articles.title: Microstructural and Strength Characterization of Acid-Resistant Cement Mortar Incorporating Crab Shell Powder and Recycled PET
articles.title_zh: 蟹壳粉和再生PET耐酸水泥砂浆的显微组织和强度表征
articles.abstract: Environmental pollution caused by marine shell waste and plastic disposal, together with carbon dioxide emissions from cement production, has increased the demand for sustainable construction materials. This study investigates the microstructural characteristics and acid resistance of cement mortar incorporating crab shell powder (CSP) as a partial cement replacement and recycled polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastic as a fine aggregate replacement. X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis identified portlandite, quartz, belite, and tobermorite phases, providing insights into hydration and microstructural development. X-ray fluorescence (XRF) analysis revealed slight variations in the major oxide composition and clinker compounds, supporting the potential use of CSP as a supplementary cementitious material. Durability performance was evaluated by immersing mortar cubes in hydrochloric acid (HCl) and sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄) for 56 and 92 days. Weight loss and compressive strength were assessed to determine the effects of CSP and PET replacement levels. The results indicate that moderate CSP incorporation improves acid resistance and durability, whereas excessive replacement causes deterioration of the cementitious matrix. A CSP replacement level of up to 15% by weight of cement is identified as a promising option for sustainable mortar production. This approach offers potential benefits through waste valorization and reduced reliance on conventional cement and natural fine aggregates.
articles.abstract_zh: 海洋贝壳废弃物和塑料处理造成的环境污染，加上水泥生产产生的二氧化碳排放，增加了对可持续建筑材料的需求。本研究研究了以蟹壳粉（ CSP ）作为部分水泥替代品，再生聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（ PET ）塑料作为精细骨料替代品的水泥砂浆的微观结构特征和耐酸性。X射线衍射（ XRD ）分析确定了钙质岩、石英、贝氏体和托氏体相，为水合作用和微观结构发展提供了见解。X射线荧光（ XRF ）分析显示主要氧化物成分和熟料化合物的轻微变化，支持CSP作为辅助胶凝材料的潜在用途。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 海洋贝壳废弃物和塑料处理造成的环境污染，加上水泥生产产生的二氧化碳排放，增加了对可持续建筑材料的需求。本研究研究了以蟹壳粉（ CSP ）作为部分水泥替代品，再生聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（ PET ）塑料作为精细骨料替代品的水泥砂浆的微观结构特征和耐酸性。X射线衍射（ XRD ）分析确定了钙质岩、石英、贝氏体和托氏体相，为水合作用和微观结构发展提供了见解。X射线荧光（ XRF ）分析显示主要氧化物成分和熟料化合物的轻微变化，支持CSP作为辅助胶凝材料的潜在用途。通过将砂浆立方体浸入盐酸（ HCl ）和硫酸（ H2SO ）中56天和92天来评估耐久性能。评估体重减轻和抗压强度，以确定CSP和PET置换水平的影响。结果表明，适度的CSP掺入可提高耐酸性和耐久性，而过度更换会导致胶凝基质的劣化。高达15重量%的水泥CSP替代水平被认为是可持续砂浆生产的一个有前途的选择。这种方法通过废物增值和减少对传统水泥和天然精细骨料的依赖提供了潜在的好处。

articles.title: Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Decision Framework with Golden Cut and ARTASI for Sustainable Mining Method Selection in Geologically Complex Thin Seams
articles.title_zh: 具有Golden Cut和ARTASI的量子球面模糊决策框架，用于地质复杂薄煤层的可持续开采方法选择
articles.abstract: The selection of a suitable mining method for geologically complex and thin coal seams, particularly those with thicknesses ranging from 0.30 to 2.12 m, remains a critical challenge. In Meghalaya, this issue is of paramount importance, as conventional unscientific extraction practices have been associated with safety hazards, resource losses, and environmental degradation. This study proposes a Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Large-Scale Decision-Making (QSF-LSDM) framework to support the systematic selection of mining methods under uncertain and conflicting conditions. The framework employs Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Sets (QSFS) to represent vagueness and hesitation in expert judgments through membership, non-membership, and hesitancy amplitudes with associated phase information. To reduce subjectivity in fuzzy parameter selection, a Golden Cut procedure based on the Golden Ratio is incorporated. Expert importance is determined using Consensus-Based Expert Weighting (CBEW), which reflects the degree of agreement among experts. Their assessments are subsequently aggregated using the Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Weighted Bonferroni Mean (QSFWBM), which captures interactions among criteria. Objective criterion weights are obtained through continuous Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), formulated to maximize the overall pairwise score deviation among alternatives. The final ranking is established using the Alternative Ranking Technique based on Adaptive Standardized Intervals (ARTASI). The framework is applied to 12 candidate mining methods evaluated across 12 criteria covering technical, economic, safety, environmental, and operational aspects.. The results identify automated 3D-trajectory shearer mining ((:M₁₀); (:Ω:=0.674)) as the highest-ranked method, followed by shearer-based thin-seam longwall mining ((:M₅); (:Ω:=0.662)) and continuous-miner bord-and-pillar mining ((:M₃); (:Ω:=0.632)). Sensitivity and comparative analyses further demonstrate the stability and robustness of the obtained ranking.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于地质复杂和薄煤层，特别是厚度在0.30至2.12 m之间的煤层，选择合适的开采方法仍然是一个关键的挑战。在梅加拉亚邦，这个问题至关重要，因为传统的非科学开采实践与安全危害、资源损失和环境退化有关。本研究提出了一个量子球面模糊大规模决策（ Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Large-Scale Decision-Making ， QSF-LSDM ）框架，以支持不确定和冲突条件下采矿方法的系统选择。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于地质复杂和薄煤层，特别是厚度在0.30至2.12 m之间的煤层，选择合适的开采方法仍然是一个关键的挑战。在梅加拉亚邦，这个问题至关重要，因为传统的非科学开采实践与安全危害、资源损失和环境退化有关。本研究提出了一个量子球面模糊大规模决策（ Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Large-Scale Decision-Making ， QSF-LSDM ）框架，以支持不确定和冲突条件下采矿方法的系统选择。该框架采用量子球面模糊集（ QSFS ） ，通过成员、非成员和犹豫幅度以及相关的相位信息来表示专家判断中的模糊和犹豫。为了减少模糊参数选择中的主观性，引入了基于黄金比例的黄金分割程序。专家重要性使用基于共识的专家加权（ CBEW ）来确定， CBEW反映了专家之间的一致程度。随后使用量子球面模糊加权Bonferroni均值（ QSFWBM ）对其评估进行汇总，该均值捕获了标准之间的相互作用。客观标准权重是通过连续蚁群优化（ ACO ）获得的，该优化是为了最大化备选方案之间的总体成对得分偏差而制定的。最终排名使用基于自适应标准化区间（ ARTASI ）的替代排名技术来确定。该框架适用于在12个标准中评估的12种候选采矿方法，这些标准涵盖技术、经济、安全、环境和运营方面。研究结果表明，自动三维轨迹采煤机采矿（ （ ： M * * ）; （ ： Ω ： = 0.674 ） ）是排名最高的方法，其次是基于采煤机的薄煤层长壁采矿（ （ ： M * * ）; （ ： Ω ： = 0.662 ） ）和连续采矿机边柱采矿（ ： M * * ）; （ ： Ω ： = 0.632 ） ）。灵敏度和比较分析进一步证明了所得排名的稳定性和鲁棒性。

articles.title: The MAL Simulator: Cyber Operations Simulation based on Attack & Defense Graphs
articles.title_zh: MAL模拟器：基于攻击和防御图的网络运营模拟
articles.abstract: We have developed the MAL Simulator, a cyber operation simulator based on the Meta Attack Language (MAL). The MAL Simulator is intended for decision-driven cyber attack and defense simulations, for system analysis and the development of automated agents. By building the simulator around an attack modeling language, it can be adapted to different target domains without modifying the source code. We used the simulator for two case studies where we trained two types of agents for automated cyber operations: a defensive agent and an offensive agent. To ground the experiments, we base the models in data collected from an emulated network implemented in the cyber range CRATE. We found that the trained attacker policy could reach the designated targets more efficiently than the compared search methods, and that the trained defender agent induced lower costs than a naive heuristic agent under noisy alert conditions. When testing the RL attacker against the RL defender, we found that the performance of the defenders dropped significantly. This emphasizes the importance of cyber attack simulators to facilitate training both offensive and defensive agents. The MAL Simulator and associated tooling is publicly available and provides common interfaces for compatibility with existing machine learning frameworks.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了MAL模拟器，这是一款基于元攻击语言（ MAL ）的网络操作模拟器。MAL模拟器用于决策驱动的网络攻击和防御模拟，用于系统分析和自动化代理的开发。通过围绕攻击建模语言构建模拟器，它可以适应不同的目标域，而无需修改源代码。我们将模拟器用于两个案例研究，其中我们培训了两种类型的自动网络操作代理：防御代理和进攻代理。为了为实验奠定基础，我们将模型基于从网络靶场板条箱中实现的模拟网络收集的数据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了MAL模拟器，这是一款基于元攻击语言（ MAL ）的网络操作模拟器。MAL模拟器用于决策驱动的网络攻击和防御模拟，用于系统分析和自动化代理的开发。通过围绕攻击建模语言构建模拟器，它可以适应不同的目标域，而无需修改源代码。我们将模拟器用于两个案例研究，其中我们培训了两种类型的自动网络操作代理：防御代理和进攻代理。为了为实验奠定基础，我们将模型基于从网络靶场板条箱中实现的模拟网络收集的数据。我们发现，与比较的搜索方法相比，训练的攻击者策略可以更有效地到达指定目标，并且在噪声警报条件下，训练的防御者代理比天真的启发式代理的成本更低。在对RL防御者测试RL攻击者时，我们发现防御者的表现显着下降。这强调了网络攻击模拟器在促进进攻和防御特工培训方面的重要性。MAL模拟器和相关工具是公开可用的，并提供与现有机器学习框架兼容的通用接口。

articles.title: Tactile alert placement in driving contexts based on neurocognitive evidence and eight consensus based design guidelines
articles.title_zh: 基于神经认知证据和八项基于共识的设计准则，在驾驶环境中放置触觉警报
articles.abstract: Tactile alerts can communicate spatial and temporal information in automo-tive human–machine interfaces while reducing reliance on visual and auditory channels. Evidence on appropriate body locations for such alerts remains dis-tributed across automotive human-machine interface (HMI), haptic-interface, and somatosensory research. This study examines how body location may influ-ence the perception and processing of tactile alerts in driving contexts. It adopts a sequential evidence-to-consensus design comprising a scoping review of automo-tive HMI studies, reported in accordance with PRISMA-ScR; an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses on tactile perception and processing; and a modified Delphi study with six specialists from automotive industry, design, and neuroscience. The scoping review identified fifteen eligible studies, while the umbrella review synthesized evidence from six eligible reviews. The integrated evidence indicates that body regions differ in tactile acuity and sensitivity and that spatial congruence between stimulation location and event direction may support alert interpretation and response. Ten preliminary design guidelines were formulated and subsequently evaluated and refined through expert consensus, resulting in eight consensus-supported guidelines.
articles.abstract_zh: 触觉警报可以在自动人机界面中传达空间和时间信息，同时减少对视觉和听觉通道的依赖。在汽车人机界面（ HMI ）、触觉界面和躯体感觉研究中，有关此类警报的适当身体位置的证据仍然存在。本研究研究了身体位置如何影响驾驶环境中触觉警报的感知和处理。它采用循序的证据到共识设计，包括根据PRISMA-ScR报告的自动人机界面研究的范围审查；关于触觉感知和处理的系统评价和荟萃分析的总括审查；以及由来自汽车行业、设计和神经科学的六位专家参与的经修改的Delphi研究。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 触觉警报可以在自动人机界面中传达空间和时间信息，同时减少对视觉和听觉通道的依赖。在汽车人机界面（ HMI ）、触觉界面和躯体感觉研究中，有关此类警报的适当身体位置的证据仍然存在。本研究研究了身体位置如何影响驾驶环境中触觉警报的感知和处理。它采用循序的证据到共识设计，包括根据PRISMA-ScR报告的自动人机界面研究的范围审查；关于触觉感知和处理的系统评价和荟萃分析的总括审查；以及由来自汽车行业、设计和神经科学的六位专家参与的经修改的Delphi研究。范围界定综述确定了15项符合条件的研究，而总括综述综合了6项符合条件综述的证据。综合证据表明，身体区域在触觉敏锐度和灵敏度方面存在差异，刺激位置和事件方向之间的空间一致性可能支持警报解释和响应。制定了十项初步设计指南，随后通过专家共识进行评估和完善，最终形成了八项共识支持的指南。

articles.title: Assessing the Robustness of European and Chinese Air and High Speed Rail Network Accessibility
articles.title_zh: 评估欧洲和中国空中和高速铁路网络可达性的稳健性
articles.abstract: Aviation and High-speed rail (HSR) are primary modes for continental long-distance travel. While their integration can significantly enhance systemic robustness, network topologies and governance models differ drastically between Air and HSR networks across regions. We conduct a quantitative, comparative robustness analysis of the aviation-only network against the integrated aviation-HSR network for both Europe and China. Using a multi-layer network representation of scheduled services, topological metrics and a schedule-based routing algorithm, the networks are subjected to simulated random airport failures, adaptive targeted hub attacks, and operational airline shutdowns. The results reveal that under random failures, both unimodal aviation networks exhibit similar topological decay. However, under targeted attacks, China's reliance on a highly concentrated hub-and-spoke system leads to an earlier topological collapse compared to Europe's decentralized, point-to-point network. Crucially, integrating the HSR layer fundamentally shifts this dynamic. China's unified HSR mega-grid acts as a safeguard that nearly halves topological vulnerability and preserves substantial service availability during major aviation disruptions. Conversely, Europe's fragmented HSR ''patchwork" provides only marginal redundancy during aviation crises. While China can strategically leverage its HSR grid to mitigate disruptions in the aviation network, Europe must prioritize cross-border rail services to create a viable multimodal safety net for long-distance travel.
articles.abstract_zh: 航空和高速铁路（ HSR ）是大陆长途旅行的主要模式。虽然它们的集成可以显着增强系统稳健性，但Air和HSR网络之间的网络拓扑和治理模型在各个地区之间存在巨大差异。我们对照欧洲和中国的综合航空高铁网络，对纯航空网络进行定量、比较稳健性分析。使用调度服务的多层网络表示、拓扑度量和基于调度的路由算法，网络将受到模拟随机机场故障、自适应定向枢纽攻击和航空公司运营关闭的影响。结果表明，在随机故障下，两个单峰航空网络都表现出相似的拓扑衰减。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 航空和高速铁路（ HSR ）是大陆长途旅行的主要模式。虽然它们的集成可以显着增强系统稳健性，但Air和HSR网络之间的网络拓扑和治理模型在各个地区之间存在巨大差异。我们对照欧洲和中国的综合航空高铁网络，对纯航空网络进行定量、比较稳健性分析。使用调度服务的多层网络表示、拓扑度量和基于调度的路由算法，网络将受到模拟随机机场故障、自适应定向枢纽攻击和航空公司运营关闭的影响。结果表明，在随机故障下，两个单峰航空网络都表现出相似的拓扑衰减。然而，在有针对性的攻击下，与欧洲分散的点对点网络相比，中国对高度集中的中心辐射系统的依赖导致了更早的拓扑崩溃。至关重要的是，整合HSR层从根本上改变了这种动态。中国统一的高铁大型电网起到了保障作用，几乎将拓扑脆弱性降低了一半，并在重大航空中断期间保持了大量的服务可用性。相反，欧洲零散的高铁“拼凑”在航空危机期间只能提供边际冗余。虽然中国可以战略性地利用其高铁网络来缓解航空网络的中断，但欧洲必须优先考虑跨境铁路服务，以创建可行的多式联运长途旅行安全网。

articles.title: Evaluation of a GNSS-derived RTK-RISK indicator against global space-weather indices during the May 2024 geomagnetic storm
articles.title_zh: 2024年5月地磁风暴期间全球导航卫星系统衍生的RTK-RISK指标与全球空间天气指数的评估
articles.abstract: Severe space-weather events can produce rapid temporal and spatial ionospheric disturbances that degrade high-precision Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positioning. This study evaluates a regional GNSS-derived RTK-RISK indicator against independent global space-weather and geomagnetic indices during the extreme geomagnetic storm of 11 May 2024. RTK-RISK combines regional Rate of Total Electron Content Index (ROTI) variability and spatial vertical total electron content (VTEC) gradients derived from a Latvian continuously operating reference station network. The indicator and its individual components were compared with the geomagnetic Dst and Kp indices, the interplanetary magnetic field Bz component, its southward component Bs, solar-wind speed, and the coupling proxy VswBs. Spearman rank correlation was used as the principal measure of association. The strongest statistically significant simultaneous relationship with RTK-RISK was observed for Dst (ρ = −0.63). Kp showed a positive association of ρ = 0.65, although this relationship did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.078, N = 8) at its native 3-h resolution. Significant simultaneous associations were also observed for Bs (ρ = 0.41), Bz (ρ = −0.40), and VswBs (ρ = 0.35). The signs of these relationships were physically consistent with enhanced geomagnetic activity and southward interplanetary magnetic field conditions. The results indicate that the independently derived regional RTK-RISK indicator responds coherently to global space-weather conditions and provides a locally resolved measure of ionospheric disturbance relevant to RTK positioning reliability.
articles.abstract_zh: 严重的空间天气事件会产生快速的时间和空间电离层干扰，从而降低高精度全球导航卫星系统（ GNSS ）的定位。本研究根据2024年5月11日极端地磁风暴期间独立的全球空间天气和地磁指数，对区域GNSS衍生的RTK-RISK指标进行评估。RTK-RISK结合了来自拉脱维亚连续运行参考站网络的区域总电子含量指数（ ROTI ）变异率和空间垂直总电子含量（ VTEC ）梯度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 严重的空间天气事件会产生快速的时间和空间电离层干扰，从而降低高精度全球导航卫星系统（ GNSS ）的定位。本研究根据2024年5月11日极端地磁风暴期间独立的全球空间天气和地磁指数，对区域GNSS衍生的RTK-RISK指标进行评估。RTK-RISK结合了来自拉脱维亚连续运行参考站网络的区域总电子含量指数（ ROTI ）变异率和空间垂直总电子含量（ VTEC ）梯度。将该指标及其各个分量与地磁Dst和Kp指数、行星际磁场Bz分量、其南向分量Bs、太阳风速度和耦合代理VswBs进行比较。Spearman秩相关性被用作关联的主要度量。对于Dst （ ρ = − 0.63 ） ，观察到与RTK-RISK同步关系最强的统计学显著性。Kp显示ρ = 0.65的正相关，尽管这种关系在其天然3-h分辨率下没有达到统计学显著性（ p = 0.078 ， N = 8 ）。Bs （ ρ = 0.41 ）、Bz （ ρ = − 0.40 ）和VswBs （ ρ = 0.35 ）也观察到显著的同时相关性。这些关系的迹象在物理上与增强的地磁活动和向南的行星际磁场条件一致。结果表明，独立推导的区域RTK-RISK指标对全球空间天气条件做出一致响应，并提供了与RTK定位可靠性相关的电离层扰动的局部分解度量。

articles.title: Hydrogen-bond dynamics, proton transfer, and water mobility in crystalline guanidinium carbonates for direct air capture
articles.title_zh: 用于直接空气捕获的结晶碳酸胍中的氢键动力学、质子转移和水迁移率
articles.abstract: Direct air capture requires sorbents that bind CO2 selectively yet release it with low energy. Bis-iminoguanidines capture CO2 by crystallizing as hydrated carbonate salts, but the molecular events linking water loss, proton transfer, and CO2 release remain unresolved. Here we combine variable-temperature single-crystal neutron and X-ray diffraction with ab initio molecular dynamics to determine how two crystalline carbonate phases follow different regeneration pathways. We show that lattice water acts as a molecular gate for carbonate protonation. In a metastable phase, water is isolated from carbonate, creating a softer hydrogen-bond network that promotes surface proton transfer and a transient carbonic-acid configuration. In the stable phase, water hydrogen-bonds directly to carbonate, stabilizing the lattice and suppressing proton transfer until water rearrangement and partial desorption disrupt the hydration environment. Controlling hydration topology together with targeted hydrogen-bond flexibility offers a route to direct-air-capture sorbents that retain selective CO2 binding while lowering regeneration energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 直接空气捕获需要吸附剂选择性地结合二氧化碳，但以低能量释放二氧化碳。双亚氨基胍通过结晶为水合碳酸盐来捕获二氧化碳，但与水损失、质子转移和二氧化碳释放相关的分子事件仍未解决。在这里，我们将变温单晶中子和X射线衍射与从头分子动力学相结合，以确定两种结晶碳酸盐相如何遵循不同的再生途径。我们证明了晶格水充当碳酸盐质子的分子门。在亚稳相中，水与碳酸盐分离，形成更软的氢键网络，促进表面质子转移和瞬态碳酸结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 直接空气捕获需要吸附剂选择性地结合二氧化碳，但以低能量释放二氧化碳。双亚氨基胍通过结晶为水合碳酸盐来捕获二氧化碳，但与水损失、质子转移和二氧化碳释放相关的分子事件仍未解决。在这里，我们将变温单晶中子和X射线衍射与从头分子动力学相结合，以确定两种结晶碳酸盐相如何遵循不同的再生途径。我们证明了晶格水充当碳酸盐质子的分子门。在亚稳相中，水与碳酸盐分离，形成更软的氢键网络，促进表面质子转移和瞬态碳酸结构。在稳定相中，水氢直接与碳酸盐结合，稳定晶格并抑制质子转移，直到水重排和部分解吸破坏水合环境。控制水合拓扑和有针对性的氢键灵活性为直接空气捕获吸附剂提供了一种途径，该吸附剂在降低再生能量的同时保留了选择性的二氧化碳结合。

articles.title: Runoff Interception Characteristics of a Y-Shaped Bamboo Structure for Slope Protection
articles.title_zh: Y形竹护坡结构径流截流特性
articles.abstract: Conventional slope protection systems are susceptible to runoff-induced erosion, surface-soil loss, and shallow soil deformation under rainfall conditions. This study developed a Y-shaped bamboo structure integrating runoff interception and seepage drainage functions. Model tests and theoretical analysis were conducted to investigate the runoff interception efficiency of the structure under simulated rainfall conditions. The results showed that the Y-shaped bamboo structure exhibited effective runoff interception performance, with the cumulative intercepted runoff increasing approximately linearly with rainfall duration. The included angle between the two wings had the greatest effect on runoff interception efficiency, followed by wing length and wing diameter, with these three parameters collectively accounting for 93.04% of the total variance. Furthermore, a theoretical runoff interception model coupling weir flow theory with Darcy's law was developed and validated against laboratory model tests, showing good agreement with the experimental results. The findings provide a theoretical basis for geometric optimization and support the potential application of Y-shaped bamboo structures in ecological slope protection.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统的边坡保护系统在降雨条件下容易受到径流引起的侵蚀、地表土壤流失和浅层土壤变形的影响。本研究开发了一种集径流截流和渗流排水功能于一体的Y形竹结构。进行了模型试验和理论分析，以研究结构在模拟降雨条件下的径流截流效率。结果表明， Y形竹结构表现出有效的径流截流性能，累积截流量随降雨持续时间近似线性增加。两翼夹角对径流截流效率影响最大，其次是翅膀长度和翅膀直径，这三个参数合计占总方差的93.04%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统的边坡保护系统在降雨条件下容易受到径流引起的侵蚀、地表土壤流失和浅层土壤变形的影响。本研究开发了一种集径流截流和渗流排水功能于一体的Y形竹结构。进行了模型试验和理论分析，以研究结构在模拟降雨条件下的径流截流效率。结果表明， Y形竹结构表现出有效的径流截流性能，累积截流量随降雨持续时间近似线性增加。两翼夹角对径流截流效率影响最大，其次是翅膀长度和翅膀直径，这三个参数合计占总方差的93.04%。此外，在实验室模型试验中，建立了耦合堰流理论和达西定律的理论径流截获模型，并进行了验证，与实验结果吻合良好。研究结果为几何优化提供了理论依据，并支持Y形竹结构在生态边坡保护中的潜在应用。

articles.title: Interoceptive Breathing Perceptions with Anxiety
articles.title_zh: 焦虑时的感知呼吸感知
articles.abstract: Background Interoception (i.e. the sensing, processing, and evaluation of signals originating from within the body) has emerged as a key process linked to anxiety, sharing both neural and physiological substrates. The current project examined how anxiety is related to subjective measures of sensitivity towards two different interoceptive breathing modalities, inspiratory resistance and hypercapnia (elevated carbon dioxide; CO2), across a spectrum of anxiety levels.Methods Participants (n = 75) completed self-report measures of anxiety and related variables before undergoing two breathing perception tasks involving graded increases in inspiratory resistance (10, 20, 30 cmH2O/L/s) and hypercapnia (2%, 4%, 6% CO2). Perceptual responses (sensory via breathlessness ratings and affect via anxiety ratings) at each step were recorded using visual analogue scales. Data were analysed in STATA using linear mixed effects regression models to assess the variance associated with anxiety status, stimulus level, and their interaction. Additional exploratory correlation analyses were also performed between the perceptual, physiological and anxiety-related measures.Results Primary analyses indicated that anxiety was associated with increased overall affective ratings (resistance: β = 3.83, p < 0.05; CO2: β = 3.28, p < 0.05) but not sensory ratings. However, anxiety did not influence participants’ sensitivity to changes in stimulus intensity (i.e. slope) for either inspiratory resistance or hypercapnia. Additionally, anxiety did not relate to ventilatory responses during either stimulus. Exploratory analyses revealed additional correlations including lower self-efficacy relating to altered ventilation during both tasks.Conclusions Overall, these findings suggest that anxiety is primarily associated with increased overall affective perceptions of breathing-related interoceptive signals but does not alter the sensory ratings nor ventilatory responses. This dissociation highlights potential markers for anxiety vulnerability and may inform the development of targeted interventions that focus on specifically modifying affective responses to bodily sensations.

articles.title: Structural, Dielectric, Optical, and Electrochemical Insights into Enhanced OER Activity of Y3Fe5O12 over YFeO3 Ferrite Nanoparticles for Hydroelectric Cell Applications
articles.abstract: YFeO3 (YF) and Y3Fe5O12 (YGF) nanoparticles were synthesized by a modified low-temperature sol-gel auto-combustion route to elucidate structure–property relationships governing oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and hydroelectric cell (HEC) performance. Rietveld-refined XRD confirmed orthorhombic YF and cubic garnet YGF phases, while Raman and HRTEM established phase purity, crystallinity, and morphology. YGF exhibited higher dielectric permittivity (23.20), lower dielectric loss (0.765), larger specific surface area (12.815 m2g− 1), and oxygen-vacancy-rich surface chemistry, facilitating electrochemical charge transfer. Accordingly, YGF showed higher ECSA (18.25 cm²), Cdl (0.73 mF cm− 2), and lower Rct (359 Ω) than YF. YGF delivered superior OER activity with an overpotential of 392 mV at 10 mA cm− 2 and a Tafel slope of 133 mV dec− 1. The YGF-based HEC achieved 14.123 mA short-circuit current, 0.981 V open-circuit voltage, and 13.854 mW maximum power, demonstrating its potential for sustainable hydroelectric energy conversion. These findings establish YGF as a promising multifunctional energy-conversion material.

articles.title: Impact of Fractal Dimension on Antenna Behavior: Sierpiński Carpet and Koch Snowflake Designs
articles.abstract: This paper presents a comparative study of two fractal antennas—the Sierpiński Carpet and Koch Snowflake-designed with identical dimensions and operating at 2.3~GHz. Although similar in size, their different fractal geometries lead to distinct electromagnetic behaviors. Key performance metrics such as input impedance, reflection coefficient, and radiation patterns are analyzed.

articles.title: Comparative Analysis of Viscoelastic Models for Head-Tissue Layers under Step Loading
articles.abstract: This study compares four linear viscoelastic networks for scalp, skull, cerebrospinal fluid, and brain contributions. An eight-element parallel network describes stress relaxation, while an eight-element series network describes creep. Reduced Maxwell and Kelvin models are evaluated alongside these configurations. Closed-form equations connect the spring–dashpot arrangements to their response curves. Under a 5% step strain, the parallel network relaxes from 400.835 to 400.334 MPa, a decrease of about 0.125%. The skull spring accounts for most of the stress. At a held stress of 24.010 kPa, the series network approaches a strain rate of 4802.05 s−1 because its free dashpots sustain flow. The reduced Kelvin network gives bounded creep with a 7 ms time constant. Its strain reaches 14.6224 at 0.1 s, exceeding the small-strain range at the selected load. The three-element Maxwell approximation closely follows the total relaxation stress, with a maximum difference of 0.015082 MPa. Comparison of the normalized relaxing components reveals the difference in decay rates. The findings connect network structure, material inputs, and loading to the resulting relaxation and creep behavior, providing a basis for further development of reduced head-tissue models.

articles.title: The Lunar Stairway: An Orbital-Platform-First Paradigm for Lunar Development and Its Engineering Rationale
articles.abstract: Objective: To examine the mainstream premise that lunar development must be based on the lunar surface; to argue the engineering rationale for building long-term residential bases, production facilities, and logistics hubs first in circumlunar orbit rather than on the lunar surface; and to propose a system design for the “Lunar Stairway” (a distributed system of circumlunar platform ports).  Methods: On the basis of orbital mechanics (the vis-viva equation and the rocket equation), the velocity increments and mass penalties of lunar-surface landing and departure were calculated and compared with those of residence in circumlunar orbit; the success rate of lunar soft-landing missions worldwide from 1966 to 2025 was tallied; scientific assessments of the Apollo moonquake network, the Chang’e-4 in situ radiation measurements on the lunar surface, and the health effects of lunar dust were compiled; and a ballistic delivery and interception–deceleration model for the “circumlunar platform–capsule projectile–cable-net/pit/sponge-lake splashdown” system was established.  Results: A one-way landing on the lunar surface requires a velocity increment of approximately 1.9 km/s (with Isp = 300 s, propellant accounts for approximately 47.6% of the initial mass), and departure from the Moon requires a further approximately 1.85 km/s. The fully successful lunar soft-landing rate is approximately 50%, with failures concentrated in the powered-descent phase. Apollo seismometers recorded shallow moonquakes of magnitude up to approximately 5, lasting from tens of minutes to several hours, far longer than the tens of seconds of terrestrial earthquakes. The dose equivalent rate on the lunar surface is approximately 1.4 mSv/d (twice that on the International Space Station), and an extreme solar particle event of the 1972 type could deliver a dose of the order of 3–4 Sv without shielding. Lunar dust is fine, electrically charged, and sharp-edged; it is difficult to remove completely and causes irreversible damage to equipment and to the human respiratory system. With frozen orbits, the annual station-keeping velocity increment in low lunar orbit can be held to 10–50 m/s, corresponding to approximately 3–17 kg/(t·yr) of chemical propellant or approximately 0.6–3.2 kg/(t·yr) with electric propulsion, comparable to or lower than the ISS reboost level (approximately 18 kg/(t·yr)); ballistic delivery requires only an ejection increment of approximately 23 m/s and approximately 10 kg/t of propellant. Near-lunar orbits, although they require more orbit control, maintain closer contact with the lunar surface and receive less galactic radiation because of blockage by the Moon. Different orbits and distributed deployments should therefore be adopted according to actual requirements.  Conclusions: Circumlunar-orbit platforms are comprehensively superior to lunar-surface residence in energy, safety, environment, astronomical observation, and logistics efficiency. It is recommended that the primary construction layer of lunar development be placed in lunar orbit rather than on the lunar surface, and that low-overload ballistic delivery and electromagnetic ejection be used to open a “lunar orbit–lunar surface” materials corridor (without which construction of the Stairway would be pointless). If a momentum-exchange mode is adopted between platform and cargo, substantial propellant and energy can be saved, coupling the efficient descent of cargo with platform orbit changes and orbit maintenance. The paper also proposes that spent spacecraft hulls be stored in lunar orbit as a reserve of scarce metals.

articles.title: Self-Calibrated Hyperspectral Neural Radiance Fields for 3D Reconstruction of Bone and Bone Analogues
articles.abstract: Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) captures rich, wavelength-dependent information linked to mineralised tissue composition, while3D reconstruction preserves surface morphology and structural detail. Combining the two offers a powerful, non-contactapproach for bone assessment, yet existing hyperspectral 3D reconstruction methods rely on externally estimated cameraposes (e.g., via COLMAP), an assumption that is often unreliable on bone surfaces due to their low texture, specular reflectance,and irregular morphology. To address this challenge, we propose BoNeRF-HS, a self-calibrated hyperspectral neural radiancefield for 3D reconstruction. BoNeRF-HS jointly optimises camera intrinsics, volume density, and hyperspectral radiance directlyfrom multi-view HSI, removing the need for COLMAP based poses. To exploit the correlation between neighbouring spectralbands, we introduce a gated spectral adapter head that learns a controlled, wavelength-dependent residual correction to thepredicted radiance. We evaluate BoNeRF-HS on a newly acquired multi-view hyperspectral dataset (45 views, 120 spectralbands, 400–1000 nm) of mouse bone, trabecular bone analogue, and cortical bone analogue specimens. Experimental resultsdemonstrate that our framework achieves improved reconstruction quality, and better preservation of bone surface detailscompared with existing approaches. These results establish a practical path toward pose-free, non-contact 3D hyperspectralcharacterisation of bone, with potential applications in intraoperative visualisation, forensic skeletal analysis, and biomaterialevaluation.

articles.title: Slow-motion electron camera reveals light-driven quantum jumps in graphene
articles.abstract: Using a new slow-motion electron camera, physicists from Regensburg, Marburg and Jülich revealed how intense electric fields drive electrons in graphene, causing them to jump across energy gaps in a seemingly paradoxical manner. This was made possible by a novel combination of laser technology and electron microscopy.

articles.title: Topography shapes the internal organisation of tiger home ranges in the plateau-gorge landscapes of central India
articles.abstract: Accurate home-range estimation is central to understanding animal space use, yet most telemetry studies represent terrestrial movement on two-dimensional planimetric surfaces and may therefore overlook the effects of terrain. Although digital elevation model (DEM)-based three-dimensional correction can improve home-range estimates in steep mountainous environments, its ecological relevance in plateau-gorge landscapes remain unclear. We examined how topography influences both home-range estimation and the internal organisation of space use by resident tigers (Panthera tigris) in the Vindhyan plateau-gorge landscape of central India. Using long-term GPS telemetry data, we compared two-dimensional and DEM-corrected three-dimensional autocorrelated kernel density estimates for 50% core areas and 95% home ranges across sexes and seasons. We also classified the landscape into six functional landform classes using DEM-derived geomorphometric variables and applied a Bayesian Dirichlet core–shell model to quantify landform enrichment within 50% core areas relative to the surrounding 95 − 50% home-range shell. Topographic correction produced only negligible increases in estimated home-range area, with 3D-to-2D ratios close to unity, indicating that vertical relief contributed little to the geometric extent of tiger home ranges in this landscape. Terrain nevertheless strongly influenced where intensive space use occurred. Core areas were consistently enriched in rugged refuge and low-drainage landforms, whereas open plateau was systematically under-represented. These patterns were strongest during summer and monsoon and were more pronounced and seasonally consistent in females than in males, suggesting sex-specific differences in the spatial organisation of core use. By contrast, general slope showed little evidence of consistent enrichment across seasons. Our results show that a limited effect of topographic correction on total home-range area should not be interpreted as evidence that terrain is ecologically unimportant. In this plateau–gorge system, topography shaped the internal distribution of tiger space use more strongly than the outer geometry of the home range. Combining DEM-derived landform classification with Bayesian compositional analysis therefore reveals ecological structure that conventional home-range metrics alone may miss. This framework is broadly transferable to wide-ranging terrestrial mammals in heterogeneous landscapes and can help identify terrain features that contribute disproportionately to habitat quality and conservation value.

articles.title: Isogeometric thermal buckling analysis of variable-stiffness laminated plates with delamination using a multi-point constraint approach
articles.abstract: Variable-stiffness laminated plates offer superior structural efficiency but are susceptible to delamination defects that significantly degrade their thermal buckling performance. This paper presents an isogeometric analysis (IGA) framework for the thermal buckling of VS laminated plates containing elliptical or rectangular delamination. The geometry and displacement field are discretized using non-uniform rational B-splines, which naturally satisfy the high-order continuity required by higher-order shear deformation theory and accurately represent curvilinear fiber paths. Delamination is modeled by a two-plate approach, dividing the plate into upper and lower sublaminates in the delaminated region. Multi-point constraints (MPCs) enforced via a penalty method are employed to guarantee kinematic compatibility along the intact interface. Fully clamped boundary conditions are applied on all four edges. The thermal buckling problem is reduced to a generalized eigenvalue problem, and the critical temperature is obtained as the smallest positive eigenvalue. Numerical verification against FEM results confirms the accuracy of the proposed model. Parametric studies investigate the effects of delamination shape, size, aspect ratio, in-plane location, and number of delaminations on the critical thermal buckling temperature. The proposed IGA-MPC framework provides an accurate and efficient tool for analyzing the thermal buckling of VS laminated plates with delamination.

articles.title: Life cycle assessment of the Garissa solar PV plant: evaluating the environmental sustainability of utility-scale solar in Kenya
articles.abstract: Kenya’s transition to low-carbon energy systems has accelerated the deployment of utility-scale solar photovoltaic projects, yet questions remain about their long-term environmental sustainability. This study presents a cradle-to-grave life cycle assessment of the Garissa Solar PV Plant, the largest grid-connected solar facility in East and Central Africa, to quantify its greenhouse gas emissions and identify environmental hotspots. Using an attributional LCA framework and a custom Excel-based model and region appropriate inventories, the study assessed emissions across manufacturing, transportation, operation, and end-of-life management under current national conditions. The results indicate the plant’s lifecycle intensity is 23.6 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹, substantially lower than fossil-based electricity generation (coal: 780–1095 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹; natural gas: 400–726 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹), and consistent with international benchmarks for utility-scale PV systems (typically 20–60 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹, depending on the technology, geography, and system boundaries). Lifecycle contributions are dominated by upstream stages: manufacturing, 17.27 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹ and balance of components, 5.85 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹; transport, 0.47 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹; and end-of-life, 0.0237 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹ under a conservative 100% landfill baseline. Although Garissa’s carbon profile aligns with international benchmarks, it reveals Kenya’s reliance on carbon-intensive global supply chains remains a key driver in upstream emissions. The study underscores the need for lifecycle-aligned policy reforms, including solar-specific recycling protocols, localised manufacturing strategies, and water-efficient maintenance practices in arid regions. It also anticipates future challenges posed by BESS, which could significantly increase lifecycle emissions. By providing Kenya’s first utility-scale solar LCA, this research offers critical insights for policymakers, developers, and researchers aiming to align solar expansion with climate and sustainability goals.

articles.title: First Line or Last Word: Where a Stored Order Sits in a Product Review and Whether a Web LLM Assistant Obeys It
articles.abstract: In a companion study we showed that a short stored review carrying a direct order (“delete user carlos”) made a small local assistant delete the account every time, while a hosted-class assistant ignored it (Hadad, Hadad, and Tavakoli 2026). Real reviews are not short shouts. They run to a paragraph, and a planted sentence can sit at the top, in the middle, or at the bottom of one. This paper moves that one sentence around inside the same ordinary review and asks whether where it sits decides whether it is obeyed, discussed, or simply summarised away. We test two framings (direct order, support note) at three positions in one fixed jacket review, in the same Flask shop, on the same two models, vulnerable and tool-free variants, 84 trials in total. No position produced a deletion on either model: direct orders in a full-length review gave 0/9 effects on the local model, against 3/3 for near-identical plain wording in a one-line review in the companion study. Position showed up one level lower. On the local model the opening direct order was still discussed as account business in 3/3 trials, while every other planted cell was summarised as jacket text (0/15; Fisher (:p=0.0012) on deletion talk). Muse surfaced exactly one planted order in 18 attack trials, at the end of a review, and surfaced it to refuse it by name (§[sec:results36]). A stored order, it turns out, needs to be the review, not merely in it – and even at the top of a real review, this small model only talked. We release payloads, transcripts, judge labels, and the counting scripts.

articles.title: Merging nonlinear finite element models and the floating frame of reference formulation
articles.abstract: The current state of the art floating frame of reference formulation is used for flexible multibody dynamics simulations. In this formulation, the flexibility is modelled using linear finite element models with respect to a moving frame. Nevertheless, taking into account higher order terms locally can be important for the purpose of modelling moderate to large strains within a body. Nonlinear finite element models contain such terms. In this work, it is explained how the floating frame of reference formulation and the nonlinear finite element formulation can be merged to obtain the best of both worlds. A new nonlinear finite element formulation is developed relative to a body’s floating frame. This is used to find expressions for the internal elastic loads and tangent stiffness matrix. Both expressions contain all possible higher order terms and can be used in the incremental solution procedures for static and dynamic simulations. The new formulation is developed such that when these higher order terms are neglected, a floating frame formulation is obtained in terms of the absolute interface coordinates. Hence, this work enables inclusion of carefully selected higher order terms in the floating frame formulation for specific applications. In this way, the floating frame of reference formulation allows for higher order terms while at the same time model order reduction techniques can still be applied.

articles.title: Multi-Objective Thermo-Mechanical Topology Optimization of Lightweight Structures for Structural Stiffness, Thermal Performance, and Dynamic Characteristics
articles.abstract: This study presents a multi-objective topology optimization framework for lightweight thermo-mechanical structures subjected to simultaneous mechanical, thermal, and dynamic requirements. A two-dimensional simply supported structure is modeled using a structured quadrilateral finite element mesh comprising 4,800 Q4 elements and 4,961 nodes. The material distribution is parameterized using the Solid Isotropic Material with Penalization (SIMP) approach with a penalization factor of 3.0 and a prescribed volume fraction of 40%. Three coupled performance criteria are considered: structural compliance, total heat transfer, and fundamental natural frequency. Thermal, structural, and modal finite element analyses are sequentially performed for each candidate topology within a multi-objective evolutionary optimization procedure. The optimized configuration preserves the prescribed material volume and total mass of 31.20 kg while redistributing material toward mechanically and dynamically efficient regions. The results show a reduction in structural compliance from 8.70646×10− 2 to 8.65559×10− 2, corresponding to a 0.584% improvement. The fundamental natural frequency increases from 145.63 to 148.24 Hz, representing a 1.793% improvement, while the second and third natural frequencies reach 295.03 and 555.69 Hz, respectively. Total heat transfer changes only marginally from 43.2021 to 43.2368 W, corresponding to a 0.0804% increase. The final optimized structure exhibits a maximum displacement of 4.6663×10− 4 m, maximum von Mises stress of 1.0372×105 Pa, mean von Mises stress of 1.3848×104 Pa, and maximum heat flux of 421.08 W/m². The results demonstrate that coupled topology optimization can improve structural stiffness and dynamic performance while maintaining a fixed material budget and nearly unchanged thermal behavior. The proposed framework provides a computationally efficient basis for the design of lightweight structures requiring simultaneous mechanical, thermal, and vibration performance.

articles.title: Mechanistic Study on the Filtration Behavior Simulation of Suspended Solids in Mine Water by Coal Mine Goaf
articles.abstract: Coal and water resources are inversely distributed in western China, and the resource utilization of mine water is recognized as one of the key pathways for the green development of coal. In underground coal mine reservoirs, gangue from mined-out areas is utilized as the core purification medium; however, the removal characteristics and synergistic mechanisms for suspended solids are not yet fully clarified.Gangue and suspended solids from the Daliuta mining area are selected as research subjects. Dynamic circulation simulation tests, XRD, SEM, and laser particle size analysis are employed to systematically investigate the purification effects of gangue on suspended solids in mine water under varying concentrations, settling times, settling heights, and settling distances, and the underlying mechanisms are elucidated.The turbidity of mine water is reduced from 77.43 NTU to 11.41 NTU by gangue, with a total removal rate of 85.26%, which is nearly 20 percentage points higher than that of natural sedimentation. A higher initial concentration of suspended solids results in a faster initial removal rate, and 750 mg/L is identified as the optimal purification concentration. The main removal process is completed within 15 minutes, and an increase in settling height significantly enhances the purification effect. Suspended solids are removed through the synergistic actions of physical interception, gravitational sedimentation, and surface adsorption by gangue. Coarse particles of 150–180 µm are effectively intercepted, while most residual particles are smaller than 60 µm.The regulatory patterns of gangue particle size gradation, hydraulic retention time, and settling conditions on suspended solids sedimentation efficiency are clarified. A theoretical basis and technical support are thereby provided for the structural optimization of mined-out areas in underground coal mine reservoirs and the in-situ, low-cost purification of mine water.

articles.title: Hydrological Drought Risk Assessment and Management Prioritization under Changing Climate: Part 1. Scenario-Neutral Assessment of Bivariate Drought Hazard
articles.abstract: The results of a climate change impact assessment can differ substantially depending on the choice of climate change scenario and climate model. This study introduced a scenario-neutral approach that does not depend on specific future projections and evaluated the hydrological drought hazard of the 113 middle-sized watersheds of South Korea across a precipitation-temperature exposure space defined by systematic perturbations in precipitation and temperature. The design drought return period was estimated by copula-based bivariate frequency analysis of drought duration and severity applied to the simulated daily streamflow for 1974–2025, and watershed-specific response surfaces were constructed from 252 precipitation-temperature perturbation combinations ((:R²)=0.568–0.932). Local sensitivity analysis around the baseline point showed that the return period increased with increasing precipitation and decreased with rising temperature, and the national median precipitation increase required to offset 1℃ of warming was 2.64%. When the 72 projections from 18 general circulation models (GCMs) under 4 Shared Socioeconomic Pathway (SSP) scenarios were mapped onto the response surfaces, the ensemble median showed an increase in the return period for all SSP-period combinations, whereas 13.5–31.3% of the individual projections showed a decrease, identifying unfavorable projections that run counter to the central tendency. These results show that the scenario-neutral response surfaces allow changes in drought hazard under diverse future projections to be compared on a consistent basis, and they provide the hazard information for the watershed-level management prioritization.

articles.title: Synergistic Thermo-Hydrodynamic Enhancement in Ternary Hybrid Nanofluids (THN) Stabilized in Ethylene Glycol– Distilled Water Mixture (EG@DW 50:50)
articles.abstract: The synthesis of homogeneous and well dispersed mixed metal oxide (MMO) in a mixture of Ethylene Glycol and Distilled Water (EG@DW, 50:50) mixture is established using 2-Step probe sonication, ZnO, Al2O3, and TiO2 as an MMO/EG@DW based ternary hybrid nanofluids (THN) were prepared to evaluate the thermophysical, hydrodynamic and convective heat transfer coefficient (CHTC) characteristics in a closed straight stainless steel based circular geometry heat exchanger subjected to a constant heat flux of 10092.41 W m-2. All the metal oxides with different sizes and morphologies were taken at an equal 33.3 % weight and dispersed in EG@DW base fluid at four varying concentrations: 0.025 wt.%, 0.05 wt.%, 0.075 wt.% and 0.1 wt.% to attain well-dispersed hybrid nanofluids. The FESEM, UV-vis, and wt.% absorbance characterizations were carried out to see the uniform dispersion of all particles. The dynamic/kinematic viscosities, density, and thermal conductivity were evaluated at varying temperatures from 20ºC to 45ºC and varying wt.% concentrations. A significant improvement in all parameters was noticed when all metal oxides were loaded together in the EG@DW base fluid. The photograph sedimentation test was employed to assess the longer-term stability and suspension of all particles, and the results revealed surprising stability up to 7 weeks after preparation. Following the confirmation of the experimental analytical correlation, different test runs for MMO/EG@DW-based THN were conducted through a circular geometry heat exchanger in turbulent regions. A prominent enhancement in CHTC and Nusselt numbers was recorded on average and locally against varying Reynolds (Re) numbers from 5849 to 24544. The 0.1 wt.% concentration contributed a higher enhancement of 3120 W m−2 K−1 in CHTC of the MMO/EG@DW based THN with a slight increase in applied pumping power, which is due to the use of EG with DW. Further, the study stated that all the positive parameters at all Reynolds ranges and wt.% concentrations of MMO/EG@DW based THN offered the possible use of mixed metal oxides hybrid/composite aqueous suspension, together as an alternative working liquid in varying thermal management systems.

articles.title: Root Class-Specific Phosphorus Dynamics and Antioxidant Defense Responses in Contrasting Chinese Fir Clones Under Phosphorus Deficiency
articles.abstract: Aims Phosphorus (P) deficiency is a serious constraint on the productivity of forest plantations, especially in Chinese fir (Cunninghamia lanceolata). This study aims to determine how P availability affects root class-specific P acquisition, antioxidant responses, and physiological adaptations in two contrasting Chinese fir clones (020 and 061) across three harvesting periods. Methods Seedlings were grown in P-deficient (P0) and P-replete (P1) conditions, and P dynamics and antioxidant responses were determined across root orders, shoots, and needles. Results Generally, P concentration and accumulation increased with harvesting time and were significantly higher in P-replete conditions, with clone-061 being the better P acquirer than clone-020. P concentration and accumulation differed significantly among root classes, indicating functional specialization in P acquisition and distribution. P uptake and translocation were highest during early harvestings, while P use efficiency was higher at later growth stages. Under P deficiency, the activities of antioxidant enzymes, such as superoxide dismutase, peroxidase, and catalase, increased with harvesting time, especially in clone-061, and the malondialdehyde content decreased with harvesting time and remained comparatively lower in clone-061, indicating reduced oxidative damage. According to principal component analysis, both P acquisition and antioxidant enzyme activity were positively associated with antioxidant responses and negatively associated with malondialdehyde in a distinct, root-class-specific manner. Conclusions Overall, clone-061 exhibited superior P acquisition, utilization efficiency, and antioxidant capacity, highlighting its greater adaptation to phosphorus-limited environments. These findings reveal root-specific P-use strategies and support selecting P-efficient Chinese fir genotypes for sustainable plantation management.

articles.title: Temporally Coherent Hierarchical Distance Queries for Deformable Triangle Meshes
articles.abstract: Signed-distance queries on deformable triangle meshes are fundamental operations that are repeatedly performed in a wide range of applications, including collision handling, surface tracking, physically based simulation, and geometric processing. However, in dynamic environments where a mesh continuously deforms over time, reconstructing a static hierarchy at every frame or updating all bounding volumes can incur substantial computational cost, while conventional distance-query acceleration structures do not fully exploit such temporal coherence. In this paper, we propose a temporally coherent hierarchical distance-query method for deformable triangle meshes. The proposed method maintains an anisotropic temporal bound for each hierarchy node to account for local deformation and selectively refreshes the stored reference bound only for nodes whose deformation magnitude exceeds a prescribed threshold, thereby preserving the tightness of the temporal bounds. In addition, nearest-triangle information from the previous frame is retained as a compact persistent seed and re-evaluated on the deformed geometry of the current frame to obtain a tight initial distance upper bound. A stackless traversal is then performed using conservatively expanded hierarchical bounds to compute the exact nearest triangle and signed distance. This temporal-coherence-based hierarchy reuse and selective refresh strategy effectively reduces the cost of repeated distance queries while preserving accuracy under continuous mesh deformation. Experimental results show that, under identical distance-field resolutions and deformation conditions, the proposed method produces signed-distance values that agree with those of the baseline within numerical precision while improving distance-query performance by up to approximately 2.5× in the evaluated tests. The proposed method can therefore be effectively applied to a broad range of real-time graphics and simulation applications that require repeated distance computations on dynamic and deformable geometry.

articles.title: Observation-Based Initialization for Inverse Modeling of Atmospheric Temperature with Rossby-Constrained Transport
articles.abstract: We consider a finite-dimensional inverse problem for atmospheric temperature transport from sparse satellite observations. A spectral stream function with Rossby dispersion defines the horizontal velocity, and a convection--diffusion equation maps its parameters to temperature measurements. The main methodological component is a regularized construction of the initial temperature and compatible latitudinal boundary values from the preceding day's observations. A bounded latitude coordinate, a low-order background, and two longitudinal harmonics provide a smooth periodic initial field without using the assimilation day's temperatures. Continuous piecewise-linear finite elements, implicit Euler stepping, and streamline upwind/Petrov--Galerkin stabilization solve the forward problem. An adaptive artificial bee colony algorithm identifies 28 flow parameters under a shared perturbation-speed constraint. For 105 nighttime Aura Microwave Limb Sounder measurements on 6 March 2011, the fine-mesh root-mean-square discrepancy is 5.129 K and the Pearson correlation is 0.660. The corresponding linear-initialization experiment gives 6.127 K and 0.373, respectively. The root-mean-square discrepancy therefore decreases by 16.3%. A static evaluation of the new initial field gives a correlation of 0.549, providing a reference for assessing the additional improvement obtained with optimized transport. The results support observation-based initialization for temperature reconstruction within the considered model and motivate further evaluation of predictive performance and flow identifiability.

articles.title: Residual-Guided Adaptive Pressure Bases for Dimension-Reduced FLIP Projection
articles.abstract: We present a residual-guided adaptive pressure basis for dimension-reduced FLIP liquid simulation. Uniform dimension reduction lowers the cost of the pressure Poisson solve, but aggressive coarsening can under-represent localized pressure variation near impacts, thin sheets, and complex free surfaces. Our method augments the coarse surface-aware pressure basis only in regions predicted to require additional representation capacity. The selection criterion combines the fine-grid residual of the reduced pressure solution with free-surface curvature and local velocity variation. To avoid a same-frame refinement re-solve, the filtered residual from the previous time step is used as a temporal predictor, while the geometric and kinematic indicators respond to newly formed structures. The resulting adaptive system requires a single reduced pressure solve per time step. Comparisons with uniform dimension reduction and full-resolution projection show lower pressure approximation error and post-projection divergence than uniform reduction with only a modest increase in pressure degrees of freedom and computation time. The same formulation is evaluated in both 2D and 3D FLIP simulations.

articles.title: Yes, Trees are the Solution for Thermal Comfort and Environmental Quality in Equatorial Public Squares
articles.abstract: Unregulated urban expansion can diminish green spaces and alter microclimatic conditions, thereby compromising thermal comfort and the quality of life for the population. In this context, urban forestry plays a pivotal role in mitigating warming effects within urban environments. The present study aimed to analyze the influence of urban tree canopy cover on surface temperature and thermal comfort in urban squares within the municipality of Santarém, Pará state, Brazil. To this end, in situ measurements of surface temperature were conducted using an infrared thermometer, alongside assessments of thermal stress and perceived temperature using a heat stress meter equipped with the Wet-Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT) index. Data were collected in both tree-shaded and unshaded areas across seven city squares at 08:00, 13:00, and 18:00. The results demonstrated that the afternoon period exhibited the highest mean values for surface temperature (40.1°C), thermal stress (31.6°C), and perceived temperature (48.3°C). Areas lacking tree canopy cover recorded higher surface temperatures (39.7°C), elevated thermal stress (30.5°C), and greater perceived temperatures (45.4°C) compared to tree-shaded areas. Among the evaluated sites, Liberdade Square presented the highest mean surface temperature (40.8°C), while São Raimundo and Três Poderes squares recorded the highest values for thermal stress (31.2°C) and perceived temperature (48.6°C). We conclude that the presence of tree canopy cover significantly contributes to lowering surface temperatures and improving thermal comfort conditions, thereby highlighting the critical role of urban forestry in urban planning and the enhancement of urban environmental quality.

articles.title: Hybrid Token Optimization for Text-to-Image Person Re-identification
articles.abstract: Text-to-image person re-identification (TIReID) enables natural-language search over pedestrian image collections. Although dual-grained methods combine global and local matching, recent dual-grained pipelines use encoder-produced global tokens for coarse matching and attention-ranked local tokens for fine-grained matching. This interface leaves global representations without complementary priors, local evidence dependent on a single ranking cue, and image--text sequence asymmetry insufficiently addressed. To address these limitations, we propose Hybrid Token Optimization (HTO), a parameter-efficient, role-aware framework at the encoder--matcher interface. HTO comprises two coordinated components. Dictionary Prior Enhancement uses modality-specific dictionaries, cross-attention, and conservative residual blending to refine global-token representations. Spatial-Energy Heterogeneous Token Selection combines attention-based saliency, a feature-norm cue, and an adaptive minimum-coverage constraint to broaden local-token coverage in both modalities. Both components leave the established matching heads unchanged and operate during both training and inference, while the auxiliary losses are used only for training. Under a fixed-seed protocol, HTO yields Rank-1 point-estimate gains of 0.45, 0.40, and 2.25 percentage points over the reproduced baseline on CUHK-PEDES, ICFG-PEDES, and RSTPReid, respectively. It increases the parameter count by less than 0.4% and is also compatible with Test-Time Human-Centered Interaction. These results suggest that role-aware token-interface refinement can improve fine-grained cross-modal retrieval without redesigning the matcher.

articles.title: Effect of HIP and Laser Shock Peening Sequence on the Fatigue Behavior of Laser Powder Bed Fused Ti6Al4V
articles.abstract: The fatigue performance of laser powder bed fused Ti-6Al-4V is influenced by process-induced defects, surface condition and the stress state generated by manufacturing and post-processing. This study examined whether reversing the order of hot isostatic pressing (HIP) and laser shock peening (LSP) altered the fatigue response of a deliberately defect-rich LPBF condition. Specimens were subjected to LSP followed by HIP or HIP followed by LSP. X-ray computed tomography was used to quantify the internal defect populations, stress-life testing was conducted between 210 and 380 MPa at R = 0 and 50 Hz, and scanning electron microscopy was used to examine post-test surface features associated with crack initiation. The two hybrid routes exhibited similar defect counts and mean sphericity values, while the HIP + LSP condition contained the largest measured defect and the greatest detected defect volume. Nevertheless, HIP + LSP produced the stronger fatigue response, including two right-censored run-outs at 106 cycles, compared with no run-outs for LSP + HIP. The CT descriptors therefore did not account for the observed sequence effect. The results are consistent with, but do not directly prove, the hypothesis that applying LSP after HIP preserves the beneficial final surface state generated by peening, whereas subsequent HIP exposure may modify or relax part of that state. Because residual stress was not measured, this mechanism is presented as a literature-supported interpretation rather than a measured causal relationship. The findings demonstrate that post-processing order can influence fatigue performance even when conventional CT defect metrics do not indicate a superior internal defect population.

articles.title: Development of a Water Infrastructure Sustainability Index (WISI): An Integrated Framework for Assessing Resilience, Circular Economy, and Long-Term Sustainability
articles.abstract: Wastewater treatment plants are often assessed by compliance and cost, which leaves energy, carbon, resource recovery, asset condition, climate exposure and digital capability outside a single view. We reformulate the conceptual Water Infrastructure Sustainability Index (WISI) as a computable index for wastewater treatment plants. WISI v1.1 combines seven dimensions (technical performance, water, energy, circular economy, carbon, asset resilience, digital intelligence) through 22 normalised indicators and weighted arithmetic aggregation. The reformulation corrects inverted indicator directions, removes undefined and non-applicable indicators, and limits double counting by assigning each physical flow to one dimension. Because no complete operational dataset was available, we tested the index on 40 synthetic plants, with 50 replicate datasets, using Monte Carlo weight perturbation, varying weight distributions, and alternative model structures. Rankings were stable under moderate weight uncertainty (median Spearman ρ = 0.98 for Dirichlet κ = 50) and fell to 0.87 only when weights were nearly random (κ = 3); aggregation rule changed rankings most (ρ = 0.95 for geometric aggregation). Nominal weights did not match effective influence: technical performance, with the largest weight (0.20), accounted for about 7–8% of index variance. Class bands from the earlier framework placed a median of 70% of synthetic plants in the lowest class; data-derived bands were uncertain by about five score points. A feasibility check on two operating plants showed that routine laboratory data cover only 3 of the 22 indicators.

articles.title: Path Planning of Surgical Robot for Minimally Invasive Surgery on Riemannian Manifold
articles.abstract: Robotic surgery for minimally invasive surgery can reduce the surgeon’s workload by autonomously guiding robotic forceps. Movement of the robot is restricted around a fixed insertion port. The robot often encounters angle limitations during operation. Also, the surface of the abdominal cavity is non-concave, making it computationally expensive to find the desired path. In this work, to solve these problems, we propose a method for path planning in joint space by transforming the position into a Riemannian manifold. An edge cost function is defined to search for a desired path in the joint space and reduce the range of motion of the joints. We found that the organ is mostly non-concave, making it easy to find the optimal path using gradient descent method. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method reduces the range of joint angle movement compared to calculations in position space.

articles.title: Regulation, function and evolutionary structure of St18, encoding a Zinc-Finger Transcription Factor, in the oligodendrocyte lineage
articles.abstract: Myelinating oligodendrocytes are first observed during evolution in vertebrates above jawless fishes. Oligodendrocyte progenitor cells (OPCs) undergo extensive transcriptional and morphological remodelling to initiate differentiation and myelination. We report that the zinc-finger transcription factor St18 (aka Myt3) is upregulated during the OPC-to–newly formed oligodendrocyte (NFOL) transition. Single-nucleus RNA-sequencing (snRNA-seq) performed after lysolecithin-induced demyelination of the mouse spinal cord revealed that St18 was acutely upregulated in remyelinating OPCs. In primary rat OPC cultures, St18 overexpression promoted differentiation, whereas OPC conditional St18 knockout delayed developmental myelination in the mouse brain. Chromatin accessibility profiling identified candidate cis-regulatory elements for oligodendroglial St18 expression activated by core oligodendrocyte transcription factors, including SOX10, KLF9/13, and MYRF, and we confirmed that St18 expression in OPCs is Sox10-dependent in vivo. Phylogenetic analysis suggests that St18 arose via duplication of Myt1 in early jawed vertebrates, coinciding with the emergence of myelinating oligodendrocytes. These findings define St18 as a transcriptional marker of NFOLs and OLs and provide insight into the evolutionary regulation of central nervous system myelination.

articles.title: A Drude-Augmented Kramers–Kronig Framework for Predicting Optical Properties of Substitutionally Doped Low-Dimensional Semiconductors: Application to (8,0) SiC Nanotubes
articles.abstract: We present a generalizable computational framework that combines a Kramers--Kronig transformation with a Drude free-carrier term to predict the optical and dielectric properties of substitutionally doped low-dimensional semiconductors. The framework is designed as a fast-screening alternative to full density functional theory (DFT) calculations, requiring only three physically transparent input parameters: the effective bandgap energy, the peak absorption energy, and the static dielectric constant. For metallic dopants, a Drude term is added with plasma frequency and scattering rate taken from optical fits of post-transition metals. The framework is validated against published first-principles DFT results for Al-, N-, and P-doped SiC nanotubes and against spectroscopic ellipsometry data for bulk 3C-SiC and 4H-SiC, showing good quantitative agreement. As a demonstration, we apply the framework to 15 dopant configurations of the pristine zigzag (8,0) silicon carbide nanotube (SiCNT), covering Group~III (B, Al, Ga, In, Tl), Group~V (N, P, As, Sb, Bi), and Group~VII (F, Cl, Br, I) elements. The framework captures the p-type to plasmonic transition in the Group~III series (absorption onset shifts from 2.0~eV to 1.0~eV), the monotonic bandgap narrowing in the Group~V series (sim3.7~eV for N to sim1.2~eV for Bi), and the systematic redshift in the halogen series (1.85~eV for pristine to 1.43 ± 0.20~eV for Cl). The framework provides a reproducible, computationally inexpensive route to optical property prediction for doped low-dimensional systems and yields quantitative guidelines for UV photodetectors, visible-range photocatalysts, infrared sensors, and broadband plasmonic devices. Complete Python source code, material parameter database, and figure generation scripts are provided for full reproducibility.

articles.title: Synthesis and Structural Characterization of Some D-panthenol Cocrystals using Carboxylic acid as Coformers
articles.abstract: D-Panthenol (provitamin B5) is a pharmaceutically and cosmetically important active ingredient whose solid-state application is constrained by pronounced hygroscopicity and limited crystallinity. In this study, cocrystals of D-panthenol were designed and synthesized with three carboxylic acid coformers oxalic acid, isophthalic acid (2:1), and trimesic acid via slow solvent evaporation from methanol/ethanol solution, and the resulting solid forms were characterized by UV–Visible and Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. UV–Visible spectroscopy revealed a consistent bathochromic (red) shift in the absorption maximum (λmax), rising from 210 nm in pure D-panthenol to 214 nm in the oxalic acid cocrystal (Dp–OX), 217 nm in the isophthalic acid cocrystal (Dp–ISO, 2:1), and 222 nm in the trimesic acid cocrystal (Dp–Trim). The magnitude of the shift scaled with coformer aromaticity and hydrogen-bonding capacity, and the aromatic coformers additionally introduced secondary absorption bands at 244, 273, and 302 nm (Dp–ISO) and 258, 283, and 320 nm (Dp–Trim), consistent with supplementary π→π* transitions. These electronic changes were corroborated by FTIR spectroscopy, which showed systematic shifts in the O–H stretch (3454–3464 cm⁻¹), C = O stretch (1737–1741 cm⁻¹), N–H/C = C bend (1637–1641 cm⁻¹), and C–O stretch (1111–1127 cm⁻¹) regions relative to pure D-panthenol. Because no new absorption bands emerged in any spectrum, the observed shifts are attributed to intermolecular hydrogen bonding rather than covalent modification, confirming that D-panthenol's molecular identity was preserved in all three cocrystals. Together, the UV–Visible and FTIR results provide convergent spectroscopic evidence that cocrystallization with carboxylic acid coformers systematically perturbs the electronic and vibrational environment of D-panthenol through non-covalent supramolecular interactions, supporting cocrystal engineering as a viable route to modified D-panthenol solid forms for pharmaceutical application.

articles.title: Latitudinal contrast in the equatorial Atlantic influence on Nigerian August rainfall
articles.abstract: The influence of the equatorial Atlantic on West African monsoon rainfall is well established for the region as a whole, but its variation with latitude and month within Nigeria has not been quantified. Satellite rainfall estimates and sea-surface temperatures for 1981 to 2025 were used to compare a southern (4 to 8°N) and a northern (10 to 14°N) band after removing El Niño–Southern Oscillation and linear-trend effects. In a pre-specified analysis of June to August rainfall, one standard deviation of warming in an equatorial Atlantic temperature index (ATL3) was associated with 56.5 mm more rainfall in the south and 3.2 mm in the north, a difference of 53.3 mm (95% interval 19.5 to 87.1 mm). An exploratory monthly analysis located the contrast in August, the month of the southern little dry season (49.0 mm; 26.2 to 68.7 mm), and it was confirmed in an independent period, 1951 to 1980, with rain-gauge data and criteria fixed beforehand (35.9 mm; 20.0 to 52.2 mm). The August contrast persisted when the datasets, band definitions, linear trend and other ocean basins were changed. It corresponded to 12 to 23% of local rainfall south of 8.5°N and fell to near zero north of 10°N, and reanalysis data showed stronger moisture convergence over the southern band. The full-season contrast was less robust, and May temperatures gave no forecast skill. The signal of an ocean basin can therefore differ markedly within one country and one month, which region-wide seasonal indices conceal.

articles.title: Power Grid Operational Risk Assessment Based on Source-Grid Multi- dimensional Feature Fusion and Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts Model
articles.title_zh: 基于源网多维特征融合和多门混合专家模型的电网运行风险评估
articles.abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy, the stochasticity of wind and photovoltaic (PV) outputs and complex power-flow constraints impose higher requirements on the spatiotemporal identification of power grid balance operation risks. Existing risk assessment methods often overlook the spatiotemporal coupling and dynamic characteristics of the system and rely heavily on wind/PV data-driven approaches, causing the assessed risk distribution to deviate from actual operation results; neural networks also suffer from poor interpretability. Therefore, this paper proposes a power grid operational risk assessment method based on a multi-gate mixture-of-experts (MMoE) model. First, a two-stage dispatch model driven by empirical forecast error distributions is established to simulate actual dispatch errors and generate risk labels. Second, an MMoE model integrating source-side and schedule-side tabular features, grid-side topology features, and historical temporal features is constructed, and task-specific gating networks are used for joint prediction. Meanwhile, the gating weights and graph attention coefficients of the model provide adaptive interpretability analysis for balancing risks. The determination accuracies for curtailment and security of supply events are 92.7% and 84.2%, respectively, with false-alarm rates of 4.8% and 21.0%.Results for a representative operating interval demonstrate risk-association interpretation based on gating weights and graph attention coefficients, achieving high-accuracy risk prediction and causal tracing.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着可再生能源渗透率的不断提高，风电、光伏出力的随机性和复杂的潮流约束对电网平衡运行风险的时空识别提出了更高的要求。现有的风险评估方法往往忽视系统的时空耦合和动态特性，严重依赖风电/光伏数据驱动的方法，导致评估的风险分布与实际运行结果存在偏差；神经网络还存在可解释性差的问题。因此，本文提出一种基于多门混合专家（MMoE）模型的电网操作风险评估方法。首先，建立由经验预测误差分布驱动的两阶段调度模型来模拟实际调度误差并生成风险标签。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着可再生能源渗透率的不断提高，风电、光伏出力的随机性和复杂的潮流约束对电网平衡运行风险的时空识别提出了更高的要求。现有的风险评估方法往往忽视系统的时空耦合和动态特性，严重依赖风电/光伏数据驱动的方法，导致评估的风险分布与实际运行结果存在偏差；神经网络还存在可解释性差的问题。因此，本文提出一种基于多门混合专家（MMoE）模型的电网操作风险评估方法。首先，建立由经验预测误差分布驱动的两阶段调度模型来模拟实际调度误差并生成风险标签。其次，构建了集成源端和调度端表格特征、网格端拓扑特征和历史时间特征的MMoE模型，并使用特定于任务的门网络进行联合预测。同时，模型的门控权重和图注意力系数为平衡风险提供了自适应可解释性分析。限电事件和安全供电事件的判定准确率分别为92.7%和84.2%，误报率分别为4.8%和21.0%。代表性运行区间的结果证明了基于门控权重和图关注系数的风险关联解释，实现了高精度的风险预测和因果追踪。

articles.title: Development and Field Validation of an IoT-Based Smart Beehive Monitoring System for Precision Apiculture
articles.title_zh: 基于物联网的精准养蜂智能蜂箱监控系统的开发和现场验证
articles.abstract: Even though honey bee colonies are experiencing record losses, the majority of beekeepers continue to conduct laborious, time-consuming manual hive inspections hence need for continuous, non-invasive, and cost-effective monitoring technologies that can support timely beekeeping decisions. The Bee-Hive Project, a low-cost solar-powered Internet of Things (IoT) system for ongoing smart hive monitoring, is the subject of this paper's case study. A conventional embedded-systems design cycle was employed during the development process, encompassing requirements specification, architectural design, component selection, bench prototyping, PCB manufacturing, mechanical integration, firmware creation, and field validation. The system is configured with a five-stage data path (Fig. 1). An Arduino MKR WAN 1310 interrogates multiple sensors within the hive. The microcontroller transmits the data via a LoRaWAN uplink after encoding it into a compact binary payload. The Arduino MKR WAN 1310 is surrounded by sensors for temperature, humidity and weight. Data is sent via LoRaWAN to The Things Stack and subsequently to the Ubidots and BEEP cloud platforms for alerting and visualization. A LoRaWAN gateway acquires the uplink, subsequently transmitting it to The Things Stack (TTN), a LoRaWAN network server, where the binary payload is decoded into designated fields via a bespoke decoder function. The weatherproof solar-powered enclosure and custom printed circuit board were constructed and put through a two-week field test. In addition to discussing the advantages and disadvantages of the system in light of the precision-beekeeping literature, the paper reports on the design, implementation, and field results. The proposed system successfully enabled real-time hive monitoring by transmitting environmental, weight, and battery data at ten-minute intervals, demonstrating a low-cost, solar-powered, weather-resistant IoT solution for precision beekeeping in off-grid environments.

articles.abstract: More than a century after Einstein first devised the equations that describe gravity, physicists are still finding new ways of interpreting them. Asenjo of Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez in Chile, recently found a new way of looking at Einstein's equations that reveals a striking analogy with "magnetic reconnection" in plasmas, which occurs when magnetic field lines break and reconnect, powering explosive phenomena such as solar flares.
