We introduce an accessible Fisher-information framework based on a physically admissible family of measurements and use it to separate state-level sensitivity, channel degradation, and receiver limitations. The framework is applied to Ramsey and NOON interferometry, squeezed-state displacement sensing, two-level thermometry, and multiparameter qubit sensing. We show that resource normalization, finite visibility, readout errors, measurement rank, shot allocation, calibration uncertainty, and nuisance parameters can substantially modify the experimentally available advantage. For squeezed-state sensing, homodyne-axis misalignment produces a finite optimal squeezing, while bounded calibration uncertainty leads to a robust operating rule. In the pure-loss model considered here, attenuation reduces the attainable information without shifting this optimum. The results provide practical design rules that connect quantum-enhanced state preparation with realistic measurement constraints and experimentally extractable sensing performance.

articles.title: Categorization of scientific publications using large language models as applied to atomic spectroscopy
articles.abstract: We present an automated framework employing large language models to categorize atomic spectroscopy literature for NIST bibliographic databases. The system processes native PDFs and supplementary materials via instruction-driven reasoning agents to assign structured search keywords encompassing target species, subject codes, and experimental methodologies. Validation against human-curated datasets demonstrates high precision in elemental species identification, while establishing that granular subject code assignment remains the primary source of categorization error.

articles.title: Aspect-ratio-dependent stall delay and spanwise separation topology of a finite NACA 2412 wing at Re = 2.2 x 106
articles.abstract: This study presents a systematic RANS-based investigation of the NACA 2412 wing at Re = 2.2 × 106 across AR = 1, 2, and 4, using the k–ε model with standard wall functions. A wall-shear-stress-based separation fraction metric S is introduced to quantify separation and extended spanwise as S(z/b) to map the three-dimensional separation topology. The two-dimensional results were validated against experimental measurements, predicting pre-stall lift within 2–3% with 1–2° stall-angle overprediction. For three-dimensional cases, the stall onset is progressively delayed with decreasing AR, from α = 20° at AR = 4 to α = 32° at AR = 1, compared to the two-dimensional baseline of α = 16°. This delay is attributed to tip-vortex downwash suppressing trailing-edge separation across a larger span fraction. The spanwise separation profiles reveal a smooth root-to-tip gradient at higher AR, whereas the profiles collapse into a broad inner-span plateau at AR = 1. These results demonstrate how aspect ratio affects chordwise and spanwise trailing-edge separation from onset to deep stall and provide a surface-resolved reference dataset for low-AR cambered-wing stall prediction and finite-wing aerodynamic design.

articles.title: Real-time measurement of dielectric properties of lunar regolith simulants
articles.abstract: Establishing a permanent settlement on the Moon will require infrastructure capable of protecting astronauts and equipment from the abrasive effects of lunar dust, radiation, micrometeorite impacts, and extreme thermal fluctuations. Lunar regolith is a dielectric material that can be efficiently heated to its melting temperature using microwave energy, providing an abundant, and cost-effective feedstock for energy-efficient construction. In this study, we measured the complex permittivity of two lunar regolith simulants, the mare simulant JSC-1A and the highland simulant NU-LHT-4M, from room temperature to melting. A dual-mode permittivity measurement technique enabled simultaneous measurement of complex permittivity while the simulant was heated using a single-mode microwave system operating at approximately 2.45 GHz. For both simulants, the real and imaginary parts of the permittivity increases significantly with temperature. The resulting temperature-dependent data will enable more accurate numerical modelling of microwave heating of lunar regolith, supporting the optimisation of microwave heating devices and improved energy efficiency in lunar ISRU processing.

articles.title: Surface State Decouples Normal Detachment and Slip Initiation in Grip- Optimized Rubber Contacts
articles.abstract: Rubber surface condition can influence both normal detachment and resistance to tangential slip, but these responses are not necessarily governed by the same interfacial mechanisms. This study investigated how surface preparation of a grip-optimized climbing shoe rubber affects pull-off and slip initiation against smooth and textured rigid spherical counter-surfaces. The same rubber compound was tested in four surface states: the original moulded surface (P0), a cut surface exposing subsurface material (CUT), and surfaces ground with P100 or P60 abrasive paper. Normal detachment was characterized using maximum pull-off force and work of detachment, while tangential response was evaluated using static and steady sliding friction coefficients and the static-to-steady friction drop.Surface preparation strongly altered both detachment and friction, but the responses were not directly coupled. The ground surfaces generally showed higher detachment resistance but lower static and steady sliding friction than P0, with the magnitude of these effects depending on counter-surface texture. CUT further emphasized this decoupling: despite having nearly the same arithmetic mean height (Sa) as P0, it produced markedly greater pull-off force and work of detachment, particularly against the smooth pin, while exhibiting lower static friction. This demonstrates that surface preparation affects the response through more than roughness amplitude alone.Resistance to normal detachment therefore cannot be used alone to predict resistance to tangential slip. Pull-off and friction tests provide complementary information, and both rubber surface preparation and representative counter-surface texture should be controlled when evaluating climbing shoe rubber performance.

articles.title: Role of recycled fine aggregates in regulating hydration behavior and mechanical performance of alkali-activated slag mortars
articles.abstract: Recycled fine aggregates (RFA) contain old cement paste with relatively high alkalinity, which may provide additional activation in alkali activated slag systems. In this study, RFA was used to replace river sand at replacement ratios of 0%, 50% and 100% in alkali activated slag mortars. Liquid and solid sodium silicate with Na2O concentrations of 0%, 3%, 6% and 9% were investigated. The setting time, flowability, compressive and flexural strengths, heat evolution and microstructure were evaluated. The results showed that increasing the RFA content shortened the setting time but reduced the flowability of the mortars. RFA also promoted strength development, particularly at early ages and moderate alkali activator dosages. For mortars activated with 6% liquid sodium silicate, the 28-day compressive strength increased from 50.9 MPa for 0% RFA to 57.2 MPa for 100% RFA. Even without an external alkali activator, the mortar containing 100% RFA achieved a 28-day compressive strength of 13.7 MPa. The main hydration peak of mortars containing 0%, 50% and 100% RFA appeared at approximately 81, 68 and 51 h, respectively, confirming the accelerating effect of RFA on slag hydration. SEM and EDS observations further indicated that RFA promoted early-age microstructure densification, while the attached old paste introduced a double-layer interface transition zone. Overall, the effect of RFA on alkali activated slag mortar results from the competition between enhanced hydration and the adverse effects associated with reduced flowability and interfacial defects.

articles.title: Finite Local Information Capacity in Continuum Dynamics
articles.abstract: Finite-dimensional local Hilbert spaces are widely used as microscopic regulators and have also been proposed as a fundamental information-capacity property of space-time. A finite local dimension, however, is not equivalent to a spatial lattice spacing, and neither is equivalent to a coarse-graining scale. We formulate a regulator-resolved framework that keeps these three notions separate and defines finite-information deviations operationally as the failure of microscopic and effective time evolution to commute with a specified coarse-graining channel. The resulting deviation is a state- and observable-dependent quantity in a common effective state space, rather than a formal subtraction of generators acting on different domains. We derive a decomposition into capacity, spatial-discretization, and coarse-graining contributions; a finite-time capacity bound controlled by discarded state weight and leakage through the cutoff boundary; observable error bounds; and a sharp continuity bound for subsystem entropies. We further show that block entropy and averaged one-cell entropy differ by a relative-entropy measure of total correlation and therefore cannot be interchanged. An information-geometric expansion of neighboring reduced states yields a nonlinear sigma-model effective action on the manifold of coarse-grained states. A single entropy field follows only under an additional one-dimensional closure condition. Finally, we test the framework in an exactly evolved periodic Klein--Gordon chain with independently variable lattice spacing and local number-state cutoff. Spectral peaks are extracted from dynamical matrix elements rather than imposed. Ground-state, dispersion, reduced-state, and entropy errors converge rapidly with local capacity, while the remaining lattice--continuum discrepancy persists at fixed spacing. The results provide a controlled mathematical and numerical foundation for finite-information models without claiming a unique microscopic theory of quantum gravity.

articles.title: Rare-Earth-Element-Doped ZnO Thin Films for Gas Sensing and Solar-Cell Applications A Critical Review of Structure–Property Relationships, Defect Chemistry, Surface Morphology and Device-Level Performance
articles.abstract: Rare-earth-element (REE) modification provides a route to tune the structure, surface chemistry, optical response and carrier transport of zinc oxide (ZnO), a wide-band-gap semiconductor used in resistive gas sensors and as a transparent or electron-transport layer in photovoltaic architectures. Yet the performance consequences of REE incorporation are strongly dependent on dopant identity, concentration, oxidation state, synthesis route, defect compensation and device architecture. This critical review examines how Ce, La, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Er, Yb and related ions influence wurtzite phase stability, lattice strain, crystallite growth, surface morphology, optical absorption, Tauc-derived band-gap estimates, conductivity and interface behaviour. For gas sensing, the discussion connects adsorption and surface charge transfer to depletion-layer width, grain-boundary barriers, humidity dependence and selectivity. For photovoltaics, it distinguishes film-level optical/electrical indicators from complete-device metrics such as short-circuit current density, open-circuit voltage, fill factor, power-conversion efficiency and operational stability. Published examples include Nd-modified ZnO showing 43 s response and 12 s recovery to 25 ppm NH₃ at room temperature in a particular SILAR-prepared sensor, and recent Sm/Eu/Gd-doped samples with dopant-dependent ammonia response [1, 2]. These values are not directly comparable without harmonized protocols. The review emphasizes evidence quality, the danger of assigning visible photoluminescence uniquely to oxygen vacancies, and the need to verify dopant location using complementary methods. A composition–process–structure–defect–property–function framework is proposed to guide reproducible materials development and to prevent the mistaken assumption that a formulation optimized for gas adsorption will also optimize photovoltaic charge extraction.

articles.title: NHC-Modulated Fe (II) Complex for TADF-Assisted Multiphoton Lifetime Imaging: Concurrent Apoptosis Monitoring and Quantification
articles.abstract: The application of luminescent iron complexes in bioimaging is severely constrained by ultrafast excited-state deactivation and cellular background interference. Herein, we present [Fe(imp)2]2+, the first Fe (II) complex that enables the emergence of both three-photon excited fluorescence (3PEF) and thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF), accessed via stepwise substitution of terpyridine with N‑heterocyclic carbene (NHC) ligands to circumvent the intrinsic drawbacks of traditional Fe‑based materials. Mechanistically, the enhanced ligand field reshapes the relative energetics of the metal-to-ligand charge transfer (MLCT) and metal-centered (MC) state manifolds, disfavoring MC-mediated nonradiative decay and opening a thermally activated emissive pathway. More significantly, [Fe(imp)2]2+ serves as an apoptosis-related spatiotemporal cascade-targeting agent, sequentially targeting the plasma membrane, mitochondria, and the entire cell. The TADF-assisted lifetime-resolved signatures render [Fe(imp)2]2+ capable of distinguishing apoptosis from mixed cell death, with a global lifetime evolution spanning 1.1-2.4 ns and a pronounced lifetime heterogeneity of 0.43 ns. Co-incubation of [Fe(imp)2]2+ with anti-apoptotic agents demonstrated that effective cytoprotection is achieved when the probe lifetime dropped below 1.2 ns. This work pioneers NHC-regulated Fe (II) complexes TADF-mediated lifetime probes, offering a new paradigm for transition-metal bioimaging.

articles.title: Transient AMOC weakening during overshoot warming masks committed Greenland ice sheet loss
articles.abstract: Climate mitigation strategies increasingly rely on temporarily exceeding the Paris Agreement’s warming targets (well below 2 °C, preferably 1.5 °C) before drawing temperatures back down through large-scale carbon dioxide removal (CDR). Whether such ”overshoot” pathways can protect vulnerable components of the Earth system — including the Greenland Ice Sheet, which holds enough ice to raise global sea level by more than 7 meters — remains unclear. We use one-way coupled Earth system and ice sheet model simulations to show that temporary weakening of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) during overshoot warming cools the North Atlantic and temporarily mitigates ice loss in southwest Greenland, despite sustained global warming of up to 3 °C. However, once the AMOC recovers, renewed regional warming over Greenland triggers accelerated surface melt under global mean temperatures compatible with the Paris targets. In particular, after AMOC recovery, southwest Greenland becomes highly sensitive to small additional warming above 1.5°C, thus suggesting that this region may have a critical threshold within Paris-compatible temperature limits of 1.5 to 2°C. Our results suggest that, where overshoot pathways trigger substantial AMOC weakening, large-scale Greenland mass loss may emerge only after ocean circulation, and regional warming, recover — meaning AMOC weakening during overshoot would not prevent, but merely postpone, committed ice sheet destabilization.

articles.title: Engineered protein cages with phosphate-dependent reversible opening
articles.abstract: Engineered protein cages are promising nanocarriers for molecular delivery. Reversible and non-destructive control over their structural opening and closing for cargo manipulation remains a key challenge. Here, we present protein cages formed by an engineered variant of Aquifex aeolicus lumazine synthase, called AaLS-POF, that exhibits a rapid and reversible transition between closed dodecahedral and open tetrahedral states in response to phosphate or analogous oxyanions. This dynamic opening-closing behavior, induced by a non-invasive stimulus, enables controlled retrieval and packaging of various cargoes through enzymatic methods. Cryo-EM and mutagenesis identified a key phosphate-binding site and revealed how local recognition of a simple oxyanion is transmitted across subunit interfaces to reshape the geometry of a megadalton-scale assembly. The elucidated molecular mechanism and design principles make the AaLS-POF system a promising platform for engineering customized nanocontainers with desired opening characteristics.

articles.title: Quantum Entanglement Optimization and Prototype Design in Positronic Simulation Frameworks
articles.abstract: We present a simulation-driven framework for optimizing quantum entanglement in engineered positronic substrates. Using high-resolution parameter sweeps of a coupling coefficient g and ensemble time-domain traces, we identify a reproducible global entanglement maximum at g ≈ 32.786 and robust secondary plateau regions near g≈60 and g≈100. We quantify entanglement using concurrence-like measures and present a prototype architecture that implements adaptive feedback to maintain maximal entanglement under dynamic perturbations. The archive includes full simulation code, figure-generation scripts and prototype design notes to enable reproducible experimental follow-up.

articles.title: Complex dynamical regimes of the Tayler-Spruit dynamo
articles.abstract: Author(s): Paul Barrère, Jérôme Guilet, Basile Gallet, and Raphaël Raynaud The amplification of large-scale magnetic fields via the Tayler-Spruit dynamo has been invoked to explain the slow rotation of stellar cores and the formation of magnetars. The existence of this mechanism has recently been proved via 3D MHD numerical simulations of a differentially rotating stably stratified fluid. Using the same setup, we show that the dynamo can produce a wide variety of magnetic field dynamics, including reversals and hemisphericity, by varying thermal stratification. In a fiducial simulation, we interpret the appearance of reversals as the result of the coupling of two large-scale magnetic modes with opposite equatorial symmetries by the symmetry breaking of the flow. [Phys. Rev. Fluids 11, 103704] Published Mon Oct 26, 2026

articles.title: Complex field-induced magnetic phases and anisotropic magnetotransport in off-stoichiometric CeCuBi₂
articles.abstract: Author(s): Vikas Chahar, Shivam Rathod, Sneh, Lipika, Shobha Singh, Balwant Singh Chauhan, Subhadeep Bej, Weida Yin, Yin-Chen Huang, Rie Y. Umetsu, Ratnamala Chatterjee, and Kaustuv Manna We report a detailed study on the structural, angle-dependent magnetic and magnetotransport properties of highly anisotropic off-stoichiometric CeCuBi₂ single crystals. Our results reveal CeCuBi₂ as an anisotropic Kondo antiferromagnet exhibiting complex field-induced… [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 104421] Published Mon Oct 26, 2026

articles.title: Simulation-guided design of an integrated photonic cavity for frequency-multiplexed spontaneous parametric down-conversion
articles.abstract: Author(s): Benjamin Szamosfalvi, Michael Raymer, CJ Xin, Leticia Magalhaes, Jarrett Nelson, Marko Lončar, and Ryan M. Camacho Frequency-multiplexed entangled photon pair sources with narrow bandwidths and high pair generation efficiency are a key enabling technology for quantum networking. We present a simulation-based design study of an integrated photonic racetrack resonator source for spontaneous parametric down-convers… [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 044078] Published Mon Oct 26, 2026

articles.title: Alloy engineering of excitonic properties in TMD monolayers
articles.abstract: Author(s): Eirini Katsipoulaki, Adlen Smiri, Panagiotis Spiliotakis, Konstantinos Mourzidis, Danae Katrisioti, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Georgios Kopidakis, Zdeněk Sofer, Gang Wang, Emmanuel Stratakis, George Kioseoglou, Iann C. Gerber, Xavier Marie, and Ioannis Paradisanos Changing the atomic composition of a semiconductor offers a powerful way to tailor its properties. This study explores atomically thin alloys of molybdenum, sulfur, and selenium by probing their excitons, Coulomb-bound electron-hole pairs. By gradually replacing selenium with sulfur, the study reveals how alloying modifies exciton emission energies, atomic lattice vibrations, spin-orbit coupling and polarization of emitted light. articles.title: Navigating the BERMUDA triangle of scientific software: A modular approach to data, hardware, and algorithm design in quantum chemistry and its realization in Python
articles.abstract: Modern quantum-chemistry software must support increasingly complex methods, heterogeneous hardware, reusable data structures, and user-facing workflows without losing maintainability. Using PyBEST as a case study, this work discusses how such complexity can be organized within the Python programming language through modular interfaces rather than scattered across method-specific implementations. The central motif is the B alanced pythonic E nvironment for R esearch with M odular U nified D esign and A bstractions (BERMUDA) Triangle : data representation, computational execution, and algorithmic organization, showcasing how implemented components and ongoing architectural developments—including backend-independent tensor contractions, an effective-Hamiltonian infrastructure, a domain-aware linear-algebra layer, the DAISpY charge-transfer analysis, and graphical input preparation—can be organized within one coherent ecosystem. The resulting perspective treats scalability not only as a numerical goal, but also as a software-design property: scientific codes remain sustainable when new features can be added without obscuring the route from theory to implementation and interpretation.

articles.title: Semiclassical initial value representation in curvilinear coordinates
articles.abstract: A semiclassical propagator originally defined on Euclidean space is systematically extended to general curvilinear coordinate systems. This method time-evolves nuclear wave packets on the fly in curvilinear coordinates, without prior construction of global potential energy surfaces or complicated kinetic energy operators, and enables dimensionality reduction by isolating the physically essential degrees of freedom through coordinate constraints. By propagating the dynamics in a redundant coordinate space, the coordinate singularities inherent to curvilinear systems are circumvented in a numerically robust manner. In addition, the topology of each coordinate—such as its periodicity and boundary conditions—is properly taken into account by modifying the coherent state basis of the propagator. We applied this approach to molecular motions that are difficult to describe in conventional normal coordinates—pure rotation of hydrogen and methane, rovibrational dynamics of hydrogen, and large-amplitude torsional motion of butane—and reproduced reference eigenenergies and the characteristic features of the corresponding spectra.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Dataset merging strategy for efficient construction of a machine-learning force field: A case of CeO 2 surfaces with an oxygen vacancy
articles.abstract: The accuracy and transferability of machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) critically depend on the quality of the training database. Here, we propose a dataset merging strategy for efficiently constructing a transferable MLFF for pristine and oxygen-defective CeO 2 surfaces. The proposed strategy is based on three key elements: (1) initiating on-the-fly training from small, less stable slab models to accelerate early stage convergence by sampling diverse high-energy configurations; (2) sampling diverse local structures by gradually increasing the temperature during molecular dynamics simulations while avoiding excessively rapid atomic motions and unphysically short contacts; and (3) merging independently generated datasets from slab models with different thicknesses and defect conditions to improve transferability. The resulting MLFF is validated on larger slab models containing 144 atoms and applied to structural optimization of pristine and oxygen-defective surfaces as well as lattice oxygen diffusion pathways on defective surfaces. The predicted pathways and energy barriers are in good agreement with density functional theory results, particularly for pathways involving relatively large structural and energetic changes. Furthermore, the merged MLFF was applied to ideal CeO 2 (111) slabs containing up to 5183 atoms, yielding only weak size dependence of the predicted vacancy-migration barrier. These results highlight that systematic dataset merging across model sizes and configurations provides a practical route to constructing transferable MLFFs for complex oxide surfaces.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Analytical nuclear gradients for the CC2 method using pair-natural orbitals based on localized virtual molecular orbitals for ground states
articles.abstract: Analytical nuclear energy gradients are indispensable for geometry optimizations and potential-energy-surface explorations, yet their development for pair-natural-orbital (PNO)-based methods remains limited. In this work, we present the analytical nuclear gradient theory for the ground-state PNO-based second-order approximate coupled cluster (CC2) model using localized virtual molecular orbitals (LVMOs). The gradient theory is formulated within the Lagrangian framework as an extension of our previously developed LVMO-based PNO-MP2 analytical gradient theory. Although the use of LVMOs requires additional localization constraints in the Lagrangian, orthonormal LVMOs simplify the coupled-perturbed equations and energy gradient expressions, and these advantages are exploited in the PNO-CC2 analytical gradient formulation. The implementation is extended to the spin-component-scaled variant. To facilitate the development and implementation, we extended our previously developed automated symbolic derivation framework, which systematically generates the derivative expressions for gradient calculations. Benchmark calculations on phenylalkane chains demonstrate favorable scaling of the analytical gradient evaluation. Gradients vary smoothly along a bond-dissociation coordinate of a ketene derivative, indicating that PNO orbital truncation does not introduce noticeable artifacts. Geometry optimizations of difluorodiene reproduce the characteristic elongation of electron-rich bonds observed for the CC2 theory relative to the MP2 theory. Applications to intermolecular complexes show that the PNO-CC2 framework provides optimized structures and binding energies comparable with those from the PNO-MP2 framework. Single-point gradient calculations for realistic molecular systems of around one hundred atoms demonstrate applicability of the implementation. This work establishes the analytical gradient formulation for ground-state PNO-CC2 theory and provides a foundation for future extensions to excited states.

articles.title: Multifractal Magnons Around Localized Defects
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multifractal wavefunctions fluctuate over a hierarchy of spatial scales, remaining spatially extended while exhibiting strongly nonuniform structure. We show that magnons in otherwise crystalline two-dimensional magnets can exhibit such behavior on mesoscopic scales, without disorder or quasiperiodicity. A localized defect can mix discrete groups of nearly degenerate magnon states in a finite sample, generating multiscale interference patterns and multifractal wavefunctions. We demonstrate this mechanism for both a simple spin defect and topological magnetic skyrmions. Large-scale spin-wave calculations for skyrmions in chiral and frustrated magnets reveal clear multifractal diagnostics over the full accessible range of system sizes of above-gap modes. Crucially, skyrmions make these states experimentally observable by hybridizing them with magnetically active internal deformation modes, which gives a subset of the multifractal states a nonzero magnetic dipole moment. These states can therefore be excited by uniform ac fields and remain distinguishable at realistic frequency resolution, providing a direct route to observing mesoscopic magnon multifractality.

articles.title: Temperature-Dependent Multiphysics Modeling of Additive Friction Stir Deposition Using Multi-Task Coupled Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.04082v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Additive friction stir deposition (AFSD) involves coupled thermal and material-flow fields governed by frictional heating, plastic deformation, and tool-imposed boundary conditions. High-fidelity finite-volume methods (FVMs) can resolve these fields but are computationally expensive, while constant-property approximations can distort the predicted thermo-mechanical response. This work develops a steady-state multi-task coupled physics-informed neural network (MCoPINN) to predict three-dimensional temperature and material-flow fields while reconstructing temperature-dependent thermal conductivity, density, and specific heat from sparse property measurements. A theoretical analysis decomposes prediction error into property reconstruction and neural field-solver contributions and characterizes the discrepancy associated with constant-property models. A controlled one-dimensional nonlinear-conduction study evaluates property reconstruction under sparse measurements. The framework is then evaluated for AFSD against a temperature-dependent FVM benchmark and experimental thermocouple measurements. MCoPINN reproduces the reference thermal and material-flow fields and reduces average temperature root-mean-square error from 50.13 K for the constant-property CoPINN to 30.28 K across four traverse speeds. MCoPINN requires approximately 8.5 hours of training per condition, compared with 52 hours for the FVM benchmark. These results demonstrate computationally efficient, physics-coupled prediction with temperature-dependent material properties.

articles.title: Analysis of transition dipole moments of band-progression peaks of fluorocarbons: Fundamentals and application to orientation analysis of fluoropolymers
articles.abstract: Perfluoroalkyl chains give infrared spectra involving a dominant absorption peak corresponding to the CF 2 symmetric stretching vibration mode. The direction of the transition dipole moment of this mode is approximately perpendicular to the chain axis, that is, the vibrational motion belongs to the E 1 symmetry species. Accordingly, the band progressions of this mode have also been considered to have the same property. In the present study, we have investigated the properties of the band progressions in detail using the p-polarized multiple-angle incidence resolution spectrometry on an oriented n-C 20 F 42 monolayer. We found that the surface selection rule of band progressions is the same as that of the CF 3 symmetric stretching vibrational mode with the aid of quantum chemical calculations. This indicates that the transition dipole moment of the band progressions does not correspond to the E 1 mode but is instead oriented predominantly parallel to the chain axis. We also show that this distinction is important for determining the orientation of perfluoroalkyl chains.

articles.title: Enhanced diffusion sampling: Efficient rare event sampling and free energy calculation with diffusion models
articles.abstract: The rare-event sampling problem has long been the central limiting factor in molecular dynamics, especially in biomolecular simulation. Recently, diffusion models such as BioEmu have emerged as powerful equilibrium samplers that generate independent samples from complex molecular distributions, eliminating the cost of sampling rare transition events. However, a sampling problem remains when computing observables that rely on states which are rare in equilibrium, for example, folding free energies. Here, we introduce enhanced diffusion sampling, enabling efficient exploration of rare-event regions while preserving unbiased thermodynamic estimators. The key idea is to perform quantitatively accurate steering protocols to generate biased ensembles and subsequently recover equilibrium statistics via exact reweighting. We instantiate our framework in three algorithms: UmbrellaDiff (umbrella sampling with diffusion models), MetaDiff (a batchwise analog for metadynamics), and ΔG-Diff (free-energy differences via tilted ensembles). We demonstrate the three methods on toy free-energy landscapes and apply ΔG-Diff to protein folding free-energy calculations with BioEmu. Our methods reduce the cost of rare-state estimation, enabling protein folding free-energy calculations in minutes to hours of graphics processing unit time per system.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Engineering logical gates with irrep surface codes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.06775v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation can incur a substantial resource cost when a desired logical operation must be constructed from a restricted set of logical primitives. To make such operations directly available, we introduce irrep surface codes (ISCs), two-dimensional topological quantum error-correcting codes engineered to transversally implement a prescribed set of logical gates. The target logical gates only need to satisfy two conditions: (i) they generate a finite group, which, up to global phases, is forced by the Eastin-Knill theorem, and (ii) they are irreducible, meaning that any operator commuting with the set of gates must be proportional to the identity. This accommodates arbitrary finite groups of diagonal gates and arbitrary reversible classical gates, since each can be embedded into a larger irreducible finite group of gates. It also enables logical gates outside every finite level of the Clifford hierarchy. To incorporate these operations into surface-code computations, we further develop lattice-surgery protocols to transfer the encoded information between surface codes and ISCs obeying one of two sufficient conditions. Together, these results establish a systematic method for tailoring topological codes to desired logical operations and integrating them into conventional computations.

articles.title: Casimir force screening by a quantum Boltzmann plasma
articles.abstract: We develop a finite-temperature field-theoretical description of the Casimir interaction between two perfectly conducting boundaries with the intervening gap filled by a two-component quantum Boltzmann plasma embedded in a homogeneous dielectric background. The quantum motion of the charged particles is represented by imaginary-time worldlines, while the electromagnetic field is treated in the Gaussian approximation. The resulting partition function contains distinct longitudinal and transverse response contributions and an additional quantum-induced source term with no classical counterpart. In the classical limit, the theory reduces to the usual Casimir-screening picture: the static longitudinal mode is Debye screened, whereas the transverse electromagnetic sector is unaffected by classical mobile charges. Finite thermal de Broglie wavelengths modify the nonzero Matsubara response and produce the leading quantum correction to the force. In the static long-wavelength limit, the longitudinal dielectric function has, through the leading quantum correction, the same expansion structure as the Lindhard response of a degenerate electron gas under the correspondence k TF ↔ κ D and kF↔λdB−1. In contrast, the static transverse response reproduces the leading high-temperature Landau orbital diamagnetic susceptibility. We investigate the crossover between classical and quantum plasma behavior in a regime where these corrections become appreciable while the plasma remains approximately nondegenerate and can still be treated, at leading order, within Maxwell–Boltzmann statistics. We illustrate this crossover for a weakly coupled electron–proton plasma and an effective Li + –solvated-electron plasma in liquid ammonia. The latter yields a sub-percent quantum correction to the force gradient for the parameters considered.

articles.title: Thymol–Menthol Deep Eutectic Solvent as a Functional Additive for PEO-Based Solid Polymer Electrolytes
articles.title_zh: 百里酚-薄荷醇低共熔溶剂作为 PEO 基固体聚合物电解质的功能添加剂
articles.abstract: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) have emerged as an alternative strategy to enhance electrolyte performance when employed as additives. In the present study, a new solid-state polymer electrolyte based on polyethylene oxide (PEO) doped with thymol–menthol deep eutectic solvents (T:M DESs) was successfully prepared via solution casting technique. Prior to incorporation into the PEO matrix, the physical and spectroscopic properties of the T:M DES additives were investigated using density, surface tension analysis, and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR). The results revealed that the T:M 1:4 composition exhibited the density (0.91 g cm− 3) and surface tension (30 mN m− 1), due to higher menthol content which enhances intermolecular interactions, leading to a more organized molecular arrangement within the DES structure. The PEO-T:M electrolyte was analysed through FTIR, Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), and Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS). FTIR analysis confirmed the successful incorporation of T:M DES into the PEO matrix through broadening and shifting of the hydroxyl (–OH) stretching band, indicating strong hydrogen bonding interactions between T:M and PEO. EIS revealed that the ionic conductivity of the PEO electrolyte increased gradually upon the incorporation of T:M DES additives. Among the various additive compositions, ratio 1:4 of T:M DES additive exhibited the highest ionic conductivity of 1.28 × 10⁻⁶ Scm− 1. Overall, these findings highlight the promising role of thymol–menthol DES additives in improving the physicochemical properties and electrochemical performance of PEO-based electrolytes for potential electrochemical application.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 低共熔溶剂 (DES) 已成为用作添加剂时增强电解质性能的替代策略。在本研究中，通过溶液浇铸技术成功制备了一种基于聚环氧乙烷（PEO）掺杂百里酚-薄荷醇低共熔溶剂（T：M DES）的新型固态聚合物电解质。在加入 PEO 基质之前，使用密度、表面张力分析和傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR) 研究了 T:M DES 添加剂的物理和光谱特性。结果表明，T:M 1:4 组合物表现出密度（0.91 g cm− 3）和表面张力（30 mN m− 1），这是由于较高的薄荷醇含量增强了分子间相互作用，导致 DES 结构内的分子排列更加有序。通过 FTIR、热重分析 (TGA) 和电化学阻抗谱 (EIS) 对 PEO-T:M 电解质进行分析。 FTIR 分析证实，通过羟基 (-OH) 伸缩带的加宽和移动，T:M DES 成功融入 PEO 基质中，表明 T:M 和 PEO 之间存在强氢键相互作用。 EIS 显示，加入 T:M DES 添加剂后，PEO 电解质的离子电导率逐渐增加。在各种添加剂组合物中，比例为1:4的T:M DES添加剂表现出最高的离子电导率，为1.28×10⁶Scm− 1。总的来说，这些发现突出了百里酚-薄荷醇DES添加剂在改善PEO基电解质的物理化学性质和电化学性能方面的潜在电化学应用前景。

articles.title: Extreme temperature gradient drives substantial thermoelectric current in additive manufacturing
articles.title_zh: 极端温度梯度在增材制造中驱动大量热电流
articles.abstract: Thermoelectric effects are commonly neglected in engineering alloys because their Seebeck coefficients are small. Here we show that this material-centred assumption fails under the extreme temperature gradients of additive manufacturing (AM). Combining in situ measurements of transient potential with multiphysics simulations under representative conditions of laser-powder-bed-fusion and laser-directed-energy-deposition.In our experiments we find that temperature gradients of ~10⁵–10⁸ K m⁻¹ generate current densities of ~10⁶–10⁸ A m⁻² in melt pool of AlSi10Mg, despite its Seebeck coefficient of only ~2 μV K⁻¹. These values match or exceed current densities in some conditions ofthermoelectric materials. Additionally, we established a fully coupled thermoelectric magnetohydrodynamic (TEMHD)model that incorporates complete thermoelectric effects, and investigated the influence of thermoelectric source terms on the multi-physics coupling process. The currents are strongly anisotropic and spatially heterogeneous within the melt pool. The resulting Joule and Thomson heat terms locally rival or exceed heat losses from the melt-pool surface, changing regional temperature gradients by ~1–10% and current densities by ~2–15%, whereas the Peltier term remains weak. Although the specific microstructural consequences remain to be established, the magnitude, localization and thermal feedback of thermoelectriccurrents identify them as an inherent non-negligiblecomponent of melt-pool dynamics and solidification in AM, and as a pre-existing electrical background for magnetically or electrically assisted process. Our high‑fidelity TEMHD model provides an effective tool for studying this class of problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 工程合金中的热电效应通常被忽略，因为它们的塞贝克系数很小。在这里，我们证明这种以材料为中心的假设在增材制造 (AM) 的极端温度梯度下是失败的。在激光粉末床熔融和激光定向能量沉积的代表性条件下，将瞬态电势的原位测量与多物理场模拟相结合。在我们的实验中，我们发现~10⁵–10⁸ K m⁻1的温度梯度在AlSi10Mg熔池中产生~10⁶–10⁸ A m⁻²的电流密度，尽管其塞贝克系数仅为~2 μV K⁻1。这些值匹配或超过热电材料某些条件下的电流密度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 工程合金中的热电效应通常被忽略，因为它们的塞贝克系数很小。在这里，我们证明这种以材料为中心的假设在增材制造 (AM) 的极端温度梯度下是失败的。在激光粉末床熔融和激光定向能量沉积的代表性条件下，将瞬态电势的原位测量与多物理场模拟相结合。在我们的实验中，我们发现~10⁵–10⁸ K m⁻1的温度梯度在AlSi10Mg熔池中产生~10⁶–10⁸ A m⁻²的电流密度，尽管其塞贝克系数仅为~2 μV K⁻1。这些值匹配或超过热电材料某些条件下的电流密度。此外，我们建立了包含完整热电效应的全耦合热电磁流体动力学（TEMHD）模型，并研究了热电源项对多物理场耦合过程的影响。熔池内的电流具有强烈的各向异性和空间异质性。由此产生的焦耳热项和汤姆逊热项在局部可与熔池表面的热损失相媲美或超过，将区域温度梯度改变约 1-10%，将电流密度改变约 2-15%，而珀尔帖项仍然较弱。尽管具体的微观结构后果仍有待确定，但热电流的大小、局部化和热反馈将其确定为增材制造中熔池动力学和凝固的固有的不可忽视的组成部分，并且作为磁或电辅助过程的预先存在的电背景。我们的高保真 TEMHD 模型为研究此类问题提供了有效的工具。

articles.title: More about Spin-Spin Dipole-Dipole Interactions Contributions to the Shapes of Nitroxide EPR Spectra in Solution
articles.title_zh: 更多关于自旋-自旋偶极-偶极相互作用对溶液中氮氧化物 EPR 光谱形状的贡献
articles.abstract: In this work, experimental data were obtained confirming unusual contribution of dipole-dipole interaction between unpaired electron of the radical and its own ¹⁵N nucleus (DD1) to EPR resonance line shapes in solutions of ¹⁵N-Tempol radicals. One might expect that the random modulation of DD1 by rotational diffusion leads to spectral diffusion of the resonance frequencies: DD1 randomly flips the orientation of the nitrogen nuclear spin, causing the electron spin to randomly change frequencies and jump from one hyperfine component to another. Spectral diffusion is expected. This is an expected process in the case of the interaction of a nuclear spin with the lattice or with electrons in other radicals, or in the case of spin diffusion within the nuclear spin system. In this case, the electron spin facilitates flipping of the nuclear spin, and resonant frequency of that electron changes. As Marsh demonstrated, the elementary process is not limited merely to the nuclear spin flip. In addition to the frequency shift, spin coherence of unpaired electron acquires an extra phase of π. It should be noted that a similar effect was previously predicted by Salikhov and experimentally confirmed in studies by Bales and colleagues regarding paramagnetic relaxation associated with the dipole-dipole interaction of unpaired electrons in dilute solutions of nitroxide radicals (DD2). In this work, we present experimental data demonstrating negative interference between contributions of DD1 and DD2 paramagnetic relaxation mechanisms, on the one hand, and paramagnetic relaxation caused by spin exchange during random bimolecular collisions of radicals, on the other. Spin exchange leads to spectral diffusion without π-phase jumps of spin coherence.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，获得的实验数据证实了自由基的不成对电子与其自身的 15N 核（DD1）之间的偶极-偶极相互作用对 15N-Tempol 自由基溶液中的 EPR 共振线形状的贡献。人们可能会认为，通过旋转扩散对 DD1 进行随机调制会导致共振频率的谱扩散：DD1 随机翻转氮核自旋的方向，导致电子自旋随机改变频率并从一个超精细组件跳跃到另一个超精细组件。预计会发生光谱扩散。在核自旋与晶格或与其他自由基中的电子相互作用的情况下，或者在核自旋系统内自旋扩散的情况下，这是预期的过程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，获得的实验数据证实了自由基的不成对电子与其自身的 15N 核（DD1）之间的偶极-偶极相互作用对 15N-Tempol 自由基溶液中的 EPR 共振线形状的贡献。人们可能会认为，通过旋转扩散对 DD1 进行随机调制会导致共振频率的谱扩散：DD1 随机翻转氮核自旋的方向，导致电子自旋随机改变频率并从一个超精细组件跳跃到另一个超精细组件。预计会发生光谱扩散。在核自旋与晶格或与其他自由基中的电子相互作用的情况下，或者在核自旋系统内自旋扩散的情况下，这是预期的过程。在这种情况下，电子自旋促进核自旋的翻转，并且该电子的共振频率发生变化。正如马什所证明的，基本过程不仅限于核自旋翻转。除了频移之外，不成对电子的自旋相干性还获得额外的π相位。应该指出的是，Salikhov 之前预测了类似的效应，并在 Bales 及其同事的研究中通过实验证实了与硝基氧自由基 (DD2) 稀溶液中不成对电子偶极-偶极相互作用相关的顺磁弛豫。在这项工作中，我们提供的实验数据一方面证明了 DD1 和 DD2 顺磁弛豫机制的贡献与自由基随机双分子碰撞期间自旋交换引起的顺磁弛豫之间的负面干扰。自旋交换导致光谱扩散，而没有自旋相干性的π相跳跃。

articles.title: Physics-Coupled Task Allocation for Collaborative Robotic Welding of Dissimilar Steel Joints Using an α-Potential Game and a Physics-Informed Neural Network Surrogate
articles.title_zh: 使用 α 势博弈和物理通知神经网络代理的异种钢接头协作机器人焊接的物理耦合任务分配
articles.abstract: Collaborative robotic welding of dissimilar steel joints involves coupled decisions concerning task assignment, welding sequence, thermal interaction, energy consumption, and production time. Conventional distance-based allocation methods do not explicitly account for the fact that neighboring welding operations may modify the thermal state and mechanical response of subsequent operations. This study proposes a physics-coupled task-allocation framework in which collaborative welding robots are modelled as players of an α-potential game and the thermo-mechanical response is evaluated using a physics-informed neural-network (PINN) surrogate. The α-potential formulation represents the bounded discrepancy between individual utility changes and changes in a common potential function resulting from non-additive thermal interactions. A sufficient equilibrium result is established: under a finite feasible strategy space, a global maximizer of the α-potential is an α-Nash equilibrium. Log-linear learning is employed as a stochastic strategy-update mechanism, while finite-time convergence results from the potential-game literature are invoked only for the exact-potential case and under their stated assumptions. The PINN incorporates the transient heat-conduction and mechanical-equilibrium equations into its training objective and provides a reduced-cost approximation of repeated thermo-mechanical evaluations. In the computational study, the proposed framework reduced normalized makespan and energy consumption relative to the distance-driven allocation strategy while simultaneously accounting for residual stress and carbon redistribution. The results indicate that coupling physical response with distributed task allocation can improve the quality of multi-robot welding decisions. The reported numerical values are computational predictions and should be independently validated experimentally before being generalized to industrial welding applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 异种钢接头的协作机器人焊接涉及有关任务分配、焊接顺序、热相互作用、能耗和生产时间的耦合决策。传统的基于距离的分配方法没有明确考虑相邻焊接操作可能改变后续操作的热状态和机械响应的事实。本研究提出了一种物理耦合任务分配框架，其中协作焊接机器人被建模为 α 势游戏的参与者，并使用物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 代理来评估热机械响应。 α-势公式表示个体效用变化与非相加热相互作用导致的公共势函数变化之间的有限差异。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 异种钢接头的协作机器人焊接涉及有关任务分配、焊接顺序、热相互作用、能耗和生产时间的耦合决策。传统的基于距离的分配方法没有明确考虑相邻焊接操作可能改变后续操作的热状态和机械响应的事实。本研究提出了一种物理耦合任务分配框架，其中协作焊接机器人被建模为 α 势游戏的参与者，并使用物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 代理来评估热机械响应。 α-势公式表示个体效用变化与非相加热相互作用导致的公共势函数变化之间的有限差异。建立了充分的均衡结果：在有限可行策略空间下，α-势的全局最大化是α-纳什均衡。对数线性学习被用作随机策略更新机制，而来自潜在博弈文献的有限时间收敛结果仅针对确切的潜在情况并在其规定的假设下被调用。 PINN 将瞬态热传导和机械平衡方程纳入其训练目标，并提供重复热机械评估的低成本近似。在计算研究中，所提出的框架相对于距离驱动的分配策略减少了归一化完工时间和能源消耗，同时考虑了残余应力和碳重新分配。结果表明，将物理响应与分布式任务分配相结合可以提高多机器人焊接决策的质量。报告的数值是计算预测，在推广到工业焊接应用之前应进行独立的实验验证。

articles.title: Q-IDS Bench: Reproducible and Resource-Aware Evaluation of Quantum-Inspired Intrusion Detection Across Five Network and IoT Datasets
articles.title_zh: Q-IDS Bench：跨五个网络和物联网数据集对量子启发的入侵检测进行可重复和资源感知的评估
articles.abstract: Very high IDS scores are frequently reported, but one ac curacy measure does not by itself show whether a detector will remain reliable under a different split, preprocess ing pipeline, or deployment budget. Q-IDS Bench exam ines this issue by benchmarking nine quantum-inspired intrusion-detection system (IDS) configurations on five datasets, all implemented on classical hardware. The data are divided into training, validation, and test sets before fitted preprocessing, and each experiment is repeated with five random seeds. Performance is assessed with weighted F1, AUPRC, MCC, false-positive rate, attack recall, and model-side inference latency. The best weighted-F1 values range from 98.86% to 99.95%, but the leading architecture depends on the dataset. The key result is therefore not a universal winner but the reproducibility of the compari son: model rankings are dataset-specific, and hybridisation alone does not guarantee better performance. The study provides a baseline for future comparison with genuine quantum machine learning (QML) implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 经常报告非常高的 IDS 分数，但一项精度测量本身并不能表明检测器在不同的分割、预处理管道或部署预算下是否保持可靠。 Q-IDS Bench 通过在五个数据集上对九个量子启发的入侵检测系统 (IDS) 配置进行基准测试来解决这个问题，所有数据集都在经典硬件上实现。在拟合预处理之前，数据被分为训练集、验证集和测试集，并且每个实验都使用五个随机种子重复。通过加权 F1、AUPRC、MCC、误报率、攻击召回率和模型端推理延迟来评估性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经常报告非常高的 IDS 分数，但一项精度测量本身并不能表明检测器在不同的分割、预处理管道或部署预算下是否保持可靠。 Q-IDS Bench 通过在五个数据集上对九个量子启发的入侵检测系统 (IDS) 配置进行基准测试来解决这个问题，所有数据集都在经典硬件上实现。在拟合预处理之前，数据被分为训练集、验证集和测试集，并且每个实验都使用五个随机种子重复。通过加权 F1、AUPRC、MCC、误报率、攻击召回率和模型端推理延迟来评估性能。最佳加权 F1 值范围为 98.86% 到 99.95%，但领先的架构取决于数据集。因此，关键结果不是普遍的获胜者，而是比较的可重复性：模型排名是特定于数据集的，并且单独的杂交并不能保证更好的性能。该研究为未来与真正的量子机器学习（QML）实现进行比较提供了基准。

articles.title: Multi-Dimensional Structural Fingerprinting for Quantitative Polymorph Comparison: A Comprehensive Topological Analysis of Sulfathiazole, Galunisertib and Aripiprazole Polymorphs
articles.title_zh: 用于定量多晶型物比较的多维结构指纹图谱：磺胺噻唑、Galunisertib 和阿立哌唑多晶型物的综合拓扑分析
articles.abstract: Polymorphism in organic molecular crystals presents significant challenges for pharmaceutical and materials science applications, requiring robust methods for quantitative structural comparisons. We present a multi-dimensional topological fingerprinting approach that quantifies structural relationships through five complementary categories: crystal packing, intermolecular interaction networks, molecular conformation, fragment orientation, and spatial geometry. Distribution-based similarity metrics enable ranking and clustering of structuresrev{, and every descriptor is independent of the unit cell, space-group setting and Cartesian frame.We demonstrate the approach on three pharmaceutical polymorph families: five DFT-optimized sulfathiazole polymorphs, ten experimental galunisertib polymorphs and nine experimental forms of the flexible, partly non-aromatic aripiprazole. Which categories are conserved depends on the molecule. For sulfathiazole, spatial geometry is the most consistent category (0.78--0.86), whereas conformation and interaction networks separate Forms II, III and IV from Forms I and V. For galunisertib, spatial geometry and conformation are the most consistent, crystal packing varies most. For aripiprazole, spatial geometry is much less conserved (0.41--0.74), and the decomposition distinguishes forms that share their packing but not their conformation (Forms I and X) from forms that share their conformation but not their lattice (Forms III, IV and V). The overall similarity agrees with COMPACK cluster matching for sulfathiazole (Spearman ρ=-0.89 with RMSD) and follows the number of matched molecules for galunisertib (ρ=0.44) and aripiprazole (0.67). Compared with the invariant descriptors AMD, PDD and SOAP, the fingerprint identifies the form of 47 sulfathiazole and 21 aripiprazole structures equally reliably and ranks distinct polymorphs closer to COMPACK cluster matching (aripiprazole: ρ=0.67 versus 0.14--0.37), though not to simulated PXRD similarity. Rankings are robust to coordinate perturbations and cutoff choices, except where an H-bond lies at the criterion or few aromatic contacts occur. The framework supports polymorph classification, structural relationship analysis, validation of crystal structure prediction and solid-form screening.
articles.abstract_zh: 有机分子晶体的多态性给制药和材料科学应用带来了重大挑战，需要稳健的方法来进行定量结构比较。我们提出了一种多维拓扑指纹识别方法，通过五个互补类别来量化结构关系：晶体堆积、分子间相互作用网络、分子构象、片段取向和空间几何。基于分布的相似性度量可以对结构rev{进行排序和聚类，并且每个描述符都独立于晶胞、空间群设置和笛卡尔坐标系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有机分子晶体的多态性给制药和材料科学应用带来了重大挑战，需要稳健的方法来进行定量结构比较。我们提出了一种多维拓扑指纹识别方法，通过五个互补类别来量化结构关系：晶体堆积、分子间相互作用网络、分子构象、片段取向和空间几何。基于分布的相似性度量可以对结构rev{进行排序和聚类，并且每个描述符都独立于晶胞、空间群设置和笛卡尔坐标系。我们在三个药物多晶型物家族上演示了该方法：五种DFT优化的磺胺噻唑多晶型物、十种实验性galunisertib多晶型物和九种灵活的、部分非芳香族阿立哌唑的实验形式。哪些类别是保守的取决于分子。对于磺胺噻唑，空间几何形状是最一致的类别（0.78--0.86），而构象和相互作用网络将II、III和IV型与I和V型分开。对于galunisertib，空间几何和构象是最一致的，晶体堆积变化最大。对于阿立哌唑，空间几何保守性要低得多（0.41--0.74），并且分解将共享堆积但不共享构象的形式（形式 I 和 X）与共享构象但不共享晶格的形式（形式 III、IV 和 V）区分开来。总体相似性与磺胺噻唑的 COMPACK 聚类匹配一致（Spearman ρ=-0.89，RMSD），并遵循 galunisertib (ρ=0.44) 和阿立哌唑 (0.67) 的匹配分子数。与不变描述符 AMD、PDD 和 SOAP 相比，指纹图谱同样可靠地识别了 47 个磺胺噻唑和 21 个阿立哌唑结构的形式，并对不同的多晶型物进行了更接近 COMPACK 簇匹配的排序（阿立哌唑：ρ=0.67 与 0.14--0.37），尽管与模拟的 PXRD 相似性不同。排名对于协调扰动和截止选择是稳健的，除非氢键位于标准或很少发生芳族接触。该框架支持多晶型分类、结构关系分析、晶体结构预测验证和固体形式筛选。

articles.title: Experimental and Computational Investigation of Thermal Conductivity in Porous Silicon: Doping-Dependent Performance of Molecular Dynamics and Physics- Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 多孔硅热导率的实验和计算研究：分子动力学和物理信息神经网络的掺杂相关性能
articles.abstract: Porous silicon (pSi) is a highly promising material for nanoscale thermal management, but predicting its thermal conductivity remains challenging due to complex structure-property dependencies. In this work, we present a comprehensive multiscale investigation of heat transport in pSi, combining experimental gas-microphone photoacoustic (PA) measurements with atomistic Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations and continuum-level Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). Mesoporous pSi layers with porosities ranging from 48% to 75% were fabricated via electrochemical etching of highly doped p+-type silicon, and their effective thermal conductivity was experimentally determined. Our findings reveal that the thermal properties are fundamentally governed by the initial substrate doping, which dictates the formation of either isotropic sponge-like or anisotropic columnar morphologies. We demonstrate that MD simulations accurately capture the thermal behavior of heavily doped samples by explicitly accounting for phonon confinement, whereas the PINN approach excellently models percolation and macroscopic heat flux in stochastic networks typical of lightly and moderately doped silicon. By integrating these computational and experimental datasets with literature values, we utilized symbolic regression to derive a generalized analytical expression for the effective thermal conductivity of pSi as a function of porosity and temperature. This hybrid multiscale framework connects nanoscale phonon mechanics to macroscopic thermophysical properties, providing a predictive tool for the design of porous silicon-based thermoelectric and thermal-insulation devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 多孔硅（pSi）是一种非常有前途的纳米级热管理材料，但由于复杂的结构-性能依赖性，预测其导热率仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们将实验气体麦克风光声 (PA) 测量与原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和连续体级物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 相结合，对 pSi 中的热传输进行了全面的多尺度研究。通过高掺杂p+型硅的电化学蚀刻制备了孔隙率在48%至75%之间的介孔pSi层，并通过实验确定了它们的有效导热率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多孔硅（pSi）是一种非常有前途的纳米级热管理材料，但由于复杂的结构-性能依赖性，预测其导热率仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们将实验气体麦克风光声 (PA) 测量与原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和连续体级物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 相结合，对 pSi 中的热传输进行了全面的多尺度研究。通过高掺杂p+型硅的电化学蚀刻制备了孔隙率在48%至75%之间的介孔pSi层，并通过实验确定了它们的有效导热率。我们的研究结果表明，热性能从根本上是由初始衬底掺杂决定的，这决定了各向同性海绵状或各向异性柱状形态的形成。我们证明，MD 模拟通过明确考虑声子限制来准确捕获重掺杂样品的热行为，而 PINN 方法可以出色地模拟轻掺杂和中掺杂硅典型的随机网络中的渗流和宏观热通量。通过将这些计算和实验数据集与文献值相结合，我们利用符号回归推导出 pSi 有效导热系数作为孔隙率和温度函数的通用分析表达式。这种混合多尺度框架将纳米级声子力学与宏观热物理性质联系起来，为多孔硅基热电和隔热装置的设计提供了预测工具。

articles.title: A Study on Defect Monitoring in Stainless Steel Laser Welding Processes Using a Multi-Sensor System
articles.title_zh: 使用多传感器系统进行不锈钢激光焊接过程缺陷监测的研究
articles.abstract: Laser welding has been widely used in various manufacturing industries due to its high energy density, low heat input, and excellent productivity. In battery systems for electric vehicles (EVs), cooling panels require reliable joining processes to ensure structural integrity and effective thermal management. Although aluminum alloys are commonly used for weight reduction, their relatively low melting temperature can compromise structural integrity under severe thermal conditions such as thermal runaway. Therefore, SUS304L are being considered as alternative materials to enhance safety and structural integrity. In this study, a multi-sensor-based monitoring approach is proposed for defect detection during laser welding of SUS304L using an Adjustable Ring Mode (ARM) laser. A photodiode was used to detect infrared (IR) and ultraviolet (UV) optical signals during welding to analyze variations in plasma and melt pool behavior, while an infrared thermal camera was employed to measure the temperature distribution in the weld zone. Various defect scenarios were introduced to investigate signal characteristics under different welding conditions. In addition, two thermal imaging approaches were compared: total area analysis for observing the overall thermal distribution along the weld bead and local area analysis for tracking the laser heat source and molten pool. The results showed that porosity was mainly associated with abnormal UV signal fluctuations, whereas undercut was more clearly reflected by irregular IR peaks. Non-penetration was characterized by increased IR signal variation together with changes in the local thermal response. Local area analysis provided a more stable thermal response around the laser interaction zone than total area analysis. Combining the IR, UV, and local thermal responses enabled the defect-related signal characteristics to be compared within a single monitoring framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 激光焊接因其能量密度高、热输入低、生产率优异等优点而被广泛应用于各个制造行业。在电动汽车 (EV) 的电池系统中，冷却板需要可靠的连接工艺，以确保结构完整性和有效的热管理。尽管铝合金通常用于减轻重量，但其相对较低的熔化温度可能会在热失控等严酷的热条件下损害结构完整性。因此，SUS304L 被认为是增强安全性和结构完整性的替代材料。在本研究中，提出了一种基于多传感器的监测方法，用于使用可调环模式 (ARM) 激光器进行 SUS304L 激光焊接期间的缺陷检测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 激光焊接因其能量密度高、热输入低、生产率优异等优点而被广泛应用于各个制造行业。在电动汽车 (EV) 的电池系统中，冷却板需要可靠的连接工艺，以确保结构完整性和有效的热管理。尽管铝合金通常用于减轻重量，但其相对较低的熔化温度可能会在热失控等严酷的热条件下损害结构完整性。因此，SUS304L 被认为是增强安全性和结构完整性的替代材料。在本研究中，提出了一种基于多传感器的监测方法，用于使用可调环模式 (ARM) 激光器进行 SUS304L 激光焊接期间的缺陷检测。光电二极管用于检测焊接过程中的红外（IR）和紫外（UV）光信号，以分析等离子体和熔池行为的变化，同时采用红外热像仪来测量焊接区域的温度分布。引入各种缺陷场景来研究不同焊接条件下的信号特征。此外，还比较了两种热成像方法：用于观察沿焊道的整体热分布的总面积分析和用于跟踪激光热源和熔池的局部区域分析。结果表明，孔隙率主要与异常的紫外信号波动有关，而底切则由不规则的红外峰更清晰地反映。非穿透的特点是红外信号变化增加以及局部热响应变化。局部区域分析在激光相互作用区域周围提供了比总区域分析更稳定的热响应。结合红外、紫外和局部热响应，可以在单个监控框架内比较与缺陷相关的信号特征。

articles.title: Graphene-Engineered NiFe-LDH Nanocomposites with Surface- Controlled Charge Storage for High-Performance Supercapacitors
articles.title_zh: 用于高性能超级电容器的具有表面控制电荷存储的石墨烯工程 NiFe-LDH 纳米复合材料
articles.abstract: Nickel-iron layered double hydroxide (NiFe-LDH) is a promising pseudo-capacitive electrode material; however, its electrochemical performance is limited by poor electrical conductivity and the tendency of LDH nanosheets to form agglomerates. Herein, to overcome both challenges, we have employed a one-pot hydrothermal method to synthesize a NiFe-LDH-Graphene nanocomposite (NiFe-LDH@Graphene), in which the two-dimensional graphene interface provides conductive electron transport pathways while inhibiting the formation of aggregates. BET Analysis revealed a 17% enhancement in surface area (SBET) after inclusion with graphene, with values being ~ 41.4 and 48.5%, for bare NiFe-LDH and NiFe-LDH@Graphene, respectively. The electrode fabricated from NiFe-LDH@Graphene nanostructure showcases an enhanced specific capacitance up to 953 F g− 1 at 1 A g− 1 (representing a 138% increase in Cs, vis-à-vis ~ 400 F g− 1 for bare NiFe-LDH) with an energy density of 26.81 Wh kg− 1 at a power density of 224.89 W kg− 1, respectively. Power-law analysis carried out using cyclic voltammograms at varying scanning rates clearly demonstrated a change in the charge storage behavior from nearly diffusion-controlled (b = 0.419) for pure NiFe-LDH to surface-controlled for NiFe-LDH@Graphene (b = 0.868). These findings clearly indicate improved contribution of faradic and capacitive processes at the surface due to the integration of graphene sheets into NiFe-LDH. Furthermore, NiFe-LDH@Graphene electrode retains a higher capacitance retention (CR) of ~ 90.2% after 6000 Galvanostatic charge-discharge (GCD) cycles, outperforming pristine NiFe-LDH by 17%, with a CR value of ~ 73.2%. This improvement is attributed to the conducting 2D graphene structure, which suppresses nanosheet restacking while facilitating electron transport. Collectively, these results position planar carbon scaffolding as an electronically and geometrically superior engineering strategy for high-performance pseudocapacitive electrodes.
articles.abstract_zh: 镍铁层状双氢氧化物（NiFe-LDH）是一种很有前途的赝电容电极材料；然而，其电化学性能受到较差的导电性和LDH纳米片形成团聚倾向的限制。为了克服这两个挑战，我们采用一锅水热法合成了 NiFe-LDH-石墨烯纳米复合材料（NiFe-LDH@Graphene），其中二维石墨烯界面提供导电电子传输途径，同时抑制聚集体的形成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 镍铁层状双氢氧化物（NiFe-LDH）是一种很有前途的赝电容电极材料；然而，其电化学性能受到较差的导电性和LDH纳米片形成团聚倾向的限制。为了克服这两个挑战，我们采用一锅水热法合成了 NiFe-LDH-石墨烯纳米复合材料（NiFe-LDH@Graphene），其中二维石墨烯界面提供导电电子传输途径，同时抑制聚集体的形成。 BET 分析显示，添加石墨烯后，裸露 NiFe-LDH 和 NiFe-LDH@Graphene 的表面积 (SBET) 增加了 17%，其值分别约为 41.4% 和 48.5%。由 NiFe-LDH@石墨烯纳米结构制成的电极在 1 A g− 1 时表现出高达 953 F g− 1 的增强比电容（与裸 NiFe-LDH 的 ~ 400 F g− 1 相比，Cs 增加了 138%），功率密度为 26.81 Wh kg− 1 时能量密度为 26.81 Wh kg− 1分别为 224.89 W kg− 1。使用不同扫描速率的循环伏安图进行幂律分析，清楚地表明电荷存储行为从纯 NiFe-LDH 的近扩散控制 (b = 0.419) 到 NiFe-LDH@石墨烯的表面控制 (b = 0.868)。这些发现清楚地表明，由于石墨烯片集成到 NiFe-LDH 中，表面法拉第和电容过程的贡献得到了改善。此外，NiFe-LDH@石墨烯电极在6000次恒电流充放电（GCD）循环后仍保持较高的电容保持率（CR）~ 90.2％，比原始NiFe-LDH高17％，CR值~ 73.2％。这一改进归功于导电的二维石墨烯结构，它抑制了纳米片的重新堆叠，同时促进了电子传输。总的来说，这些结果将平面碳支架定位为高性能赝电容电极的电子学和几何学上优越的工程策略。

articles.title: One University Three Positions: A Reproducible Simulation Study of Database Dependent Institutional Rankings across OpenAlex Scopus and Web of Science
articles.title_zh: 一所大学三个位置：OpenAlex Scopus 和 Web of Science 中数据库相关机构排名的可重复模拟研究
articles.abstract: Institutional research rankings are often reported as if a university occupies one stable position. In practice, the position is partly produced by the bibliographic database through coverage, affiliation resolution, citation scaling, document classification, and residual metadata error. This study develops a database-choice uncertainty framework and evaluates it through a fully reproducible Monte Carlo simulation. A fixed population of 700 synthetic universities was generated with heterogeneous size, latent research quality, disciplinary portfolio, language profile, and regional location. OpenAlex, Scopus, and Web of Science were represented by prespecified observation functions informed by documented differences rather than fitted to vendor data. Identical indicator definitions and weights were then applied in 1,000 replications for the reference model and for six sensitivity scenarios. In the reference model, OpenAlex and Web of Science rankings had a mean Spearman correlation of 0.954, yet their mean median absolute rank gap was 40.8 places and their mean top-100 overlap was 81.7%. The apparent contradiction reflects high system-level concordance alongside consequential institution-level movement. Directional effects were strongly patterned: the median synthetic Global South institution ranked 34 places better in OpenAlex than in Web of Science, whereas the median institution in other regions ranked 52 places worse. A Shapley decomposition assigned 65.4% of explained OpenAlex-Web of Science discordance to coverage, 24.6% to residual noise, 11.7% to citation scaling, and − 1.7% to an affiliation suppressor interaction. Removing language and geography penalties reduced the mean median rank gap from 40.8 to 17.9 places. The study proposes rank envelopes, membership probabilities, layer-specific decomposition, and a minimum reporting standard. It demonstrates mechanisms rather than measuring current vendor performance; all code, parameters, synthetic data, and replication outputs accompany the manuscript.
articles.abstract_zh: 机构研究排名通常被认为是一所大学占据一个稳定的位置。实际上，位置部分是由书目数据库通过覆盖范围、隶属关系解析、引文缩放、文档分类和残留元数据错误产生的。本研究开发了一个数据库选择不确定性框架，并通过完全可重复的蒙特卡罗模拟对其进行评估。形成了由 700 所固定人口组成的综合性大学，其规模、潜在研究质量、学科组合、语言概况和区域位置均存在差异。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机构研究排名通常被认为是一所大学占据一个稳定的位置。实际上，位置部分是由书目数据库通过覆盖范围、隶属关系解析、引文缩放、文档分类和残留元数据错误产生的。本研究开发了一个数据库选择不确定性框架，并通过完全可重复的蒙特卡罗模拟对其进行评估。形成了由 700 所固定人口组成的综合性大学，其规模、潜在研究质量、学科组合、语言概况和区域位置均存在差异。 OpenAlex、Scopus 和 Web of Science 是通过预先指定的观察函数来表示的，这些函数是根据记录的差异而不是根据供应商数据进行拟合的。然后，将相同的指标定义和权重应用于参考模型和六种敏感性场景的 1,000 次重复中。在参考模型中，OpenAlex 和 Web of Science 排名的平均 Spearman 相关性为 0.954，但它们的平均中位数绝对排名差距为 40.8 位，前 100 名的平均重叠率为 81.7%。这种明显的矛盾反映了系统层面的高度一致性以及随之而来的机构层面的变动。方向效应具有很强的模式性：全球南方综合机构在 OpenAlex 中的排名中位比在 Web of Science 中高出 34 位，而其他地区的中位机构排名较差 52 位。 Shapley 分解将解释的 OpenAlex-Web of Science 不一致的 65.4% 归因于覆盖率，24.6% 归因于残余噪声，11.7% 归因于引文缩放，- 1.7% 归因于隶属抑制子相互作用。取消语言和地理处罚后，平均中位数排名差距从 40.8 位减少到 17.9 位。该研究提出了等级范围、成员概率、特定层分解和最低报告标准。它展示了机制而不是衡量当前供应商的绩效；所有代码、参数、合成数据和复制输出均附在手稿中。

articles.title: Surface Charge Transition Levels and Hole Localization of Dopants in BiVO4(010) Photoanodes
articles.title_zh: BiVO4(010) 光电阳极中掺杂剂的表面电荷跃迁水平和空穴局域化
articles.abstract: Bismuth vanadate (BiVO4) is a benchmark oxide photoanode whose performance is governed by surface states, yet the thermodynamics and charge transition levels (CTLs) of its surface defects remain far less characterized than its bulk defect physics. Here we use dielectric-dependent hybrid density functional theory to compute formation energies and CTLs for oxygen vacancies and for substitutional n-type (Mo, W) and p-type (Ca, Sr) dopants on BiVO4(010). Under the O-rich conditions of anodic operation, Mo and W substitute on the V sublattice, which they prefer over the Bi site by 3.3 and 3.7 eV for a Fermi level at the conduction band edge. Surface oxygen vacancies are shallow donors whose ε(2+/0) level lies 0.16 eV below the conduction band and are ionized over almost the whole gap. MoV and WV are deeper donors at 0.51 and 0.58 eV below the conduction band. CaBi is a shallow acceptor 0.02 eV above the valence band, whereas SrBi has no transition within the gap and is ionized at every Fermi level. The two acceptors also place the hole differently, CaBi on the outermost oxygen layer and SrBi in the interior. Because photoanode operation is limited by holes reaching the surface, an acceptor that captures photogenerated holes on the outermost oxygen layer should be more useful for water oxidation than one that leaves them in the interior, which makes CaBi the more promising p-type dopant of the two.
articles.abstract_zh: 钒酸铋 (BiVO4) 是一种基准氧化物光阳极，其性能由表面态决定，但其表面缺陷的热力学和电荷跃迁水平 (CTL) 的特征仍然远不如其体缺陷物理特征。在这里，我们使用介电相关的混合密度泛函理论来计算 BiVO4(010) 上氧空位以及替代 n 型（Mo、W）和 p 型（Ca、Sr）掺杂剂的形成能和 CTL。在阳极操作的富O条件下，Mo和W在V亚晶格上进行取代，对于导带边缘的费米能级，它们比Bi位点高3.3和3.7 eV。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钒酸铋 (BiVO4) 是一种基准氧化物光阳极，其性能由表面态决定，但其表面缺陷的热力学和电荷跃迁水平 (CTL) 的特征仍然远不如其体缺陷物理特征。在这里，我们使用介电相关的混合密度泛函理论来计算 BiVO4(010) 上氧空位以及替代 n 型（Mo、W）和 p 型（Ca、Sr）掺杂剂的形成能和 CTL。在阳极操作的富O条件下，Mo和W在V亚晶格上进行取代，对于导带边缘的费米能级，它们比Bi位点高3.3和3.7 eV。表面氧空位是浅施主，其 ε(2+/0) 能级位于导带以下 0.16 eV，并且几乎在整个能隙上被电离。 MoV 和 WV 是更深的供体，位于导带以下 0.51 和 0.58 eV。 CaBi 是价带上方 0.02 eV 的浅受主，而 SrBi 在能隙内没有跃迁，并且在每个费米能级都被电离。两个受体对空穴的位置也不同，CaBi 位于最外层氧层，SrBi 位于内部。由于光阳极操作受到到达表面的空穴的限制，捕获最外层氧层上的光生空穴的受主应该比将空穴留在内部的受主对水氧化更有用，这使得 CaBi 成为两者中更有前途的 p 型掺杂剂。

articles.title: Design and Optimization of High-Efficiency Amorphous/Crystalline Silicon Heterojunction (HIT) Solar Cells Using SCAPS-1D Simulation
articles.title_zh: 使用 SCAPS-1D 仿真设计和优化高效非晶/晶硅异质结 (HIT) 太阳能电池
articles.abstract: The heterojunction structure of amorphous/crystalline silicon solar cells, a-Si:H(p)/a Si:H(i)/c-Si(n)/BSF (a-Si:H(n+)/Au, was analyzed using numerical computer simulations. The study examined how the thickness, charge carrier concentration, and band gap of the a-Si:H layers affect solar cell performance. Additionally, the impact of defect density in the bulk material and at the emitter/wafer interface was explored. The study discusses the effect of incorporation of an intrinsic a-Si:H(i) buffer layer and a n-doped a-Si:H(n) back surface field layer, modeled solar cell structures with the configuration a-Si:H(p)/a-Si:H(i)/c-Si(n)/a-Si:H(n+)/Au. This study establishes design criteria for a-Si:H/c-Si heterojunction solar cells, identifying the optimal emitter thickness, band gap of emitter, buffer, and back layer.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用数值计算机模拟分析了非晶/晶体硅太阳能电池的异质结结构a-Si:H(p)/a Si:H(i)/c-Si(n)/BSF (a-Si:H(n+)/Au)。该研究考察了a-Si:H层的厚度、载流子浓度和带隙如何影响太阳能电池的性能。此外，还探讨了块体材料中和发射极/晶圆界面处的缺陷密度的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用数值计算机模拟分析了非晶/晶体硅太阳能电池的异质结结构a-Si:H(p)/a Si:H(i)/c-Si(n)/BSF (a-Si:H(n+)/Au)。该研究考察了a-Si:H层的厚度、载流子浓度和带隙如何影响太阳能电池的性能。此外，还探讨了块体材料中和发射极/晶圆界面处的缺陷密度的影响。该研究讨论了结合本征 a-Si:H(i) 缓冲层和 n 掺杂 a-Si:H(n) 背表面场层，模拟具有 a-Si:H(p)/a-Si:H(i)/c-Si(n)/a-Si:H(n+)/Au 配置的太阳能电池结构。本研究建立了 a-Si:H/c-Si 异质结太阳能电池的设计标准，确定了最佳发射极厚度、发射极、缓冲层和背面的带隙。层。

articles.title: A Semi-Automatic Roof Type-Driven Workflow for LoD2 Building Reconstruction from Orthophotos and Photogrammetric Point Clouds
articles.title_zh: 用于根据正射影像和摄影测量点云进行 LoD2 建筑重建的半自动屋顶类型驱动工作流程
articles.abstract: Level of Detail 2 (LoD2) building models provide explicit roof geometry and basic semantic subdivision and are widely used in urban analysis, 3D GIS, and remote sensing applications. However, generating LoD2 models from orthophotos and photogrammetric point clouds remains challenging, particularly due to variable data quality, complex roof forms, and dense urban structures. This study proposes a semi-automatic, roof type driven workflow for LoD2 building reconstruction that combines interactive digitized roof outlines and roof shape labels with rule based Boundary Representation (BREP) reconstruction in Python. Derived roof outlines from orthophotos are classified into five roof types (flat, gable, hip, shed, pyramid), while Digital Terrain Model (DTM), Digital Surface Model (DSM), normalized DSM, slope, and aspect layers derived from point clouds are used to infer roof height and roof plane orientation. The novelty of this study lies in a roof type driven semi-automatic workflow that explicitly uses roof type knowledge as the main driver of reconstruction rules, integrates orthophotos based roof outlines with elevation derivatives from point clouds, and generates complete BREP based LoD2 building models in CityJSON with CityGML conversion. The method is implemented to reconstruct 371 buildings into semantically structured LoD2 models stored in CityJSON and convertible to CityGML. Visual accuracy is evaluated for 30 buildings using completeness, correctness, and quality metrics derived from a confusion matrix comparing reconstructed roof planes with orthophotos reference data, yielding average values of 100% for completeness and 98.33% for both correctness and quality. Geometric accuracy is assessed by comparing selected model dimensions with point clouds based reference measurements, resulting in a Root Mean Square Error of 0.90 m, which satisfies the LoD2 tolerance adopted in this study. Overall, the results show that a roof type based semi-automatic workflow can deliver interpretable, semantically coherent, and interoperable LoD2 building models from photogrammetric data while maintaining explicit control over roof geometry and compatibility with existing 3D city model standards.
articles.abstract_zh: 细节级别 2 (LoD2) 建筑模型提供明确的屋顶几何形状和基本语义细分，广泛应用于城市分析、3D GIS 和遥感应用。然而，从正射影像和摄影测量点云生成 LoD2 模型仍然具有挑战性，特别是由于数据质量可变、屋顶形式复杂和城市结构密集。本研究提出了一种半自动、屋顶类型驱动的 LoD2 建筑重建工作流程，它将交互式数字化屋顶轮廓和屋顶形状标签与 Python 中基于规则的边界表示 (BREP) 重建相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 细节级别 2 (LoD2) 建筑模型提供明确的屋顶几何形状和基本语义细分，广泛应用于城市分析、3D GIS 和遥感应用。然而，从正射影像和摄影测量点云生成 LoD2 模型仍然具有挑战性，特别是由于数据质量可变、屋顶形式复杂和城市结构密集。本研究提出了一种半自动、屋顶类型驱动的 LoD2 建筑重建工作流程，它将交互式数字化屋顶轮廓和屋顶形状标签与 Python 中基于规则的边界表示 (BREP) 重建相结合。从正射影像导出的屋顶轮廓被分为五种屋顶类型（平顶、山墙、四坡、棚屋、金字塔），而数字地形模型（DTM）、数字表面模型（DSM）、归一化DSM、坡度和从点云导出的坡向图层用于推断屋顶高度和屋顶平面方向。本研究的新颖之处在于屋顶类型驱动的半自动工作流程，该工作流程明确使用屋顶类型知识作为重建规则的主要驱动力，将基于正射影像的屋顶轮廓与点云的高程导数相集成，并通过 CityGML 转换在 CityJSON 中生成完整的基于 BREP 的 LoD2 建筑模型。该方法可将 371 座建筑物重建为存储在 CityJSON 中并可转换为 CityGML 的语义结构化 LoD2 模型。使用完整性、正确性和质量指标评估了 30 座建筑物的视觉准确性，这些指标源自混淆矩阵，将重建的屋顶平面与正射影像参考数据进行比较，得出完整性的平均值为 100%，正确性和质量的平均值为 98.33%。通过将选定的模型尺寸与基于点云的参考测量进行比较来评估几何精度，得出的均方根误差为 0.90 m，满足本研究中采用的 LoD2 容差。总体而言，结果表明，基于屋顶类型的半自动工作流程可以根据摄影测量数据提供可解释、语义一致且可互操作的 LoD2 建筑模型，同时保持对屋顶几何形状的明确控制以及与现有 3D 城市模型标准的兼容性。

articles.title: Numerical and Experimental Investigation of Galvanic Corrosion in Coupled AA7025 and SS304L for Marine Applications
articles.title_zh: 船用AA7025和SS304L耦合电偶腐蚀的数值和实验研究
articles.abstract: This study investigates the galvanic corrosion of AA7025 aluminum alloy coupled with 304L stainless steel (SS) fasteners in marine structures, using a multi-methodological approach involving analytical modeling, SolidWorks 3D modeling, COMSOL Multiphysics simulations, and experimental validation. The AA7025-304L SS couples were tested in tap water, 3.5% NaCl, and 1M H₂SO₄ for 30 days. Corrosion rates increased significantly due to galvanic coupling: 4.92× in tap water, 3.16× in NaCl, and 4.26× in H₂SO₄, with predictive models accurate within 5% error. H₂SO₄ caused the highest hardness loss (10.97%) and a corrosion depth of 100.4 µm. Microstructural analysis showed CaCO₃ scaling in tap water, severe pitting in NaCl, and generalized dissolution in H₂SO₄. COMSOL simulations identified an Al-5Zn sacrificial anode as an effective mitigation strategy, providing a protective current density of 0.84 A/m² and a polarization potential of -1.08 V, significantly reducing AA7025 corrosion in marine-relevant environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究采用多方法方法，包括分析建模、SolidWorks 3D建模、COMSOL Multiphysics模拟和实验验证，研究AA7025铝合金与304L不锈钢(SS)紧固件在船舶结构中的电偶腐蚀。将AA7025-304L SS对在自来水、3.5% NaCl和1M H ₂ SO钚中测试30天。由于电偶耦合，腐蚀速率显著增加：自来水中为4.92 × ， NaCl中为3.16 × ， H ₂ SO中为4.26 × ，预测模型误差在5%以内。
