We further show that a hierarchical combination of this model with the transformer model outperforms other state-of-the-art architectures for large-scale quantum systems, opening new avenues for investigating quantum phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 数值模拟量子多体系统是现代物理学的核心挑战之一，因为希尔伯特空间随系统尺寸呈指数增长，使得大规模精确解决方案变得棘手。在过去的十年中，生成人工神经网络已经成为强大的波函数分析，推动了寻找基态表示、从数据重建量子态以及量子多体系统动力学建模方面的进步。虽然循环神经网络 (RNN) 的计算效率很高，但循环性质会限制其捕获远程相关性的能力。具有底层自注意力机制的 Transformer 模型擅长捕获这些远程相关性，但会增加计算要求，从而限制了小型物理系统的应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数值模拟量子多体系统是现代物理学的核心挑战之一，因为希尔伯特空间随系统尺寸呈指数增长，使得大规模精确解决方案变得棘手。在过去的十年中，生成人工神经网络已经成为强大的波函数分析，推动了寻找基态表示、从数据重建量子态以及量子多体系统动力学建模方面的进步。虽然循环神经网络 (RNN) 的计算效率很高，但循环性质会限制其捕获远程相关性的能力。具有底层自注意力机制的 Transformer 模型擅长捕获这些远程相关性，但会增加计算要求，从而限制了小型物理系统的应用。在这项工作中，我们通过探索作为波函数模拟的多层感知器（MLP）混合器模型来解决这些限制。通过计算轻量级混合策略，通过系统全局和本地混合信息，该架构有望将捕获远程相关性的能力与低计算成本结合起来。我们对模型进行基准测试，以寻找二维量子多体系统在物质各个相中的基态表示，并研究不同物理系统大小的表示准确性和计算效率的行为。通过将其性能与具有单站点和修补输入定义的 RNN 和 Transformer 模型进行比较，我们证明 MLP 混合器架构的性能与最先进的网络模型具有竞争力。我们进一步表明，该模型与变压器模型的分层组合优于大规模量子系统的其他最先进的架构，为研究物质的量子相开辟了新途径。

articles.title: Delta-Doped GeV⁻ in diamond with isotope resolvable optical spectra
articles.title_zh: 金刚石中 Delta 掺杂 GeV⁻ 的同位素可分辨光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30375v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Group IV color centers in diamond -- silicon, germanium, tin, and lead-vacancy centers -- are a promising platform for quantum networking. Typical Group-IV creation utilizes ion implantation during diamond growth that leaves the color centers with a broad depth distribution and damage-induced strain inhomogeneity. Deterministic placement and damage reduction in Group IV generation are essential for improving this platform. In this letter, we report on the localization of germanium-vacancy (GeV⁻) to a < 10 nm layer via the timed injection of GeH₄ during microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition. In this layer we have realized 17 ppm of Ge and a strain-free environment for the GeV⁻. Subsequent electron irradiation and annealing have generated a sheet density of 0.12 GeV⁻/μm². The minimal damage from color center generation mitigates spectral inhomogeneity and allows spectral resolution of isotopic clusters, with the best cluster having an inhomogeneous distribution of 2.14 GHz and an average linewidth of 47 ± 11 MHz. Our study gives insight into formation dynamics of GeV⁻ in delta-doped systems and estimates our vacancy to GeV⁻ yield to be ≥ 90%, establishing an athermal nearest-neighbor formation model. We further characterized the spin T₂^* and set a lower bound of 730 ns, limited by a paramagnetic defect.
articles.abstract_zh: 钻石中的 IV 族色心——硅、锗、锡和铅空位中心——是一个有前途的量子网络平台。典型的 IV 族制造在钻石生长过程中利用离子注入，使色心具有较宽的深度分布和损伤引起的应变不均匀性。第四组生成中的确定性放置和损伤减少对于改进该平台至关重要。在这封信中，我们报告了在微波等离子体化学气相沉积过程中通过定时注入 GeH₄ 将锗空位 (GeV⁻) 定位到 < 10 nm 的层。在这一层中，我们实现了 17 ppm 的 Ge 和 GeV⁻ 的无应变环境。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钻石中的 IV 族色心——硅、锗、锡和铅空位中心——是一个有前途的量子网络平台。典型的 IV 族制造在钻石生长过程中利用离子注入，使色心具有较宽的深度分布和损伤引起的应变不均匀性。第四组生成中的确定性放置和损伤减少对于改进该平台至关重要。在这封信中，我们报告了在微波等离子体化学气相沉积过程中通过定时注入 GeH₄ 将锗空位 (GeV⁻) 定位到 < 10 nm 的层。在这一层中，我们实现了 17 ppm 的 Ge 和 GeV⁻ 的无应变环境。随后的电子辐照和退火产生了 0.12 GeV-/μm2 的片密度。色心生成造成的最小损害可减轻光谱不均匀性，并实现同位素簇的光谱分辨率，最佳簇具有 2.14 GHz 的不均匀分布和 47 ± 11 MHz 的平均线宽。我们的研究深入了解了 δ 掺杂系统中 GeV⁻ 的形成动力学，并估计空位到 GeV⁻ 的产率≥ 90%，建立了非热最近邻形成模型。我们进一步表征了自旋 T2^* 并设置了 730 ns 的下限，受顺磁缺陷的限制。

articles.title: Monodromy Defects of 3D Wilson-Fisher Criticality on the Fuzzy Sphere
articles.title_zh: 模糊球上3D Wilson-Fisher临界值的单向缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31269v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Monodromy (twist) line defects arise as the boundaries of topological symmetry surfaces, which are among the simplest non-trivial conformal defects with direct realizations as magnetic vortex in quantum magnets, as Wilson and t Hooft lines of gauge theories, and as the replica twist operators in quantum information theory. However, their interacting dynamics remains difficult to characterize non-perturbatively. Here we design a way to realize the monodromy boundary conditions in the fuzzy-sphere regularization by threading a symmetry-selective Aharonov-Bohm flux through the two poles of the sphere. We apply this construction to the Z₂ twist of the 3D Ising conformal field theory (CFT), π-twist of the 3D O(2) CFT and three inequivalent monodromies of O(3) (centre twist, z-axis π-twist and the reflection). For each defect, we extract the low-lying defect spectrum together with bulk-to-defect and defect-defect operator product expansion coefficients, which characterize the operators living on the defect line, their mutual interactions, and how they couple to the surrounding critical bulk. Among the low-lying defect primaries resolved in our spectra, we find no relevant scalar perturbation that preserves all the symmetries of the corresponding defect. The relevant deformations identified in our calculations break at least one preserved symmetry, providing evidence that these monodromy defects are stable against symmetry-preserving relevant perturbations. These results establish a systematic set of non-perturbative conformal data for monodromy defects beyond the Ising twist. Our construction therefore turns the symmetry flux into a tunable knob of the fuzzy-sphere regularization, opening a route to exploring the response of critical matter to distinct defects.
articles.abstract_zh: 单向（扭曲）线缺陷作为拓扑对称面的边界出现，是最简单的非平凡共形缺陷之一，可以直接实现为量子磁体中的磁涡流、规范理论中的威尔逊线和霍夫特线以及量子信息论中的复制扭曲算子。然而，它们的相互作用动态仍然难以非扰动地表征。在这里，我们设计了一种通过将对称选择性阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量穿过球体的两个极点来实现模糊球正则化中的单向边界条件的方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单向（扭曲）线缺陷作为拓扑对称面的边界出现，是最简单的非平凡共形缺陷之一，可以直接实现为量子磁体中的磁涡流、规范理论中的威尔逊线和霍夫特线以及量子信息论中的复制扭曲算子。然而，它们的相互作用动态仍然难以非扰动地表征。在这里，我们设计了一种通过将对称选择性阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量穿过球体的两个极点来实现模糊球正则化中的单向边界条件的方法。我们将此构造应用于 3D 伊辛共形场论 (CFT) 的 Z2 扭曲、3D O(2) CFT 的 π 扭曲和 O(3) 的三个不等价单峰（中心扭曲、z 轴 π 扭曲和反射）。对于每个缺陷，我们提取低位缺陷谱以及块体到缺陷和缺陷到缺陷算子乘积展开系数，这些系数描述了缺陷线上的算子、它们的相互作用以及它们如何与周围的临界块体耦合。在我们的光谱中解析的低位缺陷原色中，我们没有发现相关的标量扰动可以保留相应缺陷的所有对称性。我们的计算中确定的相关变形破坏了至少一种保留的对称性，提供了证据表明这些单向缺陷对于保留对称性的相关扰动是稳定的。这些结果为伊辛扭曲之外的单峰缺陷建立了一组系统的非微扰共形数据。因此，我们的构造将对称通量转变为模糊球正则化的可调旋钮，开辟了一条探索关键物质对不同缺陷的响应的途径。

articles.title: Quantum Fokker-Planck solvers as trainable generative models
articles.title_zh: 量子福克-普朗克求解器作为可训练的生成模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31330v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop and analyze generative models based on quantum solvers of stochastic differential equations. Unlike the common approach based on layered variational quantum circuits with parameterized rotations, we parameterize the potential of a Langevin process. The associated Fokker-Planck (FP) equations are Hermitianized and solved using a linear combination of cosine operators implemented through quantum singular value transformation. By encoding the square root of the stationary density, the model enables sampling through computational-basis measurements and is efficiently controlled by coefficients of the block-encoded diagonal potential. We train the proposed model to match empirical distributions within the family described by FP equations, demonstrating parameter recovery for multivariate probability distributions. Crucially, the model remains trainable at scale. Sample-efficient and convex optimization for in-distribution targets arises from a physics-informed inductive bias and holds regardless of the dimensionality of the problem. We provide circuit constructions and efficient block encodings of the main components of the algorithm and analyze resource requirements. Our approach frames quantum generative learning as quantum model discovery and provides a foundation for extending this framework to high-dimensional, strongly correlated scientific data.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发和分析基于随机微分方程的量子求解器的生成模型。与基于具有参数化旋转的分层变分量子电路的常见方法不同，我们对朗之万过程的潜力进行参数化。相关的福克-普朗克 (FP) 方程经过厄米化并使用通过量子奇异值变换实现的余弦算子的线性组合进行求解。通过对稳态密度的平方根进行编码，该模型能够通过计算基础测量进行采样，并通过块编码对角势的系数进行有效控制。我们训练所提出的模型以匹配 FP 方程描述的族内的经验分布，展示多元概率分布的参数恢复。至关重要的是，该模型仍然可以大规模训练。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发和分析基于随机微分方程的量子求解器的生成模型。与基于具有参数化旋转的分层变分量子电路的常见方法不同，我们对朗之万过程的潜力进行参数化。相关的福克-普朗克 (FP) 方程经过厄米化并使用通过量子奇异值变换实现的余弦算子的线性组合进行求解。通过对稳态密度的平方根进行编码，该模型能够通过计算基础测量进行采样，并通过块编码对角势的系数进行有效控制。我们训练所提出的模型以匹配 FP 方程描述的族内的经验分布，展示多元概率分布的参数恢复。至关重要的是，该模型仍然可以大规模训练。分布内目标的样本效率和凸优化源于物理信息的归纳偏差，并且无论问题的维数如何都成立。我们提供算法主要组件的电路结构和高效块编码，并分析资源需求。我们的方法将量子生成学习框架为量子模型发现，并为将该框架扩展到高维、强相关的科学数据提供了基础。

articles.title: Orbital-coherence memory in electrical transport and its self-consistent Maxwell response
articles.title_zh: 电传输中的轨道相干记忆及其自洽麦克斯韦响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31390v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An internal electronic coherence changes electrical transport only when it feeds back on the physical current. We develop a reduced description of this feedback and distinguish its exact consequences from the assumptions required for a microscopic realization. An opposite-parity two-orbital Hamiltonian identifies a current-coupled orbital force. Under an explicitly stated moment closure and collision ansatz, it yields a passive three-state response with an exponentially damped oscillatory memory. The resulting conductivity redistributes a fixed optical weight and predicts a nonmonotonic dependence of dc conduction on coherence damping at fixed remaining parameters. The orbital reduction constrains the coupling and internal frequency through a shared bare splitting, providing a test beyond unconstrained spectral fitting. A charge-conserving spatial extension couples to Maxwell equations through a positive energy balance and separates the constitutive response from longitudinal collective and transverse electromagnetic modes. We formulate complex-conductivity and transmission tests, including the limits of parameter identification over a finite bandwidth. The model supplies a conditional connection between orbital dynamics, transport memory, and electromagnetic observables; conductivity alone does not establish a uniquely quantum mechanism, and a material-specific collision calculation and closure-error assessment remain necessary.
articles.abstract_zh: 内部电子相干性仅在反馈物理电流时才会改变电传输。我们对这种反馈进行了简化的描述，并将其确切后果与微观实现所需的假设区分开来。相反宇称双轨道哈密顿量确定了电流耦合轨道力。在明确规定的力矩闭合和碰撞模拟下，它产生具有指数阻尼振荡记忆的被动三态响应。由此产生的电导率重新分配固定的光学权重，并预测固定剩余参数下直流传导对相干阻尼的非单调依赖性。轨道缩减通过共享的裸分裂来限制耦合和内部频率，从而提供超越无约束频谱拟合的测试。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 内部电子相干性仅在反馈物理电流时才会改变电传输。我们对这种反馈进行了简化的描述，并将其确切后果与微观实现所需的假设区分开来。相反宇称双轨道哈密顿量确定了电流耦合轨道力。在明确规定的力矩闭合和碰撞模拟下，它产生具有指数阻尼振荡记忆的被动三态响应。由此产生的电导率重新分配固定的光学权重，并预测固定剩余参数下直流传导对相干阻尼的非单调依赖性。轨道缩减通过共享的裸分裂来限制耦合和内部频率，从而提供超越无约束频谱拟合的测试。电荷守恒空间延伸通过正能量平衡耦合到麦克斯韦方程，并将本构响应与纵向集体和横向电磁模式分开。我们制定复杂的电导率和传输测试，包括有限带宽上参数识别的限制。该模型提供了轨道动力学、传输记忆和电磁可观测量之间的条件联系；仅靠电导率并不能建立独特的量子机制，并且仍然需要针对特定材料的碰撞计算和闭合误差评估。

articles.title: Macroscopic Nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer Mediated by Coherent Magnons
articles.title_zh: 相干磁振子介导的宏观核共振能量转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31507v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Phonon-mediated nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer (RET) in metal deuterides is severely constrained by inertial rest-mass dilution, lattice fracture limits, and thermal nuclear spin cancellation. Extending the generalized nuclear Dicke model to Ferromagnetic Resonance (FMR) magnons eliminates mass dilution via hyperfine-amplified M1 coupling while unlocking relativistic Dirac M2 coupling via Overhauser spin polarization. We derive a Suhl-clamped FMR scaling law predicting 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) and 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) breakup neutrons, 19.9 MeV alpha particles, and reconciled sub-keV fusion anomalies.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属氘化物中声子介导的核共振能量转移（RET）受到惯性静止质量稀释、晶格断裂极限和热核自旋抵消的严重限制。将广义核迪克模型扩展到铁磁共振 (FMR) 磁振子，可以通过超精细放大 M1 耦合消除质量稀释，同时通过 Overhauser 自旋极化解锁相对论狄拉克 M2 耦合。我们推导出 Suhl 钳位 FMR 标度定律，预测 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) 和 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) 破裂中子、19.9 MeV α 粒子和协调的亚 keV 聚变异常。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属氘化物中声子介导的核共振能量转移（RET）受到惯性静止质量稀释、晶格断裂极限和热核自旋抵消的严重限制。将广义核迪克模型扩展到铁磁共振 (FMR) 磁振子，可以通过超精细放大 M1 耦合消除质量稀释，同时通过 Overhauser 自旋极化解锁相对论狄拉克 M2 耦合。我们推导出 Suhl 钳位 FMR 标度定律，预测 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) 和 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) 破裂中子、19.9 MeV α 粒子和协调的亚 keV 聚变异常。

articles.title: Screening strongly correlated materials in solid oxide cells with quantum simulation
articles.title_zh: 通过量子模拟筛选固体氧化物电池中的强相关材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31591v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop an end-to-end framework for assessing a quantum-computing application in industrial materials science: the screening of strongly correlated oxygen-electrode materials for SOFCs and SOECs. We formulate the materials problem in terms of interface observables including oxygen-vacancy formation energies, vacancy migration barriers, and electronic conductivity. We describe how these observables can be obtained using a diagrammatic GW-based embedding, either GW+DMFT or self-energy embedding theory (SEET), applied to a DFT-screened shortlist. The atomistic electrode/electrolyte interface defines the electronic structure problem from which the correlated impurity models are constructed. Quantum impurity solvers would provide the finite-temperature impurity Green's functions required by the embedding. The computational challenges that classical solvers may encounter as the interacting active space grows, together with the polynomial scaling of quantum Hamiltonian simulation for efficiently represented discretized models, open an opportunity for quantum advantage. We identify the benchmarks needed to assess this opportunity through convergence of vacancy and migration energetics and comparison with the best applicable classical solvers. We provide illustrative logical qubit counts and identify the thermal state preparation, simulation, measurement, and repeated-solve costs needed for a complete resource assessment. We connect microscopic observables to macroscopic engineering metrics using a continuum model for mixed ionic--electronic conducting oxygen electrodes that couples oxygen surface exchange, solid-state oxygen transport, electrode microstructure, and finite electrode thickness. Finally, we estimate the potential worldwide business value of improved electrode materials under SOFC and SOEC deployment scenarios informed by public technical targets and electrolyser deployment data.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个端到端框架，用于评估工业材料科学中的量子计算应用：筛选用于 SOFC 和 SOEC 的强相关氧电极材料。我们根据界面可观测量来制定材料问题，包括氧空位形成能、空位迁移势垒和电子电导率。我们描述了如何使用基于图解 GW 的嵌入（GW+DMFT 或自能嵌入理论 (SEET)）来获得这些可观测值，并将其应用于 DFT 筛选的候选列表。原子电极/电解质界面定义了构建相关杂质模型的电子结构问题。量子杂质求解器将提供嵌入所需的有限温度杂质格林函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一个端到端框架，用于评估工业材料科学中的量子计算应用：筛选用于 SOFC 和 SOEC 的强相关氧电极材料。我们根据界面可观测量来制定材料问题，包括氧空位形成能、空位迁移势垒和电子电导率。我们描述了如何使用基于图解 GW 的嵌入（GW+DMFT 或自能嵌入理论 (SEET)）来获得这些可观测值，并将其应用于 DFT 筛选的候选列表。原子电极/电解质界面定义了构建相关杂质模型的电子结构问题。量子杂质求解器将提供嵌入所需的有限温度杂质格林函数。随着相互作用的活动空间的增长，经典求解器可能遇到的计算挑战，以及有效表示离散模型的量子哈密顿模拟的多项式缩放，为量子优势提供了机会。我们通过空缺和迁移能量学的融合以及与最适用的经典求解器的比较来确定评估这一机会所需的基准。我们提供说明性逻辑量子位计数，并确定完整资源评估所需的热态准备、模拟、测量和重复求解成本。我们使用混合离子-电子传导氧电极的连续体模型将微观可观测值与宏观工程指标联系起来，该模型耦合了氧表面交换、固态氧传输、电极微观结构和有限电极厚度。最后，我们根据公共技术目标和电解槽部署数据估计了 SOFC 和 SOEC 部署场景下改进电极材料的潜在全球商业价值。

articles.title: Onsager Algebras and Lattice Fermions
articles.title_zh: Onsager 代数和格子费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31653v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the exact Onsager algebra of free lattice fermions in staggered, Wilson, and overlap incarnations, working in both Hamiltonian and Euclidean formulations in four spacetime dimensions. In each case, we show that the exact lattice algebra emanates the full chiral symmetry of the low-energy theory: if there are N massless Dirac fermions in the continuum, the Onsager algebra reduces to a U(2N) chiral symmetry. The details of which generators are quantised or ultra-local differ between formulations. There is also a trade-off between the locality of generators and the maximum compact subgroup of the Onsager algebra.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究交错、威尔逊和重叠形式的自由晶格费米子的精确 Onsager 代数，在四个时空维度上使用哈密顿和欧几里得公式。在每种情况下，我们都证明了精确的晶格代数体现了低能理论的完整手性对称性：如果连续体中有 N 个无质量狄拉克费米子，则 Onsager 代数可简化为 U(2N) 手性对称性。哪些生成器是量化的或超局部的，其细节在不同的公式中是不同的。生成元的局域性和 Onsager 代数的最大紧子群之间也存在权衡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究交错、威尔逊和重叠形式的自由晶格费米子的精确 Onsager 代数，在四个时空维度上使用哈密顿和欧几里得公式。在每种情况下，我们都证明了精确的晶格代数体现了低能理论的完整手性对称性：如果连续体中有 N 个无质量狄拉克费米子，则 Onsager 代数可简化为 U(2N) 手性对称性。哪些生成器是量化的或超局部的，其细节在不同的公式中是不同的。生成元的局域性和 Onsager 代数的最大紧子群之间也存在权衡。

articles.title: Exact few-magnon Bethe scars of the non-integrable alternating Heisenberg chain
articles.title_zh: 不可积交替海森堡链的精确少磁振子贝特疤痕
articles.abstract: arXiv:2501.14017v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Exact solutions of quantum lattice models serve as useful guides for interpreting physical phenomena in condensed matter systems. Prominent examples of integrability appear in one dimension, including the Heisenberg chain, where the Bethe ansatz method has been widely successful. Recent work has noted that certain non-integrable models harbor quantum many-body scar states, which form a superspin of regular states hidden in an otherwise chaotic spectrum. Here we consider one of the simplest examples of a non-integrable model, the alternating ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic (bond-staggered) Heisenberg chain, a close cousin of the spin-1 Haldane chain and a spin analog of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, and show the presence of exponentially many zero-energy states. We highlight features of the alternating chain that allow treatment with the coordinate Bethe ansatz (with important modifications), and surprisingly, for a non-integrable system, we find simple compact expressions for zero-energy eigenfunctions for a few magnons, including solutions with fractionalized particle momentum. These states exhibit wavefunction scarring similar to that of single-particle states in chaotic billiards. We discuss a general numerical recipe to diagnose the existence of such generalized Bethe ansatz (GBA) scar states and also provide exact analytic expressions for their entanglement. We conclude by conjecturing a picture of magnon pairing which may generalize to multiple magnons. Our work opens the avenue to describe certain eigenstates of partially integrable systems using the GBA.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子晶格模型的精确解可以为解释凝聚态物质系统中的物理现象提供有用的指导。可积性的突出例子出现在一维，包括海森堡链，其中 Bethe ansatz 方法取得了广泛的成功。最近的研究指出，某些不可积模型具有量子多体疤痕态，这些态形成隐藏在混沌光谱中的规则态的超自旋。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子晶格模型的精确解可以为解释凝聚态物质系统中的物理现象提供有用的指导。可积性的突出例子出现在一维，包括海森堡链，其中 Bethe ansatz 方法取得了广泛的成功。最近的研究指出，某些不可积模型具有量子多体疤痕态，这些态形成隐藏在混沌光谱中的规则态的超自旋。在这里，我们考虑不可积模型最简单的例子之一，即交替的铁磁-反铁磁（键交错）海森堡链，它是自旋 1 Haldane 链的近亲，也是 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型的自旋类似物，并显示了指数级许多零能态的存在。我们强调了交替链的特征，这些特征允许用坐标 Bethe ansatz 进行处理（经过重要修改），令人惊讶的是，对于不可积系统，我们找到了一些磁振子的零能量本征函数的简单紧凑表达式，包括具有分数化粒子动量的解。这些状态表现出与混沌台球中的单粒子状态相似的波函数疤痕。我们讨论了诊断此类广义 Bethe ansatz (GBA) 疤痕态是否存在的通用数值方法，并为其纠缠提供了精确的分析表达式。我们通过推测磁振子配对图来得出结论，该图可以推广到多个磁振子。我们的工作为使用 GBA 描述部分可积系统的某些本征态开辟了道路。

articles.title: Antiferromagnetic resonance in α-MnTe
articles.title_zh: α-MnTe 中的反铁磁共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.18933v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiferromagnetic resonance in a bulk α-MnTe crystal is investigated using both frequency-domain and time-domain THz spectroscopy techniques. At low temperatures, an excitation at the photon energy of (3.5± 0.1)~meV is observed and identified as a magnon mode through its distinctive dependence on temperature and magnetic field. This behavior is reproduced using a simplified model for antiferromagnetic resonance in an easy-plane antiferromagnet. The results of our experiments, when compared to exchange constants established in the literature, allow us to extract the out-of-plane component of the single-ion magnetic anisotropy reaching (40±10)~μeV.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用频域和时域太赫兹光谱技术研究了块体 α-MnTe 晶体中的反铁磁共振。在低温下，观察到光子能量为(3.5±0.1)~meV的激发，并通过其对温度和磁场的独特依赖性将其识别为磁振子模式。使用易平面反铁磁体中的反铁磁共振的简化模型再现了这种行为。我们的实验结果与文献中建立的交换常数相比，使我们能够提取出单离子磁各向异性的面外分量达到（40±10）~μeV。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用频域和时域太赫兹光谱技术研究了块体 α-MnTe 晶体中的反铁磁共振。在低温下，观察到光子能量为(3.5±0.1)~meV的激发，并通过其对温度和磁场的独特依赖性将其识别为磁振子模式。使用易平面反铁磁体中的反铁磁共振的简化模型再现了这种行为。我们的实验结果与文献中建立的交换常数相比，使我们能够提取出单离子磁各向异性的面外分量达到（40±10）~μeV。

articles.title: Quantum geometry and quantum capacitance in the orbital magneto-electric effect
articles.title_zh: 轨道磁电效应中的量子几何和量子电容
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.02911v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The orbital magneto-electric effect (OME), the generation of a steady-state orbital angular momentum (OAM) density by an electric field, is a central component of orbitronics. Nevertheless its microscopic interpretation is complicated by the existence of two qualitatively different contributions: the intra-band Edelstein term stemming from the combined effect of the equilibrium OAM and Fermi surface shift, and the inter-band contribution, stemming from Zitterbewegung induced by the electric field. Here we develop a pedagogical density-matrix formulation of the OME within the framework of the modern theory of Bloch-electron OAM, in which the two contributions naturally emerge from distinct parts of the density matrix, and their distinct quantum geometric structures are clearly seen. In the inter-band contribution, in addition to the local- and itinerant-circulation terms, we show that a band-diagonal displacement, or charge dipole, is present, which is linear in the electric field and governed by the normalized quantum metric. For a tilted massive Dirac cone the Zitterbewegung OME and the Fermi-surface orbital response occur for orthogonal electric-field orientations, providing a route to separate them experimentally. The itinerant-circulation contribution is identical to the dipolar one, so in a two-band model the dipole accounts for exactly half of the inter-band response, both in the doped regime and in the insulating gap. Our recent insights identify quantum-metric engineering as a route for enhancing orbital magneto-electric responses and clarify the relation between modern orbital magnetization, polarization, and orbital torque phenomenology.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道磁电效应（OME），即通过电场产生稳态轨道角动量（OAM）密度，是轨道电子学的核心组成部分。然而，它的微观解释由于存在两种性质不同的贡献而变得复杂：带内埃德尔斯坦项源于平衡OAM和费米表面位移的综合效应，以及带间贡献源于电场引起的Zitterbewegung。在这里，我们在布洛赫电子 OAM 的现代理论框架内开发了 OME 的教学密度矩阵公式，其中两个贡献自然地从密度矩阵的不同部分中出现，并且可以清楚地看到它们不同的量子几何结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轨道磁电效应（OME），即通过电场产生稳态轨道角动量（OAM）密度，是轨道电子学的核心组成部分。然而，它的微观解释由于存在两种性质不同的贡献而变得复杂：带内埃德尔斯坦项源于平衡OAM和费米表面位移的综合效应，以及带间贡献源于电场引起的Zitterbewegung。在这里，我们在布洛赫电子 OAM 的现代理论框架内开发了 OME 的教学密度矩阵公式，其中两个贡献自然地从密度矩阵的不同部分中出现，并且可以清楚地看到它们不同的量子几何结构。在带间贡献中，除了局域环流项和巡回环流项之外，我们还表明存在带对角线位移或电荷偶极子，它在电场中是线性的，并由归一化量子度量控制。对于倾斜的大狄拉克锥体，Zitterbewegung OME 和费米表面轨道响应会在正交电场方向上发生，从而提供了在实验上分离它们的途径。巡回循环的贡献与偶极子的贡献相同，因此在双带模型中，偶极子恰好占带间响应的一半，无论是在掺杂状态还是在绝缘间隙中。我们最近的见解将量子计量工程确定为增强轨道磁电响应的途径，并阐明现代轨道磁化、极化和轨道扭矩现象学之间的关系。

articles.title: Spin-resolved microscopy of ⁸⁷Sr SU(N) Fermi-Hubbard systems
articles.title_zh: ⁸⁷Sr SU(N) 费米-哈伯德系统的自旋分辨显微镜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05478v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum-gas microscopes provide direct access to the phases of the Hubbard model, bringing microscopic insight into the complex competition between interactions, SU(2) magnetism, and doping. Alkaline-earth(-like) fermions extend this spin-1/2 paradigm by realizing higher symmetries and giving access to SU(N) Hubbard models, with rich phase diagrams to be unveiled. Despite its fundamental interest, a microscopic exploration of SU(N) quantum systems has remained elusive. Here we report the realization of a quantum-gas microscope for fermionic ⁸⁷Sr. Our imaging scheme, based on cooling and fluorescence on the narrow intercombination line at 689 nm, enables spin-resolved single-atom detection. By implementing a spin-selective optical pumping protocol, we determine the occupation of each of the 10 spin states in a single experimental realization, a crucial capability for probing site-resolved magnetic correlations. We benchmark our method by observing single-particle Larmor precession across the full spin-9/2 ground-state manifold and use numerical simulations of SU(N) Fermi-Hubbard chains, incorporating the measured detection fidelities, to demonstrate its capability to resolve many-body spin correlations. Our results establish ⁸⁷Sr quantum-gas microscopy as a powerful approach to study exotic magnetism in the SU(N) Fermi-Hubbard model, and provide a new detection tool for studies in quantum simulation, computation, and metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子气体显微镜可以直接观察哈伯德模型的相，从微观角度洞察相互作用、SU(2) 磁性和掺杂之间的复杂竞争。碱土（类）费米子通过实现更高的对称性并提供 SU(N) Hubbard 模型来扩展这种自旋 1/2 范式，并提供丰富的相图。尽管SU(N)量子系统具有根本性的意义，但其微观探索仍然难以实现。在这里，我们报告了费米子 ⁸⁷Sr 量子气体显微镜的实现。我们的成像方案基于 689 nm 窄组合线上的冷却和荧光，可实现自旋分辨单原子检测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子气体显微镜可以直接观察哈伯德模型的相，从微观角度洞察相互作用、SU(2) 磁性和掺杂之间的复杂竞争。碱土（类）费米子通过实现更高的对称性并提供 SU(N) Hubbard 模型来扩展这种自旋 1/2 范式，并提供丰富的相图。尽管SU(N)量子系统具有根本性的意义，但其微观探索仍然难以实现。在这里，我们报告了费米子 ⁸⁷Sr 量子气体显微镜的实现。我们的成像方案基于 689 nm 窄组合线上的冷却和荧光，可实现自旋分辨单原子检测。通过实施自旋选择性光泵浦协议，我们确定了单个实验实现中 10 个自旋态中每一个的占据情况，这是探测位点分辨磁关联的关键能力。我们通过观察整个自旋 9/2 基态流形上的单粒子拉莫尔进动来对我们的方法进行基准测试，并使用 SU(N) 费米-哈伯德链的数值模拟，结合测量的检测保真度，来证明其解决多体自旋相关性的能力。我们的研究结果确立了 ⁸⁷Sr 量子气体显微镜作为研究 SU(N) 费米-哈伯德模型中的奇异磁性的强大方法，并为量子模拟、计算和计量学研究提供了一种新的检测工具。

articles.title: Dipole-exchange spin waves and mode hybridization in magnetic nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 磁性纳米粒子中的偶极子交换自旋波和模式杂交
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.24187v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate spin-wave modes in confined ferromagnetic resonators with spherical and cylindrical geometries across the exchange-dominated, dipole-exchange, and dipolar interaction regimes. Starting from the linearized Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, we show that the projection of the total angular momentum and mirror parity are conserved quantities in the problem of axially symmetric resonators. These symmetries provide a natural classification of spin-wave modes and explain the degeneracy of exchange modes, as well as its lifting by dipolar interactions. Numerical analysis shows that the nonlocal dipolar interaction removes the exchange degeneracy and hybridizes modes, leading to avoided crossings between modes that belong to the same symmetry sector. To describe this behavior, we develop a coupled-mode theory formulated directly in terms of dynamical magnetization, which reduces the dipole-exchange problem to a finite system of interacting modes. The resulting framework provides a unified description of spin-wave spectra in confined magnetic particles from the exchange limit to the dipolar regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了交换主导、偶极交换和偶极相互作用状态下具有球形和圆柱形几何形状的受限铁磁谐振器中的自旋波模式。从线性化的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程出发，我们证明总角动量的投影和镜宇称在轴对称谐振器问题中是守恒量。这些对称性提供了自旋波模式的自然分类，并解释了交换模式的简并性及其通过偶极相互作用的提升。数值分析表明，非局域偶极相互作用消除了交换简并并使模式混合，从而避免了属于同一对称扇区的模式之间的交叉。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了交换主导、偶极交换和偶极相互作用状态下具有球形和圆柱形几何形状的受限铁磁谐振器中的自旋波模式。从线性化的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程出发，我们证明总角动量的投影和镜宇称在轴对称谐振器问题中是守恒量。这些对称性提供了自旋波模式的自然分类，并解释了交换模式的简并性及其通过偶极相互作用的提升。数值分析表明，非局域偶极相互作用消除了交换简并并使模式混合，从而避免了属于同一对称扇区的模式之间的交叉。为了描述这种行为，我们开发了一种直接根据动态磁化强度表述的耦合模式理论，该理论将偶极子交换问题简化为相互作用模式的有限系统。由此产生的框架提供了从交换极限到偶极状态的受限磁性粒子中自旋波谱的统一描述。

articles.title: Benchmarking the accuracy of superconducting pair-pair correlations within Constrained Path Quantum Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 在约束路径量子蒙特卡罗中对超导对对相关性的准确性进行基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.25858v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ground state properties of the Hubbard model are of fundamental importance to understand the mechanism of unconventional superconductivity in the high-T_c cuprates and other materials. One of the most powerful numerical methods for strongly interacting models is quantum Monte Carlo, which however faces a fundamental limitation, the Fermion sign problem. The sign problem can be mitigated using approximate methods such as Constrained Path Monte Carlo, where the sign of the overlap with a trial wavefunction is constrained to remain positive. Beyond the constraint, additional approximations must be made in order to measure observables for operators that do not commute with the Hamiltonian. We examine critically the most commonly used approximation, back propagation, as well as a recently proposed constraint release measurement technique. In comparisons with a variety of systems that can be solved numerically exactly by other methods, we find that back propagation tends to underestimate long-range superconducting pair-pair correlations. Except in special cases such as one dimension, back propagation introduces an uncontrolled approximation even when the exact trial wavefunction is used. The constraint release technique can provide accurate results, with the disadvantages that it much more computationally expensive and reintroduces the sign problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 哈伯德模型的基态特性对于理解高温铜酸盐和其他材料的非常规超导机制至关重要。强相互作用模型最强大的数值方法之一是量子蒙特卡罗，但它面临着一个基本限制，即费米子符号问题。可以使用约束路径蒙特卡罗等近似方法来缓解符号问题，其中与试验波函数重叠的符号被限制为保持正值。除了约束之外，必须进行额外的近似，以便测量不与哈密顿量交换的算子的可观测量值。我们批判性地研究了最常用的近似、反向传播以及最近提出的约束释放测量技术。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 哈伯德模型的基态特性对于理解高温铜酸盐和其他材料的非常规超导机制至关重要。强相互作用模型最强大的数值方法之一是量子蒙特卡罗，但它面临着一个基本限制，即费米子符号问题。可以使用约束路径蒙特卡罗等近似方法来缓解符号问题，其中与试验波函数重叠的符号被限制为保持正值。除了约束之外，必须进行额外的近似，以便测量不与哈密顿量交换的算子的可观测量值。我们批判性地研究了最常用的近似、反向传播以及最近提出的约束释放测量技术。与可以通过其他方法精确数值求解的各种系统相比，我们发现反向传播往往会低估长程超导对对相关性。除了一维等特殊情况外，即使使用精确的试验波函数，反向传播也会引入不受控制的近似。约束释放技术可以提供准确的结果，但缺点是计算成本更高并且重新引入符号问题。

articles.title: Ligand-mediated Origin of Altermagnetic Spin-Splitting
articles.title_zh: 配体介导的交变磁自旋分裂的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.21284v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets host spin-split electronic bands despite zero net magnetization, opening new routes for spintronics beyond conventional ferromagnets. Going beyond symmetry-based classifications, which specify allowed terms but not their hierarchy, here we use first-principles calculations and Wannier Hamiltonian engineering to uncover the microscopic bonding contributions of altermagnetic spin splitting in the g-wave altermagnet Co₁/₄NbSe₂. We show that the splitting is captured by a short-range tight-binding model, establishing its local origin. By selectively controlling hopping channels, we demonstrate that the dominant contribution arises not from direct magnetic-ion hopping, but from ligand-mediated hybridization that transfers anisotropy to itinerant states. This identifies ligand-assisted coupling as the key mechanism of altermagnetic spin splitting and provides a microscopic bridge between minimal models and symmetry guided first-principles material searches, enabling real-space design of altermagnetic functionality.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管净磁化强度为零，但交替磁体仍具有自旋分裂电子能带，这为自旋电子学开辟了超越传统铁磁体的新途径。超越基于对称的分类（指定允许的术语但不指定其层次结构），这里我们使用第一原理计算和 Wannier Hamiltonian 工程来揭示 g 波交变磁体 Co₁/₄NbSe2 中交变磁自旋分裂的微观键合贡献。我们表明，分裂是由短程紧束缚模型捕获的，建立了其局部起源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管净磁化强度为零，但交替磁体仍具有自旋分裂电子能带，这为自旋电子学开辟了超越传统铁磁体的新途径。超越基于对称的分类（指定允许的术语但不指定其层次结构），这里我们使用第一原理计算和 Wannier Hamiltonian 工程来揭示 g 波交变磁体 Co₁/₄NbSe2 中交变磁自旋分裂的微观键合贡献。我们表明，分裂是由短程紧束缚模型捕获的，建立了其局部起源。通过选择性控制跳跃通道，我们证明主要贡献不是来自直接磁离子跳跃，而是来自配体介导的杂交，该杂交将各向异性转移到流动状态。这将配体辅助耦合确定为交变磁自旋分裂的关键机制，并在最小模型和对称引导第一原理材料搜索之间提供了微观桥梁，从而实现了交变磁功能的实空间设计。

articles.title: Microscopic theory of the lower critical field in superconducting thin-film strips
articles.title_zh: 超导薄膜带下临界场的微观理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05890v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The lower critical field Bc₁ of a narrow superconducting thin-film strip sets the thermodynamic scale for vortex-free operation in a perpendicular magnetic field. The standard Pearl--London estimate requires a phenomenological vortex-core cutoff, because the London theory does not resolve the core. We formulate a microscopic theory for a dirty strip by solving the two-dimensional Usadel equations in the film plane, with the applied field included directly in the gauge-invariant momentum. Self-consistent vortex and Meissner solutions are computed at fixed field, and Bc₁ is obtained from their Gibbs-energy difference. The calculation resolves the vortex core and its finite-width deformation without introducing a cutoff. The resulting vortex self-energy is larger than the naive Pearl--London estimate and cannot, in general, be represented by a London logarithm with a single width-independent cutoff. The formulation applies at any T
articles.abstract_zh: 窄超导薄膜带的较低临界场 Bc1 设定了垂直磁场中无涡流运行的热力学尺度。标准的珍珠伦敦估计需要唯象涡核截止，因为伦敦理论没有解决核心问题。我们通过求解薄膜平面中的二维 Usadel 方程，制定了脏带的微观理论，所施加的场直接包含在规范不变动量中。自洽涡旋和迈斯纳解是在固定场上计算的，Bc₁是从它们的吉布斯能量差中获得的。该计算在不引入截止的情况下解决了涡核及其有限宽度变形。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 窄超导薄膜带的较低临界场 Bc1 设定了垂直磁场中无涡流运行的热力学尺度。标准的珍珠伦敦估计需要唯象涡核截止，因为伦敦理论没有解决核心问题。我们通过求解薄膜平面中的二维 Usadel 方程，制定了脏带的微观理论，所施加的场直接包含在规范不变动量中。自洽涡旋和迈斯纳解是在固定场上计算的，Bc₁是从它们的吉布斯能量差中获得的。该计算在不引入截止的情况下解决了涡核及其有限宽度变形。由此产生的涡旋自能大于朴素的 Pearl-London 估计值，并且通常不能用具有单一宽度无关截止值的伦敦对数来表示。该公式适用于任何 T

articles.title: Lattice dynamics and structural correlations in antiferromagnet SrLaCoNbO₆ double perovskite
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁体 SrLaCoNbO₆ 双钙钛矿的晶格动力学和结构相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07630v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a detailed temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy and Co K-edge extended x-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) study of the insulating antiferromagnetic double perovskite SrLaCoNbO₆. Interestingly, pronounced changes in the phonon frequencies, linewidths, and intensities are observed around 60~K, well above the long-range antiferromagnetic ordering temperature, Tᵣₘ N approx 15~K. These anomalies indicate a modification of the lattice dynamics that may involve local structural distortions, short-range magnetic correlations, or an interplay between them. Additional changes in both high- and low-energy Raman modes are detected near 160--180~K via variations in phonon intensities and linewidths, together with changes in the Fano asymmetry of selected low-energy modes. The asymmetric line shapes of these modes are well described phenomenologically by Fano profiles and indicate coupling of the discrete phonons to an underlying continuum, whose possible microscopic origins are discussed. Moreover, the EXAFS analysis reveals correlated changes in bond distances and Debye--Waller factors around the Co ions near 60~K and 160~K, indicating subtle local structural distortions at temperatures corresponding to the Raman anomalies. The combined Raman and EXAFS results therefore demonstrate a close correlation between anomalous lattice dynamics and local structural evolution in SrLaCoNbO₆.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了绝缘反铁磁双钙钛矿 SrLaCoNbO₆ 的详细温度依赖性拉曼光谱和 Co K 边扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 研究。有趣的是，在 60~K 左右观察到声子频率、线宽和强度的显着变化，远高于长程反铁磁有序温度 Tᵣₘ N 约 15~K。这些异常表明晶格动力学发生了变化，可能涉及局部结构畸变、短程磁关联或它们之间的相互作用。通过声子强度和线宽的变化，以及所选低能模式的法诺不对称性的变化，在 160--180~K 附近检测到高能和低能拉曼模式的额外变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了绝缘反铁磁双钙钛矿 SrLaCoNbO₆ 的详细温度依赖性拉曼光谱和 Co K 边扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 研究。有趣的是，在 60~K 左右观察到声子频率、线宽和强度的显着变化，远高于长程反铁磁有序温度 Tᵣₘ N 约 15~K。这些异常表明晶格动力学发生了变化，可能涉及局部结构畸变、短程磁关联或它们之间的相互作用。通过声子强度和线宽的变化，以及所选低能模式的法诺不对称性的变化，在 160--180~K 附近检测到高能和低能拉曼模式的额外变化。 Fano 轮廓在现象学上很好地描述了这些模式的不对称线形状，并表明离散声子与底层连续体的耦合，并讨论了其可能的微观起源。此外，EXAFS 分析揭示了在 60~K 和 160~K 附近 Co 离子周围键距和 Debye-Waller 因子的相关变化，表明在与拉曼异常相对应的温度下存在微妙的局部结构扭曲。因此，拉曼和 EXAFS 的组合结果证明了 SrLaCoNbO₆ 中的反常晶格动力学与局部结构演化之间存在密切相关性。

articles.title: Dynamical Nonrelativistic Spin Splitting via THz Nonlinear Phononics
articles.title_zh: 通过太赫兹非线性声学实现动态非相对论自旋分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10091v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) in collinear antiferromagnets, including altermagnets and compensated ferrimagnets, offers a route to high-frequency spintronics immune to stray fields, but its dynamic control has remained elusive. We demonstrate, using density functional theory (DFT) and nonlinear phononics, that THz laser pulses can achieve ultrafast, reversible control of NRSS on picosecond timescales in antiferromagnets. We derive two mode-selection criteria, accounting for phonon and magnetic wavevector compatibility and inversion parity, to identify which phonon modes can activate NRSS. Our calculations illustrate the creation of NRSS in spin-degenerate NiO and the enhancement of existing splitting in LaFeO₃. While practical implementation depends on excitation conditions, lattice dynamics, and mode coupling, these results establish design principles for identifying materials with stronger and more accessible responses. Limitations imposed by driving fields, phonon damping, and anharmonic detuning motivate further materials screening based on accessible excitation strengths, lattice stability, resonance frequency matching, and favorable anharmonic coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 共线反铁磁体（包括交替磁体和补偿亚铁磁体）中的非相对论自旋分裂（NRSS）为不受杂散场影响的高频自旋电子学提供了一条途径，但其动态控制仍然难以捉摸。我们利用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 和非线性声学证明，太赫兹激光脉冲可以在反铁磁体中的皮秒时间尺度上实现 NRSS 的超快、可逆控制。我们推导出两个模式选择标准，考虑声子和磁波矢量兼容性以及反演奇偶性，以确定哪些声子模式可以激活 NRSS。我们的计算说明了自旋简并 NiO 中 NRSS 的产生以及 LaFeO₃ 中现有分裂的增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 共线反铁磁体（包括交替磁体和补偿亚铁磁体）中的非相对论自旋分裂（NRSS）为不受杂散场影响的高频自旋电子学提供了一条途径，但其动态控制仍然难以捉摸。我们利用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 和非线性声学证明，太赫兹激光脉冲可以在反铁磁体中的皮秒时间尺度上实现 NRSS 的超快、可逆控制。我们推导出两个模式选择标准，考虑声子和磁波矢量兼容性以及反演奇偶性，以确定哪些声子模式可以激活 NRSS。我们的计算说明了自旋简并 NiO 中 NRSS 的产生以及 LaFeO₃ 中现有分裂的增强。虽然实际实施取决于激发条件、晶格动力学和模式耦合，但这些结果确立了识别具有更强和更容易响应的材料的设计原则。驱动场、声子阻尼和非谐波失谐所施加的限制促使基于可获取的激励强度、晶格稳定性、共振频率匹配和有利的非谐波耦合进行进一步的材料筛选。

articles.title: Parity-driven RKKY decoupling and anomalous 1/R Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction in odd-parity magnets
articles.title_zh: 奇宇称磁体中宇称驱动的 RKKY 解耦和反常 1/R Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10757v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Unconventional odd-parity magnets, characterized by an odd-parity momentum-dependent spin splitting, offer a fundamentally distinct paradigm for non-collinear spintronics. Here, we theoretically investigate the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida indirect exchange in two-dimensional odd-parity magnets subjected to Rashba spin-orbit coupling. Using an analytical real-space Green's function formalism, we uncover a parity-driven spatial decoupling in the magnetic response. Because of the odd-parity exchange field, the out-of-plane Ising interaction is structurally insulated from the macroscopic magnetic modulation, oscillating isotropically at the shifted Fermi wavevector. Conversely, the in-plane Heisenberg components exhibit pronounced, directionally tunable spatial beating. Beyond collinear exchange, the hybridized bands generate a highly tunable, three-component Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction alongside symmetric off-diagonal anisotropies. We reveal that the out-of-plane chiral twisting is driven by the massive, nonrelativistic momentum shift, while the in-plane chiral components are relativistic. Furthermore, the competition between the nodal geometry and the Rashba gap drives an anomalous, dimension-reducing crossover, in which the in-plane chiral components follow a 1D-like 1/R spatial decay along the nodal lines over an extended intermediate-distance window before ultimately recovering the conventional 2D 1/R² asymptote. We demonstrate that these findings hold universally across the odd-parity class by explicitly generalizing our framework to f-wave magnets. Finally, numerical tight-binding calculations verify the striking robustness of this parity-driven decoupling against both scalar and random magnetic exchange disorder. These findings establish odd-parity magnets as promising platforms for engineering robust, directionally tunable non-collinear spin textures.
articles.abstract_zh: 非常规奇宇称磁体的特点是奇宇称动量相关的自旋分裂，为非共线自旋电子学提供了一个根本不同的范例。在这里，我们从理论上研究了 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的二维奇宇称磁体中的 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida 间接交换。使用分析实空间格林函数形式，我们发现了磁响应中宇称驱动的空间解耦。由于奇宇称交换场，面外伊辛相互作用在结构上与宏观磁调制隔离，在移动的费米波矢量处各向同性振荡。相反，面内海森堡分量表现出明显的、方向可调的空间跳动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非常规奇宇称磁体的特点是奇宇称动量相关的自旋分裂，为非共线自旋电子学提供了一个根本不同的范例。在这里，我们从理论上研究了 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的二维奇宇称磁体中的 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida 间接交换。使用分析实空间格林函数形式，我们发现了磁响应中宇称驱动的空间解耦。由于奇宇称交换场，面外伊辛相互作用在结构上与宏观磁调制隔离，在移动的费米波矢量处各向同性振荡。相反，面内海森堡分量表现出明显的、方向可调的空间跳动。除了共线交换之外，杂化带还产生高度可调的三分量 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用以及对称的非对角各向异性。我们揭示了面外手性扭曲是由巨大的非相对论性动量变化驱动的，而面内手性成分是相对论性的。此外，节点几何结构和 Rashba 间隙之间的竞争驱动了一种异常的降维交叉，其中面内手征分量在扩展的中间距离窗口上沿着节点线遵循类似 1D 的 1/R 空间衰减，然后最终恢复传统的 2D 1/R² 渐近线。通过将我们的框架明确推广到 f 波磁体，我们证明这些发现在奇宇称类别中普遍成立。最后，数值紧束缚计算验证了这种奇偶驱动的解耦对于标量和随机磁交换无序的惊人鲁棒性。这些发现确立了奇宇称磁体作为工程稳健、定向可调非共线自旋纹理的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Selective strain tuning of nonequilibrium multiferroic dynamics in BiFeO_text3
articles.title_zh: BiFeO_text3 中非平衡多铁动力学的选择性应变调谐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29472v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum materials are characterized by intertwined orders, and a fundamental goal in condensed matter physics is to achieve their selective control in such a way that one order parameter can be tuned while leaving others largely unaffected. Although significant progress has been made in thermal equilibrium, realizing such control out of equilibrium remains highly challenging. Here we employed in-situ tensile strain to selectively manipulate the photoinduced lattice dynamics associated with ferroelectric and magnetic orders in multiferroic BiFeO₃. By applying MeV ultrafast electron diffraction to freestanding BiFeO₃ membranes under tunable strain, we showed that tensile strain markedly suppresses the ultrafast photoinduced reduction of the ferroelectric displacement. By contrast, the photoinduced dynamics of the antiferrodistortive rotation of the oxygen octahedra, which modulates the magnetic order, remains insensitive to strain. Not only do these findings reveal distinct microscopic pathways underlying nonequilibrium multiferroic dynamics, they also establish tunable strain as an effective route for engineering ultrafast phase control in correlated materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料的特点是相互交织的秩序，凝聚态物理的一个基本目标是实现其选择性控制，从而可以调整一个秩序参数，同时使其他秩序参数基本上不受影响。尽管在热平衡方面已经取得了重大进展，但实现这种不平衡控制仍然极具挑战性。在这里，我们采用原位拉伸应变来选择性地操纵与多铁性 BiFeO₃ 中的铁电和磁序相关的光致晶格动力学。通过在可调应变下对独立式 BiFeO₃ 膜应用 MeV 超快电子衍射，我们发现拉伸应变显着抑制了铁电位移的超快光致减少。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子材料的特点是相互交织的秩序，凝聚态物理的一个基本目标是实现其选择性控制，从而可以调整一个秩序参数，同时使其他秩序参数基本上不受影响。尽管在热平衡方面已经取得了重大进展，但实现这种不平衡控制仍然极具挑战性。在这里，我们采用原位拉伸应变来选择性地操纵与多铁性 BiFeO₃ 中的铁电和磁序相关的光致晶格动力学。通过在可调应变下对独立式 BiFeO₃ 膜应用 MeV 超快电子衍射，我们发现拉伸应变显着抑制了铁电位移的超快光致减少。相比之下，调节磁序的氧八面体反铁畸变旋转的光致动力学仍然对应变不敏感。这些发现不仅揭示了非平衡多铁动力学背后的独特微观途径，而且还确立了可调谐应变作为相关材料中工程超快相位控制的有效途径。

articles.title: What Becomes of the Antiferromagnetic String When Long Range Neel Order Is Lost? Exact Results
articles.title_zh: 当长程尼尔阶丢失时，反铁磁弦会发生什么？确切的结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30346v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Early string descriptions of doped antiferromagnets associate hole motion in a locally Néel-ordered background with a path-dependent antiferromagnetic string. We ask what becomes of this mechanism when long range Néel order is lost while short range antiferromagnetic correlations persist. In a singlet bond representation, the underlying basis states do not assign an oriented (A/B) spin registration to each bond. Therefore, any surviving long wavelength antiferromagnetic axis is naturally described as a director, (mathbf nsim-mathbf n). Long range Néel order can nevertheless provide a global (S²) lift of this director field; when that long range registration is lost, non liftable configurations of the (RP²) manifold become physically accessible, opening a topologically nontrivial (mathbb Z₂) sector. Its elementary defects are half vortices that globally minimize the (RP²) (σ)-model energy within the nontrivial (mathbb Z₂) sector. An a posteriori energetic comparison further shows that the projective half vortex texture is softer than the corresponding vector reference texture. A pair of half vortices with opposite windings is logarithmically confined, (V(R) = κ lnleft(R/rcₒᵣₑright)), (κ = π ρₛ /2). The resulting confinement is carried not by a one dimensional string but by an extended two-dimensional spin texture. Thus, the loss of long-range Néel order does not eliminate antiferromagnetic confinement but removes the global Néel lift. This activates a distinct projective mechanism in which a local path dependent string is replaced, at long wavelengths, by a global topological texture with logarithmic confinement.
articles.abstract_zh: 早期对掺杂反铁磁体的弦描述将局部尼尔有序背景中的空穴运动与路径相关的反铁磁弦联系起来。我们要问的是，当长程尼尔序丢失而短程反铁磁相关性仍然存在时，这种机制会发生什么。在单态键表示中，基础基态不会为每个键分配定向 (A/B) 自旋配准。因此，任何幸存的长波长反铁磁轴自然被描述为指向矢（mathbf nsim-mathbf n）。尽管如此，长程尼尔阶仍可以提供该导向场的全局（S²）提升；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 早期对掺杂反铁磁体的弦描述将局部尼尔有序背景中的空穴运动与路径相关的反铁磁弦联系起来。我们要问的是，当长程尼尔序丢失而短程反铁磁相关性仍然存在时，这种机制会发生什么。在单态键表示中，基础基态不会为每个键分配定向 (A/B) 自旋配准。因此，任何幸存的长波长反铁磁轴自然被描述为指向矢（mathbf nsim-mathbf n）。尽管如此，长程尼尔阶仍可以提供该导向场的全局（S²）提升；当远距离配准丢失时，(RP²) 流形的不可提升配置变得可以物理访问，从而打开一个拓扑上不平凡的 (mathbb Z2) 扇区。其基本缺陷是半涡流，可全局最小化非平凡 (mathbb Z2) 扇区内的 (RP²) (σ) 模型能量。后验能量比较进一步表明，投影半涡纹理比相应的矢量参考纹理更软。一对具有相反绕线的半涡旋受到对数限制，(V(R) = κ lnleft(R/rcₒᵣₑright))，(κ = π ρₛ /2)。由此产生的限制不是由一维弦来承载，而是由扩展的二维自旋纹理来承载。因此，长程尼尔阶的损失并没有消除反铁磁约束，而是消除了全局尼尔升力。这激活了一种独特的投影机制，其中局部路径依赖弦在长波长下被具有对数限制的全局拓扑纹理所取代。

articles.title: Perfect Born Sampling of Symmetric Thermal Tensor Network States
articles.title_zh: 对称热张量网络状态的完美出生采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.35754v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate calculations of correlated fermions at low temperatures constitute a major challenge in quantum many-body physics, most notably in the studies of high-T_c superconductivity and ultracold atom optical lattices. Stochastic sampling of tensor-network states offers a promising route to tackle this problem; however, existing schemes have long faced a fundamental dilemma---sampling efficiency and symmetry acceleration cannot be achieved simultaneously. Here we propose a perfect Born sampling approach for thermal tensor networks, which performs importance sampling directly from the purified density matrix via the Born rule and incorporates Abelian and non-Abelian symmetries by sampling symmetry quantum numbers. We benchmark the method, realized as both stochastic matrix product states (stoMPS) and stochastic projected entangled pair states (stoPEPS), on large-scale quantum lattice models. Using stoMPS, we accurately simulate the square-lattice Hubbard model on cylinders up to width W=10, and study the triangular-lattice Hubbard model down to T/t = 1/64. We reveal scalar chiral order at half filling and kinetic ferromagnetism upon electron doping, with the latter directly compared to ultracold atom experiments. We further extend the stoMPS method to compute finite-temperature quantum dynamics, as demonstrated by the optical conductivity of the Hubbard model. We showcase the generalization of stoPEPS on up to 20×20 square-lattice quantum Ising model, where accurate results are obtained near its quantum critical point. Our method combines high sampling efficiency with full symmetry acceleration. The resulting state-of-the-art framework captures both equilibrium and dynamical properties down to ultralow temperatures, thereby providing a powerful theoretical tool for correlated quantum systems, particularly fermion Hubbard quantum gas microscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 低温下相关费米子的精确计算是量子多体物理中的一个重大挑战，尤其是在高温超导和超冷原子光学晶格的研究中。张量网络状态的随机采样为解决这个问题提供了一条有希望的途径；然而，现有的方案长期以来面临着一个根本性的困境——采样效率和对称加速无法同时实现。在这里，我们提出了一种用于热张量网络的完美玻恩采样方法，该方法通过玻恩规则直接从纯化的密度矩阵进行重要性采样，并通过采样对称量子数来合并阿贝尔和非阿贝尔对称性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低温下相关费米子的精确计算是量子多体物理中的一个重大挑战，尤其是在高温超导和超冷原子光学晶格的研究中。张量网络状态的随机采样为解决这个问题提供了一条有希望的途径；然而，现有的方案长期以来面临着一个根本性的困境——采样效率和对称加速无法同时实现。在这里，我们提出了一种用于热张量网络的完美玻恩采样方法，该方法通过玻恩规则直接从纯化的密度矩阵进行重要性采样，并通过采样对称量子数来合并阿贝尔和非阿贝尔对称性。我们在大规模量子晶格模型上对该方法进行了基准测试，该方法以随机矩阵乘积态 (stoMPS) 和随机投影纠缠对态 (stoPEPS) 的形式实现。使用 stoMPS，我们准确地模拟了宽度 W=10 的圆柱体上的方晶格哈伯德模型，并研究了低至 T/t = 1/64 的三角晶格哈伯德模型。我们揭示了半填充时的标量手性顺序和电子掺杂时的动力学铁磁性，后者直接与超冷原子实验进行比较。我们进一步扩展 stoMPS 方法来计算有限温度量子动力学，正如哈伯德模型的光导率所证明的那样。我们展示了 stoPEPS 在高达 20×20 方格量子 Ising 模型上的推广，在其量子临界点附近获得了准确的结果。我们的方法将高采样效率与全对称加速相结合。由此产生的最先进的框架捕获了超低温的平衡和动力学特性，从而为相关量子系统，特别是费米子哈伯德量子气体显微镜提供了强大的理论工具。

articles.title: Quantum theory of molecular orientation
articles.title_zh: 分子取向的量子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2403.04572v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We formulate a quantum phase space for rotational and nuclear-spin states of rigid molecules. For each nuclear spin isomer, we re-derive the isomer's admissible angular momentum states from molecular geometry and nuclear-spin data, introduce its angular position states using quantization theory, and develop a generalized Fourier transform converting between the two. We classify molecules into three types -- asymmetric, rotationally symmetric, and perrotationally symmetric -- with the last type having no macroscopic analogue due to nuclear-spin statistics constraints. We discuss two general features in perrotationally symmetric state spaces that are Hamiltonian-independent and induced solely by symmetry and spin statistics. First, we quantify when and how an isomer's state space is completely rotation-spin entangled, meaning that it does not admit any separable states. Second, we identify isomers whose position states house an internal pseudo-spin or "fiber" degree of freedom, and the fiber's Berry phase or matrix after adiabatic changes in position yields naturally robust operations, akin to braiding anyonic quasiparticles or realizing fault-tolerant quantum gates. We outline how the fiber can be used as a quantum error-correcting code and discuss scenarios where these features can be experimentally probed
articles.abstract_zh: 我们为刚性分子的旋转和核自旋态制定了量子相空间。对于每种核自旋异构体，我们从分子几何和核自旋数据重新推导异构体的允许角动量状态，使用量子化理论引入其角位置状态，并开发两者之间的广义傅立叶变换。我们将分子分为三种类型——不对称、旋转对称和旋转对称——最后一种类型由于核自旋统计限制而没有宏观的类似物。我们讨论旋转对称状态空间中的两个一般特征，它们与哈密顿量无关，并且仅由对称性和自旋统计引起。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为刚性分子的旋转和核自旋态制定了量子相空间。对于每种核自旋异构体，我们从分子几何和核自旋数据重新推导异构体的允许角动量状态，使用量子化理论引入其角位置状态，并开发两者之间的广义傅立叶变换。我们将分子分为三种类型——不对称、旋转对称和旋转对称——最后一种类型由于核自旋统计限制而没有宏观的类似物。我们讨论旋转对称状态空间中的两个一般特征，它们与哈密顿量无关，并且仅由对称性和自旋统计引起。首先，我们量化异构体的状态空间何时以及如何完全旋转自旋纠缠，这意味着它不接受任何可分离的状态。其次，我们确定了其位置状态具有内部赝自旋或“纤维”自由度的异构体，并且纤维的贝里相或矩阵在位置绝热变化后产生自然鲁棒的操作，类似于编织任意子准粒子或实现容错量子门。我们概述了如何将光纤用作量子纠错码，并讨论可以通过实验探测这些特性的场景

articles.title: Examining the Anomalous Nature of Chiral Effects in Thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 检查热力学中手性效应的反常性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.02079v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum anomalies give rise to novel transport phenomena, including the generation of a current in a relativistic fluid due to the presence of magnetic field or vorticity. We present an exclusive and direct computation of the chiral anomaly in the adiabatic regime within the path integral for a massless fermion on a generic electromagnetic and curved background, including local temperature and chemical potential. We identify new quantum-thermodynamical contributions to the breaking of axial symmetry which induce the Chiral Separation and Vortical Effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子异常引起新的输运现象，包括由于磁场或涡旋的存在而在相对论性流体中产生电流。我们提出了在一般电磁和弯曲背景下，包括局部温度和化学势的无质量费米子路径积分内绝热状态中手性反常的独特且直接的计算。我们发现了新的量子热力学对轴对称性破缺的贡献，从而引发了手性分离和涡旋效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子异常引起新的输运现象，包括由于磁场或涡旋的存在而在相对论性流体中产生电流。我们提出了在一般电磁和弯曲背景下，包括局部温度和化学势的无质量费米子路径积分内绝热状态中手性反常的独特且直接的计算。我们发现了新的量子热力学对轴对称性破缺的贡献，从而引发了手性分离和涡旋效应。

articles.title: Meta-learning of Gibbs states for many-body Hamiltonians with applications to Quantum Boltzmann Machines
articles.title_zh: 多体哈密顿量的吉布斯态元学习及其在量子玻尔兹曼机中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.16373v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The preparation of quantum Gibbs states is a fundamental challenge in quantum computing, essential for applications ranging from modeling open quantum systems to quantum machine learning. Building on the Meta-Variational Quantum Eigensolver framework proposed by Cervera-Lierta et al. and a problem-driven ansatz design, we introduce two meta-learning algorithms: Meta-Variational Quantum Thermalizer (Meta-VQT) and Neural Network Meta-VQT (NN-Meta VQT) for efficient thermal state preparation of parametrized Hamiltonians on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. Meta-VQT utilizes a fully quantum ansatz, while NN Meta-VQT integrates a quantum--classical hybrid architecture. Both use collective optimization over a finite set of training parameter values to prepare approximate Gibbs states at held-out parameter values within the sampled parameter domain. We validate our methods on Transverse Field Ising Models (TFIM) with up to eight qubits and on a two-qubit Heisenberg model with all field terms. Within these finite-size benchmarks, the trained models accurately prepare thermal states at test points inside the training interval. For the six and eight qubit cases of TFIM, meta-learned parameters when combined with appropriately designed ansatz serve as warm-start initializations, significantly outperforming random initializations in the optimization tasks. Furthermore, a 3 qubit Kitaev ring example showcases our algorithm's effectiveness across finite-temperature crossover regimes. Finally, we apply our algorithms to train a Quantum Boltzmann Machine (QBM) on a 2-qubit Heisenberg model with all field terms, achieving enhanced training efficiency, improved Gibbs state accuracy, and a 30-fold runtime speedup over existing techniques such as variational quantum imaginary time (VarQITE)-based QBM highlighting the practicality of meta-algorithm-based QBMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子吉布斯态的制备是量子计算中的一个基本挑战，对于从建模开放量子系统到量子机器学习等应用至关重要。基于 Cervera-Lierta 等人提出的元变分量子本征求解器框架。和问题驱动的 ansatz 设计，我们引入了两种元学习算法：元变分量子热化器 (Meta-VQT) 和神经网络 Meta-VQT (NN-Meta VQT)，用于在嘈杂的中尺度量子 (NISQ) 设备上进行参数化哈密顿量的高效热状态准备。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子吉布斯态的制备是量子计算中的一个基本挑战，对于从建模开放量子系统到量子机器学习等应用至关重要。基于 Cervera-Lierta 等人提出的元变分量子本征求解器框架。和问题驱动的 ansatz 设计，我们引入了两种元学习算法：元变分量子热化器 (Meta-VQT) 和神经网络 Meta-VQT (NN-Meta VQT)，用于在嘈杂的中尺度量子 (NISQ) 设备上进行参数化哈密顿量的高效热状态准备。 Meta-VQT 采用完全量子模拟，而 NN Meta-VQT 则集成了量子-经典混合架构。两者都对一组有限的训练参数值使用集体优化，以在采样参数域内的保留参数值处准备近似吉布斯状态。我们在具有多达八个量子位的横向场伊辛模型（TFIM）和具有所有场项的两量子位海森堡模型上验证了我们的方法。在这些有限尺寸的基准中，经过训练的模型可以在训练间隔内的测试点准确地准备热状态。对于 TFIM 的 6 个和 8 个量子位情况，元学习参数与适当设计的 ansatz 相结合可用作热启动初始化，在优化任务中显着优于随机初始化。此外，3 量子位 Kitaev 环示例展示了我们的算法在有限温度交叉机制中的有效性。最后，我们应用我们的算法在具有所有场项的 2 量子位海森堡模型上训练量子玻尔兹曼机 (QBM)，与现有技术（例如基于变分量子虚数时间 (VarQITE) 的 QBM）相比，实现了更高的训练效率、更高的吉布斯状态精度和 30 倍的运行时间加速，凸显了基于元算法的 QBM 的实用性。

articles.title: Imaginary-time-enhanced feedback-based quantum algorithms for universal ground-state preparation
articles.title_zh: 用于通用基态制备的基于虚数时间增强反馈的量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.13044v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Preparing ground states of strongly correlated quantum systems is a central goal in quantum simulation and optimization. The feedback-based quantum algorithm (FALQON) provides an attractive alternative to variational methods with a fully quantum feedback rule, but it fails in the presence of spectral degeneracies, where the feedback signal collapses and the evolution cannot reach the ground state. Using the Fermi-Hubbard model on lattices up to 3x3, we show that this breakdown appears at half-filling on the 2x2 lattice and extends to both half-filled and doped configurations on the 3x3 lattice. We then introduce an imaginary-time-enhanced FALQON (iFALQON) scheme, which inserts short imaginary-time evolution steps into the feedback loop. This proposed method suppresses excited-state components, escapes degenerate subspaces, restores monotonic energy descent and improves ground-state convergence across the tested fillings. We further benchmark its performance against existing methods, showing improved results for iFALQON, demonstrating the potential of hybrid real-imaginary-time feedback dynamics for ground-state preparation in strongly correlated quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 准备强相关量子系统的基态是量子模拟和优化的中心目标。基于反馈的量子算法（FALQON）为具有完全量子反馈规则的变分方法提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案，但它在存在谱简并的情况下失败，在这种情况下，反馈信号崩溃并且演化无法达到基态。在高达 3x3 的晶格上使用 Fermi-Hubbard 模型，我们发现这种击穿出现在 2x2 晶格的半填充状态，并延伸到 3x3 晶格的半填充和掺杂配置。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准备强相关量子系统的基态是量子模拟和优化的中心目标。基于反馈的量子算法（FALQON）为具有完全量子反馈规则的变分方法提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案，但它在存在谱简并的情况下失败，在这种情况下，反馈信号崩溃并且演化无法达到基态。在高达 3x3 的晶格上使用 Fermi-Hubbard 模型，我们发现这种击穿出现在 2x2 晶格的半填充状态，并延伸到 3x3 晶格的半填充和掺杂配置。然后，我们引入了虚数时间增强型 FALQON (iFALQON) 方案，该方案将短虚数时间演化步骤插入到反馈循环中。该方法抑制激发态分量，逃避简并子空间，恢复单调能量下降并改善测试填充物的基态收敛。我们进一步根据现有方法对其性能进行基准测试，显示了 iFALQON 的改进结果，展示了混合实时虚时反馈动力学在强相关量子系统中基态制备中的潜力。

articles.title: Rigorous error bounds for dissipative thermal state preparation from weak system-bath coupling
articles.title_zh: 弱系统-浴耦合的耗散热态制备的严格误差范围
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.03011v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Thermal state preparation is a central challenge in the simulation of quantum many-body systems. Yet, provably efficient algorithms for this task were only introduced recently [Chen et al. Nature 646, 561 (2025)]. These algorithms are based on dissipative Lindbladian evolution which exactly fixes the thermal state. Controlled and efficient digital simulation of this evolution, although possible in principle, remains out of reach for present-day quantum hardware. Subsequent work has therefore focused on analog approximations of the proposed Lindbladians via `collision models' with relatively modest requirements -- a resettable bath of ancilla qubits whose couplings to the system can be tuned in time-dependent fashion -- while still admitting rigorous fixed-point error bounds. Existing rigorous approaches, however, do not exploit the fact that these constructions generically implement not only the desired Lindblad dynamics, but also an additional unitary evolution generated by the system Hamiltonian which may aid convergence to the thermal state [Lloyd and Abanin arXiv:2506.21318 (2025)]. Here, we show that this unitary contribution does indeed tighten the fixed-point error bound and demonstrate that it is rigorously controlled by the system-bath coupling strength J, scaling as J². This demonstrates that the effect of the spurious `Lamb shift' term generated by the system-bath interaction can be controlled by tuning J. We clarify the role, previously observed, of a randomized implementation in suppressing possible resonances of the drive with the many-body spectrum, and bound the additional variance that this randomization imposes on observables. Finally, we numerically study aspects of the protocol which are relevant for its practical realization, such as the mixing time.
articles.abstract_zh: 热态准备是量子多体系统模拟中的一个核心挑战。然而，针对此任务的可证明有效的算法最近才被引入[Chen 等人。自然 646, 561 (2025)]。这些算法基于耗散 Lindbladian 演化，它精确地固定了热状态。对这种演化的受控且高效的数字模拟虽然原则上是可能的，但对于当今的量子硬件来说仍然遥不可及。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热态准备是量子多体系统模拟中的一个核心挑战。然而，针对此任务的可证明有效的算法最近才被引入[Chen 等人。自然 646, 561 (2025)]。这些算法基于耗散 Lindbladian 演化，它精确地固定了热状态。对这种演化的受控且高效的数字模拟虽然原则上是可能的，但对于当今的量子硬件来说仍然遥不可及。因此，后续工作的重点是通过“碰撞模型”对所提出的 Lindbladians 进行模拟近似，其要求相对适中——可重置的辅助量子位元，其与系统的耦合可以以时间相关的方式进行调整——同时仍然承认严格的定点误差界限。然而，现有的严格方法并没有利用这样一个事实：这些结构通常不仅实现了所需的 Lindblad 动力学，而且还实现了由系统哈密顿量生成的额外酉演化，这可能有助于收敛到热状态 [Lloyd 和 Abanin arXiv:2506.21318 (2025)]。在这里，我们表明，这种单一贡献确实收紧了定点误差界限，并证明它受到系统浴耦合强度 J 的严格控制，缩放为 J²。这表明，系统-浴相互作用产生的虚假“兰姆位移”项的影响可以通过调整 J 来控制。我们阐明了先前观察到的随机实现在抑制驱动器与多体谱的可能共振方面的作用，并限制了这种随机化对可观察量施加的额外方差。最后，我们对协议中与其实际实现相关的方面进行了数值研究，例如混合时间。

articles.title: Chiral Transport in Metric-Affine Geometries
articles.title_zh: 公制仿射几何中的手性输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04841v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Anomalous transport in equilibrium fermionic fluids chirally coupled to background Weyl-type nonmetricity is studied. A formal descent analysis is carried out in which the dependence of the anomaly polynomial on the nonmetricity tensor is encoded in a Weyl invariant four-form. The constitutive relation of the axial-vector current is evaluated from the equilibrium partition function obtained using transgression techniques, showing the existence of nonmetricity-mediated chiral separation effects driven by the fluid's vorticity and the Weyl magnetic field. A second nonminimal coupling of fermionic matter to metric-affine geometries proposed in the literature is also discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究了与背景 Weyl 型非度量性手性耦合的平衡费米子流体中的反常输运。进行形式下降分析，其中异常多项式对非度量张量的依赖性被编码为 Weyl 不变四形式。根据海侵技术获得的平衡分配函数评估了轴矢量电流的本构关系，表明存在由流体涡度和外尔磁场驱动的非度量介导的手性分离效应。还讨论了文献中提出的费米子物质与度量仿射几何的第二个非最小耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究了与背景 Weyl 型非度量性手性耦合的平衡费米子流体中的反常输运。进行形式下降分析，其中异常多项式对非度量张量的依赖性被编码为 Weyl 不变四形式。根据海侵技术获得的平衡分配函数评估了轴矢量电流的本构关系，表明存在由流体涡度和外尔磁场驱动的非度量介导的手性分离效应。还讨论了文献中提出的费米子物质与度量仿射几何的第二个非最小耦合。

articles.title: Plasma transport by carrier electrons: classical coefficients across ionization and magnetization
articles.title_zh: 载流子电子的等离子体传输：电离和磁化的经典系数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The classical transport of magnetic field and electron energy in a plasma requires the use of coefficients that depend on plasma ionization Z and magnetization χ. This paper explains these scalings through studying the electron velocities responsible for each transport process. Both electron-electron collisions and magnetization affect higher velocity electron populations preferentially, lowering the carrier velocities; transport carried by a high energy electron population is therefore more suppressed by both electron-electron collisions and magnetization than transport carried by lower velocities. Carrier Hall parameters ψ=χ f(Z) are defined for each coefficient such that magnetization can be described independent of ionization. An analytic idealized coefficient with a single rigid carrier velocity reproduces many of the characteristics of the coefficients, in particular thermal conductivity, but overestimates plasma magnetization due to magnetization itself lowering the carrier velocity. A single moving carrier model improves agreement, but cannot describe the smoothness of the Righi-Leduc coefficient, which originates from being an average over a range of carrier velocities. This is the first paper in a 3-part series; the subsequent papers will extend the carrier picture to non-local heat-flux (paper 2) and non-local magnetic field evolution (paper 3).
articles.abstract_zh: 等离子体中磁场和电子能量的经典传输需要使用取决于等离子体电离 Z 和磁化 χ 的系数。本文通过研究负责每个传输过程的电子速度来解释这些比例。电子-电子碰撞和磁化都会优先影响速度较高的电子群，从而降低载流子速度；因此，高能电子群携带的传输比较低速度携带的传输更容易受到电子-电子碰撞和磁化的抑制。为每个系数定义载流子霍尔参数 ψ=χ f(Z)，以便可以独立于电离来描述磁化强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 等离子体中磁场和电子能量的经典传输需要使用取决于等离子体电离 Z 和磁化 χ 的系数。本文通过研究负责每个传输过程的电子速度来解释这些比例。电子-电子碰撞和磁化都会优先影响速度较高的电子群，从而降低载流子速度；因此，高能电子群携带的传输比较低速度携带的传输更容易受到电子-电子碰撞和磁化的抑制。为每个系数定义载流子霍尔参数 ψ=χ f(Z)，以便可以独立于电离来描述磁化强度。具有单个刚性载流子速度的解析理想化系数再现了系数的许多特征，特别是热导率，但由于磁化本身降低了载流子速度，所以高估了等离子体磁化强度。单个移动载流子模型提高了一致性，但无法描述 Righi-Leduc 系数的平滑度，该系数源于一系列载流子速度的平均值。这是由 3 部分组成的系列文章中的第一篇；后续论文将把载体图扩展到非局域热通量（论文 2）和非局域磁场演化（论文 3）。

articles.title: Evolution of Jeans instability in nonthermal magnetized complex plasmas
articles.title_zh: 非热磁化复杂等离子体中 Jeans 不稳定性的演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30332v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The classical Jeans instability framework provides a conceptual foundation for understanding self-gravitational collapse and subsequent star formation in interstellar environments. However, cosmic plasmas are inherently magnetized and frequently collisionless, exhibiting significant departures from local thermodynamic equilibrium. While linear theories predict initial instability thresholds, they fail to track the long-term nonlinear runaway dynamics. We present a fluid simulation investigating the nonlinear evolution of the Jeans instability in a magnetized tricomponent complex (dusty) plasma. The constituent nonthermal electrons and ions are governed by the κ-distribution law, while the heavier dust grains are treated in a fluid framework, coupled with a uniform ambient magnetic field. The numerical architecture utilizes a fourth-order finite difference method (FDM) for spatial gradients and a second-order leap-frog time-integration scheme. We systematically investigate the complex interplay among the self-gravitational attraction, nonthermal electrostatic screening, and magnetic pressure across a wide range of magnetic field strengths and degrees of nonthermality. It is found that enhanced nonthermality accelerates structural localization, while the magnetic field introduces a critical pressure barrier that suppresses the instability. In highly magnetized environments, thermal and nonthermal systems exhibit identical growth rate characteristics, indicating that magnetic pressure dominates the nonthermal thermostatistics in the strong magnetic regime. This study develops a comprehensive and numerically robust framework to understand early-stage star formation and evolution processes in nonthermal astrophysical media.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典的金斯不稳定性框架为理解星际环境中的自引力坍缩和随后的恒星形成提供了概念基础。然而，宇宙等离子体本质上是磁化的并且通常是无碰撞的，表现出与局部热力学平衡的显着偏离。虽然线性理论预测了初始不稳定阈值，但它们无法跟踪长期非线性失控动力学。我们提出了一种流体模拟，研究磁化三组分复杂（尘埃）等离子体中牛仔裤不稳定性的非线性演化。组成的非热电子和离子受 κ 分布定律控制，而较重的尘埃颗粒则在流体框架中进行处理，并加上均匀的环境磁场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典的金斯不稳定性框架为理解星际环境中的自引力坍缩和随后的恒星形成提供了概念基础。然而，宇宙等离子体本质上是磁化的并且通常是无碰撞的，表现出与局部热力学平衡的显着偏离。虽然线性理论预测了初始不稳定阈值，但它们无法跟踪长期非线性失控动力学。我们提出了一种流体模拟，研究磁化三组分复杂（尘埃）等离子体中牛仔裤不稳定性的非线性演化。组成的非热电子和离子受 κ 分布定律控制，而较重的尘埃颗粒则在流体框架中进行处理，并加上均匀的环境磁场。该数值架构采用四阶有限差分法 (FDM) 来计算空间梯度，并采用二阶蛙跳时间积分方案。我们系统地研究了自引力、非热静电屏蔽和磁压力在各种磁场强度和非热度范围内的复杂相互作用。研究发现，增强的非热性加速了结构局部化，而磁场引入了抑制不稳定性的临界压力屏障。在高度磁化的环境中，热系统和非热系统表现出相同的生长速率特征，表明磁压力在强磁区中主导非热恒温系统。这项研究开发了一个全面且数值稳健的框架，以了解非热天体物理介质中的早期恒星形成和演化过程。

articles.title: A novel mechanism for spontaneous ExB shear layer formation in scrape-off-layer plasmas
articles.title_zh: 刮掉层等离子体中自发 ExB 剪切层形成的新机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30343v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a novel mechanism for spontaneous shear-flow generation in the scrape-off layer (SOL) of magnetically confined plasmas, arising at abrupt changes in the sheath connection length L_parallel. Such transitions occur naturally in the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator. Applying a critical balance treatment for interchange turbulence, we find that L_parallel sets the equilibrium pressure gradient and hence the radial electric field away from the transition, producing an E× B shear around the transition comparable to the turbulence growth rate. High-fidelity simulations are shown to be consistent with the theoretical prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在磁约束等离子体的刮除层（SOL）中自发产生剪切流的新机制，该机制是在鞘层连接长度 L_parallel 突然变化时产生的。这种转变在 Wendelstein 7-X 仿星器中自然发生。对交换湍流应用临界平衡处理，我们发现 L_parallel 设置平衡压力梯度，从而设置远离转变的径向电场，在转变周围产生与湍流增长率相当的 E× B 剪切。高保真模拟显示与理论预测一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种在磁约束等离子体的刮除层（SOL）中自发产生剪切流的新机制，该机制是在鞘层连接长度 L_parallel 突然变化时产生的。这种转变在 Wendelstein 7-X 仿星器中自然发生。对交换湍流应用临界平衡处理，我们发现 L_parallel 设置平衡压力梯度，从而设置远离转变的径向电场，在转变周围产生与湍流增长率相当的 E× B 剪切。高保真模拟显示与理论预测一致。

articles.title: Concentration-Dependent Speciation in ZnCl2 Electrolyte Solutions: Transferability of Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials and Speciation Sensitivity of EXAFS
articles.title_zh: ZnCl2 电解质溶液中的浓度依赖性形态：机器学习原子间势的可转移性和 EXAFS 的形态敏感性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting speciation in concentrated electrolytes requires accurate ion interactions and adequate sampling of slowly interconverting coordination environments. We combine Zn K-edge extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) measurements with long-timescale molecular dynamics (MD) using machine-learning interatomic potentials to study aqueous ZnCl2 from dilute conditions to 30 m. We train revPBE-based DeepMD models with D3 corrections included or excluded for Zn-containing pairs and compare them with DPMD-SCAN, classical MD (CMD), and MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN. EXAFS calculations are benchmarked against hydrated and chloride-coordinated Zn reference complexes, then applied to MD ensembles alongside Zn-Cl coordination free-energy analysis. Increasing concentration reduces octahedral coordination, replaces water with chloride, and promotes chloride-bridged association. All three DeepMD models yield similar EXAFS at 3 m, but DPMD-SCAN shows greater transferability across concentrations, reproducing measured spectral trends, key features of mixed ZnCl2/LiCl spectra, and octahedral fractions consistent with other studies. DFT treatment strongly affects coordination free energies and aggregation; excluding Zn-related D3 corrections does not systematically improve EXAFS agreement. CMD shows larger spectral discrepancies and less consistent coordination trends. MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN improves upon CMD and yields spectra comparable to DPMD-SCAN, which provides more consistent agreement and greater computational efficiency. Neighbor-resolved analysis shows that distance disorder and scattering-path interference can produce similar EXAFS signatures for distinct coordination ensembles, highlighting the need for rigorous sampling and ensemble-averaged spectra to distinguish isolated from chloride-bridged Zn species.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测浓电解质中的形态需要准确的离子相互作用和对缓慢相互转换的配位环境进行充分采样。我们使用机器学习原子间势将 Zn K 边扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 测量与长时标分子动力学 (MD) 相结合，研究从稀释条件到 30 m 的 ZnCl2 水溶液。我们训练基于 revPBE 的 DeepMD 模型，其中包含或排除含 Zn 对的 D3 校正，并将它们与 DPMD-SCAN、经典 MD (CMD) 和 MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN 进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测浓电解质中的形态需要准确的离子相互作用和对缓慢相互转换的配位环境进行充分采样。我们使用机器学习原子间势将 Zn K 边扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 测量与长时标分子动力学 (MD) 相结合，研究从稀释条件到 30 m 的 ZnCl2 水溶液。我们训练基于 revPBE 的 DeepMD 模型，其中包含或排除含 Zn 对的 D3 校正，并将它们与 DPMD-SCAN、经典 MD (CMD) 和 MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN 进行比较。 EXAFS 计算以水合和氯化物配位 Zn 参考络合物为基准，然后应用于 MD 系综以及 Zn-Cl 配位自由能分析。增加浓度会减少八面体配位，用氯化物代替水，并促进氯化物桥联。所有三个 DeepMD 模型在 3 m 处均产生类似的 EXAFS，但 DPMD-SCAN 显示出更大的跨浓度可转移性，再现了测量的光谱趋势、混合 ZnCl2/LiCl 光谱的关键特征以及与其他研究一致的八面体分数。 DFT 处理强烈影响配位自由能和聚集；排除与 Zn 相关的 D3 修正并不能系统地改善 EXAFS 一致性。 CMD 显示出较大的光谱差异和不太一致的协调趋势。 MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN 在 CMD 的基础上进行了改进，产生的光谱可与 DPMD-SCAN 相媲美，从而提供更一致的一致性和更高的计算效率。邻域解析分析表明，距离无序和散射路径干扰可以为不同的配位系综产生类似的 EXAFS 特征，这突出表明需要严格采样和系综平均光谱来区分分离的和氯桥 Zn 物种。

articles.title: First Results of Calculation of the Dayside Magnetopause Reconnection Rate with TRACERS
articles.title_zh: 用 TRACERS 计算日侧磁顶重联率的初步结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantifying the rate of reconnection remains a key challenge in the study of geomagnetic storms. In this study, we present the first results from the new Tandem Reconnection and Cusp Electrodynamics Reconnaissance Satellites (TRACERS) mission to calculate the reconnection rate from dispersed ion populations measured in the cusp, using previously developed methodology. We study ion dispersion events in two storms. During the first storm, which occurred on September 30, 2025, 21 dispersion events were identified in TRACERS 2 ion data as a combined result of geospace dynamics and the spacecraft cusp encounters. Throughout this time when ion dispersion was detected by TRACERS , the reconnection rate is calculated and is shown to track reasonably well with another measure of geomagnetic activity, the Cross Polar Cap Potential (CPCP) as obtained by the Super Dual Auroral Radar Network (SuperDARN). The dispersions are correlated with the smoothed CPCP, and a correlation of r²=0.62 was found using the dispersions from the onset and main phase of the storm. The correlation disappears when including dispersions from the recovery period. The distribution of reconnection rates throughout this storm lies generally between 0.1 - 1.5 mV/m, slightly lower than previous reconnection rates calculated with DMSP, but consistent with in-situ observations made with Polar. In this work, we also apply a previously developed automatic identification algorithm for ion-energy cusp dispersion to TRACERS, with the intent that it may serve as a tool for future statistical analysis as the data volume becomes too large to manually review.
articles.abstract_zh: 量化重新连接率仍然是地磁风暴研究中的一个关键挑战。在这项研究中，我们展示了新的串联重联和尖点电动力学侦察卫星 (TRACERS) 任务的第一个结果，该任务使用先前开发的方法计算尖点中测量的分散离子群的重联率。我们研究两个风暴中的离子分散事件。在 2025 年 9 月 30 日发生的第一场风暴期间，TRACERS 2 离子数据中识别出了 21 个色散事件，这是地球空间动力学和航天器尖点遭遇的综合结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量化重新连接率仍然是地磁风暴研究中的一个关键挑战。在这项研究中，我们展示了新的串联重联和尖点电动力学侦察卫星 (TRACERS) 任务的第一个结果，该任务使用先前开发的方法计算尖点中测量的分散离子群的重联率。我们研究两个风暴中的离子分散事件。在 2025 年 9 月 30 日发生的第一场风暴期间，TRACERS 2 离子数据中识别出了 21 个色散事件，这是地球空间动力学和航天器尖点遭遇的综合结果。在此期间，当 TRACERS 检测到离子色散时，会计算重新连接率，并显示与另一种地磁活动测量方法（由超级双极光雷达网络 (SuperDARN) 获得的跨极帽电位 (CPCP)）相当好地跟踪。离散度与平滑的 CPCP 相关，并且使用风暴爆发和主阶段的离散度发现相关性为 r²=0.62。当包括恢复期的离散时，相关性消失。整个风暴的重连率分布一般在 0.1 - 1.5 mV/m 之间，略低于之前用 DMSP 计算的重连率，但与用 Polar 进行的现场观测一致。在这项工作中，我们还将之前开发的离子能量尖点色散自动识别算法应用于TRACERS，目的是当数据量太大而无法手动检查时，它可以作为未来统计分析的工具。

articles.title: Deep-Learning Identification and Global Characterization of Energetic O2+ Beams at Mars
articles.title_zh: 火星高能 O2+ 束的深度学习识别和全局表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30578v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Martian ionospheric ions can be accelerated away from Mars by the solar wind, contributing substantially to atmospheric ion escape. Here, we develop a U-Net-based image segmentation model to identify a distinct population of escaping planetary ions, energetic O2+ beams, from a decade of Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN (MAVEN) observations and perform an event-based statistical analysis of their global properties and dependence on external conditions. We find that O2+ beams are widely distributed throughout the Martian plasma environment, with a strong preference for the +E hemisphere, where the solar wind convective electric field points away from Mars. This pronounced spatial asymmetry indicates that the convective electric field plays a major role in beam formation. In the solar wind and magnetosheath, these beams are consistent with the plume. Their occurrence-weighted flux agrees with previous long-term plume estimates, whereas the flux during identified beam intervals is substantially higher. This highlights the advantage of our event-based approach in capturing the intrinsic properties of O2+ plumes. In the induced magnetotail, beam formation remains strongly associated with the convective electric field, while the Hall electric field can provide additional energization. The beam properties are primarily controlled by upstream solar wind conditions, with no apparent influence from solar extreme ultraviolet irradiance. These results might improve our understanding of ion escape at Mars. More broadly, we also demonstrate the potential of deep learning for identifying transient plasma populations from spacecraft observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 火星电离层离子可以被太阳风加速远离火星，这对大气离子逃逸做出了重大贡献。在这里，我们开发了一个基于 U-Net 的图像分割模型，从十年来的火星大气和挥发性演化 (MAVEN) 观测中识别出逃逸行星离子、高能 O2+ 束的独特群体，并对它们的全局特性和对外部条件的依赖性进行基于事件的统计分析。我们发现O2+束广泛分布在整个火星等离子体环境中，特别偏爱+E半球，那里的太阳风对流电场远离火星。这种明显的空间不对称性表明对流电场在束流形成中起着重要作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 火星电离层离子可以被太阳风加速远离火星，这对大气离子逃逸做出了重大贡献。在这里，我们开发了一个基于 U-Net 的图像分割模型，从十年来的火星大气和挥发性演化 (MAVEN) 观测中识别出逃逸行星离子、高能 O2+ 束的独特群体，并对它们的全局特性和对外部条件的依赖性进行基于事件的统计分析。我们发现O2+束广泛分布在整个火星等离子体环境中，特别偏爱+E半球，那里的太阳风对流电场远离火星。这种明显的空间不对称性表明对流电场在束流形成中起着重要作用。在太阳风和磁鞘中，这些光束与羽流一致。它们的发生加权通量与之前的长期羽流估计一致，而确定的波束间隔期间的通量要高得多。这凸显了我们基于事件的方法在捕获 O2+ 羽流的内在特性方面的优势。在感应磁尾中，束流形成仍然与对流电场密切相关，而霍尔电场可以提供额外的能量。光束特性主要受上游太阳风条件控制，不受太阳极紫外辐照度的明显影响。这些结果可能会增进我们对火星离子逃逸的理解。更广泛地说，我们还展示了深度学习从航天器观测中识别瞬态等离子体群体的潜力。

articles.title: Metasurface engineering of transient photothermal responses for vibrational imaging at living interfaces
articles.title_zh: 生命界面振动成像瞬态光热响应的超表面工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chemical transformations at biological interfaces are central to cellular function, yet the weak vibrational signals associated with subtle molecular changes limit their spatially resolved observation. Here, we present metasurface-driven mid-infrared photothermal imaging (MetaMIP), which uses resonantly engineered metasurfaces to amplify molecular temperature modulation while retaining rapid thermal recovery. Visible-light detection converts this response into submicrometre maps of individual nanoparticles and biological cells. In living cells, MetaMIP resolves spatially distinct chemical changes during enzymatic lipid conversion across the cell membrane. These results demonstrate the potential of engineered photothermal interfaces for mapping chemical composition and tracking its evolution during reactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 生物界面的化学转变是细胞功能的核心，但与微妙的分子变化相关的微弱振动信号限制了它们的空间分辨观察。在这里，我们提出了超表面驱动的中红外光热成像（MetaMIP），它使用共振工程超表面来放大分子温度调节，同时保持快速热恢复。可见光检测将这种响应转化为单个纳米颗粒和生物细胞的亚微米图。在活细胞中，MetaMIP 可以解析跨细胞膜的酶促脂质转化过程中空间上不同的化学变化。这些结果证明了工程光热界面在绘制化学成分并跟踪其在反应过程中的演变方面的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生物界面的化学转变是细胞功能的核心，但与微妙的分子变化相关的微弱振动信号限制了它们的空间分辨观察。在这里，我们提出了超表面驱动的中红外光热成像（MetaMIP），它使用共振工程超表面来放大分子温度调节，同时保持快速热恢复。可见光检测将这种响应转化为单个纳米颗粒和生物细胞的亚微米图。在活细胞中，MetaMIP 可以解析跨细胞膜的酶促脂质转化过程中空间上不同的化学变化。这些结果证明了工程光热界面在绘制化学成分并跟踪其在反应过程中的演变方面的潜力。

articles.title: Experimental evidence of forward energy transfer induced by core-edge coupling in multiscale tokamak turbulence
articles.title_zh: 多尺度托卡马克湍流中核-边耦合引起的正向能量传递的实验证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30638v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Turbulence in magnetically confined plasmas is inherently quasi-two-dimensional and can exhibit both inverse and forward energy transfer across scales. Experimental evidence for cross-scale energy transfer in the hot plasma core has, however, remained scarce. Understanding such energy transfer is crucial because it governs turbulent transport, which directly impacts confinement quality of fusion plasmas. Here we report experimental evidence consistent with forward energy transfer associated with core-edge coupling in tokamak turbulence. We combined multichannel collective Thomson scattering (CTS) and radially localized Doppler backscattering (DBS) to resolve cross-scale fluctuation dynamics. The results reveal that a quasi-coherent mode (QCM) originating from the edge is also present in the core and resonantly couples with broadband turbulence, producing significant forward energy transfer and characteristic secondary instabilities. These combined measurements indicate that quasi-two-dimensional tokamak turbulence can support a net energy transfer from ion to electron scales through cross-scale wave-wave interactions, contrary to the inverse cascade paradigm of idealized two-dimensional turbulence. Such a plasma regime is attractive for fusion reactors, as it avoids large edge-localized modes (ELMs) that damage first-wall components and maintains high confinement quality even in the presence of high-Z impurities.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁约束等离子体中的湍流本质上是准二维的，并且可以表现出跨尺度的反向和正向能量转移。然而，热等离子体核心中跨尺度能量转移的实验证据仍然很少。了解这种能量传递至关重要，因为它控制着湍流传输，而湍流传输直接影响聚变等离子体的约束质量。在这里，我们报告了与托卡马克湍流中与核心边缘耦合相关的正向能量传递一致的实验证据。我们结合多通道集体汤姆逊散射（CTS）和径向局域多普勒后向散射（DBS）来解决跨尺度波动动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁约束等离子体中的湍流本质上是准二维的，并且可以表现出跨尺度的反向和正向能量转移。然而，热等离子体核心中跨尺度能量转移的实验证据仍然很少。了解这种能量传递至关重要，因为它控制着湍流传输，而湍流传输直接影响聚变等离子体的约束质量。在这里，我们报告了与托卡马克湍流中与核心边缘耦合相关的正向能量传递一致的实验证据。我们结合多通道集体汤姆逊散射（CTS）和径向局域多普勒后向散射（DBS）来解决跨尺度波动动力学。结果表明，源自边缘的准相干模式（QCM）也存在于核心中，并与宽带湍流共振耦合，产生显着的前向能量转移和特征二次不稳定性。这些组合测量表明，准二维托卡马克湍流可以通过跨尺度波波相互作用支持从离子尺度到电子尺度的净能量转移，这与理想化二维湍流的逆级联范例相反。这种等离子体状态对于聚变反应堆很有吸引力，因为它避免了大边缘局域模式（ELM），这种模式会损坏第一壁组件，并且即使在存在高 Z 杂质的情况下也能保持高约束质量。

articles.title: Nonlinear Drift Waves and Electrostatic Density Cavities in Upper Ionosphere
articles.title_zh: 电离层上部的非线性漂移波和静电密度空腔
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonlinear drift waves are investigated to explain the mechanism for the creation of one dimensional (1D) and two dimensional (2D) electrostatic density cavities in the presence of density gradient in direction perpendicular to the geomagnetic field. Ion motion along field lines has to be neglected for the formation of density depletion because nonlinear contribution of their parallel motion overcomes the effect of drift waves which create negative nonlinear potential. It is pointed out that a straightforward but appropriate model for drift waves can explain the generation of density cavities having widths in xy-plane if the external magnetic field is assumed to be along z-axis i.e. bf B₀ = B₀ hatz. The general nonlinear equation for drift waves takes the form of Zakharov-Kuznetson (ZK) equation when ion nonlinear vorticity term is ignored and it admits the solution in the form of 2D solitary wave. In 1D case, the ZK equation reduces to Korteweg de Vries (KdV) equation which admits solution in the form of 1D soliton. In both cases, the nonlinear potential becomes negative. The order of magnitude of the amplitude and width of density cavities is found to be in agreement with the satellite observations in upper ionosphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究非线性漂移波以解释在垂直于地磁场的方向上存在密度梯度的情况下创建一维 (1D) 和二维 (2D) 静电密度空腔的机制。对于密度耗尽的形成，必须忽略离子沿场线的运动，因为它们的平行运动的非线性贡献克服了产生负非线性电势的漂移波的影响。有人指出，如果假设外部磁场沿 z 轴，即 bf B₀ = B₀ hatz，则直接但适当的漂移波模型可以解释 xy 平面内具有宽度的密度空腔的产生。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究非线性漂移波以解释在垂直于地磁场的方向上存在密度梯度的情况下创建一维 (1D) 和二维 (2D) 静电密度空腔的机制。对于密度耗尽的形成，必须忽略离子沿场线的运动，因为它们的平行运动的非线性贡献克服了产生负非线性电势的漂移波的影响。有人指出，如果假设外部磁场沿 z 轴，即 bf B₀ = B₀ hatz，则直接但适当的漂移波模型可以解释 xy 平面内具有宽度的密度空腔的产生。当忽略离子非线性涡量项时，漂移波的一般非线性方程采用扎哈罗夫-库兹涅森（ZK）方程的形式，并允许解为二维孤波形式。在一维情况下，ZK 方程简化为 Korteweg de Vries (KdV) 方程，该方程允许以一维孤子的形式求解。在这两种情况下，非线性势均变为负值。发现密度空腔的幅度和宽度的数量级与电离层上部的卫星观测结果一致。

articles.title: On Spurious Mesh-Scale Oscillations Associated with Resonance-Cone Regimes in Wave-Plasma Simulations
articles.title_zh: 波等离子体模拟中与共振锥区相关的伪网格尺度振荡
