articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spurious mesh-scale oscillations can compromise frequency-domain finite-element simulations of electromagnetic wave propagation in magnetized cold plasmas. We investigate their origin and mitigation through a verification framework combining a mixed Nédélec-Lagrange solver, a waveport accommodating non-orthogonal modes in anisotropic media, and an analytical generalized Fresnel benchmark at a vacuum-plasma interface. Comparisons with this benchmark show that the observed oscillations occur in resonance-cone regimes and are absent from the analytical fields, confirming their numerical origin. Systematic tests assess the effects of approximation order, variational formulation, mesh geometry, and numerical collisionality. Plane-wave residual and Fourier spectral analyses suggest that local mesh variations induce spectral coupling to additional wavevector components, predominantly populating the dispersion branches in collisionless resonance-cone regimes where the reduced scalar equation loses ellipticity. Uniform rectangular grids recover the analytical wave structure, further supporting the role of mesh geometry and symmetry. However, strict symmetry requirements limit the applicability of this approach, motivating numerical regularization. In resonance-cone regimes, introducing sufficient numerical collisionality suppresses the mesh-scale oscillations, yielding smooth electric-field solutions and reducing the error relative to the analytical benchmark. For one resonance-cone benchmark configuration, the error-minimizing damping decreases with mesh refinement according to an empirical Zₘₐₜₕᵣₘ ₙpropto h¹.⁴⁸ scaling, sustaining error reduction consistent with second-order convergence and avoiding the accuracy limit imposed by fixed collisionality. ...
articles.abstract_zh: 虚假的网格尺度振荡可能会影响磁化冷等离子体中电磁波传播的频域有限元模拟。我们通过一个验证框架来研究它们的起源和缓解，该验证框架结合了混合内德莱克-拉格朗日求解器、在各向异性介质中容纳非正交模式的波口以及真空-等离子体界面处的分析广义菲涅耳基准。与该基准的比较表明，观察到的振荡发生在共振锥区域中，并且在分析场中不存在，从而证实了它们的数值起源。系统测试评估近似阶数、变分公式、网格几何和数值碰撞的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 虚假的网格尺度振荡可能会影响磁化冷等离子体中电磁波传播的频域有限元模拟。我们通过一个验证框架来研究它们的起源和缓解，该验证框架结合了混合内德莱克-拉格朗日求解器、在各向异性介质中容纳非正交模式的波口以及真空-等离子体界面处的分析广义菲涅耳基准。与该基准的比较表明，观察到的振荡发生在共振锥区域中，并且在分析场中不存在，从而证实了它们的数值起源。系统测试评估近似阶数、变分公式、网格几何和数值碰撞的影响。平面波残差和傅里叶谱分析表明，局部网格变化会引起与附加波矢量分量的光谱耦合，主要填充无碰撞共振锥区域中的色散分支，其中减少的标量方程失去椭圆度。均匀的矩形网格恢复了分析的波浪结构，进一步支持了网格几何形状和对称性的作用。然而，严格的对称性要求限制了这种方法的适用性，从而促进了数值正则化。在共振锥体系中，引入足够的数值碰撞性可以抑制网格尺度振荡，产生平滑的电场解并减少相对于分析基准的误差。对于一种共振锥基准配置，误差最小化阻尼根据经验 Zₘₐₜₕᵣₘ ₙpropto h1.⁴⁸ 缩放而随着网格细化而减小，维持与二阶收敛一致的误差减少，并避免固定碰撞所施加的精度限制。 ...

articles.title: Effective-action formulation of k-odd bianisotropy and unidirectional polarization rotation in nonlocal temporal metamaterials
articles.title_zh: 非局域时间超材料中 k 奇双向异性和单向偏振旋转的有效作用公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive the effective action of temporal metamaterials up to first order in spatial derivatives through a multiscale analysis of the electromagnetic Lagrangian density. We show that the first-order spatial correction gives rise to an effective bianisotropic coupling tensor that is odd in the wavevector k. Remarkably, chiral, pseudochiral, and omega-type bianisotropic responses emerge as distinct directional manifestations of a single nonlocal coupling tensor, even when the underlying electric and magnetic response tensors remain symmetric. Furthermore, we establish a framework for analyzing Lorentz reciprocity based on the Hessian of the effective action. We demonstrate that Lorentz reciprocity is preserved in the presence of omega-type coupling but is broken when chiral or pseudochiral coupling emerges. This nonreciprocity manifests as the unidirectional rotations of normalized Stokes vectors incurred by Floquet-engineered chirality and pseudochirality.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过电磁拉格朗日密度的多尺度分析，我们推导出时间超材料在空间导数中达到一阶的有效作用。我们表明，一阶空间校正产生了一个有效的双各向异性耦合张量，该张量在波矢 k 中为奇数。值得注意的是，即使底层的电和磁响应张量保持对称，手性、伪手性和欧米伽型双各向异性响应也作为单个非局部耦合张量的不同方向表现出现。此外，我们建立了一个基于有效作用的Hessian 分析洛伦兹互易性的框架。我们证明洛伦兹互易性在欧米茄型耦合存在的情况下得以保留，但在手性或伪手性耦合出现时被破坏。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过电磁拉格朗日密度的多尺度分析，我们推导出时间超材料在空间导数中达到一阶的有效作用。我们表明，一阶空间校正产生了一个有效的双各向异性耦合张量，该张量在波矢 k 中为奇数。值得注意的是，即使底层的电和磁响应张量保持对称，手性、伪手性和欧米伽型双各向异性响应也作为单个非局部耦合张量的不同方向表现出现。此外，我们建立了一个基于有效作用的Hessian 分析洛伦兹互易性的框架。我们证明洛伦兹互易性在欧米茄型耦合存在的情况下得以保留，但在手性或伪手性耦合出现时被破坏。这种非互易性表现为由 Floquet 设计的手性和伪手性引起的归一化斯托克斯矢量的单向旋转。

articles.title: The Mechanism of Chirality in Plasmonic Structures: Asymmetric Resonance Modes
articles.title_zh: 等离子体结构中的手性机制：不对称共振模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31045v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study presents a theoretical framework for understanding the mechanism of chirality generation and circular dichroism (CD) in chiral nanostructures, with a particular focus on the role of asymmetric plasmon resonance mode distributions. Although previous studies have linked chiroptical properties to resonance differences, the specific nature and origin of these differences have not been fully elucidated. Here, we provide a more detailed explanation by quantitatively analyzing the asymmetric electric-field components arising from mode asymmetry. Specifically, we examine the near-field symmetry of individual nanorods and corner-stacked coupled structures (CSCS). The results demonstrate that chirality arises from asymmetric electric-field distributions, which give rise to distinct phase and amplitude responses of the electromagnetic fields in the composite structure under right-handed circularly polarized (RCP) and left-handed circularly polarized (LCP) illumination. The absorption and CD spectra, which exhibit distinct features around 910,nm, support this mechanism and provide valuable insights into the design of chiroptical materials. The proposed mechanism is not restricted to a specific chiral structure or resonance and offers a broader explanation for the generation of circular dichroism.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项研究提出了一个理论框架，用于理解手性纳米结构中手性产生和圆二色性（CD）的机制，特别关注不对称等离子共振模式分布的作用。尽管先前的研究已将手性光学特性与共振差异联系起来，但这些差异的具体性质和起源尚未完全阐明。在这里，我们通过定量分析由模式不对称引起的不对称电场分量来提供更详细的解释。具体来说，我们检查了单个纳米棒和角堆叠耦合结构（CSCS）的近场对称性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这项研究提出了一个理论框架，用于理解手性纳米结构中手性产生和圆二色性（CD）的机制，特别关注不对称等离子共振模式分布的作用。尽管先前的研究已将手性光学特性与共振差异联系起来，但这些差异的具体性质和起源尚未完全阐明。在这里，我们通过定量分析由模式不对称引起的不对称电场分量来提供更详细的解释。具体来说，我们检查了单个纳米棒和角堆叠耦合结构（CSCS）的近场对称性。结果表明，手性源于不对称电场分布，在右旋圆偏振（RCP）和左旋圆偏振（LCP）照明下，复合结构中的电磁场会产生不同的相位和振幅响应。吸收光谱和 CD 光谱在 910 nm 附近表现出明显的特征，支持了这一机制，并为手性光学材料的设计提供了宝贵的见解。所提出的机制不限于特定的手性结构或共振，并且为圆二色性的产生提供了更广泛的解释。

articles.title: In situ performance of the Vertex Silicon Plane in the BM@N experiment during Run 9
articles.title_zh: 运行 9 期间 BM@N 实验中顶点硅平面的原位性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Vertex Silicon Plane (VSP) was commissioned and operated for the first time as the most upstream tracking station of the Baryonic Matter at Nuclotron (BM@N) experiment at the NICA accelerator complex during Run 9. The station consisting of six double-sided silicon microstrip modules based on the CBM-BM@N detector technology was installed about 8 cm downstream from the target inside the SP-41 analyzing magnet. The in situ module performance was characterized in terms of the signal-to-noise ratio, time resolution, and Lorentz drift in the magnetic field. The most probable cluster signal-to-noise ratio ranges from 15.5 to 33.2, while the time resolution relative to the trigger pulse is about 12 ns. The tracking performance was evaluated using track-hit residuals and hit-matching efficiency; two independent reference configurations based on the Forward Silicon Detector (FSD) and Gas Electron Multiplier (GEM) tracking systems give consistent efficiencies of about 95%. The contribution of the VSP to the BM@N tracking performance was further studied through the transverse track impact parameter and the reconstruction of short VSP-GEM tracklets. Owing to its position close to the target and its coverage at large polar angles, the VSP provides an additional near-target tracking point and makes it possible to extend the geometrical acceptance beyond that of the FSD- and GEM-based central tracking system.
articles.abstract_zh: 顶点硅平面（ VSP ）在运行9期间首次调试和运行，作为NICA加速器综合体核加速器（ BM @ N ）重子物质实验的最上游跟踪站。该站由六个基于CBM-BM @ N探测器技术的双面硅微带模块组成，安装在SP-41分析磁铁内部距离目标约8厘米的下游。原位模块性能的特征在于磁场中的信噪比、时间分辨率和洛伦兹漂移。最可能的簇信噪比范围为15.5至33.2 ，而相对于触发脉冲的时间分辨率约为12 ns。使用轨迹命中残差和命中匹配效率评估跟踪性能；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 顶点硅平面（ VSP ）在运行9期间首次调试和运行，作为NICA加速器综合体核加速器（ BM @ N ）重子物质实验的最上游跟踪站。该站由六个基于CBM-BM @ N探测器技术的双面硅微带模块组成，安装在SP-41分析磁铁内部距离目标约8厘米的下游。原位模块性能的特征在于磁场中的信噪比、时间分辨率和洛伦兹漂移。最可能的簇信噪比范围为15.5至33.2 ，而相对于触发脉冲的时间分辨率约为12 ns。使用轨迹命中残差和命中匹配效率评估跟踪性能；基于前向硅探测器(FSD)和气体电子倍增器(GEM)跟踪系统的两种独立参考配置可提供约95%的一致效率。通过横向轨迹冲击参数和短VSP-GEM轨迹的重建，进一步研究了VSP对BM @ N跟踪性能的贡献。由于其靠近目标的位置和大极角的覆盖范围， VSP提供了一个额外的近目标跟踪点，并且可以将几何接受度扩展到基于FSD和GEM的中央跟踪系统之外。

articles.title: Accurate ab initio calculations of the ground state properties of singly charged alkali metal hydrides
articles.title_zh: 单电荷碱金属氢化物基态性质的精确从头计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this article, we investigate the ground state electronic properties of singly charged alkali metal hydrides using the single-reference coupled-cluster method with single and double excitations (CCSD), together with perturbative triple excitations (CCSD(T)). A large relativistic core-valence quintuple-zeta basis set has been employed. The calculated spectroscopic constants and molecular properties are compared with existing data in the literature. Further, the relevant vibrational parameters are determined by solving the vibrational Schrödinger equation utilizing potential energy curves and permanent dipole moment curves. Thereafter, spontaneous and black-body radiation induced transition rates are calculated to obtain the lifetimes of the vibrational states.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们使用单参考耦合簇法（ CCSD ）研究单电荷碱金属氢化物的基态电子特性，以及摄动三重激励（ CCSD （ T ） ）。已经采用了一个大型相对论核心价五重zeta基集。将计算的光谱常数和分子性质与文献中的现有数据进行比较。此外，通过利用势能曲线和永久偶极矩曲线求解振动薛定谔方程来确定相关的振动参数。此后，计算自发和黑体辐射诱导的过渡速率，以获得振动状态的寿命。

articles.title: Track finding and particle identification performance with particle physics foundation models
articles.title_zh: 使用粒子物理基础模型进行跟踪发现和粒子识别性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern high energy nuclear and particle physics experiments produce large amounts of sparse data that must be reduced significantly in size before performing physics analysis. Recently, there has been an effort to evaluate Foundation Models as a potential tool for performing data analysis. These models have been shown to learn features in high dimensional datasets based on the multi-modal data they are trained on. To show their effectiveness at performing complex pattern recognition tasks, such as reconstructing charged particles in a magnetic field, we evaluated the performance of a Foundation Model based reconstruction on several downstream tasks with a dataset composed of spacepoints in a Time Projection Chamber. We show that the performance of the Foundation Model based data analysis significantly improves upon that of traditional methods, and furthermore can be adapted to learn additional tasks that are not necessarily related to the initial training objective.
articles.abstract_zh: 现代高能核和粒子物理实验产生了大量的稀疏数据，在进行物理分析之前必须显着缩小其大小。最近，人们一直在努力评估基础模型作为执行数据分析的潜在工具。这些模型已被证明可以根据其训练的多模态数据来学习高维数据集中的特征。为了证明它们在执行复杂模式识别任务（例如在磁场中重建带电粒子）方面的有效性，我们评估了基于基础模型的重建在几个下游任务上的性能，这些任务的数据集由时间投影室中的空间点组成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代高能核和粒子物理实验产生了大量的稀疏数据，在进行物理分析之前必须显着缩小其大小。最近，人们一直在努力评估基础模型作为执行数据分析的潜在工具。这些模型已被证明可以根据其训练的多模态数据来学习高维数据集中的特征。为了证明它们在执行复杂模式识别任务（例如在磁场中重建带电粒子）方面的有效性，我们评估了基于基础模型的重建在几个下游任务上的性能，这些任务的数据集由时间投影室中的空间点组成。我们表明，基于基础模型的数据分析的性能明显优于传统方法，并且可以适应学习与初始训练目标不一定相关的额外任务。

articles.title: Unconstrained learning of equivariant atomistic properties
articles.title_zh: 等变原子性质的无约束学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials based on graph neural networks (GNNs) have made first-principles accuracy routine for the potential energy surface (PES). Their backbones, often O(3)-equivariant by design, are increasingly used to learn other atomistic properties. Many of these are of high angular order or pseudotensorial character, defined per atom, or expanded on large atom-centered basis sets. Such targets strain equivariant GNNs, whose tensor products grow steeply in cost with angular order and can fail to represent the target if truncated, forcing difficult trade-offs between hyperparameters. Unconstrained models like the Point-Edge Transformer (PET) instead replace explicit O(3) algebra with edge-to-edge attention and learn equivariance from data, so that the same backbone can in principle learn any equivariant property. We demonstrate how to use PET to learn molecular dipoles and polarizabilities, NMR chemical shielding tensors, and auxiliary-basis expansions of the electron density. Increasing the backbone size systematically improves both accuracy and equivariance error, and targeted architectural and training choices reduce the symmetry breaking further. PET matches or improves on the released reference models at lower inference cost and, compared with equivariant models, a smaller memory footprint. The predictions give accurate IR and Raman spectra and isotropic shieldings; the predicted densities accelerate self-consistent field calculations and give one-shot ground-state properties, and pretrained density models transfer to higher levels of theory by fine-tuning on little data. The impact of approximate equivariance is small for most observables, further validating this approach to train fast, accurate, and useful surrogate models for properties beyond the PES.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于图神经网络（ GNN ）的机器学习原子间势已成为势能面（ PES ）的第一原理精度例程。它们的主干，通常是O (3) -在设计上等价的，越来越多地用于学习其他原子特性。其中许多具有高角度顺序或假张量特征，定义为每个原子，或在大原子中心的基准集上扩展。这种靶标会使等变量GNN产生应变，其张量积随着角度顺序的变化而急剧增长，如果被截断，则可能无法代表靶标，从而迫使超参数之间难以权衡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于图神经网络（ GNN ）的机器学习原子间势已成为势能面（ PES ）的第一原理精度例程。它们的主干，通常是O (3) -在设计上等价的，越来越多地用于学习其他原子特性。其中许多具有高角度顺序或假张量特征，定义为每个原子，或在大原子中心的基准集上扩展。这种靶标会使等变量GNN产生应变，其张量积随着角度顺序的变化而急剧增长，如果被截断，则可能无法代表靶标，从而迫使超参数之间难以权衡。像点边变换器（ PET ）这样的无约束模型用边对边注意力代替显式O （ 3 ）代数，并从数据中学习等方差，以便相同的骨干原则上可以学习任何等变特性。我们演示了如何使用PET来学习分子偶极子和极化率、核磁共振化学屏蔽张量以及电子密度的辅助基础膨胀。系统地增加主干尺寸可以提高精度和等方差误差，有针对性的架构和训练选择可以进一步减少对称性突破。PET以较低的推理成本匹配或改进已发布的参考模型，并且与等变量模型相比，内存占用更小。预测给出了准确的红外和拉曼光谱和各向同性屏蔽；预测的密度加速了自洽场计算并给出了一次性基态特性，并且通过对少量数据进行微调，预训练的密度模型转移到更高的理论水平。对于大多数可观测对象来说，近似等方差的影响很小，这进一步验证了这种方法可以为PES以外的属性训练快速、准确和有用的替代模型。

articles.title: Phase-Matched Chirps for Energy-Efficient Excitation of Magneto-Mechanical Resonators
articles.title_zh: 用于磁机械谐振器节能激励的相位匹配啁啾
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magneto-mechanical resonators (MMRs) are a recently proposed class of passive, wireless devices used for sensing and tracking. The operating principle of MMRs relies on an excitation of the sensor by oscillating magnetic fields, followed by an inductive readout to measure the sensor's dynamics. One challenge lies in generating efficient excitation signals to ensure maximum energy harvesting by the sensor. In this simulation study, we focus on chirped magnetic-field excitations and compare their performance with conventional constant-frequency excitation for both sinusoidal and rectangular waveforms. The results indicate varying levels of efficiency, with a sinusoidal linear down-chirp excitation signal yielding the largest deflection angle, offering the best potential for reducing the energy consumption and improving the temporal resolution of the measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁机械谐振器（ MMR ）是最近提出的一类用于传感和跟踪的无源无线设备。MMR的工作原理依赖于振荡磁场对传感器的激励，然后通过感应读数来测量传感器的动态。一个挑战是生成有效的激励信号，以确保传感器最大限度地收集能量。在这项模拟研究中，我们专注于啁啾磁场激励，并将其与正弦波和矩形波的常规恒频激励进行比较。结果表明，效率水平不同，正弦线性下啁啾激励信号产生最大偏转角，为降低能耗和提高测量的时间分辨率提供了最佳潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁机械谐振器（ MMR ）是最近提出的一类用于传感和跟踪的无源无线设备。MMR的工作原理依赖于振荡磁场对传感器的激励，然后通过感应读数来测量传感器的动态。一个挑战是生成有效的激励信号，以确保传感器最大限度地收集能量。在这项模拟研究中，我们专注于啁啾磁场激励，并将其与正弦波和矩形波的常规恒频激励进行比较。结果表明，效率水平不同，正弦线性下啁啾激励信号产生最大偏转角，为降低能耗和提高测量的时间分辨率提供了最佳潜力。

articles.title: Synthetic 2D magnetic turbulence with controlled island structuring
articles.title_zh: 具有受控岛结构的合成2D磁湍流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic turbulence remains up to this day not fully understood, despite its important role in the behavior of plasmas. A recurring ingredient in plasma turbulence is the spontaneous formation and evolution of plasmoids. These represent magnetic islands on current sheets in two-dimensional turbulent magnetic fields that are consistently found in high-resolution direct numerical simulations (DNSs) using a magnetohydrodynamic description. However, such simulations require considerable amounts of computational power. Synthetic turbulence models provide an alternative, cheap approach to the generation of fully-developed turbulent fields. In this work, we first present an extension of our open-source, general synthetic turbulence BxC toolkit that is specifically tailored to generate 2D turbulent magnetic fields. We then use a novel physically motivated, but purely geometric construction that generates current sheet island chains, which results in fields that visually match the ones obtained through DNSs. We show how this construction affects the magnetic field lines and find a correlation with the formation of magnetic O-points and X-points. The magnetic flux and size of the islands in the field are found to match well with theoretical scaling laws. Lastly, we show BxC's capabilities by generating a 2D N× N turbulent magnetic field of resolution N = 100000, going beyond the state-of-the-art reached by simulations, on a single CPU with modest computational resources. Our construction maintains direct control over the inertial range, and allows to make morphological changes to the plasmoids and fields, demonstrating plasmoid appearance, disappearance and merging.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管磁湍流在等离子体的行为中起着重要作用，但它至今仍未得到充分理解。等离子体湍流中一个反复出现的成分是等离子体的自发形成和演化。这些代表二维湍流磁场中电流片上的磁岛，这些磁岛在使用磁流体动力学描述的高分辨率直接数值模拟（ DNS ）中始终存在。然而，这种模拟需要相当大的计算能力。合成湍流模型为生成完全开发的湍流场提供了一种廉价的替代方法。在这项工作中，我们首先展示了我们的开源通用合成湍流BxC工具包的扩展，该工具包专门用于生成2D湍流磁场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管磁湍流在等离子体的行为中起着重要作用，但它至今仍未得到充分理解。等离子体湍流中一个反复出现的成分是等离子体的自发形成和演化。这些代表二维湍流磁场中电流片上的磁岛，这些磁岛在使用磁流体动力学描述的高分辨率直接数值模拟（ DNS ）中始终存在。然而，这种模拟需要相当大的计算能力。合成湍流模型为生成完全开发的湍流场提供了一种廉价的替代方法。在这项工作中，我们首先展示了我们的开源通用合成湍流BxC工具包的扩展，该工具包专门用于生成2D湍流磁场。然后，我们使用一种新颖的物理动机，但纯粹是几何结构，生成当前的片状岛链，从而产生与通过DNS获得的字段在视觉上匹配的字段。我们展示了这种构造如何影响磁场线，并找到了与磁性O点和X点形成的相关性。磁场中岛屿的磁通量和大小与理论尺度定律非常吻合。最后，我们通过在具有适度计算资源的单个CPU上生成分辨率为N = 100000的2D N × N湍流磁场来展示BxC的能力，这超出了模拟所达到的最先进水平。我们的构造保持了对惯性范围的直接控制，并允许对等离子体和场进行形态学改变，展示等离子体外观、消失和合并。

articles.title: Predictive electronic feedback control for narrow-linewidth lasers
articles.title_zh: 窄线宽激光器的预测电子反馈控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31396v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Narrow-linewidth lasers are essential for various key atom-laser interaction processes and optical setups in quantum coherent control, quantum precision measurement, and quantum information science. The Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) technique is the standard method for the frequency-stabilization of narrow-linewidth lasers, but the inherent time delay in its feedback loop inevitably induces excessive phase noise, commonly known as servo bumps. Previous solutions primarily rely on additional optical components outside the electronic feedback control loop. Here, we propose and implement a generic method based on the Smith predictor to address the time-delay issue entirely within the electronic part of the PDH feedback control loop. We systematically demonstrate its capability to suppress phase noise and reduce servo bumps by adding only a single Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) controller to the loop. This class of methods is demonstrated to be conceptually concise with minimal hardware overhead, effective in practice, and holds potential for a wide variety of future applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 窄线宽激光器对于量子相干控制、量子精度测量和量子信息科学中的各种关键原子-激光相互作用过程和光学设置至关重要。Pound-Drever-Hall （ PDH ）技术是窄线宽激光器稳频的标准方法，但其反馈回路中固有的时间延迟不可避免地会引起过多的相位噪声，通常称为伺服凸点。以前的解决方案主要依赖于电子反馈控制回路之外的其他光学元件。在这里，我们提出并实现了一种基于Smith预测器的通用方法，以完全在PDH反馈控制回路的电子部分内解决延时问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 窄线宽激光器对于量子相干控制、量子精度测量和量子信息科学中的各种关键原子-激光相互作用过程和光学设置至关重要。Pound-Drever-Hall （ PDH ）技术是窄线宽激光器稳频的标准方法，但其反馈回路中固有的时间延迟不可避免地会引起过多的相位噪声，通常称为伺服凸点。以前的解决方案主要依赖于电子反馈控制回路之外的其他光学元件。在这里，我们提出并实现了一种基于Smith预测器的通用方法，以完全在PDH反馈控制回路的电子部分内解决延时问题。我们通过仅在回路中添加一个现场可编程门阵列（ FPGA ）控制器，系统地展示了其抑制相位噪声和减少伺服凸点的能力。这类方法在概念上是简洁的，硬件开销最小，在实践中有效，并且具有广泛的未来应用潜力。

articles.title: Coherent synchrotron radiation extraction from a bent beam pipe
articles.title_zh: 从弯曲光束管中提取相干同步辐射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent synchrotron radiation generated in a bending magnet can propagate far downstream and heat the beam pipe. We investigate a beam-free side outlet that diverts part of this radiation into a separate guide. We use a paraxial equation to calculate radiation generation in the bend and its division between the two guides. Modal and finite-difference solutions are used in the bend, and quadratic finite elements on a changing transverse mesh in the branching region. We check the paraxial approximation against full-wave solutions at selected frequencies. Separately, we calculate radiation attenuation in a conducting pipe without an outlet using complex modes that satisfy impedance boundary conditions. For this example, independently damped perfectly conducting modes underestimate the high-frequency transmitted power. For a 70×25 mm rectangular chamber with a 30^circ bend of radius 2.2 m and Gaussian bunches of rms length 10,μm, the selected outlet diverts about 53% of the total outgoing radiation power into the beam-free channel.
articles.abstract_zh: 在弯曲磁体中产生的相干同步辐射可以向下游传播并加热束管。我们研究了一个无光束侧出口，该出口将部分辐射转移到单独的导轨中。我们使用近轴方程来计算弯道中的辐射产生及其在两个导轨之间的分布。在弯曲区域使用模态和有限差分解，在分支区域的变化横向网格上使用二次有限元。我们在选定的频率上对照全波解检查近轴近似。另外，我们使用满足阻抗边界条件的复杂模式计算没有出口的导电管中的辐射衰减。对于这个例子，独立阻尼的完美导通模式低估了高频发射功率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在弯曲磁体中产生的相干同步辐射可以向下游传播并加热束管。我们研究了一个无光束侧出口，该出口将部分辐射转移到单独的导轨中。我们使用近轴方程来计算弯道中的辐射产生及其在两个导轨之间的分布。在弯曲区域使用模态和有限差分解，在分支区域的变化横向网格上使用二次有限元。我们在选定的频率上对照全波解检查近轴近似。另外，我们使用满足阻抗边界条件的复杂模式计算没有出口的导电管中的辐射衰减。对于这个例子，独立阻尼的完美导通模式低估了高频发射功率。对于半径为2.2 m的30 ^圆弯曲且均方根长度为10 μm的高斯束的70 × 25 mm矩形腔室，所选出口将总输出辐射功率的约53%转移到无光束通道中。

articles.title: Observation of Polarization Topology in Magneto-Optical BICs
articles.title_zh: 磁光BIC中极化拓扑的观察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polarization topology in momentum space is a fundamental characteristic of photonic bound states in the continuum (BICs), where the winding of far-field polarization defines a quantized topological charge. Although magneto-optical (MO) BICs combine polarization topology with magnetically tunable chirality, experimental characterization remains challenging because time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking complicates eigenpolarization extraction. Here, we experimentally resolve the momentum-space polarization topology of an MO BIC by reconstructing its two-dimensional far-field eigenpolarization texture. We extract the resonant output polarization using singular value decomposition of the polarization-resolved angle-resolved reflection matrix without invoking reciprocity. The reconstructed polarization azimuth winds counterclockwise by 2π around the Γ-point singularity, yielding a topological charge of q = +1. Moreover, the polarization handedness can be reversed solely by varying the magnetic-bias strength, while the field direction and the measured topological charge remain unchanged. A non-Hermitian coupled-mode model traces this reversal to hybridization between the BIC mode and a leaky mode. This work establishes experimental access to momentum-space polarization topology in nonreciprocal photonics, opening a route to explore topological singularities and their evolution under active TRS breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 动量空间中的偏振拓扑是连续体（ BIC ）中光子束缚态的基本特征，其中远场偏振的绕组定义了量化拓扑电荷。尽管磁光（ MO ） BIC将极化拓扑与磁可调手性相结合，但实验表征仍然具有挑战性，因为时间反转对称性（ TRS ）破坏使本征极化提取复杂化。在这里，我们通过重建MO BIC的二维远场本征极化纹理来实验性地解决MO BIC的动量空间极化拓扑。我们使用偏振分辨角度分辨反射矩阵的奇异值分解来提取共振输出偏振，而不调用互易性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 动量空间中的偏振拓扑是连续体（ BIC ）中光子束缚态的基本特征，其中远场偏振的绕组定义了量化拓扑电荷。尽管磁光（ MO ） BIC将极化拓扑与磁可调手性相结合，但实验表征仍然具有挑战性，因为时间反转对称性（ TRS ）破坏使本征极化提取复杂化。在这里，我们通过重建MO BIC的二维远场本征极化纹理来实验性地解决MO BIC的动量空间极化拓扑。我们使用偏振分辨角度分辨反射矩阵的奇异值分解来提取共振输出偏振，而不调用互易性。重建的极化方位围绕Γ点奇点逆时针缠绕2π ，产生q = +1的拓扑电荷。此外，极化手性可以仅通过改变磁偏置强度来逆转，而场方向和测量的拓扑电荷保持不变。非厄米耦合模式模型将这种逆转追溯到BIC模式和泄漏模式之间的杂交。这项工作在非互易光子学中建立了对动量空间偏振拓扑的实验访问，开辟了探索拓扑奇点及其在主动TRS断裂下的演化的途径。

articles.title: GEM-PIC-RZ: a Galilean electromagnetic particle-in-cell code in quasi-cylindrical geometry with nonuniform grids
articles.title_zh: GEM-PIC-RZ ：准圆柱几何中具有非均匀网格的伽利略电磁粒子单元代码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Laser-plasma accelerators span scales from the micrometre wavelength of the driving laser to acceleration lengths of millimetres or metres. Full particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations resolve the laser carrier but are constrained by the Courant condition, whereas quasi-static models are computationally efficient but do not resolve it. We present GEM-PIC-RZ, a quasi-cylindrical implementation of the Galilean electromagnetic PIC scheme. The method retains the slow evolution of the forward field and therefore resolves the laser carrier while allowing a propagation step governed by the evolution of the laser and plasma rather than by the cell size. User-defined nonuniform grids and a charge-conserving regularization of the bubble closure support efficient simulations across these scales. Comparisons with the full PIC code FBPIC show agreement for the laser wake, the depletion and redshift of a few-cycle pulse, and ionization injection; the measured CPU time is about 2,% of that for FBPIC in the reported runs; the injected charge carries a model uncertainty of about 15,% from the regularization. An envelope model, in contrast, underestimates the depletion of the few-cycle pulse fivefold. Self-injection in a sharp density down-ramp is not yet reproduced and remains an open problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 激光等离子体加速器从驱动激光的微米波长到毫米或米的加速长度。全粒子单元（ PIC ）模拟解决了激光载波，但受到Courant条件的限制，而准静态模型在计算上是有效的，但不能解决它。我们提出了GEM-PIC-RZ ，这是伽利略电磁PIC方案的准圆柱形实现。该方法保留了前向场的缓慢演变，因此分辨了激光载体，同时允许由激光和等离子体的演变而不是细胞大小控制的传播步骤。用户定义的非均匀网格和气泡闭合的电荷守恒正则化支持跨这些尺度的有效模拟。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 激光等离子体加速器从驱动激光的微米波长到毫米或米的加速长度。全粒子单元（ PIC ）模拟解决了激光载波，但受到Courant条件的限制，而准静态模型在计算上是有效的，但不能解决它。我们提出了GEM-PIC-RZ ，这是伽利略电磁PIC方案的准圆柱形实现。该方法保留了前向场的缓慢演变，因此分辨了激光载体，同时允许由激光和等离子体的演变而不是细胞大小控制的传播步骤。用户定义的非均匀网格和气泡闭合的电荷守恒正则化支持跨这些尺度的有效模拟。与完整PIC代码FBPIC的比较表明，激光尾迹、几周期脉冲的耗尽和红移以及电离注入一致；测量的CPU时间约为报告运行中FBPIC的2 ， % ；注入电荷的模型不确定度约为正则化的15 ， %。相比之下，包络模型低估了小周期脉冲的五倍耗尽。急剧密度下降匝道中的自我注射尚未再现，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

articles.title: Confinement of hybridized light modes in nonlinear-optical superpotentials
articles.title_zh: 非线性光学超电位中杂交光模式的限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we present a spatial and temporal light trapping mechanism induced by coherent frequency conversion. We consider a wave-mixing process, where a pumped nonlinearity mediates a frequency-domain beamsplitter interaction between two signal modes. When these wave modes are counterpropagating, temporally trapped eigenmodes emerge at the zero of the nonlinearity profile. We establish that such spatio-temporal trapping has a direct connection to supersymmetric quantum mechanics, which ensures the existence and robustness of the trapped modes and allows us to derive analytic solutions of the bound eigenmodes. Backwards sum-frequency conversion may thus enable a unique class of active photonic memory devices, whose design parameters are compatible with the state of the art in integrated nonlinear photonics. We propose proof-of-principle experiments to study this nonlinear-optical trapping effect on thin-film lithium niobate. In addition, as a case study, we show how the temporal trap can be used alongside parametric gain. Our work unveils potential applications ranging from classical integrated photonics to multimode quantum nonlinear photonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种由相干频率转换引起的空间和时间光捕获机制。我们考虑了一个波混合过程，其中泵浦非线性介导了两种信号模式之间的频域分束器相互作用。当这些波模反向传播时，在非线性轮廓的零点处出现时间陷阱特征模。我们确定这种时空陷阱与超对称量子力学有直接联系，这确保了陷阱模态的存在性和鲁棒性，并使我们能够导出有界特征模态的解析解。因此，向后和频转换可以启用一类独特的有源光子存储器件，其设计参数与集成非线性光子学中的现有技术兼容。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种由相干频率转换引起的空间和时间光捕获机制。我们考虑了一个波混合过程，其中泵浦非线性介导了两种信号模式之间的频域分束器相互作用。当这些波模反向传播时，在非线性轮廓的零点处出现时间陷阱特征模。我们确定这种时空陷阱与超对称量子力学有直接联系，这确保了陷阱模态的存在性和鲁棒性，并使我们能够导出有界特征模态的解析解。因此，向后和频转换可以启用一类独特的有源光子存储器件，其设计参数与集成非线性光子学中的现有技术兼容。我们提出了原理证明实验来研究这种对薄膜铌酸锂的非线性光学俘获效应。此外，作为一个案例研究，我们展示了时间陷阱如何与参数增益一起使用。我们的工作揭示了从经典集成光子学到多模量子非线性光子学的潜在应用。

articles.title: A sharp gradient-corrected Lieb--Thirring inequality in one dimension with applications to density functional theory
articles.title_zh: 一个尖锐的梯度校正Lieb--一个维度上的不等式与密度泛函理论的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30887v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We first prove a sharp Lieb-Thirring inequality with semi-classical constant and gradient correction in one dimension. In the periodic setting, the corresponding inequality also includes a parity dependent shell-correction term, which appears to be new. Moreover, we also characterize the optimizers of these inequalities. In particular, the optimizing density profiles form a two-dimensional manifold, which we call here the Poincaré density manifold. We then apply these results to study the Thomas--Fermi--von Weizsäcker (TFW) approximation of the kinetic energy in Density Functional Theory. More precisely, we first obtain an explicit and non-asymptotic bound on the global and local error made by the TFW approximation. These bounds are controlled by the distance of the normalized density profile from the Poincaré density manifold times the number of particles. In particular, these bounds show that the TFW approximation is exact on the Poincaré manifold. We then show that, in the periodic setting, the distance between the Kohn-Sham potential and the inverse TFW potential in the natural dual Sobolev space can also be controlled by explicit density dependent constants times the distance to the Poincaré manifold. As a corollary, we prove that for a fixed density profile, the Kohn-Sham potential converges towards the inverse Thomas--Fermi potential in the high-density limit N → infty with asymptotic rate of order N⁻². This rate is shown to be optimal.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们首先证明了具有半经典常数和一维梯度校正的尖锐 Lieb-Thirring 不等式。在周期设置中，相应的不等式还包括奇偶校验相关的壳校正项，这似乎是新的。此外，我们还描述了这些不等式的优化器。特别是，优化密度分布形成二维流形，我们在此将其称为庞加莱密度流形。然后，我们应用这些结果来研究密度泛函理论中动能的 Thomas-Fermi-von Weizsäcker (TFW) 近似。更准确地说，我们首先获得 TFW 近似产生的全局和局部误差的显式非渐近界限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们首先证明了具有半经典常数和一维梯度校正的尖锐 Lieb-Thirring 不等式。在周期设置中，相应的不等式还包括奇偶校验相关的壳校正项，这似乎是新的。此外，我们还描述了这些不等式的优化器。特别是，优化密度分布形成二维流形，我们在此将其称为庞加莱密度流形。然后，我们应用这些结果来研究密度泛函理论中动能的 Thomas-Fermi-von Weizsäcker (TFW) 近似。更准确地说，我们首先获得 TFW 近似产生的全局和局部误差的显式非渐近界限。这些界限由归一化密度分布与庞加莱密度流形的距离乘以粒子数来控制。特别是，这些界限表明 TFW 近似在庞加莱流形上是精确的。然后我们证明，在周期设置中，自然对偶 Sobolev 空间中 Kohn-Sham 势和逆 TFW 势之间的距离也可以通过显式密度相关常数乘以到庞加莱流形的距离来控制。作为推论，我们证明，对于固定的密度分布，Kohn-Sham 势在高密度极限 N → infty 中收敛到逆 Thomas-Fermi 势，渐进率达到 N⁻² 级。该速率被证明是最佳的。

articles.title: Anisotropic spin hydrodynamics in a magnetized medium: entropy-current formulation and minimal linear modes
articles.title_zh: 磁化介质中的各向异性自旋流体动力学：熵流公式和最小线性模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31408v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We formulate anisotropic relativistic spin hydrodynamics in a parity-even magnetized medium using an Israel--Stewart entropy-current construction. Treating the magnetic field at leading order in the gradient expansion reduces the rotational symmetry to SO(2) and separates spin susceptibilities and dissipative transport into longitudinal, transverse, and mixed channels. A restricted quadratic entropy current yields transient equations for the retained dissipative stresses and spin fluxes. We analyze a minimal linear closure around an unpolarized homogeneous equilibrium, retaining dynamical magnetic-flux perturbations but no explicit spin-magnetization coupling; spin and magnetic fluctuations mix through the fluid variables. Infrared coefficient equations and ultraviolet characteristic expansions organize the magnetosonic and Alfvén-like spectra together with spectator spin-flux poles. The first-order truncation exhibits unstable boost-sector poles and superlinear large-wave-number branches, interpreted as diagnostics of the truncated equations rather than microscopic dispersion predictions. For the baseline parameters, finite relaxation times yield asymptotically linear propagation branches and finite relaxation poles, with no growing modes found on the sampled grid. The characteristic speeds depend nonmonotonically on spin transport and provide necessary light-cone diagnostics, without establishing general stability or strong hyperbolicity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用 Israel-Stewart 熵流结构在宇称偶磁化介质中制定了各向异性相对论自旋流体动力学。在梯度展开中以前导顺序处理磁场可降低 SO(2) 的旋转对称性，并将自旋磁化率和耗散传输分离为纵向、横向和混合通道。受限二次熵流产生保留耗散应力和自旋通量的瞬态方程。我们分析了非极化均匀平衡周围的最小线性闭合，保留动态磁通量扰动，但没有明确的自旋磁化耦合；自旋和磁波动通过流体变量混合。红外系数方程和紫外特征展开式将磁声波谱和类阿尔芬谱与观察者自旋通量极点组织在一起。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用 Israel-Stewart 熵流结构在宇称偶磁化介质中制定了各向异性相对论自旋流体动力学。在梯度展开中以前导顺序处理磁场可降低 SO(2) 的旋转对称性，并将自旋磁化率和耗散传输分离为纵向、横向和混合通道。受限二次熵流产生保留耗散应力和自旋通量的瞬态方程。我们分析了非极化均匀平衡周围的最小线性闭合，保留动态磁通量扰动，但没有明确的自旋磁化耦合；自旋和磁波动通过流体变量混合。红外系数方程和紫外特征展开式将磁声波谱和类阿尔芬谱与观察者自旋通量极点组织在一起。一阶截断表现出不稳定的升压扇区极点和超线性大波数分支，被解释为截断方程的诊断而不是微观色散预测。对于基线参数，有限弛豫时间产生渐近线性传播分支和有限弛豫极点，在采样网格上没有发现增长模式。特征速度非单调地取决于自旋输运，并提供必要的光锥诊断，而无需建立一般稳定性或强双曲性。

articles.title: In-Situ Differential-Light-Shift Cancellation for Trapped-Atom Clocks
articles.title_zh: 捕获原子钟的原位差分光移消除
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26398v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Differential light shifts (DLS) induced by optical trapping fields fundamentally limit the stability and accuracy of trapped-atom microwave clocks. We demonstrate an in-situ method to cancel DLS by simultaneously interrogating multiple spatially separated atomic ensembles at different trap intensities generated from a common light source. By operating the ensembles at set intensity ratios and performing Ramsey spectroscopy, the intensity-dependent frequency shifts are measured within each experimental cycle and extrapolated to the zero-intensity limit. This approach effectively enables shot-to-shot determination of a DLS-free frequency without requiring magic wavelengths or species-specific cancellation schemes. We validate the method for Rb atoms trapped in time-averaged potentials by introducing controlled variations of the total trap power and show that the extrapolated frequency remains insensitive to these fluctuations. The technique is general and can be extended to other systematic shifts, providing a scalable route toward improved stability and accuracy in compact trapped-atom clocks and related quantum sensors relying on optical dipole traps
articles.abstract_zh: 光捕获场引起的差分光移（DLS）从根本上限制了捕获原子微波时钟的稳定性和准确性。我们演示了一种原位方法，通过同时询问由同一光源产生的不同陷阱强度的多个空间分离的原子系综来消除 DLS。通过以设定的强度比操作系综并执行拉姆齐光谱，在每个实验周期内测量强度相关的频移并外推到零强度极限。这种方法有效地实现了无 DLS 频率的逐次确定，而不需要神奇波长或特定于物种的消除方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光捕获场引起的差分光移（DLS）从根本上限制了捕获原子微波时钟的稳定性和准确性。我们演示了一种原位方法，通过同时询问由同一光源产生的不同陷阱强度的多个空间分离的原子系综来消除 DLS。通过以设定的强度比操作系综并执行拉姆齐光谱，在每个实验周期内测量强度相关的频移并外推到零强度极限。这种方法有效地实现了无 DLS 频率的逐次确定，而不需要神奇波长或特定于物种的消除方案。我们通过引入总陷阱功率的受控变化来验证在时间平均势中捕获 Rb 原子的方法，并表明外推频率对这些波动仍然不敏感。该技术是通用的，可以扩展到其他系统转变，为提高紧凑型俘获原子钟和依赖于光学偶极子陷阱的相关量子传感器的稳定性和准确性提供了可扩展的途径

articles.title: Geodesic torsion of the magnetic field line and other predictors of coil non-planarity in QI stellarators
articles.title_zh: QI 仿星器中磁场线的测地线扭转和线圈非平面性的其他预测因子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.26763v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Stellarator magnetic fields are often realized with non-planar modular coils with their out-of-plane bending being one of the main engineering challenges. We ask whether the non planarity of the fialment can be predicted from the equilibrium alone. We look at a dataset of coils for stellarator equilibira and find that the geodesic torsion of the magnetic field line is a strong and robust predictor in a wide range of coil feasibility requirements. We compare the performance of the geodesic torsion against other equilibrium and surface geometry properties and find it to be a superior predictorv hardly replaceable by other quantities we considered in this dataset. The ranking it induces also reproduces the ordering of four published configurations --- precise QA, precise QI at nfp 2 and 3, and W7-X. Our conclusions suggest that geodesic torsion of the magnetic field line may be considered as a cheap and robust candidate for a stage-one non-planarity proxy.
articles.abstract_zh: 仿星器磁场通常通过非平面模块化线圈来实现，其平面外弯曲是主要的工程挑战之一。我们询问是否可以仅根据平衡来预测细丝的非平面性。我们查看了仿星器平衡线圈数据集，发现磁场线的测地线扭转在各种线圈可行性要求中是一个强大且稳健的预测因子。我们将测地线扭转的性能与其他平衡和表面几何特性进行比较，发现它是一个优异的预测值，几乎无法被我们在此数据集中考虑的其他量替代。它产生的排名还再现了四种已发布配置的顺序——精确 QA、nfp 2 和 3 处的精确 QI 以及 W7-X。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 仿星器磁场通常通过非平面模块化线圈来实现，其平面外弯曲是主要的工程挑战之一。我们询问是否可以仅根据平衡来预测细丝的非平面性。我们查看了仿星器平衡线圈数据集，发现磁场线的测地线扭转在各种线圈可行性要求中是一个强大且稳健的预测因子。我们将测地线扭转的性能与其他平衡和表面几何特性进行比较，发现它是一个优异的预测值，几乎无法被我们在此数据集中考虑的其他量替代。它产生的排名还再现了四种已发布配置的顺序——精确 QA、nfp 2 和 3 处的精确 QI 以及 W7-X。我们的结论表明，磁场线的测地线扭转可被视为第一阶段非平面性代理的廉价且可靠的候选者。

articles.title: Exact and Asymptotically Complete Robust Verifications of Neural Networks via Ising Solvers
articles.title_zh: 通过 Ising 求解器对神经网络进行精确且渐近完整的鲁棒验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.00408v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present an Ising-compatible framework for formal neural-network robustness verification under bounded input perturbations. For piecewise activations (both continuous piecewise-linear and discrete piecewise-constant), the Exact Logarithmic Piecewise Model (Log-PW) provides an exact, sound, and complete formulation with a state-optimal logarithmic encoding, reducing the binary variables per neuron from linear O(κ) to information-theoretically minimal logarithmic complexity O(lceil log₂ κ rceil) via logarithmic SOS2 (Log-PWL) and SOS1 (Log-PWC) constraints. For general element-wise activations, the Asymptotic Step-Envelope Model (Step-Env) leverages Log-PWC to construct sound, refinable endpoint enclosures. An exact monotonic reduction based on Jordan decomposition further extends this framework to arbitrary non-monotonic activations. We further develop a hybrid Benders solver with output-sensitive iteration bounds, leveraging a Helly-based conflict compression theory to avoid generic exponential cut explosion. In particular, for shallow networks with fixed input dimension, this establishes an unconditionally polynomial Benders iteration complexity in network size. Interval pruning, certificate transfer for pruned networks, and layerwise classical--Ising partitioning further reduce spin requirements. Experiments demonstrate exact certification fidelity for piecewise-linear networks and near-reference accuracy for non-linear activations under compact spin budgets. On MNIST benchmarks, Log-PW halves binary decision spins over One-Hot formulations, while Helly-based cuts achieve up to a 13.41× speedup and an 87.6% reduction in master queries over standard baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个与 Ising 兼容的框架，用于在有界输入扰动下进行形式神经网络鲁棒性验证。对于分段激活（连续分段线性和离散分段常数），精确对数分段模型 (Log-PW) 提供了具有状态最优对数编码的精确、可靠且完整的公式，通过对数 SOS2 (Log-PWL) 和SOS1 (Log-PWC) 约束。对于一般的逐元素激活，渐近阶梯包络模型 (Step-Env) 利用 Log-PWC 来构造合理的、可细化的端点包络。基于乔丹分解的精确单调约简进一步将该框架扩展到任意非单调激活。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个与 Ising 兼容的框架，用于在有界输入扰动下进行形式神经网络鲁棒性验证。对于分段激活（连续分段线性和离散分段常数），精确对数分段模型 (Log-PW) 提供了具有状态最优对数编码的精确、可靠且完整的公式，通过对数 SOS2 (Log-PWL) 和SOS1 (Log-PWC) 约束。对于一般的逐元素激活，渐近阶梯包络模型 (Step-Env) 利用 Log-PWC 来构造合理的、可细化的端点包络。基于乔丹分解的精确单调约简进一步将该框架扩展到任意非单调激活。我们进一步开发了一种具有输出敏感迭代边界的混合 Benders 求解器，利用基于 Helly 的冲突压缩理论来避免通用指数切割爆炸。特别是，对于具有固定输入维度的浅层网络，这在网络大小上建立了无条件多项式 Benders 迭代复杂度。间隔剪枝、剪枝网络的证书传输以及分层经典伊辛分区进一步降低了旋转要求。实验证明了分段线性网络的精确认证保真度和紧凑自旋预算下非线性激活的接近参考精度。在 MNIST 基准测试中，Log-PW 将 One-Hot 公式的二元决策旋转减半，而基于 Helly 的削减与标准基线相比实现了 13.41 倍的加速和主查询减少了 87.6%。

articles.title: A coupled finite element formulation for chemo-mechano-thermodynamical contact and its application to bonding and debonding
articles.title_zh: 化学-机械-热力学接触的耦合有限元公式及其在粘合和脱粘中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12375v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This work presents a finite element formulation for coupled chemo-mechano-thermodynamical large deformation contact. The formulation is based on the contact theory of Sauer et al. (2022) that contains six coupled (but separate) fields: the deformation and temperature of the two contacting bodies, as well as an interfacial bonding field and interfacial temperature. The latter is governed by the chemical and mechanical energy dissipation at the interface. Here the focus is placed on the evolution of bonding and debonding, and how it is coupled to the mechanical and thermal contact state. Several elementary models are proposed for this based on a quadratic contact potential. The resulting contact formulation becomes very general and versatile, which is illustrated by several challenging examples. They include pressure- and gap- dependent bonding, exothermic bonding reactions, thermal hardening and thermal expansion, as well as simultaneous bonding and debonding. They are based on a monolithic finite element implementation using classical and isogeometric shape functions together with implicit time integration. Its full linearization, required for the Newton-Raphson solution method, is also provided for the six-field problem, as well as for several of its simplifications. If bonding sites are material points, the bonding variable can be condensed-out locally.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作提出了化学-机械-热力学耦合大变形接触的有限元公式。该公式基于 Sauer 等人的接触理论。 （2022）包含六个耦合（但独立）场：两个接触体的变形和温度，以及界面结合场和界面温度。后者由界面处的化学和机械能耗散控制。这里的重点是键合和脱键合的演变，以及它如何与机械和热接触状态耦合。为此提出了基于二次接触电势的几个基本模型。由此产生的接触公式变得非常通用和通用，这可以通过几个具有挑战性的例子来说明。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这项工作提出了化学-机械-热力学耦合大变形接触的有限元公式。该公式基于 Sauer 等人的接触理论。 （2022）包含六个耦合（但独立）场：两个接触体的变形和温度，以及界面结合场和界面温度。后者由界面处的化学和机械能耗散控制。这里的重点是键合和脱键合的演变，以及它如何与机械和热接触状态耦合。为此提出了基于二次接触电势的几个基本模型。由此产生的接触公式变得非常通用和通用，这可以通过几个具有挑战性的例子来说明。它们包括压力和间隙相关的键合、放热键合反应、热硬化和热膨胀，以及同时键合和脱键合。它们基于使用经典和等几何形状函数以及隐式时间积分的整体有限元实现。牛顿-拉夫逊求解方法所需的完全线性化也适用于六场问题及其一些简化。如果键合位点是质点，则键合变量可以局部压缩。

articles.title: Filament Formation via Collision-induced Magnetic Reconnection -- Kinematic Features
articles.title_zh: 通过碰撞引起的磁重联形成细丝——运动学特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.16205v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Collision-induced Magnetic Reconnection (CMR) mechanism has recently been proposed as a filament formation model that emphasizes the active role of magnetic fields. To enable better observational tests with data from modern telescopes, we provide more specific observable predictions for filaments formed via CMR. Two types of CMR kinematics are revealed in position-velocity (PV) diagrams. First, due to the nature of CMR, the midplane contains a it converging motion close to the filament and two it diverging motions farther from the filament. They exhibit a blueshift, redshift, blueshift, redshift (BRBR) velocity pattern along the line-of-sight when the collision midplane is inclined, giving rise to a special pattern in the PV-diagram. Second, the longitudinal PV-diagram along the filament spine exhibits a velocity oscillating pattern, which is currently attributed to the magnetic transport of gas clumps in the it converging motion. The first type of pattern involves emission primarily outside the filament, which can be confused with the environment. The second type, however, mainly emerges from gas inside the filament, thus more robust for observational tests. Both the integral-shaped filament and the Stick filament in the Orion A cloud show the velocity oscillation in PV-diagrams, although the spatial oscillation frequency and their velocity spread differ.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近提出了碰撞诱导磁重联（CMR）机制作为细丝形成模型，强调磁场的积极作用。为了利用现代望远镜的数据进行更好的观测测试，我们为通过 CMR 形成的细丝提供了更具体的可观测预测。位置-速度 (PV) 图中揭示了两种类型的 CMR 运动学。首先，由于 CMR 的性质，中平面包含一个靠近灯丝的会聚运动和两个远离灯丝的发散运动。当碰撞中面倾斜时，它们沿着视线呈现蓝移、红移、蓝移、红移 (BRBR) 速度模式，从而在 PV 图中产生特殊模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近提出了碰撞诱导磁重联（CMR）机制作为细丝形成模型，强调磁场的积极作用。为了利用现代望远镜的数据进行更好的观测测试，我们为通过 CMR 形成的细丝提供了更具体的可观测预测。位置-速度 (PV) 图中揭示了两种类型的 CMR 运动学。首先，由于 CMR 的性质，中平面包含一个靠近灯丝的会聚运动和两个远离灯丝的发散运动。当碰撞中面倾斜时，它们沿着视线呈现蓝移、红移、蓝移、红移 (BRBR) 速度模式，从而在 PV 图中产生特殊模式。其次，沿着细丝脊柱的纵向PV图表现出速度振荡模式，目前这归因于气体团块在其会聚运动中的磁性传输。第一种类型的模式主要涉及灯丝外部的发射，这可能与环境相混淆。然而，第二种类型主要从灯丝内部的气体中产生，因此对于观察测试来说更加稳健。尽管空间振荡频率和速度分布不同，但猎户座 A 云中的整体形细丝和棒状细丝都在 PV 图中显示了速度振荡。

articles.title: AI Mindmeld: A Latent Interconnect Protocol
articles.title_zh: AI Mindmeld：潜在互连协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLMs can act as scientific agents using tools to consult specialists and run experiments. Yet specialist information must enter their context, generally as text, images, audio or video: a bottleneck between models with rich, high-dimensional representations. We advocate direct representation exchange: a mindmeld conveying many properties, including information an LLM would not think to request. It should be extensible to new specialists, flexible across questions and tasks, and compositional across independently connected specialists without joint training. The Latent Interconnect Protocol (LIP) learns connectors mapping specialist representations into LLM internal states. Training only connectors keeps this practical as LLMs grow and evolve. We connect three protein and three small molecule specialists to Gemma 3 (4B and 12B parameters) and Kimi K2.6 (1T total, 32B active), freezing all pretrained models. Independently trained connectors provide useful information without changing the LLM or existing connectors, supporting familiar and new question types about unseen objects. We demonstrate zero-shot transfer to cross-domain tasks without joint training. Task performance and compositionality generally improve with LLM capability, with especially strong gains in zero-shot task transfer. Limitations remain: current LLMs were not trained for specialist representations as native inputs; access does not ensure reliable interpretation, integration or use in reasoning. We call on specialist developers to provide consistent representation interfaces and, especially, on LLM developers to train models to receive, combine and reason with these inputs. These efforts could expand scientific agents' information while preserving conventional tools' flexibility. Data, pretrained connectors, and code for training, evaluation and interactive inference: https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld
articles.abstract_zh: 法学硕士可以充当科学代理人，使用工具咨询专家和进行实验。然而，专业信息必须进入其上下文，通常以文本、图像、音频或视频的形式：具有丰富、高维表示的模型之间的瓶颈。我们提倡直接表示交换：心灵融合传达许多属性，包括法学硕士不会要求的信息。它应该可以扩展到新的专家，灵活地处理问题和任务，并且可以在独立连接的专家之间进行组合，而无需联合培训。潜在互连协议 (LIP) 学习将专业表示映射到 LLM 内部状态的连接器。随着法学硕士的成长和发展，仅对连接器进行培训就可以保持这一实用性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 法学硕士可以充当科学代理人，使用工具咨询专家和进行实验。然而，专业信息必须进入其上下文，通常以文本、图像、音频或视频的形式：具有丰富、高维表示的模型之间的瓶颈。我们提倡直接表示交换：心灵融合传达许多属性，包括法学硕士不会要求的信息。它应该可以扩展到新的专家，灵活地处理问题和任务，并且可以在独立连接的专家之间进行组合，而无需联合培训。潜在互连协议 (LIP) 学习将专业表示映射到 LLM 内部状态的连接器。随着法学硕士的成长和发展，仅对连接器进行培训就可以保持这一实用性。我们将三个蛋白质和三个小分子专家连接到 Gemma 3（4B 和 12B 参数）和 Kimi K2.6（总计 1T，32B 活跃），冻结所有预训练模型。独立训练的连接器提供有用的信息，无需更改法学硕士或现有连接器，支持有关未见物体的熟悉和新问题类型。我们演示了无需联合训练即可实现跨域任务的零样本迁移。任务性能和组合性通常会随着 LLM 能力的提高而提高，尤其是在零样本任务迁移方面的收益尤其显着。局限性仍然存在：目前的法学硕士没有接受过专业代表作为本地输入的培训；访问并不能确保推理中的可靠解释、整合或使用。我们呼吁专业开发人员提供一致的表示接口，特别是法学硕士开发人员训练模型以接收、组合和推理这些输入。这些努力可以扩大科学人员的信息，同时保留传统工具的灵活性。用于训练、评估和交互式推理的数据、预训练连接器和代码：https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld

articles.title: Generalizing Metropolis-Hastings for DAG Sampling
articles.title_zh: 推广 Metropolis-Hastings 进行 DAG 采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A fundamental challenge in Bayesian network structure learning lies in efficiently approximating the posterior distribution of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). For large, high-dimensional datasets, the task remains beyond the capabilities of current methods. This work advances Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms by introducing novel moves that simultaneously resample the parents for multiple nodes of the DAG. At the core of these moves is duet sampling, a new generalization of the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm that selects two proposal distributions from a pool at each iteration. One is used for generating a candidate state of the Markov chain and another for evaluating the return to the current state; both are ingredients of an appropriately crafted acceptance criterion. Pairing different proposal distributions provides additional freedom and enables constructing Markov chains that mix more efficiently than their basic Metropolis-Hastings counterparts, at no additional computational cost. Experiments show that our new moves, both individually and in combination, outperform the previous state of the art, which relies on a more restrictive pool of moves. This advantage persists even when letting the previous methods leverage duet sampling to enhance their performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝叶斯网络结构学习的一个基本挑战在于有效逼近有向无环图（DAG）的后验分布。对于大型高维数据集，该任务仍然超出了当前方法的能力。这项工作通过引入同时对 DAG 多个节点的父节点进行重新采样的新颖举措来推进马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗算法。这些举措的核心是二重采样，这是 Metropolis-Hastings 算法的新推广，该算法在每次迭代时从池中选择两个提案分布。一个用于生成马尔可夫链的候选状态，另一个用于评估返回当前状态；两者都是适当制定的验收标准的组成部分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 贝叶斯网络结构学习的一个基本挑战在于有效逼近有向无环图（DAG）的后验分布。对于大型高维数据集，该任务仍然超出了当前方法的能力。这项工作通过引入同时对 DAG 多个节点的父节点进行重新采样的新颖举措来推进马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗算法。这些举措的核心是二重采样，这是 Metropolis-Hastings 算法的新推广，该算法在每次迭代时从池中选择两个提案分布。一个用于生成马尔可夫链的候选状态，另一个用于评估返回当前状态；两者都是适当制定的验收标准的组成部分。配对不同的提议分布提供了额外的自由度，并且能够构建比基本 Metropolis-Hastings 对应物更有效混合的马尔可夫链，而无需额外的计算成本。实验表明，我们的新动作，无论是单独还是组合，都优于以前的技术水平，后者依赖于更严格的动作池。即使让以前的方法利用二重采样来增强其性能，这种优势仍然存在。

articles.title: Probing and Steering for Safety-Relevant Behaviours in Large Language Models
articles.title_zh: 大型语言模型中安全相关行为的探测和指导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30363v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Activation probes are computed directions in a language model's residual stream, used both to detect safety-relevant behaviours and, by adding their direction back into the stream, to steer them. We explore how the main design choices behind such probes interact, within one pipeline, on one model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and across three behaviours: deception, high-stakes awareness and sycophancy. The pipeline crosses two estimators (difference-of-means and logistic regression) with three token-pooling schemes (last, mean and learned attention), selects appropriate layers to detect or steer a behaviour, and evaluates every direction twice: as a detector of the behaviour, and as a steering vector to push outputs towards the behaviour. Prior work read together suggests a read/write dissociation, in which logistic regression reads (detects) best but difference-of-means directions write (steer) best. We find that it holds for deception and high-stakes but not for sycophancy, where the pattern reverses. The reversal appears to follow partially from the data rather than from the estimators. The best pooling technique and the layer choice depend on the behaviour and data, and the layer that steers best can sit well before the layer that detects best. The right steering metric to use between changing a model's perception and eliciting behaviour depends on the task - and the two can disagree outright. The exported probes and directions power an interactive interface through which a user can score and steer text directly.
articles.abstract_zh: 激活探针是语言模型残余流中的计算方向，既用于检测与安全相关的行为，又通过将其方向添加回流中来引导它们。我们探讨了此类探测器背后的主要设计选择如何在一个管道内、一个模型 (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) 上以及三种行为之间相互作用：欺骗、高风险意识和阿谀奉承。该管道跨越两个估计器（均值差和逻辑回归）和三个令牌池方案（最后、平均和学习注意力），选择适当的层来检测或引导行为，并对每个方向进行两次评估：作为行为的检测器，并作为将输出推向行为的引导向量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 激活探针是语言模型残余流中的计算方向，既用于检测与安全相关的行为，又通过将其方向添加回流中来引导它们。我们探讨了此类探测器背后的主要设计选择如何在一个管道内、一个模型 (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) 上以及三种行为之间相互作用：欺骗、高风险意识和阿谀奉承。该管道跨越两个估计器（均值差和逻辑回归）和三个令牌池方案（最后、平均和学习注意力），选择适当的层来检测或引导行为，并对每个方向进行两次评估：作为行为的检测器，并作为将输出推向行为的引导向量。之前一起阅读的工作表明读/写分离，其中逻辑回归读取（检测）最好，但均值差异方向写入（引导）最好。我们发现它适用于欺骗和高风险，但不适用于阿谀奉承，而后者的模式正好相反。这种逆转似乎部分来自数据，而不是估计者。最好的池化技术和层的选择取决于行为和数据，并且控制最好的层可以远远位于检测最好的层之前。在改变模型的感知和引发行为之间使用的正确指导指标取决于任务 - 并且两者可能完全不同意。导出的探针和方向为交互式界面提供支持，用户可以通过该界面直接评分和引导文本。

articles.title: Escaping the Phylogenetic Trap: Persistent Homology Enables Cross-Species Ion Channel Classification via Multimodal Graph Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 摆脱系统发育陷阱：持久同源性通过多模态图神经网络实现跨物种离子通道分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Protein classifiers are highly sensitive to evaluation protocol: random train/test splits induce phylogenetic leakage, allowing models to exploit taxon-specific correlations and substantially overestimate out-of-distribution performance. This issue is particularly acute for venom compound classification by ion-channel target (Ca2+, K+, Na+), where reported accuracies of 80-90% do not reflect generalization to unseen taxa. We formulate cross-species prediction as a structured distribution shift in which taxonomic identity acts as a confounder, requiring representations that capture structural features invariant across phylogeny. Using a shared multimodal backbone that fuses ESM-2 sequence embeddings with a disulfide-aware graph attention network, we systematically compare five structural inductive biases (spectral, Riemannian, SE(3)-invariant, statistical-manifold, and persistent-homology representations) under a leave-one-taxon-out evaluation protocol on a benchmark of 1,373 ColabFold-predicted venom compounds spanning five taxa. The persistent-homology representation summarizes backbone geometry through topological descriptors that are robust to local structural perturbations, providing an inductive bias toward phylogenetically invariant learning. Under conventional i.i.d. splits, all models achieve similar accuracy (81-86%), masking differences in inductive bias. Under taxonomic shift, this parity collapses: a sequence-only baseline drops to approximately 30%, the remaining geometric priors cluster at 54-55%, while our persistent-homology model (PH-GNN) achieves 63.4%, outperforming the next-best method by over 8 percentage points. These results demonstrate that random-split evaluation obscures meaningful differences in representation quality and identify topological representations as an effective inductive bias for learning under structured biological distribution shift.
articles.abstract_zh: 蛋白质分类器对评估协议高度敏感：随机训练/测试分裂会导致系统发育泄漏，使模型能够利用分类单元特定的相关性并大大高估分布外的性能。这个问题对于按离子通道目标（Ca2+、K+、Na+）进行毒液化合物分类尤其严重，其中报告的 80-90% 的准确度并不反映对看不见的类群的概括。我们将跨物种预测制定为一种结构化的分布变化，其中分类学身份充当混杂因素，需要捕获跨系统发育的结构特征不变的表示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蛋白质分类器对评估协议高度敏感：随机训练/测试分裂会导致系统发育泄漏，使模型能够利用分类单元特定的相关性并大大高估分布外的性能。这个问题对于按离子通道目标（Ca2+、K+、Na+）进行毒液化合物分类尤其严重，其中报告的 80-90% 的准确度并不反映对看不见的类群的概括。我们将跨物种预测制定为一种结构化的分布变化，其中分类学身份充当混杂因素，需要捕获跨系统发育的结构特征不变的表示。使用将 ESM-2 序列嵌入与二硫键感知图注意网络融合的共享多模态主干，我们在留一分类单元评估协议下，以跨五个类群的 1,373 种 ColabFold 预测的毒液化合物为基准，系统地比较了五种结构归纳偏差（光谱、黎曼、SE(3) 不变、统计流形和持久同源表示）。持久同源表示通过对局部结构扰动具有鲁棒性的拓扑描述符总结了主干几何结构，为系统发育不变学习提供了归纳偏差。在传统的 i.i.d. 下分裂，所有模型都达到相似的精度（81-86%），掩盖了归纳偏差的差异。在分类转变下，这种奇偶性崩溃了：仅序列基线下降到大约 30%，剩余的几何先验聚类在 54-55%，而我们的持久同源模型 (PH-GNN) 达到 63.4%，比次优方法高出 8 个百分点以上。这些结果表明，随机分割评估掩盖了表示质量的有意义的差异，并将拓扑表示确定为结构化生物分布转移下学习的有效归纳偏差。

articles.title: Memory-Augmented Online Test-Time Adaptation for EEG Motor Imagery via Perturbation Consistency and Confidence Calibration
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30422v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain--computer interfaces (BCIs) have gained traction as portable neural measurement systems. However, the practical deployment of these instruments is often hindered by nonstationarity and cross-subject distribution shifts, which lead to significant intersubject inconsistency. Existing adaptation methods remain impractical for real-time measurement scenarios, as they typically require offline access to source or aggregated target data. To address these challenges, this article proposes memory-augmented online test-time adaptation (OTTA) with perturbation consistency and confidence calibration (MOPC), a source-free framework designed to enhance the reliability of BCI instrumentation. MOPC enables the measurement system to update its decoding parameters on the fly during the inference stage, facilitating single-pass adaptation without accessing sensitive source data. We introduce random-mask perturbations to enforce prediction consistency against inherent EEG signal noise and acquisition artifacts. Furthermore, a confidence-calibrated reweighting loss is designed to integrate feature-space similarity, effectively mitigating unreliable pseudolabels and class imbalance during continuous signal acquisition. To ensure system stability and prevent the catastrophic forgetting of established neural patterns, a lightweight memory module is incorporated to regularize parameter updates within a tight latency budget. Evaluated on the BCI IV IIb and OpenBMI datasets, MOPC achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming prior methods by 2.22~% and 3.67~%, respectively, while keeping the per-trial adaptation latency to approximately 40--60 ms. This study provides a robust, recalibration-free solution for real-time EEG decoding, marking a significant advancement in the precision and usability of practical BCI measurement instruments.

articles.title: Ground-Truth-First Benchmarking of Reinforcement Learning via Converse Optimality: From Smooth, Fully Observed Systems to Non-Smooth or Partially Observed Tasks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30954v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmarking in reinforcement learning is usually relative: algorithms are ranked by returns on environments with unknown optima. Distance to optimality remains unobservable, while conclusions may depend on reward design, stochasticity, hyperparameters, environment selection, and simulator details. We develop a ground-truth-first framework based on converse optimality, constructing each task with a certified optimal value function and policy withheld from learners and used only for evaluation. The framework unifies two modes: sensitivity benchmarking samples certified environments from continuous-time generators to assess robustness to task variation, while oracle-referenced comparison uses native discrete-time generators to evaluate policies via optimality gap, regret, and policy error. Continuous-time models support physically interpretable sensitivity studies but introduce dependence on the simulator step (Δ t) and numerical scheme. Native discrete-time models align the environment, oracle, and learner on the same transition law, eliminating external integration choices as a confounder. We reproduce quantitative results covering optimizer sensitivity and oracle-referenced comparisons on serial planar arms, dynamically extended nonholonomic vehicles, and quadrotor-inspired tasks. The methodology extends beyond smooth affine Gaussian systems: virtual-input pullback handles non-affine raw-action interfaces and finite-covariance non-Gaussian disturbances. A non-smooth converse optimality formulation enables certified benchmarks with kinked value functions and switching surfaces. For partially observed evaluation, an information-state formulation reduces benchmarking to converse optimality on a sufficient statistic and provides an information-penalty reference. Code, fixtures, and diagnostics are available on the public project page.

articles.title: Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31439v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Given an unseen graph, a start node, s, and an end node, t, can a language model generate the shortest path from s to t? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.

articles.title: PYTHIA, a transferable machine learning framework for simultaneous defect and adsorption site optimization
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning has permeated material optimization, providing high value. Nevertheless, its re- liance on a high number of samples limits its applicability to relatively explored material families. In this paper we extend the applicability of machine learning to novel and understudied materials through the PYTHIA (Probabilistic Yet Transferable Hierarchical Interaction Architecture) framework. Pythia utilizes two of the most powerful machine learning concepts, foundational models and transfer learning. We employ a complex foundational model trained on a large dataset of chemically similar molecules, on a target that is physically close to our prediction target. Then, we freeze the weights and perform subspace alignment with the use of a transformer layer and add uncertainty quantification with gaussian processes. These two layers can be trained on a limited dataset yet allow us to leverage the gained knowl- edge and the studied materials and complex architectures. The resulting model is used as a surrogate for a Bayesian Optimization scheme. To showcase the robustness of the framework, we applied it to the investigation of adsorption and defect optimization of two distinct systems. Not only were we able to correctly and efficiently identify the optimal adsorption sites of even complex a

articles.title: A Transformer-based Approach for Real-time Multi-agent Path Planning with Varying Initial/Final Conditions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30388v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We address the problem of real-time multi-agent path planning under prescribed initial and final configurations, formulated as a high-dimensional optimal control problem subject to inter-agent collision avoidance and obstacle constraints. Classical solvers based on the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation or Pontryagin's maximum principle (PMP) become computationally intractable as the number of agents grows, due to the curse of dimensionality and the non-convexity introduced by interaction constraints. We propose OCFormer, a transformer-based neural network that parameterizes the inverse of a coordinate transformation mapping a simple, analytically tractable latent space, in which agents evolve independently under a decoupled Hamiltonian, to the physical space of the coupled, interacting system. The model is trained by minimizing a physics-informed loss comprising the Hamiltonian ODE residual from the PMP and a boundary matching term, without requiring pre-computed trajectory data. The self-attention mechanism endows OCFormer with permutation equivariance over agents, a structural symmetry that prior symplectic network approaches do not natively enforce. When trained on a distribution of boundary conditions, the amortized OCFormer produces near-optimal trajectories for unseen initial and final configurations in a single forward pass (sim220ms), enabling real-time inference without retraining. We further introduce a lightweight transfer learning framework that adapts a pretrained OCFormer to out-of-distribution perturbations in seconds via L-BFGS fine-tuning. Numerical experiments on two- and three-dimensional multi-agent navigation with up to 128 agents demonstrate the scalability and efficiency of the proposed approach.

articles.title: Bridging Number-Theoretic Primality Testing And Algorithmic Optimization: An Adaptive Cryptographic Framework
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30935v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The security of modern public-key cryptographic systems, such as RSA, Diffie-Hellman, and ECC, depends entirely on the computational intractability of the integer factorization and discrete logarithm problems. For these asymmetric algorithms to operate, a core requirement is that the system must be capable of generating, testing, and simultaneously proving the primality of extraordinarily large numbers. To meet those requirements, this study proposes a comprehensive framework, bridging clas- sical number theory with modern machine learning models and optimization algorithms. Specifically, the paper delineates an adaptive, arbitrary-precision architecture dedicated exclusively to primality testing. Concurrently, the research deeply analyzes the theoretical foundations of testing methods (both deterministic and probabilistic), hardware-level optimization techniques, and the application of quantum-secured entropy sources, while providing rigorous mathematical proofs to guarantee security even when the prime distribution is biased.

articles.title: DRAFT: Decoding and Reconstructing 3D Room Layouts from fMRI and Camera Trajectories
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31108v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) decoders reconstruct images and 3D objects, recovering the metric geometry of rooms from a moving viewpoint remains an open challenge. We introduce, to our knowledge for the first time, the task of reconstructing 3D layouts of held-out scenes using only the known camera trajectories and the fMRI signals of participants watching indoor walkthroughs, without any visual frames. The task is hard because of the temporal mismatch between rapid visual changes and blurred fMRI signals. Our method, DRAFT (Decoding and Reconstructing 3D room lAyouts from fMRI and Trajectories), extracts a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex and fuses this neural code with the geometric free space derived from camera motion. To evaluate it, we propose layout r, the Pearson correlation between predicted and ray-cast log depths. On ten held-out scenes (20 participants), DRAFT reaches a layout r of 0.480, outperforming the camera path alone (0.446) and seven fMRI decoders (at most 0.429). DRAFT also works as a plug-in that improves all seven decoders without retraining, raising their layout r from 0.171-0.429 to 0.487-0.493. Brain activity and camera motion can thus recover the metric layout of unseen rooms, a first step toward reconstructing the 3D spaces people see.

articles.title: Can Entanglement-Induced Feature-Map Designs Improve Projected Quantum Kernels?
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31260v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Projected quantum kernels (PQKs) have emerged as a notable approach to circumvent the hardness of machine learning tasks arising from the exponential dimensionality of the quantum Hilbert space. However, recent PQK studies often rely heavily on extensive classical hyperparameter tuning of the radial basis function (RBF) kernel parameter and the support vector machine regularization parameter. The extensive tuning can mask the true representational power of the underlying PQKs induced by quantum feature maps, which has not been explored in detail. Thus, this work aims to expose the structural capabilities of PQKs by isolating and evaluating their native inductive bias through comparisons between untuned and tuned PQKs against the RBF baseline. Furthermore, we propose novel quantum feature maps that leverage two-qubit entanglement to capture multivariate correlations in IoT data. The results show that extensive tuning can lead to competitive performance architectures, while our proposed entanglement topologies exhibit a significantly stronger native inductive bias. This reveals that superior quantum architectural design can yield structurally better PQKs with improvements arising from quantum-mechanical properties rather than from classical hyperparameter tuning.

articles.title: Automatic Differentiation for Inference on Partially Observed Markov Process Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.03085v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Automatic differentiation (AD) has driven recent advances in machine learning, including deep neural networks and Hamiltonian Markov Chain Monte Carlo methods. Partially observed nonlinear stochastic dynamical systems have proved resistant to AD techniques because widely used particle filter algorithms yield an estimated likelihood function that is discontinuous as a function of the model parameters. To resolve this, we create a theoretical framework that embeds two existing AD particle filter methods within a new class of algorithms. This new class permits a bias-variance tradeoff and hence a mean squared error substantially lower than the existing algorithms. This allows us to develop likelihood maximization algorithms suited to the Monte Carlo properties of the AD gradient estimate. Our algorithms require only a differentiable simulator for the latent dynamic system; by contrast, most previous approaches to AD likelihood maximization for particle filters require access to the system's transition probabilities. Numerical results indicate that a hybrid algorithm, using AD to refine a coarse solution from an iterated filtering algorithm, shows substantial improvement on current state-of-the-art methods on a challenging scientific benchmark problem.

articles.title: Reducing QPU Calls in Variational Quantum Algorithms via Classical Offloading of Gradient Computation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.16361v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) are a promising approach for leveraging near-term quantum computers, but trainability and quantum-resource costs remain major challenges. Here we address these challenges with the Hardware Efficient and dynamical LIe algebra supported Ansatz (HELIA) and two training methods combining the classical-enhanced g method with the quantum-based Parameter-Shift Rule (PSR). This distributes gradient estimation and training across classical and quantum hardware. We evaluate ground-state estimation of 6- to 18-qubit Hamiltonians using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) and quantum phase classification for Hamiltonians up to 12 qubits. For VQE, our methods improve accuracy and success rates, with a mean reduction in estimated logical quantum evaluations of up to 60% relative to Full-PSR training of the same ansatz. For classification, the largest improvement in mean peak test accuracy relative to Full-PSR is 2.8 percentage points. We also use these methods as a warm-start pretraining strategy for Hamiltonians with exponential-dimensional dynamical Lie algebras. Gradient diagnostics for the studied Hamiltonian configurations show slower gradient-variance decay than the selected deep hardware-efficient reference over the simulated system sizes, potentially paving the way for training large-qubit quantum models.

articles.title: Nested Sampling: A Critical and Comprehensive Theoretical Guide
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.17916v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The nested sampling (NS) technique has gained widespread attention, particularly in cosmology and astronomy, due to its ability to efficiently explore high-likelihood regions - a feature akin to an implicit likelihood optimization that underlies its success. While the full theoretical derivation of NS is complex and involves several approximations, the central challenge lies in sampling from the likelihood-constrained priors, which is crucial for its performance. This work provides a comprehensive and detailed exposition of NS derivation, clarifying both its theoretical foundations and practical challenges. We provide a thorough description of the NS procedure, emphasizing both its strengths and potential limitations. The connections between NS, importance sampling (IS), and vertical Monte Carlo are also discussed in detail. In doing so, this work seeks to deepen understanding of the method and to foster the development of future enhancements, novel variants, and more efficient implementations across a wide range of scientific applications. Thus, the main contribution of this work is twofold: it serves both as a tutorial for newcomers to the field and as a critical review for experienced practitioners.

articles.title: Accelerating Wildfire Hazard Mapping Across Canada with an AI Surrogate Modelling Framework
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Canada's increasing wildfire activity requires frequent national hazard mapping to guide proactive mitigation, including fuel management, land-use planning, infrastructure protection, and evacuation routing. However, process-based wildfire simulation frameworks (e.g., BurnP3 and BurnP3+) rely on computationally intensive Monte Carlo simulations to model burn probability, fire intensity, and rate of spread. These workflows can take days to weeks to process a single regional modelling unit. To overcome these computational bottlenecks, we present three contributions developed through collaboration between AI researchers and wildfire modelling experts: (a) a standardized framework for training, fine-tuning, and evaluating AI surrogate models against process-based wildfire simulators; (b) a multi-task deep learning surrogate trained on national-scale data to emulate burn probability, mean fire intensity, and mean rate of spread at a fraction of the computational cost (seconds); and (c) domain-specific metrics and counterfactual evaluation protocols to probe out-of-distribution generalization. Integrating geospatial data (fuel, terrain, ignition likelihood) and regional weather, our model approximates BurnP3+ simulation outputs, achieving strong performance across agreement, rank-correlation, error, and spatial-overlap metrics. It preserves downstream hazard classifications and produces physically plausible responses to expert-informed counterfactual interventions. On a representative region, the surrogate achieves 806-fold end-to-end CPU acceleration and uses 13% of BurnP3+'s host memory, facilitating rapid scenario analysis.

articles.title: Reducing Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Forecast Error through Tree-Anchored Expert Combination
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31248v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A strong direct tree model may remain the best standalone photovoltaic forecaster, yet a weighted combination can reduce its residual errors. We examine whether complementary temporal predictors can lower the tree's mean absolute error (MAE) over 15--240 minutes without weaker ensemble members degrading performance. The candidate bank contains LightGBM and seven neural implementations with different temporal representations. A combiner fitted to MAE has nonnegative weights that sum to one. Unhelpful candidates can receive zero weight, while the tree anchors the combination and provides a development-stage fallback. The main design shares weights across horizons; horizon-specific weights and alternative losses test whether further complexity is needed. On 56,078 windows from two co-located public PVDAQ systems, the historical shared-MAE policy reduces scaled MAE by 3.21% relative to the tree. The latest bounded neural correction does not reduce MAE further than this static combination. The results support selective combination of complementary predictions in this bank rather than equal averaging or indiscriminate addition of modules. Both analyses reuse a previously inspected evaluation period. They do not establish independent replication, weather-specific causation or universal gains from eight experts.

articles.title: Jev-DLC: Decision-Level Continual Learning from Typed Feedback
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31521v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Individual preferences often become visible only after deployment, when a user accepts one decision or revokes it in favor of another. Jev-style typed interfaces make this feedback explicit by identifying the selected action and, under revocation, the decision it replaces. We study how these consequences persist across requests as Decision-Level Continual Learning from Typed Feedback (Jev-DLC). Jev-DLC treats each correction as both evidence about a recurring action identity and a directed relation between the preferred and rejected choices. It preserves these signals in complementary bounded channels above a frozen scorer and combines their scores to shape the next decision. The method retains no raw interaction history, adds no scorer call, and performs no runtime language-model backward pass. We also introduce TCPA-Bench, a chronological suite that credits a correction only through its effect on later decisions. On TCPA-Repeat, Jev-DLC reaches 44.83% user-macro accuracy overall, 2.43 points above Recent-4 history replay. After at least two earlier feedback events, it reaches 56.07%, a 7.54-point margin over the strongest reported comparison at this depth. These results show how explicit typed corrections can become compact causal state for continual personalization.

articles.title: Who Is Sycophantic to Whom? Confident LLMs, Human Deference, and the Collapse of Trust Calibration
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31579v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Research on sycophancy asks whether large language models (LLMs) bend towards what their users want to hear. We ask the reverse question: when an LLM is confident, consistent, and wrong, do users bend towards it? In a within-subjects experiment, 32 participants learned up to five science topics by chatting with five assistants built on the same model (GPT-5-mini). Unknown to participants, each assistant's briefing had 0, 25, 50, 75, or 100% of its facts replaced by plausible falsehoods, and every assistant spoke with full confidence. A surprise quiz after each topic offered the correct fact, the planted falsehood, and two distractors, with a confidence rating for every answer. Across 104 quizzes and 1,040 answers, scores fell from 7.4 to 2.9 out of 10, and the planted option was chosen on 60% of falsified items against 11% of correctly taught ones (odds ratio 12.5). Transcript coding showed that whenever the assistant stated a falsehood, it was adopted about 65% of the time at every falsification level. Absorbed falsehoods were held with high confidence (8.4/10), the modeled confidence advantage of right over wrong answers vanished, and the discrimination of confidence for correctness fell from an AUROC of 0.70 to chance, while post-task trust ratings barely moved. Participants tended to return to the chat more when the assistant was worse, but returning went with more absorption, not less, and 30% of all turns pasted quiz questions back to the source being checked. The assistant itself was almost never sycophantic and never conceded under pushback. We introduce a baseline-corrected Human Deference Index to quantify this human-side sycophancy and argue that trustworthiness is a property of the human-AI pair, that sycophancy evaluations should measure both directions, and that learning interfaces must make reliability legible claim by claim.

articles.title: The roles of nonharmonic damping and spatial correlation of atomic movements in determining the amplitudes and attenuation frequencies of electro-optic coefficients
articles.abstract: Large electro-optic coefficients make ferroelectric materials attractive for high-speed optical modulation in optical communication. However, in materials like barium titanate this coefficient decreases markedly with increasing modulation frequency. This decrease can limit the bandwidth of electro-optic modulators, making it essential to understand the underlying attenuation mechanism. In this paper, we find that it is the nonharmonic damping of the phonon modes, instead of the phonon mode frequency itself, that plays an important role in determining both the amplitude of the low-frequency electro-optic coefficient and its attenuation frequency.
