articles.title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate multi-horizon photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential for grid stability, energy scheduling, and the efficient operation of PVbatterygrid systems. However, existing models often fail to jointly capture short-term variability and long-term temporal patterns, while lacking unified multi-horizon capability and interpretability. To address these limitations, this study proposes a novel hybrid deep learning framework that integrates a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and N-BEATS within an attention-based fusion architecture. The proposed model leverages TFT to learn short-term temporal dependencies and dynamic feature importance, while N-BEATS captures long-term trend and seasonal components through interpretable basis decomposition. An adaptive attention mechanism dynamically fuses both branches, enabling balanced multi-scale learning. The framework simultaneously generates forecasts for 30-minute, 2-hour, 6-hour, 12-hour, and 24-hour horizons within a single unified pipeline. The model is evaluated using multi-year real-world datasets from the Desert Knowledge Australia Solar Centre (DKASC). Experimental results demonstrate superior performance over statistical, machine learning, and deep learning baselines. The proposed model achieves RMSE values of 42.35, 46.27, 52.29, and 48.11 across the 20162017, 2023, 2024, and 20252026 datasets, respectively, corresponding to a 3540% reduction compared to the best baseline (TFT). Additionally, MAPE remains below 5% across all datasets, indicating high predictive accuracy and stability. The model also provides interpretability through attention visualization and trendseasonality decomposition, and is deployed on a cloud-based platform for real-time forecasting. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework is robust, interpretable, and suitable for practical renewable energy applications.

articles.title: Decision Sufficiency of Learned Representation Interfaces for Safe Generative Control
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A controller can guide a language model toward safe and useful responses by choosing when to assist, ask for clarification, or refuse. When the controller uses selected internal features, poor performance alone cannot distinguish missing information from limitations of its decision rules or training. We study decision sufficiency: whether the best controller using a representation can match the minimum average loss attainable with full state information, under the same strategies and evaluation criteria. For interfaces with finitely many outputs, we compute the optimal loss exactly and separate the three sources of excess loss. Pairwise checks can miss information loss: states with the same controller input may share an optimal strategy in every pair but not across the whole group. We bound the number of states needed to reveal a conflict and characterize the fewest outputs an unrestricted interface needs to avoid all conflicts. We audit selected features from sparse autoencoders, which encode model activations using relatively few active features, in Qwen2.5, SmolLM2, and Phi. On SmolLM2 responses scored by two human raters, restricting the controller to two selected on/off features increases its minimum average loss by 0.0345--0.1166 relative to full state information, even with the governing policy supplied. Both independently trained autoencoders show the increase on both evaluation sets. The audit identifies decision failures that require changing the controller's input, not merely its architecture or training.

articles.title: TRCM: Topology-Aware Route-Consistency Modeling for Robust Neural Vehicle Routing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural combinatorial optimization has enabled fast constructive solvers for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), yet most autoregressive models still construct solutions through sequential node selection and represent route organization only implicitly. We investigate whether route-level customer co-assignment can be modeled explicitly and used to guide this node-level decision process. To this end, we propose TopologyAware RouteConsistency Modeling (TRCM), which reuses node representations from a standard autoregressive construction pipeline to predict pairwise same-route probabilities and injects them into customer selection as a route-consistency signal. Because sameroute supervision is both class-imbalanced and structurally uneven, TRCM combines structure-preserving augmentation with Topological Entropy (TE)- based reweighting to emphasize locally ambiguous customer pairs. Under matched decoding budgets, TRCM reduces the optimality gap from 3.67% to 3.28% on CVRP50 and from 2.11% to 1.99% on CVRP100; under 8-fold augmented inference, it reduces the CVRP100 gap from 1.61% to 1.49%. On XML100, TRCM*8Aug improves the average objective by 0.24%, with larger gains on several structurally informative factors. A controlled demand-reassignment test over 500 variants further shows more concentrated objective fluctuations. These results support explicit route-consistency modeling as an effective structural principle for autoregressive neural routing.

articles.title: Learning Inter-Graph Interactions Between Heterogeneous Substructures of Chemical Systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Complex chemical systems containing heterogeneous substructures are common in real-world applications. Various physical phenomena of the complex chemical systems are derived from the interactions between the heterogeneous substructures. However, existing graph representation learning methods for inter-graph interactions assumed graph-level interactions between homogeneous structures, such as organic molecules and inorganic crystalline materials. We propose a data descriptor of the complex chemical systems and a graph neural network for learning inter-graph interactions between organic and inorganic compounds. We applied the proposed method to predict the physical properties of hybrid solar cell materials containing heterogeneous substructures, which have received significant attention for sustainable energy resources. By learning heterogeneous inter-graph interactions, the proposed method achieved state-of-the-art accuracy in predicting band gaps of 1,682 hybrid solar cell materials.

articles.title: Foundation-Style Pretraining for Scalable and Transferable Distributed PV Forecasting
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27763v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid growth of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation is increasing the demand for accurate forecasting across large numbers of geographically dispersed stations. Existing approaches are commonly developed for individual sites or specific forecasting horizons, requiring repeated training and maintenance as new stations are integrated and limiting direct reuse at previously unseen sites. To address this scalability gap, this paper presents a domain-specific foundation-style pretraining framework that learns a shared forecasting model from heterogeneous multi-site and multi-horizon PV data. NWP-assisted forecasting is formulated as a sequence-completion problem that unifies historical PV power, meteorological observations, future numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts, and time encodings. Three pretraining objectives are designed and systematically evaluated, including forecast-aligned reconstruction, generic reconstruction, and mixed reconstruction. The mixed objective combines the operational structure of PV forecasting with random sequence reconstruction and provides the most balanced performance across forecasting accuracy, degraded NWP conditions, and downstream adaptation. Experiments on 479 distributed PV stations use 340 stations for model development and 139 spatially held-out stations for zero-shot evaluation. Across horizons from 6 hours to 7 days, the multi-site pretrained MR model outperforms representative station-specific and shared baselines, as well as generalist time-series models, including a recent large-scale pretrained foundation model. The pretrained model can also be directly deployed at new PV stations and subsequently adapted to region-specific operational objectives when local data become available, providing a scalable forecasting paradigm for large distributed PV fleets.

articles.title: From Generic to Dedicated: A Novel Optimizer for Online Continual Learning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27835v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Online Continual Learning (OCL) requires models to learn from non-stationary data streams under a strict single-pass constraint, making them highly susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. While existing studies have explored various strategies from data, architecture, and optimization perspectives, the optimizer often directly uses generic approaches such as SGD and AdamW. In this work, we reveal a new link between optimization dynamics and OCL needs by recasting Polyak-Ruppert averaging as the engine of "plasticity" and Primal averaging as the anchor of "stability". This inspires our novel optimizer, SPIN (Stability-Plasticity INterpolation), which explicitly decouples plasticity and stability by interpolating between a fast-moving "plasticity" sequence and an adaptive "stability" sequence. We theoretically demonstrate that SPIN implicitly employs an inverse Hessian approximation, providing crucial Tikhonov regularization to damp noisy, single-sample Hessian estimates and mitigate forgetting. More importantly, SPIN can be seamlessly integrated into existing OCL methods by taking resulted gradients as input and replacing standard optimizers. Extensive experiments show that using SPIN instead of standard optimizers yields consistent and significant performance gains across multiple OCL approaches, including the challenging rehearsal-free setting and under strict memory constraints.

articles.title: Geometry-Agnostic Data-Driven Discovery of Extreme Scenarios
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28487v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a two-stage data-driven neural framework for discovering dynamically admissible extreme scenarios. Rather than assuming prior knowledge of the governing equations, the first stage infers the effective dynamical constraints directly from observational data. When the underlying physical system possesses suitable symmetries, the learned dynamics can be represented in a geometry-agnostic form, independent of any fixed grid, coordinate system, dimensionality, and intrinsic curvature. In the second stage, a physics-informed neural-search uses this learned dynamics to uncover rare, high-impact coherent structures that may not have appeared in the original observations. We demonstrate this framework through representative examples of increasing dimensionality and geometric complexity. Starting from a traditionally learned Duffing dynamics, we find a homoclinic pulse as a plausible localized extreme scenario. Next, since the same equation also appears in the stationary nonlinear Schrodinger system, with the coordinate interpreted as space instead of time, this pulse becomes a standing soliton. We then retrain the first stage using a geometry-agnostic neural representation, enabling the learned dynamics to be lifted to higher-dimensional space to obtain higher-dimensional solitary profile, known as Townes soliton. Finally, with a Liouville system, we demonstrate that dynamics learned from data on a (1+1)-dimensional Lorentzian quasi-manifold can be transferred to a (2+0)-dimensional Euclidean manifold to identify an instanton. Our approach can be applied to other coherent spatiotemporal structures, including kinks, rogue waves, compactons, peakons, and potentially even singularities, with applications in risk analysis, nonlinear forecasting, and anomaly detection.

articles.title: PaPi: Parallel Picard-Duhamel Integration for Fast Neuro-Spectral Architectures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neuro-spectral architectures (NeuSA) are a class of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that have proven effective for solving time-dependent PDEs in the frequency domain. However, training and inference often rely on costly numerical integration of the learned vector field, typically using sequential Runge-Kutta time stepping, which limits temporal parallelism. We introduce PaPi, an integration scheme inspired by weakly nonlinear flows that enables time-Parallel inference through exponential integration and a Duhamel-Picard scheme. We show that the Duhamel-Picard iteration converges exponentially for all flows, and provide explicit error bounds that depend on how close the flow is to linear. Experiments show that PaPi accelerates training and inference by up to two orders of magnitude, achieving training times of under one second for low-dimensional PDE learning problems, while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy.

articles.title: Planning under Noise with Neural Operators
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28623v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: Planning under uncertain control execution noise requires reliable feedback policies across diverse environments. We introduce Planning Under Noise (PUN), a neural operator that learns noise-aware value fields for planning in unseen geometries. Building on an established screened-Poisson formulation of stochastic optimal control, we address two challenges: specifying boundary conditions that support navigation across varying geometries and efficiently computing fields with reliable gradients. Zero-Dirichlet obstacle boundaries terminate sampled paths at walls, weakening the goal signal along long routes and making it harder to estimate reliably. We instead impose reflecting Neumann conditions on obstacles and a Dirichlet condition at the goal, allowing sampled paths to continue exploring free space until they reach the target. To solve the resulting PDE without a configuration-space mesh, we extend a Monte Carlo (MC) solver, Walk on Stars (WoSt), to higher dimensions. However, local MC fluctuations can reverse estimated gradient directions and cause planning failures, making direct planning require costly sampling. PUN amortizes this computation by learning geometry-to-field mappings from noisy, partially converged Monte Carlo labels, avoiding expensive convergence for every training example. At inference, test-time scaling uses bounded local search guided by the predicted global field. We evaluate PUN on planning tasks across dimensions. Across four noise levels, PUN matches or outperforms all compared planners, achieving 95-100% success on the 4D replanning benchmark while maintaining the lowest runtime. At the highest tested noise level in 4D, PUN achieves 10.7-60.6% relative gains in success rate over other methods while running 3.29-32.15 times faster.

articles.title: This is SParTA: A modular, efficient and scalable transformer architecture for jet-tagging
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27106v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present the Sparse Particle-interaction Transformer Architecture (SParTA), a modular, scalable, and efficient transformer for jet tagging at high-energy colliders. Exploiting the steeply falling transverse-momentum (p_T) spectrum of jet constituents, SParTA factorizes constituent processing into two topological regimes. Ordered by descending p_T, only the N hardest constituents (the hard core) participate in quadratic O(N²) differential interaction attention driven by pairwise physical and learned relational features. The remaining soft constituents are integrated via linear O(lN) cross-attention to the hard core, preserving soft-radiation and color-flow information while avoiding the O(l²) memory bottleneck of full self-attention over all l constituents. Pairwise interaction features are computed dynamically in-network from constituent four-momenta and conditioned on global jet-level substructure observables. On the quark-gluon tagging benchmark, a 300K-parameter SParTA model achieves an AUC of 92.02% and accuracy of 85.06%, matching the 2.14M-parameter Particle Transformer (ParT) at one-seventh the parameter count and outperforming IAFormer by 21% in background rejection at 30% signal efficiency. On the boosted top-tagging benchmark, SParTA outperforms ParT and ParticleNet with 511K parameters, while we analyze the architectural trade-offs relative to fully dense multi-layer interaction networks.

articles.title: Towards Interaction State Recognition in Sensorized Gecko-Inspired Adhesive Interfaces for Orbital Servicing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27141v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reliable contact establishment remains a critical challenge for autonomous on-orbit servicing (OOS), particularly when interacting with non-cooperative targets. Gecko-inspired dry adhesives provide a lightweight, passive, and residue-free solution for robotic capture in space, yet current systems operate in open loop, without the ability to estimate their own contact or adhesion state during interaction. This paper presents a real-time interaction-awareness framework that enables sensorized gecko-inspired adhesive interfaces to estimate their contact state throughout the adhesion lifecycle using embedded capacitive sensing. Five discrete interaction states (idle, proximity, contact, engaged, and disengaged) are classified using experimentally collected and augmented sensor data, enabling a comparative evaluation of six lightweight machine learning models suitable for embedded deployment. Among the evaluated models, Random Forest achieved the highest offline classification accuracy of 95.65%. For online deployment, combining Random Forest with a rule-based state machine improved accuracy from 78.02% to 93.14%, achieving a macro F1-score of 0.9343 while maintaining a 53 ms inference cycle. These results demonstrate that incorporating physics-consistent state constraints significantly improves robustness during realtime inference, representing a step toward interaction-aware capture in future autonomous orbital servicing missions.

articles.title: Low Residuals, Wrong Value: Learning the Viscosity Solution of Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs Equations with PINNs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27193v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and other residual-trained solvers judge a candidate solution by the size of its sampled PDE residual. For first-order Hamilton-Jacobi equations this is not sufficient: the same equation and boundary data admit Lipschitz almost-everywhere solutions that differ from the viscosity solution by O(1) while violating the equation only on sets of measure zero. We study whether residual minimization selects such solutions in a fixed-horizon pursuit-evasion game whose Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs value function is known in closed form on the circle S¹ and on the flat tori T² and T⁴. We train four neural parameterizations with ten seeds on each geometry, 120 runs in total. A standard network with periodic Fourier features converges to folded almost-everywhere solutions in all 30 runs: small residuals and the expected capture-layer gradient, yet values that are wrong over most of the domain. A network with periodicity imposed through the loss recovers the viscosity solution in one and two dimensions but becomes unreliable in four. Two parameterizations that receive the geodesic distance do substantially better: a single network fed the wrapped displacement and its distance recovers the viscosity solution in all 30 runs, while a minimum over periodic image charts succeeds in 27 of 30 and introduces a wrong-image failure mode. Finally, for the convex Hamiltonian considered here, we use the semiconcavity of the viscosity solution to build a mesh-free finite-difference test that needs only forward network evaluations; it detects the folded solutions and the harmful min-of-charts failures without access to the exact value function. A small sampled residual thus does not by itself validate a learned Hamilton-Jacobi solution; the parameterization and independent structural diagnostics can be essential for selecting the viscosity solution.

articles.title: EMBER: Predicting TCR--pMHC Binding Without a Docked Complex
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27334v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose EMBER, a structure-based framework for TCR--pMHC binding prediction that eliminates the need for a predicted docked complex, and with it the placement error that dominates such predictions. Traditional structure-based predictors utilize the co-folded complex structure of the receptor and the antigen and interpret binding from its contact surface. Consequently, every downstream feature inherits any deviation the structure-prediction tool introduced. Methodologically, EMBER folds the TCR and pMHC independently, encodes them as SE(3)-invariant residue graphs, and compares their learned representations without constructing a shared coordinate frame. A relative pose is therefore not an input of the model, so placement error cannot propagate into the prediction. Computationally, EMBER preprocesses O(N+M) monomer folds where a complex-based predictor needs O(NM) operations. Experimentally, under epitope-disjoint evaluation with six retrained baselines, EMBER is first on every metric under all four folding tools, by 0.9 to 14.4% in micro-AUROC, 18.5 to 25.3% in micro-AUPRC and 10.6 to 24.1% in MCC. Its ranking is also up to 85% more stable across folding tools.

articles.title: Soliton Profiles in 1D: Enhanced Neural-Network Solvers and Constrained Deep Ritz Methods
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27500v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop and compare enhanced neural-network solvers for one-dimensional ground-state profiles, which are solutions of  Qprⁱmeprⁱme=bQ-γ Qp,quad Q>0,quad p>1, quad b, γ >0,  the stationary profile equation for the nonlinear Schrödinger, generalized Korteweg-de Vries, and nonlinear Klein-Gordon equations. Its explicit sech-type solutions serve as exact reference for error computation and benchmark hyperparameter selection. We improve on the standard Adam-trained physics-informed neural network (PINN) baseline by introducing higher-order optimization via Gauss-Newton/Levenberg-Marquardt and L-BFGS refinements, as well as Fourier-feature PINNs, and constrained Deep Ritz (DR) formulations. In DR approaches we introduce two new neural-network formulations, which implement two classical variational characterizations: a Nehari-constrained Deep Ritz method, in which the height is learned by projecting onto the Nehari/Pokhozhaev manifold, and a Weinstein Deep Ritz method, in which a normalized profile minimizes the Weinstein quotient. The Deep Ritz formulations perform best overall, in particular, the Weinstein variant gives the best error-runtime balance. The neural-network based solvers remain less accurate and efficient than classical Petviashvili iteration in 1D, however, the current study provides a proof of concept: the mesh-free formulation, non-reliance on exact profiles or the related features make them promising in higher dimensions and for more complicated nonlinearities and dispersive operators.

articles.title: Factual Access States in Diffusion Language Models: From Mechanism to Knowledge Editing and Retrieval
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27580v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Factual recall is a lookup: some representation inside the network serves as the key, and what that key is made of decides which queries can retrieve the fact, what an edit must cover, and what a retriever can read. We call it the factual access state. In autoregressive (AR) models the subject position enriches attributes largely independently of the relation, and relation-specific selection happens later, at the readout position. In masked diffusion language models (DLMs) we find the state is assembled differently, and much earlier: in the first attention layer the wording of the relation is routed into the position of whichever entity is visible and the early feed-forward layers look the fact up on this fused representation. The state therefore varies with the relation's surface form and with the query direction, so the queries about one fact occupy a region of state space rather than a point, and an operation on the fact succeeds only for queries that enter it. We treat the state as an interface to a DLM's factual knowledge, and put it to two uses. Writing to the state gives a knowledge editor: from one declarative statement, Multi-View Edit fits one shared value per direction across that region and installs it in the early-MLP block, preserving source-prompt reliability while substantially improving paraphrase and reverse question answering, where AR editors gain near zero. Reading it suggests a complementary use: the state at each entity position can serve as a relation-specific retrieval vector with no training, returning both pieces of evidence for two-entity queries on which pooled, prompted and lexical retrievers almost never return both.

articles.title: You Are the Trigger: Speaker-Activated Backdoors
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27210v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Speech models are increasingly used as an interface to AI systems, from transcription tools to voice agents. Existing audio backdoors require an attacker to introduce triggers at inference time. We study a different threat model in which the attacker compromises the model during fine-tuning but has no access to the victim's inference-time inputs. We introduce the Speaker-Activated Backdoor (SAB) setting, in which a target speaker's natural voice serves as the trigger. We develop a two-phase fine-tuning method that first makes speaker identity more accessible and then binds the target speaker to an attacker-chosen payload. Compared with a one-phase baseline with the same training budget, the two-phase method substantially improves selectivity and clean performance, and is especially important for content-dependent attacks. SAB achieves 90.2% and 97.0% backdoor success on Whisper-medium and Parakeet, with false-positive rates of 1.7% and 0%, respectively using as little as two minutes of real audio from the target speaker. We further demonstrate content-dependent semantic rewriting and downstream tool-use attacks, where malicious instructions are inserted into 96.9% of target-speaker transcripts. When these transcripts are passed to frontier LLM agents, GPT-4o and Claude (Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku), the injected instruction drives the agent to carry out the harmful action in up to 87.5% of cases. The attack generalizes to held-out recordings, multiple target speakers, and common acoustic degradations. These results establish speaker identity as a practical backdoor trigger that requires no inference-time attacker access and is invisible at the transcript layer.

articles.title: Second-order magnetic properties in paramagnetic molecules from a current density formulation including scalar relativistic effects
articles.abstract: This work presents the theoretical background for the computation of nuclear magnetic shielding, nuclear hyperfine, and magnetizability tensors of paramagnetic molecules using a magnetically induced current density framework to account for both orbital and spin contributions. The resulting magnetizability tensor is fully consistent with the general Van Vleck formulation, recovering the temperature-dependent Curie contribution through the explicit integration of the magnetically induced spin current density. The methodology proposed herein provides a straightforward computational route that bypasses the complex evaluation of g-tensors and zero-field splitting Hamiltonians. While the theoretical framework is general, we present applications rooted in physically motivated approximations where scalar relativistic effects are incorporated through corrections based on the zeroth-order regular approximation Hamiltonian within the ground-state spin density. This approach combines a relativistic self-consistent field calculation for the ground-state spin density with a non-relativistic, origin-independent current density calculation for the orbital contribution. This hybrid strategy is shown to capture the heavy-atom light-atom effect in 1 H and 13 C shieldings, particularly in paramagnetic molecular systems containing transition metals up to the 3d series. By restricting the relativistic treatment to the spin density, where scalar relativistic effects are dominant, and neglecting such effects on the orbital contribution of light atoms, this method offers a good compromise between computational efficiency and accuracy for the characterization of large open-shell molecular systems.

articles.title: First-principles description of pumped inelastic x-ray scattering: Example of K-edge RIXS in graphite
articles.abstract: We present an ab initio framework for predicting resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) in optically pumped materials. Our methodology is based on the Kramers–Heisenberg formula for the double-differential cross section formulated using the results of the Bethe–Salpeter equation from many-body perturbation theory. To extend this approach to the time domain, we incorporate non-equilibrium charge-carrier distributions obtained from real-time, time-dependent density-functional theory. Generalizing the RIXS implementation with respect to arbitrary polarizations allows us to consider different orientations of incoming and outgoing light. We demonstrate our method’s capabilities by studying RIXS at the K-edge of graphite for various non-equilibrium charge-carrier distributions, representing different delay times after optical pumping. Our results reveal angular dependencies in π - and σ -orbital-derived spectral regions, in good agreement with the experiment.

articles.title: Quantum tunneling on water. III. An asymmetric Marcus-based electron-transfer model for microdroplet redox chemistry
articles.abstract: Water microdroplets support a broad range of spontaneous redox reactions at rates that often exceed expectations from bulk solution, yet a microscopic framework that is both mechanistic and quantitatively predictive across diverse acceptors remains lacking. In Parts I and II [C. Zhuang, N. Qian, and W. Min, J. Chem. Phys. 164 (22), 224709 (2026) and J. Chem. Phys. 164 (22), 224710 (2026)] of this series, we described microdroplet redox chemistry as concerted electron tunneling from partially solvated interfacial hydroxide to acceptors within a symmetric Marcus framework. Here, we extend this picture to an asymmetric, solvation-state-dependent framework in which reactant- and product-side reorganization energies are unequal and evolve along the interfacial dehydration coordinate. This generalization captures the partial breakdown of a single linear-response solvent coordinate at heterogeneous water interfaces and yields a corresponding asymmetric rate expression. Reanalysis of previously studied acceptors confirms consistency with the earlier symmetric model, while revealing that asymmetry becomes decisive in strongly imbalanced cases. Proton reduction by interfacial hydroxide provides a striking example: charge recombination generates highly unequal solvation responses and alters the predicted kinetics by orders of magnitude. Comparison with three independent experimental datasets yields rate estimates in encouraging agreement with experiment, supporting proton reduction as a baseline pathway of intrinsic microdroplet reactivity. A paired comparison of pyridine and benzene further defines a practical boundary for interfacial redox observability. Finally, parity analysis of all acceptors examined across this series shows broad quantitative agreement between predicted and experimentally inferred rate constants. Together, these results establish an asymmetric Marcus framework as a more faithful and predictive theory of electron transfer at heterogeneous water interfaces.

articles.title: Multi-Excitation Front-Face Fluorescence Spectroscopy with Explainable LSTM for Detection of Lymphatic Tissue Adulteration in Ground Beef
articles.title_zh: 多激发正面荧光光谱与可解释的 LSTM 用于检测碎牛肉中的淋巴组织掺假
articles.abstract: Minced beef adulterated with lymphatic tissue presents food-safety, authenticity and economic concerns, optical detection is complicated by variation in fat content, lipid oxidation and muscle type that alter fluorescence independently of adulteration. We therefore combined multi-excitation front-face fluorescence with explainable long short-term memory (LSTM) network to improve specificity. A total of 824 minced beef samples from five commercial slaughterhouses, three breeds, two slaughter-age groups and three muscle cuts, were prepared; 11 spectral outliers were excluded, leaving 813 samples for analysis. Excitation-emission measurements at 280, 322, 340 and 380 nm sampled fluorescence associated with tryptophan, vitamin A, NADH, flavins, collagen cross-links and oxidation. Standard normal variate preprocessing and competitive adaptive reweighted sampling reduced the input variables from 188 to 86 channels, modelled using a shared weight four input LSTM. On the internal test set, model achieved R2P = 0.997, RMSEP = 1.60% w/w and RPD = 19.5. External validation demonstrated performance on two previously unseen slaughterhouses (R2P = 0.988–0.993, RMSEP = 2.60–3.35% w/w, RPD = 9.3–12.0). Interference study (n = 104) incorporating adipose tissue, saline, oxidation and muscle-cut variation, predicted lymphatic content remained below 0.5% w/w and met prespecified equivalence margin of ± 1.0% w/w. SHAP analysis identified increased NADH and reduced tryptophan associated fluorescence as influential predictors. Multi-batch detection limit was 1.8% w/w, whereas reliable quantification began at 6.0% w/w. These results support the use of multi-excitation fluorescence-LSTM analysis for screening lymphatic-tissue adulteration at concentrations relevant to the regulatory thresholds, while reliable quantification near 2% w/w and transferability across instruments remain to established

articles.title: Green Rosemary Extract-Mediated Synthesis of Ag/Co/La2O3/Chitosan Nanocomposite for Multifunctional Antibacterial Activity and Simultaneous Removal of Binary Dyes from Water
articles.title_zh: 绿迷迭香提取物介导合成具有多功能抗菌活性并同时去除水中二元染料的Ag/Co/La2O3/壳聚糖纳米复合材料
articles.abstract: The development of multifunctional nanocomposites capable of simultaneously addressing chemical and biological water contaminants represents an important strategy for sustainable wastewater treatment. Herein, we report a novel Ag/Co/La2O3/chitosan nanocomposite designed for the simultaneous photocatalytic removal of methylene blue (MB) and crystal violet (CV) from a 1:1 binary dye system, coupled with antibacterial activity against representative Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria. Structure analysis showed that the synthesized nanomaterial consisted of multiple phases of Ag/AgCl, Co(OH)2, La2O3, and La(OH)3, with enhanced dispersion of nanoparticles and improved surface properties with the use of chitosan. The energy band gap reduced from 3.89 eV in Ag/Co/La2O3 NC to 2.94 eV in CS-NC, and there was an increase in the zeta potential from + 8.19 to + 13.78 mV. The CS-NC possessed excellent antibacterial properties and produced ROS in a dose-dependent manner, having a maximum inhibition zone (22 mm) against S. epidermidis. In binary MB and CV removal, 97.5 ± 0.7% and 94.0 ± 0.9% removal efficiencies were attained, respectively, using 0.50 g L− 1 of CS-NC under pH 9.0, 25 ± 1°C, and 180 min under UV-A irradiation. Kinetic data were best described by the pseudo-second-order model (R2 = 0.9998 for MB and 0.9996 for CV), while Langmuir analysis gave apparent maximum capacities of 75.925 and 75.062 mg g− 1. After seven cycles, 93.85% and 88.09% of the initial MB and CV removal efficiencies were retained, respectively. Limited Ag and Co release further supports its stability. Generally, this greenly fabricated multifunctional nanocomposite offers a promising, reusable, and environmentally relevant platform for integrated antimicrobial and dye-contaminated wastewater treatment.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 开发能够同时解决化学和生物水污染物的多功能纳米复合材料是可持续废水处理的重要策略。在此，我们报道了一种新型Ag/Co/La2O3/壳聚糖纳米复合材料，设计用于同时光催化去除1:1二元染料系统中的亚甲蓝（MB）和结晶紫（CV），并具有针对代表性革兰氏阴性和革兰氏阳性细菌的抗菌活性。结构分析表明，合成的纳米材料由Ag/AgCl、Co(OH)2、La2O3和La(OH)3多相组成，壳聚糖的使用增强了纳米颗粒的分散性并改善了表面性能。能带隙从Ag/Co/La2O3 NC的3.89 eV减小到CS-NC的2.94 eV，zeta电位从+ 8.19增加到+ 13.78 mV。 CS-NC具有优异的抗菌性能，并以剂量依赖性方式产生ROS，对表皮葡萄球菌具有最大抑制区（22毫米）。在二元 MB 和 CV 去除中，使用 0.50 g L− 1 的 CS-NC，在 pH 9.0、25±1°C 和 UV-A 照射下 180 分钟，去除效率分别为 97.5±0.7% 和 94.0±0.9%。伪二阶模型可以最好地描述动力学数据（MB 的 R2 = 0.9998，CV 的 R2 = 0.9996），而 Langmuir 分析给出的表观最大容量为 75.925 和 75.062 mg g− 1。七个循环后，初始 MB 和 CV 去除效率分别保留了 93.85% 和 88.09%。有限的银和钴释放进一步支撑了其稳定性。一般来说，这种绿色制造的多功能纳米复合材料为集成抗菌和染料污染废水处理提供了一个有前景、可重复使用且与环境相关的平台。

articles.title: Frequency-Dependent Characteristics of Intermuscular Functional Networks During Continuous Single-Leg Hopping
articles.title_zh: 连续单腿跳跃过程中肌间功能网络的频率相关特征
articles.abstract: Objective Continuous single-leg hopping requires the lower limb to repeatedly absorb impact, maintain postural stability, and generate propulsive force during successive landing–push-off cycles. However, conventional electromyographic measures primarily characterize the activation of individual muscles and provide limited information regarding the overall functional organization among multiple muscles. This study constructed intermuscular functional networks based on surface electromyography (sEMG) to investigate the frequency-dependent characteristics of lower-limb intermuscular connectivity during the stance phase of continuous single-leg hopping and to compare network organization between the dominant and non-dominant limbs.Methods Twenty-seven healthy male participants performed a continuous single-leg vertical hopping task. Bilateral sEMG signals were recorded from eight lower-limb muscles. Signals were extracted within the alpha (8–13 Hz), beta (14–30 Hz), and gamma (31–60 Hz) frequency bands. Eight-node weighted intermuscular functional networks were constructed using bias-corrected normalized mutual information (NMI). Mean NMI, weighted global efficiency, and weighted clustering coefficient were calculated, and network characteristics were compared across frequency bands and between the dominant and non-dominant limbs.Results Overall intermuscular connectivity was relatively greater in the alpha band, with particularly strong connections observed within the quadriceps, including RF–VM, RF–VL, and VM–VL. Mean NMI, weighted global efficiency, and weighted clustering coefficient generally decreased with increasing frequency. All three network metrics showed significant frequency effects in the dominant limb (P < 0.001), whereas only weighted global efficiency showed a significant frequency effect in the non-dominant limb (P = 0.004). No significant differences in network metrics were detected between the dominant and non-dominant limbs within the alpha, beta, or gamma frequency bands (P > 0.05).Conclusion Multi-muscle coordination during the stance phase of continuous single-leg hopping exhibited clear frequency-dependent organization. Lower-frequency activity was characterized by stronger overall intermuscular statistical dependence and greater network integration, while relatively strong intermuscular connections were mainly concentrated among the quadriceps muscles involved in knee extension and landing–push-off control. In the present sample of healthy males, Intermuscular network organization exhibited clear frequency-dependent characteristics, whereas no significant between-limb differences were detected within the examined frequency bands. NMI-based intermuscular functional network analysis provides information on multi-muscle statistical dependence and network-level organization beyond conventional single-muscle activation measures, and may provide a healthy reference for future comparisons of neuromuscular coordination during continuous hopping across injury, rehabilitation, and training conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 目的 连续单腿跳跃需要下肢在连续的着陆-推出循环中反复吸收冲击力、保持姿势稳定并产生推进力。然而，传统的肌电图测量主要表征单个肌肉的激活，并提供有关多个肌肉之间的整体功能组织的有限信息。本研究构建了基于表面肌电图（sEMG）的肌间功能网络，以研究连续单腿跳跃站立阶段下肢肌间连接的频率依赖性特征，并比较优势肢体和非优势肢体之间的网络组织。 方法 27 名健康男性参与者执行连续单腿垂直跳跃任务。从八个下肢肌肉记录双侧表面肌电信号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 目的 连续单腿跳跃需要下肢在连续的着陆-推出循环中反复吸收冲击力、保持姿势稳定并产生推进力。然而，传统的肌电图测量主要表征单个肌肉的激活，并提供有关多个肌肉之间的整体功能组织的有限信息。本研究构建了基于表面肌电图（sEMG）的肌间功能网络，以研究连续单腿跳跃站立阶段下肢肌间连接的频率依赖性特征，并比较优势肢体和非优势肢体之间的网络组织。 方法 27 名健康男性参与者执行连续单腿垂直跳跃任务。从八个下肢肌肉记录双侧表面肌电信号。在 α (8–13 Hz)、β (14–30 Hz) 和 gamma (31–60 Hz) 频段内提取信号。使用偏差校正归一化互信息（NMI）构建八节点加权肌间功能网络。计算平均 NMI、加权全局效率和加权聚类系数，并比较跨频段以及优势肢体和非优势肢体之间的网络特征。结果 总体肌间连接在 α 频段相对较高，在股四头肌内观察到特别强的连接，包括 RF-VM、RF-VL 和 VM-VL。平均 NMI、加权全局效率和加权聚类系数通常随着频率的增加而降低。所有三个网络指标均在优势肢体中显示出显着的频率效应（P  0.05）。结论连续单腿跳跃的站立阶段的多肌肉协调表现出明显的频率依赖性组织。低频活动的特点是整体肌间统计依赖性更强，网络整合程度更高，而相对较强的肌间连接主要集中在参与膝关节伸展和落地推离控制的股四头肌。在目前的健康男性样本中，肌间网络组织表现出明显的频率依赖性特征，而在检查的频带内没有检测到显着的肢体间差异。基于 NMI 的肌间功能网络分析提供了超越传统单肌肉激活措施的多肌肉统计依赖性和网络级组织的信息，并且可以为未来在跨损伤、康复和训练条件下连续跳跃过程中神经肌肉协调的比较提供健康的参考。

articles.abstract: Author(s): Owen Ganter, Tatjana Henrichs, Yassine Agarmani, Steffi Hartmann, Mark Kartsovnik, Stephen Winter, Michael Lang, and Jens Müller Uncovering hidden structural dynamics in an organic conductor Organic conductors host a remarkable interplay between molecular structure and electronic properties. In κ-(BETS) 2 Mn(N(CN) 2 ) 3 , a multiferroic candidate exhibiting electronic ferroelectricity below the metal-to-insulator transition at 25 K, we identify the microscopic origin of a long-standing anomaly near 100 K. Resistance noise spectroscopy, thermal expansion, and computational modeling reveal compelling evidence for a glass-like freezing of dicyanamide ligands in the anion layer. Despite occurring outside the conducting layer, this structural transition leaves a pronounced fingerprint on the charge-carrier dynamics. Our results demonstrate that slow structural fluctuations in the anion network can strongly influence electronic behavior, providing new insight into the role of donor-anion coupling and disorder in organic quantum materials. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 104416] Published Tue Oct 20, 2026

articles.abstract: Author(s): Balázs Gulácsi and Guido Burkard Superconducting qubits are a leading platform for quantum computing, but scaling up their circuitry is limited by crosstalk between qubits, and by the growing density of control wiring. This theoretical study uncovers a particular kind of crosstalk: When the magnetic flux through one qubit varies in time, that qubit’s neighbors see this as a voltage source woven into the circuit itself, in a circuit version of Faraday’s law of induction. Rather than a bane, though, this crosstalk mechanism could be turned into a boon, enabling quantum gates with less wiring per qubit. [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 044056] Published Tue Oct 20, 2026

articles.title: Two quantum spin liquid states coexisting in the kagome antiferromagnet herbertsmithite
articles.title_zh: 两种量子自旋液态共存于kagome反铁磁Herbertsmithite中
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Herbertsmithite (ZnCu₃(OH)₆Cl₂) is one of the most extensively studied quantum spin liquid (QSL) candidates, yet the precise nature of its ground state remains unresolved. Here, we compare the results of high-resolution inelastic neutron scattering on single crystals of herbertsmithite (ZnₓCu₄-x(OD)₆Cl₂, xsimeq 0.85) with large-scale density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and dynamical DMRG simulations to benchmark the spin Hamiltonian and uncover fundamental properties of the ground state. The measured spin correlations determine an energy density for the Heisenberg model that closely matches simulations, an essential verification of the Hamiltonian. In parallel, DMRG simulations reveal two nearly degenerate QSL states. Both preserve translational symmetry, but one retains the lattice point-group symmetries whereas the other develops anisotropic spin correlations that break point-group symmetry. These two QSLs have distinct spin structure factors, and, remarkably, close agreement with the neutron spectra is achieved with an admixture of the two states. Our results establish a quantitative correspondence between neutron scattering and simulations, and suggest that herbertsmithite realizes a regime in which two proximate gapped QSL states coexist.
articles.abstract_zh: Herbertsmithite （ ZnCu （ OH ） ）是研究最广泛的量子自旋液体（ QSL ）候选物之一，但其基态的精确性质仍未得到解决。在这里，我们比较了高分辨率非弹性中子散射在Herbertsmithite的单晶（ Zn · Cu · x （ OD ） · Cl · 2 ， xsimeq 0.85 ）与大规模密度矩阵重整群（ DMRG ）和动态DMRG模拟上的结果，以对自旋哈密顿量进行基准测试，揭示基态的基本性质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Herbertsmithite （ ZnCu （ OH ） ）是研究最广泛的量子自旋液体（ QSL ）候选物之一，但其基态的精确性质仍未得到解决。在这里，我们比较了高分辨率非弹性中子散射在Herbertsmithite的单晶（ Zn · Cu · x （ OD ） · Cl · 2 ， xsimeq 0.85 ）与大规模密度矩阵重整群（ DMRG ）和动态DMRG模拟上的结果，以对自旋哈密顿量进行基准测试，揭示基态的基本性质。测量的自旋相关性确定了与模拟密切匹配的海森堡模型的能量密度，这是对汉密尔顿模型的重要验证。同时， DMRG模拟揭示了两种几乎退化的QSL状态。两者都保留了平移对称性，但一个保留了晶格点群对称性，而另一个则发展了各向异性的自旋相关性，从而打破了点群对称性。这两个QSL具有不同的自旋结构因子，值得注意的是，通过两种状态的混合，与中子光谱达到了紧密的一致。我们的研究结果建立了中子散射和模拟之间的定量对应关系，并表明Herbertsmithite实现了两种接近的间隙QSL状态共存的方案。

articles.title: Gate-defined quantum dot and charge noise analysis in a Forksheet transistor
articles.title_zh: Forksheet晶体管中的门定义量子点和电荷噪声分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24136v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the cryogenic characterization of a 14-nm nMOS Forksheet transistor down to 10 mK. We demonstrate that the device retains transistor operation with improved characteristics at cryogenic temperatures, while also forming a gate-defined quantum dot that can be tuned to the single-electron regime. In the quantum-dot regime, we perform low-frequency charge-noise measurements across different charge occupations and observe an average charge-noise amplitude of langle S₀rangle = 10;mueV/sqrtHz at 1 Hz, with a minimum measured value of 3.3;mueV/sqrtHz. These results highlight the potential of Forksheet technology for the monolithic cointegration of quantum and classical CMOS functionalities in future quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了14 nm nMOS叉形片晶体管的低温表征，低至10 mK。我们证明，该器件在低温下保持晶体管工作，具有改进的特性，同时还形成了可以调谐到单电子状态的栅极定义量子点。在量子点状态下，我们在不同的电荷职业中进行低频电荷噪声测量，并观察到langle S恤rangle = 10; mueV/sqrtHz在1 Hz下的平均电荷噪声幅度，最小测量值为3.3; mueV/sqrtHz。

articles.title: Boundary Element Modeling for THz-SNOM Near-Field Probes
articles.title_zh: THz-SNOM近场探针的边界元建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Terahertz scanning near-field optical microscopy (THz-SNOM) enables spatially and spectrally resolved investigation of low-energy collective and topological states in quantum materials and nano-structured devices by exploiting the strongly localized near field generated by a polarized atomic force microscopy (AFM) tip. Because the THz near-field response is highly sensitive to tip geometry, understanding how geometric parameters control field confinement and decay is essential for selecting tip designs that provide the spatial resolution required for specific experiments. In this work, we develop a boundary element method (BEM) for modeling the electrostatic near-field of a conducting AFM tip in response to an external background field. The tip is represented by a simplified closed, blunt-cone geometry with its surface discretized into panels using increased mesh density near the apex. A modified Green's function is used to calculate interactions between surface panels, while an augmented linear system simultaneously enforces the equipotential boundary condition on the conducting surface and overall charge neutrality to determine the induced surface-charge distribution. We validate the BEM by comparing the resulting near-field decay with that obtained from a three-dimensional quasi-static COMSOL Multiphysics simulation. The BEM accurately reproduces the COMSOL field-decay behavior while requiring orders of magnitude fewer mesh elements and substantially reducing computational cost. These results demonstrate that the BEM provides an accurate and computationally efficient framework for systematically investigating the dependence of THz near-field confinement on AFM tip geometry. This framework can be extended to more complex and experimentally realistic tip geometries, providing a route toward rational tip selection and design for application-specific spatial-resolution requirements.
articles.abstract_zh: 太赫兹扫描近场光学显微镜（ THz-SNOM ）通过利用偏振原子力显微镜（ AFM ）尖端产生的强定位近场，实现了对量子材料和纳米结构器件中低能量集体和拓扑状态的空间和光谱分辨研究。由于太赫兹近场响应对尖端几何形状高度敏感，因此了解几何参数如何控制场限制和衰减对于选择提供特定实验所需空间分辨率的尖端设计至关重要。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种边界元法（ BEM ） ，用于响应外部背景场对导电AFM尖端的静电近场进行建模。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 太赫兹扫描近场光学显微镜（ THz-SNOM ）通过利用偏振原子力显微镜（ AFM ）尖端产生的强定位近场，实现了对量子材料和纳米结构器件中低能量集体和拓扑状态的空间和光谱分辨研究。由于太赫兹近场响应对尖端几何形状高度敏感，因此了解几何参数如何控制场限制和衰减对于选择提供特定实验所需空间分辨率的尖端设计至关重要。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种边界元法（ BEM ） ，用于响应外部背景场对导电AFM尖端的静电近场进行建模。尖端由简化的闭合钝锥几何形状表示，其表面使用顶点附近的增加的网格密度离散成面板。修改后的Green函数用于计算表面板之间的相互作用，而增强线性系统同时在导电表面上施加等电位边界条件和整体电荷中性以确定感应表面电荷分布。我们通过将产生的近场衰减与从三维准静态COMSOL Multiphysics模拟获得的近场衰减进行比较来验证边界元。BEM精确地再现了COMSOL场衰减行为，同时需要的数量级更少的网格元素，并大大降低了计算成本。这些结果表明， BEM为系统研究太赫兹近场限制对AFM尖端几何形状的依赖性提供了一个准确且计算效率高的框架。该框架可以扩展到更复杂和实验逼真的尖端几何形状，为合理的尖端选择和设计提供路线，以满足特定应用的空间分辨率要求。

articles.title: Kohler's Rule Holds in the Strange Metallic Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: 科勒法则适用于奇怪的金属哈伯德模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24208v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional magnetotransport violating Kohler's rule has been reported in many strongly correlated strange metals, but the exact origin of these violations is yet unknown. To investigate this question, we use determinant quantum Monte Carlo to compute the magnetoresistance of the hole-doped Hubbard-Hofstadter model. Despite T-linear resistivity exceeding the Mott-Ioffe-Regel limit and the nominal absence of well-defined quasiparticles, we find Kohler's rule unexpectedly holds across a wide range of on-site interaction strengths and hole dopings. In particular, Kohler emerges below a crossover temperature T^starapprox t identified from the double occupancy and specific heat, coinciding with the onset of local singlet correlations between lattice sites. We thus propose that Kohler scaling in this regime reflects a more general form of many-body quantum coherence. Our results show that strong correlations and strange metallicity do not themselves generically produce anomalous magnetoresistance.
articles.abstract_zh: 在许多强烈相关的奇异金属中已经报道了违反科勒规则的非常规磁力运输，但这些违规行为的确切起源尚不清楚。为了研究这个问题，我们使用行列式量子蒙特卡罗来计算空穴掺杂的哈伯德-霍夫施塔特模型的磁阻。尽管T线性电阻率超过Mott-Ioffe-Regel极限，并且名义上没有明确定义的准粒子，但我们发现Kohler法则意外地适用于广泛的现场相互作用强度和空穴掺杂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在许多强烈相关的奇异金属中已经报道了违反科勒规则的非常规磁力运输，但这些违规行为的确切起源尚不清楚。为了研究这个问题，我们使用行列式量子蒙特卡罗来计算空穴掺杂的哈伯德-霍夫施塔特模型的磁阻。尽管T线性电阻率超过Mott-Ioffe-Regel极限，并且名义上没有明确定义的准粒子，但我们发现Kohler法则意外地适用于广泛的现场相互作用强度和空穴掺杂。特别是， Kohler出现在从双重占用和比热确定的交叉温度T ^ starapprox t以下，与晶格位点之间局部单线相关性的发生一致。因此，我们提出，在这种情况下， Kohler缩放反映了一种更普遍的多体量子相干形式。我们的结果表明，强烈的相关性和奇怪的金属性本身并不会产生一般的异常磁阻。

articles.title: Role of chirality in the polarizer-filter dichotomy in nonmagnetic junctions
articles.title_zh: 手性在非磁结偏振器-滤波器二分法中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chirality-induced spin selectivity can enable spin generation by nonmagnetic junctions, but its symmetry requirements remain debated. We show that the symmetry of the junction constrains its polarizing behavior: a spin polarizer requires a chiral junction, whereas an achiral junction can act as a spin filter. This symmetry involves the junction as a whole, not only the molecule. Achiral molecules can act as polarizers or filters depending on junction geometry, as confirmed with a minimal tight-binding model. Reciprocity forbids polarization detection by linear two-terminal magnetoresistance; we propose a nonlocal measurement that distinguishes polarizers from filters and establishes whether the junction breaks time-reversal symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性诱导的自旋选择性可以通过非磁性结实现自旋生成，但其对称性要求仍有争议。我们证明了结的对称性限制了它的偏振行为：自旋偏振器需要手性结，而非手性结可以充当自旋滤波器。这种对称性涉及整个结，而不仅仅是分子。非手性分子可以作为偏振器或过滤器，这取决于结几何形状，用最小的紧密结合模型证实。互易性禁止通过线性双端磁阻进行极化检测；我们提出了一种非局部测量方法，将偏振器与滤波器区分开来，并确定结是否会破坏时间反转对称性。

articles.title: Charge disproportionation and spin ordering in LiV₂O₅ and NaV₂O₅: a distributed moment point of view
articles.title_zh: LiV ₂ O和NaV ₂ O中的电荷歧化和自旋有序：一个分布式力矩观点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The effects of charge disproportionation between V⁴⁺ and V⁵⁺ on the exchange interactions and related magnetic, electronic and optical properties are studied in LiV₂O₅ and NaV₂O₅. The magnetic exchange interactions between local moments on atomic sites are calculated using a linear response approach based on the QSGW band structure. While the induced magnetic moments are small on the vanadyl Oᵥ and bridge O_b, their exchange interactions with the V are found to be larger than between V atoms. The Néel temperature T_N are calculated within the mean-field (MFA) and random phase (RPA) approximations for two different crystal structures with P2₁mn and Pmmn spacegroups. The critical temperatures are are corrected by a quantum statistical factor of (S+1)/S to obtain reasonable agreement with experiment. Band structures, optical dielectric functions calculated using the Bethe Salpeter Equation method and spin waves are also calculated and presented for both crystal structures and both compounds. The spin wave dispersions are calculated from the classical Heisenberg Hamiltonian including magnetic moments on both V and O atoms. Besides the lowest energy weakly interacting spin waves of the two chains of spins in the unit cell, the model predicts additional high energy optical spin waves, which correspond to more complex spin excitations in which the spins on the two V across a bridge, vanadyl O and bridge O precess independently from each other instead of staying locked together according to their collinear alignment in the ground state. These show only weak dispersion and extend up to about 1 eV but we argue that these are an artefact of using the Heisenberg model beyond its validity range and would be suppressed in a more complete theory that allows for coupling of the transverse spin with longitudinal spin and charge excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究了LiV2O5和NaV2O5中V⁴⁺和V⁵⁺之间的电荷歧化对交换相互作用以及相关磁、电子和光学性质的影响。使用基于 QSGW 能带结构的线性响应方法计算原子位点上局部矩之间的磁交换相互作用。虽然氧钒基 Oᵥ 和桥 O_b 上的感应磁矩很小，但它们与 V 的交换相互作用被发现大于 V 原子之间的交换相互作用。尼尔温度 T_N 是在具有 P2₁mn 和 Pmmn 空间群的两种不同晶体结构的平均场 (MFA) 和随机相 (RPA) 近似内计算的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究了LiV2O5和NaV2O5中V⁴⁺和V⁵⁺之间的电荷歧化对交换相互作用以及相关磁、电子和光学性质的影响。使用基于 QSGW 能带结构的线性响应方法计算原子位点上局部矩之间的磁交换相互作用。虽然氧钒基 Oᵥ 和桥 O_b 上的感应磁矩很小，但它们与 V 的交换相互作用被发现大于 V 原子之间的交换相互作用。尼尔温度 T_N 是在具有 P2₁mn 和 Pmmn 空间群的两种不同晶体结构的平均场 (MFA) 和随机相 (RPA) 近似内计算的。临界温度通过(S+1)/S的量子统计因子进行校正，以获得与实验的合理一致。还计算并呈现了两种晶体结构和两种化合物的能带结构、使用 Bethe Salpeter 方程方法计算的光学介电函数和自旋波。自旋波色散是根据经典海森堡哈密顿量计算的，包括 V 和 O 原子上的磁矩。除了晶胞中两条自旋链的最低能量弱相互作用自旋波之外，该模型还预测了额外的高能光学自旋波，这对应于更复杂的自旋激发，其中两个 V 上的自旋跨过桥、氧钒 O 和桥 O 彼此独立地进动，而不是根据它们在基态下的共线排列保持锁定在一起。这些仅显示出弱色散并延伸至约 1 eV，但我们认为这些是使用海森堡模型超出其有效范围的人为产物，并且将在允许横向自旋与纵向自旋和电荷激发耦合的更完整的理论中被抑制。

articles.title: Tunable anisotropy of high-harmonic generation in ferroelectric NbOI2
articles.title_zh: 铁电 NbOI2 中高次谐波产生的可调谐各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24302v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: he generation of even-order harmonic spectra from inversion symmetry breaking is well known, however, the tunability of the intensity and angular anisotropy on various harmonics orders remains unclear. Here, we demonstrate the second and fourth-harmonics in the ferroelectric NbOI2 exhibit distinct wavelength-dependence and anisotropies in the near-infrared regime. In particular, as the wavelength of incident light is tuned from 2150 nm to 2450 nm, the second-harmonic remains strongest for excitation along the ferroelectric polar axis, whereas the polarization of the fourth- harmonic changes preferred axis. This effect is found to be driven by the interplay of transition dipole matrix elements and interband excitations between very narrow bands near the Fermi level. We expect the tunable anisotropy of high-harmonics to enable novel optical switching devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 从反演对称性破缺产生偶次谐波谱是众所周知的，然而，各种谐波阶次的强度和角度各向异性的可调性仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明了铁电 NbOI2 中的二次和四次谐波在近红外区域表现出明显的波长依赖性和各向异性。特别是，当入射光的波长从 2150 nm 调谐到 2450 nm 时，二次谐波对于沿铁电极轴的激发保持最强，而四次谐波的偏振则改变优选轴。人们发现这种效应是由过渡偶极子矩阵元素和费米能级附近非常窄的带之间的带间激发的相互作用驱动的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从反演对称性破缺产生偶次谐波谱是众所周知的，然而，各种谐波阶次的强度和角度各向异性的可调性仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明了铁电 NbOI2 中的二次和四次谐波在近红外区域表现出明显的波长依赖性和各向异性。特别是，当入射光的波长从 2150 nm 调谐到 2450 nm 时，二次谐波对于沿铁电极轴的激发保持最强，而四次谐波的偏振则改变优选轴。人们发现这种效应是由过渡偶极子矩阵元素和费米能级附近非常窄的带之间的带间激发的相互作用驱动的。我们期望高次谐波的可调谐各向异性能够实现新型光开关器件。

articles.title: Microphase Separation and Ionic Aggregation in Oppositely Charged End-Functionalized Polymer Blends
articles.title_zh: 带相反电荷的末端官能化聚合物共混物中的微相分离和离子聚集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the phase behavior of binary blends of polymers with oppositely charged termini using an ion-correlation-augmented self-consistent field theory (IC-SCFT). Under the low dielectric conditions typical for organic polymer melts, strong ion correlations drive association of multiple chain ends, leading to emergent multichain architectures that go beyond a simple ion-paired diblock copolymer picture previously used to interpret recent experiments. At moderate to strong polymer segregation, the resulting phase diagram differs considerably from this effective-diblock prediction: ion clustering broadens the lamellar and cylindrical windows while suppressing the network phases, the reverse of the trend for end-charged diblock copolymers. At weak segregation, the two polymers remain miscible even as ion clustering persists, and decreasing chain length drives the clusters themselves through a sphere-to-cylinder-to-lamella shape transition, connecting continuously to the aggregation behavior of classical terminally charged ionomers in the limit when one of the polymer species shrinks to just the charged end. These results reveal that ion clustering -- beyond simple pairwise bonding -- shapes the self-assembly of end-charged polymer blends.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用离子相关增强自洽场理论（IC-SCFT）研究具有相反电荷末端的聚合物二元共混物的相行为。在有机聚合物熔体典型的低介电条件下，强离子相关性驱动多个链端的缔合，从而导致出现的多链结构，超越了先前用于解释最近实验的简单离子对二嵌段共聚物图。在中等至强的聚合物偏析下，所得相图与这种有效二嵌段预测有很大不同：离子簇拓宽了层状和圆柱形窗口，同时抑制了网络相，这与末端带电二嵌段共聚物的趋势相反。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用离子相关增强自洽场理论（IC-SCFT）研究具有相反电荷末端的聚合物二元共混物的相行为。在有机聚合物熔体典型的低介电条件下，强离子相关性驱动多个链端的缔合，从而导致出现的多链结构，超越了先前用于解释最近实验的简单离子对二嵌段共聚物图。在中等至强的聚合物偏析下，所得相图与这种有效二嵌段预测有很大不同：离子簇拓宽了层状和圆柱形窗口，同时抑制了网络相，这与末端带电二嵌段共聚物的趋势相反。在弱偏析下，即使离子簇持续存在，两种聚合物仍保持混溶，并且链长度的减小驱动簇本身通过球体到圆柱体到片层的形状转变，当其中一种聚合物收缩到仅带电端时，在极限内连续连接到经典末端带电离聚物的聚集行为。这些结果表明，除了简单的成对键合之外，离子簇形成了末端带电聚合物共混物的自组装。

articles.title: Second Chern Number Protected Gapless Vortex Modes in Superconducting Weyl Semimetals
articles.title_zh: 超导外尔半金属中的二陈数保护无间隙涡旋模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24401v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have studied the vortex bound states of superconducting linear and quadratic Weyl semimetals with time reversal symmetry. For vortex with vorticity n (vortex line along z direction) and Weyl semimetals with Weyl point chirality χ, there are vert nχ vert gapless vortex modes around the location of each Weyl point in superconducting Weyl semimetals. We show that the appearance of vert nχ vert gapless vortex modes originates from the imbalanced pumping of flux bound states between Chern insulators obtained at kz and -kz in Weyl semimetals. Such a physical picture is verified by numerical calculations on lattice models. Moreover, the gapless modes around each Weyl point can be characterized by the second Chern number defined in a synthetic four-dimensional space based on the effective BdG Hamiltonian. Finally, these gapless vortex modes are found to be robust against rotational symmetry-breaking terms.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有时间反演对称性的超导线性和二次韦尔半金属的涡旋束缚态。对于涡度为n（沿z方向的涡线）的涡旋和具有Weyl点手性χ的Weyl半金属，超导Weyl半金属中每个Weyl点的位置周围存在vert nχ vert无间隙涡旋模式。我们证明了 vert nχ vert 无间隙涡旋模式的出现源于 Weyl 半金属中 kz 和 -kz 处获得的 Chern 绝缘体之间通量束缚态的不平衡泵浦。这样的物理图景通过晶格模型的数值计算得到了验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有时间反演对称性的超导线性和二次韦尔半金属的涡旋束缚态。对于涡度为n（沿z方向的涡线）的涡旋和具有Weyl点手性χ的Weyl半金属，超导Weyl半金属中每个Weyl点的位置周围存在vert nχ vert无间隙涡旋模式。我们证明了 vert nχ vert 无间隙涡旋模式的出现源于 Weyl 半金属中 kz 和 -kz 处获得的 Chern 绝缘体之间通量束缚态的不平衡泵浦。这样的物理图景通过晶格模型的数值计算得到了验证。此外，每个 Weyl 点周围的无间隙模式可以通过基于有效 BdG 哈密顿量在合成四维空间中定义的第二陈数来表征。最后，这些无间隙涡旋模式被发现对于旋转对称破缺项具有鲁棒性。

articles.title: Atomistic prediction of magnetic behaviour across chemistry, structure and temperature
articles.title_zh: 跨化学、结构和温度的磁性行为的原子预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24407v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling magnetic phases and properties through composition and external conditions is central to the development of magnetic materials. Atomistic foundation models offer a route to predicting such behaviour across diverse materials, but magnetic materials remain challenging because their atomic structure and local moments are strongly coupled, while temperature and disorder drive magnetic moments into non-collinear states with evolving orientations and magnitudes. Broadly pretrained atomistic models still sample only limited magnetic diversity, while finite-temperature descriptions of coupled lattice and magnetic fluctuations remain largely material-specific. Here we introduce MagPT, pretrained across 48 elements on 912,492 spin-lattice configurations spanning structural, orientational and longitudinal magnetic fluctuations over 0 sim 1,000 K and 0 sim 10 GPa. By treating species, atomic positions and vector moments together, MagPT distinguishes magnetic states that share the same atomic structure but differ in spin configuration and energy. It captures magnetic behaviour across composition, temperature and length scales, from Slater-Pauling-type composition-magnetism relations in transition-metal alloys and finite-temperature phase evolution in elemental ferromagnets and magnetic shape-memory Heusler alloys, to emergent long-wavelength non-collinear spin textures in chiral magnets and local chemistry-magnetism coupling in high-entropy alloys. MagPT moves atomistic studies of magnetic materials beyond material-specific approaches, establishing a general framework for exploring and designing magnetic matter across diverse chemistries and conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过成分和外部条件控制磁性相和性质是磁性材料开发的核心。原子基础模型提供了一种预测不同材料的此类行为的途径，但磁性材料仍然具有挑战性，因为它们的原子结构和局部矩是强耦合的，而温度和无序将磁矩驱动到具有不断变化的方向和大小的非共线状态。广泛预训练的原子模型仍然只采样有限的磁多样性，而耦合晶格和磁涨落的有限温度描述仍然很大程度上是材料特定的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过成分和外部条件控制磁性相和性质是磁性材料开发的核心。原子基础模型提供了一种预测不同材料的此类行为的途径，但磁性材料仍然具有挑战性，因为它们的原子结构和局部矩是强耦合的，而温度和无序将磁矩驱动到具有不断变化的方向和大小的非共线状态。广泛预训练的原子模型仍然只采样有限的磁多样性，而耦合晶格和磁涨落的有限温度描述仍然很大程度上是材料特定的。在这里，我们介绍了 MagPT，它在 912,492 个自旋晶格配置上的 48 个元素上进行了预训练，涵盖了 0 sim 1,000 K 和 0 sim 10 GPa 的结构、方向和纵向磁涨落。通过同时处理物种、原子位置和矢量矩，MagPT 可以区分具有相同原子结构但自旋构型和能量不同的磁态。它捕获跨成分、温度和长度尺度的磁性行为，从过渡金属合金中的斯莱特-鲍林型成分磁性关系和元素铁磁体和磁性形状记忆赫斯勒合金中的有限温度相演化，到手性磁体中出现的长波长非共线自旋纹理和高熵合金中的局域化学磁性耦合。 MagPT 使磁性材料的原子研究超越了特定材料的方法，建立了一个通用框架，用于跨不同化学和条件探索和设计磁性物质。

articles.title: Reticulating Local Dynamics in Three-Dimensional Covalent Organic Frameworks
articles.title_zh: 三维共价有机框架中的网状局部动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In covalent organic frameworks (COFs), the geometry of the building units predetermines the structure of the framework, yet comparable design principles relating the COF linkers to the local motions that govern guest adsorption and diffusion as well as mechanical response have remained beyond reach. Here, we combine synchrotron X-ray pair distribution function (PDF) analysis with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations accelerated by machine learning interatomic potentials to resolve and compare the local dynamics of two three-dimensional imine-linked COFs, chosen to differ in the geometry and rigidity of one of their two building units. Both are constructed from the same 4-connected square planar linker, 4,4',4'',4'''-(pyrene-1,3,6,8-tetrayl)tetraaniline (PyTTA), reticulated with the 12-connected nanographene hexakis{[3,5-bis(p-formylphenyl)-4,6-dimethoxyphenyl]}hexabenzocoronene to give COF-412, [(HBC-LA₁₂)(PyTTA)₃]ᵢₘᵢₙₑ, and with the 6-connected triptycene 2,3,6,7,14,15-hexakis(4-formylphenyl)triptycene to give COF-564, [(Trip-CHO)₂(PyTTA)₃]ᵢₘᵢₙₑ. The PDF-MD approach resolves the amplitude, the time scale, and the spatial extent of the motion of all COF linkers, separating the limited libration of the fused aromatic cores from the larger reorientational tilts of the pendant aryl rings they carry and from the translation of whole linkers within the net. The simulations further reveal that exchanging the nanographene- for the triptycene-based linker tunes the equilibrium tilt and the positional probability density of PyTTA, raising the tilt amplitude of its linker partner, and, notably, strengthens the coupling between the translations of neighbouring linkers. This approach provides a blueprint for understanding local dynamical properties in COFs, and shows them to be selectable through the choice of building unit and amenable to design.
articles.abstract_zh: 在共价有机框架（COF）中，构建单元的几何形状预先决定了框架的结构，但将COF连接体与控制客体吸附和扩散以及机械响应的局部运动相关的可比较的设计原理仍然遥不可及。在这里，我们将同步加速器 X 射线对分布函数 (PDF) 分析与机器学习原子间势加速的分子动力学 (MD) 模拟相结合，以解析和比较两个三维亚胺连接 COF 的局部动力学，这两个结构单元的几何形状和刚性不同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在共价有机框架（COF）中，构建单元的几何形状预先决定了框架的结构，但将COF连接体与控制客体吸附和扩散以及机械响应的局部运动相关的可比较的设计原理仍然遥不可及。在这里，我们将同步加速器 X 射线对分布函数 (PDF) 分析与机器学习原子间势加速的分子动力学 (MD) 模拟相结合，以解析和比较两个三维亚胺连接 COF 的局部动力学，这两个结构单元的几何形状和刚性不同。两者均由相同的 4 连接方形平面连接体 4,4',4'',4'''-(芘-1,3,6,8-四基)四苯胺 (PyTTA) 构建，与 12 连接纳米石墨烯六基[3,5-双(对甲酰基苯基)-4,6-二甲氧基苯基]六苯并苯呈网状，得到 COF-412， [(HBC-LA₁2)(PyTTA)₃]ᵢₘᵢₙₑ，与6连接的三蝶烯2,3,6,7,14,15-六(4-甲酰基苯基)三蝶烯得到COF-564， [(Trip-CHO)2(PyTTA)₃]ᵢₘᵢₙₑ。 PDF-MD方法解析了所有COF连接体运动的幅度、时间尺度和空间范围，将稠合芳族核的有限解放与它们携带的悬垂芳环的较大重新取向倾斜以及网络内整个连接体的平移分开。模拟进一步表明，将纳米石墨烯替换为基于三蝶烯的连接体可以调节 PyTTA 的平衡倾斜和位置概率密度，提高其连接体配对的倾斜幅度，并且值得注意的是，增强了相邻连接体翻译之间的耦合。这种方法为理解 COF 的局部动态特性提供了蓝图，并表明它们可以通过选择构建单元来选择并易于设计。

articles.title: A GRACE Interatomic Potential for W--Ta Systems: Application to Ta Segregation and Pinning of Shear-Coupled Grain-Boundary Migration
articles.title_zh: W--Ta 体系的 GRACE 原子间势：在剪切耦合晶界迁移的 Ta 偏析和钉扎中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24432v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tungsten-tantalum alloys are promising plasma-facing materials for fusion reactors, but simulations of their coupled defect, mechanical, and microstructural evolution require an interatomic potential that remains accurate across diverse atomic environments. We develop a transferable W-Ta potential within the GRaph Atomic Cluster Expansion (GRACE) framework. The primary training dataset was generated automatically by maximizing information entropy in an atomically relevant feature space, avoiding manual enumeration of the structures and processes required for specific downstream applications. Extensive validation demonstrates a consistent description of unary and binary phase stability, elasticity, phonons, high-pressure response, surfaces, point defects, dislocation energetics, transformation pathways, alloy thermodynamics, and melting behavior. As a demonstration, the potential is applied to Ta segregation and shear-coupled migration of a Σ5(120) W GB. Simulations reveal strongly site-selective segregation: Ta preferentially occupies a small subset of crystallographically distinct atomic rows. Under shear, segregated Ta impedes disconnection-mediated grain boundary migration. The de-pinning stress initially increases with Ta concentration but plateaus as the dominant pinning environment becomes saturated, while increasing temperature weakens both segregation and pinning. These results establish a broadly validated W-Ta potential and demonstrate how automated entropy-maximized data generation can produce transferable atomistic models capable of resolving mechanisms not explicitly targeted during training.
articles.abstract_zh: 钨钽合金是用于聚变反应堆的有前景的面向等离子体材料，但对其耦合缺陷、机械和微观结构演化的模拟需要在不同原子环境中保持准确的原子间势。我们在 GRaph 原子团簇扩展 (GRACE) 框架内开发了可转移的 W-Ta 势。主要训练数据集是通过最大化原子相关特征空间中的信息熵自动生成的，避免了手动枚举特定下游应用程序所需的结构和过程。广泛的验证证明了对一元和二元相稳定性、弹性、声子、高压响应、表面、点缺陷、位错能量、转变路径、合金热力学和熔化行为的一致描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钨钽合金是用于聚变反应堆的有前景的面向等离子体材料，但对其耦合缺陷、机械和微观结构演化的模拟需要在不同原子环境中保持准确的原子间势。我们在 GRaph 原子团簇扩展 (GRACE) 框架内开发了可转移的 W-Ta 势。主要训练数据集是通过最大化原子相关特征空间中的信息熵自动生成的，避免了手动枚举特定下游应用程序所需的结构和过程。广泛的验证证明了对一元和二元相稳定性、弹性、声子、高压响应、表面、点缺陷、位错能量、转变路径、合金热力学和熔化行为的一致描述。作为演示，该电势应用于 Σ5(120) W GB 的 Ta 偏析和剪切耦合迁移。模拟揭示了强烈的位点选择性偏析：Ta优先占据晶体学上不同的原子行的一小部分。在剪切作用下，偏析的 Ta 阻碍了断开介导的晶界迁移。脱钉应力最初随着 Ta 浓度的增加而增加，但随着主要钉扎环境变得饱和而趋于稳定，而温度的升高会削弱偏析和钉扎。这些结果建立了广泛验证的 W-Ta 势，并证明了自动熵最大化数据生成如何生成可转移的原子模型，该模型能够解决训练期间未明确针对的机制。

articles.title: Accurate Atomic Correlation Energies and Virial Trends for Correlation-Consistent Effective Core Potentials III: Quantitative Separation of Fixed-Node Biases and Localization Errors in Cs-Rn
articles.title_zh: 准确的原子关联能和相关一致有效核心势的维里趋势 III：Cs-Rn 中固定节点偏差和定位误差的定量分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic benchmarks for sixth-period elements (Cs-Rn) are established to sub-millihartree precision under correlation-consistent effective core potentials (ccECPs) using coupled-cluster [up to CCSDT(Q)] and full configuration interaction methods. These references systematically characterize electron correlation, potential-to-kinetic energy partitioning, and combined fixed-node and locality biases (η) in fixed-node diffusion Monte Carlo (FNDMC). The valence kinetic-to-total energy ratio (ξ) departs from the non-relativistic all-electron Coulombic virial limit (ξ=100%), remaining confined between 25.8% and 37.6%. The Un-pseudizing of semi-core shells decreases ξ as the attractive potential energy deepens faster than the accompanying kinetic energy escalates. Periodic trends in ξ reveal a 5d plateau near 34%, with a lanthanide-contraction-driven maximum in Hf, followed by a sharp decline across the 6p block. In FNDMC, η escalates rapidly at the onset of group-1/2 and toward the 6p closed-shell limit, peaking at 5.42% in Rn. Although fixed-node errors dominate η in most sixth-period elements, a locality error inversion occurs in Bi, with Pb exhibiting comparable error magnitudes. Furthermore, core-valence partitioning alters trial wavefunction nodal topology: in Tl, three-dimensional nodal cross-sections reveal isolated toroidal domains that confine walkers. This work completes the periodic-table-wide ccECP database from H to Rn, revealing how pseudopotential choices govern energy partitioning, nodal topology, and the balance between fixed-node and localization errors.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用耦合簇[高达CCSDT(Q)]和全配置交互方法，在相关一致的有效核心势(ccECP)下建立了亚毫哈特精度的第六周期元素(Cs-Rn)的原子基准。这些参考文献系统地描述了固定节点扩散蒙特卡罗 (FNDMC) 中的电子相关性、势能到动能分配以及固定节点和局部偏差 (η) 的组合。价动能与总能量之比 (xi) 偏离非相对论全电子库仑维里极限 (xi=100%)，仍限制在 25.8% 到 37.6% 之间。由于吸引势能加深的速度快于伴随动能增加的速度，半核壳的非伪化会降低 Ψ 。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用耦合簇[高达CCSDT(Q)]和全配置交互方法，在相关一致的有效核心势(ccECP)下建立了亚毫哈特精度的第六周期元素(Cs-Rn)的原子基准。这些参考文献系统地描述了固定节点扩散蒙特卡罗 (FNDMC) 中的电子相关性、势能到动能分配以及固定节点和局部偏差 (η) 的组合。价动能与总能量之比 (xi) 偏离非相对论全电子库仑维里极限 (xi=100%)，仍限制在 25.8% 到 37.6% 之间。由于吸引势能加深的速度快于伴随动能增加的速度，半核壳的非伪化会降低 Ψ 。 Ψ 的周期性趋势显示 5d 处于接近 34% 的稳定状态，Hf 出现由镧系元素收缩驱动的最大值，随后在 6p 区块急剧下降。在 FNDMC 中，η 在 1/2 组开始时迅速升高并接近 6p 闭壳极限，在 Rn 中达到峰值 5.42%。尽管固定节点误差在大多数第六周期元素中占主导地位，但 Bi 中发生局部误差反转，而 Pb 表现出可比的误差幅度。此外，核价划分改变了试验波函数节点拓扑：在 T1 中，三维节点横截面揭示了限制步行者的孤立环形域。这项工作完成了从 H 到 Rn 的周期表范围内的 ccECP 数据库，揭示了赝势选择如何控制能量分配、节点拓扑以及固定节点和定位误差之间的平衡。

articles.title: Understanding compression-extension error asymmetry in universal machine-learning interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 理解通用机器学习原子间势中的压缩-扩展误差不对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials are increasingly used across diverse materials, yet their reliability under directional deformation remains unclear. We compare compression and extension along paired deformation paths from the same parent structures for eleven pretrained potentials. The benchmark comprises 1,963 Materials Project trajectory (MPtrj) parents and 1,286 experimental-source MinX-Eq parents at six strain magnitudes from 1% to 10%. Density-functional theory provides references for isotropic, uniaxial and biaxial loading in MPtrj and isotropic loading in MinX-Eq. At ± 10%, every model has a larger median force error under compression, with pooled isotropic compression-to-extension ratios of 2.12 and 3.30 for MPtrj and MinX-Eq. Decomposing error growth into DFT force-scale growth and relative-error evolution shows that relative errors decrease on both branches, faster under compression in MPtrj but slower under compression in MinX-Eq. Force-scale matching moves the error ratios toward unity, although MinX-Eq retains a compression-side excess across models. Radial and SOAP analyses place compressed structures at shorter separations and farther from public reference pools, while readout-associated model features show larger compression-side displacements. These results distinguish stronger physical responses from changes in relative predictive accuracy and provide a basis for assessing universal potentials in deformation simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势越来越多地应用于各种材料，但其在定向变形下的可靠性仍不清楚。我们比较了十一个预训练势沿来自相同父结构的成对变形路径的压缩和延伸。该基准包括 1,963 个材料项目轨迹 (MPtrj) 母体和 1,286 个实验来源的 MinX-Eq 母体，其应变大小从 1% 到 10% 有 6 个量级。密度泛函理论为 MPtrj 中的各向同性、单轴和双轴载荷以及 MinX-Eq 中的各向同性载荷提供了参考。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通用机器学习原子间势越来越多地应用于各种材料，但其在定向变形下的可靠性仍不清楚。我们比较了十一个预训练势沿来自相同父结构的成对变形路径的压缩和延伸。该基准包括 1,963 个材料项目轨迹 (MPtrj) 母体和 1,286 个实验来源的 MinX-Eq 母体，其应变大小从 1% 到 10% 有 6 个量级。密度泛函理论为 MPtrj 中的各向同性、单轴和双轴载荷以及 MinX-Eq 中的各向同性载荷提供了参考。在 ± 10% 时，每个模型在压缩下都具有较大的中值力误差，MPtrj 和 MinX-Eq 的合并各向同性压缩与拉伸比率分别为 2.12 和 3.30。将误差增长分解为 DFT 力尺度增长和相对误差演化表明，两个分支上的相对误差均减少，在 MPtrj 中压缩时速度更快，但在 MinX-Eq 中压缩时速度更慢。尽管 MinX-Eq 保留了跨模型的压缩侧过剩，但力尺度匹配使误差率趋于统一。径向和 SOAP 分析将压缩结构置于较短的间隔和远离公共参考池的位置，而与读出相关的模型特征显示更大的压缩侧位移。这些结果将更强的物理响应与相对预测准确性的变化区分开来，并为评估变形模拟中的普遍潜力提供了基础。

articles.title: Structural signatures of a topological transition in a disordered tetrahedral network
articles.title_zh: 无序四面体网络中拓扑转变的结构特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological transitions in disordered network materials are often characterised using descriptors of entanglement, such as ring linking and writhe, which can be difficult to access experimentally. Here we investigate whether a topological transition can instead be identified using structural descriptors more readily connected to experiment. We reanalyse configurations of a colloidal tetrahedral network model known to exhibit a pressure-driven transition between unentangled and and entangled states. We show that the cumulative all-rings vertex symbol (CARVS), a descriptor of medium-range network topology based on ring statistics, provides a clear signature of this transition despite containing no explicit information about ring linking. We further show that network entanglement produces characteristic changes in the radial distribution function and structure factor, including the emergence of short-range correlations between nonbonded nodes and the disappearance of a low-angle scattering pre-peak. These results establish experimentally accessible structural signatures of topological transitions in disordered tetrahedral networks. Comparison with canonical continuous random networks further suggests that framework materials with extended linkers may provide promising candidate systems in which to search experimentally for entanglement-driven topological transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 无序网络材料中的拓扑转变通常使用纠缠描述符来表征，例如环连接和扭曲，这可能很难通过实验获得。在这里，我们研究是否可以使用更容易与实验联系起来的结构描述符来识别拓扑转变。我们重新分析了胶体四面体网络模型的配置，该模型已知在非纠缠态和纠缠态之间表现出压力驱动的转变。我们表明，累积全环顶点符号（CARVS）是一种基于环统计的中程网络拓扑描述符，尽管不包含有关环链接的明确信息，但它提供了此转换的清晰签名。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无序网络材料中的拓扑转变通常使用纠缠描述符来表征，例如环连接和扭曲，这可能很难通过实验获得。在这里，我们研究是否可以使用更容易与实验联系起来的结构描述符来识别拓扑转变。我们重新分析了胶体四面体网络模型的配置，该模型已知在非纠缠态和纠缠态之间表现出压力驱动的转变。我们表明，累积全环顶点符号（CARVS）是一种基于环统计的中程网络拓扑描述符，尽管不包含有关环链接的明确信息，但它提供了此转换的清晰签名。我们进一步表明，网络纠缠会产生径向分布函数和结构因子的特征变化，包括非键结节点之间短程相关性的出现和低角度散射前峰的消失。这些结果建立了无序四面体网络中拓扑转变的实验可访问的结构特征。与规范连续随机网络的比较进一步表明，具有扩展连接体的框架材料可能提供有前途的候选系统，在其中通过实验搜索纠缠驱动的拓扑转变。

articles.title: Signed FK percolation in Ising spin glasses
articles.title_zh: 伊辛旋转玻璃中签名的 FK 渗滤
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce signed Fortuin-Kasteleyn (FK) percolation for the +/-J random-interaction Ising model to characterize nonzero uniform magnetization density and two-replica overlap within the class of Gibbs distributions whose infinite-volume Edwards-Sokal (ES)/FK representation has at most one infinite FK cluster almost surely. The construction refines ordinary FK connectivity by retaining the parity of coupling products along open paths. Using the infinite-volume ES representation and its DLR equations, we study pairs of companion objects and the compatible spin assignments on them. In one replica, companions are defined by positive-parity FK connections. For extremal states satisfying the infinite-cluster assumption and almost-sure existence of companion densities along the chosen van Hove sequence, nonzero limiting expected magnetization density is equivalent to density distinguishability of the companions of the infinite FK cluster. For two independent replicas, companions are defined by FK connections coherent in parity. For products of extremal one-replica states satisfying the infinite-cluster assumption and almost-sure existence of the companion densities along the chosen sequence, density distinguishability of the companions is equivalent to nonzero limiting expected mutual overlap. For two independent replicas drawn from the same extremal state, this specializes to the Edwards-Anderson self-overlap.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们为 +/-J 随机相互作用 Ising 模型引入了有符号 Fortuin-Kasteleyn (FK) 渗流，以表征吉布斯分布类中的非零均匀磁化密度和两副本重叠，其无限体积 Edwards-Sokal (ES)/FK 表示几乎肯定最多有一个无限 FK 簇。该结构通过保留开放路径上耦合产品的奇偶性来改进普通的 FK 连接。使用无限体积 ES 表示及其 DLR 方程，我们研究了伴生对象对及其兼容的自旋分配。在一个副本中，同伴由正奇偶校验 FK 连接定义。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为 +/-J 随机相互作用 Ising 模型引入了有符号 Fortuin-Kasteleyn (FK) 渗流，以表征吉布斯分布类中的非零均匀磁化密度和两副本重叠，其无限体积 Edwards-Sokal (ES)/FK 表示几乎肯定最多有一个无限 FK 簇。该结构通过保留开放路径上耦合产品的奇偶性来改进普通的 FK 连接。使用无限体积 ES 表示及其 DLR 方程，我们研究了伴生对象对及其兼容的自旋分配。在一个副本中，同伴由正奇偶校验 FK 连接定义。对于满足无限簇假设和几乎肯定存在沿所选范霍夫序列的伴星密度的极值状态，非零限制期望磁化密度相当于无限 FK 簇的伴星的密度可区分性。对于两个独立的副本，同伴由奇偶校验一致的 FK 连接定义。对于满足无限簇假设和沿所选序列几乎肯定存在伴星密度的极值单副本状态的乘积，伴星的密度可区分性相当于非零限制预期相互重叠。对于来自同一极值状态的两个独立复制品，这专门针对爱德华兹-安德森自我重叠。

articles.title: Theory of High-Temperature Fractional Chern Phases in Monolayer van der Waals Kagome Materials A₂T₃X₄
articles.title_zh: 单层范德华 Kagome 材料中的高温分数陈相理论 A2T₃X₄
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24633v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators bring the fractional quantum Hall effect, with its anyonic excitations, to zero magnetic field. So far they have been realized in moiré materials, where the long superlattice period weakens electronic interactions and confines these phases to cryogenic temperatures. Early proposals instead envisioned topological flat bands on atomic-scale lattices, where fractionalization could persist to far higher temperatures, but a suitable material has been lacking. Here we theoretically identify monolayers of the recently synthesized van der Waals kagome family A₂T₃X₄ as such a platform, combining intrinsic topological flat bands and strong Coulomb interactions with gate-tunable carrier density and layer assembly. Exact diagonalization of models derived from density functional theory reveals ferromagnetism over broad filling ranges, supporting diverse fractional Chern insulators, anomalous composite Fermi liquids, and charge-ordered phases.
