In particular, in Cs₂Pd₃S₄, the fractional Chern insulator exhibits a many-body gap of approximately 26 meV in the largest system accessible with band mixing allowing at most one interband electron-hole excitation. Layer assembly further provides a natural route to fractional quantum spin Hall insulators: bilayers with antiparallel magnetizations support this phase at realistic separations. These results identify an experimentally accessible material family in which chemical composition, carrier density, and stacking offer complementary routes to fractionalization at enhanced energy scales and control over topological order.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数陈绝缘体将分数量子霍尔效应及其任意子激发带到零磁场。到目前为止，它们已在莫尔材料中实现，其中较长的超晶格周期削弱了电子相互作用并将这些相限制在低温下。相反，早期的提议设想了原子级晶格上的拓扑平带，其中分馏可以持续到更高的温度，但一直缺乏合适的材料。在这里，我们从理论上将最近合成的范德瓦尔斯 kagome 家族 A2T3X4 的单层确定为这样的平台，将固有的拓扑平坦能带和强库仑相互作用与栅极可调载流子密度和层组装相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数陈绝缘体将分数量子霍尔效应及其任意子激发带到零磁场。到目前为止，它们已在莫尔材料中实现，其中较长的超晶格周期削弱了电子相互作用并将这些相限制在低温下。相反，早期的提议设想了原子级晶格上的拓扑平带，其中分馏可以持续到更高的温度，但一直缺乏合适的材料。在这里，我们从理论上将最近合成的范德瓦尔斯 kagome 家族 A2T3X4 的单层确定为这样的平台，将固有的拓扑平坦能带和强库仑相互作用与栅极可调载流子密度和层组装相结合。从密度泛函理论导出的模型的精确对角化揭示了广泛填充范围内的铁磁性，支持不同的分数陈绝缘体、反常复合费米液体和电荷有序相。特别是，在 Cs2Pd3S4 中，分数陈绝缘体在最大系统中表现出约 26 meV 的多体能隙，该系统可通过带混合实现最多一次带间电子空穴激发。层组装进一步提供了分数量子自旋霍尔绝缘体的自然途径：具有反平行磁化强度的双层以实际分离支持该相。这些结果确定了一种可通过实验获得的材料族，其中化学成分、载流子密度和堆叠提供了在增强的能量尺度上进行分级和控制拓扑顺序的补充途径。

articles.title: Turning Number and the Geometry of Disorder-Induced Topology
articles.title_zh: 转向数与无序拓扑几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The geometry of momentum-space Hamiltonian maps derived from the zero-frequency single-particle Green's function provides a route to a refined topological characterization of quantum systems beyond the noninteracting clean limit. The central idea is to complement standard topological invariants by invariants that characterize the geometry of the map itself. As a paradigmatic example, we study the one-dimensional chiral Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with disorder, where the topological Hamiltonian defines a planar Bloch loop. In addition to its conventional winding number, this loop possesses an integer turning number that characterizes the winding of its tangent vector. We identify turning-number transitions that occur while the topological Hamiltonian remains finite and spectrally gapped, driven solely by a vanishing tangent vector of the Bloch loop, and obtain an extended phase diagram with additional topological structure beyond the winding-number classification. Asymptotic analysis predicts the emergence and disorder dependence of the corresponding transition regime, in agreement with the numerical results. Our findings establish the geometry of momentum-space Hamiltonian maps as an additional source of topological structure beyond conventional classifications.
articles.abstract_zh: 从零频率单粒子格林函数导出的动量空间哈密顿图的几何形状为超越非相互作用清洁极限的量子系统的精细拓扑表征提供了一条途径。中心思想是通过表征地图本身几何形状的不变量来补充标准拓扑不变量。作为一个范例，我们研究了无序的一维手性 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型，其中拓扑哈密顿量定义了平面布洛赫环。除了传统的绕数之外，该环路还拥有一个整数匝数，用于表征其切向量的绕数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从零频率单粒子格林函数导出的动量空间哈密顿图的几何形状为超越非相互作用清洁极限的量子系统的精细拓扑表征提供了一条途径。中心思想是通过表征地图本身几何形状的不变量来补充标准拓扑不变量。作为一个范例，我们研究了无序的一维手性 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型，其中拓扑哈密顿量定义了平面布洛赫环。除了传统的绕数之外，该环路还拥有一个整数匝数，用于表征其切向量的绕数。我们识别了拓扑哈密顿量保持有限和谱间隙时发生的转数转变，仅由布洛赫环的消失切向量驱动，并获得了具有超出绕数分类的附加拓扑结构的扩展相图。渐近分析预测了相应过渡状态的出现和无序依赖性，与数值结果一致。我们的研究结果将动量空间哈密顿图的几何结构确立为传统分类之外的拓扑结构的额外来源。

articles.title: Shear SAW piezoelectricity of single-crystalline LiNbO₃ films grown on 42cⁱrc YX-LiTaO₃ substrates by DLI-CVD
articles.title_zh: DLI-CVD 在 42cⁱrc YX-LiTaO₃ 衬底上生长的单晶 LiNbO₃ 薄膜的剪切声表面波压电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24639v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Direct growth of single-crystalline LiNbO₃ films with technologically relevant nonpolar orientations and a single ferroelectric domain state remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate the epitaxial growth of a 320-nm-thick, single-domain 42deg YX-oriented LiNbO₃ film on a congruent 42deg YX-cut LiTaO₃ substrate by direct liquid injection chemical vapor deposition. The deposition temperature was limited to 600degC to preserve the ferroelectric domain state of the LiTaO₃ substrate. X-ray diffraction confirmed that the LiNbO₃ film inherited the substrate orientation and domain state and exhibited no detectable secondary phases. The LN rocking-curve full width at half maximum was 0.011deg, approaching the instrumental resolution and demonstrating its high crystalline quality. Single-port leaky surface acoustic wave (LSAW) resonators with a wavelength of 4,mum were fabricated on the LiNbO₃/LiTaO₃ heterostructure and on a bare LiTaO₃ reference substrate. At approximately 1 GHz, the LiNbO₃/LiTaO₃-based resonators exhibited an electromechanical coupling coefficient of about 13%, compared to 8.5% for the reference LiTaO₃-based resonators. These results demonstrate that direct epitaxial growth can produce high-quality, strongly piezoelectric LiNbO₃ films and provide a route toward thickness-controlled layered substrates for high-performance acoustic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有技术相关的非极性取向和单一铁电畴态的单晶 LiNbO₃ 薄膜的直接生长仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了通过直接液体注入化学气相沉积在全等 42 度 YX 切割 LiTaO 基板上外延生长 320 nm 厚、单畴 42 度 YX 取向 LiNbO 薄膜。沉积温度限制在 600℃，以保持 LiTaO3 基底的铁电畴状态。 X射线衍射证实LiNbO₃薄膜继承了基底取向和磁畴状态，并且没有表现出可检测到的第二相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有技术相关的非极性取向和单一铁电畴态的单晶 LiNbO₃ 薄膜的直接生长仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了通过直接液体注入化学气相沉积在全等 42 度 YX 切割 LiTaO 基板上外延生长 320 nm 厚、单畴 42 度 YX 取向 LiNbO 薄膜。沉积温度限制在 600℃，以保持 LiTaO3 基底的铁电畴状态。 X射线衍射证实LiNbO₃薄膜继承了基底取向和磁畴状态，并且没有表现出可检测到的第二相。 LN 摇摆曲线半峰全宽为 0.011 度，接近仪器分辨率并证明其高结晶质量。在 LiNbO₃/LiTaO₃ 异质结构和裸露的 LiTaO₃ 参考基板上制造了波长为 4,mum 的单端口泄漏表面声波 (LSAW) 谐振器。在大约 1 GHz 时，LiNbO3/LiTaO3 基谐振器的机电耦合系数约为 13%，而参考 LiTaO3 基谐振器的机电耦合系数为 8.5%。这些结果表明，直接外延生长可以生产高质量、强压电LiNbO₃薄膜，并为高性能声学器件的厚度控制层状基板提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Microwave probing of magnetic phases in a dipolar-exchange magnet LiGdF₄
articles.title_zh: 偶极交换磁体 LiGdF₄ 中磁相的微波探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24734v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the results of low-temperature magnetic resonance measurements performed on a single-crystal sample of a weakly anisotropic dipolar-exchange antiferromagnet LiGdF₄. The transformation of a resonance spectrum due to the formation of the ordered phase is observed at temperatures below T_N=0.19(1) K. A sequence of field-induced phase transitions is detected for the external magnetic field applied along the fourfold axis of the crystal. A well-resolved magnetic resonance spectrum is observed in one of the low-field magnetic phases as well as above the saturation field. Competing exchange and dipolar interactions, as a special type of magnetic frustration, are suggested to account for the delayed ordering and complex magnetic phase diagram of the system.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了对弱各向异性偶极交换反铁磁体 LiGdF₄ 的单晶样品进行低温磁共振测量的结果。在低于 T_N=0.19(1) K 的温度下观察到由于有序相的形成而引起的共振谱的转变。沿着晶体的四重轴施加的外部磁场检测到一系列场诱发的相变。在低场磁相之一以及饱和场上方观察到高分辨率的磁共振谱。建议将竞争交换和偶极相互作用作为一种特殊类型的磁挫败来解释系统的延迟排序和复杂的磁相图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了对弱各向异性偶极交换反铁磁体 LiGdF₄ 的单晶样品进行低温磁共振测量的结果。在低于 T_N=0.19(1) K 的温度下观察到由于有序相的形成而引起的共振谱的转变。沿着晶体的四重轴施加的外部磁场检测到一系列场诱发的相变。在低场磁相之一以及饱和场上方观察到高分辨率的磁共振谱。建议将竞争交换和偶极相互作用作为一种特殊类型的磁挫败来解释系统的延迟排序和复杂的磁相图。

articles.title: Molecular Doping of MoS₂ with N-Heterocyclic Carbenes: A Raman Study of Interfacial Charge Transfer
articles.title_zh: N-杂环卡宾对 MoS2 进行分子掺杂：界面电荷转移的拉曼研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24769v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate efficient electron doping of exfoliated MoS₂ through the deposition of N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC) molecules onto its surface. Raman spectroscopy reveals a pronounced softening of the optical A₁g phonon mode after NHC deposition, consistent with electron transfer from the NHC molecules to the MoS₂ layers. The largest phonon-energy shifts are observed in monolayer and bilayer flakes whereas changes in bulk-like MoS₂ are negligible, indicating that the doping efficiency depends on the number of layers. This thickness dependence highlights the dominant role of interfacial charge transfer at the NHC/MoS₂ interface. Quantitative analysis of the Raman modes of as-exfoliated and NHC-covered MoS₂, together with comparison with literature values, allows us to estimate an increase in the two-dimensional electron density of about two-orders of magnitude in MoS₂ mono- and bilayers. These results demonstrate that NHC-based surface deposition is a promising approach for chemically tuning the carrier density of semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenides and provide a potential route toward molecularly tunable two-dimensional electronic devices, in which, analogous to modulation doping, the donors reside outside the semiconductor lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了通过在其表面沉积 N-杂环卡宾 (NHC) 分子对剥离的 MoS2 进行有效的电子掺杂。拉曼光谱揭示了 NHC 沉积后光学 A₁g 声子模式的明显软化，这与从 NHC 分子到 MoS2 层的电子转移一致。在单层和双层薄片中观察到最大的声子能量变化，而块状 MoS2 的变化可以忽略不计，这表明掺杂效率取决于层数。这种厚度依赖性凸显了 NHC/MoS2 界面上界面电荷转移的主导作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了通过在其表面沉积 N-杂环卡宾 (NHC) 分子对剥离的 MoS2 进行有效的电子掺杂。拉曼光谱揭示了 NHC 沉积后光学 A₁g 声子模式的明显软化，这与从 NHC 分子到 MoS2 层的电子转移一致。在单层和双层薄片中观察到最大的声子能量变化，而块状 MoS2 的变化可以忽略不计，这表明掺杂效率取决于层数。这种厚度依赖性凸显了 NHC/MoS2 界面上界面电荷转移的主导作用。对剥离状态和 NHC 覆盖的 MoS2 的拉曼模式进行定量分析，并与文献值进行比较，使我们能够估计 MoS2 单层和双层中的二维电子密度增加了大约两个数量级。这些结果表明，基于NHC的表面沉积是一种有前途的化学调节半导体过渡金属二硫族化物载流子密度的方法，并为分子可调节二维电子器件提供了潜在途径，其中与调制掺杂类似，施主位于半导体晶格之外。

articles.title: Strain-Tunable High-T_c Superconductivity in Layered R3m B₂CN
articles.title_zh: 层状 R3m B2CN 中的应变可调谐高温超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using DFPT and Wannier-interpolated matrix elements in EPW, we find that isotropic tensile strain of 0--6% narrows the B:2p/C:2p bands at the Fermi level while softening the phonon branches most strongly coupled to them, driving the coupling constant λ from 0.967 to 2.620. All four strained configurations remain mechanically and dynamically stable, satisfying the Born--Huang criteria with no imaginary phonon modes at any strain level. The fully anisotropic Migdal--Eliashberg equations give a T_c that rises monotonically from 53.5~K to 84.5~K across the strain series, crossing the liquid-nitrogen boiling point at 6% strain. The SISSO-based machine-learning model in EPW agrees with the anisotropic Migdal--Eliashberg T_c values to within 10~K across the strain series.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用 EPW 中的 DFPT 和 Wannier 插值矩阵元素，我们发现 0--6% 的各向同性拉伸应变使费米能级的 B:2p/C:2p 能带变窄，同时软化与其最强耦合的声子分支，将耦合常数 λ 从 0.967 驱动到 2.620。所有四种应变配置都保持机械和动态稳定，满足 Born-Huang 标准，在任何应变水平下都没有虚声子模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用 EPW 中的 DFPT 和 Wannier 插值矩阵元素，我们发现 0--6% 的各向同性拉伸应变使费米能级的 B:2p/C:2p 能带变窄，同时软化与其最强耦合的声子分支，将耦合常数 λ 从 0.967 驱动到 2.620。所有四种应变配置都保持机械和动态稳定，满足 Born-Huang 标准，在任何应变水平下都没有虚声子模式。完全各向异性的 Migdal--Eliashberg 方程给出了在整个应变系列中从 53.5~K 单调上升到 84.5~K 的 T_c，在 6% 应变下穿过液氮沸点。 EPW 中基于 SISSO 的机器学习模型与整个应变系列的各向异性 Migdal-Eliashberg T_c 值在 10~K 范围内一致。

articles.title: Topological Splitting of Sondheimer Oscillations in Thin-Film Weyl Semimetals
articles.title_zh: 薄膜外尔半金属中桑德海默振荡的拓扑分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We discuss topological effects on Sondheimer oscillations in the magnetoresistance of thin-film Weyl semimetals. The Sondheimer oscillations are periodic in magnetic field and originate from the commensurability between the film thickness and the cyclotron-orbit pitch. Using Boltzmann transport theory, we investigate the effects of Berry curvature and orbital magnetic moment on the oscillations. We find that the Sondheimer oscillations split into two branches with different frequencies and that each branch becomes chirped because its frequency depends on magnetic field. These features originate from the orbital-Zeeman-induced deformation of the Fermi surface. The same mechanism also applies to Dirac semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们讨论了薄膜外尔半金属磁阻中桑德海默振荡的拓扑效应。桑德海默振荡在磁场中是周期性的，源自薄膜厚度和回旋加速器轨道节距之间的可通约性。利用玻尔兹曼输运理论，我们研究了贝里曲率和轨道磁矩对振荡的影响。我们发现桑德海默振荡分裂成两个频率不同的分支，并且每个分支都会发出啁啾声，因为其频率取决于磁场。这些特征源于轨道塞曼引起的费米表面变形。同样的机制也适用于狄拉克半金属。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们讨论了薄膜外尔半金属磁阻中桑德海默振荡的拓扑效应。桑德海默振荡在磁场中是周期性的，源自薄膜厚度和回旋加速器轨道节距之间的可通约性。利用玻尔兹曼输运理论，我们研究了贝里曲率和轨道磁矩对振荡的影响。我们发现桑德海默振荡分裂成两个频率不同的分支，并且每个分支都会发出啁啾声，因为其频率取决于磁场。这些特征源于轨道塞曼引起的费米表面变形。同样的机制也适用于狄拉克半金属。

articles.title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions in the SU(2) gauge theory of the Shastry-Sutherland Dirac spin liquids
articles.title_zh: Shastry-Sutherland 狄拉克自旋液体 SU(2) 规范理论中的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We classify the fermion bilinears of the SU(2) gauge theory of the Shastry-Sutherland Dirac spin liquids under the spin-orbit-locked space group and treat the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interactions of SrCu₂(BO₃)₂ at leading order in 1/N and at one loop. At linear order DM can neither gap the spinons nor destabilize the SO(5) point above a scale T^*. Symmetry forbids every local gauge-singlet fermion mass at any order. Among the singlet bilinears, the in-plane couplings induce only a conserved spin current of dimension exactly 2, which sets T^*=4λsimeq0.03-0.17 K, and the out-of-plane coupling only a flavored spin-2 current, irrelevant at a unitary critical point. DM-induced Yukawa couplings start below 2% of the one that bounds the pseudocritical window. In zero field, measured samples order above 1 K, at or above T^*. Below T^*, in a two-dimensional sample at the critical pressure, the Dirac cones reconstruct into a chirally protected d-wave quadratic band touching whose only gauge-singlet gap channels are the two valence-bond components and the scalar chirality. A one-loop flow, with the gauge field screened by the band touching, ends at T**sim(0.03-0.1)λ on a ray containing valence-bond order for the material's exchange and for most random couplings, and otherwise on a gapped chiral Z₂ spin liquid. The DM bias between the two plaquette patterns is at most of order 10⁻⁴, with a direction not fixed at O(1/N), whereas non-magnetic quenched disorder couples a relevant random field to the plaquette doublet and none to the chirality. A field along [100] induces a (π,π) Néel moment linear in the field; a field along [001] does not. This selection rule also holds in the dimer phase and is testable by ¹¹B NMR under pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对自旋轨道锁定空间群下的 Shastry-Sutherland Dirac 自旋液体的 SU(2) 规范理论的费米子双线性进行分类，并在 1/N 和一个循环中处理 SrCu2(BO3)2 的前导阶 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用。在线性阶上，DM 既不能使自旋子间隙，也不能破坏 T^* 尺度之上的 SO(5) 点的稳定性。对称性禁止任何阶的局部规范单线态费米子质量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对自旋轨道锁定空间群下的 Shastry-Sutherland Dirac 自旋液体的 SU(2) 规范理论的费米子双线性进行分类，并在 1/N 和一个循环中处理 SrCu2(BO3)2 的前导阶 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用。在线性阶上，DM 既不能使自旋子间隙，也不能破坏 T^* 尺度之上的 SO(5) 点的稳定性。对称性禁止任何阶的局部规范单线态费米子质量。在单重态双线性中，面内耦合仅引起维度恰好为 2 的守恒自旋电流，这使得 T^*=4λsimeq0.03-0.17 K，而面外耦合仅引起风味自旋 2 电流，在酉临界点不相关。 DM 引起的汤川耦合开始时低于伪临界窗口边界耦合的 2%。在零场中，测量的样本阶数高于 1 K，等于或高于 T^*。在 T^* 以下，在临界压力下的二维样本中，狄拉克锥重构为手性保护的 d 波二次带接触，其唯一的规范单重态间隙通道是两个价键分量和标量手性。单环流（其规范场由能带接触屏蔽）在包含材料交换和大多数随机耦合的价键序的射线上终止于 T**sim(0.03-0.1)λ，否则在有间隙的手性 Z2 自旋液体上终止。两个斑块图案之间的 DM 偏差最多为 10⁻⁴ 量级，方向不固定为 O(1/N)，而非磁性猝灭无序将相关随机场耦合到斑块双峰，而不耦合到手性。沿 [100] 的场在场中产生线性 (π,π) Néel 矩；沿 [001] 的字段则不然。该选择规则在二聚体相中也成立，并且可以在压力下通过 11 B NMR 进行测试。

articles.title: Large exchange bias from coupled antiferromagnetic order and glassy magnetic freezing in Co₀.₃₆NbS₂
articles.title_zh: Co₀.₃₆NbS2 中耦合反铁磁序和玻璃态磁冻结产生的大交换偏差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetization measurements on single-crystalline Co₀.₃₆NbS₂ reveal antiferromagnetic order near TN simeq 26 K and a lower-temperature history-dependent magnetic response consistent with glassy freezing of a subset of magnetic moments. After field cooling, M(H) loops exhibit a sizable exchange-bias shift, reaching |HEB| simeq 4.4 kOe at 1.8 K for a 70 kOe field-cooling sweep protocol. The training effect, field-sweep and cooling-field protocol dependence, and disappearance of the bias near a blocking temperature TB simeq 12 K, well below TN, support an interpretation in which frozen uncompensated moments are exchange-coupled to an antiferromagnetic matrix. These results suggest that antiferromagnetic-glassy-moment coupling may provide a broader route to exchange bias in off-stoichiometric magnetic NbS₂ intercalates.
articles.abstract_zh: 单晶 Co₀.₃₆NbS2 的磁化测量揭示了 TN simeq 26 K 附近的反铁磁序以及与磁矩子集的玻璃态冻结一致的低温历史相关磁响应。现场冷却后，M(H) 环路表现出相当大的交换偏置偏移，达到 |HEB|对于 70 kOe 现场冷却扫描协议，1.8 K 时 simeq 4.4 kOe。训练效果、场扫描和冷却场协议依赖性以及远低于 TN 的阻断温度 TB simeq 12 K 附近的偏置消失，支持冻结未补偿力矩与反铁磁矩阵交换耦合的解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单晶 Co₀.₃₆NbS2 的磁化测量揭示了 TN simeq 26 K 附近的反铁磁序以及与磁矩子集的玻璃态冻结一致的低温历史相关磁响应。现场冷却后，M(H) 环路表现出相当大的交换偏置偏移，达到 |HEB|对于 70 kOe 现场冷却扫描协议，1.8 K 时 simeq 4.4 kOe。训练效果、场扫描和冷却场协议依赖性以及远低于 TN 的阻断温度 TB simeq 12 K 附近的偏置消失，支持冻结未补偿力矩与反铁磁矩阵交换耦合的解释。这些结果表明，反铁磁玻璃矩耦合可能提供更广泛的途径来交换非化学计量磁性 NbS2 插层中的偏置。

articles.title: Frustration-Assisted Electrical Switching in CoₓTaS₂
articles.title_zh: CoₓTaS2 中的挫败辅助电开关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrical switching in antiferromagnets is commonly described as the action of current-induced torques on a rigid order parameter. In frustrated magnets, however, competing states can create a history-dependent energy landscape in which slow collective dynamics actively participate in electrical reconfiguration. Here, we demonstrate frustration-assisted switching in near-stoichiometric CoₓTaS₂, a van der Waals antiferromagnet located at the composition-sensitive boundary between Hall-active and Hall-inactive multi-Q-related magnetic regimes. Although the crystals exhibit no resolved spontaneous Hall response, they retain van Hove singularities near the Fermi level and order antiferromagnetically below T_N simeq 31.5 K. Current pulses write nonvolatile anisotropic resistance states in microstructured devices, with an activation current density nearly an order of magnitude below that reported for the Hall-active lower-intercalation phase. The switching response separates into two temperature-dependent dynamical regimes rather than following a single current threshold. Independent magnetization-aging and post-field-relaxation measurements reveal slow, history-dependent magnetic dynamics, and the relaxation strength closely follows the inverse switching amplitude. These results identify magnetic frustration and glassy dynamics as central ingredients in the electrical reconfiguration of CoₓTaS₂, establishing a route to functional switching through a dynamically soft antiferromagnetic landscape.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁体中的电气开关通常被描述为电流感应扭矩对刚性阶参数的作用。然而，在受挫的磁体中，竞争状态可以创造一个依赖于历史的能源景观，其中缓慢的集体动态积极参与电力重构。在这里，我们演示了近化学计量 CoₓTaS2 的挫败辅助切换，这是一种范德华反铁磁体，位于霍尔活性和霍尔非活性多 Q 相关磁态之间的成分敏感边界。尽管晶体没有表现出解析的自发霍尔响应，但它们保留了费米能级附近的范霍夫奇点，并在 T_N simeq 31.5 K 以下反铁磁性有序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体中的电气开关通常被描述为电流感应扭矩对刚性阶参数的作用。然而，在受挫的磁体中，竞争状态可以创造一个依赖于历史的能源景观，其中缓慢的集体动态积极参与电力重构。在这里，我们演示了近化学计量 CoₓTaS2 的挫败辅助切换，这是一种范德华反铁磁体，位于霍尔活性和霍尔非活性多 Q 相关磁态之间的成分敏感边界。尽管晶体没有表现出解析的自发霍尔响应，但它们保留了费米能级附近的范霍夫奇点，并在 T_N simeq 31.5 K 以下反铁磁性有序。电流脉冲在微结构器件中写入非易失性各向异性电阻态，激活电流密度比霍尔活性较低插层相低近一个数量级。开关响应分为两个与温度相关的动态状态，而不是遵循单个电流阈值。独立的磁化老化和后场弛豫测量揭示了缓慢的、依赖于历史的磁动力学，并且弛豫强度紧密跟随反向切换幅度。这些结果表明，磁挫败和玻璃动力学是 CoₓTaS2 电重构的核心成分，从而建立了一条通过动态软反铁磁景观进行功能切换的途径。

articles.title: Electric Hidden Unconventional Collinear Magnetism in 2D (PT)-Symmetric Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 二维 (PT) 对称反铁磁体中的电隐藏非常规共线磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric hidden unconventional collinear magnetism, in which a perpendicular electric field ((E_z)) lifts the (PT)-enforced degeneracy and selectively releases the hidden crystallographic constraints in conventional 2D antiferromagnets to drive emergent magnetic phases, has remained largely unexplored. Here we establish a complete symmetry classification of all 88 collinear spin layer groups (cSLGs) compatible with conventional (PT)-symmetric antiferromagnets, and show that the (E_z) drives the system into three distinct classes of unconventional collinear magnetism: type-IV magnetism (Class-I, 23 cSLGs), altermagnetism (Class-II, 34 cSLGs), and fully compensated ferrimagnetism (Class-III, 31 cSLGs). We illustrate these categories using the most common and feasibly exfoliable 2D candidate materials. These include Sr₂CaCr₂P₂O₉ and Sr₂CaCr₂As₂O₉ (Class-I), BaMnGe and MnPS₃ (Class-II), and Sr₃Fe₂O₅Cl₂ and bilayer MnBi₂Te₄ (Class-III). We further demonstrate that the (E_z) generates distinctly different spin-splitting fingerprints across the three classes, yielding distinct spin-dependent responses: the electric Hall effect in Class-I, spin-polarized transport in Class-II, and the electric reversible magneto-optical Kerr effect in Class-III. Our work not only closes a complete internal cycle from conventional to unconventional collinear magnetism in 2D antiferromagnets, but also establishes a viable all-electrical compensated magnetism platform and control scheme for future spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 电隐藏的非常规共线磁力，其中垂直电场 ((E_z)) 提升 (PT) 强制的简并性并选择性地释放传统 2D 反铁磁体中隐藏的晶体学约束以驱动涌现的磁相，该磁力在很大程度上仍未得到探索。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电隐藏的非常规共线磁力，其中垂直电场 ((E_z)) 提升 (PT) 强制的简并性并选择性地释放传统 2D 反铁磁体中隐藏的晶体学约束以驱动涌现的磁相，该磁力在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们建立了与传统 (PT) 对称反铁磁体兼容的所有 88 个共线自旋层组 (cSLG) 的完整对称分类，并表明 (E_z) 将系统驱动为三个不同类别的非常规共线磁性：IV 型磁性（I 类，23 个 cSLG）、交变磁性（II 类，34 个 cSLG）和完全补偿的亚铁磁性（III 类，31 个 cSLG）。我们使用最常见且可行的可剥离二维候选材料来说明这些类别。其中包括 Sr2CaCr2P2O9 和 Sr2CaCr2As2O9（I 类）、BaMnGe 和 MnPS3（II 类）以及 Sr3Fe2O5Cl2 和双层 MnBi2Te4（III 类）。我们进一步证明，(E_z) 在三个类别中产生明显不同的自旋分裂指纹，产生不同的自旋相关响应：I 类中的电霍尔效应、II 类中的自旋极化输运以及 III 类中的电可逆磁光克尔效应。我们的工作不仅封闭了二维反铁磁体中从传统到非常规共线磁性的完整内部循环，而且还为未来的自旋电子应用建立了可行的全电补偿磁性平台和控制方案。

articles.title: Electronic structure, magnetic order and anisotropic magnetoresistance in mathbfEu₁₋ₓGdₓCd₂P₂ (0 le x le1)
articles.title_zh: mathbfEu₁₋ₓGdₓCd2P2 (0 le x le1) 中的电子结构、磁序和各向异性磁阻
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, EuCd₂P₂ has attracted increased attention for its colossal magnetoresistive (CMR) property, the mechanism of which seems to deviate from that of known canonical CMR compounds such as manganites. Many studies underscore the role of low density of hole carriers caused by Eu vacancies, particularly in stabilizing ferromagnetic (FM) order and modifying electrical transport and magnetoresistive responses in this compound. A magnetic polaron based mechanism rather than double exchange based mechanism is being proposed to explain the CMR effect for this compound. In this work, we explore the effect of elctron doping on the magnetic transition and CMR behaviour via Gd substitution at Eu sites with varying concentration (x) in Eu₁₋ₓGdₓCd₂P₂. Our Density Functional Theory (DFT) and Monte Carlo-based calculations reveal an oscillating ground state magnetic order as a function of electron carrier density. The ground state is found to be A-AFM metal for x=0.056, 0.125 and 0.5 while it becomes ferromagnetic metal at x= 0.33, 0.67 and 1. Most importantly, we predict colossal anisotropic magnetoresistance in this compound for x=0.125 and 0.5. The underlying mechanism of anisotropic CMR in this compound looks similar to double exchange like due to the presence of a strong intra-site 4f-5d ferromagnetic exchange interaction and an itinerant electron in the hybridized conduction states. The oscillating ground state magnetic order and the enhancement of transition temperature (as high as 150K for x=0.67) as a function of electron carrier density offers a new avenue to tune the magnetotransport property in this compound and offers an excellent platform for designing future spintronics devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，EuCd2P2 因其巨大的磁阻 (CMR) 特性而引起了越来越多的关注，其机制似乎偏离了已知的典型 CMR 化合物（如锰酸盐）的机制。许多研究强调了由 Eu 空位引起的低空穴载流子密度的作用，特别是在稳定铁磁 (FM) 有序以及改变该化合物中的电传输和磁阻响应方面。正在提出基于磁极化子的机制而不是基于双交换的机制来解释该化合物的 CMR 效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，EuCd2P2 因其巨大的磁阻 (CMR) 特性而引起了越来越多的关注，其机制似乎偏离了已知的典型 CMR 化合物（如锰酸盐）的机制。许多研究强调了由 Eu 空位引起的低空穴载流子密度的作用，特别是在稳定铁磁 (FM) 有序以及改变该化合物中的电传输和磁阻响应方面。正在提出基于磁极化子的机制而不是基于双交换的机制来解释该化合物的 CMR 效应。在这项工作中，我们通过在 Eu₁₋ₓGdₓCd2P2 中不同浓度 (x) 的 Eu 位点进行 Gd 取代，探讨了电子掺杂对磁转变和 CMR 行为的影响。我们的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 和基于蒙特卡罗的计算揭示了振荡基态磁序作为电子载流子密度的函数。当 x=0.056、0.125 和 0.5 时，基态为 A-AFM 金属，而当 x=0.33、0.67 和 1 时，基态变为铁磁金属。最重要的是，我们预测当 x=0.125 和 0.5 时，该化合物会出现巨大的各向异性磁阻。该化合物中各向异性 CMR 的基本机制看起来类似于双交换，因为存在强的位点内 4f-5d 铁磁交换相互作用和处于混合传导态的流动电子。振荡基态磁序和转变温度（x=0.67 时高达 150K）的增强作为电子载流子密度的函数，为调整该化合物中的磁输运特性提供了新途径，并为设计未来的自旋电子器件提供了出色的平台。

articles.title: Long-lived nonequilibrium spin configuration induced by dual optical excitation
articles.title_zh: 双光激发引起的长寿命非平衡自旋构型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ability to create and control nonequilibrium spin states is central to understanding ultrafast magnetism and to developing optical routes for manipulating magnetic materials beyond conventional thermal pathways.In metallic systems, photoexcited electronic distributions rapidly evolve toward quasi-thermal states through efficient electron-electron and electron-phonon scattering, making long-lived modification of spin-dependent interactions difficult to achieve. Here, we investigate coherent magnetization precession in an amorphous GdFeCo thin film driven by simultaneous excitation with two femtosecond laser pulses.Using a symmetric dual-pump geometry that continuously evolves from single-pulse to spatially periodic excitation, we separate effects associated with the excitation pattern from those arising from simultaneous dual-pump excitation. We identify a narrow excitation window in which the lifetime of the ferromagnetic-resonance-like mode increases strongly while its frequency exhibits a small but reproducible increase.Time-window analysis shows that the enhanced lifetime persists for several hundred picoseconds, substantially longer than transient magnetostatic effects associated with the periodic excitation pattern.The combined frequency and decay time changes cannot be explained by spatially structured heating alone and instead point to a long-lived nonequilibrium spin-dependent electronic configuration. Within a phenomenological Elliott-Yafet framework, the simultaneous increase in FMR decay time and frequency is consistent with a transient reduction of the effective spin-mixing parameter governing spin-flip scattering. Our results demonstrate that the excitation pathway, rather than excitation energy alone, can serve as a control parameter for spin relaxation and provide access to nonequilibrium spin states that are not readily reached by conventional single-pulse excitation.
articles.abstract_zh: 创建和控制非平衡自旋态的能力对于理解超快磁性以及开发用于超越传统热途径操纵磁性材料的光学途径至关重要。在金属系统中，光激发电子分布通过有效的电子-电子和电子-声子散射迅速向准热态演化，使得自旋相关相互作用的长期修改难以实现。在这里，我们研究了由两个飞秒激光脉冲同时激励驱动的非晶 GdFeCo 薄膜中的相干磁化进动。使用从单脉冲连续演化到空间周期性激励的对称双泵几何结构，我们将与激励模式相关的效应与同时双泵激励产生的效应分开。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 创建和控制非平衡自旋态的能力对于理解超快磁性以及开发用于超越传统热途径操纵磁性材料的光学途径至关重要。在金属系统中，光激发电子分布通过有效的电子-电子和电子-声子散射迅速向准热态演化，使得自旋相关相互作用的长期修改难以实现。在这里，我们研究了由两个飞秒激光脉冲同时激励驱动的非晶 GdFeCo 薄膜中的相干磁化进动。使用从单脉冲连续演化到空间周期性激励的对称双泵几何结构，我们将与激励模式相关的效应与同时双泵激励产生的效应分开。我们确定了一个狭窄的激发窗口，其中类铁磁谐振模式的寿命大幅增加，而其频率呈现小但可重复的增加。时间窗口分析表明，增强的寿命持续数百皮秒，远长于与周期性激发模式相关的瞬态静磁效应。频率和衰减时间的组合变化不能仅用空间结构加热来解释，而是指向长寿命的非平衡自旋相关电子配置。在现象学 Elliott-Yafet 框架内，FMR 衰减时间和频率的同时增加与控制自旋翻转散射的有效自旋混合参数的瞬时减少一致。我们的结果表明，激发途径（而不是单独的激发能量）可以作为自旋弛豫的控制参数，并提供传统单脉冲激发不易达到的非平衡自旋态。

articles.title: Tensor network Monte Carlo study of the J1-J2 Ising model on the square lattice
articles.title_zh: 方格上 J1-J2 Ising 模型的张量网络蒙特卡罗研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The frustrated square-lattice J1-J2 Ising model exhibits rich magnetic phases, yet its phase transitions remain difficult to characterize due to critical slowing down in conventional Monte Carlo and truncation errors inherent to tensor renormalization group methods.We develop a tensor-network Monte Carlo (TNMC) algorithm for this frustrated model, which supports both open and periodic boundary conditions. For periodic lattices, we use a sweeping block-update strategy that updates spin blocks while fixing surrounding spins.To boost efficiency, we couple our sampler with histogram reweighting, and test each technique standalone to validate these independent optimizations.We perform extensive finite-size scaling analyses at g=0.55 and g=1.0, extracting apparent critical temperatures and effective thermal exponents from Binder-cumulant data.Our method offers an efficient, nearly bias-free path for large-scale simulations of J1-J2-type frustrated magnets under periodic boundaries and generalizes readily to other frustrated spin lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 受抑方格 J1-J2 Ising 模型表现出丰富的磁相，但由于传统蒙特卡罗的临界减速和张量重正化群方法固有的截断误差，其相变仍然难以表征。我们为该受抑模型开发了张量网络蒙特卡罗 (TNMC) 算法，该算法支持开放边界条件和周期性边界条件。对于周期性晶格，我们使用扫描块更新策略，在修复周围自旋的同时更新自旋块。为了提高效率，我们将采样器与直方图重新加权结合起来，并独立测试每种技术以验证这些独立的优化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受抑方格 J1-J2 Ising 模型表现出丰富的磁相，但由于传统蒙特卡罗的临界减速和张量重正化群方法固有的截断误差，其相变仍然难以表征。我们为该受抑模型开发了张量网络蒙特卡罗 (TNMC) 算法，该算法支持开放边界条件和周期性边界条件。对于周期性晶格，我们使用扫描块更新策略，在修复周围自旋的同时更新自旋块。为了提高效率，我们将采样器与直方图重新加权结合起来，并独立测试每种技术以验证这些独立的优化。我们在 g=0.55 和 g=1.0 处执行广泛的有限尺寸缩放分析，从 Binder 累积数据中提取表观临界温度和有效热指数。我们的方法为大规模模拟提供了一种高效、几乎无偏差的路径。 J1-J2 型受挫磁体位于周期性边界下，很容易推广到其他受挫自旋晶格。

articles.title: Instability-driven segregation of V group transition metals on HEB₂ grain boundaries influencing enhanced mechanical properties
articles.title_zh: HEB2 晶界上 V 族过渡金属的不稳定驱动偏析影响增强的机械性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Five metals share a common sublattice in the (Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B₂ (HEB₂). Most high-entropy materials are produced as polycrystalline materials in the form of sintered ceramics. The question of which metal species are located at grain boundaries is still unknown. Here, we calculated the grain-boundary energy γGB of four types of boundaries in five binary diborides and HEB₂ using density functional theory (DFT). We analyzed the bonding at these boundaries using COHP and sampled cation segregation at six boundaries of HEB₂, ordered and general, using Monte Carlo / molecular dynamics with a MACE potential that was fine-tuned for this system. According to our results γGB splits by group: the group V diborides NbB₂ and TaB₂ form boundaries with about half the energy of the group IV at three of the four types of GBs, ranging from 0.8 to 2.7 compared to 2.5--4.8~J/m². COHP shows a significant difference at the Fermi level, namely the Me--B bonds of NbB₂ and TaB₂ are antibonding at Fermi energy (E_F) in the bulk but bonding at the GB, while their integrated strength hardly changes. In HEB₂ the segregation follows a similar pattern: Nb and Ta are enriched at five of the six grain boundaries, including general boundaries, up to 23--35~at.% at 2000~K, although the size of the atoms would favor Zr and Hf in the expanded sites. A segregated Σ 193 grain boundary can withstand 26 against 20~GPa for a random boundary in tension at 300~K. The grain boundaries of HEB₂ are composed of group V metals, as suggested by the boundary energies of binaries compounds and their bonding at the Fermi level. Grain boundaries of the (Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B₂ preferentially include Nb and Ta. This lowers the grain boundary energy and strengthens the boundaries. This consists of the lower boundary energy and changes Fermi level bonding in NbB₂ and TaB₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 五种金属在 (Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B2 (HEB2) 中共享一个共同的亚晶格。大多数高熵材料都是以烧结陶瓷形式的多晶材料生产的。哪些金属种类位于晶界的问题仍然未知。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算了五种二硼化物和 HEB2 中四种晶界的晶界能 γGB。我们使用 COHP 分析了这些边界处的键合，并使用蒙特卡罗/分子动力学和针对该系统进行微调的 MACE 势，对 HEB2 的六个有序和一般边界处的阳离子偏析进行了采样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 五种金属在 (Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B2 (HEB2) 中共享一个共同的亚晶格。大多数高熵材料都是以烧结陶瓷形式的多晶材料生产的。哪些金属种类位于晶界的问题仍然未知。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算了五种二硼化物和 HEB2 中四种晶界的晶界能 γGB。我们使用 COHP 分析了这些边界处的键合，并使用蒙特卡罗/分子动力学和针对该系统进行微调的 MACE 势，对 HEB2 的六个有序和一般边界处的阳离子偏析进行了采样。根据我们的结果，γGB 按族划分：V 族二硼化物 NbB2 和 TaB2 形成边界，在四种类型的 GB 中的三种中，其能量约为 IV 族的一半，范围从 0.8 到 2.7，而 2.5--4.8~J/m2。 COHP在费米能级上表现出显着差异，即NbB2和TaB2的Me--B键在体相费米能级(E_F)处呈反键合，但在晶界处成键，而它们的综合强度几乎没有变化。在 HEB2 中，偏析遵循类似的模式：Nb 和 Ta 在 6 个晶界中的 5 个处富集，包括一般晶界，在 2000~K 时高达 23--35~at.%，尽管原子的尺寸有利于 Zr 和 Hf 在扩展位点。偏析的 Σ 193 晶界可以承受 26 对 20~GPa 的随机晶界在 300~K 的张力。 HEB2 的晶界由 V 族金属组成，如二元化合物的边界能及其在费米能级的键合所示。 (Hf，Ta，Ti，Nb，Zr)B 2 的晶界优先包括Nb和Ta。这降低了晶界能并强化了晶界。这由较低的边界能组成，并改变了 NbB2 和 TaB2 中的费米能级键合。

articles.title: Near self-duality and spatial reorganization of anyon vortex lattices
articles.title_zh: 任意子涡晶格的近自对偶性和空间重组
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Contact attraction drives the self-generated vortex lattice of a trapped anyon gas towards self-duality, but integrated energies do not reveal where the remaining departure from it is located. We address this question in the almost-bosonic Chern--Simons--Schrödinger average-field model using a positive, gauge-invariant local defect that measures the covariant kinetic energy in excess of the magnetic bound. Numerically computed low-energy states at three statistical fluxes show that, as the stability line is approached, the integrated defect falls by about two orders of magnitude while the density modulation grows, so that magnetic saturation and density uniformity separate. The residual defect concentrates in a vortex-free outer shell that carries unscreened statistical flux. There it reduces to a smooth radial mismatch between the statistical flow and the density decay, which the interior lattice cannot cancel, whereas the covariant kinetic and amplitude-gradient energies show no comparable enrichment. The effect is robust to grid and box refinement, while its magnitude depends on flux and on the low-energy branch. Exact dilation and contact-response identities relate the squared energy to the density shape and provide consistency checks. Repulsion produces the opposite trend: a smoother density with a larger defect.
articles.abstract_zh: 接触吸引力驱动被捕获的任意子气体的自生涡晶格走向自对偶性，但积分能量并不能揭示剩余的偏离位置。我们在近玻色子陈-西蒙斯-薛定谔平均场模型中解决了这个问题，使用正的、规范不变的局部缺陷来测量超过磁界的协变动能。对三个统计通量的低能态进行数值计算表明，随着接近稳定线，积分缺陷下降约两个数量级，而密度调制则增长，从而磁饱和和密度均匀性分离。残余缺陷集中在无涡流外壳中，该外壳携带未经筛选的统计通量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 接触吸引力驱动被捕获的任意子气体的自生涡晶格走向自对偶性，但积分能量并不能揭示剩余的偏离位置。我们在近玻色子陈-西蒙斯-薛定谔平均场模型中解决了这个问题，使用正的、规范不变的局部缺陷来测量超过磁界的协变动能。对三个统计通量的低能态进行数值计算表明，随着接近稳定线，积分缺陷下降约两个数量级，而密度调制则增长，从而磁饱和和密度均匀性分离。残余缺陷集中在无涡流外壳中，该外壳携带未经筛选的统计通量。在那里，它减少到统计流和密度衰减之间的平滑径向失配，而内部晶格无法消除这种失配，而协变动能和振幅梯度能则没有表现出可比的富集。该效应对于网格和盒子细化来说是稳健的，而其大小取决于通量和低能量分支。精确的膨胀和接触响应恒等式将平方能量与密度形状联系起来并提供一致性检查。排斥产生相反的趋势：密度更平滑，缺陷更大。

articles.title: Activating Nonstandard Axion Electrodynamics in Topological Insulator Materials
articles.title_zh: 激活拓扑绝缘体材料中的非标准轴子电动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The conventional axion response of topological insulators (TIs) is characterized by an isotropic pseudoscalar magnetoelectric (ME) coupling rooted in band topology: the condensed matter analog of the axion field. However, as we reveal here, this and other more general ME responses can arise in existing TI materials from symmetry breaking without requiring nontrivial topology. Indeed, we show that breaking parity and time-reversal symmetries using combined electric and magnetic fields unlocks nonstandard axion electrodynamics via the controllable activation of various tensorial ME couplings, thus, going beyond the standard axion picture. Using a well-established first-principles-informed effective model for Bi-and Sb-based TI materials, we estimate the resulting ME coefficients and make concrete predictions for experiments. In particular, we identify nonreciprocal directional dichroism as a distinctive magneto-optical signature of these ME effects, therefore opening a route to engineer and probe symmetry-induced ME phenomena beyond the conventional topological response.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑绝缘体 (TI) 的传统轴子响应的特点是植根于能带拓扑的各向同性赝标量磁电 (ME) 耦合：轴子场的凝聚态模拟。然而，正如我们在这里所揭示的，这种和其他更一般的 ME 响应可以在现有 TI 材料中因对称性破缺而出现，而不需要非平凡的拓扑。事实上，我们表明，利用组合电场和磁场打破奇偶校验和时间反转对称性，可以通过各种张量 ME 耦合的可控激活来解锁非标准轴子电动力学，从而超越标准轴子图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑绝缘体 (TI) 的传统轴子响应的特点是植根于能带拓扑的各向同性赝标量磁电 (ME) 耦合：轴子场的凝聚态模拟。然而，正如我们在这里所揭示的，这种和其他更一般的 ME 响应可以在现有 TI 材料中因对称性破缺而出现，而不需要非平凡的拓扑。事实上，我们表明，利用组合电场和磁场打破奇偶校验和时间反转对称性，可以通过各种张量 ME 耦合的可控激活来解锁非标准轴子电动力学，从而超越标准轴子图。使用针对 Bi 和 Sb 基 TI 材料的完善的第一性原理有效模型，我们估计了所得的 ME 系数并为实验做出了具体的预测。特别是，我们将非互易方向二色性确定为这些 ME 效应的独特磁光特征，因此开辟了一条在传统拓扑响应之外设计和探测对称引起的 ME 现象的途径。

articles.title: NEP-kappa 2.0: A unified framework for phonon transport and nonequilibrium thermalization with machine-learning interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: NEP-kappa 2.0：具有机器学习原子间势的声子输运和非平衡热化的统一框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present NEP-kappa 2.0, a unified framework that integrates density-functional theory, material-specific machine-learning interatomic potentials, and pretrained force models for advanced phonon calculations. A common workflow enables harmonic lattice dynamics, quasi-harmonic and stochastic self-consistent phonon treatments, three- and four-phonon transport, Wigner population--coherence transport, and time-dependent phonon dynamics. Applications to 3C-SiC, BAs, and Cs₂AgInCl₆ demonstrate consistent force-model comparisons, finite-temperature renormalization, higher-order scattering, and intermode coherence. Beyond steady-state transport, mode-resolved simulations of selectively excited 3C-SiC reveal that half of the injected optical-phonon energy reaches acoustic modes within approximately 3.75 ps, primarily through one-optical--two-acoustic scattering. Acoustic branches exhibit response times differing by a factor of five, with competing scattering channels producing a transient energy overshoot. Channel-resolved entropy production and persistent nonthermal occupations distinguish interbranch energy redistribution from intrabranch thermalization. The framework connects equilibrium phonon transport with microscopic nonequilibrium energy dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 NEP-kappa 2.0，这是一个统一的框架，集成了密度泛函理论、特定材料的机器学习原子间势以及用于高级声子计算的预训练力模型。通用工作流程可实现谐波晶格动力学、准谐波和随机自洽声子处理、三声子和四声子输运、维格纳布居相干输运以及时间相关声子动力学。在 3C-SiC、BA 和 Cs2AgInCl6 上的应用展示了一致的力模型比较、有限温度重整化、高阶散射和模间相干性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了 NEP-kappa 2.0，这是一个统一的框架，集成了密度泛函理论、特定材料的机器学习原子间势以及用于高级声子计算的预训练力模型。通用工作流程可实现谐波晶格动力学、准谐波和随机自洽声子处理、三声子和四声子输运、维格纳布居相干输运以及时间相关声子动力学。在 3C-SiC、BA 和 Cs2AgInCl6 上的应用展示了一致的力模型比较、有限温度重整化、高阶散射和模间相干性。除了稳态传输之外，选择性激发 3C-SiC 的模式解析模拟表明，注入的光学声子能量的一半在大约 3.75 ps 内达到声学模式，主要是通过一光学 - 二声学散射。声学分支的响应时间相差五倍，竞争性散射通道会产生瞬态能量超调。通道分辨的熵产生和持续的非热占据将分支间能量重新分配与分支内热化区分开来。该框架将平衡声子输运与微观非平衡能量动力学联系起来。

articles.title: Thermal Responses of Spin Density and Spin Current Induced by Bogoliubov Fermi Surfaces in Proximity Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 邻近超导体中 Bogoliubov 费米面引起的自旋密度和自旋电流的热响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergence of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces in s-wave proximity superconducting systems provides a unique platform for generating nontrivial spin responses in the presence of spin-orbit coupling. In this work, we investigate temperature-gradient driven responses of spin polarization and spin current in such a proximity system related to Fe(Te,Se). The interplay of in-plane magnetization, superconductivity, and nematicity gives rise to nontrivial Berry curvature and spin-related hybrid Berry curvature on the Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, which are shown to lead to finite thermally driven nonequilibrium spin polarization and spin Nernst effect. We find that the responses are strongly enhanced by the emergence of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, and are linear in temperature at low temperatures, rendering a unique spintronic character of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: s波邻近超导系统中博戈柳博夫费米面的出现提供了一个独特的平台，可以在自旋轨道耦合的情况下产生非平凡的自旋响应。在这项工作中，我们研究了与 Fe(Te,Se) 相关的邻近系统中自旋极化和自旋电流的温度梯度驱动响应。面内磁化、超导性和向列性的相互作用在博戈柳波夫费米面上产生了非平凡的贝里曲率和自旋相关的混合贝里曲率，这被证明会导致有限的热驱动非平衡自旋极化和自旋能斯特效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: s波邻近超导系统中博戈柳博夫费米面的出现提供了一个独特的平台，可以在自旋轨道耦合的情况下产生非平凡的自旋响应。在这项工作中，我们研究了与 Fe(Te,Se) 相关的邻近系统中自旋极化和自旋电流的温度梯度驱动响应。面内磁化、超导性和向列性的相互作用在博戈柳波夫费米面上产生了非平凡的贝里曲率和自旋相关的混合贝里曲率，这被证明会导致有限的热驱动非平衡自旋极化和自旋能斯特效应。我们发现，Bogoliubov 费米面的出现极大地增强了响应，并且在低温下呈线性，呈现出 Bogoliubov 费米面独特的自旋电子特征。

articles.title: Microscopic Compensation of Circular Optical Response in Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交变磁体中圆形光学响应的微观补偿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A weak or vanishing circular optical signal need not imply weak helicity-sensitive transitions: it can be the residual of much larger opposing microscopic contributions. We resolve the finite-frequency interband Kubo response before summing over transitions and momentum, separating cancellation among transitions at fixed momentum from cancellation across the Brillouin zone. An exactly compensated d-wave model establishes the symmetry benchmark. In MnTe, first-principles Wannier calculations reveal a symmetry-dark Néel orientation with an extended sign-changing circular kernel whose bulk integral vanishes. Reorienting the Néel vector removes this extinction, yet the allowed response remains a small imbalance between large positive- and negative-momentum sectors; the imbalance reverses with photon energy and flips the macroscopic sign. Thus magnetic symmetry decides whether circular response is allowed, whereas microscopic compensation determines how much survives and with what sign. This distinction provides a general framework for interpreting weak, vanishing, and sign-changing magneto-optical signals in compensated magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 弱或消失的圆形光信号不一定意味着弱的螺旋性敏感跃迁：它可以是更大的相反微观贡献的残余物。我们在对跃迁和动量求和之前求解有限频率带间 Kubo 响应，将固定动量跃迁之间的抵消与布里渊区的抵消分开。精确补偿的 d 波模型建立了对称性基准。在 MnTe 中，第一原理 Wannier 计算揭示了对称暗尼尔取向，具有扩展的变号圆形核，其体积积分消失。重新定向尼尔矢量消除了这种灭绝，但允许的反应仍然是大的正动量和负动量部分之间的小不平衡；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 弱或消失的圆形光信号不一定意味着弱的螺旋性敏感跃迁：它可以是更大的相反微观贡献的残余物。我们在对跃迁和动量求和之前求解有限频率带间 Kubo 响应，将固定动量跃迁之间的抵消与布里渊区的抵消分开。精确补偿的 d 波模型建立了对称性基准。在 MnTe 中，第一原理 Wannier 计算揭示了对称暗尼尔取向，具有扩展的变号圆形核，其体积积分消失。重新定向尼尔矢量消除了这种灭绝，但允许的反应仍然是大的正动量和负动量部分之间的小不平衡；这种不平衡随着光子能量的增加而逆转，并翻转宏观符号。因此，磁对称性决定了是否允许循环响应，而微观补偿则决定了有多少幸存以及带有什么符号。这种区别为解释补偿磁体中微弱的、消失的和符号变化的磁光信号提供了一个通用框架。

articles.title: Emergent Chirality Reversal in Magnetically Driven Rotor Clusters
articles.title_zh: 磁驱动转子簇中的紧急手性反转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25537v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Does a collection of magnetically driven rotors necessarily rotate in the same direction as its individual members? We show that rotors driven by a rotating magnetic field self-assemble into clusters whose collective rotation can oppose the self-rotation of every rotor within them. The reversal arises from competition between rotation-translation coupling and dipolar interactions, which favor opposite directions of collective rotation. Their balance varies with system size and driving frequency, producing a transition between the two handed states, while hydrodynamic interactions shift the transition boundary. Collective handedness can thus emerge opposite to the field-imposed single-rotor rotation without reversing the external field, and can be tuned through system size and driving frequency.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁力驱动转子的集合是否必须与其各个部件以相同的方向旋转？我们证明，由旋转磁场驱动的转子会自组装成簇，其集体旋转可以对抗其中每个转子的自旋转。这种逆转是由旋转-平移耦合和偶极相互作用之间的竞争引起的，有利于集体旋转的相反方向。它们的平衡随着系统尺寸和驱动频率的变化而变化，从而在两个手态之间产生过渡，而流体动力学相互作用则改变过渡边界。因此，集体旋向可以与场强加的单转子旋转相反，而无需反转外部场，并且可以通过系统尺寸和驱动频率进行调整。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁力驱动转子的集合是否必须与其各个部件以相同的方向旋转？我们证明，由旋转磁场驱动的转子会自组装成簇，其集体旋转可以对抗其中每个转子的自旋转。这种逆转是由旋转-平移耦合和偶极相互作用之间的竞争引起的，有利于集体旋转的相反方向。它们的平衡随着系统尺寸和驱动频率的变化而变化，从而在两个手态之间产生过渡，而流体动力学相互作用则改变过渡边界。因此，集体旋向可以与场强加的单转子旋转相反，而无需反转外部场，并且可以通过系统尺寸和驱动频率进行调整。

articles.title: Chiral symmetry and the orbital susceptibility of disordered honeycomb flakes
articles.title_zh: 无序蜂窝状薄片的手性对称性和轨道磁化率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The orbital susceptibility of a small disordered grain is dominated by rare samples in which an occupied and an empty level nearly touch. In a chaotic grain such near-degeneracies are suppressed by level repulsion and must also coincide with the chemical potential, so the mean susceptibility stays finite. In a neutral honeycomb flake, chiral (sublattice) symmetry removes the second condition: It places the chemical potential in the middle of the smallest gap, in every disorder realization. Here we show that the mean orbital susceptibility then grows as ln(1/T) at low temperature T if disorder can close this gap while a magnetic field still mixes the two levels, and that the hopping geometry decides whether it can: Positive nearest-neighbor hopping on a compact hexagonal flake keeps the gap open, third-neighbor hopping allows it to close. In a chiral random-matrix model with n level pairs the coefficient of the logarithm is Cₙ=sqrt2/n,Γ[(n+1)/2]/Γ(n/2), close to unity, and a detuned chemical potential cuts the logarithm off.
articles.abstract_zh: 小无序颗粒的轨道磁化率主要由占据的能级和空能级几乎接触的稀有样本决定。在混沌颗粒中，这种近简并性受到能级排斥的抑制，并且也必须与化学势一致，因此平均磁化率保持有限。在中性蜂窝状薄片中，手性（亚晶格）对称性消除了第二个条件：它将化学势放置在每个无序实现中的最小间隙的中间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 小无序颗粒的轨道磁化率主要由占据的能级和空能级几乎接触的稀有样本决定。在混沌颗粒中，这种近简并性受到能级排斥的抑制，并且也必须与化学势一致，因此平均磁化率保持有限。在中性蜂窝状薄片中，手性（亚晶格）对称性消除了第二个条件：它将化学势放置在每个无序实现中的最小间隙的中间。在这里，我们表明，如果无序可以关闭这个带隙，而磁场仍然混合两个能级，那么平均轨道磁化率在低温 T 下会以 ln(1/T) 的形式增长，并且跳跃几何形状决定它是否可以：紧凑六边形薄片上的正最近邻跳变使带隙保持打开，第三邻跳变允许它关闭。在具有 n 个水平对的手性随机矩阵模型中，对数系数为 Cₙ=sqrt2/n, Г[(n+1)/2]/Г(n/2)，接近于 1，并且失谐的化学势切断了对数。

articles.title: Signatures of slow particle transport in the interacting Aubry-André chain
articles.title_zh: 相互作用的奥布里-安德烈链中慢粒子传输的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25557v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Slow delocalization in strongly disordered many-body quantum chains can originate from two distinct mechanisms: rare resonances and avalanches, rooted in the energy statistics, or an energy-independent combinatorial path-entropy obstruction in operator space. Quasiperiodic potentials eliminate rare regions with similar potentials that are thought to be responsible for avalanche instabilities and modify the statistics of resonances, thus allowing us to delineate the two mechanisms. To do so, we numerically study the entanglement entropy S(t), number entropy S_N(t), and Hartley number entropy S_H(t) following a quantum quench in the interacting Aubry-André chain with disorder strength D. We find S(t)simμln t, S_N(t)simνlnln t with growth rates μsimνsim D⁻γ and γapprox 3, the same behavior that was previously found in the case of quenched disorder. Furthermore, the saturation values S_H(t→infty) continue to grow with system size L as ln L, a growth that persists for Dgtrsim 8 where MBL was argued to be stable. The similarity of the quasi-periodic and quenched disorder cases points to a common origin of the slow particle transport that does not rely on rare-region avalanches and persists despite strongly modified resonance statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 强无序多体量子链中的缓慢离域化可以源于两种不同的机制：基于能量统计的罕见共振和雪崩，或运算符空间中的能量独立的组合路径熵障碍。准周期电位消除了具有相似电位的罕见区域，这些区域被认为是雪崩不稳定性的原因，并修改了共振的统计数据，从而使我们能够描述这两种机制。为此，我们在相互作用的Aubry-André链中以无序强度D进行量子猝灭后，数值研究纠缠熵S (t)、数熵S_N (t)和哈特利数熵S_H (t)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强无序多体量子链中的缓慢离域化可以源于两种不同的机制：基于能量统计的罕见共振和雪崩，或运算符空间中的能量独立的组合路径熵障碍。准周期电位消除了具有相似电位的罕见区域，这些区域被认为是雪崩不稳定性的原因，并修改了共振的统计数据，从而使我们能够描述这两种机制。为此，我们在相互作用的Aubry-André链中以无序强度D进行量子猝灭后，数值研究纠缠熵S (t)、数熵S_N (t)和哈特利数熵S_H (t)。我们发现S (t) simμln t、S_N (t) simνlnln t的生长速度为μsimνsim D ”和γapprox 3 ，与先前在猝灭性疾病的情况下发现的行为相同。此外，饱和值S_H （ t→ infty ）随着系统大小L作为ln L而继续增长，这种增长对于Dgtrsim 8来说是持续的，其中MBL被认为是稳定的。准周期性和淬灭性疾病病例的相似性指向缓慢粒子传输的共同起源，该起源不依赖于罕见区域雪崩，并且尽管强烈修改的共振统计数据仍持续存在。

articles.title: Flaw-tolerant recycling of waste tires into high-performance rubber
articles.title_zh: 废旧轮胎耐瑕疵回收成高性能橡胶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25572v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Annually about one billion tires reach the end of life. Rubber from waste tires can be ground into particles and incorporated into a matrix. In practice, the resulting composites are commonly not recycled into new tires, but downcycled into low-value products such as sport surfaces, indoor flooring, and rubberized asphalt. Recycling waste tires into new tires remains a challenge. In particular, such composites typically have low strength, especially when the particle content is high or the particles are large. A single waste tire particle may act as a flaw to initiate macroscopic fracture and knock down the strength of the entire composite. Here we propose the principle of flaw-tolerant recycling. Rather than requiring every particle to be reliable and small, the matrix is designed so that flaw-like particles do not initiate macroscopic fracture. We demonstrate a flaw-tolerant matrix consisting of two intertwined networks: a network of densely entangled and sparsely crosslinked long natural rubber chains, and a percolated network of carbon aggregates. When the flaw-tolerant matrix is incorporated with up to 80 wt% of commercially available waste particles, the resulting composites still maintain strength. The principle of flaw-tolerant recycling may aid the development of recycling waste tires into new tires.
articles.abstract_zh: Annually about one billion tires reach the end of life. Rubber from waste tires can be ground into particles and incorporated into a matrix.在实践中，所得复合材料通常不会回收成新轮胎，而是降级回收成低价值产品，例如运动表面、室内地板和橡胶沥青。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Annually about one billion tires reach the end of life. Rubber from waste tires can be ground into particles and incorporated into a matrix.在实践中，所得复合材料通常不会回收成新轮胎，而是降级回收成低价值产品，例如运动表面、室内地板和橡胶沥青。 Recycling waste tires into new tires remains a challenge. In particular, such composites typically have low strength, especially when the particle content is high or the particles are large. A single waste tire particle may act as a flaw to initiate macroscopic fracture and knock down the strength of the entire composite. Here we propose the principle of flaw-tolerant recycling.基质的设计不是要求每个颗粒都可靠且小，而是使缺陷状颗粒不会引发宏观断裂。我们展示了一个由两个交织的网络组成的容错矩阵：一个由密集缠结和稀疏交联的天然橡胶长链组成的网络，以及一个由碳聚集体组成的渗透网络。当容错基体与高达 80 wt% 的市售废弃颗粒混合时，所得复合材料仍能保持强度。 The principle of flaw-tolerant recycling may aid the development of recycling waste tires into new tires.

articles.title: Engineering topological phenomena via field-driven Weyl motion
articles.title_zh: 通过场驱动外尔运动工程拓扑现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We illustrate the field-driven anomalous Hall engineering via the momentum-space motion of Weyl nodes using pyrochlore iridates under a [111] magnetic field as an example. We model the system with a well-established microscopic Hamiltonian and the field effect with the spin rotation from the all-in-all-out to the ferromagnetic state. Tracking the position of Weyl nodes during the spin rotation, we demonstrate macroscopic anomalous Hall conductivity variations are fundamentally driven by Weyl node motions by comparing the full multi-band Kubo formula with the geometric Weyl node separation. The discrepancy occurs only near a critical spin rotation angle, where several Weyl nodes come into close proximity. We reveal that the evolution of anomalous Hall conductivity under the magnetic field agrees with reported experiments in an order-of-magnitude and non-monotonicity. These results elucidate the field-driven dynamics of momentum-space monopoles and provide a framework for understanding transport in strongly correlated topological materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们以 [111] 磁场下的烧绿石虹彩为例，通过 Weyl 节点的动量空间运动来说明场驱动的反常霍尔工程。我们使用完善的微观哈密顿量和自旋旋转从全进全出到铁磁态的场效应对该系统进行建模。通过跟踪自旋旋转过程中 Weyl 节点的位置，我们通过比较完整的多带 Kubo 公式与几何 Weyl 节点分离，证明了宏观异常霍尔电导率变化从根本上是由 Weyl 节点运动驱动的。这种差异仅发生在临界自旋旋转角附近，此时几个外尔节点非常接近。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们以 [111] 磁场下的烧绿石虹彩为例，通过 Weyl 节点的动量空间运动来说明场驱动的反常霍尔工程。我们使用完善的微观哈密顿量和自旋旋转从全进全出到铁磁态的场效应对该系统进行建模。通过跟踪自旋旋转过程中 Weyl 节点的位置，我们通过比较完整的多带 Kubo 公式与几何 Weyl 节点分离，证明了宏观异常霍尔电导率变化从根本上是由 Weyl 节点运动驱动的。这种差异仅发生在临界自旋旋转角附近，此时几个外尔节点非常接近。我们揭示了磁场下异常霍尔电导率的演变与报道的实验在数量级和非单调性上一致。这些结果阐明了动量空间单极子的场驱动动力学，并为理解强相关拓扑材料中的输运提供了框架。

articles.title: Crystal Structure Based Graph Neural Network And LLM Multi-Modal Approach for Material Magnetic Ordering Prediction
articles.title_zh: 基于晶体结构的图神经网络和LLM多模态方法用于材料磁有序预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI/ML models are useful for the prediction of materials' properties. Recently, there has been great progress in developing Neural Network models to predict the properties of solids, molecules, and crystals, avoiding expensive and time-consuming laboratory testing. This study presents a novel AI/ML-based multi-modal approach to predict material magnetic ordering using material crystal structure information as input to a Graph Neural Network model (GNN) and semantic text descriptions of the material's properties and structure as input to a Large Language Model (LLM), before performing information fusion of the GNN and LLM outputs to predict material magnetic ordering in four classes (Non-magnetic, Ferromagnetic, Antiferromagnetic, Ferrimagnetic). The model is trained, validated, and tested on a dataset which is a combination of Materials Project dataset, Magndata dataset, and a set of uranium compounds with magnetic ordering determined in laboratory testing, with an 80/10/10 (training/validation/testing) data split. The proposed GNN and LLM multi-modal approach achieves better overall accuracy than both the standalone GNN and LLM approaches with three fusion strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: AI/ML 模型对于预测材料特性非常有用。最近，在开发神经网络模型来预测固体、分子和晶体的特性方面取得了巨大进展，避免了昂贵且耗时的实验室测试。本研究提出了一种基于 AI/ML 的新型多模态方法，使用材料晶体结构信息作为图神经网络模型 (GNN) 的输入，将材料属性和结构的语义文本描述作为大语言模型 (LLM) 的输入，然后对 GNN 和 LLM 输出进行信息融合，以预测四类（非磁性、铁磁性、反铁磁性、亚铁磁性）的材料磁排序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: AI/ML 模型对于预测材料特性非常有用。最近，在开发神经网络模型来预测固体、分子和晶体的特性方面取得了巨大进展，避免了昂贵且耗时的实验室测试。本研究提出了一种基于 AI/ML 的新型多模态方法，使用材料晶体结构信息作为图神经网络模型 (GNN) 的输入，将材料属性和结构的语义文本描述作为大语言模型 (LLM) 的输入，然后对 GNN 和 LLM 输出进行信息融合，以预测四类（非磁性、铁磁性、反铁磁性、亚铁磁性）的材料磁排序。该模型在数据集上进行训练、验证和测试，该数据集是材料项目数据集、Magndata 数据集和一组在实验室测试中确定磁序的铀化合物的组合，数据分割为 80/10/10（训练/验证/测试）。所提出的 GNN 和 LLM 多模态方法比具有三种融合策略的独立 GNN 和 LLM 方法实现了更好的整体精度。

articles.title: Effects of Nonmagnetic Impurities on Nonequilibrium Phase Transitions in Microwave-Driven Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 非磁性杂质对微波驱动超导体非平衡相变的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the nonequilibrium steady states of a microwave-driven BCS superconductor in the presence of nonmagnetic impurity scattering and energy relaxation. Using the Floquet-Nambu-Keldysh Green's function method together with the self-consistent Born approximation, we self-consistently determine the superconducting order parameter in the microwave-driven steady state. We find that the nonequilibrium phase diagram depends strongly on the impurity-scattering strength. When impurity scattering is absent or weak, the steady-state order parameter is single-valued at each temperature and drive frequency. At intermediate scattering strengths, we find bistability between microwave-enhanced and microwave-suppressed superconducting states. As the impurity-scattering strength increases further, we instead find bistability between the superconducting and normal states. This evolution reflects competition between two effects of microwave driving: Eliashberg-type enhancement through the redistribution of thermally excited quasiparticles and suppression through pair-breaking-induced quasiparticle generation. In contrast to the robustness of equilibrium s-wave superconductivity against nonmagnetic impurity scattering, our results demonstrate that nonmagnetic impurity scattering plays a central role in determining the character of nonequilibrium superconducting phase transitions under microwave driving.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了存在非磁性杂质散射和能量弛豫的情况下微波驱动的 BCS 超导体的非平衡稳态。利用 Floquet-Nambu-Keldysh Green 函数方法和自洽 Born 近似，我们自洽地确定了微波驱动稳态下的超导有序参数。我们发现非平衡相图很大程度上取决于杂质散射强度。当杂质散射不存在或很弱时，稳态有序参数在每个温度和驱动频率下都是单值。在中等散射强度下，我们发现微波增强和微波抑制超导态之间存在双稳态。随着杂质散射强度进一步增加，我们反而发现超导态和正常态之间的双稳态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了存在非磁性杂质散射和能量弛豫的情况下微波驱动的 BCS 超导体的非平衡稳态。利用 Floquet-Nambu-Keldysh Green 函数方法和自洽 Born 近似，我们自洽地确定了微波驱动稳态下的超导有序参数。我们发现非平衡相图很大程度上取决于杂质散射强度。当杂质散射不存在或很弱时，稳态有序参数在每个温度和驱动频率下都是单值。在中等散射强度下，我们发现微波增强和微波抑制超导态之间存在双稳态。随着杂质散射强度进一步增加，我们反而发现超导态和正常态之间的双稳态。这种演变反映了微波驱动的两种效应之间的竞争：通过热激发准粒子重新分布的 Eliashberg 型增强和通过破偶诱导准粒子生成的抑制。与平衡横波超导对非磁性杂质散射的鲁棒性相反，我们的结果表明，非磁性杂质散射在确定微波驱动下非平衡超导相变的特征中起着核心作用。

articles.title: Phase transitions of the antiferromagnetic J₁-J₂-J₃ Ising model on the cubic lattice
articles.title_zh: 立方晶格上反铁磁 J1-J2-J3 Ising 模型的相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25884v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the conflicting findings in prior studies regarding the nature of the phase transition for the three-dimensional antiferromagnetic J₁-J₂-J₃ Ising model on the cubic lattice with J₁ = J₂ = J₃ = 1.0, in this study we conduct a detailed investigation of this model using both Monte Carlo simulations and neural networks (NN). Here J₁ and J₂ are the intralayer nearest-neighbor and next-nearest-neighbor couplings, respectively, and J₃ is the nearest-neighbor interlayer interaction. By investigating the data obtained from much larger lattices than those used in previous studies, we find that the phase transition for J₁ = J₂ = J₃ = 1.0 is second order without any ambiguity. Hence we bring a resolution to this debate. Apart from J₁ = J₂ = J₃ = 1.0, we study the critical phenomenon associated with J₂/J₁ = 4/7 and J₃ = J₁ = 1.0 as well. In addition, by employing a dedicated training and testing strategy, our NN computation not only is much more efficient than those utilizing the standard procedures commonly used in the literature, but also requires only a per-mille fraction of the storage capacity needed by a conventional NN calculation when a large linear system size L is considered. The method employed here provides an extremely resource-efficient route for applying NN techniques to study the critical behaviors of higher-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 受先前研究中关于立方晶格上 J₁ = J2 = J₃ = 1.0 的三维反铁磁 J₁-J2-J₃ Ising 模型相变性质的相互矛盾的结果的启发，在本研究中，我们使用蒙特卡洛模拟和神经网络 (NN) 对此模型进行了详细研究。其中 J₁ 和 J2 分别是层内最近邻耦合和次近邻耦合，J₃ 是最近邻层间相互作用。通过研究从比之前研究中使用的大得多的晶格获得的数据，我们发现 J₁ = J2 = J₃ = 1.0 的相变是二阶的，没有任何歧义。因此，我们对这场辩论提出了解决方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受先前研究中关于立方晶格上 J₁ = J2 = J₃ = 1.0 的三维反铁磁 J₁-J2-J₃ Ising 模型相变性质的相互矛盾的结果的启发，在本研究中，我们使用蒙特卡洛模拟和神经网络 (NN) 对此模型进行了详细研究。其中 J₁ 和 J2 分别是层内最近邻耦合和次近邻耦合，J₃ 是最近邻层间相互作用。通过研究从比之前研究中使用的大得多的晶格获得的数据，我们发现 J₁ = J2 = J₃ = 1.0 的相变是二阶的，没有任何歧义。因此，我们对这场辩论提出了解决方案。除了J₁=J2=J₃=1.0之外，我们还研究了与J2/J₁=4/7和J₃=J₁=1.0相关的临界现象。此外，通过采用专门的训练和测试策略，我们的神经网络计算不仅比文献中常用的标准程序高效得多，而且当考虑大线性系统尺寸 L 时，仅需要传统神经网络计算所需存储容量的千分之一。这里采用的方法为应用神经网络技术来研究高维系统的关键行为提供了一种极其资源有效的途径。

articles.title: Ferroelastic domain wall driven glassy dynamics and photoresponse in a SrTiO₃ (111) two-dimensional electron gas
articles.title_zh: SrTiO₃ (111) 二维电子气中铁弹性畴壁驱动的玻璃态动力学和光响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The (111) orientation of SrTiO₃ (STO)-based heterostructures has emerged as a versatile platform for two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs), yet the influence of STO's polar ferroelastic domain-wall (DW) network on charge transport remains largely unexplored. Here we study AlOₓ/STO (111) interfaces hosting 2DEGs of different carrier densities. In the lower-density 2DEG, low-temperature transport exhibits thermal hysteresis, slow resistance relaxation, cooling-rate dependence, and memory effects, signaling glasslike electron dynamics. The relaxation is strongly non-monotonic in temperature, increasing below sim80 K, peaking near 25 K, and vanishing below sim12 K, tracking the established evolution of the ferroelastic DW state of bulk STO rather than any electronic energy scale, which identifies the DW network as its origin. These signatures are absent in a second, more metallic interface with much higher carrier density, demonstrating that the electron-DW coupling can be tuned. We further show that polar DWs govern the photoresponse: the persistent photoconductivity rises sharply below sim80 K, coinciding with the onset of DW polarity. Together, these results establish polar ferroelastic DWs as a carrier-density-tunable electronic degree of freedom in STO (111)-based 2DEGs, opening routes to manipulate 2DEG properties through topological defects.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于 SrTiO₃ (STO) 的异质结构的 (111) 取向已成为二维电子气 (2DEG) 的通用平台，但 STO 的极性铁弹性畴壁 (DW) 网络对电荷传输的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们研究承载不同载流子密度的 2DEG 的 AlOₓ/STO (111) 接口。在较低密度的 2DEG 中，低温输运表现出热滞后、缓慢的电阻松弛、冷却速率依赖性和记忆效应，表明玻璃状电子动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于 SrTiO₃ (STO) 的异质结构的 (111) 取向已成为二维电子气 (2DEG) 的通用平台，但 STO 的极性铁弹性畴壁 (DW) 网络对电荷传输的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们研究承载不同载流子密度的 2DEG 的 AlOₓ/STO (111) 接口。在较低密度的 2DEG 中，低温输运表现出热滞后、缓慢的电阻松弛、冷却速率依赖性和记忆效应，表明玻璃状电子动力学。弛豫在温度上是强烈非单调的，在 sim80 K 以下增加，在 25 K 附近达到峰值，并在 sim12 K 以下消失，跟踪块体 STO 铁弹 DW 状态的既定演化，而不是任何电子能量尺度，这将 DW 网络识别为其起源。这些特征在第二个更具金属性、载流子密度更高的界面中不存在，这表明电子-DW 耦合是可以调节的。我们进一步表明，极性 DW 控制光响应：持续光电导率在 sim80 K 以下急剧上升，与 DW 极性的开始一致。总之，这些结果将极性铁弹 DW 确立为基于 STO (111) 的 2DEG 中载流子密度可调的电子自由度，开辟了通过拓扑缺陷操纵 2DEG 特性的途径。

articles.title: Interfacial origin of magnetic compensation and topological-like Hall effect in crystalline lutetium iron garnet thin films.
articles.title_zh: 结晶镥铁石榴石薄膜中磁补偿和类拓扑霍尔效应的界面起源。
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferrimagnetic oxides such as rare-earth iron garnets (REIG) have emerged as essential components of spin-based devices owing to their high Curie temperatures, low Gilbert damping, and excellent insulating properties. Recently, REIGs have attracted immense interest for hosting robust chiral spin textures that can be potential information carriers in next-generation spintronic devices. Here we investigate the structural, chemical, and magnetic behaviour of single-crystal Lu3Fe5O12 (LuIG) thin films for different film thicknesses on a Gd3(Mg,Zr)Ga5O12(111) or SGGG(111) substrate. Our results demonstrate the presence of a 3 nm-thick Gd-rich LuIG layer at the LuIG/SGGG interface, which gives rise to a magnetic compensation temperature around 50 K. We further probe the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in LuIG layers with an adjacent platinum ultrathin film. In addition to the magnetic compensation point, the AHE loops show pronounced nonmonotonic features, often attributed to the spin Hall topological-like Hall effect (SH-THE) and non-collinear spin textures arising from the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI). LuIG thickness-dependent AHE measurements reveal that the composition variation due to Gd diffusion breaks the inversion symmetry and could contribute to DMI. These findings shed light on fundamental understanding and engineering of the different interfaces of magnetic garnets for advanced spintronic device applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土铁石榴石 (REIG) 等亚铁磁氧化物由于其高居里温度、低吉尔伯特阻尼和优异的绝缘性能，已成为自旋器件的重要组成部分。最近，REIG 因拥有强大的手性自旋纹理而引起了极大的兴趣，这些纹理可以成为下一代自旋电子器件中的潜在信息载体。在这里，我们研究了 Gd3(Mg,Zr)Ga5O12(111) 或 SGGG(111) 衬底上不同膜厚的单晶 Lu3Fe5O12 (LuIG) 薄膜的结构、化学和磁性行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土铁石榴石 (REIG) 等亚铁磁氧化物由于其高居里温度、低吉尔伯特阻尼和优异的绝缘性能，已成为自旋器件的重要组成部分。最近，REIG 因拥有强大的手性自旋纹理而引起了极大的兴趣，这些纹理可以成为下一代自旋电子器件中的潜在信息载体。在这里，我们研究了 Gd3(Mg,Zr)Ga5O12(111) 或 SGGG(111) 衬底上不同膜厚的单晶 Lu3Fe5O12 (LuIG) 薄膜的结构、化学和磁性行为。我们的结果表明，LuIG/SGGG 界面处存在 3 nm 厚的富 Gd LuIG 层，这会产生 50 K 左右的磁补偿温度。我们进一步探讨了 LuIG 层与相邻铂超薄膜的反常霍尔效应 (AHE)。除了磁补偿点之外，AHE 环还表现出明显的非单调特征，这通常归因于自旋霍尔拓扑类霍尔效应 (SH-THE) 和 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 产生的非共线自旋纹理。 LuIG 厚度相关的 AHE 测量表明，Gd 扩散引起的成分变化打破了反演对称性，可能有助于 DMI。这些发现揭示了先进自旋电子器件应用中磁性石榴石不同界面的基本理解和工程设计。

articles.title: Methods of density functional theory in one dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维密度泛函理论方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26012v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Density functional theory is formally justified by an existence proof. As such, the need for computational methods to study the theory is a useful route to understanding the full theory. In this paper, we discuss the numerical strategies to efficiently evaluate computations for Kohn-Sham systems in one dimension and also methods for determining exact properties, including time-dependence. An accompanying library is also available for computing one-dimensional density functional theory and publicly available. The expressions used to implement the density functional in one-dimension are surveyed. An alternative justification for a gradient-based technique is also shown that can be applied to time-dependent evolution of the exact Kohn-Sham potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 密度泛函理论通过存在性证明得到形式上的证明。因此，需要使用计算方法来研究理论，这是理解完整理论的有用途径。 In this paper, we discuss the numerical strategies to efficiently evaluate computations for Kohn-Sham systems in one dimension and also methods for determining exact properties, includin…
articles.abstract_zh_full: 密度泛函理论通过存在性证明得到形式上的证明。因此，需要使用计算方法来研究理论，这是理解完整理论的有用途径。 In this paper, we discuss the numerical strategies to efficiently evaluate computations for Kohn-Sham systems in one dimension and also methods for determining exact properties, including time-dependence.附带的库也可用于计算一维密度泛函理论并公开可用。研究了用于实现一维密度泛函的表达式。 An alternative justification for a gradient-based technique is also shown that can be applied to time-dependent evolution of the exact Kohn-Sham potential.

articles.title: Magnetoelectric Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in Centrosymmetric Solids
articles.title_zh: 中心对称固体中的磁电体光伏效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is commonly believed that a bulk photovoltaic current requires broken spatial inversion symmetry. However, in this work, we demonstrate that dc photocurrents can arise in centrosymmetric solids from the bilinear coupling between the electric and magnetic components of light. This magnetoelectric bulk photovoltaic effect (MBPE) has a quantum-geometric origin in the dipole moments of the Zeeman quantum metric and Zeeman Berry curvature. We identify four distinct MBPE mechanisms, including time-reversal-even and time-reversal-odd injection-like and shift-like photocurrents driven by linearly or circularly polarized light. Our symmetry analysis shows that the MBPE is allowed in broad classes of two-dimensional centrosymmetric nonmagnetic and magnetic materials under normally incident light. As representative examples, we predict sizable MBPEs in centrosymmetric monolayer Pt₂HgSe₃ and altermagnetic RuF₄, with current densities on the order of 1~mA/m. Notably, the injection-like photocurrent in RuF₄ reverses sign upon switching either the light helicity or the Néel vector. Our results extend the bulk photovoltaic effect to centrosymmetric solids and open new opportunities for electrical readout of altermagnetic order.
articles.abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为，大容量光伏电流需要打破空间反演对称性。然而，在这项工作中，我们证明了中心对称固体中可以因光的电分量和磁分量之间的双线性耦合而产生直流光电流。这种磁电体光伏效应 (MBPE) 在塞曼量子度量和塞曼贝里曲率的偶极矩中具有量子几何起源。我们确定了四种不同的 MBPE 机制，包括由线性或圆偏振光驱动的时间反转偶数和时间反转奇数注入和移位光电流。我们的对称性分析表明，在法向入射光下，MBPE 可以用于多种二维中心对称非磁性和磁性材料。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们普遍认为，大容量光伏电流需要打破空间反演对称性。然而，在这项工作中，我们证明了中心对称固体中可以因光的电分量和磁分量之间的双线性耦合而产生直流光电流。这种磁电体光伏效应 (MBPE) 在塞曼量子度量和塞曼贝里曲率的偶极矩中具有量子几何起源。我们确定了四种不同的 MBPE 机制，包括由线性或圆偏振光驱动的时间反转偶数和时间反转奇数注入和移位光电流。我们的对称性分析表明，在法向入射光下，MBPE 可以用于多种二维中心对称非磁性和磁性材料。作为代表性例子，我们预测中心对称单层 Pt2HgSe3 和交变磁性 RuF4 中会出现相当大的 MBPE，电流密度约为 1~mA/m。值得注意的是，RuF₄ 中的类注入光电流在切换光螺旋性或尼尔矢量时会反转符号。我们的研究结果将体光伏效应扩展到中心对称固体，并为交变磁序的电读出开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: Generalised Fluctuating Dynamic Density-Functional Theory: Derivation and Applications
articles.title_zh: 广义脉动动态密度泛函理论：推导与应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical density-functional theory is a powerful theoretical framework for studying the equilibrium density distribution of complex many-body systems. The core of the framework is to bridge microscopic and macroscopic descriptions of fluids through a variational principle that minimises the system's free energy. For dynamical settings, dynamic DFT (DDFT) extends the equilibrium framework to capture the time evolution of an order parameter, typically density. However, DDFT is often insufficient for mesoscopic systems far from equilibrium where fluctuations become significant, necessitating a stochastic extension: fluctuating DDFT. Here we derive a generalised FDDFT from first principles starting from the microscopic Hamiltonian dynamics using coarse-graining techniques, including Zwanzig's projection operator method. The resulting FDDFT applies to arbitrary observable fields, where the dynamics are driven by a thermodynamic force expressed in terms of an entropy functional. The dynamics consist of reversible, dissipative, and stochastic contributions, each directly linked to the underlying microscopic dynamics via the Liouville operator, Green-Kubo relations, and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. To highlight the difference in the level of description between DDFT and FDDFT, we demonstrate how further coarse-graining via averaging leads to a generalised DDFT, valid at the macroscale. To showcase the effectiveness and utility of the generalised FDDFT, we apply it to two prototypical fluid systems: colloidal and simple viscous fluids. In the former case, we utilise the new formalism to re-derive the recently found colloidal FDDFT. In the latter case, we rigorously recover the non-isothermal extension of the Landau-Lifshitz fluctuating Navier-Stokes equations, providing fundamental derivation of this well-known phenomenological model, enabling to clarify its underlying principles.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典密度泛函理论是研究复杂多体系统平衡密度分布的强大理论框架。该框架的核心是通过最小化系统自由能的变分原理来连接流体的微观和宏观描述。对于动态设置，动态 DFT (DDFT) 扩展了平衡框架以捕获有序参数（通常是密度）的时间演化。然而，对于远离平衡状态且波动变得显着的介观系统，DDFT 通常是不够的，需要随机扩展：波动 DDFT。在这里，我们使用粗粒度技术（包括 Zwanzig 的投影算子方法）从微观哈密顿动力学出发，根据第一原理推导了广义 FDDFT。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典密度泛函理论是研究复杂多体系统平衡密度分布的强大理论框架。该框架的核心是通过最小化系统自由能的变分原理来连接流体的微观和宏观描述。对于动态设置，动态 DFT (DDFT) 扩展了平衡框架以捕获有序参数（通常是密度）的时间演化。然而，对于远离平衡状态且波动变得显着的介观系统，DDFT 通常是不够的，需要随机扩展：波动 DDFT。在这里，我们使用粗粒度技术（包括 Zwanzig 的投影算子方法）从微观哈密顿动力学出发，根据第一原理推导了广义 FDDFT。由此产生的 FDDFT 适用于任意可观测场，其中动力学由以熵泛函表示的热力学驱动。动力学由可逆、耗散和随机贡献组成，每个贡献都通过刘维尔算子、Green-Kubo 关系和波动耗散定理与潜在的微观动力学直接相关。为了强调 DDFT 和 FDDFT 之间描述水平的差异，我们演示了如何通过平均进一步粗粒度导致在宏观尺度上有效的广义 DDFT。为了展示广义 FDDFT 的有效性和实用性，我们将其应用于两种典型的流体系统：胶体和简单粘性流体。在前一种情况下，我们利用新的形式主义重新推导了最近发现的胶体FDDFT。在后一种情况下，我们严格地恢复了朗道-利夫希茨涨落纳维-斯托克斯方程的非等温扩张，提供了这个著名的唯象模型的基本推导，从而能够阐明其基本原理。

articles.title: Evidence of valence bond solid and quantum paramagnetism in the J₁--J₂--J₃ Heisenberg model from pseudofermion functional renormalization group
articles.title_zh: 来自赝费米子泛函重正化群的 J₁--J2--J₃ 海森堡模型中价键固体和量子顺磁性的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent tensor network studies reporting a quantum spin liquid (QSL) within the quantum paramagnetic (QP) regime, we investigate numerically the zero-temperature phase diagram of the J₁--J₂--J₃ Heisenberg model on the square lattice using the pseudofermion functional renormalization group (pf-fRG). Thanks to improved frequency resolution and larger lattice truncations, we are able to explore a significantly larger parameter space than previous pf-fRG work to map out the phase boundary of an extended QP region. We further resolve possible bond order within the QP regime by measuring the dimer response to small deformations in J₁, i.e. bond anisotropy that breaks the point-group symmetry of the Hamiltonian. The functional renormalization group flow of the dimer susceptibility suggests that the QP window splits into two: a region where it grows continuously down to the lowest energy scale to signal valence bond solid (VBS) order, and another region where it reaches a peak at a finite scale and is subsequently suppressed to indicate a QSL.
articles.abstract_zh: 受最近报告量子顺磁 (QP) 范围内的量子自旋液体 (QSL) 的张量网络研究的启发，我们使用赝费米子泛函重正化群 (pf-fRG) 对方晶格上 J₁--J2--J₃ 海森堡模型的零温度相图进行了数值研究。由于频率分辨率的提高和更大的晶格截断，我们能够探索比之前的 pf-fRG 工作大得多的参数空间，以绘制扩展 QP 区域的相边界。我们通过测量 J₁ 中小变形的二聚体响应，即打破哈密顿量的点群对称性的键各向异性，进一步解决 QP 范围内可能的键序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受最近报告量子顺磁 (QP) 范围内的量子自旋液体 (QSL) 的张量网络研究的启发，我们使用赝费米子泛函重正化群 (pf-fRG) 对方晶格上 J₁--J2--J₃ 海森堡模型的零温度相图进行了数值研究。由于频率分辨率的提高和更大的晶格截断，我们能够探索比之前的 pf-fRG 工作大得多的参数空间，以绘制扩展 QP 区域的相边界。我们通过测量 J₁ 中小变形的二聚体响应，即打破哈密顿量的点群对称性的键各向异性，进一步解决 QP 范围内可能的键序。二聚体敏感性的功能重整化群流表明，QP 窗口分裂为两个：一个区域连续生长到最低能量尺度以发出价键固体 (VBS) 顺序的信号，另一个区域在有限尺度上达到峰值并随后被抑制以指示 QSL。

articles.title: Bicircular light tunable topological phases and nonlinear Hall responses in odd-parity magnets
articles.title_zh: 奇宇称磁体中的双圆光可调拓扑相位和非线性霍尔响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets are an emerging class of magnetic materials that exhibit characteristic features of both ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. Odd-wave magnets, where the momentum-dependent spin splitting follows an odd-parity form factor, provide a distinct platform for exploring unconventional magnetic and topological phenomena. In this work, we demonstrate light-induced topological phase transitions in odd-parity magnets driven by bicircular light. We show that a cascade of topological phase transitions occur as the relative amplitude ratio of the two beams is varied. These are accompanied by sharp changes of the quantum metric. We demonstrate that bicircular light unlocks nonlinear Hall responses arising from Berry curvature and quantum metric in irradiated odd-wave magnets, and formulate the underlying selection rules. Our results show that both the topology and the nonlinear responses in odd-parity magnets can be directly controlled by a bicircular drive.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁体是一类新兴的磁性材料，具有铁磁体和反铁磁体的特征。奇波磁体，其中动量相关的自旋分裂遵循奇宇称形状因子，为探索非常规磁性和拓扑现象提供了一个独特的平台。在这项工作中，我们演示了双圆光驱动的奇宇称磁体中的光诱导拓扑相变。我们表明，当两束光束的相对振幅比发生变化时，会发生一系列拓扑相变。这些都伴随着量子度量的急剧变化。我们证明双圆光可以解锁受辐射奇波磁体中的贝里曲率和量子度量产生的非线性霍尔响应，并制定基本的选择规则。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁体是一类新兴的磁性材料，具有铁磁体和反铁磁体的特征。奇波磁体，其中动量相关的自旋分裂遵循奇宇称形状因子，为探索非常规磁性和拓扑现象提供了一个独特的平台。在这项工作中，我们演示了双圆光驱动的奇宇称磁体中的光诱导拓扑相变。我们表明，当两束光束的相对振幅比发生变化时，会发生一系列拓扑相变。这些都伴随着量子度量的急剧变化。我们证明双圆光可以解锁受辐射奇波磁体中的贝里曲率和量子度量产生的非线性霍尔响应，并制定基本的选择规则。我们的结果表明，奇宇称磁体的拓扑和非线性响应都可以通过双圆驱动器直接控制。

articles.title: Time-Reversal Symmetry Breaking in the Centrosymmetric Nonsymmorphic Superconductor RuB2
articles.title_zh: 中心对称非对称超导体 RuB2 中时间反演对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26264v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Centrosymmetric nonsymmorphic AB2 (A = Ru, Os) borides exhibit anomalous superconducting properties, but the microscopic nature of their superconducting ground state remains unresolved. Here, we investigate RuB2 using zero- and transverse-field muon spin relaxation (muSR), first-principles electronic-structure calculations, and Ginzburg-Landau symmetry analysis. Zero-field muSR reveals spontaneous internal magnetic fields below Tc = 1.6 K, providing direct evidence for time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB). Transverse-field measurements establish a fully gapped superconducting state, with a gap magnitude close to the BCS weak-coupling limit. Density-functional calculations show that RuB2 is a multiband Z2 topological metal with appreciable spin-orbit coupling. Guided by the experimental observations and the symmetry of the orthorhombic crystal structure, our Ginzburg-Landau analysis suggests that an internally antisymmetric, nonunitary spin-triplet state is a promising candidate for the superconducting order parameter. This candidate is consistent with both the observed TRSB and the fully gapped superconducting state. These results establish RuB2 as a promising platform for investigating unconventional superconductivity arising from the interplay of crystal symmetry, multiband electronic structure, and spin-orbit coupling, and motivate further studies of related nonsymmorphic borides. The two muSR measurements provide complementary constraints: zero-field data probe spontaneous magnetism associated with TRSB, while transverse-field data characterize superconducting field distribution and support a full gap. The topological electronic structure and spin-orbit coupling provide context for unconventional pairing. Although these results do not uniquely determine the order parameter, they narrow candidates and highlight that nonsymmorphic symmetry may shape superconductivity in RuB2.
articles.abstract_zh: 中心对称非对称AB2（A = Ru，Os）硼化物表现出反常超导特性，但其超导基态的微观本质仍未解决。在这里，我们使用零场和横向场 μ 子自旋弛豫 (muSR)、第一原理电子结构计算和 Ginzburg-Landau 对称性分析来研究 RuB2。零场 muSR 揭示了低于 Tc = 1.6 K 的自发内部磁场，为时间反转对称性破缺 (TRSB) 提供了直接证据。横向场测量建立了完全带隙的超导状态，带隙大小接近 BCS 弱耦合极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中心对称非对称AB2（A = Ru，Os）硼化物表现出反常超导特性，但其超导基态的微观本质仍未解决。在这里，我们使用零场和横向场 μ 子自旋弛豫 (muSR)、第一原理电子结构计算和 Ginzburg-Landau 对称性分析来研究 RuB2。零场 muSR 揭示了低于 Tc = 1.6 K 的自发内部磁场，为时间反转对称性破缺 (TRSB) 提供了直接证据。横向场测量建立了完全带隙的超导状态，带隙大小接近 BCS 弱耦合极限。密度泛函计算表明，RuB2 是一种多能带 Z2 拓扑金属，具有明显的自旋轨道耦合。在实验观察和斜方晶体结构的对称性的指导下，我们的金兹堡-朗道分析表明，内部反对称、非酉自旋三重态是超导有序参数的有希望的候选者。该候选状态与观察到的 TRSB 和全能隙超导态一致。这些结果使 RuB2 成为研究晶体对称性、多能带电子结构和自旋轨道耦合相互作用所产生的非常规超导性的一个有前景的平台，并激发了相关非对称硼化物的进一步研究。两个 muSR 测量提供了互补的约束：零场数据探测与 TRSB 相关的自发磁性，而横向场数据表征超导场分布并支持全间隙。拓扑电子结构和自旋轨道耦合为非常规配对提供了背景。尽管这些结果并不能唯一地确定序参数，但它们缩小了候选参数范围，并强调非对称性可能会塑造 RuB2 的超导性。

articles.title: Finite-size scaling of spin-wave scattering and enhancement in magnonic Fabry-Pérot nanoresonators
articles.title_zh: 磁波法布里-珀罗纳米谐振器中自旋波散射和增强的有限尺寸缩放
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26277v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnonic neural networks require compact resonant nodes that scatter spin waves efficiently, concentrate spin-wave energy and can be reconfigured. Hybrid magnonic Fabry-Pérot resonators, formed by a ferromagnetic-metal stripe dipolar-coupled to a yttrium iron garnet (YIG) film, provide low-loss and programmable control of spin-wave transmission, but have so far been studied only for stripes that are long compared with the spin-wave wavelength. Here we use micromagnetic simulations to determine how the response of a 200-nm-wide CoFeB stripe on a 55-nm-thick YIG film evolves as the stripe length is reduced from infinity to 640 nm. An infinitely long stripe acts as a one-dimensional cavity that opens a transmission gap at the first-order resonance (1.70 GHz and 1.47 GHz for the parallel and antiparallel magnetic configuration) and enhances the out-of-plane precession amplitude in the YIG film by factors of about 5 and 12, without distorting the transmitted wavefront. For lengths of a few micrometers, backward-volume spin waves emitted from the stripe ends modulate the precession along the stripe and fragment the reflected and transmitted wavefronts. Below about 1.2 micrometer, the resonator scatters incident spin waves over the entire isofrequency contour of the film, with caustic beams that are most pronounced in the antiparallel configuration. In this regime the parallel configuration supports weakly enhanced quantized modes, whereas the antiparallel configuration supports a single mode with an out-of-plane enhancement of about 15. The width, thickness and shape of the stripe tune this mode by 50-100 MHz, and its strong enhancement lowers the onset of nonlinear frequency shift and fold-over to incident amplitudes of a few percent of the saturation magnetization. Sub-micrometer magnonic resonators are therefore promising reconfigurable nonlinear nodes for magnonic networks.
