articles.title: Chiral Valence-Bond Solid and Chiral Triplons
articles.title_zh: 手性价键固体和手性三联体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12856v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a chiral valence-bond solid (VBS) in which spin-singlet bond order itself spontaneously acquires handedness without magnetic order. Using a spin-lattice model on the diamond lattice, we demonstrate two enantiomorphic VBS states. In the presence of anisotropic spin interactions, this emergent handedness is inherited by chiral triplons with spin-split bands and spin textures that reverse between the two enantiomers. These textures generate a temperature-gradient-induced net spin response whose sign is set by the VBS handedness. The imaginary off-diagonal components of the dynamical spin structure factor encode the triplon polarization and change sign between the two enantiomers, enabling direct detection of chiral triplons and the selected handedness by polarized inelastic neutron scattering. Our results establish a direct connection between spontaneous chirality and magnetic excitations, opening avenues for exploring the interplay between quantum magnetism and chiral physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种手性价键固体（ VBS ） ，其中自旋单键顺序本身自发地获得手性而没有磁性顺序。使用金刚石晶格上的自旋晶格模型，我们演示了两个对映态VBS状态。在存在各向异性自旋相互作用的情况下，这种出现的手性由具有自旋分裂带和自旋纹理的手性三元组继承，在两个对映异构体之间反转。这些纹理产生温度梯度诱导的净自旋响应，其符号由VBS手性设置。动态自旋结构因子的虚拟偏对角分量编码了两个对映体之间的三倍子极化和变化符号，从而能够通过极化非弹性中子散射直接检测手性三倍子和选定的手性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种手性价键固体（ VBS ） ，其中自旋单键顺序本身自发地获得手性而没有磁性顺序。使用金刚石晶格上的自旋晶格模型，我们演示了两个对映态VBS状态。在存在各向异性自旋相互作用的情况下，这种出现的手性由具有自旋分裂带和自旋纹理的手性三元组继承，在两个对映异构体之间反转。这些纹理产生温度梯度诱导的净自旋响应，其符号由VBS手性设置。动态自旋结构因子的虚拟偏对角分量编码了两个对映体之间的三倍子极化和变化符号，从而能够通过极化非弹性中子散射直接检测手性三倍子和选定的手性。我们的研究结果建立了自发手性与磁激发之间的直接联系，为探索量子磁性和手性物理学之间的相互作用开辟了途径。

articles.title: ZStar: A unified toolkit for polarization, Born effective charges, dielectric and piezoelectric responses, and infrared and Raman spectra
articles.title_zh: ZStar ：用于极化、天生有效电荷、介电和压电响应以及红外和拉曼光谱的统一工具包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.16802v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Born effective charge (BEC) tensors link atomic displacements to polarization, thereby connecting lattice vibrations with dielectric response and infrared activity. We present ZStar, an open-source Python toolkit that automates calculations of polarization, BEC, phonons, static and frequency-dependent dielectric response, and infrared and Raman spectra. ZStar supports bulk crystals, two-dimensional materials, one-dimensional structures, and molecules through an integrated workflow for input preparation, execution, and response analysis. Berry-phase polarization and real-space dipoles describe responses along periodic and open directions, respectively. Its unified, symmetry-adapted finite-displacement framework jointly determines BEC and zone-center force constants from the same calculations, improving computational efficiency while preserving numerical accuracy. Strain-response calculations further provide proper piezoelectric coefficients and their internal-relaxation contributions for bulk crystals. In the ABACUS+PYATB route, electronic Hamiltonian data are reused to obtain Raman response without additional self-consistent calculations. Native response implementations from VASP and CP2K are also integrated. Matched infrared/Raman benchmarks against the implemented separate workflows achieve speedups of up to 8.4. An accompanying agent skill provides an agent-friendly interface for workflow integration. ZStar therefore offers an efficient and automated route for exploring polarization, BEC, dielectric and piezoelectric responses, and vibrational spectra across different material dimensionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 天然有效电荷（ BEC ）张量将原子位移与极化联系起来，从而将晶格振动与介电响应和红外活动联系起来。我们推出了ZStar ，这是一个开源的Python工具包，可以自动计算极化、BEC、声子、静态和频率相关的介电响应，以及红外和拉曼光谱。ZStar通过用于输入准备、执行和响应分析的集成工作流程，支持块状晶体、二维材料、一维结构和分子。浆果相极化和实空间偶极子分别描述了沿周期方向和开放方向的响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 天然有效电荷（ BEC ）张量将原子位移与极化联系起来，从而将晶格振动与介电响应和红外活动联系起来。我们推出了ZStar ，这是一个开源的Python工具包，可以自动计算极化、BEC、声子、静态和频率相关的介电响应，以及红外和拉曼光谱。ZStar通过用于输入准备、执行和响应分析的集成工作流程，支持块状晶体、二维材料、一维结构和分子。浆果相极化和实空间偶极子分别描述了沿周期方向和开放方向的响应。其统一的、适应对称的有限位移框架通过相同的计算共同确定BEC和区域中心力常数，在保持数值精度的同时提高了计算效率。应变响应计算进一步为本体晶体提供适当的压电系数及其内部松弛贡献。在算盘+ PYATB路线中，电子哈密顿数据被重复使用以获得拉曼响应，而无需额外的自洽计算。还集成了VASP和CP2K的原生响应实现。与实施的单独工作流程相匹配的红外/拉曼基准可实现高达8.4的加速。随附的客服代表技能为工作流程集成提供了方便客服代表的界面。因此， ZStar为探索不同材料尺寸的极化、BEC、介电和压电响应以及振动光谱提供了一条高效的自动化路线。

articles.title: Electrified Metal-Water Interfaces at Constant Potential: Data-Efficient Transfer Learning for Machine-Learning-Based Molecular Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 恒定电势的带电金属-水界面：基于机器学习的分子动力学的数据高效迁移学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.19338v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Simulating electrified metal-water interfaces with explicit solvent under constant potential is essential for understanding electrochemical processes, yet remains prohibitively expensive with ab initio methods. We present TRECI, a data-efficient workflow for constructing machine learning force-fields (ML-FFs) that achieve ab initio-level accuracy in electronically grand-canonical molecular dynamics. By leveraging transfer learning from general-purpose and domain-specific models, TRECI enables stable and accurate simulations across a wide potential range using a reduced number of reference configurations. This efficiency allows the use of high-level meta-GGA functionals and rigorous surface-electrification schemes. Applied to Cu(111)-water, models trained on just one thousand configurations yield accurate molecular dynamics simulations, capturing bias-dependent solvent restructuring effects not previously reported. TRECI offers a general strategy for characterising diverse materials and interfacial chemistries, significantly lowering the cost of realistic constant-potential simulations and expanding access to quantitative electrochemical modelling.
articles.abstract_zh: 在恒定电势下用显式溶剂模拟带电金属-水界面对于理解电化学过程至关重要，但从头计算方法仍然非常昂贵。我们推出了 TRECI，这是一种数据高效的工作流程，用于构建机器学习力场 (ML-FF)，可在电子大规范分子动力学中实现从头开始的精度。通过利用通用和特定领域模型的迁移学习，TRECI 使用更少的参考配置在广泛的潜在范围内实现稳定和准确的模拟。这种效率允许使用高级元 GGA 函数和严格的表面电气化方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在恒定电势下用显式溶剂模拟带电金属-水界面对于理解电化学过程至关重要，但从头计算方法仍然非常昂贵。我们推出了 TRECI，这是一种数据高效的工作流程，用于构建机器学习力场 (ML-FF)，可在电子大规范分子动力学中实现从头开始的精度。通过利用通用和特定领域模型的迁移学习，TRECI 使用更少的参考配置在广泛的潜在范围内实现稳定和准确的模拟。这种效率允许使用高级元 GGA 函数和严格的表面电气化方案。应用于 Cu(111)-水时，仅经过 1000 种配置训练的模型就可以产生准确的分子动力学模拟，捕获先前未报道的依赖于偏差的溶剂重组效应。 TRECI 提供了表征不同材料和界面化学的通用策略，显着降低了实际恒电位模拟的成本，并扩大了定量电化学建模的范围。

articles.title: Higher-Dimensional Information Lattice: Quantum State Characterization through Inclusion-Exclusion Local Information
articles.title_zh: 高维信息晶格：通过包含-排除局部信息表征量子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20793v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Developing a local description of quantum information is a central problem in quantum many-body physics: the goal is to identify how correlations are organized across positions and scales without choosing specific observables. We introduce a higher-dimensional information lattice, an inclusion-exclusion construction that decomposes the von Neumann information of reduced density matrices into contributions labeled by subsystem position and scale. Above one dimension, overlapping subsystems can form loops, allowing information associated with one subsystem to be inferred nonlocally from the density matrices of others. The sign of the inclusion-exclusion information resolves such overlap redundancies in position and scale: positive values mark positions and scales with net information gain, while negative values occur where redundant contributions dominate new ones. We implement the construction in two dimensions and apply it to many-body ground states with distinct entanglement structures. For localized states, such as disordered-localized states or gapped ground states of local Hamiltonians, the local information decays exponentially along different directions, defining direction-dependent information length scales. In critical states with a Fermi surface, decay becomes algebraic, with dominant directions tied to the velocity of gapless modes. In the toric code, topological order manifests as a negative information value at the largest lattice scale, interpreted as global information redundancy between the smallest loop-enclosing overlapping subsystems. We also isolate the universal information carried by edge states and locate the signatures of non-Abelian fusion channels in position and scale. Our results establish the higher-dimensional information lattice as a framework for resolving universal correlation structures through the spatial and scale distribution of quantum information.
articles.abstract_zh: 开发量子信息的局部描述是量子多体物理学的一个中心问题：目标是确定如何在不选择特定可观测值的情况下跨位置和尺度组织相关性。我们引入了一种高维信息格，一种包含排除结构，它将约化密度矩阵的冯·诺依曼信息分解为由子系统位置和规模标记的贡献。在一维之上，重叠的子系统可以形成循环，从而允许从其他子系统的密度矩阵非局部地推断与一个子系统相关的信息。包含-排除信息的符号解决了位置和规模上的重叠冗余：正值用净信息增益标记位置和规模，而负值出现在冗余贡献主导新贡献的情况下。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开发量子信息的局部描述是量子多体物理学的一个中心问题：目标是确定如何在不选择特定可观测值的情况下跨位置和尺度组织相关性。我们引入了一种高维信息格，一种包含排除结构，它将约化密度矩阵的冯·诺依曼信息分解为由子系统位置和规模标记的贡献。在一维之上，重叠的子系统可以形成循环，从而允许从其他子系统的密度矩阵非局部地推断与一个子系统相关的信息。包含-排除信息的符号解决了位置和规模上的重叠冗余：正值用净信息增益标记位置和规模，而负值出现在冗余贡献主导新贡献的情况下。我们在二维上实现了该结构，并将其应用于具有不同纠缠结构的多体基态。对于局域态，例如无序局域态或局部哈密顿量的有隙基态，局部信息沿不同方向呈指数衰减，从而定义了方向相关的信息长度尺度。在费米面的临界状态下，衰变变成代数的，其主导方向与无间隙模式的速度相关。在环面代码中，拓扑顺序表现为最大晶格尺度上的负信息值，解释为最小循环封闭重叠子系统之间的全局信息冗余。我们还隔离了边缘状态携带的通用信息，并在位置和尺度上定位非阿贝尔融合通道的特征。我们的结果建立了高维信息晶格作为通过量子信息的空间和尺度分布来解决普遍相关结构的框架。

articles.title: Failure of the mean-field Hartree approximation for a bosonic many-body system with non-Hermitian Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 具有非厄米哈密顿量的玻色多体系统的平均场 Hartree 近似失效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13038v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Mean-field Hartree theory is a central tool for reducing many-body dynamics to an effective one-particle evolution. This approximation has been employed when the Hamiltonian governing the many-body dynamics is not Hermitian. Indeed, non-Hermitian Hamiltonians model particle gain/loss or the evolution of open quantum systems between consecutive quantum jumps. Furthermore, the validity of the Hartree approximation for generic non-Hermitian Hamiltonians lies at the basis of a quantum algorithm for nonlinear differential equations. In this work, we show that this approximation can fail. First, we consider the most general bosonic mean-field Hamiltonian with two-body interactions and we prove that, for non-Hermitian Hamiltonian, the Hartree equation does not capture the correct second time derivative of the one-particle marginal state at t=0 in the thermodynamic limit. Then, we analytically solve a model of N bosonic qubits with a purely anti-Hermitian Hamiltonian, compute the limit for N→infty of the one-particle marginal state and show that it does not agree with the solution of the non-Hermitian Hartree equation. We further show that there exists an initial condition such that the exact one-particle marginal state undergoes a finite-time transition to a mixed state, a phenomenon that is completely absent in the case of Hermitian Hamiltonians. Finally, we simulate a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian with real spectrum and show that, also in this case, there are initial conditions for which the Hartree equation does not reproduce the correct one-particle marginal state in the limit N→infty. Our findings challenge the validity of the mean-field Hartree approximation for non-Hermitian Hamiltonians, and call for additional conditions for the validity of the mean-field regime to model the dynamics of particle gain and loss and the open-system dynamics in bosonic many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 平均场哈特里理论是将多体动力学简化为有效的单粒子演化的核心工具。当控制多体动力学的哈密顿量不是埃尔米特量时，就采用了这种近似。事实上，非厄米哈密顿量可以模拟粒子增益/损失或连续量子跳跃之间开放量子系统的演化。此外，Hartree 近似对于一般非厄米哈密顿量的有效性在于非线性微分方程的量子算法的基础。在这项工作中，我们证明这种近似可能会失败。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平均场哈特里理论是将多体动力学简化为有效的单粒子演化的核心工具。当控制多体动力学的哈密顿量不是埃尔米特量时，就采用了这种近似。事实上，非厄米哈密顿量可以模拟粒子增益/损失或连续量子跳跃之间开放量子系统的演化。此外，Hartree 近似对于一般非厄米哈密顿量的有效性在于非线性微分方程的量子算法的基础。在这项工作中，我们证明这种近似可能会失败。首先，我们考虑具有双体相互作用的最一般的玻色平均场哈密顿量，并证明，对于非厄米哈密顿量，Hartree 方程不能捕获热力学极限中 t=0 时单粒子边缘态的正确二阶时间导数。然后，我们用纯反厄米哈密顿量解析求解 N 个玻色子量子位的模型，计算单粒子边缘态 N→infty 的极限，并表明它与非厄米 Hartree 方程的解不一致。我们进一步表明，存在一个初始条件，使得精确的单粒子边缘状态经历有限时间过渡到混合状态，这种现象在厄米哈密顿量的情况下完全不存在。最后，我们用实谱模拟非厄米哈密顿量，并表明，同样在这种情况下，存在哈特里方程无法在极限 N→infty 中再现正确的单粒子边缘状态的初始条件。我们的研究结果对非厄米哈密顿量的平均场哈特里近似的有效性提出了挑战，并要求平均场体系的有效性需要额外的条件来模拟粒子增益和损失的动力学以及玻色多体系统中的开放系统动力学。

articles.title: Dirac branch-cut modes with relativistic transport
articles.title_zh: 具有相对论输运的狄拉克分支切割模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.28127v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Emergent Dirac fields, exhibiting effective relativistic physics, are most commonly associated with bulk and surface states in materials such as graphene and topological insulators. Here we show that phase dislocations of a complex Dirac mass support a distinct family of propagating Dirac defect states that behave as massless or massive one-dimensional relativistic modes. These traveling-wave defect states, termed Dirac branch-cut (DBC) modes, are governed by a one-dimensional Dirac Hamiltonian whose effective mass is controlled by the phase difference across the branch cut. Using acoustic metamaterials, we experimentally demonstrate a range of relativistic phenomena exhibited by DBC modes, including relativistic dispersion, energy-independent confinement, Klein tunnelling, and transport along freeform (e.g., spiral) trajectories. Our results establish branch-cut defects as a distinct platform for realizing propagating Dirac defect states, extending relativistic Dirac physics from bulk and surface states to propagating modes confined to defect boundaries.
articles.abstract_zh: 涌现狄拉克场表现出有效的相对论物理学，最常与石墨烯和拓扑绝缘体等材料的体态和表面态相关。在这里，我们证明复杂狄拉克质量的相位错支持一系列独特的传播狄拉克缺陷态，这些缺陷态表现为无质量或大量一维相对论模式。这些行波缺陷态被称为狄拉克分支切割（DBC）模式，由一维狄拉克哈密顿量控制，其有效质量由分支切割上的相位差控制。使用声学超材料，我们通过实验证明了 DBC 模式所表现出的一系列相对论现象，包括相对论色散、能量无关限制、克莱因隧道效应和沿自由形式（例如螺旋）轨迹的传输。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 涌现狄拉克场表现出有效的相对论物理学，最常与石墨烯和拓扑绝缘体等材料的体态和表面态相关。在这里，我们证明复杂狄拉克质量的相位错支持一系列独特的传播狄拉克缺陷态，这些缺陷态表现为无质量或大量一维相对论模式。这些行波缺陷态被称为狄拉克分支切割（DBC）模式，由一维狄拉克哈密顿量控制，其有效质量由分支切割上的相位差控制。使用声学超材料，我们通过实验证明了 DBC 模式所表现出的一系列相对论现象，包括相对论色散、能量无关限制、克莱因隧道效应和沿自由形式（例如螺旋）轨迹的传输。我们的研究结果将分支切割缺陷建立为实现传播狄拉克缺陷态的独特平台，将相对论狄拉克物理从体态和表面态扩展到仅限于缺陷边界的传播模式。

articles.title: A Monte Carlo Study of the Dipolar Universality Class in Three Dimensions
articles.title_zh: 三维偶极普遍性类的蒙特卡罗研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.11573v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The dipolar universality class describes the phase transition in 3D ferromagnets with strong dipolar interactions, as first discussed by Aharony and Fisher in the 1970s. While this universality class has been studied theoretically using renormalization group methods, as well as experimentally, little is known about it from Monte Carlo simulations. In this paper, we aim to bridge this gap. We introduce a lattice model that faithfully implements the transverse constraint on the order parameter. We introduce a Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithm which involves a combination of local Metropolis updates preserving the constraint, and a global update of the zero mode. We perform simulations on cubic lattices up to volume 48× 48 × 48. We observe a continuous phase transition between the disordered and ordered phases. We obtain estimates of the critical exponent ν and the critical Binder ratio, and compare them with results from other techniques. We also study whether rotational invariance emerges at the critical point, and discuss the influence of the toroidal geometry on this question.
articles.abstract_zh: 偶极普遍性类描述了具有强偶极相互作用的 3D 铁磁体中的相变，正如 Aharony 和 Fisher 在 20 世纪 70 年代首次讨论的那样。虽然已经使用重正化群方法从理论上以及实验上研究了这种普适性类别，但从蒙特卡罗模拟中我们对它知之甚少。在本文中，我们旨在弥合这一差距。我们引入了一种晶格模型，它忠实地实现了对阶次参数的横向约束。我们引入了马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗算法，该算法涉及保留约束的局部 Metropolis 更新和零模式的全局更新的组合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 偶极普遍性类描述了具有强偶极相互作用的 3D 铁磁体中的相变，正如 Aharony 和 Fisher 在 20 世纪 70 年代首次讨论的那样。虽然已经使用重正化群方法从理论上以及实验上研究了这种普适性类别，但从蒙特卡罗模拟中我们对它知之甚少。在本文中，我们旨在弥合这一差距。我们引入了一种晶格模型，它忠实地实现了对阶次参数的横向约束。我们引入了马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗算法，该算法涉及保留约束的局部 Metropolis 更新和零模式的全局更新的组合。我们对体积高达 48×48×48 的立方晶格进行模拟。我们观察到无序相和有序相之间的连续相变。我们获得了临界指数 ν 和临界 Binder 比率的估计，并将它们与其他技术的结果进行比较。我们还研究了在临界点是否出现旋转不变性，并讨论了环形几何对此问题的影响。

articles.title: Spectral theory of energy-selective quantum search with Ising Hamiltonian phase oracles
articles.title_zh: 伊辛哈密顿相位预言的能量选择性量子搜索谱理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.03380v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We develop an exact spectral-response theory for the Grover-type iterate (W_T=D_ξexp(-i T H)), in which the evolution generated by a diagonal Ising Hamiltonian is used directly as a continuous phase oracle. An energy-grouped recurrence and its generating-function solution show how the empirical characteristic function determines the position, width, height, and saturation time of an energy-selective resonance. For an annealed Gaussian density of states, a high-density-tail resonance containing (M) configurations is reached after (Θ(sqrt2ⁿ/M)) oracle calls with success probability (Θ(1)), giving a quadratic query improvement over independent uniform sampling with classical energy evaluation. For correlated random Ising spectra, overlap-dependent covariances lead to a realization-dependent resonance shift with root-mean-square scale (O(n⁻³)), parametrically larger than the resonance width, and can also reduce the peak height. The shift is both an algorithmic detuning and a coherent probe of sample-specific spectral fluctuations whose ensemble statistics reflect the Ising overlap structure. Spectral symmetrization and iterative calibration can remove or compensate the resonance-center displacement for prescribed-energy targeting. We also clarify the relation to designed spectral filters and the precision and coherence requirements of this asymptotic primitive.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们为 Grover 型迭代开发了精确的谱响应理论 (W_T=D_xiexp(-i T H))，其中对角伊辛哈密顿量生成的演化被直接用作连续相预言。能量分组递归及其生成函数解显示了经验特征函数如何确定能量选择共振的位置、宽度、高度和饱和时间。对于退火的高斯态密度，在 (θ(sqrt2ⁿ/M)) 预言机调用后以成功概率 (θ(1)) 达到包含 (M) 配置的高密度尾部共振，与经典能量评估的独立均匀采样相比，二次查询得到了改进。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为 Grover 型迭代开发了精确的谱响应理论 (W_T=D_xiexp(-i T H))，其中对角伊辛哈密顿量生成的演化被直接用作连续相预言。能量分组递归及其生成函数解显示了经验特征函数如何确定能量选择共振的位置、宽度、高度和饱和时间。对于退火的高斯态密度，在 (θ(sqrt2ⁿ/M)) 预言机调用后以成功概率 (θ(1)) 达到包含 (M) 配置的高密度尾部共振，与经典能量评估的独立均匀采样相比，二次查询得到了改进。对于相关随机伊辛光谱，重叠相关的协方差会导致均方根尺度 (O(n⁻3)) 的实现相关共振位移，其参数大于共振宽度，并且还可以降低峰高。这种偏移既是算法失谐，也是样本特定光谱波动的相干探测，其集合统计数据反映了伊辛重叠结构。光谱对称化和迭代校准可以消除或补偿规定能量瞄准的共振中心位移。我们还阐明了与设计的光谱滤波器的关系以及该渐近原语的精度和相干性要求。

articles.title: Fortuity and fragility in supersymmetric SYK
articles.title_zh: 超对称 SYK 中的偶然性和脆弱性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.12160v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In the mathcal N=2 supersymmetric SYK model with N fermions, every BPS state is fortuitous: at fixed charge, it exists only over a finite range of N. Allowing the charge to increase, we show that BPS classes may instead be uplifted along lattice walks inside the fortuity window, potentially to arbitrarily large N. However, there is no canonical uplift. We therefore introduce a decoder D whose spectrum quantifies exact uplift and its metric cost. We call the failure or increasing cost of uplifting harmonic representatives metric fragility. Chen's single-matrix model and the protected tower of the two-flavor SYK model realize bare and genuinely dressed mechanisms of perfect uplift, respectively. In the generic one-flavor model, exact uplift eventually fails. The Lin-Maldacena-Rozenberg-Shan-type operator D^dagger D exhibits level statistics consistent with the Gaussian unitary ensemble. Its eigenvalues quantify the metric continuity of BPS states across system size, while their correlations probe chaos within the BPS sector. Metric fragility and BPS chaos are thus encoded in complementary observables of the same operator, distinguishing chaotic BPS sectors from exactly solvable towers.
articles.abstract_zh: 在具有 N 个费米子的数学 N=2 超对称 SYK 模型中，每个 BPS 状态都是偶然的：在固定电荷下，它仅存在于 N 的有限范围内。允许电荷增加，我们表明 BPS 类可能会沿着偶然窗口内的格子行走提升，可能达到任意大的 N。但是，不存在规范提升。因此，我们引入了解码器 D，其频谱量化了精确的提升及其度量成本。我们将提升谐波的失败或成本增加称为度量脆弱性。陈的单矩阵模型和两种风格的SYK模型的保护塔分别实现了裸露和真实装饰的完美提升机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在具有 N 个费米子的数学 N=2 超对称 SYK 模型中，每个 BPS 状态都是偶然的：在固定电荷下，它仅存在于 N 的有限范围内。允许电荷增加，我们表明 BPS 类可能会沿着偶然窗口内的格子行走提升，可能达到任意大的 N。但是，不存在规范提升。因此，我们引入了解码器 D，其频谱量化了精确的提升及其度量成本。我们将提升谐波的失败或成本增加称为度量脆弱性。陈的单矩阵模型和两种风格的SYK模型的保护塔分别实现了裸露和真实装饰的完美提升机制。在通用的单一风味模型中，精确提升最终会失败。 Lin-Maldacena-Rozenberg-Shan 型算子 D^dagger D 表现出与高斯酉系综一致的水平统计。其特征值量化了跨系统规模的 BPS 状态的度量连续性，而它们的相关性则探测了 BPS 部门内的混乱情况。因此，度量脆弱性和 BPS 混沌被编码在同一算子的互补可观测量中，从而将混沌 BPS 扇区与精确可解的塔区分开来。

articles.title: Physics-Transfer Learning: A Physics-Constrained Theory for Zero-Shot Generalization Along the Ladder of Complexity
articles.title_zh: 物理迁移学习：沿着复杂性阶梯进行零样本泛化的物理约束理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22376v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable out-of-distribution generalization remains a central challenge in machine learning, particularly when models are deployed in data-scarce high-fidelity domains. Existing approaches often rely on statistical distribution alignment, or invariance assumptions that can fail when domain shifts reflect changes in underlying mechanisms. Inspired by a longstanding paradigm in physics that understands complex systems by starting from tractable idealizations and progressively incorporating additional mechanisms and levels of fidelity, we propose physics-transfer (PT) learning, a physics-constrained learning theory for zero-shot generalization along a ladder of complexity. PT constructs chains of anchor domains (CADs) that connect low-cost source domains to complex targets and introduces computable feasibility and reliability indicators for assessing transfer before target-domain labels are observed. Under physical-consistency and stable-representation assumptions, we derive an operational upper bound on target risk in terms of source empirical risk, the PT indicators, and finite-sample errors, and establish convergence as adjacent complexity gaps shrink and data coverage improves. We evaluate PT on excited-state energy prediction in quantum systems and dynamical-transition prediction in classical systems using neural networks trained without target-domain labels. Across substantial distribution shifts, PT yields accurate high-fidelity predictions, while the indicators identify incorrect physical mappings before target-domain prediction fails. These results provide a model-agnostic framework for designing, diagnosing, and controlling generalization in data-scarce learning problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 可靠的分布外泛化仍然是机器学习中的一个核心挑战，特别是当模型部署在数据稀缺的高保真领域时。现有方法通常依赖于统计分布对齐或不变性假设，当域变化反映了基础机制的变化时，这些假设可能会失败。受物理学中长期存在的范式的启发，该范式通过从易于处理的理想化开始并逐步纳入额外的机制和保真度水平来理解复杂系统，我们提出了物理迁移（PT）学习，这是一种沿着复杂性阶梯进行零样本泛化的物理约束学习理论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可靠的分布外泛化仍然是机器学习中的一个核心挑战，特别是当模型部署在数据稀缺的高保真领域时。现有方法通常依赖于统计分布对齐或不变性假设，当域变化反映了基础机制的变化时，这些假设可能会失败。受物理学中长期存在的范式的启发，该范式通过从易于处理的理想化开始并逐步纳入额外的机制和保真度水平来理解复杂系统，我们提出了物理迁移（PT）学习，这是一种沿着复杂性阶梯进行零样本泛化的物理约束学习理论。 PT 构建锚域链 (CAD)，将低成本源域连接到复杂目标，并引入可计算的可行性和可靠性指标，用于在观察目标域标签之前评估传输。在物理一致性和稳定表示假设下，我们根据源经验风险、PT 指标和有限样本误差得出目标风险的操作上限，并随着相邻复杂性差距缩小和数据覆盖范围提高而建立收敛。我们使用没有目标域标签训练的神经网络来评估量子系统中激发态能量预测和经典系统中动态跃迁预测的 PT。在大量的分布变化中，PT 可以产生准确的高保真度预测，而指标可以在目标域预测失败之前识别出不正确的物理映射。这些结果为设计、诊断和控制数据稀缺学习问题的泛化提供了一个与模型无关的框架。

articles.title: Regime-Aware Coupled Orchestration of Neural Operator Specialists for Multiphysics Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 多物理场动力学神经算子专家的机制感知耦合编排
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-world physics often unfolds over a variety of characteristic lengths and time scales. These non-uniformities are among the main reasons numerical simulations remain expensive when used predictively on practical systems: the same computational domain can contain smooth transport, vortical structures, thin interfaces, reaction fronts, and rapidly relaxing regions. Neural operators are attractive surrogates for such problems. However, a single architecture is still expected to represent all these local behaviours with a single set of weights and a single inductive bias. In this work, we introduce the regime-aware coupled neural orchestrator (RCNO), a framework that learns to distribute and connect a library of local operator specialists in space and time. For every patch, an orchestrator builds a causal query from the current fields, neighbouring halo values, local regime features, patch identity, activity level, and case parameters. The nine expert embeddings exchange two rounds of query-conditioned message passing before an edge-biased cross-attention stage produces a dispatch distribution that can be evaluated sparsely. Local predictions are assembled into a global field and projected onto system-specific physical constraints. A seam-aware extension additionally learns residual corrections across internal patch interfaces. We apply the same orchestration architecture to two qualitatively different systems: reacting flow and Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes (CHNS) dynamics. The results show that useful operator specialisation exists across local regimes, that the advantage of conditional composition increases as the spatial decomposition becomes finer, and, on reacting flow, that explicitly treating patch interfaces improves continuity, PDE consistency, and rollout accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 现实世界的物理学通常会在各种特征长度和时间尺度上展开。这些不均匀性是数值模拟在实际系统上进行预测时仍然昂贵的主要原因之一：相同的计算域可以包含平滑传输、涡流结构、薄界面、反应前沿和快速松弛区域。神经算子是此类问题的有吸引力的替代者。然而，仍然期望单个架构能够使用一组权重和单个归纳偏差来表示所有这些局部行为。在这项工作中，我们介绍了机制感知耦合神经协调器（RCNO），这是一个学习在空间和时间上分配和连接本地操作员专家库的框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现实世界的物理学通常会在各种特征长度和时间尺度上展开。这些不均匀性是数值模拟在实际系统上进行预测时仍然昂贵的主要原因之一：相同的计算域可以包含平滑传输、涡流结构、薄界面、反应前沿和快速松弛区域。神经算子是此类问题的有吸引力的替代者。然而，仍然期望单个架构能够使用一组权重和单个归纳偏差来表示所有这些局部行为。在这项工作中，我们介绍了机制感知耦合神经协调器（RCNO），这是一个学习在空间和时间上分配和连接本地操作员专家库的框架。对于每个补丁，编排器都会根据当前字段、邻近光环值、局部机制特征、补丁身份、活动级别和案例参数构建因果查询。在边缘偏向交叉注意阶段产生可以稀疏评估的调度分布之前，九个专家嵌入交换两轮查询条件消息传递。局部预测被组装到全局字段中并投影到特定于系统的物理约束。接缝感知扩展还可以学习跨内部补丁接口的残余校正。我们将相同的编排架构应用于两个性质不同的系统：反应流和 Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes (CHNS) 动力学。结果表明，跨局部机制存在有用的算子专门化，随着空间分解变得更精细，条件组合的优势会增加，并且在反应流上，显式处理补丁接口可以提高连续性、PDE 一致性和推出精度。

articles.title: Sorted Mutability as an Entropic Functional: Theory and Two Applications
articles.title_zh: 作为熵函数的排序可变性：理论和两个应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate sorted mutability, ζ_S, as an information-based quantity with an explicit entropic character. We show that ζ_S is directly proportional to the diversity of a data sequence and can therefore be expressed in terms of Shannon entropies, establishing a connection between compression-based measures and conventional information theory. In contrast to regular mutability, which preserves the sequential ordering of the data, sorted mutability removes this ordering and provides a static characterization of the distribution of observed values. We illustrate these properties in two complementary settings: the two-dimensional ferromagnetic Q-clock model and wind-power production data. For the Q-clock model, sorted mutability and diversity display the same temperature dependence, consistent with their analytical relation, while conventional thermodynamic observables provide an independent reference. In the case of wind power, we report monthly results for sorted mutability and diversity, showing proportional time evolutions. These results support sorted mutability as a useful, easy-to-calculate entropic functional for analyzing both equilibrium and non-equilibrium data sets.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究排序可变性 ze_S，将其作为具有显式熵特征的基于信息的量。我们证明，z_S 与数据序列的多样性成正比，因此可以用香农熵表示，建立基于压缩的度量和传统信息论之间的联系。与保留数据顺序的常规可变性相反，排序可变性消除了这种顺序并提供了观察值分布的静态特征。我们通过两个互补的设置来说明这些属性：二维铁磁 Q 时钟模型和风力发电数据。对于Q时钟模型，排序的可变性和多样性表现出相同的温度依赖性，与其分析关系一致，而传统的热力学可观测量提供了独立的参考。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究排序可变性 ze_S，将其作为具有显式熵特征的基于信息的量。我们证明，z_S 与数据序列的多样性成正比，因此可以用香农熵表示，建立基于压缩的度量和传统信息论之间的联系。与保留数据顺序的常规可变性相反，排序可变性消除了这种顺序并提供了观察值分布的静态特征。我们通过两个互补的设置来说明这些属性：二维铁磁 Q 时钟模型和风力发电数据。对于Q时钟模型，排序的可变性和多样性表现出相同的温度依赖性，与其分析关系一致，而传统的热力学可观测量提供了独立的参考。就风电而言，我们每月报告排序可变性和多样性的结果，显示成比例的时间演变。这些结果支持排序可变性作为一种有用的、易于计算的熵函数，用于分析平衡和非平衡数据集。

articles.title: Physics-informed Neural Networks Based on the Fokker-Planck Model for Rarefied Gas Flows
articles.title_zh: 基于 Fokker-Planck 稀薄气流模型的物理信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rarefied nonequilibrium flows are described by the Boltzmann equation, which can be solved using stochastic particle or deterministic methods. With advances in computing, data-assisted physics-informed neural networks have been widely used for flow prediction by combining governing equations with measured or computed data. Data-free PINNs do not require such training data and have been widely studied for continuum flows, but their application to rarefied flows remains limited. This study develops a data-free Fokker-Planck physics-informed neural network (FP-PINN) to describe rarefied nonequilibrium flows. The physics loss is constructed from the ellipsoidal statistical Fokker-Planck (ES-FP) equation using a velocity distribution function (VDF) closure and moment projection. The FP-PINN is evaluated for a steady one-dimensional Mach 10 normal shock. The FP-PINN results agree with the numerical ES-FP results, with errors below 1%. Compared with the particle ES-FP results, the FP-PINN predicts a sharper shock structure with errors up to 17%. This difference is attributed to the VDF closure and moment projection.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀有非平衡流由玻尔兹曼方程描述，可以使用随机粒子或确定性方法求解。随着计算技术的进步，数据辅助物理信息神经网络通过将控制方程与测量或计算数据相结合，已被广泛用于流量预测。无数据 PINN 不需要此类训练数据，并且已针对连续流进行了广泛研究，但其在稀薄流中的应用仍然有限。这项研究开发了一种无数据的福克-普朗克物理信息神经网络（FP-PINN）来描述稀薄的非平衡流。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀有非平衡流由玻尔兹曼方程描述，可以使用随机粒子或确定性方法求解。随着计算技术的进步，数据辅助物理信息神经网络通过将控制方程与测量或计算数据相结合，已被广泛用于流量预测。无数据 PINN 不需要此类训练数据，并且已针对连续流进行了广泛研究，但其在稀薄流中的应用仍然有限。这项研究开发了一种无数据的福克-普朗克物理信息神经网络（FP-PINN）来描述稀薄的非平衡流。物理损失是使用速度分布函数 (VDF) 闭包和力矩投影根据椭球统计 Fokker-Planck (ES-FP) 方程构建的。 FP-PINN 针对稳定的一维马赫 10 正向冲击进行评估。 FP-PINN 结果与数值 ES-FP 结果一致，误差低于 1%。与粒子ES-FP结果相比，FP-PINN预测出更尖锐的激波结构，误差高达17%。这种差异归因于 VDF 闭合和力矩投影。

articles.title: Long-Lived Charge Trap Characterization for Rare-Event Searches with Skipper-CCDs
articles.title_zh: 使用 Skipper-CCD 进行罕见事件搜索的长寿命电荷陷阱表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Skipper Charge-Coupled Devices (Skipper-CCDs) are detectors with sub-electron resolution, allowing them to play a critical role in rare-event searches. A major challenge in experiments using these detectors is understanding and mitigating low-energy backgrounds which impact the single-electron rate. One potential component of the single-electron rate could arise from single-electron charge traps caused by lattice defects. In this work we use a new in-situ technique for generating uniform charge known as ``pixel-pumping'' across the CCD to study single-electron traps in a SENSEI sensor placed underground in the MINOS cavern at Fermilab, which enables sensitivity to long-lived traps with emission times >10³ seconds, a regime that was previously not accessible. We fully characterize 1787 traps and use this information to estimate their contribution to the single-electron background in SENSEI. Through simulation, we find the characterized population of traps does not significantly impact the single-electron rate. We further identify the energies and cross-sections for traps to which this analysis is sensitive, and compare this with the values that could impact the single-electron rate. This analysis probes a large fraction of this region. However, we also see that a sufficiently numerous hidden population could contribute significantly to the single-electron rate, and new measurement techniques will have to be devised in order to fully rule out this population.
articles.abstract_zh: Skipper 电荷耦合器件 (Skipper-CCD) 是具有亚电子分辨率的探测器，使其能够在罕见事件搜索中发挥关键作用。使用这些探测器进行实验的一个主要挑战是理解和减轻影响单电子速率的低能量背景。单电子速率的一个潜在组成部分可能来自晶格缺陷引起的单电子电荷陷阱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Skipper 电荷耦合器件 (Skipper-CCD) 是具有亚电子分辨率的探测器，使其能够在罕见事件搜索中发挥关键作用。使用这些探测器进行实验的一个主要挑战是理解和减轻影响单电子速率的低能量背景。单电子速率的一个潜在组成部分可能来自晶格缺陷引起的单电子电荷陷阱。在这项工作中，我们使用一种新的原位技术在 CCD 上生成称为“像素泵浦”的均匀电荷，以研究位于费米实验室 MINOS 洞穴地下的 SENSEI 传感器中的单电子陷阱，该传感器能够对发射时间 >10 秒的长寿命陷阱敏感，这是以前无法实现的。我们充分描述了 1787 个陷阱的特征，并使用这些信息来估计它们对 SENSEI 中单电子背景的贡献。通过模拟，我们发现陷阱的特征群体不会显着影响单电子速率。我们进一步确定了该分析敏感的陷阱的能量和横截面，并将其与可能影响单电子速率的值进行比较。该分析探测了该区域的很大一部分。然而，我们也看到足够多的隐藏群体可能对单电子率有显着贡献，并且必须设计新的测量技术以完全排除该群体。

articles.title: Comment on "Beam blow up due to beamstrahlung in circular e+e- colliders"
articles.title_zh: 对“圆形 e+e- 对撞机中由于束致辐射导致的束爆炸”的评论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The authors of the original article, Valdivia Garcia and Zimmermann (2021), state that they "derive analytical formulae for the equilibrium beam parameters, considering the varying electromagnetic field during the collision". However, to calculate the bending radius in the field of the counter-propagating bunch, they employed an approximation that is completely unjustified. Consequently, a significant portion of the formulae derived in the article bears a very tenuous relationship to reality. For practical purposes, we propose a different solution -- one that is far simpler and more accurate.
articles.abstract_zh: 原始文章的作者 Valdivia Garcia 和 Zimmermann (2021) 表示，他们“考虑到碰撞过程中电磁场的变化，推导了平衡梁参数的解析公式”。然而，为了计算反向传播束流场中的弯曲半径，他们采用了完全不合理的近似值。因此，本文中导出的公式的很大一部分与现实的关系非常脆弱。出于实用目的，我们提出了一种不同的解决方案——一种更简单、更准确的解决方案。

articles.title: Atmospheric Chemistry-Climate Modeling with an AI Foundation Model
articles.title_zh: 使用 AI 基础模型进行大气化学-气候建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atmospheric composition and chemistry-climate interactions are central to predicting future climate change. Yet simulating chemical and aerosol processes is typically the most expensive component of an atmospheric model and is often highly simplified or prescribed entirely. AI weather forecasting foundation models have shown skill rivalling process-based models and are increasingly fine-tuned for new atmospheric tasks. Here, we present the first foundation model to capture interactions between emissions, atmospheric composition, and radiation. We fine-tune the Aurora Earth system foundation model on simulations from the chemistry-climate model UKCA. Our model reproduces daily meteorology, composition, aerosol, and radiation fields of the coupled system with 23 of 27 predicted fields achieving R² above 0.85 in both the troposphere and stratosphere. It reproduces ozone, CO, and temperature with annual mean biases below 4% and the downwelling shortwave and longwave fluxes to within 6%. Our model remains stable in autoregressive simulation over 50 years while running ~100× faster than UKCA. By training on paired emissions scenarios, our model learns responses to perturbations by capturing tropospheric ozone's response to changes in NO and CO emissions and surface radiation's response to aerosol. We further show that incorporating MLS satellite ozone retrievals into training corrects biases in the underlying UKCA fields, reducing zonal mean ozone error against collocated observations by 23% between 250 and 20 hPa. Our approach does not suggest process-based modeling can be replaced but demonstrates that a foundation model can be adapted to respond to forcings and learn from observations at a relatively small computational cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 大气成分和化学与气候的相互作用对于预测未来气候变化至关重要。然而，模拟化学和气溶胶过程通常是大气模型中最昂贵的组成部分，并且通常被高度简化或完全规定。人工智能天气预报基础模型已经显示出与基于过程的模型相媲美的技能，并且越来越多地针对新的大气任务进行微调。在这里，我们提出了第一个基础模型来捕获排放、大气成分和辐射之间的相互作用。我们根据化学气候模型 UKCA 的模拟对极光地球系统基础模型进行微调。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大气成分和化学与气候的相互作用对于预测未来气候变化至关重要。然而，模拟化学和气溶胶过程通常是大气模型中最昂贵的组成部分，并且通常被高度简化或完全规定。人工智能天气预报基础模型已经显示出与基于过程的模型相媲美的技能，并且越来越多地针对新的大气任务进行微调。在这里，我们提出了第一个基础模型来捕获排放、大气成分和辐射之间的相互作用。我们根据化学气候模型 UKCA 的模拟对极光地球系统基础模型进行微调。我们的模型再现了耦合系统的日常气象、成分、气溶胶和辐射场，其中 27 个预测场中有 23 个在对流层和平流层中实现了 R2 以上 0.85。它再现了臭氧、二氧化碳和温度，年平均偏差低于 4%，下降流短波和长波通量在 6% 以内。我们的模型在自回归模拟中保持稳定超过 50 年，同时运行速度比 UKCA 快约 100 倍。通过配对排放场景的训练，我们的模型通过捕获对流层臭氧对 NO 和 CO 排放变化的响应以及表面辐射对气溶胶的响应来学习对扰动的响应。我们进一步表明，将 MLS 卫星臭氧反演纳入训练中可以纠正 UKCA 基础领域的偏差，将 250 至 20 hPa 期间相对于并置观测的纬向平均臭氧误差减少 23%。我们的方法并不表明可以取代基于过程的建模，而是表明可以调整基础模型来响应强迫并以相对较小的计算成本从观察中学习。

articles.title: Two-photon Doppler-free spectroscopy of the 6s²;¹S₀ → 6s23s;¹S₀ Rydberg transition for quantum sensing in ytterbium
articles.title_zh: 用于镱量子传感的 6s2;1S₀ → 6s23s;1S₀ 里德堡跃迁的双光子无多普勒光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Here we report atomic structure calculations and experimental observations of the two-photon 6s²;¹S₀ → 6s23s;¹S₀ transition in Yb. The unique level structure of Yb places the 6s6p;¹P₁ state's energy at approx!49.7% of the ionization energy, which facilitates two-photon Doppler-free excitation of the 6s23s;¹S₀ Rydberg state from the 6s²;¹S₀ ground state at a relatively low optical intensity. This J= 0 → J=0 transition is immune to first-order Zeeman and electric quadrupole shifts, has reduced sensitivity to higher-order Zeeman shifts, and is further predicted to have relatively low sensitivity to density shifts. Using configuration interaction theory, we compute relevant properties of the 6s23s;¹S₀ Rydberg state for sensing, including the C₆ coefficient, dc polarizability, blackbody radiation (BBR) shift, and BBR depopulation rate. As a first experimental step, we demonstrate two-photon Doppler-free spectroscopy of the 6s²;¹S₀ → 6s23s;¹S₀ transition. From our experimental spectra, we estimate the natural linewidth (lifetime) of the 6s23s;¹S₀ state to be 90 kHz (1.8 μs). We believe this transition, or other 6s²;¹S₀ → 6sns;¹S₀ transitions in Yb with napprox23, may find use in a variety of sensing applications, potentially including a two-photon clock, electrometer, or BBR thermometer.

articles.title: Time-Domain Data-Driven Loewner Reduced-Order Models for Electromagnetic Simulation
articles.title_zh: 用于电磁仿真的时域数据驱动 Loewner 降阶模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a data-driven Loewner framework for constructing reduced-order models (ROMs) from time-domain electromagnetic (EM) simulation data. High-fidelity simulation of microwave devices can be computationally expensive, particularly when fine spatial discretization and long observation windows are required. The proposed method uses transient input-output data to construct Loewner and shifted Loewner matrices, from which a reduced descriptor realization is obtained through singular value decomposition (SVD). The resulting models are identified from a limited training window and used to predict responses over substantially longer time intervals, with prediction windows up to 50 times the duration of the training window. The method is formalized as an explicit, reproducible algorithm and validated against full-order simulations for four microwave structures: a substrate-integrated-waveguide filter, a frequency-selective surface, an evanescent-mode coaxial comb-line filter, and a diplexer. The results demonstrate the potential of Loewner-based identification to provide compact models of electromagnetic responses while reducing the need for repeated full-order simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的Loewner框架，用于从时域电磁（ EM ）仿真数据构建降阶模型（ ROM ）。微波器件的高保真模拟在计算上可能是昂贵的，特别是当需要精细的空间离散化和长观测窗口时。该方法利用瞬态输入输出数据构造Loewner矩阵和移位Loewner矩阵，通过奇异值分解（ SVD ）得到简化的描述子实现。所得模型从有限的训练窗口中识别出来，并用于预测大致更长时间间隔的响应，预测窗口高达训练窗口持续时间的50倍。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的Loewner框架，用于从时域电磁（ EM ）仿真数据构建降阶模型（ ROM ）。微波器件的高保真模拟在计算上可能是昂贵的，特别是当需要精细的空间离散化和长观测窗口时。该方法利用瞬态输入输出数据构造Loewner矩阵和移位Loewner矩阵，通过奇异值分解（ SVD ）得到简化的描述子实现。所得模型从有限的训练窗口中识别出来，并用于预测大致更长时间间隔的响应，预测窗口高达训练窗口持续时间的50倍。该方法被形式化为一种显式的、可重现的算法，并针对四个微波结构的全阶模拟进行了验证：衬底集成波导滤波器、频率选择表面、渐逝模式同轴梳状线滤波器和双工器。结果表明，基于Loewner的识别具有提供电磁响应紧凑模型的潜力，同时减少了对重复全序模拟的需求。

articles.title: Fourier-Feature-Embedded Complex-Valued Physics-Informed Convolutional Residual Networks for Sparse and Gappy Noisy Flow-Field Reconstruction
articles.title_zh: 用于稀疏和间隙噪声流场重建的傅里叶特征嵌入式复值物理通知卷积残差网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reconstructing flow fields from sparse and noisy measurements becomes particularly challenging when data are completely absent from dynamically critical regions, such as the vortex-formation region of a wake. Conventional interpolation and numerical reconstruction methods generally require sufficient spatial or boundary information, while physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can also face difficulties when sparse and noisy observations provide little or no supervision in the region of interest. To address this gap, we propose a Fourier-feature-embedded complex-valued physics-informed convolutional residual network (FCV-PICRN) for sparse, gappy, and noisy flow-field reconstruction. The framework integrates Fourier features for oscillatory and multiscale structures, complex-valued representations for coupled amplitude--phase learning, and convolutional residual blocks constrained by the Navier--Stokes equations. The method is first verified using the Taylor--Green vortex at Re=100 and then evaluated for the cylinder wake at Re=100. Three severe missing-data configurations are imposed in the dynamically sensitive wake: a large hole, a large truncation, and a plus-shaped gap extending in both streamwise and transverse directions. These gaps are further combined with additive Gaussian and multiplicative speckle noise. Despite having no supervised velocity data inside the excluded regions, FCV-PICRN reconstructs velocity, pressure, and vorticity with high structural similarity index (SSIM) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), and remains robust under Gaussian noise up to 20%. Finally, for forced two-dimensional Kolmogorov turbulence with 5% Gaussian noise, FCV-PICRN yields lower reconstruction errors than a conventional PINN. These results demonstrate robust physics-informed reconstruction of severely incomplete and noisy flows across laminar and turbulent regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 当动态关键区域（例如尾流的涡流形成区域）完全没有数据时，从稀疏和嘈杂的测量中重建流场变得特别具有挑战性。传统的插值和数值重建方法通常需要足够的空间或边界信息，而当稀疏和噪声观测在感兴趣区域提供很少或没有监督时，物理信息神经网络（PINN）也可能面临困难。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了一种傅里叶特征嵌入的复值物理信息卷积残差网络（FCV-PICRN），用于稀疏、间隙和噪声流场重建。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当动态关键区域（例如尾流的涡流形成区域）完全没有数据时，从稀疏和嘈杂的测量中重建流场变得特别具有挑战性。传统的插值和数值重建方法通常需要足够的空间或边界信息，而当稀疏和噪声观测在感兴趣区域提供很少或没有监督时，物理信息神经网络（PINN）也可能面临困难。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了一种傅里叶特征嵌入的复值物理信息卷积残差网络（FCV-PICRN），用于稀疏、间隙和噪声流场重建。该框架集成了振荡和多尺度结构的傅里叶特征、耦合幅度-相位学习的复值表示以及受纳维-斯托克斯方程约束的卷积残差块。 The method is first verified using the Taylor--Green vortex at Re=100 and then evaluated for the cylinder wake at Re=100.动态敏感尾流中存在三种严重的数据缺失配置：大孔、大截断和沿流向和横向延伸的加号间隙。 These gaps are further combined with additive Gaussian and multiplicative speckle noise.尽管排除区域内没有监督速度数据，FCV-PICRN 仍以高结构相似性指数 (SSIM) 和峰值信噪比 (PSNR) 重建速度、压力和涡度，并在高达 20% 的高斯噪声下保持鲁棒性。最后，对于具有 5% 高斯噪声的强制二维 Kolmogorov 湍流，FCV-PICRN 产生比传统 PINN 更低的重建误差。 These results demonstrate robust physics-informed reconstruction of severely incomplete and noisy flows across laminar and turbulent regimes.

articles.title: Development of a fabrication-to-benchtop process for SiN-based quantum devices
articles.title_zh: 基于SiN的量子器件的制造到台式工艺的开发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22776v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon nitride has emerged as a key material for the advancement of future quantum communication and computational devices. However, challenges persist in establishing a comprehensive development process, spanning from fabrication to optical characterization, essential for advancing these devices to their next stage of potential. Maintaining control over the entire process, from start to finish, alongside device modeling, enables more efficient and timely iteration and optimization. Here we introduce a fabrication-to-benchtop process. We employ an in-house stoichiometric recipe for device fabrication and conduct comprehensive characterization of optical losses and material properties. Understanding and controlling the refractive index of the device are vital for predicting device geometries and group indices. Implementing the refractive indices of our fabricated devices, we simulate microring resonators and demonstrate their application in generating optical solitons.

articles.title: Fully relativistic calculation of thermal shifts in spectra of hydrogen molecular ion
articles.title_zh: 氢分子离子光谱热位移的完全相对论计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Within a fully relativistic framework, we discuss the one-loop self-energy correction, generalized to the presence of external blackbody radiation, for a bound electron in the hydrogen molecular ion. The calculations rely on the thermal part of the photon propagator from finite-temperature quantum electrodynamics. The Dirac equation with a two-center potential is solved using the dual kinetic balance condition, extended to axially symmetric systems, and a B-spline-based trial function. The results are obtained within the Born-Oppenheimer adiabatic approximation. Thermal shift for the ground term of the hydrogen molecular ion is computed as a function of the internuclear distance. Including this correction, we present the resulting shifts of the vibrational levels. The analysis focuses on the dynamical effect, a comparison is made with data available in the current literature.
articles.abstract_zh: Within a fully relativistic framework, we discuss the one-loop self-energy correction, generalized to the presence of external blackbody radiation, for a bound electron in the hydrogen molecular ion.计算依赖于有限温度量子电动力学中光子传播器的热部分。

articles.title: PINN-LPCDD: Physics-Informed Neural Network with Learnable and Physically Consistent Domain Decomposition for Compressible Multi-Medium Flows
articles.title_zh: PINN-LPCDD：具有可学习且物理一致的域分解的物理信息神经网络，用于可压缩的多媒体流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The physics-informed neural network (PINN) faces significant challenges when solving compressible multi-medium flows, including the inability to locate interface positions, poor approximation of discontinuities, and difficulty in handling high-pressure-ratio problems between media with large stiffness differences. To address these issues, we propose PINN with Learnable and Physically Consistent Domain Decomposition (PINN-LPCDD), a framework that incorporates the sharp interface method (SIM) into PINNs for solving compressible multi-medium flows. Firstly, we design separate sub-networks for each medium with learnable parameters to automatically learn interface positions, so that the domain decomposition is physically consistent, and the contact discontinuity at the interface is naturally sharp. Secondly, the Euler equations with artificial viscosity are solved to enhance robustness when handling problems involving shock waves. Lastly, the scaling invariance of the Euler equations is exploited to facilitate the solution of high pressure ratio problems. Numerical experiments on air-air, air-helium, air-water, and air-R22 problems demonstrate the acceptable accuracy of the proposed method in simulating multi-medium flows.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）在解决可压缩多介质流时面临重大挑战，包括无法定位界面位置、不连续性近似较差以及难以处理刚度差异较大的介质之间的高压比问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了具有可学习和物理一致域分解的 PINN（PINN-LPCDD），这是一个将锐接口方法（SIM）纳入 PINN 的框架，用于解决可压缩的多媒体流。首先，我们为每种介质设计单独的具有可学习参数的子网络来自动学习界面位置，使得域分解在物理上是一致的，并且界面处的接触不连续性自然是尖锐的。

articles.title: Permutationally Invariant Polynomial Descriptors as Colored Multigraphs
articles.title_zh: 作为彩色多重图的排列不变多项式描述符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The combinatorial explosion in monomial counts limits the extension of global permutationally invariant polynomial (PIP) potential energy surfaces to larger molecular systems. We use graph-theoretic language to reformulate PIPs as colored multigraphs and develop a series of theoretical and computational tools. First, we introduce an offline PIP generation algorithm whose cost has an upper bound independent of atom count for a fixed degree cutoff and number of element types. Second, we introduce a new online PIP evaluation algorithm, termed tensor-network descent. For the full PIP set through degree d in a system of M atoms, the evaluation complexity for 1le dle14 is O!left(f(d)Mleftlfloor⁽sqrt¹⁺⁸d⁺¹⁾/²rⁱghtrfloorright). At the commonly used cutoff of d=5, the online evaluation complexity decreases from the M¹⁰ scaling of conventional explicit term-by-term computation to M³. Numerical tests using the full PIP set through degree 5 show that our method achieves speedups of several orders of magnitude on most MD17 systems and remains computationally affordable for systems containing more than one thousand atoms. The method has a native tensor form, supports automatic differentiation, and provides a unified theoretical construction of four classes of PIP descriptors defined consistently across systems---global, atom-centered, bond-centered, and cluster-centered---establishing a representation and computational foundation for PIP potentials for large systems and for transfer across systems. Together, these results show that PIPs are neither inherently restricted to small systems nor intrinsically nontransferable.

articles.title: Properties and challenges of machine learning closures for ten-moment fluid models in the case of Landau damping
articles.title_zh: 朗道阻尼情况下十矩流体模型的机器学习闭包的特性和挑战
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-fluid ten-moment models for plasma simulations evolve the velocity moments of the Velocity Distribution Function (VDF) up to the pressure tensor and require a closure for the divergence of the next velocity moment, the heat flux. We investigate the use of Machine Learning (ML) models for the discovery of heat flux closures, as an alternative to the typically employed Hammett-Perkins-like analytical closures. As a test case, we investigate Landau damping, which describes a resonant process of energy transfer between particles and waves. We find that fluid simulations with ML closures correctly reproduce both the damping frequency and the non-linear phase of Landau damping, and thereby outperform Hammett-Perkins-like closures, within the parameter ranges seen during training and when interpolating within those ranges. When extrapolating beyond the training data, the performance of the ML closure degrades with increasing distance from known parameters. We then investigate how well offline metrics (i.,e.; evaluating the trained model on fully-kinetic reference simulations, without inserting it into two-fluid simulations) can predict online performance, when the model is actually used in the two-fluid simulation. Our results show that offline metrics do not fully explain online performance, highlighting important implications for method evaluation in this field. We further investigate suitable metrics for online performance evaluation in the absence of a fully-kinetic reference simulation, which is often computationally expensive to run. We propose using the temporal evolution of entropy to evaluate the performance of reduced models with ML closures when no or few kinetic reference simulations are available.
articles.abstract_zh: 用于等离子体模拟的二流体十矩模型将速度分布函数 (VDF) 的速度矩演化为压力张量，并且需要封闭下一个速度矩（热通量）的发散。我们研究使用机器学习 (ML) 模型来发现热通量闭包，作为通常采用的类似 Hammett-Perkins 分析闭包的替代方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用于等离子体模拟的二流体十矩模型将速度分布函数 (VDF) 的速度矩演化为压力张量，并且需要封闭下一个速度矩（热通量）的发散。我们研究使用机器学习 (ML) 模型来发现热通量闭包，作为通常采用的类似 Hammett-Perkins 分析闭包的替代方案。 As a test case, we investigate Landau damping, which describes a resonant process of energy transfer between particles and waves.我们发现，使用 ML 闭包进行的流体模拟可以正确再现阻尼频率和 Landau 阻尼的非线性相位，从而在训练期间以及在这些范围内插值时看到的参数范围内优于 Hammett-Perkins 类闭包。 When extrapolating beyond the training data, the performance of the ML closure degrades with increasing distance from known parameters.然后，我们研究当模型实际用于二流体模拟时，离线指标（即在全动力学参考模拟上评估经过训练的模型，而不将其插入二流体模拟）可以预测在线性能。我们的结果表明，离线指标并不能完全解释在线性能，凸显了对该领域方法评估的重要影响。我们进一步研究在缺乏全动力学参考模拟的情况下进行在线性能评估的合适指标，而全动力学参考模拟的运行成本通常很高。我们建议在没有或很少有动力学参考模拟可用时，使用熵的时间演化来评估具有 ML 闭包的简化模型的性能。

articles.title: Graph-Learned Spring SST Evolution and Land-Ocean Synergy Improve Yangtze Summer Rainfall Prediction
articles.title_zh: 图学习春季海温演变和陆海协同改善长江夏季降雨预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23094v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Seasonal prediction of Yangtze summer rainfall is challenged by nonstationary oceanic precursors. Here we demonstrate that accounting for the evolution of spring SST and state-dependent land surface information improves predictability. Graph total variation (GTV) is applied to March-May SST fields over the western Pacific, Niño3.4, and tropical Indian Ocean to identify spatially coherent, month-specific SST coefficients for each grid cell and month to form a scalar GTV index. The learned coefficient patterns capture April-to-May ENSO decay and an opposing Indian Ocean adjustment, consistent with coupled Indo-Pacific variability. During 2008-2022, the GTV index prediction outperforms Niño3.4-based and sparse-regression benchmarks. Further improvement is achieved by including interactions of May Indo-China Peninsula soil moisture with Indian Ocean SST, importantly also correcting several underestimated wet summers. Circulation diagnostics associate the learned index with a summer geopotential-height dipole and Yangtze moisture convergence, while dry-Indochina/warm-Indian-Ocean conditions coincide with stronger westward extension of the western Pacific subtropical high.
articles.abstract_zh: 长江夏季降水的季节性预测受到非平稳海洋前兆的挑战。在这里，我们证明，考虑春季海温和状态依赖性地表信息的演变可以提高可预测性。将图形总变异（ GTV ）应用于西太平洋、Niño3.4和热带印度洋的3-5月海温场，以确定每个网格单元和月份的空间相干、特定月份的海温系数，从而形成标量GTV指数。学习系数模式捕获了4月至5月的ENSO衰变和相反的印度洋调整，这与耦合的印度洋-太平洋变异性一致。在2008-2022年期间， GTV指数预测优于基于Niño3.4和稀疏回归基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长江夏季降水的季节性预测受到非平稳海洋前兆的挑战。在这里，我们证明，考虑春季海温和状态依赖性地表信息的演变可以提高可预测性。将图形总变异（ GTV ）应用于西太平洋、Niño3.4和热带印度洋的3-5月海温场，以确定每个网格单元和月份的空间相干、特定月份的海温系数，从而形成标量GTV指数。学习系数模式捕获了4月至5月的ENSO衰变和相反的印度洋调整，这与耦合的印度洋-太平洋变异性一致。在2008-2022年期间， GTV指数预测优于基于Niño3.4和稀疏回归基准。通过包括五月印度支那半岛土壤湿度与印度洋海温的相互作用，实现了进一步的改善，重要的是也纠正了几个被低估的潮湿夏季。环流诊断将学习指数与夏季位势高度偶极子和长江水分收敛联系起来，而干旱印度支那/暖印度洋条件与西太平洋副热带高压更强的向西延伸相吻合。

articles.title: Role of Device Size on Island Divertor Performance of W7-X-like Configurations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To examine how the island divertor performs in future low-shear stellarator reactors, we simulate (using EMC3-Eirene [1]) 3 different scales of W7-X: its current size, increased by a factor 2, and increased by a factor 4, where 4 times W7-X corresponds roughly to a reactor-scale device. For a single magnetic configuration, the standard magnetic configuration in W7-X, we examine how increasing the size of W7-X alters the divertor performance of the island divertor. We analyze how device scale shifts the location of the ionization source and the downstream density and temperature trends in the island divertor for achieving detachment. Local field line analysis shows that factor 2 and factor 4 size scalings achieve target densities >10²¹  m⁻³ via plasma ``self-baffling" within the open island divertor geometry. Finally, the heat and particle flux deposition on the scaled-up island divertor configurations are calculated. We observe a separation in the target heat and particle flux distribution with increased machine size in agreement with [2]. The target heat fluxes are <5  MW/m² at high separatrix densities. This shows that the separation of the heat and particle flux channels remains to be largely unproblematic. This analysis helps guide how to improve the open island divertor geometries for future stellarator reactors.

articles.title: Energy-Aware Earth System Science: A Community Roadmap
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Earth system models underpin the evidence that informs net-zero policy, yet their energy demands are rarely considered when judging model quality. Using archived output from 159 models spanning five generations of the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project (CMIP), we show that model error has fallen at a constant rate of 13.5 per cent per doubling of compute since 1995. Halving CMIP6 error would require 28 times more compute. Improvements are uneven, with sea-level pressure and surface air temperature errors declining 3.5-fold and 2.7-fold since CMIP1, but precipitation error by only 7 per cent. Machine-learning weather models match or exceed operational forecast skill at a fraction of the runtime, but none publishes measured energy, and including training changes how they rank. We propose a skill-energy framework that combines an empirical Pareto front with a ranking score. These findings argue for standardised reporting of energy use and performance ahead of CMIP8.

articles.title: High average flux positron sources driven by a mJ-class laser
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23243v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on the production and characterisation of MeV-scale positron populations driven by a high-repetition-rate, mJ-class laser system. The positrons are generated via a two-step Bethe--Heitler process driven by laser-wakefield-accelerated electron beams propagating through a mm-scale lead converter. At 10 Hz, approximately 1000 positrons in the 0.8--1.7 MeV energy range were measured over 100 accumulated shots. Stable electron acceleration was demonstrated at 10 Hz, 100 Hz, and 1 kHz using approximately 9 mJ of laser energy in the focal spot, indicating the potential for substantially higher average positron fluxes for laser systems operating at kHz repetition rates and energies of 10s of mJ. Such a positron source allows generating sufficiently high average fluxes of MeV-scale positrons while maintaining low positron yields per pulse and narrow temporal distributions, a regime of particular interest for novel applications in material science and fundamental physics. The measured positron yields and spectra are in good agreement with Monte Carlo simulations, supporting the modelling of the positron-production process and magnetic transport system.

articles.title: How the elastic axis folds the transonic flutter boundary: shock energy transfer and conformally calibrated active learning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Isogai's case A, a pitch-plunge aerofoil whose elastic axis lies half a chord ahead of the leading edge, has a folded transonic flutter boundary in inviscid flow: near the bottom of the transonic dip several flutter speeds coexist at one Mach number. We map this boundary, and the family obtained by moving the elastic axis, with coupled unsteady Euler simulations, a Gaussian-process surrogate of the damping coefficient trained by batch active learning, and split conformal prediction on independent random simulations, which turns the surrogate into stability calls with a distribution-free error rate. Three failure modes of time-domain damping labels that leave no trace in the residuals are documented, and the half-degree mean incidence left by the common one-degree start is shown to raise the flutter speed at the dip by 2.8%, more than any numerical setting. With 80 simulations the learned case A boundary labels 64 of 65 independent runs correctly, and calibrated calls are wrong in at most 1.6% of cases. Over Mach number, elastic axis and flutter speed index, 193 simulations and 40 calibration runs show that the fold exists only for elastic axes more than about 0.4 chord ahead of the leading edge; it closes between 0.39 and 0.33 chord ahead, on two meshes. Chordwise energy budgets, closed against the solver loads and the growth rate within a few per cent, explain the boundary. The lower branch is crossed through the reduced frequency at unchanged shock phase. On the upper branch the shock is pinned at the trailing edge, and moving the elastic axis aft brings the pivot of the flutter mode towards the section, so that the damping of the supersonic surface falls faster than the residual shock input and the fold closes.

articles.title: A dry cryogenic platform with picometre stability for nanoscale and quantum technologies
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23407v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mechanically ultrastable environments within maintenance-free dry cryostats are needed for high-precision surface probe microscopy experiments, as well as next-generation quantum technologies. The most demanding applications require picometre-scale precision combined with multi-axis and millimetre-scale scanning range, while offering access to optical, microwave, and radiofrequency control and a vector magnetic field. We demonstrate a versatile platform for such systems based on passive and active vibration control for a commercial dry cryostat. Using a tunable optical microcavity as a sensor, we report vibration levels of 4.2 pm root mean square at 2.3 K over one hour without postselection. We further demonstrate drift-free long-term operation with stability below 8.6 pm RMS over 12 hours. Our system enables continuous and automated operation for next-generation high-throughput applications without the need for liquid helium infrastructure. Requiring only standard machining facilities and commercially available hardware, the design can be readily adapted for cryogenic optical, electrical and magnetic high-precision measurements across quantum science, surface science, and nanotechnology.

articles.title: Path-integrated electrostatic energization in laser-driven collisionless cylindrical convergence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collisionless converging ion flows can sustain particle energization over an extended path, but the field channel responsible for the energy gain is not always identifiable. In laser-driven bladed microtube implosion, energetic carbon ions were previously observed alongside a self-generated gigagauss-class axial magnetic field [D. Pan and M. Murakami, Phys. Plasmas 32, 072107 (2025)], leaving the origin of their energization unresolved. Using two-dimensional particle-in-cell simulations, field-particle power decomposition and trajectory-resolved work accounting show that radial electrostatic work accumulated along the converging path supplies more than 98% of the net in-plane electric work, whereas the azimuthal channel associated with the time-varying magnetic field remains subdominant. The peak local mean ion energy factorizes, to good approximation, into an incident-flow contribution controlled by laser intensity and a geometric enhancement that grows approximately linearly with the inner radius because ions accumulate electrostatic work over a longer convergence path. The path-averaged radial electric field langle Eᵣrangle scales with the peak laser intensity I_L as langle Eᵣrangle propto I_L⁰.⁴⁷, favoring a geometry-pinned, comoving charge-separation structure over Debye-limited scaling. The peak local mean carbon-ion energy reaches 0.89 GeV. A smooth-cylinder control exhibits comparable peak energization, showing that blade modulation mainly affects poststagnation ion residence rather than the energy source.

articles.title: Noise suppression of quantum frequency conversion in thin-film lithium niobate waveguides via adapted poling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum frequency conversion (QFC) enables optical interfaces between dissimilar quantum systems, but suppressing noise while maintaining high conversion efficiency remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate that adapted poling in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) waveguides reduces the pump-power requirement while shifting the dominant noise mechanism and its power scaling. In 2-cm-long waveguides, adapted poling enables maximum conversion efficiency at an on-chip pump power of 19±0.8~mW, reducing the required pump power by 8~dB and the total conversion noise by 14~dB relative to conventional periodic poling at their respective maximum-conversion operating points. Controlled measurements with different pump conditions and device configurations reveal a transition from predominantly quadratic noise scaling in periodically poled devices to predominantly linear scaling in adapted-poling devices. This transition accompanies a shift from noise dominated by cascaded second-harmonic generation and Stokes spontaneous Raman scattering to direct anti-Stokes spontaneous Raman scattering. These results establish adapted poling as an effective approach to suppressing nonlinear noise, enabling low-noise integrated frequency converters for quantum networks.

articles.title: Reconstruction of Magnetic Fields with a Physics-Informed Neural Network
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate reconstruction of magnetic fields and their gradients is essential for assessing and controlling systematic effects in precision measurement experiments. We have developed a physics-informed neural network (PINN) method which reconstructs three-dimensional magnetic fields subject to the source-free Maxwell equations, nablacdotB=0 and nablatimesB=0. In an extension of our previous work on PINN methods for reconstruction of magnetic fields in inaccessible interior regions via measurements at exterior locations, we now demonstrate the feasibility of applying PINN methods to the extraction of magnetic field gradient terms from discrete measurement points subject to constraints from Maxwell's equations.

articles.title: Eulerian ion energisation in three-dimensional hybrid-Vlasov-Maxwell turbulence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23740v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In collisionless plasma turbulence, energy is transferred from electromagnetic fluctuations to the particles. However, the relative contributions of different ion energisation mechanisms remain unclear. We investigate ion energisation in three-dimensional hybrid Vlasov--Maxwell simulations of decaying turbulence at βᵢ₀=0.25 and βᵢ₀=4, where βᵢ₀ is the initial ratio of ion thermal to magnetic pressure. Using the exact ion momentum equation, we decompose the ion energisation rate jᵢcdotE into the work done on the parallel, diamagnetic, curvature, agyrotropic and polarisation ion currents. This decomposition requires neither gyrotropy nor scale separation and, therefore, remains valid where guiding-centre theory breaks down. We show that the agyrotropic term, which has no guiding-centre counterpart, accounts for 21,% of the energisation at βᵢ₀=0.25 and 91,% at βᵢ₀=4. We find that the dominant instantaneous energisation term changes with βᵢ₀, from the polarisation current at low βᵢ₀ to the diamagnetic and agyrotropic currents at high βᵢ₀, at all resolved scales. In addition, we show that reversible exchange with the ion bulk flow dominates the instantaneous rate, so the time-integrated energy transfer is larger at βᵢ₀=4 even though the instantaneous rate is smaller. Our results provide quantitative evidence that guiding-centre drifts alone cannot describe ion energisation in kinetic-scale turbulence and that the dominant energisation term depends on βᵢ. The results also highlight the key role of non-local thermodynamic-equilibrium effects in energy conversion in collisionless plasma turbulence.

articles.title: Operators Reveal Scale-Dependent Limits on Recovering Greenland Ice Loss from Sea Level Fingerprints
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23748v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sea level fingerprints connect the spatial distribution of rapid ice mass change to sea surface height (SSH) change, but the spatial resolving power of this inverse problem remains poorly quantified. Here we provide the first systematic, scale-resolved quantification of Greenland Ice Sheet mass change structure recoverable from its SSH fingerprint when ice loss geometry varies. We develop a physics-informed neural operator, constrained by an accurate neural-operator emulator of the forward sea level equation, to probe the information content of this ill-conditioned inverse problem. Across synthetic ice change ensembles, broad ice loss patterns can be recovered, but distinct ice fields can produce nearly identical fingerprints, so fine-scale structure depends on the assumed a-priori ice change distribution. Inversion fidelity varies with the wavelength and amplitude of ice mass change. An empirical error law separates these effects and defines a scale-dependent accuracy ceiling. For a satellite-altimetry-derived reference field, the estimated fingerprint-only ceiling is R²sim0.79 under the present SSH observation geometry and matched-prior assumption. The leading three principal components explain 99.76% of fingerprint variance, yet higher-order components retain information needed to distinguish finer ice change structure. SSH observations near Greenland carry most information on ice loss locations. Applying the leading fingerprint principal components to the observed 1993--2019 SSH rate recovers the large-scale Greenland fingerprint, while the residual field is correlated with basin-scale bathymetry, consistent with unresolved sterodynamic variability. These results establish a quantitative empirical bound on fingerprint-only ice-loss resolving power and identify how independent observations and ice sheet constraints can improve inference.

articles.title: ModeCast: One-Shot Prediction of Linear MHD Eigenmodes and Growth Rates in Tokamaks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-scale magnetohydrodynamic instabilities break plasma confinement, can trigger disruptions, and constrain fusion reactor design; modeling a single configuration against them takes hours with a reference solver such as JOREK, and a design study requires thousands of hours. ModeCast is the first learned surrogate to return the complete linear stability assessment for MHD modes. Trained on a comprehensive dataset of over 45,000 JOREK simulations across thousands of equilibria, it screens stability across toroidal mode numbers n=1-4 and predicts the full spatial structure and growth rate of unstable modes. Excluding the equilibrium solve, inference on a single GPU is over 10,000x faster than multi-core JOREK linear stability runs. The gain comes from building the linear-phase physics into the formulation, objective, and inputs, yielding up to six times more training data. ModeCast misses none of the unstable held-out cases, and its predicted fields reproduce the simulation's measured physics, from magnetic island topology to resistivity trends. On a fixed-geometry resistivity scan outside its training distribution, refitting only the 22k-parameter growth rate head of the 145M-parameter network on four simulation halves the held-out internal kink growth rate error, and fine-tuning the whole network adds little. Because it is differentiable and returns full fields, ModeCast could in the future assimilate experimental measurements, providing a bridge to real devices and accelerating progress toward commercial fusion. Project page: zenithon.ai/research/modecast.

articles.title: Sparking Dynamic, Relativistic Magnetic Reconnection in a Twisted Flux Tube
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22653v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic reconnection around neutron stars (NSs) forms small-scale currents while transferring energy to electron-positron pairs. These dissipating currents cover a wide range of scales, potentially leaving an imprint on time-variable X-ray bursts and pulsed radio emission. We present a reduced, planar model of internal reconnection in a magnetic flux tube with relativistic magnetization, finite resistivity, and strong guide field. Comparing with realistic NS parameters, this model represents the dynamics of a slender magnetic flux tube that is much thinner than the stellar radius. The seed current profile is smooth and does not spontaneously reconnect; instead, a discrete and localized current perturbation is introduced, representing e.g. localized energy release from a NS crust or magnetosphere. Three high-resolution relativistic magnetohydrodynamics simulations are described: one has uniform resistivity and Lundquist number such that reconnection proceeds in the plasmoid-mediated regime; the other two account for the feedback of charge starvation on the resistivity in current layers, where density is depleted; we provide a more general explanation for this depletion. All simulations produce a few dominant magnetic X-points and a secondary Kelvin-Helmholtz instability that excites high-wavenumber currents. We quantify the reconnection rate, the intermittency of dissipation, and the time profile of current spikes. We further present three-dimensional simulations confirming a limited growth of the ideal kink mode in the strong guide field regime. Applications are discussed, including to radio pulse microstructure and current damping below the magnetar surface during an X-ray flare, leading to mass loss and X-ray afterglow.

articles.title: Quantum Circuits for Variable-Coefficient Vlasov Dynamics via Schrödingerisation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23405v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-dimensional Vlasov equations present promising use cases for quantum simulation, but their transport coefficients must be implemented coherently in order to preserve a compact quantum representation. We develop explicit Schrödingerised circuits for prescribed external field Vlasov dynamics without classical field updates. In 1D1V, velocity-dependent streaming is compiled directly from the encoded velocity register, while a non-linear cubic field is evaluated using reversible fixed-point arithmetic. For fixed polynomial degree, the field workspace scales linearly with the coordinate register width, while the field evaluation subroutine has polynomial depth. As a proof of concept, we simulate a minimal coupled 3D3V anharmonic Penning system and realise mixed electric-field terms and transverse magnetic coupling on a six-dimensional phase space in agreement with classical calculations. Resource analysis shows approximately linear growth with the number of time steps, while identifying the auxiliary register as the dominant depth bottleneck. Structured preparation and register recovery of the auxiliary state reveal an interplay between loading cost and readout. Together, our algorithm demonstrates a fully coherent quantum simulation of high-dimensional Vlasov dynamics with variable coefficients and identifies the practical resource costs that must be controlled for large-scale quantum implementation.

articles.title: When Magnitude Suffices: Reconstructing Time-Domain-Gated Microwave Signals Without Phase on a Thoracic Phantom
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23608v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Time-domain gating separates the arrivals that form a microwave S-parameter measurement. It requires the measurement of complex values, so this application almost always uses a vector network analyzer (VNA). We show that, on one calibrated measurement configuration, the gated magnitude the VNA would give can be reconstructed from a magnitude-only sweep of a spectrum analyzer with a tracking generator (SA). We select the gate center for separability of the measured states, correct each instrument once by a per-bin subtraction of a reference state, and train a fully connected network on sweeps from both instruments. The test object is a torso phantom with lung-shaped compartments whose filling takes eleven dielectric states, each held out in turn. On S₁₁ the reconstruction from SA input reaches a shape error of 0.08 dB² with a state ordering of 0.81. This matches the reconstruction from VNA input. On S₂₁ it reaches 0.82 dB² and keeps the ordered groups of the states. An explicit phase prediction performs much worse, because gating needs the phase to about 0.2 rad RMS. Across eleven measurement configurations the dependence of phase on magnitude is strong for reflection and weak for transmission. This explains the difference between S₁₁ and S₂₁. Where the magnitude carries enough of the phase, a scalar instrument gives the gated response without any phase measurement after installation. On the open UM-BMID breast data set, with whole phantoms held out, the shape error of the network is 30 percent lower than that of a per-bin linear map.

articles.title: In Situ Three-Dimensional Mapping of Lithiation Heterogeneity in NMC Electrodes using XANES Nanotomography
articles.abstract: arXiv:2307.08871v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spatial heterogeneity in lithiation complicates the interpretation of electrode-averaged electrochemical measurements and the assessment of local active-material utilization. Here, we use three-energy X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) nanotomography to investigate lithiation distributions in NMC532 composite electrodes with active-material loadings of 3 and 15 mg cm-2. Tomographic acquisitions at 8.30, 8.35, and 8.43 keV combine three-dimensional particle morphology with Ni K-edge chemical sensitivity at a processed voxel size of 210 nm. The normalized absorption contrast serves as a relative lithiation indicator, without assigning absolute lithium concentrations. Measurements were performed in situ after 1 h of open-circuit relaxation at selected electrochemical states. In the lower-loading electrode, four successive states during interrupted discharge at 2 mA cm-2 reveal an increasing lithium-rich volume fraction alongside core-shell-like distributions, nonuniform peripheral enrichment, and particle-to-particle variability. In the higher-loading electrode, two regions examined at 50% depth of discharge exhibit different lithiation-sensitive contrast distributions despite sharing the same nominal electrochemical state. These observations document heterogeneity within particles, between particles, and between electrode regions, showing how overall lithiation progression can coexist with spatially nonuniform local states. Three-energy XANES nanotomography thus provides a means of examining lithiation heterogeneity in dense composite electrodes with limited spectral sampling. Correlative phase-contrast imaging could further relate these distributions to the arrangement of the carbon-binder domain and pore network.

articles.title: Theoretical studies of envelope oscillations and instabilities of mismatched intense charged-particle beams in periodic focusing channels
articles.abstract: arXiv:2401.12171v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The behavior of mismatched intense charged-particle beams in periodic transport channels of the solenoid and quadrupole type is studied theoretically. The envelope-oscillation frequencies of the mismatched beam are obtained by the smooth-approximation method and by numerical evaluation of the linearly perturbed K-V envelope equations. Phase shifts of the envelope oscillations and growth factors per focusing period in the case of instability are calculated for a solenoid and a magnetic quadrupole (FODO) channel using the parameters of the Maryland and GSI beam transport experiments. For comparison and the purpose of illustration, the K-V equations are integrated numerically, and envelope curves as well as single-particle trajectories for mismatched beams are shown in graphical form. In addition, computer simulation studies with the PARMILA code were performed, and results are presented both for K-V and a Gaussian distribution in transverse phase space.~ Published in: Particle~Accelerators~bf 14, 227--260 (1984)}

articles.title: On the stability and emittance growth of different particle phase-space distributions in a long magnetic quadrupole channel
articles.abstract: arXiv:2401.12595v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The behavior of K-V, waterbag, parabolic, conical and Gaussian distributions in periodic quadrupole channels is studied by particle simulations. In the parameter range studied, the response associated with the K-V instabilities becomes progressively less pronounced toward the Gaussian distribution.
