In four post-hoc exact same-parent tests, FULL exceeded coordinate-basis, matched-spectrum, row-shuffled, and wrong-anatomy controls by 9.959, 9.698, 11.241, and 3.985 points, respectively (all 95% CIs excluded zero; Holm-adjusted P<0.001). A separate 60-participant same-paradigm evaluation retained a positive physical-operator contrast (+4.029 points; +2.338 to +5.773), whereas dynamic--static was inconclusive; its preregistered status is partial confirmation rather than unrestricted external validation. The SSM added +1.059 points (+0.013 to +1.892). Claims remain bounded to five binary motor-imagery domains and the tested operators.

articles.title: TriRouter: Sparse-to-Dense Electrode-Space Routing for Robust EEG Motor Imagery Decoding
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces require reliable decoding from multichannel EEG, but practical acquisition often yields sparse or corrupted electrode montages. We propose TriRouter, an electrode-space routing framework with discriminative-preservation, mask-robustness, and latent-compensation paths. A validation-calibrated router uses observable channel availability to allocate path contributions, preserving complete-channel discrimination while increasing representation recovery under severe missingness. In BNCI2014-001, TriRouter outperforms standard public backbones and a dynamic-spatial-filtering corrupted-EEG baseline. It improves accuracy over the strongest corrupted-EEG baseline by 3.68, 4.02, and 6.46 percentage points at nominal 25%, 50%, and 75% missing settings, and remains effective under structured regional missingness and additional low-channel dataset evaluation.

articles.title: Tool Recommendation for Multi-Step Agents: Finding Every Tool a Task Needs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23707v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate. We present Tool Recommendation, a deployed system that gives an agent all of them, hundreds of times more than a typical MCP server exposes, through a fixed interface of three tools. It runs at the gateway between agent and tools, executing every call under the end user's own credentials and checking it against the user's consent for each service and the tools the agent may use. We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost. On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its size. In paired multi-step workflows, its first recommendation covered every required tool in 93% of Codex sessions, and against a fixed list of 100 tools it cut input tokens by 17% with Codex and 40% with Claude Code and the total bill in all 14 runs, by up to 40%, with no change in task completion.

articles.title: Where Prefill Expert Reduction Hurts MoE Models: A Few Prompt Tokens Carry Most of the Short-Answer F1 Loss
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22454v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Running prompt tokens through fewer routed experts during prefill is a simple way to make mixture-of-experts (MoE) serving cheaper, yet it is unclear what this damages. We locate the damage with token-, layer- and attention-path interventions on short-answer question answering in four MoE families. At half the experts the F1 loss of three families is mostly answer form: the model still finds the answer but stops answering briefly. In Qwen3-30B-A3B this loss is made at the two chat-template tokens before the answer, and in DeepSeek-V2-Lite at the first 8-32 prompt tokens, where its instruction sits; by answer likelihood these positions account for about half and a fifth of the damage. Reduction changes the first token's attention mass, norm and largest activation by less than 4%, and restoring super experts or massive activations recovers at most about a quarter of the loss, well below keeping the sensitive positions full. On real prompts with about 4% of tokens at full experts, placing them on the task interface keeps F1 within one point of the unmodified model, while placing them at random in the documents is about 3 points worse (two of five prespecified primary comparisons; the others were undecided or not run). Because the answer boundary always ends a single-turn prompt, and DeepSeek's loss was no longer detectable once its instruction moved away from the start, the sensitive tokens lay at the prompt ends in every sensitive layout we found, so rules that keep the ends are not distinguished from rules that read application marks. Time to first token falls about 14% on 11K-token prompts and not at 2K tokens.

articles.title: Explaining Chess and Go in Natural Language
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23166v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern chess engines play far beyond human ability, often choosing moves whose underlying ideas are difficult for humans to understand. We propose an automatic metric for evaluating chess explanations, grounded in chess-engine evaluations. Evaluating state-of-the-art language models using this metric, we find that they perform surprisingly poorly, often relying on surface-level board observations rather than robust, transferable chess concepts. We then introduce BinProp, a training-free method that enables these same models to discover reusable chess concepts and use them to explain moves in natural language. BinProp improves explainability for every model tested, nearly tripling the average score compared with direct prompting. Beyond chess, the same method discovers useful concepts in Go, draughts, and shogi without additional tuning.

articles.title: Managed stratospheric aerosol injection phaseout under deep carbon removal: cross-model and aerosol-lifetime sensitivity
articles.abstract: Stratospheric aerosol injection (SAI) has been proposed as a temporary complement to mitigation and carbon dioxide removal (CDR), but safe withdrawal depends on how rapidly greenhouse forcing falls and on the dynamics of the aerosol actuator. We execute one prespecified annual feedback controller separately in FaIR 2.2.4 and Hector 3.5.0 under matched future non-CO₂ forcing and a deliberately deep CDR stress-test pathway. In a two-layer energy-balance emulator of the SAI response, we then add a first-order aerosol-forcing reservoir with 0.67, 1.0 and 1.5 year e-folding times, spanning the approximately 8-month to 1.5-year sulfur lifetimes reported across four G6-1.5K-SAI Earth system models. Across 1,500 aerosol-lifetime-by-plant tests, median 2060 temperature is 1.200–1.206°C, no trajectory reaches the 3.5 W m⁻² command ceiling, and none of 1,192 trajectories with complete 20-year post-phaseout windows has a positive temperature trend. Phaseout emerges from the feedback law; a CO₂-indexed command ceiling never binds. FaIR and Hector temperature trajectories remain close while their long-horizon CO₂ endpoints diverge. These results show that, conditional on sustained deep CDR, no complete experiment in the tested reduced-complexity models and forcing-persistence assumptions produced a positive 20-year post-phaseout temperature trend. Regional hydrology, aerosol microphysics, ozone chemistry and governance remain outside the validated scope.

articles.title: Calibration-Free, Nanometer-Scale Single-Molecule Localization with MINFLUX and RASTMIN via Direct Minimum Fitting
articles.abstract: Ultraprecise super-resolution fluorescence microscopy techniques such as MINFLUX and RASTMIN achieve single-digit nanometer-scale localization precision of single molecules by probing them with a minimum of light. Their standard analysis pipelines rely on maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) combined with prior calibration of the excitation profile, imposing significant experimental complexity and sensitivity to imperfections. Here, we introduce a calibration-free localization framework for these methods based on direct fitting of photon-position arrays using physically motivated point spread function models. Through Monte Carlo simulations, we show that direct fitting—particularly with a donut-based model—achieves localization precision approaching the Cramér–Rao lower bound and closely matches MLE performance over a wide range of photon counts. Experimental validation using RASTMIN measurements on single emitters confirms that, at ≥ 1000 detected photons, calibration-free fitting yields localization precision indistinguishable from MLE while maintaining nanometer-scale accuracy. We further demonstrate that incorporating modest model flexibility enables robustness against realistic optical aberrations and accurate reconstruction of spatial patterns. These results establish direct fitting as a simple and robust alternative to calibration-dependent approaches, providing a more practical route toward high-precision photon-efficient single-molecule localization using minima of light.

articles.title: Indoor Air Quality and Thermal Environment Across Three Leather Footwear Facilities in Agra India
articles.abstract: Field evidence on indoor air quality and thermal environment from small-scale Indian manufacturing remains scarce, particularly for leather footwear. We monitored particulate matter, carbon dioxide (CO2), formaldehyde, volatile organic compounds, temperature, humidity, and air velocity across three leather footwear facilities of differing scale and ventilation in Agra, India, over 27 months (608 sessions). Two-way ANOVA (facility by season) showed between-facility differences dominated variance for every parameter (partial eta-squared 0.10–0.87); mean PM2.5, CO2, formaldehyde and volatile organics were 2.0-, 1.9-, 3.0- and 3.5-fold higher in the cottage than organized facility. Season dominated particulate matter and thermal variables but not gas-phase pollutants, tracking ventilation rather than climate. Indoor/outdoor PM2.5 ratios rose from 0.48 to 1.00 across facilities, and CO2 exceeded the ASHRAE ventilation threshold in 99.5% of cottage sessions versus 0% in the organized facility. As one facility represents each tier, these associations are hypothesis-generating, not evidence of a general scale effect.

articles.title: Plasma-Activated Water and Oregano Essential Oil Nanoliposomes Integrated into a Hydroxyethyl Cellulose Coating for Microbial Control of Seafood
articles.abstract: Plasma-activated water (PAW) is a promising non-thermal antimicrobial system for food preservation, but the limited persistence of reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (RONS) can restrict its prolonged activity on food surfaces. This study developed a hydroxyethyl cellulose (HEC)-based active coating integrating PAW-derived RONS with oregano essential oil nanoliposomes (OEONL) for microbial control of seafood. Among the tested HEC concentrations, 3% (w/v) provided the most favorable balance of water uptake, water retention, and RONS persistence. OEONL exhibited a mean particle size of 102.31 ± 1.46 nm and an encapsulation efficiency of 79.31 ± 2.86%. Nanoliposomal incorporation produced a more homogeneous coating microstructure while largely preserving the principal chemical features of HEC. Incorporation of OEONL also enhanced DPPH radical-scavenging activity in a sample-mass- and extraction-time-dependent manner. In seafood challenge tests, the PAH-OEONL coating suppressed total viable counts (TVC), Vibrio parahaemolyticus, and Salmonella in shrimp meat and golden pompano fillets at both 4 and 25°C. At 4°C, it delayed TVC from reaching 7 log CFU/g from approximately day 6 to day 16 in shrimp meat and from day 4 to day 14 in golden pompano fillets, representing a delay of approximately 10 days relative to uncoated controls. Antimicrobial activity also remained evident at 25°C. These findings demonstrate that combining PAW-derived reactive species with nanoliposome-delivered OEO provides a promising active-coating strategy for microbial control of seafood under different storage temperatures.

articles.title: Baseline radiological assessment of soils in an active limestone mining environment in Ibese southwestern Nigeria
articles.abstract: Industrial limestone mining can alter the natural distribution of naturally occurring radioactive materials (NORM) through excavation, blasting, crushing, and dust generation, making baseline radiological characterization essential for environmental surveillance and occupational radiation protection. However, baseline radiological data for active limestone mining environments in Nigeria remain limited. This study established the baseline radiological characteristics of surface soils from the Ibese limestone mining area, Ogun State, southwestern Nigeria. Thirty surface soil samples were systematically collected from active quarry sites, transition zones, and neighbouring residential areas. Samples were prepared following International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) protocols and analysed for ⁴⁰K, ²³⁸U, and ²³²Th activity concentrations using NaI(Tl) gamma-ray spectrometry. Radiological hazard parameters, including Raeq, Hex, Hin, absorbed dose rate, AEDE, ELCR, AGED, and Iγ, were evaluated. Mean activity concentrations of ⁴⁰K, ²³⁸U, and ²³²Th were 485.47 ± 195.75, 11.07 ± 8.11, and 19.37 ± 9.85 Bq kg⁻¹, respectively. While ⁴⁰K exceeded the global average reported by UNSCEAR, ²³⁸U and ²³²Th were below worldwide reference values. The mean values of Raeq (76.14 Bq kg⁻¹), Hex (0.206), Hin (0.236), absorbed dose rate (37.05 nGy h⁻¹), AEDE (0.045 mSv y⁻¹), and Iγ (0.591) were all below internationally recommended limits, indicating negligible radiological risk. Correlation analysis identified ²³²Th as the principal contributor to absorbed dose rate and most radiological hazard indices, whereas ⁴⁰K predominantly influenced AGED variability. Overall, the Ibese limestone mining environment presents no immediate radiological concern for quarry workers or nearby residents. This study provides one of the first baseline radiological datasets for an active industrial limestone mining environment in Nigeria, supporting future environmental monitoring, occupational radiation protection, and NORM management.

articles.title: Heme-oxygenase-1 (HO-1) in CCR2/CCL2/CD200 brain mononuclear cells contribute to neuroinflammation in young adulthood after chorioamnionitis
articles.abstract: Chemokine receptor 2+ (CCR2+) mediates peripheral mononuclear cell infiltration into the brain via its ligand C motif ligand 2 (CCL2), whereas Immune inhibitory ligand CD200, suppresses mononuclear cell activation. Whether sustained alterations in CCR2/CCL2/CD200-expressing mononuclear cell populations and their Heme-oxygenase-1 (HO-1) expression contribute to persistent neuroinflammation following perinatal chorioamnionitis (CHORIO) remains unknown. We hypothesized that HO-1 expression within CCR2/CCL2/CD200 mononuclear cell subsets is altered in adulthood following perinatal CHORIO compared with sham controls. Brains were collected at postnatal day (P) 21 and P60 (n = 6–8/group), dissociated and surface and intracellular markers used to identify inflammatory and oxidative mononuclear cell subsets with flow cytometry. At P60, CHORIO brains exhibited fewer CCR2+CD11bcL/INT cells (p = 0.008), increased intracellular HO-1 expression, (p = 0.01) and a reciprocal increase in CCR2-CD11bcL/INT cells (p = 0.008). In addition, CCL2+/CCR2+CD11bcL/INT (p = 0.04) and CD200+/CCR2+CD11bcL/INT (p = 0.005) ratios were also increased in CHORIO. HO-1 expression in CCR2+CD11bcL/INT cells was lower at P21 than at P60, suggesting an age-dependent phenotypic shift after CHORIO. Here we demonstrate that alterations in CCR2/CCL2/CD200 signaling and HO-1 expression in adult brain mononuclear cells following perinatal CHORIO are sustained, suggesting long-term inflammatory and oxidative immune signaling that may contribute to chronic neuroinflammation.

articles.title: Estimating Evapotranspiration Using the SEBAL Model and Remote Sensing: Spatiotemporal Dynamics in Quara District, Northwest Ethiopia
articles.abstract: Evapotranspiration (ET) is a fundamental component of the hydrological cycle that simultaneously integrates interactions between land surface, vegetation, and atmospheric systems through the combined processes of evaporation and transpiration. This is especially critical in arid and semi-arid regions such as Quara District in northwest Ethiopia, where water resources are scarce and precise quantification of actual water consumption is essential for sustainable water management. This study applies the Surface Energy Balance Algorithm for Land (SEBAL) model using Landsat-8 OLI/TIRS remote sensing imagery acquired during the dry season of 2020 (January, February, March, and April) to estimate actual evapotranspiration (ET) across the Quara District. The SEBAL model computes ET as a residual of the surface energy balance equation, requiring estimation of net radiation (Rₙ), soil heat flux (G₀), and sensible heat flux (H). The results reveal ET₂₄ values ranging from 0.68 mm/day to 9.63 mm/day across the four acquisition dates, with pronounced spatial and temporal variability driven by differences in land cover type, soil moisture, and vegetation density. The methodology demonstrates that satellite-based energy balance models offer a robust, spatially explicit alternative to traditional ground-based methods for ET estimation in data-scarce environments. The findings underscore the value of integrating remote sensing and GIS techniques for operational water resources management in semi-arid landscapes.

articles.title: A receptor and chaperone that influences lung MAIT cell number, function, and lung inflammation
articles.abstract: Innate-like T cells are tissue-resident lymphocytes, but the factors that govern their localization to specific tissues, at steady state or after infections, are not well defined.  Mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells are an innate-like T cell population that is relatively frequent in the lungs of mice and humans.  Receptor activity-modifying protein 3 (RAMP3) is a member of a family of three proteins that modulate the expression and function of several GPCRs, including those involved in immune responses.  Despite this, the role of RAMP3 in T cell immunity has not been widely explored. We found that Ramp3–/– mice had increased lung MAIT cells at steady-state or after infection, while other T cell populations were less affected. Ramp3–/– mice had increased surface CXCR6 expression, and RAMP3 overexpression reduced CXCR6. CXCR6 was required for the dramatic increase in lung MAIT cells after infection. These data suggest that RAMP3 negatively regulated CXCR6 and limited lung MAIT cell numbers. This has important consequences, because infected Ramp3–/– mice had increased IL-17A-secreting lung MAIT cells, but were more susceptible to pulmonary infection, with reduced bacterial clearance, increased cellular infiltration, and immunopathology.  The increase in lung MAIT cells after infection occurred predominantly from cells located in the tissue, but in Ramp3–/– mice there was evidence for some recruitment to the lung. We have established that RAMP3 is a negative regulator of excessive lung MAIT cell responses, acting in part through CXCR6.

articles.title: Engine Emission and Noise Reduction Using Organic Waste-based Activated Carbon Filters: A Case Study on Motorcycles
articles.abstract: The increasing number of motorcycles in developing countries such as Indonesia has intensified air and noise pollution, while large quantities of agricultural waste remain underutilized. This study investigates the feasibility of converting agricultural residues into activated carbon filters for simultaneous reduction of motorcycle exhaust emissions and noise. Activated carbon filters were fabricated from three abundant biomass wastes, namely peanut shells, palm fiber, and durian peels, and installed on a 110 cc motorcycle exhaust system. The effects of biomass precursor and chemical activating agents (H₃PO₄, KOH, and NaCl) on carbon monoxide (CO), carbon dioxide (CO₂), hydrocarbon (HC), and exhaust noise were experimentally evaluated under idle operating conditions. The results demonstrate that all biomass-derived activated carbon filters reduced exhaust emissions and noise compared with the unfiltered exhaust. Peanut shell-based activated carbon exhibited the highest performance for reducing CO and HC emissions, whereas durian peel-derived activated carbon achieved the greatest reduction in CO₂ emissions. Among the investigated activating agents, KOH produced the highest adsorption performance owing to its ability to generate a more developed porous carbon structure. In addition, palm fiber-based activated carbon provided the greatest reduction in exhaust noise due to its porous acoustic-damping properties. These findings demonstrate that agricultural waste-derived activated carbon can serve as a low-cost and environmentally sustainable alternative for simultaneous exhaust emission control and noise attenuation, while promoting the valorization of agricultural residues within a circular economy framework.

articles.title: Recovering What Breaks in a Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulation of a Lattice Gauge Theory
articles.abstract: A recent trapped-ion experiment realised a lattice gauge theory with the gauge field in the internal states of the ions and bosonic matter in their vibrations. We showed earlier that its noise damage can be predicted. Here, we show that most of it can be undone. The conservation law of the theory is a parity of each vibrational mode, which heating flips, so a heating event leaves a mark that can be read without disturbing the physics. We keep only the runs in which this mark never changed. With equal heating rates and continuous monitoring, the kept runs reproduce the heating-free dynamics exactly, with a closed-form yield. Reading the mark at finite intervals introduces a small bias linear in the interval, which we derive and bound. At the reported rates, a single final check removes most of the heating and preparation damage while accepting eight runs out of ten.

articles.title: Experimental and Regression Analysis of Prism and Reflector- Less Edm Measurements Under Variable Field Conditions Using Leica TS16p1R500 Total Station
articles.abstract: Electronic Distance Measurement (EDM) is widely applied to carry out topographic surveys and study landforms, land use, river geomorphic change detection, construction layout, dynamic bridge deformations, and documenting the culture heritage. In order to ensure the results of surveying according to the requirements of a particular project, it is important to know the reliability and accuracy of surveying instruments. The achievable accuracy will depend on the instrument used, atmospheric conditions in the line of measurement, and the target employed. In this study, an analysis of prism and reflector-less EDM measurement data based on statistics through a regression approach has been conducted using a Leica TS16 robotic total station. The experimental investigation considered multiple influencing parameters, including prism type, target material, target color, incidence angle, and weather conditions. Statistical analysis was performed using mean error, root mean square error, and regression-based error modeling to examine the relationship between measurement error and observation distance. The results demonstrate that prism-based measurements provide superior accuracy, exceeding reflector-less measurements by approximately 21.77%, particularly at longer distances. Circular prisms exhibited the highest precision, with errors remaining within the millimeter level, while reflector-less measurements showed increased sensitivity to surface properties, incidence angle, and atmospheric variations. Results from regression analysis indicated that prism readings showed consistency with the specified accuracy from the manufacturer across the range of interest, while the reflector-less method displayed increasing discrepancies, especially when atmospheric and geometrical conditions were poor.

articles.title: Ca-Doped BaCeO₃ Nanoperovskites for Enhanced Photocatalytic Degradation and Electrochemical Detection of Trimethoprim
articles.abstract: Calcium-doped barium cerate (Ca–BaCeO₃) nanoperovskites were synthesized via a facile sol–gel method and investigated as dual-functional materials for environmental and electrochemical applications. The synthesized nanoparticles exhibited a direct optical band-gap of 2.1 eV, indicating their suitability for visible-light-driven applications. Photocatalytic activity was evaluated for the degradation of trimethoprim (TMP) under sunlight irradiation, achieving approximately 96% degradation under optimized conditions of 0.7 g L⁻¹ catalyst dosage, 35 ppm TMP concentration, pH 7, and 40 °C. The enhanced photocatalytic performance was attributed to improved charge separation and reduced electron–hole recombination resulting from Ca doping. Electrochemical sensing of TMP was investigated using cyclic voltammetry, where the modified electrode exhibited a linear response with a sensitivity of 0.5 mA µM⁻¹ cm⁻². The limit of detection (LOD) and limit of quantification (LOQ) were determined to be 0.03 µM and 0.09 µM, respectively, demonstrating reliable sensing performance. The combined photocatalytic and electrochemical performances demonstrate that Ca–BaCeO₃ nanoperovskites are promising dual-functional materials for pharmaceutical pollutant remediation and pharmaceutical sensing applications.

articles.title: Multiscale autoregressive modeling generates ordered protein conformational trajectories
articles.abstract: Protein function depends on transitions among conformational states, but generating long, ordered structural sequences by molecular dynamics (MD) remains computationally expensive at the scale of large protein panels. Many generative approaches emphasize conformational ensembles, whereas sequential trajectory generators must also control error accumulation over long rollouts. We present TEMPO, a hierarchical autoregressive model trained on MD trajectories to generate ordered protein-backbone conformations at two temporal resolutions. A slow-scale model advances anchor conformations at the 20-ns sampling stride used for training, and a fast-scale model generates 1-ns-spaced frames conditioned on the slow-scale context. On held-out mdCATH and ATLAS proteins, TEMPO reproduced MD-derived ensemble observables. On ATLAS, Pearson correlations were 0.91 for ensemble-averaged pairwise RMSD and 0.89 for residue-level RMSF; the leading principal-component direction agreed with MD in 76% of cases, compared with 44% for AlphaFlow. Relative to a single-scale autoregressive model, the hierarchy reduced long-horizon RMSD error from 8.62 to 1.78~Å, and a 400-frame rollout required less than 1 min. Across 10 endpoint-conditioned adenylate kinase rollouts, progression along a shared time-lagged coordinate was accompanied by progressive contact exchange during opening. Inference-time steering yielded conformations satisfying predefined DFG-in- and DFG-out-like local backbone criteria in 68 of 100 kinases. Across 252 kinases, fluctuation profiles showed variable agreement with crystallographic B-factors (mean Spearman ρ=0.358; 22% with ρ≥0.5). TEMPO provides a framework for generating and comparing ordered protein conformational sequences.

articles.title: Variational block-correlated coupled-cluster Monte Carlo
articles.abstract: Motivated by the recent success of quantum neural states, we present a variational implementation of the coupled-cluster method suitable for quantum Monte Carlo simulations. We introduce a Young tableaux representation of the wave-function coefficients and their derivatives that substantially reduces the computational complexity of the variational optimization. While the algorithm is generic, we illustrate its implementation with an application to the Heisenberg model in one and two dimensions, using the block-correlated coupled-cluster Ansatz with doubles and triples. Convergence is greatly improved by means of importance sampling based on a fictitious temperature. The resulting approach achieves competitive accuracy while providing a scalable framework for variational coupled-cluster calculations.

articles.title: Microscopic origin of polytype-dependent melting in SiC revealed by machine-learning molecular dynamics
articles.abstract: Predicting how crystal structure influences high-temperature stability remains a key challenge in materials modeling and design. Silicon carbide (SiC), one of the most thermally and chemically stable materials known, provides an ideal system for studying this problem because its many polytypes preserve similar local tetrahedral bonding while differing in long-range stacking geometry. To determine the impact of polytype structure on the high-temperature stability of SiC, we combine phase-coexistence machine-learning molecular dynamics with finite-temperature phonon analysis, enabled by a fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential that accurately describes crystalline, high-temperature, and disordered configurations across multiple SiC polytypes. We identify a clear stability ordering, 3C > 2H > 9R, reflected consistently in structural disordering, interlayer sliding, and finite-temperature phonon spectra. Across all polytypes, melting initiates through the formation of short C–C contacts and carbon-rich local regions, followed by a progressive loss of tetrahedral Si–C connectivity. The reduced stability of the long-period 9R polytype is associated with a denser manifold of low-frequency transverse-acoustic modes arising from its stacking periodicity and associated zone folding, which broaden and soften further at high temperature. These modes can provide additional low-energy channels for thermally activated lateral bilayer motion, consistent with the larger sliding amplitudes observed in 9R and their positive correlation with local structural disorder.

articles.title: Collective intermolecular Coulombic decay beyond Coulomb
articles.abstract: Intermolecular Coulombic decay (ICD) is a widely spread phenomenon in nature and the laboratory in which the excess energy of a donor is utilized to ionize a nearby acceptor. If the excess energy is insufficiently large to enable ICD, two (or more) donors can collectively transfer their combined excess energy to ionize the acceptor. Experiments show that this collective ICD is, surprisingly, operative in gases. Recently, it has been demonstrated that standard ICD can take place efficiently at large distances between the donors and acceptors due to retardation. Here, we derive the theory of collective ICD including retardation. Quantum electrodynamics perturbation theory is used, and it is shown that the theory can be substantially simplified and the process made more amenable to interpretation by introducing two-body interaction potentials that include retardation. Explicit formulas for the rate of collective ICD are derived and interpreted by expressing the rate in terms of measurable quantities and geometric factors. It is demonstrated that the change in the permanent dipole moments of the species upon excitation is a relevant ingredient in collective ICD.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Quantum simulation of ligand-like molecules through sample-based quantum diagonalization in density matrix embedding framework
articles.abstract: The accurate treatment of electron correlation in extended molecular systems remains computationally challenging using classical electronic structure methods. Hybrid quantum–classical algorithms offer a potential route to overcome these limitations; however, their practical deployment on existing quantum computers requires strategies that both reduce problem size and mitigate hardware noise. In this work, we investigate ground-state energy calculations of ligand-like molecules using Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) within the Density Matrix Embedding Theory (DMET) framework, focusing on low-symmetry systems with diverse bonding motifs that exhibit subsystem-dependent variations in fragment–environment entanglement. These entanglement-based variations directly influence bath orbital construction, impurity sizes, and the structure of the embedded Hamiltonians, posing nontrivial challenges for both embedding and quantum sampling. By combining DMET fragmentation with SQD-based construction of reduced configuration spaces through quantum sampling and iterative configuration recovery, we perform quantum simulations on IBM’s Eagle R3 (ibm_sherbrooke) and IBM’s Heron R3 (ibm_boston) superconducting quantum hardware, thereby showing that the entanglement structure across embedding subsystems plays a central role in determining the efficiency and accuracy of the simulations. Despite these complexities, we show that the DMET-SQD framework yields ground-state energies in strong agreement with DMET-full configuration interaction benchmarks, achieving chemical accuracy (1 kcal/mol) across all systems studied. These results demonstrate that SQD-based quantum simulations can be robustly extended to low-symmetry, chemically realistic, industry relevant molecules and highlight the importance of entanglement-aware embedding strategies for scalable quantum electronic structure calculations.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: A GENERIC-Informed Neural Network for Generative Rheology
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23352v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present GINNGER (GENERIC-Informed Neural Network for GEnerative Rheology), a framework for discovering thermodynamically admissible constitutive equations from microstructural flow data. Unlike existing approaches that learn constitutive operators, GINNGER reformulates constitutive discovery as the learning of the underlying thermodynamic generators from which constitutive equations emerge. Embedding the GENERIC formalism into the learning process restricts the search to constitutive models that satisfy the first and second laws of thermodynamics by construction, eliminating the need to prescribe phenomenological constitutive equations a priori. A second conceptual advance is a spectral formulation of constitutive discovery in the intrinsic eigenspace of the polymer conformation tensor. This provides a kinematics-independent thermodynamic state space in which the thermodynamic generators depend only on the instantaneous microstructural state, while flow kinematics acts solely as an external driver transporting the system through this space. Consequently, data from shear, extensional, and mixed flows contribute to the discovery of a single constitutive model that generalizes across deformation protocols and flow geometries. By learning thermodynamic generators rather than high-dimensional constitutive operators, GINNGER substantially reduces the complexity of the discovery problem while preserving thermodynamic consistency, material objectivity, and physical interpretability by construction. The framework is validated using high-fidelity simulations, accurately reconstructing constitutive behavior and predicting complex flow fields across previously unseen geometries. GINNGER establishes a new paradigm for constitutive discovery by combining generative, spectral, and thermodynamically grounded learning within a unified framework for data-driven modeling of complex fluids.

articles.title: Elucidating the relationship between protein amide I, II, and III bands and secondary structures by localized anharmonic vibrational calculations
articles.abstract: The amide I, II, and III spectra of the insulin dimer and ubiquitin were investigated using our recently developed localized, second-order vibrational quasi-degenerate perturbation theory (VQDPT2) combined with quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics calculations. By averaging over ten snapshots from molecular dynamics trajectories, we confirmed that the computed spectra converged to a sufficient degree. Although the method has intrinsic limitations due to the neglect of vibrational coupling between neighboring amide groups, we found that the method provides a useful basis for spectral analysis of these proteins. The analysis of the averaged amide I, II, and III bands revealed that, for both proteins, the amide II and III peak positions tend to be closely associated with the coil contribution, whereas the origin of the amide I maximum is more protein dependent. The calculated amide I and III frequencies of the coil structures showed good agreement with experimental values. The spectra of each secondary structure were further subdivided according to the type of hydrogen bonding within the secondary structure. For structurally constrained α-helix and β-sheet structures, hydrogen-bond-dependent amide I frequency shifts were found to correlate with changes in the amide dihedral angles (O=C–N–H). Localized VQDPT2 enables direct interpretation of amide band shifts associated with conformational changes and provides a deeper understanding of the structural origin responsible for these band shifts.

articles.title: Sum-frequency order parameter ratio determination for molecules with high-symmetry vibrational modes
articles.abstract: The structure of molecules at surfaces and buried interfaces can be probed by second-order nonlinear optical techniques that derive their response from environments with broken centrosymmetry, thereby simultaneously enhancing the signal from the molecules of interest and suppressing the responses of the adjacent bulk phases. However, even though these methods are surface-sensitive, extracting orientation information has often relied on significant assumptions about the shape of the orientation distribution and the underlying molecular electronic structure. Here, we illustrate that the measurement of the relative magnitude and the phase of tensor elements that govern the vibrational sum frequency response can be used to construct a ratio of order parameters ⟨ P 3 ⟩/⟨ P 1 ⟩. This structural parameter does not require knowledge of the hyperpolarizability or even the hyperpolarizability ratio, thereby dramatically increasing the accuracy of its determination. We then show how this parameter can be used to comment on the most probable distribution of tilt angles. This is demonstrated for para -cyanophenol at three different interfaces.

articles.title: Surface-Normal Electric Spin in Obliquely Excited Parallel-Slit SPP Fields
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.34224v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Handedness-dependent light-matter interactions require control of local electric-field rotation, but generating controlled surface-normal spin textures is difficult under oblique illumination. Here, we show that oblique s-polarized illumination of a periodic array of parallel slits produces spatially alternating surface-normal electric spin, with its period tunable by the incidence angle. We further show that the spin texture changes qualitatively between substrate- and air-side excitation depending on whether the SPP field interferes with the excitation field. Under substrate-side excitation, the spin distribution follows the conventional spin-flow relation, whereas under air-side excitation, interference between the SPP and excitation fields produces a distinct spatial periodicity and allows the spin extrema to coincide with the field-intensity maxima. A simple interference model reproduces these contrasting spin textures.

articles.title: Vitamin E Augments Metformin Efficacy in Reversing Dexamethasone-Induced Glucose Dysregulation, Dyslipidemia, and Oxidative Stress via GLUT-4 Modulation in Mice
articles.abstract: Insulin resistance, characterized by dyslipidemia, hyperglycemia, and oxidative stress, contributes to the development of type 2 diabetes. Micronutrient Vitamin E as an antioxidant along with Metformin can have synergistic effects on improving insulin resistance. The present study aimed to evaluate whether vitamin E enhances the effects of metformin on GLUT-4 expression, dyslipidemia, and oxidative stress in a mouse model of dexamethasone-induced insulin resistance. Experimental animals were divided into five groups: control; Control, D (dexamethasone 1mg/kg intrapriteoinally; IP for 3 weeks), M (metformin 250 mg/kg orally for last 2 weeks of dexamethasone treatment), E, (Vitamin E 250 mg/kg orally for last 2 weeks of dexamethasone treatment), EM (metformin+Vitamin E for last 2 weeks of dexamethasone treatment). At the end of experimental period, oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) is done. Then Blood samples were collected under deep anesthesia to measure glucose, insulin, lipid profile and liver enzymes. Hepatic oxidative stress markers and muscular GLUT4 Protein level were investigated by immunohistochemistry. Findings demonstrated that the EM group indicated significantly superior improvements in hyperglycemia and oral glucose tolerance (OGTT) (P < 0.0001) compared to monotherapy. Furthermore, combined treatment effectively reduced insulin levels and mitigated oxidative stress, evidenced by increased Superoxide Dismutase (SOD) and decreased Malondialdehyde (MDA) markers (P < 0.01). Muscular GLUT-4 protein expression was also markedly enhanced in the EM group (P < 0.001), although no significant differences were noted in lipid profiles between treatment groups. Overall, these findings suggest that vitamin E supplementation effectively potentiates the beneficial impact of metformin on insulin resistance and its associated metabolic disturbances.

articles.abstract: Researchers have developed and demonstrated a new hybrid photonic platform that integrates quantum emitters with photonic devices, providing a way to reliably control the interaction between photons and quantum information carriers. The chip-based platform, which combines gallium phosphide (GaP) with a diamond substrate, could help make quantum networks more practical by providing a way to connect quantum devices over long distances.

articles.title: Correcting AI-generated false criminal allegations: a human-rights framework for remedial closure
articles.title_zh: 纠正人工智能生成的虚假刑事指控：补救性结案的人权框架
articles.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) can fabricate criminal allegations about identifiable people, but the legal difficulty is not confined to correcting the visible output. A false claim may persist in service-side memory, retrieval systems, application programming interface transmissions, risk fields and downstream institutional decisions. Existing scholarship on data rectification, AI supply chains, algorithmic contestability and model correction addresses parts of this problem but does not provide a unified legal test for when distributed remediation is complete. This article develops a propagation-aware standard of remedial closure: a structured test for determining when corrective action has been completed across relevant stages of an AI system. It combines doctrinal analysis of international and regional human-rights law, European Union data-protection law and business-and-human-rights standards with technical literature on memory, retrieval, model editing and unlearning. China’s Personal Information Protection Law is used as a limited comparative portability test, and a publicly documented complaint concerning an AI-generated false criminal allegation provides a case-informed scenario. The framework requires five functions: accessible challenge and reasoned determination; cessation at reasonably identifiable nodes; correction of inaccurate records and reassessment of materially affected decisions where applicable law permits or requires; verifiable implementation; and proportionate non-recurrence safeguards. Responsibility remains actor- and operation-specific, and tracing may cease where further inquiry is objectively impossible or disproportionate considering severity and expected remedial value. Rectification is treated as legally complete only when the responsible actor can provide reasonable, demonstrable assurance that the verified false allegation has been corrected or contained across reasonably identifiable, materially relevant processing nodes within its authority, with applicable downstream effects addressed and residual risks documented.
articles.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（AI）可以捏造有关可识别人员的刑事指控，但法律上的困难并不局限于纠正可见的输出。错误声明可能会持续存在于服务端内存、检索系统、应用程序编程接口传输、风险领域和下游机构决策中。现有的关于数据修正、人工智能供应链、算法可竞争性和模型修正的学术研究解决了这个问题的部分问题，但没有为分布式修复何时完成提供统一的法律测试。本文开发了一种补救性关闭的传播感知标准：一种结构化测试，用于确定人工智能系统的相关阶段的纠正措施何时完成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生成式人工智能（AI）可以捏造有关可识别人员的刑事指控，但法律上的困难并不局限于纠正可见的输出。错误声明可能会持续存在于服务端内存、检索系统、应用程序编程接口传输、风险领域和下游机构决策中。现有的关于数据修正、人工智能供应链、算法可竞争性和模型修正的学术研究解决了这个问题的部分问题，但没有为分布式修复何时完成提供统一的法律测试。本文开发了一种补救性关闭的传播感知标准：一种结构化测试，用于确定人工智能系统的相关阶段的纠正措施何时完成。它将国际和区域人权法、欧盟数据保护法以及商业与人权标准的理论分析与有关记忆、检索、模型编辑和遗忘的技术文献结合起来。中国的《个人信息保护法》被用作有限的可移植性比较测试，一份关于人工智能生成的虚假犯罪指控的公开记录的投诉提供了一个案例场景。该框架需要五个功能：易于接受的挑战和合理的决定；在合理可识别的节点处停止；在适用法律允许或要求的情况下，纠正不准确的记录并重新评估受到重大影响的决定；可验证的实施；以及相应的不再发生保障措施。责任仍然是特定于参与者和操作的，如果考虑到严重性和预期的补救价值，进一步的调查客观上不可能或不成比例，则追踪可能会停止。仅当责任行为者能够提供合理的、可证明的保证，证明已验证的虚假指控已在其权限范围内的合理可识别的、实质性相关的处理节点中得到纠正或包含，并解决了适用的下游影响并记录了残余风险时，纠正才被视为法律上完成的。

articles.title: New high-frequency method boosts 2D material readout for next-gen quantum computers
articles.title_zh: 新的高频方法增强了下一代量子计算机的二维材料读出
articles.abstract: Quantum computers represent a next step in the fast-paced evolution of technology. Using quantum bits (qubits), they have the potential to run certain calculations exponentially faster than conventional computers. However, developing and fine-tuning quantum computers requires an enormous number of repetitive tests. To accelerate quantum technology development, we need a method that can read quantum states at ultrafast speeds.

articles.title: Study on Influence of Reaction time and process environment conditions on Heterogeneous Hydrogenation of HTPB using a Pd-Zr-charcoal catalyst
articles.title_zh: 反应时间和工艺环境条件对Pd-Zr-炭催化剂HTPB多相加氢影响的研究
articles.abstract: This paper outlines the influence of reactor environment conditions in synthesizing hydrogenated HTPB (HHTPB) using Hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene (HTPB) polymer by catalytic hydrogenation method using bi-solvent system using iso-propyl alcohol and toluene as active solvent media. A novel synthesis approach to understand the effect of various reactor environment conditions such as nitrogen gas, H2 gas and hydrogen-air environments to hydrogenate HTPB using a catalyst made up of palladium and zirconium as base metals supported on activated charcoal was demonstrated. Experiments were conducted in a 100 mL Inconel made batch type reactor with a magnetically driven variable speed impeller. Optimization of process time is demonstrated and fixed as 6 h for the study. HTPB and HHTPB polymers were characterized by NMR, FTIR, and chemical analysis. The results showed that the degree of hydrogenation of HTPB is ~ 87.5% which is a waxy solid under hydrogen-air environment conditions for the given reactor volume with the chosen operating conditions. After hydrogenation of HTPB, no significant change in hydroxyl value was noticed, and the HHTPB formed is of vinyl-type functional isomer in H2 environment. A marginal increase in molecular weight was observed after hydrogenation in all cases. HTPB and HHTPB were subjected to TG- DSC studies and it was found that the thermal stability of HHTPB marginally increased.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文概述了反应器环境条件对端羟基聚丁二烯（HTPB）聚合物采用异丙醇和甲苯作为活性溶剂介质的双溶剂体系催化加氢法合成氢化HTPB（HHTPB）的影响。展示了一种新颖的合成方法，以了解各种反应器环境条件（例如氮气、氢气和氢气-空气环境）对使用由钯和锆作为贱金属组成的负载在活性炭上的催化剂氢化 HTPB 的影响。实验在 100 mL Inconel 制造的带有磁力驱动变速叶轮的间歇式反应器中进行。研究中展示了工艺时间的优化并固定为 6 小时。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文概述了反应器环境条件对端羟基聚丁二烯（HTPB）聚合物采用异丙醇和甲苯作为活性溶剂介质的双溶剂体系催化加氢法合成氢化HTPB（HHTPB）的影响。展示了一种新颖的合成方法，以了解各种反应器环境条件（例如氮气、氢气和氢气-空气环境）对使用由钯和锆作为贱金属组成的负载在活性炭上的催化剂氢化 HTPB 的影响。实验在 100 mL Inconel 制造的带有磁力驱动变速叶轮的间歇式反应器中进行。研究中展示了工艺时间的优化并固定为 6 小时。通过 NMR、FTIR 和化学分析对 HTPB 和 HHTPB 聚合物进行了表征。结果表明，在给定的反应器体积和选定的操作条件下，HTPB的加氢度约为87.5%，在氢气-空气环境条件下为蜡状固体。 HTPB加氢后，羟值没有明显变化，在H2环境下形成的HHTPB为乙烯基型功能异构体。在所有情况下，氢化后均观察到分子量略有增加。对 HTPB 和 HHTPB 进行了 TG-DSC 研究，发现 HHTPB 的热稳定性略有增加。

articles.title: Robust Bilayer Electronic Structure and Reduced Magnetic Exchange in La2SmNi2O7
articles.title_zh: La2SmNi2O7 中稳健的双层电子结构和减少的磁交换
articles.abstract: Rare-earth substitution provides an effective route to enhance superconductivity in bilayer nickelates, but its influence on the local electronic structure and magnetic exchange interactions remains unclear. Here we report Ni-L₃-edge resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) measurements on single crystals of La₂SmNi₂O₇, a Sm-substituted bilayer nickelate with enhanced in-plane lattice distortion and a reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. Despite these structural modifications, the local electronic excitations associated with NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer processes occur at essentially the same energies as in La₃Ni₂O₇, including features near 0.3~eV, 1.0~eV, and 1.5~eV. This shows that Sm substitution does not substantially alter the local NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer energy scales of the corner-shared bilayer. In contrast, high-resolution RIXS reveals well-defined spin-wave-like excitations whose band top is reduced by sim7~meV. A bilayer J_c-J₁-J₂ Heisenberg analysis of the spin excitation dispersion indicates an approximately 10% reduction of the effective magnetic exchange scale, which correlates with the reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. The small intrinsic damping of these modes further points to robust local-moment-like spin dynamics in the ambient-pressure parent phase.These results reveal a dichotomy in the response to Sm substitution, with largely preserved local electronic excitation energies but a reduced magnetic exchange scale. They identify the Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni geometry as an important structural parameter influencing magnetism in Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates and provide spectroscopic constraints on microscopic models of high-T_c superconductivity in this family.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土替代提供了增强双层镍酸盐超导性的有效途径，但其对局部电子结构和磁交换相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了 La2SmNi2O7 单晶的 Ni-L₃ 边缘共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 测量，La2SmNi2O7 是一种 Sm 取代的双层镍酸盐，具有增强的面内晶格畸变和减小的层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 键角。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土替代提供了增强双层镍酸盐超导性的有效途径，但其对局部电子结构和磁交换相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了 La2SmNi2O7 单晶的 Ni-L₃ 边缘共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 测量，La2SmNi2O7 是一种 Sm 取代的双层镍酸盐，具有增强的面内晶格畸变和减小的层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 键角。尽管进行了这些结构修改，与 NiO₆ 晶体场和电荷转移过程相关的局域电子激发的能量基本上与 La₃Ni2O₇ 中相同，包括接近 0.3~eV、1.0~eV 和 1.5~eV 的特征。这表明 Sm 取代并没有显着改变局部 NiO6 晶体场和角共享双层的电荷转移能级。相比之下，高分辨率 RIXS 揭示了定义明确的类自旋波激发，其带顶降低了 sim7~meV。自旋激发色散的双层 J_c-J1-J2 海森堡分析表明有效磁交换规模减少了约 10%，这与层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP-Ni 键角的减小相关。这些模式的小固有阻尼进一步表明环境压力母相中具有强大的类局部矩自旋动力学。这些结果揭示了对 Sm 替代的响应的二分性，局部电子激发能大部分保留，但磁交换规模减小。他们将 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 几何形状确定为影响 Ruddlesden-Popper 镍酸盐磁性的重要结构参数，并为该族高温超导微观模型提供了光谱约束。

articles.title: Composition-structure-property relationships in thermally evaporated ZnS thin films and Ag/n-ZnS/FTO Schottky barrier diodes
articles.title_zh: 热蒸发 ZnS 薄膜和 Ag/n-ZnS/FTO 肖特基势垒二极管的成分-结构-性能关系
articles.abstract: Nanostructured zinc sulphide (ZnS) thin films were deposited by thermal evaporation under high-vacuum conditions. We systematically investigated how film thickness and substrate temperature affect their structural, optical, and electrical properties. EDS and XPS analyses confirmed a near-stoichiometric to slightly Zn-rich composition, with Zn2+ and S2- as the predominant chemical states. Variations in Zn/S stoichiometry correlated with changes in the structural, optical, photoluminescence, and electrical properties of the ZnS films. X-ray diffraction confirmed the formation of cubic ZnS layers with a pronounced (111) preferred orientation and a lattice parameter of 5.396 Å. The 300 nm films deposited at 323 K exhibited a mean crystallite size of ~ 25 nm, microstrain of 1.45 × 10− 3, and dislocation density of 1.61 × 1015 m-2. The optimized film exhibited n-type conductivity with a mobility of 49.3 cm2 V-1 s-1, a resistivity of 2.35 × 10− 2 Ω cm, and a carrier concentration of 5.38 × 1018 cm-3. The films showed visible-region transparency up to 92%, direct bandgaps of 3.40–3.50 eV, and an absorption coefficient > 1 × 104 cm-1. Ag/n-ZnS/FTO Schottky diodes exhibited rectifying characteristics, yielding barrier heights of 0.67 and 0.72 eV from I-V and C-V measurements, respectively, an ideality factor of 1.03, and a rectification ratio of 5.95. These findings support the potential of grown ZnS thin films as window/buffer layers in photovoltaic cells and in Schottky-barrier electronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 在高真空条件下通过热蒸发沉积纳米结构硫化锌（ZnS）薄膜。我们系统地研究了薄膜厚度和基底温度如何影响其结构、光学和电学性能。 EDS 和 XPS 分析证实了接近化学计量至微富锌的成分，其中 Zn2+ 和 S2- 为主要化学状态。 Zn/S 化学计量的变化与 ZnS 薄膜的结构、光学、光致发光和电学性质的变化相关。 X 射线衍射证实了立方 ZnS 层的形成，具有明显的 (111) 择优取向和 5.396 Å 的晶格参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在高真空条件下通过热蒸发沉积纳米结构硫化锌（ZnS）薄膜。我们系统地研究了薄膜厚度和基底温度如何影响其结构、光学和电学性能。 EDS 和 XPS 分析证实了接近化学计量至微富锌的成分，其中 Zn2+ 和 S2- 为主要化学状态。 Zn/S 化学计量的变化与 ZnS 薄膜的结构、光学、光致发光和电学性质的变化相关。 X 射线衍射证实了立方 ZnS 层的形成，具有明显的 (111) 择优取向和 5.396 Å 的晶格参数。在 323 K 下沉积的 300 nm 薄膜的平均晶粒尺寸为 ~ 25 nm，微应变为 1.45 × 10− 3，位错密度为 1.61 × 1015 m-2。优化后的薄膜表现出n型导电性，迁移率为49.3 cm2 V-1 s-1，电阻率为2.35 × 10− 2 Ω cm，载流子浓度为5.38 × 1018 cm-3。该薄膜的可见光区透明度高达 92%，直接带隙为 3.40–3.50 eV，吸收系数 > 1 × 104 cm-1。 Ag/n-ZnS/FTO 肖特基二极管表现出整流特性，I-V 和 C-V 测量的势垒高度分别为 0.67 和 0.72 eV，理想因子为 1.03，整流比为 5.95。这些发现支持生长的 ZnS 薄膜作为光伏电池和肖特基势垒电子应用中的窗口/缓冲层的潜力。

articles.title: Achieving simultaneous flame retardancy and mechanical reinforcement in PLA via PAPP/La 2 O 3 synergistic catalysis and uniaxial pre-stretching
articles.title_zh: 通过PAPP/La 2 O 3 协同催化和单轴预拉伸同时实现PLA的阻燃和机械增强
articles.abstract: Polylactic acid (PLA) is a promising bioplastic but its high flammability and poor toughness severely restrict its practical applications. Herein, we report a dual-strategy to simultaneously address these limitations by combining piperazine pyrophosphate (PAPP)/nano-La2O3 synergistic flame-retardant system with uniaxial pre-stretching post-treatment. Compared with pure PLA, the PLA composite containing 13 wt% PAPP and 2 wt% nano-La2O3 demonstrated the optimal performance, with an increase in LOI from 19.8% to 34.6% and achieving a UL‑94 V‑0 rating. Cone calorimetry revealed significant reductions in total heat release (from 79.6 to 27.8 MJ/m2) and peak heat release rate (from 368.0 to 185.6 kW/m2). Comprehensive char residue analyses (SEM, EDS, FTIR, Raman, XPS) confirmed that nano-La2O3 catalyzed the formation of a dense, highly graphitized carbon layer, effectively suppressing heat and mass transfer in the condensed phase, while gas-phase radical scavenging (PO·, PO₂·, HPO·) further interrupted combustion. Remarkably, uniaxial pre-stretching at 60°C transformed the brittle composites into ductile materials: the tensile strength of PLA/13%PAPP/2%La2O3 composite increased from 53.8 MPa to 67.4 MPa, and elongation at break dramatically increased from 4.8% to 84.5% (an 18-fold improvement). This work provides a feasible and effective strategy for developing high-performance flame-retardant PLA material with balanced fire safety and mechanical properties, offering great potential for packaging, electronics, and transportation applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚乳酸（PLA）是一种很有前景的生物塑料，但其高可燃性和较差的韧性严重限制了其实际应用。在此，我们报告了一种双策略，通过将焦磷酸哌嗪（PAPP）/纳米La2O3协同阻燃系统与单轴预拉伸后处理相结合来同时解决这些限制。与纯 PLA 相比，含有 13 wt% PAPP 和 2 wt% 纳米 La2O3 的 PLA 复合材料表现出最佳性能，LOI 从 19.8% 增加到 34.6%，并达到 UL-94 V-0 等级。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚乳酸（PLA）是一种很有前景的生物塑料，但其高可燃性和较差的韧性严重限制了其实际应用。在此，我们报告了一种双策略，通过将焦磷酸哌嗪（PAPP）/纳米La2O3协同阻燃系统与单轴预拉伸后处理相结合来同时解决这些限制。与纯 PLA 相比，含有 13 wt% PAPP 和 2 wt% 纳米 La2O3 的 PLA 复合材料表现出最佳性能，LOI 从 19.8% 增加到 34.6%，并达到 UL-94 V-0 等级。锥形量热法显示总热量释放（从 79.6 至 27.8 MJ/m2）和峰值热量释放率（从 368.0 至 185.6 kW/m2）显着降低。综合残炭分析（SEM、EDS、FTIR、拉曼、XPS）证实，纳米La2O3催化形成致密、高度石墨化的碳层，有效抑制凝聚相中的传热和传质，而气相自由基清除（PO·、PO2·、HPO·）进一步中断燃烧。值得注意的是，60°C 下的单轴预拉伸将脆性复合材料转变为韧性材料：PLA/13%PAPP/2%La2O3 复合材料的拉伸强度从 53.8 MPa 增加到 67.4 MPa，断裂伸长率从 4.8% 急剧增加到 84.5%（提高了 18 倍）。这项工作为开发具有平衡的防火安全和机械性能的高性能阻燃PLA材料提供了可行且有效的策略，为包装、电子和运输应用提供了巨大的潜力。

articles.title: Integrating GIS and machine learning for pollution vulnerability mapping in South Africa’s Kruger National Park
articles.title_zh: 集成 GIS 和机器学习来绘制南非克鲁格国家公园的污染脆弱性地图
articles.abstract: Pollution in protected areas can affect ecosystem integrity, biodiversity conservation, and the long-term sustainability of natural resource management. This study developed an integrated GIS and machine learning framework to assess and map pollution vulnerability in South Africa’s Kruger National Park (KNP). Environmental and atmospheric variables, including the Normalised Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), nitrogen dioxide (NO₂), sulphur dioxide (SO₂), carbon monoxide (CO), methane (CH₄), particulate matter (PM₂.₅), rainfall, and temperature, were integrated within Google Earth Engine and Python-based analytical environments. Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) algorithms were applied to classify spatial patterns of pollution vulnerability and identify the variables contributing most strongly to the observed patterns. The results showed that GBM achieved an overall classification accuracy of 0.76, while RF produced an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.96 and SVM achieved an AUC of 0.90. SO₂ and NO₂ were among the most influential variables in the modelling framework, indicating the importance of atmospheric pollution indicators in explaining spatial variations in vulnerability. The resulting vulnerability maps identified areas with moderate to high pollution vulnerability that can support targeted environmental monitoring and conservation planning. By integrating remote sensing, GIS, and machine learning, the study provides a spatial decision-support framework for sustainable environmental management in a large, protected area. The findings contribute particularly to Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 15 (Life on Land) through improved protection and management of terrestrial ecosystems, while also supporting SDG 13 (Climate Action) through climate-sensitive environmental planning and contributing to SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being) through improved management of environmental pollution.
articles.abstract_zh: 保护区的污染会影响生态系统的完整性、生物多样性的保护以及自然资源管理的长期可持续性。本研究开发了一个集成的 GIS 和机器学习框架，用于评估和绘制南非克鲁格国家公园 (KNP) 的污染脆弱性。环境和大气变量，包括归一化植被指数 (NDVI)、二氧化氮 (NO2)、二氧化硫 (SO2)、一氧化碳 (CO)、甲烷 (CH4)、颗粒物 (PM2.5)、降雨量和温度，均集成在 Google Earth Engine 和基于 Python 的分析环境中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 保护区的污染会影响生态系统的完整性、生物多样性的保护以及自然资源管理的长期可持续性。本研究开发了一个集成的 GIS 和机器学习框架，用于评估和绘制南非克鲁格国家公园 (KNP) 的污染脆弱性。环境和大气变量，包括归一化植被指数 (NDVI)、二氧化氮 (NO2)、二氧化硫 (SO2)、一氧化碳 (CO)、甲烷 (CH4)、颗粒物 (PM2.5)、降雨量和温度，均集成在 Google Earth Engine 和基于 Python 的分析环境中。应用随机森林 (RF)、支持向量机 (SVM) 和梯度提升机 (GBM) 算法对污染脆弱性的空间模式进行分类，并识别对观察到的模式影响最大的变量。结果表明，GBM 的总体分类精度为 0.76，而 RF 的曲线下面积 (AUC) 为 0.96，SVM 的 AUC 为 0.90。 SO2 和 NO2 是建模框架中最具影响力的变量之一，表明大气污染指标在解释脆弱性空间变化方面的重要性。由此产生的脆弱性地图确定了具有中度至高度污染脆弱性的区域，可以支持有针对性的环境监测和保护规划。通过整合遥感、GIS 和机器学习，该研究为大型保护区的可持续环境管理提供了空间决策支持框架。研究结果特别有助于通过改善陆地生态系统的保护和管理实现可持续发展目标 (SDG) 15（陆地生命），同时还通过气候敏感的环境规划支持 SDG 13（气候行动），并通过改善环境污染管理为 SDG 3（良好健康和福祉）做出贡献。

articles.abstract: For the first time, scientists have achieved strong coupling between light and long-lived acoustic vibrations in an optical fiber. Optical fibers are used in both classical telecommunications and quantum communication and could serve not only as connections between computing nodes but also as quantum processors themselves in the future. The results, published in Nature Physics, pave the way for new technologies in quantum signal processing.

articles.title: Hybridization–Ionicity Mapping for Descriptor-Guided Design of Amorphous Ge–Sb–Se Selector-Only Memory
articles.title_zh: 用于非晶 Ge-Sb-Se 仅选择器存储器描述符引导设计的杂交离子度映射
articles.abstract: Quantitative relationships among composition, bonding, and functional properties are essential for the rational design of amorphous chalcogenides. Here, we examine whether hybridization and ionicity, established composition-derived bonding descriptors, can guide selector-only memory (SOM) design. Mapping of reported SOM compositions reveals systematic correlations with the read-window margin (RWM) and identifies a favorable region for threshold-state differentiation. Guided by these trends, amorphous Ge–Sb–Se compositions with increasing Sb content were fabricated and evaluated, and all exhibited programmable SOM behavior with nonmonotonic electrical and reliability trends. Up to an intermediate Sb content, higher ionicity within an appropriate hybridization range increased polar heteropolar bonding, enlarged trap-energy separation and RWM, and improved threshold-voltage stability and endurance. Further Sb incorporation increased hybridization beyond the favorable range and promoted Sb–Sb-rich homopolar bonding, reducing trap-state differentiation and memory performance. X-ray photoelectron and Raman spectroscopy confirmed the corresponding bonding evolution, while temperature-dependent transport analyses linked these changes to trap energetics. These results establish a composition–bonding–trap–property relationship and show that hybridization–ionicity mapping can narrow candidate compositions before extensive fabrication and characterization.
articles.abstract_zh: 组成、键合和功能特性之间的定量关系对于非晶硫属化物的合理设计至关重要。在这里，我们研究了杂交和离子性以及已建立的成分衍生键合描述符是否可以指导纯选择器记忆（SOM）设计。所报道的 SOM 成分的映射揭示了与读取窗口边缘 (RWM) 的系统相关性，并确定了阈值状态分化的有利区域。在这些趋势的指导下，制备并评估了 Sb 含量增加的非晶 Ge-Sb-Se 组合物，并且所有组合物均表现出具有非单调电气和可靠性趋势的可编程 SOM 行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 组成、键合和功能特性之间的定量关系对于非晶硫属化物的合理设计至关重要。在这里，我们研究了杂交和离子性以及已建立的成分衍生键合描述符是否可以指导纯选择器记忆（SOM）设计。所报道的 SOM 成分的映射揭示了与读取窗口边缘 (RWM) 的系统相关性，并确定了阈值状态分化的有利区域。在这些趋势的指导下，制备并评估了 Sb 含量增加的非晶 Ge-Sb-Se 组合物，并且所有组合物均表现出具有非单调电气和可靠性趋势的可编程 SOM 行为。直到中间的 Sb 含量，在适当的杂化范围内较高的离子度增加了极性异极键合，扩大了陷阱能量分离和 RWM，并提高了阈值电压稳定性和耐久性。进一步的 Sb 掺入使杂化超出了有利范围，并促进了 Sb-Sb 富集同极键合，减少了陷阱态分化和记忆性能。 X射线光电子和拉曼光谱证实了相应的成键演化，而温度依赖性输运分析将这些变化与陷阱能量学联系起来。这些结果建立了成分-键合-陷阱-性质关系，并表明杂交-离子映射可以在广泛的制造和表征之前缩小候选成分的范围。
