articles.title: All-temperature superfluidity in two dimensions
articles.title_zh: 二维全温超流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In local theories with short-range interactions, continuous symmetries cannot be spontaneously broken in two spatial dimensions at nonzero temperature. U(1)-symmetric models instead admit a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) phase with quasi-long-range order and nonzero phase stiffness, which is normally destroyed at high temperatures by vortex proliferation. Here, we show that a BKT phase, and with it superfluidity, can persist to arbitrarily high temperatures. Using the large-N expansion, we study a (2+1)-dimensional quantum field theory in which a complex scalar is coupled to the critical O(N) model. At the biconical fixed point, where the inter-sector coupling is negative, the thermal effective potential has a circle of minima with nonzero U(1) amplitude. Integrating out the gapped fluctuations yields an effective theory for the compact phase mode at distances large compared to 1/T. Since temperature is the only scale at the fixed point, the phase stiffness grows linearly with temperature, with a proportionality factor that scales linearly with N and is fixed entirely by the fixed point. This renders vortex operators irrelevant for sufficiently large N. We further show that the vortex fugacity is exponentially small in N.
articles.abstract_zh: 在具有短程相互作用的局部理论中，连续对称性不能在非零温度下在两个空间维度中自发破裂。U （ 1 ） -对称模型相反承认Berezinskii-Kosterlitz--具有准长程有序和非零相刚度的无相（ BKT ）相，其通常在高温下被涡旋扩散破坏。在这里，我们展示了BKT相，以及它的超流性，可以持续到任意高的温度。使用大N展开，我们研究了(2 +1)维量子场理论，其中复标量耦合到临界O (N)模型。在扇形间耦合为负的双锥定点处，热有效电位具有非零U （ 1 ）幅度的最小值圆。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在具有短程相互作用的局部理论中，连续对称性不能在非零温度下在两个空间维度中自发破裂。U （ 1 ） -对称模型相反承认Berezinskii-Kosterlitz--具有准长程有序和非零相刚度的无相（ BKT ）相，其通常在高温下被涡旋扩散破坏。在这里，我们展示了BKT相，以及它的超流性，可以持续到任意高的温度。使用大N展开，我们研究了(2 +1)维量子场理论，其中复标量耦合到临界O (N)模型。在扇形间耦合为负的双锥定点处，热有效电位具有非零U （ 1 ）幅度的最小值圆。与1/T相比，积分间隙波动为大距离的紧凑相位模式提供了一个有效的理论。由于温度是固定点的唯一标度，因此相位刚度随温度线性增长，其比例因子与N线性缩放，并且完全由固定点固定。这使得涡旋算子与足够大的N无关。我们进一步表明，涡旋逸度在N中呈指数级小。

articles.title: Boundary-induced geometrical frustration in a square Rydberg-atom lattice
articles.title_zh: 方形Rydberg原子晶格中边界诱导的几何挫折
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20723v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study geometric defects in square-lattice Rydberg-atom arrays induced by lattice-size parity in the striated density-wave phase. While odd-sized lattices select a single striated domain, even-sized lattices seed incompatible domains at the four corners, resulting in a π/2-rotation invariant state with a geometrical defect emanating from the lattice center. At larger detunings, we instead identify a π-rotation-invariant state with two domains nucleated by opposite corners and separated by a one-dimensional diagonal defect. We probe the state-preparation protocol on the Aquila atomic quantum processor and benchmark it with equilibrium and real-time dynamics tensor-network simulations. Our results assess the role of boundaries and lattice size in determining the global ordering in programmable quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了条纹密度波相中由晶格大小奇偶引起的方格Rydberg原子阵列的几何缺陷。虽然奇数大小的晶格选择单个条纹结构域，但均匀大小的晶格在四个角处播种不相容的结构域，导致π/2-旋转不变状态，具有从晶格中心发出的几何缺陷。相反，在较大的调谐中，我们识别出π旋转不变状态，其中两个结构域由相对的角成核，并由一维对角线缺陷分开。我们探索Aquila原子量子处理器上的状态准备协议，并通过平衡和实时动态张量网络模拟对其进行基准测试。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了条纹密度波相中由晶格大小奇偶引起的方格Rydberg原子阵列的几何缺陷。虽然奇数大小的晶格选择单个条纹结构域，但均匀大小的晶格在四个角处播种不相容的结构域，导致π/2-旋转不变状态，具有从晶格中心发出的几何缺陷。相反，在较大的调谐中，我们识别出π旋转不变状态，其中两个结构域由相对的角成核，并由一维对角线缺陷分开。我们探索Aquila原子量子处理器上的状态准备协议，并通过平衡和实时动态张量网络模拟对其进行基准测试。我们的结果评估了边界和晶格大小在确定可编程量子物质的全局排序中的作用。

articles.title: Quantum oscillations in a solvable model of a Kondo insulator
articles.title_zh: 近藤绝缘子可解模型中的量子振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20734v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the effects of interactions on the low-energy density of states (SdH) and magnetization (dHvA) quantum oscillations (QOs) in a Kondo insulator. Toward this end we introduce a generalization of the periodic Anderson model with Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) interactions at each site that is exactly solvable in the large-N limit, where N is the number of flavors of the heavy f electrons. We show analytically and numerically that the insulating state remains stable in terms of spectrum, thermodynamics, and transport at low temperatures even for interaction strengths much larger than non-interacting band gap of the hybridization-gap insulator. We analytically derive generalizations of Lifshitz-Kosevich (LK) formulae, distinct for the SdH and dHvA QOs, for the interacting insulator. We find that the SdH oscillation frequencies, F₀± δ F, corresponding to the conduction and valence band edges, can be weakly renormalized by interaction relative to their non-interacting values. In contrast, dHvA QO frequency F₀ is not renormalized by interactions, and remains the same as that for the non-interacting unhybridized bands. The QO amplitudes show a remarkable difference: the dHvA amplitude is essentially unaffected by interactions, while the SdH amplitude is strongly enhanced due to gap renormalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了相互作用对近藤绝缘体中低能态密度(SdH)和磁化强度(dHvA)量子振荡(QO)的影响。为此，我们引入了在每个位点具有Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev （ SYK ）相互作用的周期Anderson模型的推广，该模型在大N极限中完全可解，其中N是重f电子的味道数。我们在分析和数值上表明，即使相互作用强度远大于杂交间隙绝缘体的非相互作用带隙，绝缘状态在低温下的光谱、热力学和传输方面仍然保持稳定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了相互作用对近藤绝缘体中低能态密度(SdH)和磁化强度(dHvA)量子振荡(QO)的影响。为此，我们引入了在每个位点具有Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev （ SYK ）相互作用的周期Anderson模型的推广，该模型在大N极限中完全可解，其中N是重f电子的味道数。我们在分析和数值上表明，即使相互作用强度远大于杂交间隙绝缘体的非相互作用带隙，绝缘状态在低温下的光谱、热力学和传输方面仍然保持稳定。我们分析性地推导了Lifshitz-Kosevich （ LK ）公式的推广，对于相互作用的绝缘体， SdH和dHvA QO是不同的。我们发现，对应于传导带边缘和价带边缘的SdH振荡频率F恤± δ F ，相对于它们的非相互作用值，可以通过相互作用弱重整化。相比之下， dHvA QO频率F ”不通过相互作用重新归一化，并且与非相互作用的非杂交条带保持相同。QO振幅显示出显着差异： dHvA振幅基本上不受相互作用的影响，而SdH振幅由于间隙重整而强烈增强。

articles.title: Enabling large language model agents for high-fidelity many-body perturbation theory calculations
articles.title_zh: 使大型语言模型代理能够进行高保真多体扰动理论计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many-body perturbation theory (MBPT) methods, including the GW approximation, the GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation (GW-BSE) method, and GW perturbation theory (GWPT), among others, provide accurate first-principles descriptions of excited-state properties and multiparticle interactions of materials. However, their use remains limited due to complex multi-software workflows, interdependent physical parameters, and substantial theoretical expertise. Large language model (LLM) agents, which couple a language model to software tools, show potential in automating computational tasks, but MBPT remains an unaddressed challenge. We show that LLM agents tested in our work, including frontier models such as Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5, do not reliably construct MBPT workflows in one attempt, suggesting that correct setup requires expert knowledge and consistency that current models lack. Across tested model-harness combinations, out-of-the-box agents average 54%, 36%, and 19% on GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT workflow benchmarks, with strong model dependence and large run-to-run variation. Errors typically originate from cross-stage inconsistencies that surface only several stages after they are introduced. We therefore develop AI-Donkey, an agentic framework that combines expert-curated knowledge with deterministic execution to enable high-fidelity GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT calculations and analyses. With AI-Donkey, all tested agents, from frontier proprietary models to open-weight models, produce complete, runnable MBPT workflows with no observed run-to-run variation. We further demonstrate autonomous calculations and post-processing on 1D, 2D, and bulk materials, including the many-body enhancement of Fröhlich electron-phonon coupling in polar semiconductors. Our approach provides a general framework for knowledge engineering to enable reliable agentic workflows in computational materials science.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体扰动理论（ MBPT ）方法，包括GW近似、GW加Bethe-Salpeter方程（ GW-BSE ）方法和GW扰动理论（ GWPT ）等，为材料的激发态性质和多粒子相互作用提供了准确的第一原理描述。然而，由于复杂的多软件工作流程、相互依赖的物理参数和大量的理论专业知识，它们的使用仍然有限。大型语言模型（ LLM ）代理将语言模型与软件工具相结合，显示出自动化计算任务的潜力，但MBPT仍然是一个未解决的挑战。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多体扰动理论（ MBPT ）方法，包括GW近似、GW加Bethe-Salpeter方程（ GW-BSE ）方法和GW扰动理论（ GWPT ）等，为材料的激发态性质和多粒子相互作用提供了准确的第一原理描述。然而，由于复杂的多软件工作流程、相互依赖的物理参数和大量的理论专业知识，它们的使用仍然有限。大型语言模型（ LLM ）代理将语言模型与软件工具相结合，显示出自动化计算任务的潜力，但MBPT仍然是一个未解决的挑战。我们表明，在我们的工作中测试的LLM代理（包括Opus 4.7和GPT-5.5等前沿模型）一次无法可靠地构建MBPT工作流程，这表明正确的设置需要专业知识和当前模型缺乏的一致性。在测试的模型-线束组合中， GW、GW-BSE和GWPT工作流程基准的开箱即用代理平均为54%、36%和19% ，具有很强的模型依赖性和较大的运行间差异。错误通常源于跨阶段的不一致性，这些不一致性在引入后仅出现几个阶段。因此，我们开发了AI-Donkey ，这是一个代理框架，将专家策划的知识与确定性执行相结合，以实现高保真GW、GW-BSE和GWPT计算和分析。借助AI-Donkey ，所有经过测试的代理，从前沿专有模型到开放式权重模型，都可以生成完整、可运行的MBPT工作流程，没有观察到运行间差异。我们进一步演示了1D、2D和体材料的自主计算和后处理，包括极性半导体中Fröhlich电子-声子耦合的多体增强。我们的方法为知识工程提供了一个通用框架，以实现计算材料科学中的可靠代理工作流程。

articles.title: Modeling Transport and Mechanics in Anion Exchange Membranes to Optimize Continuous CO2 Separations
articles.title_zh: 对阴离子交换膜中的传输和力学进行建模，以优化连续的CO2分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Water transport in charged polymer membranes is strongly influenced by hydration-dependent transport properties and polymer-network deformation. Under water-activity gradients, spatial variations in water concentration induce swelling and mechanical stresses, while the resulting deformation can influence water transport. Capturing this bidirectional interaction is important for predicting membrane behavior under nonuniform hydration conditions. This study develops a transient finite element model of water transport and mechanical deformation in a Fumasep FAA-3-50 anion exchange membrane. The framework incorporates concentration-dependent water diffusivity, hygroscopic swelling, and nonlinear viscoelastic polymer response. Uncoupled, one-way coupled, and fully coupled formulations are compared to distinguish the effects of hydration-dependent diffusivity and mechanical coupling. In the fully coupled model, local water concentration governs swelling and mechanical response, while deformation, evolving membrane geometry, and mechanical pressure feed back into water transport. Simulations predict spatially and temporally nonuniform swelling and deformation that track the evolving water-concentration field. Relative to the uncoupled concentration-dependent diffusion model, mechanical feedback alters the predicted transport response, although transport remains primarily diffusion-driven. The fully coupled model is validated against steady-state water-transport measurements across water-activity gradients and reproduces the experimentally observed hydration dependence, with strongest agreement at intermediate hydration levels. These results highlight the importance of coupled hydration, swelling, deformation, and transport processes in models of hydrated anion exchange membranes and provide a framework for evaluating membrane behavior in moisture-facilitated transport applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 带电聚合物膜中的水传输受到依赖于水合的传输特性和聚合物网络变形的强烈影响。在水活度梯度下，水浓度的空间变化会引起膨胀和机械应力，而由此产生的变形会影响水的运输。捕获这种双向相互作用对于预测非均匀水合条件下的膜行为非常重要。本研究建立了Fumasep FAA-3-50阴离子交换膜中水输运和机械变形的瞬态有限元模型。该框架结合了浓度依赖性水扩散率、吸湿膨胀和非线性粘弹性聚合物响应。比较非耦合、单向耦合和完全耦合制剂，以区分依赖于水合的扩散率和机械耦合的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 带电聚合物膜中的水传输受到依赖于水合的传输特性和聚合物网络变形的强烈影响。在水活度梯度下，水浓度的空间变化会引起膨胀和机械应力，而由此产生的变形会影响水的运输。捕获这种双向相互作用对于预测非均匀水合条件下的膜行为非常重要。本研究建立了Fumasep FAA-3-50阴离子交换膜中水输运和机械变形的瞬态有限元模型。该框架结合了浓度依赖性水扩散率、吸湿膨胀和非线性粘弹性聚合物响应。比较非耦合、单向耦合和完全耦合制剂，以区分依赖于水合的扩散率和机械耦合的影响。在完全耦合模型中，局部水浓度控制膨胀和机械响应，而变形、演变的膜几何形状和机械压力反馈到水输送中。模拟预测了跟踪水浓度场演变的空间和时间非均匀膨胀和变形。相对于非耦合浓度依赖性扩散模型，机械反馈改变了预测的传输响应，尽管传输仍然主要由扩散驱动。完全耦合的模型针对跨水活度梯度的稳态水输送测量值进行了验证，并重现了实验观察到的水合作用依赖性，在中间水合作用水平上具有最强的一致性。这些结果强调了水合阴离子交换膜模型中耦合水合、膨胀、变形和运输过程的重要性，并为评估水分促进运输应用中的膜行为提供了框架。

articles.title: Transition-Metal-Oxygen Covalency Controls Ligand-Hole Stability in Li-Rich Cathode
articles.title_zh: 过渡金属氧共价控制富锂阴极中的配体-空穴稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lithium-rich cathodes boast a large specific capacity due to the presence of excess lithium per transition metal. However, making use of that excess Li drives the cathodes to unusually high formal oxidation states, often triggering unwanted side reactions, typically signaled by gas release and commonly associated with oxygen oxidation. By varying the transition metal (TM) chemistry in Li-rich materials, cyclability can vary drastically, with some materials suffering rapid capacity fade while others are able to maintain large and stable voltage windows. Such observations indicate a crucial role for both TM and O activities, but the details remain elusive. Here, we model core-level spectroscopy to understand differences in the charge compensation mechanism between different Li2MO3 (M = Mn, Ru, Ir) cathode materials. We find that ligand holes are important throughout the series, but their stability depends strongly on the transition-metal-oxygen electronic structure. In Li2MnO3, the ground state is already strongly negative-charge-transfer-like, so further delithiation rapidly increases ligand-hole character and promotes instability. Moving from Mn to Ru and Ir increases TM-O hybridization while reducing the tendency toward an extreme negative-charge-transfer state, allowing additional holes to remain delocalized over the covalent TM-O network over a wider range of charge. These results identify TM-O covalency, rather than the absence of oxygen-hole character, as a key factor controlling reversible high-valent redox and suggest a route for stabilizing high-energy-density cathodes without invoking reversible molecular oxygen formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于每种过渡金属存在多余的锂，富锂阴极具有较大的比容量。然而，利用过量的Li将阴极驱动到异常高的形式氧化状态，通常引发不需要的副反应，通常由气体释放发出信号并且通常与氧氧化相关。通过改变富锂材料中的过渡金属（ TM ）化学性质，可循环性可能会有很大差异，一些材料会出现快速电容衰减，而另一些材料则能够保持大而稳定的电压窗口。这些观察表明TM和O活动都起着至关重要的作用，但细节仍然难以捉摸。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于每种过渡金属存在多余的锂，富锂阴极具有较大的比容量。然而，利用过量的Li将阴极驱动到异常高的形式氧化状态，通常引发不需要的副反应，通常由气体释放发出信号并且通常与氧氧化相关。通过改变富锂材料中的过渡金属（ TM ）化学性质，可循环性可能会有很大差异，一些材料会出现快速电容衰减，而另一些材料则能够保持大而稳定的电压窗口。这些观察表明TM和O活动都起着至关重要的作用，但细节仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们对芯级光谱进行建模，以了解不同Li2MO3 （ M = Mn ， Ru ， Ir ）阴极材料之间的电荷补偿机制的差异。我们发现配体孔在整个系列中都很重要，但它们的稳定性在很大程度上取决于过渡金属氧电子结构。在Li2MnO3中，基态已经是强负电荷转移样，因此进一步脱锂会迅速增加配体空穴特征并促进不稳定性。从Mn移动到Ru和Ir增加了TM-O杂交，同时减少了极端负电荷转移状态的趋势，允许额外的孔在更宽的电荷范围内在共价TM-O网络上保持去定位。这些结果确定TM-O共价性，而不是氧空穴特征的缺失，是控制可逆高价氧化还原的关键因素，并提出了一种在不引起可逆分子氧形成的情况下稳定高能密度阴极的途径。

articles.title: Sb-5p-mediated antiparallel Nd-Fe coupling in Nd₃Fe₃Sb₇
articles.title_zh: Nd中Sb-5p介导的反平行Nd-Fe耦合Fe Sb
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We uncover the microscopic mechanism underlying the antiparallel Nd-Fe coupling in the intermetallic 4f-3d-5p compound Nd₃Fe₃Sb₇ by means of high-field x-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) spectroscopy, complemented by magnetization measurements and density-functional-theory (DFT) calculations. This coupling is unexpected for intermetallics composed of light rare-earth and transition-metal elements. Sb M₄,₅-edge XMCD measurements indicate a clear spin polarization of Sb 5p states antiparallel to the Fe 3d moments. DFT calculations reveal the site-dependent character of the Sb moments and, together with the Fe-Sb antiparallel alignment seen by XMCD, identify a Fe 3d-Sb 5p-Nd 5d hybridization pathway for the antiparallel Nd-Fe coupling. Pulsed-field XMCD reveals a field-induced spin reorientation through the evolution of the c-axis projections of the Nd and Fe moments. Nd₃Fe₃Sb₇, thus, provides a platform for exploring antiparallel rare-earth-transition-metal (R-T) coupling mediated by transition-metal 3d-ligand p-rare-earth 5d hybridization in light-R-T intermetallics with p-elements.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过高场x射线磁圆二色性（ XMCD ）光谱，以磁化测量和密度泛函理论（ DFT ）计算为补充，揭示了金属间化合物4f-3d-5p中反平行Nd-Fe耦合的微观机制。这种耦合对于由轻稀土和过渡金属元素组成的金属间化合物来说是出乎意料的。SbM ，边缘XMCD测量表明Sb5p状态的明显自旋极化与Fe3d矩反平行。DFT计算揭示了Sb矩的位点依赖性特征，并与XMCD观察到的Fe-Sb反平行比对相结合，确定了反平行Nd-Fe偶联的Fe 3d-Sb 5p-Nd 5d杂交途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过高场x射线磁圆二色性（ XMCD ）光谱，以磁化测量和密度泛函理论（ DFT ）计算为补充，揭示了金属间化合物4f-3d-5p中反平行Nd-Fe耦合的微观机制。这种耦合对于由轻稀土和过渡金属元素组成的金属间化合物来说是出乎意料的。SbM ，边缘XMCD测量表明Sb5p状态的明显自旋极化与Fe3d矩反平行。DFT计算揭示了Sb矩的位点依赖性特征，并与XMCD观察到的Fe-Sb反平行比对相结合，确定了反平行Nd-Fe偶联的Fe 3d-Sb 5p-Nd 5d杂交途径。脉冲场XMCD通过Nd和Fe矩的c轴投影的演化揭示了场诱导的自旋重新定向。因此， Nd Fe Sb提供了一个探索反平行稀土-过渡金属（ R-T ）耦合的平台，该耦合通过过渡金属3d配体p-rare-earth 5d杂交在光-R-T金属间化合物与p元素中介导。

articles.title: Modified anisotropy and distinct phase diagrams in the nearly isotropic S=1 triangular-lattice antiferromagnet Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂
articles.title_zh: 近似各向同性S = 1三角晶格反铁磁体Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂中的修正各向异性和独特相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The triangular-lattice antiferromagnet serves as a benchmark platform for realizing exotic quantum phases, in which magnetic anisotropy plays an essential role. In this work, we report modified magnetic anisotropy and phase diagrams in the nearly isotropic S=1 triangular-lattice antiferromagnet Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂, compared with those of its isostructural analog K₂Ni(SeO₃)₂. The magnetic susceptibility of Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂ exhibits an easy-axis anisotropy with g_c > gₐb, opposite to the easy-plane anisotropy observed in K₂Ni(SeO₃)₂. The single Néel transition observed at zero field splits into two transitions at around 10~T, and a magnetization plateau is observed between 21~T and 37~T for both out-of-plane (Hparallel c) and in-plane (Hparallel ab) field directions in Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂. We construct magnetic phase diagrams that are distinct between Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂ and K₂Ni(SeO₃)₂. These findings highlight the sensitivity of field-induced magnetic phase behavior to anisotropy in nearly isotropic triangular-lattice antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 三角晶格反铁磁体是实现奇特量子相的基准平台，其中磁各向异性起着至关重要的作用。在本文中，我们报告了近各向同性S = 1三角晶格反铁磁体Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂与其同构模拟K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂的修正磁各向异性和相图。Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂的磁化率呈现易轴各向异性， g_c > g_b ，与K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂中观察到的易平面各向异性相反。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三角晶格反铁磁体是实现奇特量子相的基准平台，其中磁各向异性起着至关重要的作用。在本文中，我们报告了近各向同性S = 1三角晶格反铁磁体Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂与其同构模拟K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂的修正磁各向异性和相图。Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂的磁化率呈现易轴各向异性， g_c > g_b ，与K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂中观察到的易平面各向异性相反。在零场处观测到的单个Néel跃迁在10 ~ T左右分裂为两个跃迁，在Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂中，平面外(Hparallel c)和平面内(Hparallel ab)场方向的磁化平台都在21 ~ T和37 ~ T之间。我们构建了区分Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂和K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂的磁相图。这些发现突出了近各向同性三角晶格反铁磁体中磁场诱导磁相行为对各向异性的敏感性。

articles.title: Broadband radio-frequency TEM specimen holders for in situ biasing excitation and 100-ps-scale electron beam control
articles.title_zh: 用于原位偏置激励和100-ps电子束控制的宽带射频TEM样品架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Broadband electrical excitation inside a transmission electron microscope (TEM) is required to investigate electrically driven nanodevices at their actual operating frequencies and to develop fully electrical time-resolved experiments at a sub-nanosecond range. Here, we report the performances of homemade two- and four-channel radio-frequency (RF) TEM specimen holders based on a hybrid architecture combining coaxial transmission lines with miniaturized impedance-controlled printed circuit boards (PCB). Removable mechanical contacts provide direct electrical connection to interchangeable TEM chips without wire bonding. Vector network analyzer measurements demonstrate broadband transmission through the complete electrical path up to the specimen. With a representative TEM chip, the two-channel holder exhibits a -3 dB bandwidth of 7.9 GHz, while insertion losses remain below 12 dB up to 18 GHz. The same RF holder architecture was used to drive a miniaturized electrostatic electron-beam deflector. The measured temporal response indicates that the holder deflector assembly remains compatible with electrical pulse durations approaching 100 ps, with the shortest accessible times presently limited by the available waveform generator. High-resolution TEM imaging with a 200 ps probe window does not show detectable degradation of spatial resolution, while off-axis electron holography is successfully performed for probe durations down to 0.5 ns under conditions representative of operando measurements. These results establish a versatile broadband platform combining GHz electrical excitation and sub-nanosecond electron-beam control. The dual-stage configuration of our Hitachi HF3300 microscope further provides the basis for a future fully electrical pump-probe TEM approach using independently driven RF holders for specimen excitation and electron-probe control.
articles.abstract_zh: 需要在透射电子显微镜 (TEM) 内进行宽带电激发，以研究电驱动纳米器件在实际工作频率下的情况，并在亚纳秒范围内开发完全电时间分辨实验。在这里，我们报告了基于同轴传输线与小型阻抗控制印刷电路板 (PCB) 相结合的混合架构的自制两通道和四通道射频 (RF) TEM 样品架的性能。可拆卸机械触点提供与可互换 TEM 芯片的直接电气连接，无需引线键合。矢量网络分析仪测量显示了通过整个电气路径直至样品的宽带传输。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 需要在透射电子显微镜 (TEM) 内进行宽带电激发，以研究电驱动纳米器件在实际工作频率下的情况，并在亚纳秒范围内开发完全电时间分辨实验。在这里，我们报告了基于同轴传输线与小型阻抗控制印刷电路板 (PCB) 相结合的混合架构的自制两通道和四通道射频 (RF) TEM 样品架的性能。可拆卸机械触点提供与可互换 TEM 芯片的直接电气连接，无需引线键合。矢量网络分析仪测量显示了通过整个电气路径直至样品的宽带传输。采用代表性 TEM 芯片时，双通道支架具有 7.9 GHz 的 -3 dB 带宽，而插入损耗在高达 18 GHz 时仍保持在 12 dB 以下。相同的射频支架架构用于驱动小型静电电子束偏转器。测量的时间响应表明支架偏转器组件仍然与接近 100 ps 的电脉冲持续时间兼容，而最短可访问时间目前受到可用波形发生器的限制。使用 200 ps 探针窗口的高分辨率 TEM 成像没有显示出可检测到的空间分辨率下降，而在代表操作测量的条件下，离轴电子全息术成功执行了探针持续时间低至 0.5 ns 的情况。这些结果建立了一个结合了 GHz 电激励和亚纳秒电子束控制的多功能宽带平台。我们的 Hitachi HF3300 显微镜的双级配置进一步为未来的全电动泵浦探针 TEM 方法奠定了基础，该方法使用独立驱动的 RF 支架进行样品激发和电子探针控制。

articles.title: Transdimensional Chern insulators in rhombohedral multilayer graphene superlattices
articles.title_zh: 菱形多层石墨烯超晶格中的跨维陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments on lightly electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) in the "transdimensional" regime revealed anomalous Hall hysteresis under both perpendicular and in-plane magnetic fields, pointing to the emergence of transdimensional orbital magnetism in an interaction-driven "Fermi-lune" metal. Here we demonstrate that, by coupling to the moiré potential, this transdimensional orbital ferromagnetic metal can evolve into quantized Chern insulator phases in twisted RMG/hBN moiré superlattices. Using unrestricted Hartree-Fock calculations, we find that interaction-driven reconstruction isolates a spin-valley-polarized |C| = 1 Chern band, leading to a "transdimensional Chern insulator" (TDCI) state exhibiting both in-plane and out-of-plane orbital magnetizations. A minimal two-band model is introduced to describe the unique properties of TDCI, which unveils the intimate connection between non-reciprocal velocity and in-plane orbital magnetization. We further analyze the collective excitations of TDCIs, and identify soft charge and spin modes that may lead to density wave instabilities in certain cases. An in-plane magnetic field can harden the soft density-wave mode and may drive a transition from density-wave state to TDCI. Finally, when the |C| = 1 band is fractionally filled, the many-body ground state may be a fractional Chern insulator with broken rotation and mirror symmetries.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近在“跨维度”状态下进行的轻电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯（RMG）实验揭示了垂直磁场和面内磁场下的异常霍尔磁滞，表明在相互作用驱动的“费米月形”金属中出现了跨维度轨道磁性。在这里，我们证明，通过与莫尔势耦合，这种跨维轨道铁磁金属可以演化成扭曲 RMG/hBN 莫尔超晶格中的量子化陈绝缘体相。使用无限制的 Hartree-Fock 计算，我们发现相互作用驱动的重建隔离了自旋谷极化 |C| = 1 陈能带，导致“跨维陈绝缘体”(TDCI) 状态，表现出面内和面外轨道磁化强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近在“跨维度”状态下进行的轻电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯（RMG）实验揭示了垂直磁场和面内磁场下的异常霍尔磁滞，表明在相互作用驱动的“费米月形”金属中出现了跨维度轨道磁性。在这里，我们证明，通过与莫尔势耦合，这种跨维轨道铁磁金属可以演化成扭曲 RMG/hBN 莫尔超晶格中的量子化陈绝缘体相。使用无限制的 Hartree-Fock 计算，我们发现相互作用驱动的重建隔离了自旋谷极化 |C| = 1 陈能带，导致“跨维陈绝缘体”(TDCI) 状态，表现出面内和面外轨道磁化强度。引入最小二能带模型来描述 TDCI 的独特性质，揭示了非互易速度与面内轨道磁化强度之间的密切联系。我们进一步分析了 TDCI 的集体激发，并确定了在某些情况下可能导致密度波不稳定的软电荷和自旋模式。面内磁场可以硬化软密度波模式并且可以驱动从密度波状态到TDCI的转变。最后，当 |C| = 1 能带被分数填充，多体基态可能是具有破缺旋转和镜像对称性的分数陈绝缘体。

articles.title: Thermodynamic-limit bootstrap: Solving fractional quantum Hall ground states
articles.title_zh: 热力学极限自举：求解分数量子霍尔基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly interacting ground states are usually computed in finite systems and then extrapolated to the thermodynamic limit (TDL). Here we develop a quantum many-body bootstrap that solves fractional quantum Hall ground states directly in the TDL. The method gives rigorous and quantitatively tight lower bounds on the ground-state energy and identifies the ground-state structure and topological order. For Laughlin and Pfaffian parent Hamiltonians, it reproduces exact pair-correlation functions and low-lying orbital entanglement spectrum (OES) nearly level by level. For Coulomb interactions, the rigorous TDL energy bounds closely match thermodynamic estimates from exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) extrapolations, and the local diagnostics recover established Laughlin and Moore--Read OES counting and Friedel oscillations of the composite Fermi liquid. Beyond these benchmarks, the bootstrap resolves the thermodynamic ground states at ν=1/4 and ν=12/5, identifying a composite Fermi liquid and overlineRR₃ topological order, respectively. The same framework applies equally well to Abelian and non-Abelian, gapped and gapless quantum Hall states. The TDL bootstrap therefore provides a general ground-state solver that determines both the energy and the state directly in the TDL.
articles.abstract_zh: 强相互作用的基态通常在有限系统中计算，然后外推到热力学极限（TDL）。在这里，我们开发了一种量子多体自举程序，可以直接在 TDL 中求解分数量子霍尔基态。该方法给出了严格且定量严格的基态能量下界，并确定了基态结构和拓扑顺序。对于劳克林和普法夫父哈密顿量，它几乎逐层再现了精确的配对相关函数和低位轨道纠缠谱（OES）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强相互作用的基态通常在有限系统中计算，然后外推到热力学极限（TDL）。在这里，我们开发了一种量子多体自举程序，可以直接在 TDL 中求解分数量子霍尔基态。该方法给出了严格且定量严格的基态能量下界，并确定了基态结构和拓扑顺序。对于劳克林和普法夫父哈密顿量，它几乎逐层再现了精确的配对相关函数和低位轨道纠缠谱（OES）。对于库仑相互作用，严格的 TDL 能量界限与精确对角化和密度矩阵重正化群 (DMRG) 外推法的热力学估计紧密匹配，并且局部诊断恢复了已建立的 Laughlin 和 Moore--Read OES 计数和复合费米液体的 Friedel 振荡。除了这些基准之外，引导程序还解析了 ν=1/4 和 ν=12/5 处的热力学基态，分别识别了复合费米液体和 OverlineRR₃ 拓扑序。相同的框架同样适用于阿贝尔和非阿贝尔、有隙和无隙量子霍尔态。因此，TDL 自举程序提供了一个通用基态求解器，可以直接确定 TDL 中的能量和状态。

articles.title: Critical Ising Model on the Periodic Cubic Lattice (Z/LZ)³
articles.title_zh: 周期立方晶格 (Z/LZ)³ 的临界 Ising 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the critical behaviour of the nearest-neighbour Ising model on the three-dimensional periodic cubic lattice (Z/LZ)³, and we present a companion set of Monte Carlo simulations. After recalling the rigorous results on the continuity of the spontaneous magnetization in d=3 and the triviality of the scaling limit in dge 4, we compile modern high-precision estimates of the 3D Ising critical exponents and verify the scaling relations that connect them. We then describe numerical measurements of the Binder cumulant, the magnetic susceptibility, the specific heat, the two-point correlation function, and the finite-size scaling of the magnetization. We discuss the systematic uncertainties that affect the extraction of the exponent ratios γ/ν and α/ν, and we emphasize that an exponential fit of the correlation function is not appropriate at the critical point, where the decay is algebraic.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了三维周期立方晶格 (Z/LZ)³ 上最近邻伊辛模型的临界行为，并提出了一组蒙特卡罗模拟的同伴。在回顾了 d=3 中自发磁化连续性的严格结果和 dge 4 中标度极限的琐碎性之后，我们编译了 3D Ising 临界指数的现代高精度估计，并验证了连接它们的标度关系。然后，我们描述了宾德累积量、磁化率、比热、两点相关函数和磁化强度的有限尺寸缩放的数值测量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了三维周期立方晶格 (Z/LZ)³ 上最近邻伊辛模型的临界行为，并提出了一组蒙特卡罗模拟的同伴。在回顾了 d=3 中自发磁化连续性的严格结果和 dge 4 中标度极限的琐碎性之后，我们编译了 3D Ising 临界指数的现代高精度估计，并验证了连接它们的标度关系。然后，我们描述了宾德累积量、磁化率、比热、两点相关函数和磁化强度的有限尺寸缩放的数值测量。我们讨论了影响指数比 γ/ν 和 α/ν 提取的系统不确定性，并强调相关函数的指数拟合在临界点是不合适的，因为衰减是代数的。

articles.title: Pairing-channel reconstruction by Ising spin-orbit coupling in a multiorbital triangular-lattice model
articles.title_zh: 多轨道三角晶格模型中伊辛自旋轨道耦合的配对通道重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21369v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ising spin-orbit coupling (SOC) is widely known for locking electronic spins and protecting superconductivity against in-plane paramagnetic pair breaking. Here we show that, in a correlated multiorbital system, Ising SOC can play a qualitatively different role: it reconstructs the hierarchy of spin-fluctuation-mediated pairing channels by reshaping the low-energy Fermi surfaces, orbital-spin coherence factors, and momentum-resolved scattering phase space. We study a noncentrosymmetric two-orbital triangular-lattice model with Rashba SOC, Ising SOC, and onsite SOC. We solve the pairing problem within a multiorbital random-phase-approximation framework. In the single-orbital limit, an E-representation state with a dominant S_z=0 component emerges only at relatively strong Ising SOC. Orbital degrees of freedom facilitate the stabilization of this pairing state at a smaller nominal Ising SOC strength and generate a broad competition between E and A₁ pairing channels. The E state can maintain the same S_z=0 triplet character, whereas the A₁ state becomes a fully gapped sign-changing splusminus superconductor. The latter also realizes a topologically nontrivial phase in the time-reversal-invariant weak-pairing regime, with a nonzero Z₂ index, Wilson-loop spectral flow, and boundary modes. Its topology is not carried by a single orbital pairing component, but emerges cooperatively from the dominant intra- and inter-orbital pairing components. These results establish a microscopic route by which Ising SOC and orbital hybridization can reconstruct interaction-driven superconductivity, producing both Ising-triplet and topological singlet-dominated phases in correlated non-centrosymmetric systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 伊辛自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 因锁定电子自旋和保护超导免受面内顺磁对断裂而广为人知。在这里，我们表明，在相关的多轨道系统中，伊辛 SOC 可以发挥性质不同的作用：它通过重塑低能费米面、轨道自旋相干因子和动量分辨散射相空间来重建自旋涨落介导的配对通道的层次结构。我们研究了具有 Rashba SOC、Ising SOC 和现场 SOC 的非中心对称双轨道三角晶格模型。我们在多轨道随机相位近似框架内解决配对问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 伊辛自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 因锁定电子自旋和保护超导免受面内顺磁对断裂而广为人知。在这里，我们表明，在相关的多轨道系统中，伊辛 SOC 可以发挥性质不同的作用：它通过重塑低能费米面、轨道自旋相干因子和动量分辨散射相空间来重建自旋涨落介导的配对通道的层次结构。我们研究了具有 Rashba SOC、Ising SOC 和现场 SOC 的非中心对称双轨道三角晶格模型。我们在多轨道随机相位近似框架内解决配对问题。在单轨道极限下，仅在相对较强的 Ising SOC 下才会出现具有 S_z=0 分量的 E 表示态。轨道自由度有助于在较小的标称 Ising SOC 强度下稳定该配对状态，并在 E 和 A₁ 配对通道之间产生广泛的竞争。 E态可以保持相同的S_z=0三重态特征，而A₁态则成为完全有隙的变号splusminus超导体。后者还在时间反转不变的弱配对机制中实现了拓扑非平凡相，具有非零 Z2 指数、威尔逊环谱流和边界模式。它的拓扑结构不是由单个轨道配对组件承载的，而是由占主导地位的轨道内和轨道间配对组件共同产生的。这些结果建立了一条微观途径，伊辛 SOC 和轨道杂化可以重建相互作用驱动的超导性，从而在相关非中心对称系统中产生伊辛三重态和拓扑单重态为主的相。

articles.title: Edge state reconstruction in proximitized graphene and its probe using RKKY interaction
articles.title_zh: 使用 RKKY 相互作用进行邻近石墨烯及其探针的边缘状态重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Proximity induced spin-orbit coupling (SOC) in graphene emerges when it is placed on a substrate, breaking sublattice symmetry and giving rise to staggered intrinsic SOC together with Rashba spin-orbit coupling. In zigzag graphene nanoribbons, this staggered SOC produces pseudohelical edge states exhibiting sublattice-locked rather than spin-locked helicity. We investigate the effect of a finite on-site potential, restricted to the edges of the ribbon, on these edge states. We find the inter-valley edge states undergo reconstruction and become purely intra-valley, exhibiting both spin and valley polarization. The charge conductance calculations fail to capture this reconstruction, since the number of transmitted channels remains unchanged. We show that the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) magnetic exchange interaction, between two magnetic impurities situated on the ribbon edge can be used to probe the shifted band dispersion, for both the uniform and staggered spin-orbit coupling. In the presence of strong intrinsic and Rashba SOC, the RKKY interaction becomes fully anisotropic. Both sublattice staggering and edge potential-induced reconstruction lead to distinct features in the RKKY interaction. We show that the RKKY interaction terms acquire faster oscillations as a function of the spatial separation between two magnetic impurities, in response to the edge state reconstruction, establishing it as an effective probe of the edge states. Additionally, the significant mismatch in the amplitudes of the DM term corresponding to the uniform and staggered SOC, can also act as a probe of the type of SOC.
articles.abstract_zh: 当石墨烯放置在基板上时，就会出现石墨烯中的邻近诱导自旋轨道耦合（SOC），打破亚晶格对称性并与 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合一起产生交错的本征 SOC。在锯齿状石墨烯纳米带中，这种交错的 SOC 产生伪螺旋边缘态，表现出亚晶格锁定螺旋性，而不是自旋锁定螺旋性。我们研究了限制在带边缘的有限现场电势对这些边缘状态的影响。我们发现谷间边缘态经历重建并变成纯粹的谷内，表现出自旋和谷极化。电荷电导计算无法捕获这种重建，因为传输通道的数量保持不变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当石墨烯放置在基板上时，就会出现石墨烯中的邻近诱导自旋轨道耦合（SOC），打破亚晶格对称性并与 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合一起产生交错的本征 SOC。在锯齿状石墨烯纳米带中，这种交错的 SOC 产生伪螺旋边缘态，表现出亚晶格锁定螺旋性，而不是自旋锁定螺旋性。我们研究了限制在带边缘的有限现场电势对这些边缘状态的影响。我们发现谷间边缘态经历重建并变成纯粹的谷内，表现出自旋和谷极化。电荷电导计算无法捕获这种重建，因为传输通道的数量保持不变。我们表明，位于带边缘的两个磁性杂质之间的 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) 磁交换相互作用可用于探测均匀和交错自旋轨道耦合的移位能带色散。在存在强本征和 Rashba SOC 的情况下，RKKY 相互作用变得完全各向异性。亚晶格交错和边缘电势诱导重建都导致 RKKY 相互作用的独特特征。我们表明，RKKY 相互作用项随着两个磁性杂质之间的空间分离而获得更快的振荡，以响应边缘态重建，从而将其确立为边缘态的有效探针。此外，与均匀且交错的 SOC 相对应的 DM 项幅度的显着失配也可以充当 SOC 类型的探针。

articles.title: Non-equilibrium Muon Dynamics Imitating Fractional Spin Excitations in a Quantum Spin Chain
articles.title_zh: 模拟量子自旋链中分数自旋激发的非平衡 μ 子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional spin excitations in low-dimensional and frustrated magnets are commonly associated with sporadic spin fluctuations, as observed in quantum spin liquids, spin ices, and other complex magnetic states. In this study, we investigate the spin dynamics in the amplitude-modulated magnetic ground state of AgCuVO₄, a spin-1/2 chain compound with competing intrachain interactions, by muon spectroscopy. Our data reveal a Gaussian decay of muon polarization that remains remarkably resilient against applied magnetic fields---a behavior often interpreted as evidence of emergent sporadic spin dynamics. However, density functional theory calculations of muon stopping sites and their quadrupolar level-crossing resonance spectra suggest an alternative mechanism: a two-state model where the muon randomly hops between two nearby sites, eventually equilibrating across both on a microsecond timescale via quantum delocalization. These findings provide a microscopic explanation for the field-resilient muon polarization and indicate that such behavior may not always stem from intrinsic spin fluctuations, but can also arise from non-equilibrium muon dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 低维和受挫磁体中的分数自旋激发通常与零星自旋涨落相关，正如在量子自旋液体、自旋冰和其他复杂磁态中观察到的那样。在本研究中，我们通过 μ 子光谱研究了 AgCuVO₄（一种具有竞争性链内相互作用的自旋 1/2 链化合物）调幅磁基态下的自旋动力学。我们的数据揭示了μ子极化的高斯衰变，它对施加的磁场仍然具有显着的弹性——这种行为通常被解释为新兴的零星自旋动力学的证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低维和受挫磁体中的分数自旋激发通常与零星自旋涨落相关，正如在量子自旋液体、自旋冰和其他复杂磁态中观察到的那样。在本研究中，我们通过 μ 子光谱研究了 AgCuVO₄（一种具有竞争性链内相互作用的自旋 1/2 链化合物）调幅磁基态下的自旋动力学。我们的数据揭示了μ子极化的高斯衰变，它对施加的磁场仍然具有显着的弹性——这种行为通常被解释为新兴的零星自旋动力学的证据。然而，μ子停止位点及其四极能级交叉共振光谱的密度泛函理论计算提出了一种替代机制：双态模型，其中μ子在两个附近位点之间随机跳跃，最终通过量子离域在微秒时间尺度上平衡。这些发现为场弹性μ子极化提供了微观解释，并表明这种行为可能并不总是源于内在的自旋涨落，也可能源于非平衡μ子动力学。

articles.title: Flat-band ferrimagnetism in the edge-centered honeycomb antiferromagnet: From harmonic flat magnon to broad continuum
articles.title_zh: 边缘中心蜂窝反铁磁体中的平带亚铁磁性：从谐波平面磁振子到宽连续谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One of the most striking aspects of a flat band is not merely its lack of dispersion, but that it reduces the single-particle kinetic energy to a very small scale, allowing interaction effects to become the dominant energy scale in the low-energy physics. This picture has underpinned concepts such as flat-band ferromagnetism, flat-band superconductivity, and localized magnons. A more fundamental question, however, remains. Flat bands belong to the language of single-particle or linear-spin-wave physics; whether they survive as protected sharp excitations in a genuine many-body quantum magnet, or merely provide a skeleton of spectral weight left by the noninteracting picture, remains unclear. We study the spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the edge-centered honeycomb lattice to examine this question. In contrast to flat bands in geometrically frustrated magnets such as kagome, this lattice has a 2:3 sublattice imbalance that renders the intersublattice coupling matrix rectangular, whose null space gives rise to a flat band at the single-particle level. The same imbalance stabilizes a ferrimagnetic ground state through the Lieb--Mattis theorem and leads to an edge-site-localized flat magnon in linear spin-wave theory. Combining linear spin-wave theory, sign-problem-free stochastic series expansion quantum Monte Carlo, and stochastic analytic continuation, we find that quantum fluctuations transform this harmonic flat mode into a broad continuum whose centroid is about 1.55J and nearly dispersionless along the high-symmetry path. Sublattice imbalance thus offers an unfrustrated route that unifies flat bands and ferrimagnetism, and suggests that flat-band geometry organizes many-body spectral weight rather than giving rise to a protected quasiparticle.
articles.abstract_zh: 平带最引人注目的方面之一不仅仅是它缺乏色散，而且它将单粒子动能降低到非常小的尺度，使相互作用效应成为低能物理中的主要能量尺度。这张图支撑了平带铁磁性、平带超导性和局域磁振子等概念。然而，一个更根本的问题仍然存在。平带属于单粒子或线性自旋波物理学的语言；它们是否作为受保护的锐激发存在于真正的多体量子磁体中，或者仅仅提供非相互作用图像留下的光谱权重骨架，目前仍不清楚。我们研究边缘中心蜂窝晶格上的自旋 1/2 海森堡反铁磁体来研究这个问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平带最引人注目的方面之一不仅仅是它缺乏色散，而且它将单粒子动能降低到非常小的尺度，使相互作用效应成为低能物理中的主要能量尺度。这张图支撑了平带铁磁性、平带超导性和局域磁振子等概念。然而，一个更根本的问题仍然存在。平带属于单粒子或线性自旋波物理学的语言；它们是否作为受保护的锐激发存在于真正的多体量子磁体中，或者仅仅提供非相互作用图像留下的光谱权重骨架，目前仍不清楚。我们研究边缘中心蜂窝晶格上的自旋 1/2 海森堡反铁磁体来研究这个问题。与戈薇等几何受挫磁体中的平带相比，该晶格具有 2:3 的子晶格不平衡，使子晶格间耦合矩阵呈矩形，其零空间在单粒子水平上产生平带。同样的不平衡通过利布-马蒂斯定理稳定了亚铁磁基态，并导致线性自旋波理论中的边缘位置局域平面磁振子。结合线性自旋波理论、无符号问题随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗和随机解析延拓，我们发现量子涨落将这种谐波平坦模式转变为一个宽连续谱，其质心约为1.55J，并且沿着高对称性路径几乎无色散。因此，亚晶格不平衡提供了一条统一平带和亚铁磁性的顺利途径，并表明平带几何结构组织了多体光谱权重，而不是产生受保护的准粒子。

articles.title: Wavelength-selective bidirectional plasticity in self-powered Se/ZnMgO visual synapses
articles.title_zh: 自供电 Se/ZnMgO 视觉突触中的波长选择性双向可塑性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial visual synapses combine sensing, memory and processing in a single device, but most of them need an external voltage to read the synaptic weight and light is generally able to strengthen the weight rather than to weaken it. We report here Se/ZnMgO thin film photodiodes in which the photocurrent at zero bias writes and reads the synaptic weight, with a direction of change set by the photon energy alone. At equal photon flux, 365 nm pulses increase the photocurrent by 38 % while 455 nm pulses decrease it, and the depression reaching 30 % at higher flux, with up to 19 distinguishable levels per branch and no electrical energy spent. Spectrally resolved light soaking shows that short wavelengths potentiate while low-energy light erases. The interesting property is therefore the photon energy-dependent competition between potentiation and depression, the crossover being set by the defect population of the interface. Optical simulations show that both wavelengths are absorbed within the first tens of nanometres of Se, and the stored state is erased by a reverse bias in a voltage-dependent way and by sub-gap light, which indicates that potentiation corresponds to interface defects filled with electrons, in agreement with drift-diffusion simulations. The devices also show relearning, their response is modulated by bending on flexible substrates, and a network built from the measured weight updates reaches 89 % accuracy on handwritten digit recognition without noise and 85 % with the measured noise, against 97.5 % for floating-point weights.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工视觉突触将传感、记忆和处理结合在一个设备中，但大多数都需要外部电压来读取突触的重量，而光通常能够增强而不是削弱它的重量。我们在此报告 Se/ZnMgO 薄膜光电二极管，其中零偏压下的光电流写入和读取突触权重，变化方向仅由光子能量设定。在相同的光子通量下，365 nm 脉冲使光电流增加 38%，而 455 nm 脉冲则减少光电流，在较高通量下光电流下降达到 30%，每个分支有多达 19 个可区分的级别，并且不消耗电能。光谱解析光浸泡表明，短波长会增强，而低能量光会消除。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工视觉突触将传感、记忆和处理结合在一个设备中，但大多数都需要外部电压来读取突触的重量，而光通常能够增强而不是削弱它的重量。我们在此报告 Se/ZnMgO 薄膜光电二极管，其中零偏压下的光电流写入和读取突触权重，变化方向仅由光子能量设定。在相同的光子通量下，365 nm 脉冲使光电流增加 38%，而 455 nm 脉冲则减少光电流，在较高通量下光电流下降达到 30%，每个分支有多达 19 个可区分的级别，并且不消耗电能。光谱解析光浸泡表明，短波长会增强，而低能量光会消除。因此，有趣的特性是增强和抑制之间依赖于光子能量的竞争，交叉是由界面的缺陷群体设置的。光学模拟表明，两个波长都在 Se 的前几十纳米内被吸收，并且存储的状态被反向偏压以电压相关的方式和亚能隙光擦除，这表明增强对应于充满电子的界面缺陷，与漂移扩散模拟一致。这些设备还显示出重新学习功能，它们的响应通过在柔性基板上弯曲来调节，并且根据测量的权重更新构建的网络在无噪声的手写数字识别上达到 89% 的准确度，在测量噪声的情况下达到 85% 的准确度，而浮点权重的准确度为 97.5%。

articles.title: Universal Dynamic Scaling for Sub-Yield Aging and Over-Yield Rejuvenation in A Cyclically Driven Metallic Glass
articles.title_zh: 循环驱动金属玻璃中亚屈服老化和超屈服恢复的通用动态缩放
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether sub-yield aging and over-yield rejuvenation in cyclically deformed amorphous solids share a common physical origin or arise from distinct microscopic mechanisms remains a fundamental yet unresolved debate. Using molecular dynamics simulations of a metallic glass, we resolve this duality by uncovering a unified dynamic clock that dictates energy landscape navigation across both regimes. We show that the transition between regimes reflects a fundamental shift in energy injection pathways: (i) In the over-yield regime, rejuvenation is driven as a first-order response to macroscopic plastic shear work derived from Herschel-Bulkley non-linear rheological scaling. (ii) In contrast, this macroscopic work scaling fails in the sub-yield regime, where early-stage energy landscape elevation and subsequent cyclic aging are instead governed by second-order localized elastic stress fluctuations acting as a mechanical catalyst and noise source, respectively. Intense high-rate agitation increases the escape probability from deeper potential energy minima, thereby suppressing the retention efficiency of structural relaxation. By identifying these localized fluctuations as the primary origin of rate-attenuated sub-yield relaxation, we establish an exact scaling identity relating the relaxation attenuation exponent to the stress fluctuation exponent. This work directly bridges non-linear rheology with stress fluctuation dynamics, providing a unified framework to predict and manipulate structural evolution in amorphous solids.
articles.abstract_zh: 循环变形非晶固体中的亚屈服老化和超屈服回复是否具有共同的物理起源，或者源于不同的微观机制，仍然是一个基本但尚未解决的争论。利用金属玻璃的分子动力学模拟，我们通过发现一个统一的动态时钟来解决这种二元性，该时钟决定了两种状态下的能量景观导航。我们表明，两种状态之间的转变反映了能量注入途径的根本转变：（i）在超屈服状态中，再生是对源自赫歇尔-巴尔克利非线性流变尺度的宏观塑性剪切功的一阶响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 循环变形非晶固体中的亚屈服老化和超屈服回复是否具有共同的物理起源，或者源于不同的微观机制，仍然是一个基本但尚未解决的争论。利用金属玻璃的分子动力学模拟，我们通过发现一个统一的动态时钟来解决这种二元性，该时钟决定了两种状态下的能量景观导航。我们表明，两种状态之间的转变反映了能量注入途径的根本转变：（i）在超屈服状态中，再生是对源自赫歇尔-巴尔克利非线性流变尺度的宏观塑性剪切功的一阶响应。 （ii）相比之下，这种宏观工作缩放在次屈服状态下失败，其中早期能量景观提升和随后的循环老化反而由分别充当机械催化剂和噪声源的二阶局部弹性应力波动控制。强烈的高速搅拌增加了逃离更深势能最小值的概率，从而抑制了结构松弛的保留效率。通过将这些局部波动识别为速率衰减子屈服松弛的主要来源，我们建立了将松弛衰减指数与应力波动指数相关联的精确标度恒等式。这项工作直接将非线性流变学与应力波动动力学联系起来，提供了一个统一的框架来预测和操纵非晶固体的结构演化。

articles.title: Finite-size geometric crossover toward fragmentation of the potential energy shell in the quantum random energy model
articles.title_zh: 量子随机能量模型中势能壳破碎的有限几何交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum random energy model (QREM) is a paradigmatic model for studying delocalization-localization transitions at finite energy density in Fock space. In the computational basis, its diagonal energies are independent Gaussian random variables, in contrast to the correlated energies of local interacting models such as the disordered XXZ chain. In this work, we construct a potential energy shell associated with a basis state, defined through its energy variance, and investigate its connectivity on the Fock-space hypercube. As the transverse field is varied, this energy-selected subgraph undergoes a finite-size geometric crossover between fully connected and fragmented regimes. Furthermore, we observe a correlation between the shell connectivity and the finite-size fractal dimension of the eigenstates, as extracted from the participation entropy. For the QREM, the statistical independence of the diagonal energies allows the shell connectivity to be analyzed as an effective independent site percolation problem on the hypercube, with its crossover scale estimated within a one-hop approximation. At finite energy density, this estimate gives a nonmonotonic dependence of the crossover scale on system size L: increasing L initially favors connectivity, while beyond an energy-dependent scale L^*(ε) the trend reverses towards fragmentation.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子随机能量模型（QREM）是研究福克空间中有限能量密度下的离域-局域转变的范例模型。在计算基础上，其对角线能量是独立的高斯随机变量，与无序 XXZ 链等局部相互作用模型的相关能量相反。在这项工作中，我们构建了一个与基态相关的势能壳，通过其能量方差定义，并研究了它在福克空间超立方体上的连通性。随着横向场的变化，该能量选择子图在完全连接和碎片状态之间经历有限尺寸的几何交叉。此外，我们观察到从参与熵中提取的壳连通性和本征态的有限尺寸分形维数之间的相关性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子随机能量模型（QREM）是研究福克空间中有限能量密度下的离域-局域转变的范例模型。在计算基础上，其对角线能量是独立的高斯随机变量，与无序 XXZ 链等局部相互作用模型的相关能量相反。在这项工作中，我们构建了一个与基态相关的势能壳，通过其能量方差定义，并研究了它在福克空间超立方体上的连通性。随着横向场的变化，该能量选择子图在完全连接和碎片状态之间经历有限尺寸的几何交叉。此外，我们观察到从参与熵中提取的壳连通性和本征态的有限尺寸分形维数之间的相关性。对于 QREM，对角线能量的统计独立性允许将壳连通性分析为超立方体上的有效独立位点渗流问题，其交叉尺度在一跳近似内估计。在有限能量密度下，该估计给出了交叉尺度对系统尺寸 L 的非单调依赖性：增加 L 最初有利于连通性，而超过能量依赖尺度 L^*(ε) 时，趋势会逆转为碎片化。

articles.title: Directed impulsive molecular dynamics reveal energy-routing pathways of bond cleavage in TATB
articles.title_zh: 定向脉冲分子动力学揭示了 TATB 中键断裂的能量路由途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Responses of energetic materials to external stimuli involve more than uniform thermalization. Understanding directional energy redistribution is essential for structural and ignition design. Here, we use TATB as an example to construct a vibrationally faithful machine-learning potential from only 4,630 configurations. To resolve the elusive nonequilibrium energy flow, we develop directed impulsive molecular dynamics, a statistically controlled protocol that repeatedly deposits equal kinetic energy along selected vibrational modes. By amplifying mode-specific responses while tracking the ensuing nonequilibrium evolution, this approach turns energy redistribution into a directly traceable routing process. We find that initial bond cleavage depends strongly on the initially excited mode, rather than being determined by bond-cleavage barriers alone. Specifically, modes that readily trigger reaction efficiently channel energy towards a bond cleavage coordinate, whereas modes that are less effective at inducing break divert energy into soft-like modes or trap it in modes from which energy flow is inefficient.
articles.abstract_zh: 高能材料对外部刺激的反应不仅仅涉及均匀的热化。了解定向能量再分配对于结构和点火设计至关重要。在这里，我们以 TATB 为例，仅从 4,630 个配置中构建了一个振动忠实的机器学习潜力。为了解决难以捉摸的非平衡能量流，我们开发了定向脉冲分子动力学，这是一种统计控制协议，可沿选定的振动模式重复沉积相等的动能。通过放大特定模式的响应，同时跟踪随后的非平衡演化，这种方法将能量重新分配转变为直接可追踪的路由过程。我们发现初始键断裂很大程度上取决于初始激发模式，而不是仅由键断裂势垒决定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高能材料对外部刺激的反应不仅仅涉及均匀的热化。了解定向能量再分配对于结构和点火设计至关重要。在这里，我们以 TATB 为例，仅从 4,630 个配置中构建了一个振动忠实的机器学习潜力。为了解决难以捉摸的非平衡能量流，我们开发了定向脉冲分子动力学，这是一种统计控制协议，可沿选定的振动模式重复沉积相等的动能。通过放大特定模式的响应，同时跟踪随后的非平衡演化，这种方法将能量重新分配转变为直接可追踪的路由过程。我们发现初始键断裂很大程度上取决于初始激发模式，而不是仅由键断裂势垒决定。具体来说，容易触发反应的模式有效地将能量引导至键断裂坐标，而在诱导断裂方面效果较差的模式将能量转移到类似软的模式或将其捕获在能量流效率低下的模式中。

articles.title: Theory of Dispersion and Exchange Interactions Subjected to Surface Roughness in Application to Signal Transmission through a Nanoswitch
articles.title_zh: 受表面粗糙度影响的色散和交换相互作用理论在纳米开关信号传输中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the theoretical description of a resistive nanoswitch designated for a change-over between the two operation modes by calculating the electri elastic, dispersion (van der Waals and Casimir), and also exchange repulsive forces in its configuration with an account of surface roughness. The dispersion forces are described by means of the Lifshitz theory and, at the shortest separations between the interacting bodies, where this theory is inapplicable, by the method of additive summation of the interatomic potentials corrected for the role of the effects of nonadditivity. The exchange repulsion is also found by a summation of the interatomic potentials and using the proximity force approximation. It is shown that the nanoswitch possesses the equilibrium closest separation between a cantilever tip and a ground plate calculated as a function of the actuation voltage and operates in a cyclic manner with no pull-in when this voltage is switched on and off. We have found the tunnel current between a cantilever tip and a plate and investigated distortions appearing in the signal transmitted through a nanoswitch. According to our results, the amplitude distortions arising in the low-frequency information signal can be made sufficiently small by increasing a difference between the amplitudes of the carrier and information signals. Possible applications of the obtained results are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过计算电弹性、色散（范德华和卡西米尔）提出了电阻纳米开关的理论描述，该纳米开关设计用于在两种操作模式之间进行转换，并且还通过考虑表面粗糙度来交换其配置中的排斥力。色散力通过 Lifshitz 理论来描述，并且在相互作用物体之间的最短距离处（该理论不适用），通过原子间势的加性求和方法来描述，该方法针对非加和性效应的作用进行了校正。交换排斥也可以通过原子间势的求和并使用邻近力近似来找到。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过计算电弹性、色散（范德华和卡西米尔）提出了电阻纳米开关的理论描述，该纳米开关设计用于在两种操作模式之间进行转换，并且还通过考虑表面粗糙度来交换其配置中的排斥力。色散力通过 Lifshitz 理论来描述，并且在相互作用物体之间的最短距离处（该理论不适用），通过原子间势的加性求和方法来描述，该方法针对非加和性效应的作用进行了校正。交换排斥也可以通过原子间势的求和并使用邻近力近似来找到。结果表明，纳米开关在悬臂尖端和接地板之间具有平衡最接近的距离，计算为驱动电压的函数，并且当该电压打开和关闭时以循环方式工作，没有吸合。我们发现了悬臂尖端和板之间的隧道电流，并研究了通过纳米开关传输的信号中出现的失真。根据我们的结果，通过增加载波和信息信号的幅度之间的差异，可以使低频信息信号中出现的幅度失真足够小。讨论了所得结果的可能应用。

articles.title: Indirect Control of Buried CoB Spin Textures via C₆₀-Induced Modification of Ir Spin-Orbit Coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过 C₆₀ 诱导的 Ir 自旋轨道耦合修改间接控制埋置 CoB 自旋纹理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how organic materials modulate magnetic structure is a central challenge in organic spintronics. Here, we demonstrate that C₆₀ molecular films exert a pronounced and quantifiable influence on the buried magnetic spin texture in Pt/CoB/Ir based multilayer systems hosting interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (iDMI). Using Lorentz transmission electron microscopy, the magnetic domain behaviour in field-free and in-situ field environments is measured. In Fresnel mode, we reveal a reduction in magnetic domain periodicity upon C₆₀ deposition. Then, using pixelated 4D-STEM differential phase contrast mode, we establish that this modification arises from a substantial enhancement of effective magnetic anisotropy and interfacial DMI strength. Coupled with bulk magnetometry and micromagnetic simulations, we propose a mechanism based on spin-orbit coupling at the C₆₀/Ir interface which modifies the iDMI and drives a contraction of spin texture density throughout the multilayer stack. These findings extend the impact of organic molecular capping films as effective and accessible routes for engineering spin textures to buried magnetic multilayer systems, with direct implications for the design of next-generation spintronic and neuromorphic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解有机材料如何调节磁性结构是有机自旋电子学的一个核心挑战。在这里，我们证明了 C₆₀ 分子薄膜对基于 Pt/CoB/Ir 的多层系统中的埋藏磁自旋织构产生了显着且可量化的影响，该系统具有界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用（iDMI）。使用洛伦兹透射电子显微镜，测量无场和原位场环境中的磁畴行为。在菲涅尔模式下，我们揭示了 C₆₀ 沉积时磁畴周期性的减少。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解有机材料如何调节磁性结构是有机自旋电子学的一个核心挑战。在这里，我们证明了 C₆₀ 分子薄膜对基于 Pt/CoB/Ir 的多层系统中的埋藏磁自旋织构产生了显着且可量化的影响，该系统具有界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用（iDMI）。使用洛伦兹透射电子显微镜，测量无场和原位场环境中的磁畴行为。在菲涅尔模式下，我们揭示了 C₆₀ 沉积时磁畴周期性的减少。然后，使用像素化 4D-STEM 微分相衬模式，我们确定这种修改是由于有效磁各向异性和界面 DMI 强度的大幅增强而产生的。结合体磁力测量和微磁模拟，我们提出了一种基于 C₆₀/Ir 界面处的自旋轨道耦合的机制，该机制修改了 iDMI 并驱动整个多层堆叠中自旋纹理密度的收缩。这些发现扩展了有机分子覆盖膜的影响，作为将自旋纹理工程设计到掩埋磁性多层系统的有效且可访问的途径，对下一代自旋电子和神经形态器件的设计具有直接影响。

articles.title: Low magnon damping of a EuSe film down to millikelvin temperatures
articles.title_zh: EuSe 薄膜的磁振子阻尼低至毫开尔文温度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid development of quantum magnonics over the past decade has created a demand for magnetic materials that keep their magnon losses low at millikelvin temperatures and add functionality beyond that of the established iron garnets and ferromagnetic metals. The europium chalcogenides are natural candidates - they are magnetic semiconductors whose moment of 7,μB per Eu²⁺ ion stems from a half-filled 4f shell with zero orbital momentum, so that spin-orbit coupling and intrinsic damping are expected to be weak. Here we characterize an epitaxial film of the metamagnet EuSe on diamagnetic BaF₂ by magnetometry and broadband ferromagnetic resonance from 10 K down to 30 mK. EuSe combines a saturation magnetization of 1100 kA/m with antiferromagnetic, ferrimagnetic and ferromagnetic phases that are reached with fields below 0.25 T. In contrast to a Gilbert-damped ferromagnet, the linewidth of the field-aligned film decreases with increasing frequency and field, and below 750 mK it no longer depends on temperature. At 30 mK, 68 GHz and 1.8 T, it reaches 5.5 mT, close to the values of bulk single crystals, which corresponds to a magnon lifetime of 2 ns and to an upper bound of 1.1×10⁻³ for the Gilbert damping parameter. These properties make EuSe and the europium chalcogenides promising materials for hybrid quantum systems and quantum magnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 过去十年量子磁振子学的快速发展产生了对磁性材料的需求，这些材料在毫开尔文温度下保持较低的磁振子损耗，并增加了现有铁石榴石和铁磁金属之外的功能。铕硫属化物是天然的候选者——它们是磁性半导体，每个Eu2⁺离子的矩为7,μB，源于轨道动量为零的半填充4f壳，因此自旋轨道耦合和固有阻尼预计较弱。在这里，我们通过磁力测量和从 10 K 到 30 mK 的宽带铁磁共振来表征抗磁 BaF 上的超磁体 EuSe 外延膜。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过去十年量子磁振子学的快速发展产生了对磁性材料的需求，这些材料在毫开尔文温度下保持较低的磁振子损耗，并增加了现有铁石榴石和铁磁金属之外的功能。铕硫属化物是天然的候选者——它们是磁性半导体，每个Eu2⁺离子的矩为7,μB，源于轨道动量为零的半填充4f壳，因此自旋轨道耦合和固有阻尼预计较弱。在这里，我们通过磁力测量和从 10 K 到 30 mK 的宽带铁磁共振来表征抗磁 BaF 上的超磁体 EuSe 外延膜。 EuSe 将 1100 kA/m 的饱和磁化强度与反铁磁、亚铁磁和铁磁相相结合，磁场低于 0.25 T 时即可达到。与吉尔伯特阻尼铁磁体相比，场对准薄膜的线宽随着频率和磁场的增加而减小，而在 750 mK 以下，它不再依赖于温度。在 30 mK、68 GHz 和 1.8 T 下，它达到 5.5 mT，接近块状单晶的值，这对应于 2 ns 的磁振子寿命和吉尔伯特阻尼参数的上限 1.1×10³。这些特性使 EuSe 和铕硫属化物成为混合量子系统和量子磁子学的有前途的材料。

articles.title: Probing Deconfined Quantum Criticality Point on a Digital Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 探测数字量子计算机上的解禁量子临界点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A deconfined quantum critical point (DQCP) is a continuous transition between ordered phases with unrelated broken symmetries, beyond the Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson paradigm. In one dimension, such a transition between a z-polarized ferromagnet (zFM) and a valence-bond solid (VBS) is well established numerically in a frustrated spin-1/2 chain. Here we ask whether a superconducting quantum processor can resolve this transition and its signatures despite finite-size effects and device noise. The ground states are prepared by ancilla-projected quantum imaginary-time evolution (QITE), whose exact target states are compressed by tensor-network optimization into shallow depth quantum circuits. The hardware data distinguish the phases through their order parameters, spin and dimer correlations, structure factors, correlation ratios, and snapshot distributions. The crossing of the order parameters locates the transition, and its finite-size extrapolation lies close to the thermodynamic-limit value obtained from large-scale numerics. A noise model based on the device calibration accounts quantitatively for the reduced amplitudes measured on hardware. Our findings demonstrate that a Landau-forbidden transition between competing orders can be resolved on current quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 解禁量子临界点 (DQCP) 是具有不相关对称性破缺的有序相之间的连续过渡，超出了朗道-金兹堡-威尔逊范式。在一维中，z 极化铁磁体 (zFM) 和价键固体 (VBS) 之间的这种转变在受挫自旋 1/2 链中得到了很好的数值证明。在这里，我们询问超导量子处理器是否可以解决这种转变及其特征，尽管存在有限尺寸效应和设备噪声。基态是通过辅助投影量子虚时演化（QITE）准备的，其精确的目标态通过张量网络优化压缩到浅深度量子电路中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 解禁量子临界点 (DQCP) 是具有不相关对称性破缺的有序相之间的连续过渡，超出了朗道-金兹堡-威尔逊范式。在一维中，z 极化铁磁体 (zFM) 和价键固体 (VBS) 之间的这种转变在受挫自旋 1/2 链中得到了很好的数值证明。在这里，我们询问超导量子处理器是否可以解决这种转变及其特征，尽管存在有限尺寸效应和设备噪声。基态是通过辅助投影量子虚时演化（QITE）准备的，其精确的目标态通过张量网络优化压缩到浅深度量子电路中。硬件数据通过顺序参数、自旋和二聚体相关性、结构因子、相关比和快照分布来区分相。序参数的交叉定位了转变，其有限尺寸外推接近于从大规模数值获得的热力学极限值。基于设备校准的噪声模型定量地解释了硬件上测量到的减小的幅度。我们的研究结果表明，在当前的量子处理器上可以解决竞争阶之间的朗道禁止转换。

articles.title: Coexistence of Altermagnetic and Compensated Ferrimagnetic Motifs in a Noncollinear Multiferroic
articles.title_zh: 非共线多铁性中交变磁体和补偿亚铁磁体的共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collinear compensated magnets with nonrelativistic spin splitting comprise altermagnets (ALMs), whose rotation- or mirror-related opposite-spin sublattices produce momentum-selective splitting that vanishes at Γ, and compensated ferrimagnets (CFIMs), whose symmetry-inequivalent sublattices allow splitting throughout the Brillouin zone, including at Γ. Here, we show that the coplanar noncollinear magnetic state of multiferroic boracite Ni₃B₇O₁₃Cl hosts both motifs on distinct Ni sublattices in real space. The electronic structure and spin texture exhibit coexisting d-wave-like and s-wave-like spin-polarization components associated with the ALM and CFIM motifs, respectively. Opposite ferroelectric states exhibit reversed band-resolved spin polarizations, indicating magnetoelectric coupling, and sign reversals of linear shift and circular injection currents.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有非相对论性自旋分裂的共线补偿磁体包括交变磁体 (ALM) 和补偿亚铁磁体 (CFIM)，交替磁体 (ALM) 的旋转或镜像相关的相反自旋子晶格产生在 Γ 处消失的动量选择性分裂，补偿亚铁磁体 (CFIM) 的对称不等价子晶格允许在整个布里渊区（包括在 Γ 处分裂）。在这里，我们证明了多铁性硼酸石 Ni₃B₇O₁₃Cl 的共面非共线磁态在真实空间中不同的 Ni 亚晶格上承载着两个基序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有非相对论性自旋分裂的共线补偿磁体包括交变磁体 (ALM) 和补偿亚铁磁体 (CFIM)，交替磁体 (ALM) 的旋转或镜像相关的相反自旋子晶格产生在 Γ 处消失的动量选择性分裂，补偿亚铁磁体 (CFIM) 的对称不等价子晶格允许在整个布里渊区（包括在 Γ 处分裂）。在这里，我们证明了多铁性硼酸石 Ni₃B₇O₁₃Cl 的共面非共线磁态在真实空间中不同的 Ni 亚晶格上承载着两个基序。电子结构和自旋织构表现出分别与 ALM 和 CFIM 图案相关的共存的类 d 波和类 s 波自旋极化分量。相反的铁电态表现出反向的带分辨自旋极化，表明磁电耦合以及线性位移和圆形注入电流的符号反转。

articles.title: From Action Principle to Stochastic Thermodynamics of Elastic and Viscous Active Matter
articles.title_zh: 从作用原理到弹性和粘性活性物质的随机热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21835v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the complex material properties of living matter, we derive a framework of stochastic thermo- and elastodynamics for active materials from the classical principle of least action and the Rayleighian formalism for external forces. Our approach couples the local barycentric collective coordinate and the streaming velocity as the canonical conjugate pair, which unifies various descriptions of elastic and viscous soft matter, including Helfrich theory for lipid membranes, linear and nonlinear elasticity of thin shells and deformable droplets, as well as hydrodynamics of active and passive fluids. The Lagrangian mechanics of collective field variables permits direct applications of the results and theorems from statistical mechanics to existing models of complex soft and living matter. To illustrate the potential applications of stochastic elastodynamics in biology, we derive and simulate a boundary-driven deformation model of an elastic cell nucleus in the presence of fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 受生命物质复杂材料特性的启发，我们从经典的最小作用原理和外力的瑞利形式主义中推导出活性材料的随机热力学和弹性动力学框架。我们的方法将局部重心集体坐标和流动速度耦合为规范共轭对，统一了弹性和粘性软物质的各种描述，包括脂质膜的赫尔弗里希理论、薄壳和可变形液滴的线性和非线性弹性，以及主动和被动流体的流体动力学。集体场变量的拉格朗日力学允许将统计力学的结果和定理直接应用于复杂软物质和生命物质的现有模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受生命物质复杂材料特性的启发，我们从经典的最小作用原理和外力的瑞利形式主义中推导出活性材料的随机热力学和弹性动力学框架。我们的方法将局部重心集体坐标和流动速度耦合为规范共轭对，统一了弹性和粘性软物质的各种描述，包括脂质膜的赫尔弗里希理论、薄壳和可变形液滴的线性和非线性弹性，以及主动和被动流体的流体动力学。集体场变量的拉格朗日力学允许将统计力学的结果和定理直接应用于复杂软物质和生命物质的现有模型。为了说明随机弹性动力学在生物学中的潜在应用，我们推导并模拟了存在波动时弹性细胞核的边界驱动变形模型。

articles.title: Interlocked Vortex Order in the Frustrated A₃V₉Te₁₃ Lattice (A=Cs,Rb)
articles.title_zh: 受抑 A₃V₉Te₁₃ 晶格中的互锁涡序 (A=Cs,Rb)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently synthesized A₃V₉Te₁₃ (A = Cs, Rb) provides a unique platform for exploring the interplay between geometric frustration, magnetism, and correlated electronic states beyond conventional kagome systems. Based on first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the frustrated V sublattice naturally stabilizes a robust vortex or anti-vortex antiferromagnetic ground state, whose total energy is substantially lower than all other configurations. In addition, the Heisenberg model analysis show strong constraints on the ground state magnetic configuration, such that fixing spin configuration of 1 triangle propagates and fixes all others. The vortex or anti-vortex phase hosts electronic structures reminiscent of kagome metals, including Dirac-like band crossings, van Hove singularities, and flat bands near the Fermi level. Owing to the noncollinear spin texture and quasi-two-dimensional magnetic character, the Néel temperature exhibits an extremely weak dependence on both the magnitude and direction of external magnetic fields, consistent with experimental observations. For Cs-based compound, the ground state band structure is metallic with 6 Weyl points in the BZ; while for the Rb-based compound, spin--orbit coupling opens an approximately 27-meV gap at ambient pressure due to the lifted C₃ symmetry. Our results establish A₃V₉Te₁₃ as a promising platform for studying frustration-driven chiral magnetism and its interplay with topological electronic states.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近合成的 A₃V₉Te₁₃（A = Cs，Rb）提供了一个独特的平台，用于探索传统 Kagome 系统之外的几何挫败、磁性和相关电子态之间的相互作用。基于第一性原理计算，我们证明了受挫 V 子晶格自然地稳定了鲁棒涡旋或反涡旋反铁磁基态，其总能量远低于所有其他配置。此外，海森堡模型分析显示对基态磁构型的强烈约束，使得1个三角形的固定自旋构型传播并固定所有其他三角形。涡旋或反涡旋相的电子结构让人想起戈薇金属，包括狄拉克式能带交叉、范霍夫奇点和费米能级附近的平带。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近合成的 A₃V₉Te₁₃（A = Cs，Rb）提供了一个独特的平台，用于探索传统 Kagome 系统之外的几何挫败、磁性和相关电子态之间的相互作用。基于第一性原理计算，我们证明了受挫 V 子晶格自然地稳定了鲁棒涡旋或反涡旋反铁磁基态，其总能量远低于所有其他配置。此外，海森堡模型分析显示对基态磁构型的强烈约束，使得1个三角形的固定自旋构型传播并固定所有其他三角形。涡旋或反涡旋相的电子结构让人想起戈薇金属，包括狄拉克式能带交叉、范霍夫奇点和费米能级附近的平带。由于非共线自旋结构和准二维磁特性，尼尔温度对外部磁场的大小和方向表现出极弱的依赖性，这与实验观察结果一致。对于Cs基化合物，基态能带结构是金属性的，BZ中有6个Weyl点；而对于铷基化合物，由于 C₃ 对称性的提升，自旋轨道耦合在环境压力下打开了大约 27 meV 的间隙。我们的结果表明 A₃V₉Te₁₃ 是一个有前途的平台，用于研究挫败驱动的手性磁性及其与拓扑电子态的相互作用。

articles.title: Twist-controlled thermodynamic anomalies in bilayer q-state clock models
articles.title_zh: 双层 q 态时钟模型中扭转控制的热力学异常
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twist has emerged as a geometric means of controlling collective behavior across a wide range of physical systems. Whether it can qualitatively reorganize the thermodynamic anomalies of discrete spin models, and how such changes relate to microscopic spin configurations, remains less explored. Here we demonstrate twist-controlled thermodynamic anomalies in ferromagnetic bilayer q-state clock models using Monte Carlo simulations. With sufficiently strong interlayer coupling, twisting changes the number and structure of specific-heat peaks: a single peak can split into two, or two peaks can merge into one, depending on the number of allowed spin orientations. These changes are nonmonotonic in twist angle and occur over narrower parameter ranges, or are absent, for the larger q values examined. The accompanying spin textures and vortex distributions suggest a physical picture in which moire modulation of the interlayer coupling reorganizes local spin alignment and topological defects. In a representative case, peak splitting coincides with nearly uniform spin regions arranged on the moire scale and a reduced vortex population. These findings identify twist as a control parameter for the collective thermal response of discrete spin systems and raise the possibility of modified phase-transition behavior, including the emergence or suppression of an intermediate Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless phase.
articles.abstract_zh: Twist 已成为控制各种物理系统中集体行为的几何手段。它是否能够定性地重组离散自旋模型的热力学异常，以及这些变化与微观自旋构型的关系，仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们使用蒙特卡罗模拟演示了铁磁双层 q 态时钟模型中扭转控制的热力学异常。通过足够强的层间耦合，扭转会改变比热峰的数量和结构：单个峰可以分成两个，或者两个峰可以合并为一个，具体取决于允许的自旋方向的数量。这些变化在扭转角上是非单调的，并且在较窄的参数范围内发生，或者对于所检查的较大 q 值不存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Twist 已成为控制各种物理系统中集体行为的几何手段。它是否能够定性地重组离散自旋模型的热力学异常，以及这些变化与微观自旋构型的关系，仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们使用蒙特卡罗模拟演示了铁磁双层 q 态时钟模型中扭转控制的热力学异常。通过足够强的层间耦合，扭转会改变比热峰的数量和结构：单个峰可以分成两个，或者两个峰可以合并为一个，具体取决于允许的自旋方向的数量。这些变化在扭转角上是非单调的，并且在较窄的参数范围内发生，或者对于所检查的较大 q 值不存在。伴随的自旋纹理和涡流分布暗示了一幅物理图片，其中层间耦合的莫尔条纹调制重新组织了局部自旋对准和拓扑缺陷。在代表性情况下，峰值分裂与莫尔尺度上排列的几乎均匀的自旋区域和减少的涡旋数量一致。这些发现将扭曲确定为离散自旋系统集体热响应的控制参数，并提出了修改相变行为的可能性，包括中间 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 相的出现或抑制。

articles.title: Spin-1/2 Heisenberg diamond-like decorated honeycomb lattice in a magnetic field from the perspective of localized magnons and exact diagonalization
articles.title_zh: 从局域磁振子和精确对角化的角度看磁场中自旋1/2海森堡类金刚石装饰蜂窝晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 quantum Heisenberg model on the diamond-decorated honeycomb lattice in a magnetic field is investigated using complementary analytical and numerical methods. The ground-state phase diagram comprises Lieb-Mattis ferrimagnetic, dimer-tetramer, monomer-dimer, spin-canted, and saturated paramagnetic phases, giving rise to characteristic magnetization plateaus, continuous and discontinuous field-induced transitions. In the highly frustrated regime, a localized-magnon approach based on an effective classical lattice-gas model provides an accurate description of the low-temperature magnetism and thermodynamics in agreement with numerical results. At intermediate frustration, finite-temperature calculations reveal characteristic specific-heat signatures of the field-induced transitions including the development of Ising critical behavior at the field-induced transition between the monomer-dimer and Lieb-Mattis ferrimagnetic phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用互补的分析和数值方法研究了磁场中金刚石装饰的蜂窝晶格的自旋 1/2 量子海森堡模型。基态相图包括利布-马蒂斯亚铁磁相、二聚体-四聚体、单体-二聚体、自旋倾斜相和饱和顺磁相，产生特征磁化平台、连续和不连续场诱导转变。在高度受挫状态下，基于有效经典晶格气体模型的局域磁振子方法提供了与数值结果一致的低温磁性和热力学的准确描述。在中间挫折时，有限温度计算揭示了场诱导转变的特征比热特征，包括单体二聚体和利布-马蒂斯亚铁磁相之间场诱导转变时伊辛临界行为的发展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用互补的分析和数值方法研究了磁场中金刚石装饰的蜂窝晶格的自旋 1/2 量子海森堡模型。基态相图包括利布-马蒂斯亚铁磁相、二聚体-四聚体、单体-二聚体、自旋倾斜相和饱和顺磁相，产生特征磁化平台、连续和不连续场诱导转变。在高度受挫状态下，基于有效经典晶格气体模型的局域磁振子方法提供了与数值结果一致的低温磁性和热力学的准确描述。在中间挫折时，有限温度计算揭示了场诱导转变的特征比热特征，包括单体二聚体和利布-马蒂斯亚铁磁相之间场诱导转变时伊辛临界行为的发展。

articles.title: Exciton superfluidity in two-dimensional bilayers at zero and high magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 零磁场和高磁场下二维双层中的激子超流性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study interlayer exciton superfluidity versus layer separation in two-dimensional electron-hole bilayers at zero magnetic field and quantum Hall bilayers at total filling ν_T=1. Unscreened Hartree-Fock theory predicts coherence at every finite separation, with an energy scale decaying inversely with separation at large distances. We examine how screening, correlations, and spatial instabilities modify this prediction. At zero field, we solve the linearized gap equation with the full momentum and frequency dependence of the interaction screened within the random-phase approximation, without an imposed cutoff. The apparent plasmon enhancement of pairing in the ladder approximation is largely cancelled by the second-order crossed-rung correction. Static screening determines the leading pairing exponent in the controlled high-density limit at fixed separation. At large separation, the pairing scale falls exponentially with squared separation while the instability persists. Extending this result to fixed density assumes Fermi-liquid layers and higher-order dynamical corrections subleading to the static pairing interaction. At high field, we obtain an analytic uniform Hartree-Fock saddle point in the lowest Landau level, coherent at every finite separation. Within Hartree-Fock theory, its finite-wave-vector collective-mode instability favors an excitonic supersolid, distinguishing loss of spatial uniformity from loss of coherence. We conjecture that the quantum Hall bilayer evolves continuously toward weak pairing of composite fermions, with a scale far below the mean-field prediction at large separation. This suppression could produce an apparent critical separation at finite temperature without a ground-state quantum phase transition. The comparison separates the existence, energy scale, and spatial stability of interlayer coherence.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了零磁场下二维电子空穴双层和总填充 ν_T=1 下量子霍尔双层中的层间激子超流性与层分离的关系。未屏蔽的 Hartree-Fock 理论预测了每次有限分离时的相干性，能量尺度与大距离分离呈反比衰减。我们研究筛选、相关性和空间不稳定性如何修改这一预测。在零场处，我们求解线性间隙方程，其具有在随机相位近似内筛选的相互作用的完整动量和频率依赖性，而没有强加的截止。阶梯近似中配对的明显等离子体增强在很大程度上被二阶交叉梯级校正所抵消。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了零磁场下二维电子空穴双层和总填充 ν_T=1 下量子霍尔双层中的层间激子超流性与层分离的关系。未屏蔽的 Hartree-Fock 理论预测了每次有限分离时的相干性，能量尺度与大距离分离呈反比衰减。我们研究筛选、相关性和空间不稳定性如何修改这一预测。在零场处，我们求解线性间隙方程，其具有在随机相位近似内筛选的相互作用的完整动量和频率依赖性，而没有强加的截止。阶梯近似中配对的明显等离子体增强在很大程度上被二阶交叉梯级校正所抵消。静态筛选确定固定间隔下受控高密度限制内的主要配对指数。在大分离时，配对规模随着分离的平方呈指数下降，同时不稳定性仍然存在。将此结果扩展到固定密度假设费米液体层和高阶动态校正导致静态配对相互作用。在高场下，我们在最低 Landau 能级中获得了一个解析均匀 Hartree-Fock 鞍点，在每个有限间隔处都是相干的。在哈特里-福克理论中，其有限波矢量集体模式不稳定性有利于激子超固体，区分空间均匀性的损失和相干性的损失。我们推测，量子霍尔双层不断向复合费米子的弱配对演化，其规模远低于大分离时的平均场预测。这种抑制可以在有限温度下产生明显的临界分离，而无需基态量子相变。比较区分了层间相干性的存在、能量尺度和空间稳定性。

articles.title: Pt-induced semimetallic transport and enhanced thermoelectric response in the half-Heusler alloy YNi₀.₅Pt₀.₅Bi
articles.title_zh: 半霍斯勒合金 YNi₀.₅Pt₀.₅Bi 中 Pt 诱导的半金属输运和增强的热电响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22253v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Half-Heusler alloys provide a versatile platform for tuning electronic and thermal transport through chemical substitution. Here, we investigate the thermoelectric and magnetotransport properties of spark-plasma-sintered YNi₀.₅Pt₀.₅Bi. Partial substitution of Ni by Pt drives YNiBi toward semimetallic transport, characterized by hole-dominated conduction, a low Hall carrier concentration of mathrm1.9 × 10¹⁹ cm⁻³, and a sizeable nonsaturating magnetoresistance of 18% at 300 K under 14 T. Compared with YNiBi, Pt alloying increases the room-temperature Seebeck coefficient from approximately 90 to 130 mathrmμ V K⁻¹, while reducing the thermal conductivity to 3.15 mathrmW m⁻¹ K⁻¹. Single-parabolic-band analysis indicates an enhanced carrier effective mass, resulting in a room-temperature power factor of 13.7 mathrmμ W cm⁻¹ K⁻² and a figure of merit (zT= 0.13). First-principles calculations further show a Pt-induced closing of the electronic band gap and a low density of states near the Fermi level, consistent with the experimentally observed semimetal-like transport. These results demonstrate that Ni/Pt alloying provides an effective route for simultaneously tuning the electronic, magnetotransport, and thermoelectric properties of YNiBi-based half-Heusler compounds.
articles.abstract_zh: Half-Heusler 合金提供了一个多功能平台，可通过化学替代来调节电子和热传输。在这里，我们研究了火花等离子体烧结的 YNi₀.₅Pt₀.₅Bi 的热电和磁输运特性。 Pt 部分取代 Ni 驱动 YNiBi 向半金属输运方向发展，其特点是空穴主导传导、mathrm1.9 × 10⁹ cm³ 的低霍尔载流子浓度以及 14 T 下 300 K 时 18% 的相当大的非饱和磁阻。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Half-Heusler 合金提供了一个多功能平台，可通过化学替代来调节电子和热传输。在这里，我们研究了火花等离子体烧结的 YNi₀.₅Pt₀.₅Bi 的热电和磁输运特性。 Pt 部分取代 Ni 驱动 YNiBi 向半金属输运方向发展，其特点是空穴主导传导、mathrm1.9 × 10⁹ cm³ 的低霍尔载流子浓度以及 14 T 下 300 K 时 18% 的相当大的非饱和磁阻。与 YNiBi 相比，Pt 合金化将室温塞贝克系数从约 90 mathrmμ V 提高到 130 mathrmμ V K⁻1，同时将热导率降低至 3.15 mathrmW m⁻1 K⁻1。单抛物线带分析表明载体有效质量增强，室温功率因数为 13.7 mathrmμ W cm-1 K-2 和品质因数 (zT= 0.13)。第一性原理计算进一步表明，Pt 引起的电子带隙闭合和费米能级附近的低态密度，与实验观察到的类半金属输运一致。这些结果表明，Ni/Pt 合金化提供了同时调节 YNiBi 基半霍斯勒化合物的电子、磁输运和热电性能的有效途径。

articles.title: From picometre displacements to a three-dimensional lattice gas of polar skyrmions
articles.title_zh: 从皮米位移到极性斯格明子的三维晶格气体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22309v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polar skyrmions, the electric analogues of magnetic skyrmions, form arrays in PbTiO3/SrTiO3 superlattices that are known to be only short-range ordered, but how this disordered ensemble is organized in three dimensions, and how its microscopic structure underlies this organization, have remained largely inaccessible. Here, using three-dimensional difference pair distribution function (3D-ΔPDF) analysis of X-ray diffuse scattering, we show that the polar skyrmion bubbles form a three-dimensional lattice gas: they occupy discrete sites, but their order extends over only a few neighbours and is two to three times stronger across the SrTiO3 spacers than within a layer. This interlayer coupling is consistent with the polarization of the bubbles extending into the spacers. Within each bubble, the polarization rotates in a predominantly Néel-type manner, and Pb and Ti rotate together with comparable picometre displacements, demonstrating that both A- and B-site cations take part in the polar distortion.
articles.abstract_zh: 极性斯格明子（磁性斯格明子的电类似物）在 PbTiO3/SrTiO3 超晶格中形成阵列，已知这些阵列仅是短程有序的，但这种无序系综如何在三个维度上组织，以及其微观结构如何构成这种组织，仍然在很大程度上难以理解。在这里，利用 X 射线漫散射的三维差分对分布函数 (3D-ΔPDF) 分析，我们表明极性斯格明子气泡形成三维晶格气体：它们占据离散位置，但它们的有序度仅延伸到几个邻居，并且在 SrTiO3 间隔物上的有序度比在层内的有序度强两到三倍。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 极性斯格明子（磁性斯格明子的电类似物）在 PbTiO3/SrTiO3 超晶格中形成阵列，已知这些阵列仅是短程有序的，但这种无序系综如何在三个维度上组织，以及其微观结构如何构成这种组织，仍然在很大程度上难以理解。在这里，利用 X 射线漫散射的三维差分对分布函数 (3D-ΔPDF) 分析，我们表明极性斯格明子气泡形成三维晶格气体：它们占据离散位置，但它们的有序度仅延伸到几个邻居，并且在 SrTiO3 间隔物上的有序度比在层内的有序度强两到三倍。这种层间耦合与延伸到间隔物中的气泡的偏振一致。在每个气泡内，极化主要以尼尔型方式旋转，并且 Pb 和 Ti 以相当的皮米位移一起旋转，表明 A 位和 B 位阳离子都参与极性畸变。

articles.title: Parafermions in polarized ν=2/3 Fractional Quantum (Anomalous) Hall Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 偏振 ν=2/3 分数量子（反常）霍尔异质结构中的平费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22348v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent experimental signatures of fractional Chern insulators in 2D quantum materials, we investigate the realization of mathbb Z₃ parafermion zero modes (PZMs) on edges of spin-polarized ν=2/3 fractional quantum Hall states which are proximitized by superconductors. Unlike the spin-unpolarized Halperin state, the polarized ν=2/3 edge contains counterpropagating electron and fractional quasihole modes, giving rise to a plethora of competing tunneling and pairing processes. We focus on the vicinity of the fixed point where these modes reorganize into decoupled charge and neutral sectors, with the neutral sector describing an emergent dipole degree of freedom. Using bosonization and renormalization group analysis, we lay out the parameter space in which the interedge dipole interactions gap the neutral sector to stabilize one dominant tunneling and one dominant pairing channel resulting in a double sine-Gordon model in the charge sector which supports Z₃ PZMs at domain walls. We discuss both clean and disordered systems. In clean systems this mechanism requires a certain degree of control of the interaction strength and range. In contrast, disorder can provide a more generic route: While short-ranged, edge-uncorrelated disorder % on the two edges suppresses the simultaneous pinning required for stable parafermion modes, when the disorder on the two edges is sufficiently correlated, as expected for smooth disorder potentials, the parameter regime hosting PZMs increases.
articles.abstract_zh: 受二维量子材料中分数陈绝缘体最近实验特征的启发，我们研究了在邻近超导体的自旋极化 ν=2/3 分数量子霍尔态边缘上 mathbb Z₃ 平费米子零模式 (PZM) 的实现。与自旋非极化 Halperin 态不同，极化 ν=2/3 边缘包含反向传播电子和分数准空穴模式，从而产生大量竞争性隧道和配对过程。我们关注固定点附近，这些模式在此处重组为解耦电荷和中性部分，其中中性部分描述了新兴偶极子自由度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受二维量子材料中分数陈绝缘体最近实验特征的启发，我们研究了在邻近超导体的自旋极化 ν=2/3 分数量子霍尔态边缘上 mathbb Z₃ 平费米子零模式 (PZM) 的实现。与自旋非极化 Halperin 态不同，极化 ν=2/3 边缘包含反向传播电子和分数准空穴模式，从而产生大量竞争性隧道和配对过程。我们关注固定点附近，这些模式在此处重组为解耦电荷和中性部分，其中中性部分描述了新兴偶极子自由度。使用玻色子化和重正化群分析，我们布置了参数空间，其中边缘偶极子相互作用使中性部分间隙，以稳定一个主要的隧道效应和一个主要的配对通道，从而在电荷部分中形成双正弦戈登模型，该模型在畴壁处支持 Z₃ PZM。我们讨论干净的系统和无序的系统。在清洁系统中，这种机制需要对相互作用的强度和范围进行一定程度的控制。相反，无序可以提供更通用的途径：虽然两个边缘上的短程、边缘不相关的无序%抑制了稳定平费米子模式所需的同时钉扎，但当两个边缘上的无序充分相关时，正如平滑无序势所预期的那样，托管PZM的参数范围会增加。

articles.title: Band-Resolved Superconducting Gaps via the Thermal Hall Effect in CeRu2
articles.title_zh: 通过 CeRu2 中的热霍尔效应实现带分辨超导能隙
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Standard bulk probes of multiband superconductors cannot assign pairing gaps to specific electron or hole Fermi surfaces. Here we show that thermal Hall transport (κₓy), constrained by specific heat and normal-state magnetotransport, resolves this ambiguity in the compensated heavy-fermion superconductor CeRu₂. Fixing the gap magnitudes (Δₑ/k_Bapprox 13K, Δₕ/k_Bapprox 8K) and band mobilities completely determines the electronic degrees of freedom in κₓₓ and κₓy. A low-field sign reversal in κₓy places the larger gap on the heavy Ce 4f electron sheets and the smaller on the hole sheets.
articles.abstract_zh: 多带超导体的标准体探针无法将配对间隙分配给特定的电子或空穴费米表面。在这里，我们展示了受比热和正常状态磁输运约束的热霍尔输运 (κₓy)，解决了补偿重费米子超导体 CeRu2 中的这种模糊性。固定能隙大小（Δₑ/k_Bapprox 13K，Δₕ/k_Bapprox 8K）和能带迁移率完全确定了 κₓₓ 和 κₓy 中的电子自由度。 κₓy 中的低场符号反转使重 Ce 4f 电子片上的能隙较大，而孔片上的能隙较小。

articles.title: Thermodynamically Consistent Machine Learning for Fracture Prediction in Heterogeneous Materials
articles.title_zh: 用于异质材料断裂预测的热力学一致机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20614v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding fracture behavior is critical for assessing the structural integrity and longevity. Highly time-consuming physics-based fracture simulations motivate the development of machine-learning-based fracture evolution prediction with surrogate models. However, most existing machine-learning models for fracture prediction operate as black boxes and require large training datasets to generalize reliably. In this work, Thermodynamically Consistent Latent Dynamics Identification (tLaSDI) for parametric systems is introduced to predict fracture patterns and evolution in heterogeneous materials. The model learns the thermodynamic state variable in a lower-dimensional latent space using parametric GENERIC Formalism-Informed Neural Networks (pGFINNs) that enforce key thermodynamic principles, such as total energy conservation and entropy generation. This model embeds physics into the neural network architecture using a hard-constraint method that inherently complies with the underlying thermodynamic principles. The proposed tLaSDI-pGFINNs is further enhanced by a Geometry-Conditioned Autoencoder in learning the geometry configuration for effective geometry-guided learning. The energy and entropy evolution histories demonstrate that the model preserves the thermodynamic constraints on unseen testing samples. The results further show that tLaSDI-pGFINNs can more accurately capture both fracture patterns and the subsequent fracture evolution than the purely data-driven Autoencoder Long Short-Term Memory (AE-LSTM) model.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解断裂行为对于评估结构完整性和寿命至关重要。高度耗时的基于物理的断裂模拟促进了基于机器学习的替代模型断裂演化预测的发展。然而，大多数现有的断裂预测机器学习模型都是作为黑匣子运行的，需要大量的训练数据集才能可靠地概括。在这项工作中，引入参数系统的热力学一致潜在动力学识别（tLaSDI）来预测异质材料的断裂模式和演化。该模型使用参数化通用形式主义通知神经网络 (pGFINN) 来学习低维潜在空间中的热力学状态变量，该网络强制执行关键的热力学原理，例如总能量守恒和熵生成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解断裂行为对于评估结构完整性和寿命至关重要。高度耗时的基于物理的断裂模拟促进了基于机器学习的替代模型断裂演化预测的发展。然而，大多数现有的断裂预测机器学习模型都是作为黑匣子运行的，需要大量的训练数据集才能可靠地概括。在这项工作中，引入参数系统的热力学一致潜在动力学识别（tLaSDI）来预测异质材料的断裂模式和演化。该模型使用参数化通用形式主义通知神经网络 (pGFINN) 来学习低维潜在空间中的热力学状态变量，该网络强制执行关键的热力学原理，例如总能量守恒和熵生成。该模型使用本质上符合基本热力学原理的硬约束方法将物理学嵌入到神经网络架构中。所提出的 tLaSDI-pGFINN 通过几何条件自动编码器在学习几何配置方面得到进一步增强，以实现有效的几何引导学习。能量和熵演化历史表明该模型保留了对未见过的测试样本的热力学约束。结果进一步表明，与纯数据驱动的自动编码器长短期记忆 (AE-LSTM) 模型相比，tLaSDI-pGFINN 可以更准确地捕获断裂模式和随后的断裂演化。

articles.title: Region bounds, error margins and certified positivity in the numerical conformal bootstrap; Or the first mathematically rigorous bounds on the 3d Ising CFT critical exponents
articles.title_zh: 数值共形引导程序中的区域边界、误差范围和经认证的正值；或者 3d Ising CFT 临界指数的第一个数学严格界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20701v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Numerical conformal bootstrap bounds are commonly called rigorous, yet as published they are not theorems: they hold at sampled points rather than on regions of parameter space, for truncated rational approximations of the conformal blocks, for a finite list of spins, and up to floating-point rounding. We close all four gaps. We show how to search efficiently for functionals positive on regions, including external-dimension space; how positivity on the large-spin crossing vectors can be imposed as such a region constraint; how new analytic bounds on the conformal-block recursion relations give functionals positive on the true, untruncated crossing vectors; and how to certify the positivity of these functionals in exact arithmetic. The certification rests on Bernstein-basis positivity certificates in up to three variables, exact arithmetic in Q(sqrt2), a compactified treatment of the infinite spin tail, and an explicit bound on the difference between the true blocks and their truncations, so that infinitely many positivity conditions reduce to finitely many machine-checked sign conditions. As a flagship application we certify an exclusion region in the (Δ_σ,Δ_ϵ) plane: for Δ_σin[0.505,0.5405] all of Δ_ϵin(1/2,3] is excluded except a small rectangle containing the 3d Ising island, giving rigorous two-sided bounds on the critical exponents η and ν under explicitly stated spectrum assumptions. The analytic inputs for the mixed σ-ϵ system, which would remove the spin-2 gap assumption, are also proved.
