The same methods prevent common practical failure modes and can make bootstrap searches faster: region bounds turn the mapping of an island into a handful of one-dimensional bisections. The essential code to reproduce the search and the certification, and all machine-checkable certificates, are released.
articles.abstract_zh: 数值共形自举边界通常被称为严格的，但正如所发表的那样，它们不是定理：它们适用于采样点而不是参数空间区域，适用于共形块的截断有理近似，适用于有限的自旋列表，直至浮点舍入。我们弥补了所有四个差距。我们展示了如何有效地搜索区域上的正函数，包括外部维度空间；如何将大自旋交叉向量的正值作为这样的区域约束施加；共形块递归关系上的新解析界限如何在真实的、未截断的交叉向量上给出正函数；以及如何用精确算术证明这些泛函的正性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数值共形自举边界通常被称为严格的，但正如所发表的那样，它们不是定理：它们适用于采样点而不是参数空间区域，适用于共形块的截断有理近似，适用于有限的自旋列表，直至浮点舍入。我们弥补了所有四个差距。我们展示了如何有效地搜索区域上的正函数，包括外部维度空间；如何将大自旋交叉向量的正值作为这样的区域约束施加；共形块递归关系上的新解析界限如何在真实的、未截断的交叉向量上给出正函数；以及如何用精确算术证明这些泛函的正性。该认证依赖于最多三个变量的 Bernstein 正性证明、Q(sqrt2) 中的精确算术、无限自旋尾部的紧凑处理以及真实块与其截断之间差异的显式界限，以便无限多个正性条件减少为有限多个机器检查的符号条件。作为旗舰应用，我们验证 (Δ_σ,Δ_ϵ) 平面中的排除区域：对于 Δ_σin[0.505,0.5405]，除了包含 3d Ising 岛的小矩形之外，所有 Δ_ϵin(1/2,3] 都被排除，在明确规定的频谱假设下给出临界指数 η 和 ν 的严格两侧界限。混合 σ-ϵ 系统的分析输入，其中也证明了可以消除 spin-2 间隙假设，同样的方法可以防止常见的实际故障模式，并且可以使引导搜索更快：区域边界将岛的映射转变为少数一维二分法，以重现搜索和认证以及所有机器可检查的证书。

articles.title: Standard and Bipolar Rectification in Tilted Periodically-Driven Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 倾斜周期驱动量子系统中的标准和双极整流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20765v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Developing mechanisms to control transport in correlated quantum systems is essential for advancing quantum circuit technologies. In this work, we establish a rectification mechanism for both particle and energy flow in a fermionic system coupled to external baths, in the presence of a tilted potential modulated locally by a time-periodic drive. The drive generates particle and energy currents even in the absence of chemical or thermal bias between the baths. These drive-induced currents are enhanced at resonant frequencies at which avoided crossings occur in the Floquet quasienergy spectrum, reflecting the role of the Floquet states as intermediate channels for transport. Once a bias between the baths is introduced, the drive-induced current contribution can reinforce, compete with, or even cancel the bias-induced contribution. These effects enable rectification in the non-interacting regime, which we quantify via the rectification coefficient R. This coefficient measures the asymmetry between transport up the tilt (forward bias) and down the tilt (reverse bias). In addition to standard rectification, where transport is reduced under reverse bias, we identify a regime of bipolar rectification, in which the current flows only up the tilt regardless of the bias polarity. At the boundary between standard and bipolar regimes, the system achieves perfect rectification, corresponding to complete suppression of the reverse-bias current. In the presence of interactions between particles, the parameter region that supports bipolar rectification is enlarged and R can be enhanced by many orders of magnitude. Our results establish a rectification mechanism for particle and energy transport that can be experimentally realized in condensed matter and cold atom systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 开发控制相关量子系统中传输的机制对于推进量子电路技术至关重要。在这项工作中，我们在存在由时间周期驱动局部调制的倾斜电势的情况下，为与外部浴耦合的费米子系统中的粒子和能量流建立了整流机制。即使浴槽之间没有化学或热偏差，驱动器也会产生粒子和能量流。这些驱动感应电流在 Floquet 准能谱中避免发生交叉的谐振频率处增强，反映了 Floquet 态作为传输中间通道的作用。一旦在浴槽之间引入偏置，驱动感应电流贡献就可以增强、竞争甚至抵消偏置感应电流贡献。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开发控制相关量子系统中传输的机制对于推进量子电路技术至关重要。在这项工作中，我们在存在由时间周期驱动局部调制的倾斜电势的情况下，为与外部浴耦合的费米子系统中的粒子和能量流建立了整流机制。即使浴槽之间没有化学或热偏差，驱动器也会产生粒子和能量流。这些驱动感应电流在 Floquet 准能谱中避免发生交叉的谐振频率处增强，反映了 Floquet 态作为传输中间通道的作用。一旦在浴槽之间引入偏置，驱动感应电流贡献就可以增强、竞争甚至抵消偏置感应电流贡献。这些效应可以在非相互作用状态下进行整流，我们通过整流系数 R 对其进行量化。该系数测量向上倾斜（前向偏置）和向下倾斜（反向偏置）传输之间的不对称性。除了在反向偏压下传输减少的标准整流之外，我们还确定了双极整流机制，其中无论偏置极性如何，电流仅沿倾斜方向流动。在标准和双极状态之间的边界处，系统实现了完美整流，对应于反向偏置电流的完全抑制。在粒子之间存在相互作用的情况下，支持双极整流的参数区域被扩大，并且 R 可以增强多个数量级。我们的研究结果建立了一种粒子和能量传输的整流机制，可以在凝聚态物质和冷原子系统中通过实验实现。

articles.title: The Magic Barrier: A Universal Feature of Quantum Thermalization
articles.title_zh: 魔障：量子热化的普遍特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20768v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that the emergence of a ``magic barrier'', characterized by a transient maximum of nonstabilizerness during rapid entanglement growth, is a universal feature of thermalization within quantum ergodic theories, which is intimately connected to random matrix spectral properties. Starting from a pure product state, we analytically determine the time evolution of entanglement entropy, antiflatness, capacity of entanglement, and nonlocal trace distance magic under unitary dynamics generated by random matrix Hamiltonians drawn from all three Gaussian ensembles. We find that the transient maxima of antiflatness, capacity of entanglement, and nonlocal magic occur on the same characteristic timescale as the maximum rate of entanglement growth. These results establish that the magic barrier is a universal feature of RMT thermalization, suggesting universality across quantum chaotic systems. We conclude that quantitative simulations of thermalization in ergodic quantum theories inherently require quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，“魔障”的出现是量子遍历理论中热化的普遍特征，其特征是在快速纠缠增长过程中瞬时最大非稳定性，它与随机矩阵光谱特性密切相关。从纯乘积态开始，我们分析确定了由从所有三个高斯系综中抽取的随机矩阵哈密顿量生成的酉动力学下纠缠熵、反平坦性、纠缠能力和非局部迹距离魔法的时间演化。我们发现反平坦性、纠缠能力和非局部魔力的瞬态最大值与纠缠增长的最大速率发生在相同的特征时间尺度上。这些结果表明，魔障是 RMT 热化的普遍特征，表明量子混沌系统的普遍性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，“魔障”的出现是量子遍历理论中热化的普遍特征，其特征是在快速纠缠增长过程中瞬时最大非稳定性，它与随机矩阵光谱特性密切相关。从纯乘积态开始，我们分析确定了由从所有三个高斯系综中抽取的随机矩阵哈密顿量生成的酉动力学下纠缠熵、反平坦性、纠缠能力和非局部迹距离魔法的时间演化。我们发现反平坦性、纠缠能力和非局部魔力的瞬态最大值与纠缠增长的最大速率发生在相同的特征时间尺度上。这些结果表明，魔障是 RMT 热化的普遍特征，表明量子混沌系统的普遍性。我们得出的结论是，遍历量子理论中热化的定量模拟本质上需要量子计算。

articles.title: Vision-Guided Closed-Loop Autonomous Navigation of Light-Driven Janus Microbots
articles.title_zh: 光驱动 Janus 微型机器人的视觉引导闭环自主导航
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21222v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Artificial microbots capable of precise and autonomous navigation could provide versatile platforms for microscale transport, manipulation, and task execution in complex environments. However, reliable navigation becomes increasingly challenging at the micrometre scale, particularly when the surrounding environment changes dynamically. Here, we develop a vision-guided closed-loop navigation framework for light-driven cube-shaped hematite/TiO2 Janus microbots with a characteristic size of approximately 3 μm. Real-time visual localization using a custom-trained YOLOv11 object-detection model is integrated with discretized waypoint-based magnetic steering to enable precise navigation along complex prescribed trajectories, with more than 90% of the measured trajectory deviations remaining below 6 μm across the tested path geometries. The framework further enables arbitrary user-defined free-hand trajectories and autonomous navigation through a physically confined maze. In dynamically changing environments, A* path planning enables real-time path replanning while avoiding multiple independently swimming 5 μm spherical Janus micromotors. Finally, the microbot selectively captures multiple cargo particles and autonomously transports and delivers them to a predefined location while simultaneously avoiding dynamic obstacles. These results establish an integrated platform combining programmable trajectory control, autonomous path planning, real-time environmental adaptation, and task execution within a single light-driven Janus microbot system.
articles.abstract_zh: 能够精确自主导航的人造微型机器人可以为复杂环境中的微型运输、操纵和任务执行提供多功能平台。然而，在微米尺度上可靠的导航变得越来越具有挑战性，特别是当周围环境动态变化时。在这里，我们为光驱动的立方体赤铁矿/TiO2 Janus 微型机器人开发了一种视觉引导闭环导航框架，其特征尺寸约为 3 μm。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 能够精确自主导航的人造微型机器人可以为复杂环境中的微型运输、操纵和任务执行提供多功能平台。然而，在微米尺度上可靠的导航变得越来越具有挑战性，特别是当周围环境动态变化时。在这里，我们为光驱动的立方体赤铁矿/TiO2 Janus 微型机器人开发了一种视觉引导闭环导航框架，其特征尺寸约为 3 μm。使用定制训练的 YOLOv11 对象检测模型进行的实时视觉定位与基于离散航点的磁力转向相集成，能够沿着复杂的规定轨迹进行精确导航，在测试的路径几何形状中，超过 90% 的测量轨迹偏差保持在 6 μm 以下。该框架进一步实现了任意用户定义的徒手轨迹和通过物理限制迷宫的自主导航。在动态变化的环境中，A* 路径规划可实现实时路径重新规划，同时避免多个独立游动的 5 μm 球形 Janus 微电机。最后，微型机器人有选择地捕获多个货物颗粒并自动运输并将它们运送到预定位置，同时避开动态障碍物。这些结果建立了一个集成平台，将可编程轨迹控制、自主路径规划、实时环境适应和任务执行结合在单个光驱动的 Janus 微型机器人系统中。

articles.title: Quantum instanton approach to metastable collective spin systems: Numerical implementation and applications
articles.title_zh: 亚稳态集体自旋系统的量子瞬子方法：数值实现和应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21684v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Driven-dissipative collective spin systems can host several long-lived metastable states; rare switching between them governs slow relaxation and first-order dissipative phase transitions associated with changes in the dominant stationary state. In the companion Letter [arXiv:2604.15091], we introduced a quantum instanton framework based on exact quasiprobability dynamics to describe this switching and illustrated it with a minimal model possessing a simplifying symmetry. Here we develop its numerical implementation, combining collocation and shooting methods, and apply it to two microscopically motivated systems: the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model with purely collective dissipation and the cooperative resonance fluorescence with collective and local dissipation. By determining the leading exponential scaling of switching rates between metastable attractors, we predict the stationary magnetization, the first-order dissipative phase-transition point, and the exponential scaling of slow relaxation rates. These predictions agree with quantum master-equation calculations and an exact analytical result for the second model without dephasing. We also examine how the choice of quasiprobability representation affects numerical convergence and find that the alternative semiclassical Wigner approach, based on Gaussian truncation, has varying accuracy across models and parameter regimes. These results substantiate the framework's applicability to experimentally relevant collective spin systems with both collective and local dissipation.
articles.abstract_zh: 从动耗散集体自旋系统可以存在几种长期存在的亚稳态；它们之间的罕见切换控制着与主要稳态变化相关的缓慢弛豫和一阶耗散相变。在配套的信件 [arXiv:2604.15091] 中，我们引入了一个基于精确准概率动力学的量子瞬子框架来描述这种切换，并用具有简化对称性的最小模型来说明它。在这里，我们结合搭配和射击方法开发了其数值实现，并将其应用于两个微观激励系统：具有纯集体耗散的 Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick 模型和具有集体和局部耗散的协作共振荧光。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从动耗散集体自旋系统可以存在几种长期存在的亚稳态；它们之间的罕见切换控制着与主要稳态变化相关的缓慢弛豫和一阶耗散相变。在配套的信件 [arXiv:2604.15091] 中，我们引入了一个基于精确准概率动力学的量子瞬子框架来描述这种切换，并用具有简化对称性的最小模型来说明它。在这里，我们结合搭配和射击方法开发了其数值实现，并将其应用于两个微观激励系统：具有纯集体耗散的 Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick 模型和具有集体和局部耗散的协作共振荧光。通过确定亚稳态吸引子之间切换速率的领先指数缩放，我们预测了稳态磁化强度、一阶耗散相变点和慢弛豫率的指数缩放。这些预测与量子主方程计算以及第二个模型的精确分析结果一致，无需失相。我们还研究了准概率表示的选择如何影响数值收敛，并发现基于高斯截断的替代半经典维格纳方法在模型和参数范围内具有不同的精度。这些结果证实了该框架对于具有集体和局部耗散的实验相关集体自旋系统的适用性。

articles.title: Gyrators for superconducting circuit design
articles.title_zh: 用于超导电路设计的回转器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22145v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Assuming only the solubility of Kirchhoff's laws, the conservation of energy, and the form of the constitutive relations, we present a flux-charge symmetric Hamiltonian formalism that always admits a symplectic reduction for nonsingular, well-posed circuits involving gyrators, inductors, and capacitors (LCG circuits) with arbitrary non-linearity. The formalism introduces a notion of circuit duality on non-linear non-reciprocal circuits and a family of point transformations that inserts, removes, and moves reciprocal elements across gyrators while preserving the Hamiltonian spectrum. With these transformations, we extend Tellegen's classic result that gyrators make reciprocal elements behave as their dual to non-linear reciprocal elements such as the Josephson junction and quantum phase slip. Furthermore, we present conditions under which non-reciprocal circuits can be transformed to dynamically equivalent reciprocal circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 仅假设基尔霍夫定律的可解性、能量守恒和本构关系的形式，我们提出了一种磁通荷对称哈密顿形式主义，该形式主义始终允许涉及具有任意非线性的回转器、电感器和电容器（LCG 电路）的非奇异、适定电路（LCG 电路）的辛约简。该形式主义引入了非线性非互易电路上的电路对偶性概念以及一系列点变换，这些点变换在回转器上插入、删除和移动互易元素，同时保留哈密顿谱。通过这些变换，我们扩展了特勒根的经典结果，即回转器使互易元件表现为对偶非线性互易元件，例如约瑟夫森结和量子相滑。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 仅假设基尔霍夫定律的可解性、能量守恒和本构关系的形式，我们提出了一种磁通荷对称哈密顿形式主义，该形式主义始终允许涉及具有任意非线性的回转器、电感器和电容器（LCG 电路）的非奇异、适定电路（LCG 电路）的辛约简。该形式主义引入了非线性非互易电路上的电路对偶性概念以及一系列点变换，这些点变换在回转器上插入、删除和移动互易元素，同时保留哈密顿谱。通过这些变换，我们扩展了特勒根的经典结果，即回转器使互易元件表现为对偶非线性互易元件，例如约瑟夫森结和量子相滑。此外，我们提出了不可逆电路可以转换为动态等效可逆电路的条件。

articles.title: Dark Matter Axions Modulate Dark State Scintillation
articles.title_zh: 暗物质轴子调节暗态闪烁
articles.abstract: arXiv:1709.08726v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The decay rate of the thallium-iodine dark state in the popular alkali-halide scintillator NaI(Tl) modulates in phase with the dipole anisotropy of the cosmic microwave background (CMB), it is argued. Axion dark matter particles --- at rest in the local CMB rest-frame --- couple to the static magnetic field created in their rest-frame by the static electric quadrupole field within the tetragonally-distorted thallium-iodine octahedron surrounding each dark state. For axions with rest-mass energy near the roughly 0.5 eV dark state activation energy in NaI(Tl), the resulting near-infrared electric field created by this axion electrodynamic interaction modulates the dark state scintillation lifetime by bringing home the excited hole --- from the four in-plane iodine 5p orbitals that share it --- to the Tl 6s shell where it can recombine with the excited Tl 6p electron to produce the scintillation light.
articles.abstract_zh: 有人认为，流行的碱卤化物闪烁体 NaI(Tl) 中铊碘暗态的衰变率与宇宙微波背景 (CMB) 的偶极子各向异性同相调制。轴子暗物质粒子——在局部宇宙微波背景静止框架中静止——与围绕每个暗态的四方扭曲铊碘八面体内的静电四极场在其静止框架中产生的静磁场耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有人认为，流行的碱卤化物闪烁体 NaI(Tl) 中铊碘暗态的衰变率与宇宙微波背景 (CMB) 的偶极子各向异性同相调制。轴子暗物质粒子——在局部宇宙微波背景静止框架中静止——与围绕每个暗态的四方扭曲铊碘八面体内的静电四极场在其静止框架中产生的静磁场耦合。对于 NaI(Tl) 中静止质量能量接近大约 0.5 eV 暗态激活能的轴子，由该轴子电动相互作用产生的近红外电场通过将激发空穴（从共享它的四个面内碘 5p 轨道）带回家到 Tl 6s 壳层来调节暗态闪烁寿命，在 Tl 6s 壳层中它可以与激发的 Tl 6p 电子重新结合以产生闪烁光。

articles.title: Dirac Representation for Lattice Spin Operators: Spin-1/2 and Spin-1 cases
articles.title_zh: 格子自旋算子的狄拉克表示：Spin-1/2 和 Spin-1 情况
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.11917v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a quantum representation of lattice spin operators (LSOs) by mapping quantum spins to their classical analogues for spin values S=1/2 and S=1. The resulting Dirac (bra--ket) forms are derived from the structure of binary and ternary digit distributions in non-negative integers. colorblue The construction requires only an enumeration of the lattice sites and is therefore independent on the spatial dimension and lattice geometry. colorblack Analytical expressions for extracting the jth bit or trit of an integer without performing an explicit binary or ternary decomposition are obtained. colorblueAs an application of the representation, colorblack we analyze the one-dimensional spin-1/2 XXZ Heisenberg model with open boundaries in a magnetic field in both absence (uniform magnetic field) and presence of disorder (random magnetic field). In the absence of disorder (clean system), we demonstrate that the corresponding eigenvalue problem can be reduced to a tight-binding problem on a graph. For the isotropic case, this is solved analytically without resorting to any spinless transformation or the Bethe Ansatz. In the presence of disorder, a convergent perturbation theory is elaborated. Our analytical results are benchmarked against exact diagonalization for systems up to K≤ 18 spins. These computations exploit the global U(1) symmetry to block-diagonalize the Hamiltonian and the spin-inversion symmetry to further decompose the zero-magnetization sector. Quantitative agreement between analytical and numerical results is observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过将量子自旋映射到自旋值 S=1/2 和 S=1 的经典类似物，引入了晶格自旋算子 (LSO) 的量子表示。由此产生的狄拉克（bra--ket）形式源自非负整数的二进制和三元数字分布的结构。 colorblue 该构造仅需要枚举晶格位置，因此独立于空间维度和晶格几何形状。 colorblack 获得用于提取整数的第 j 位或 trit 而不执行显式二元或三元分解的解析表达式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过将量子自旋映射到自旋值 S=1/2 和 S=1 的经典类似物，引入了晶格自旋算子 (LSO) 的量子表示。由此产生的狄拉克（bra--ket）形式源自非负整数的二进制和三元数字分布的结构。 colorblue 该构造仅需要枚举晶格位置，因此独立于空间维度和晶格几何形状。 colorblack 获得用于提取整数的第 j 位或 trit 而不执行显式二元或三元分解的解析表达式。 colorblue作为 colorblack 表示的应用，我们分析了在不存在（均匀磁场）和存在无序（随机磁场）的情况下在磁场中具有开放边界的一维自旋 1/2 XXZ 海森堡模型。在没有无序（干净系统）的情况下，我们证明相应的特征值问题可以简化为图上的紧束缚问题。对于各向同性情况，可以通过分析求解，无需借助任何无自旋变换或 Bethe Ansatz。在存在无序的情况下，详细阐述了收敛微扰理论。我们的分析结果以 K≤ 18 次旋转的系统的精确对角化为基准。这些计算利用全局 U(1) 对称性对哈密顿量进行块对角化，并利用自旋反转对称性进一步分解零磁化扇区。观察到分析结果和数值结果之间的定量一致性。

articles.title: Optimal active engines obey the thermodynamic Lorentz force law
articles.title_zh: 最优主动发动机遵循热力学洛伦兹力定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17087v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: What are the fundamental limitations for finite-time engines that extract work from active nonequilibrium systems, and what are the optimal protocols that approach them? We show that the finite-time work extraction for nonconservative overdamped Langevin systems may be rewritten as a Lorentz force Lagrangian action, with the kinetic term corresponding to a thermodynamic metric term that is an L₂-optimal transport cost for the time-dependent probability density, and the magnetic field coupling term corresponding to an effective quasistatic work extraction, proving that optimal protocols counterdiabatically steer the thermodynamic state trajectory to satisfy a Lorentz force law defined on thermodynamic state space. We utilize and reinterpret classic concepts from electromagnetism in the setting of cyclical nonequilibrium processes. We show that the housekeeping heat can be controlled to be arbitrarily close to zero by minimizing nonequilibrium fluctuations. It immediately follows from our results that the constant-velocity angle clamp protocol applied to the F₁ molecular motor in a recent experiment [T. Mishima et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 148402 (2025)] is in fact the globally optimal protocol: it produces zero housekeeping heat while simultaneously minimizing dissipation and maximizing work transduction.
articles.abstract_zh: 从主动非平衡系统中提取功的有限时间引擎的基本限制是什么？接近它们的最佳协议是什么？我们证明，非保守过阻尼朗之万系统的有限时间功提取可以重写为洛伦兹力拉格朗日作用，其中动力学项对应于热力学度量项，该热力学度量项是时间相关概率密度的 L2 最优输运成本，而磁场耦合项对应于有效的准静态功提取，证明最优协议反向地引导热力学状态轨迹以满足热力学状态空间上定义的洛伦兹力定律。我们在循环非平衡过程的背景下利用并重新解释电磁学的经典概念。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从主动非平衡系统中提取功的有限时间引擎的基本限制是什么？接近它们的最佳协议是什么？我们证明，非保守过阻尼朗之万系统的有限时间功提取可以重写为洛伦兹力拉格朗日作用，其中动力学项对应于热力学度量项，该热力学度量项是时间相关概率密度的 L2 最优输运成本，而磁场耦合项对应于有效的准静态功提取，证明最优协议反向地引导热力学状态轨迹以满足热力学状态空间上定义的洛伦兹力定律。我们在循环非平衡过程的背景下利用并重新解释电磁学的经典概念。我们证明，通过最小化非平衡波动，可以将内务热量控制为任意接近于零。从我们的结果可以看出，在最近的一项实验中，恒速角钳协议应用于 F₁ 分子马达 [T.三岛等人，物理学。莱特牧师。 135, 148402 (2025)]实际上是全局最优协议：它产生零内务热量，同时最大限度地减少耗散并最大化功传导。

articles.title: Simulating cavity QED with spin-orbit coupled Bose-Einstein condensates revisited
articles.title_zh: 重新审视自旋轨道耦合玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态模拟腔 QED
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.28368v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Simulating cavity quantum electrodynamics in synthetic platforms offers a route to studying light--matter physics without real photons. We reassess the frequently invoked analogy between harmonically trapped, spin--orbit-coupled atoms and the quantum Rabi and Dicke models, with particular emphasis on squeezing and entanglement. A single non-interacting atom realizes the quantum Rabi Hamiltonian exactly, up to elementary spin and phase-space rotations. For N non-interacting atoms, however, the center-of-mass mode is only one member of a complete orthonormal set containing N-1 relative modes. We prove that, after all modes are included, the spin--spin terms generated by the collective mode cancel exactly against those generated by the relative modes. Equivalently, the original Hamiltonian is a sum of independent one-particle Hamiltonians and therefore cannot create interparticle entanglement from a separable state. Contact interactions invalidate this cancellation but do not remove the relative modes or turn the exact many-body Hamiltonian into a Dicke model. A one-mode Dicke description can arise only as a controlled low-energy approximation after all relevant relative excitations have been shown to be spectrally suppressed. We discuss this distinction together with experimental scales, finite temperature, and possible mode-selection strategies. We also distinguish the single-particle interference underlying density fringes from the interaction-stabilized stripe supersolid observed in many-body condensates.
articles.abstract_zh: 在合成平台中模拟空腔量子电动力学提供了一种在没有真实光子的情况下研究光物质物理的途径。我们重新评估了调和俘获、自旋轨道耦合原子与量子拉比和迪克模型之间经常被引用的类比，特别强调挤压和纠缠。单个非相互作用原子精确地实现量子拉比哈密顿量，直至基本自旋和相空间旋转。然而，对于 N 个不相互作用的原子，质心模态只是包含 N-1 个相对模态的完整正交集的一个成员。我们证明，在包含所有模式后，集体模式生成的自旋项与相对模式生成的自旋项完全抵消。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在合成平台中模拟空腔量子电动力学提供了一种在没有真实光子的情况下研究光物质物理的途径。我们重新评估了调和俘获、自旋轨道耦合原子与量子拉比和迪克模型之间经常被引用的类比，特别强调挤压和纠缠。单个非相互作用原子精确地实现量子拉比哈密顿量，直至基本自旋和相空间旋转。然而，对于 N 个不相互作用的原子，质心模态只是包含 N-1 个相对模态的完整正交集的一个成员。我们证明，在包含所有模式后，集体模式生成的自旋项与相对模式生成的自旋项完全抵消。同样，原始哈密顿量是独立的单粒子哈密顿量的总和，因此不能从可分离状态创建粒子间纠缠。接触相互作用使这种取消无效，但不会删除相对模式或将精确的多体哈密顿量转变为迪克模型。在所有相关的相对激发都被证明被光谱抑制之后，单模迪克描述只能作为受控的低能量近似出现。我们与实验规模、有限温度和可能的模式选择策略一起讨论这种区别。我们还将密度条纹下的单粒子干涉与多体凝聚体中观察到的相互作用稳定的条纹超固体区分开来。

articles.title: Approximate vortex lattices of atomic Fermi superfluid on a spherical surface
articles.title_zh: 球面上原子费米超流体的近似涡晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.05216v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While planar Fermi superfluids form Abrikosov vortex lattices under magnetic or effective gauge fields, spherical geometry forbids perfect lattices above 20 vortices. We characterize approximate vortex structures of atomic Fermi superfluids under an effective monopole field on a spherical surface as an analogue of the planar vortex-lattice problem by two constructions based on the Ginzburg-Landau theory. The first one is geometric and uses the random, geodesic-dome, and Fibonacci lattices as scaffolds to construct the order parameter from the degenerate monopole harmonics. The second one minimizes the free energy by numerically adjusting the coefficients to find the solution with the minimal Abrikosov parameter. We have verified the vortices from both constructions are zeros of the order parameter with circulating currents around the vortex cores. As the number of vortices increases, the Abrikosov parameters of both the Fibonacci-lattice and minimization solutions extrapolate to the planar value. We briefly discuss implications for ultracold atoms in thin spherical-shell geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 虽然平面费米超流体在磁场或有效规范场下形成阿布里科索夫涡旋晶格，但球面几何形状禁止形成超过 20 个涡旋的完美晶格。我们通过基于 Ginzburg-Landau 理论的两种结构来表征球面上有效单极场下原子费米超流体的近似涡旋结构，作为平面涡旋晶格问题的模拟。第一个是几何的，使用随机、测地圆顶和斐波那契晶格作为支架，从简并单极子谐波构造阶参数。第二个方法是通过数值调整系数来最小化自由能，以找到具有最小 Abrikosov 参数的解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 虽然平面费米超流体在磁场或有效规范场下形成阿布里科索夫涡旋晶格，但球面几何形状禁止形成超过 20 个涡旋的完美晶格。我们通过基于 Ginzburg-Landau 理论的两种结构来表征球面上有效单极场下原子费米超流体的近似涡旋结构，作为平面涡旋晶格问题的模拟。第一个是几何的，使用随机、测地圆顶和斐波那契晶格作为支架，从简并单极子谐波构造阶参数。第二个方法是通过数值调整系数来最小化自由能，以找到具有最小 Abrikosov 参数的解。我们已经验证了两种结构的涡流都是阶次参数为零，并且涡流核心周围有循环电流。随着涡旋数量的增加，斐波那契格子和最小化解的 Abrikosov 参数都会外推到平面值。我们简要讨论了薄球壳几何结构中超冷原子的含义。

articles.title: Bulk-dissociated topological bands without spin-orbit coupling in hetero-dimensional superconducting metamaterials
articles.title_zh: 异维超导超材料中无自旋轨道耦合的体解离拓扑带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.08675v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological superconductors (TSCs) in superconducting hybrid heterostructures, which integrate superconducting and non-superconducting materials, have been intensely investigated with the hope of discovering exotic non-Abelian anyons for fault-tolerant quantum computing. In this effort, a challenge for hybrid superconducting systems is controlling hybridization, which is often a balance between enhancing the superconducting proximity effect at the cost of suppressing desirable electronic properties such as strong spin-orbit interactions. Hence, discovering hybrid superconducting systems with topological properties controlled and enhanced by material geometry design without spin-orbit interactions would be intriguing to explore. In this work, we theoretically study a square superconducting network decorated with spin-polarized magnetic adatoms. We find that localized Yu-Shiba-Rusinov bound states at magnetic adatom sites collectively form a weak topological superconducting phase despite the absence of spin-orbit interactions. We then demonstrate that by tuning the Fermi energy of the network, the system can transition from a weak TSC phase to a bulk-dissociated TSC phase where the edge state bands separate from the bulk, giving rise to unexpected features such as nodal lines and co-existing bulk-dissociated edge and corner modes. Moreover, our findings highlight how hetero-dimensional superconducting metamaterials can serve as a useful template for controlling the coupling and dissociation between electronic degrees of freedom of different dimensionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导混合异质结构中的拓扑超导体（TSC）集成了超导和非超导材料，人们对其进行了深入研究，希望发现用于容错量子计算的奇异非阿贝尔任意子。在这项工作中，混合超导系统面临的挑战是控制杂化，这通常是增强超导邻近效应与抑制所需电子特性（例如强自旋轨道相互作用）之间的平衡。因此，发现具有通过材料几何设计控制和增强的拓扑特性而无需自旋轨道相互作用的混合超导系统将是令人感兴趣的探索。在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究了装饰有自旋极化磁性吸附原子的方形超导网络。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导混合异质结构中的拓扑超导体（TSC）集成了超导和非超导材料，人们对其进行了深入研究，希望发现用于容错量子计算的奇异非阿贝尔任意子。在这项工作中，混合超导系统面临的挑战是控制杂化，这通常是增强超导邻近效应与抑制所需电子特性（例如强自旋轨道相互作用）之间的平衡。因此，发现具有通过材料几何设计控制和增强的拓扑特性而无需自旋轨道相互作用的混合超导系统将是令人感兴趣的探索。在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究了装饰有自旋极化磁性吸附原子的方形超导网络。我们发现，尽管不存在自旋轨道相互作用，但磁性吸附原子位点处的局部 Yu-Shiba-Rusinov 束缚态共同形成了弱拓扑超导相。然后，我们证明，通过调整网络的费米能量，系统可以从弱 TSC 相转变为体解离 TSC 相，其中边缘态带与体相分离，从而产生意想不到的特征，例如节点线和共存的体解离边缘和角模式。此外，我们的研究结果强调了异维超导超材料如何作为控制不同维度电子自由度之间耦合和解离的有用模板。

articles.title: Partially reactive force field for the UiO-66 metal-organic framework
articles.title_zh: UiO-66 金属有机骨架的部分反作用力场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.19808v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: UiO-66 is the most widely studied metal-organic framework, on account of its structural tunability given by its capacity of sustaining high amounts of point defects in its structure. Its synthesis mechanism is largely unknown, with only a few works mostly focused on the formation of the Zr-oxide cluster. In this work, a partially reactive force field to model UiO-66, nb-UiO-FF, is introduced. This force field incorporates node--ligand reactivity via a Morse potential and the introduction of dummy atoms to reproduce the anisotropic charge distribution of the Zr atoms in the node. nb-UiO-FF reproduces structural features of both UiO-66 and its isoreticular analog UiO-67 as well as framework stability with or without defects, activated or filled with N,N-dimethylformamide or ethanol. Defect generation and node--ligand binding energies are comparable with density functional theory values. The force field is further employed within a molecular dynamics scheme to study the early stages of solvothermal node--ligand binding. Species with structures corresponding to motifs present in UiO-66 are observed, along with other metastable species. This force field enables studying the self-assembly of UiO-66, as well as the formation of its point defects.
articles.abstract_zh: UiO-66 是研究最广泛的金属有机框架，因为其结构中具有维持大量点缺陷的能力，因而具有结构可调性。其合成机制在很大程度上是未知的，只有少数工作主要集中在氧化锆簇的形成上。在这项工作中，引入了 UiO-66 模型的部分反作用力场，nb-UiO-FF。该力场通过莫尔斯电势结合节点-配体反应性并引入虚拟原子以再现节点中Zr原子的各向异性电荷分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: UiO-66 是研究最广泛的金属有机框架，因为其结构中具有维持大量点缺陷的能力，因而具有结构可调性。其合成机制在很大程度上是未知的，只有少数工作主要集中在氧化锆簇的形成上。在这项工作中，引入了 UiO-66 模型的部分反作用力场，nb-UiO-FF。该力场通过莫尔斯电势结合节点-配体反应性并引入虚拟原子以再现节点中Zr原子的各向异性电荷分布。 nb-UiO-FF 再现了 UiO-66 及其等网状类似物 UiO-67 的结构特征以及有或没有缺陷的框架稳定性，用 N,N-二甲基甲酰胺或乙醇活化或填充。缺陷产生和节点-配体结合能与密度泛函理论值相当。力场进一步应用于分子动力学方案中，以研究溶剂热节点——配体结合的早期阶段。观察到具有与 UiO-66 中存在的基序相对应的结构的物种以及其他亚稳态物种。该力场能够研究 UiO-66 的自组装及其点缺陷的形成。

articles.title: Limits of the Non-Linear Generalized Langevin Equation: Cross-Correlations, Irreversibility and Desynchronization
articles.title_zh: 非线性广义朗之万方程的极限：互相关、不可逆性和去同步
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31297v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The generalized Langevin equation (GLE) is widely used to model complex soft-matter systems, including biomolecular dynamics, by incorporating memory effects and colored noise into coarse-grained descriptions. However, recent results suggest that combining memory with non-linear forces, ubiquitous in soft matter, introduces fundamental analytical inconsistencies. Here, using a simplified model, we investigate the practical numerical consequences of these analytical results. We show that non-linear forces generate cross-correlations with the noise, modifying the fluctuation-dissipation theorem and rendering the noise position-dependent and irreversible. This implies that the commonly assumed reversible Gaussian noise in GLE simulations fails to capture essential features of the microscopic fluctuations. For weak non-linearities, these issues can be partially resolved either by using an iterative optimization of memory or by using microscopically consistent noise, which unexpectedly synchronizes GLE trajectories with the underlying microscopic dynamics. For stronger non-linearities like high barriers or shoulders in the external potential, however, iterative reconstruction fails and we observe desynchronization, indicating that the non-linear GLE no longer correctly reproduces the microscopic dynamics. Our results show in which situations non-linear GLEs can be accurately applied and when they fail, thus providing practical guidance for their application to coarse-grain soft-matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 广义朗之万方程 (GLE) 通过将记忆效应和有色噪声纳入粗粒度描述，广泛用于模拟复杂的软物质系统，包括生物分子动力学。然而，最近的结果表明，将记忆与软物质中普遍存在的非线性力相结合，会带来基本的分析不一致。在这里，我们使用简化模型研究了这些分析结果的实际数值结果。我们证明非线性力与噪声产生互相关，修改了波动耗散定理并使噪声与位置相关且不可逆。这意味着 GLE 模拟中通常假设的可逆高斯噪声无法捕获微观波动的基本特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 广义朗之万方程 (GLE) 通过将记忆效应和有色噪声纳入粗粒度描述，广泛用于模拟复杂的软物质系统，包括生物分子动力学。然而，最近的结果表明，将记忆与软物质中普遍存在的非线性力相结合，会带来基本的分析不一致。在这里，我们使用简化模型研究了这些分析结果的实际数值结果。我们证明非线性力与噪声产生互相关，修改了波动耗散定理并使噪声与位置相关且不可逆。这意味着 GLE 模拟中通常假设的可逆高斯噪声无法捕获微观波动的基本特征。对于弱非线性，这些问题可以通过使用内存的迭代优化或使用微观一致的噪声来部分解决，这会意外地将 GLE 轨迹与底层微观动力学同步。然而，对于外部势中的高势垒或肩部等更强的非线性，迭代重建会失败，并且我们观察到去同步，这表明非线性 GLE 不再正确地再现微观动力学。我们的结果表明非线性 GLE 在哪些情况下可以准确应用以及何时会失败，从而为其在粗粒软物质系统中的应用提供了实用指导。

articles.title: A closed system setting for quantum thermalisation in free fermions
articles.title_zh: 自由费米子量子热化的封闭系统设置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06362v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study thermalisation and the possible occurrence of the Mpemba effect in a closed quantum setting that mimics the interaction of a system with thermal reservoirs coupled only at its boundaries. Specifically, we consider a tripartite geometry in which a finite chain, initially prepared at a finite temperature, is suddenly connected on both sides to two semi-infinite chains of the same nature held at a different temperature. These outer chains act as thermal baths, while the full system evolves unitarily under a homogeneous Hamiltonian. This setup provides a simple quantum realisation of a temperature quench and closely resembles the original scenario in which the classical Mpemba effect was first observed. We focus on two paradigmatic free-fermion models, the XX chain and the transverse-field Ising chain, which respectively preserve and break the global U(1) particle-number symmetry. As a probe of relaxation, we consider the Frobenius distance between the time-evolved reduced density matrix of the central subsystem and its stationary state, which is the thermal state at the bath temperature. Exploiting the free-fermionic structure of both models, the dynamics remains Gaussian and the Frobenius distance can be expressed exactly in terms of two-point correlation functions. Combining this representation with generalised hydrodynamics, we derive analytical predictions for the Frobenius distance in the hydrodynamic limit, providing a complete characterisation of the thermalisation process. Using these results, we investigate the possible occurrence of the Mpemba effect. We find that, despite the genuine non-equilibrium dynamics displayed by the system, no Mpemba effect arises in this setting. Our analysis identifies a broad class of boundary-driven thermalisation protocols in which relaxation is fully characterised analytically and exhibits no anomalous acceleration of equilibration.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究热化作用以及在封闭量子环境中可能发生的姆彭巴效应，该环境模拟系统与仅在其边界耦合的热储层的相互作用。具体来说，我们考虑一种三方几何结构，其中最初在有限温度下制备的有限链突然在两侧连接到在不同温度下保持的相同性质的两条半无限链。这些外链充当热浴，而整个系统在齐次哈密顿量下统一演化。该设置提供了温度猝灭的简单量子实现，并且与首次观察到经典 Mpemba 效应的原始场景非常相似。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究热化作用以及在封闭量子环境中可能发生的姆彭巴效应，该环境模拟系统与仅在其边界耦合的热储层的相互作用。具体来说，我们考虑一种三方几何结构，其中最初在有限温度下制备的有限链突然在两侧连接到在不同温度下保持的相同性质的两条半无限链。这些外链充当热浴，而整个系统在齐次哈密顿量下统一演化。该设置提供了温度猝灭的简单量子实现，并且与首次观察到经典 Mpemba 效应的原始场景非常相似。我们关注两个典型的自由费米子模型，XX 链和横向场 Ising 链，它们分别保持和打破全局 U(1) 粒子数对称性。作为弛豫的探针，我们考虑中心子系统的时间演化约简密度矩阵与其稳态（浴温下的热态）之间的弗罗贝尼乌斯距离。利用两个模型的自由费米子结构，动力学保持高斯分布，并且弗罗贝尼乌斯距离可以用两点相关函数精确表达。将此表示与广义流体动力学相结合，我们得出了流体力学极限中弗罗贝尼乌斯距离的分析预测，提供了热化过程的完整表征。利用这些结果，我们研究了 Mpemba 效应发生的可能性。我们发现，尽管系统显示出真正的非平衡动力学，但在这种情况下不会出现姆潘巴效应。我们的分析确定了一大类边界驱动的热化协议，其中弛豫得到了充分的分析表征，并且没有表现出异常的平衡加速。

articles.title: Symmetry and Quantum Geometry in Bloch Bands
articles.title_zh: 布洛赫能带中的对称性和量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.21581v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum geometric quantities have featured heavily in the discussion of the properties of quantum systems in recent years. Among quantities most commonly discussed is the variance of Berry curvature and the integral of the trace of the quantum metric tensor. Despite their usefulness, it is known that they suffer from one significant complication: for a tight-binding model, the quantum geometric quantities depend not only on the parameters of the tight-binding model itself, but also the real space geometry of the tight-binding model, the so-called "orbital embedding". One explicitly geometry-independent quantity is therefore the minimal value of the quantum geometric quantity out of all possible real space geometries. In this work, we demonstrate that, if the tight-binding model is compatible with certain spatial symmetries, then the real space geometry that minimizes the variance of the Berry curvature or the integral of the trace of the quantum metric tensor must obey all those spatial symmetries. We further show that the statement is applicable to systems with magnetic translation symmetries and other composite symmetries, with implications for the quantum geometry of the Hofstadter model.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，量子几何量在量子系统性质的讨论中占据重要地位。最常讨论的量是贝里曲率的方差和量子度量张量的迹的积分。尽管它们很有用，但众所周知，它们面临一个显着的复杂性：对于紧束缚模型，量子几何量不仅取决于紧束缚模型本身的参数，还取决于紧束缚模型的真实空间几何，即所谓的“轨道嵌入”。因此，一个明确的与几何无关的量是所有可能的真实空间几何中量子几何量的最小值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，量子几何量在量子系统性质的讨论中占据重要地位。最常讨论的量是贝里曲率的方差和量子度量张量的迹的积分。尽管它们很有用，但众所周知，它们面临一个显着的复杂性：对于紧束缚模型，量子几何量不仅取决于紧束缚模型本身的参数，还取决于紧束缚模型的真实空间几何，即所谓的“轨道嵌入”。因此，一个明确的与几何无关的量是所有可能的真实空间几何中量子几何量的最小值。在这项工作中，我们证明，如果紧束缚模型与某些空间对称性兼容，那么最小化贝里曲率方差或量子度量张量迹积分的真实空间几何必须遵守所有这些空间对称性。我们进一步表明，该陈述适用于具有磁平移对称性和其他复合对称性的系统，并对霍夫施塔特模型的量子几何产生影响。

articles.title: Altermagnetism-Induced Spin-resolved electronic structure in Janus FeX0.5Y0.5 Monolayers (X, Y = S, Se, Te)
articles.title_zh: Janus FeX0.5Y0.5 单层中交变磁力诱导的自旋分辨电子结构（X、Y = S、Se、Te）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09054v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Realizing the spin-resolved electronic properties in superconducting materials stands as a critical frontier, offering both novel fundamental physics and potential for dissipationless spin-based devices. Here, we predict a series of Janus FeX0.5Y0.5 monolayers derived from iron-based superconductors (e.g., FeSe, FeTe, and FeS) by using Kondo-type model and first-principles calculations. These Janus structures exhibit significant spin-splittingelectronic states, large topological band gaps (51.4 meV) and high Néel temperatures (415 K). We further reveal that valley polarization can be effectively tuned via applied in-plane strain and the resulting valley-polarized anomalous Hall conductivity can be manipulated by shifting the Fermi level. Our work suggests a new strategy based on altermagnetism for engineering spin-splitting states in superconducting systems and inspires further exploration of superconducting spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现超导材料中的自旋分辨电子特性是一个关键前沿，它为无耗散自旋器件提供了新颖的基础物理和潜力。在这里，我们通过使用近藤型模型和第一性原理计算预测了一系列源自铁基超导体（例如 FeSe、FeTe 和 FeS）的 Janus FeX0.5Y0.5 单层。这些 Janus 结构表现出显着的自旋分裂电子态、大的拓扑带隙 (51.4 meV) 和高尼尔温度 (415 K)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实现超导材料中的自旋分辨电子特性是一个关键前沿，它为无耗散自旋器件提供了新颖的基础物理和潜力。在这里，我们通过使用近藤型模型和第一性原理计算预测了一系列源自铁基超导体（例如 FeSe、FeTe 和 FeS）的 Janus FeX0.5Y0.5 单层。这些 Janus 结构表现出显着的自旋分裂电子态、大的拓扑带隙 (51.4 meV) 和高尼尔温度 (415 K)。我们进一步揭示，可以通过施加面内应变有效地调节谷极化，并且可以通过改变费米能级来操纵由此产生的谷极化反常霍尔电导率。我们的工作提出了一种基于交变磁性的新策略，用于在超导系统中设计自旋分裂态，并激发了对超导自旋电子学的进一步探索。

articles.title: Berry-Curvature Effect in Anomalous Transport
articles.title_zh: 异常传输中的贝里曲率效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21161v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A theory of the Berry-phase effect in anomalous transport in ferromagnets driven by statistical forces such as the gradient of temperature or chemical potential has been developed by Di Xiao et al in Phys. Rev. Lett. 97, 026603 (2006) based on a field-dependent density of states generating an additional contribution to the current density. We present an alternative derivation of the Berry- phase effect in anomalous transport in altermagnets and noncentrosymmertric metals based on quasiclassic matrix kinetic equation. Along with anomalous Hall effect an anomalous heat flow and anomalous thermalelectric currents are derived.
articles.abstract_zh: Di Xiao 等人在 Phys.莱特牧师。 97, 026603 (2006) 基于场相关的态密度，对电流密度产生额外的贡献。我们基于准经典矩阵动力学方程提出了交替磁体和非中心对称金属中异常输运中贝里相效应的另一种推导。除了异常霍尔效应之外，还得出异常热流和异常热电流。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Di Xiao 等人在 Phys.莱特牧师。 97, 026603 (2006) 基于场相关的态密度，对电流密度产生额外的贡献。我们基于准经典矩阵动力学方程提出了交替磁体和非中心对称金属中异常输运中贝里相效应的另一种推导。除了异常霍尔效应之外，还得出异常热流和异常热电流。

articles.title: Superconductivity in a Bulk Moire Superlattice Material
articles.title_zh: 块状莫尔超晶格材料中的超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.06622v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Moire materials provide a versatile platform realizing emergent electronic states arising from enhanced correlation due to flat bands. A variety of phenomena including superconductivity, low dimensional ferromagnetism, Mott insulating phase, and topological phenomena have been reported in such systems. To date, moire phenomena have been predominantly explored in artificially assembled low dimensional van der Waals structures, where relative twist and lattice alignment are controlled during device fabrication. Recently, intrinsically grown bulk moire crystals have emerged as a complementary materials platform, in which lattice mismatch between constituent layers generates a coherent moire superlattice throughout the bulk crystal. Here, we report the evidence of bulk superconductivity in single crystals of a recently reported bulk Moire material [Sr6TaS8]1+x[TaS2]8 at ambient pressure. The material exhibits a bulk superconducting transition at Tc = 2.5 K, evidenced consistently by electrical transport, magnetic susceptibility, and heat capacity measurements on single crystals. Structural characterization by X-ray diffraction and atomic resolution electron microscopy establishes the composite, incommensurate crystal structure and scanning tunnelling microscopy reveals a long-wavelength surface modulation due to the incommensurate structure. The observation of bulk superconductivity establishes superconductivity as an emergent phase in this intrinsically synthesized moire material and highlights bulk moire crystals as a promising platform for investigating correlated quantum phenomena beyond artificially assembled two-dimensional structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 莫尔材料提供了一个多功能平台，实现因平带增强相关性而产生的紧急电子态。在此类系统中已经报道了各种现象，包括超导性、低维铁磁性、莫特绝缘相和拓扑现象。迄今为止，莫尔现象主要在人工组装的低维范德华结构中进行探索，其中相对扭曲和晶格排列在器件制造过程中受到控制。最近，本征生长的块状莫尔晶体已作为补充材料平台出现，其中组成层之间的晶格失配在整个块状晶体中产生相干莫尔超晶格。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 莫尔材料提供了一个多功能平台，实现因平带增强相关性而产生的紧急电子态。在此类系统中已经报道了各种现象，包括超导性、低维铁磁性、莫特绝缘相和拓扑现象。迄今为止，莫尔现象主要在人工组装的低维范德华结构中进行探索，其中相对扭曲和晶格排列在器件制造过程中受到控制。最近，本征生长的块状莫尔晶体已作为补充材料平台出现，其中组成层之间的晶格失配在整个块状晶体中产生相干莫尔超晶格。在这里，我们报告了最近报道的块状莫尔材料 [Sr6TaS8]1+x[TaS2]8 在环境压力下单晶具有块体超导性的证据。该材料在 Tc = 2.5 K 时表现出体超导转变，单晶的电传输、磁化率和热容测量一致证明了这一点。通过 X 射线衍射和原子分辨率电子显微镜进行的结构表征确定了复合的、不相称的晶体结构，并且扫描隧道显微镜揭示了由于不相称的结构而产生的长波长表面调制。对块体超导性的观察将超导性确立为这种本征合成莫尔材料中的涌现相，并强调块体莫尔晶体作为研究人工组装二维结构之外的相关量子现象的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Low temperature thermodynamics of Sₑff=1/2 triangular lattice quantum spin liquid candidate TlYbS₂
articles.title_zh: Sₑff=1/2三角晶格量子自旋液体候选TlYbS2的低温热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11881v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Geometrically frustrated triangular-lattice antiferromagnets exhibit a delicate competition between magnetic order and quantum spin liquid (QSL) behavior, with the Yb-based delafossite family AYbX₂ providing a structurally clean platform for exploring this physics. Here, we report a comprehensive study of single-crystal TlYbS₂ using DC magnetization, AC susceptibility, electron spin resonance (ESR), and specific heat measurements extending from room temperature to the millikelvin regime. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction confirms a trigonal Rbar3m structure comprising well-separated triangular layers of Yb³⁺ ions with no detectable site disorder. At zero field, a weak thermodynamic anomaly is observed near 530 mK, which may indicate the onset of a weakly ordered state similar to that reported in KYbSe₂. Below 300 mK, the zero-field magnetic specific heat follows Cᵣₘ ₘpropto T¹.⁸, close to a quadratic temperature dependence, in contrast to the linear temperature dependence reported for the sister compound TlYbSe₂, which has been described in terms of the interplay between spinons and thermally excited gauge-flux excitations. Magnetization and ESR measurements establish pronounced easy-plane magnetic anisotropy, with g_perp/g_parallel approx 6.9. The anomaly near 530 mK exhibits a strongly anisotropic response to magnetic field. For Hperp c, it remains visible up to approximately 2 T and continuously evolves toward a field-induced ordered phase above approximately 2.5 T, followed by a sequence of field-induced phases that includes a 1/3 magnetization plateau between approximately 5 and 8 T and full polarization near 17 T. In contrast, for Hparallel c, the anomaly weakens and is suppressed near 3 T, consistent with the recently reported confinement--deconfinement transition from an ordered state to a field-induced QSL.
articles.abstract_zh: 几何挫败三角晶格反铁磁体表现出磁序和量子自旋液体 (QSL) 行为之间的微妙竞争，基于 Yb 的铜铁矿家族 AYbX2 为探索这种物理现象提供了一个结构干净的平台。在这里，我们报告了使用直流磁化、交流磁化率、电子自旋共振 (ESR) 以及从室温到毫开尔文范围的比热测量对单晶 TlYbS2 进行的综合研究。单晶 X 射线衍射证实了三角 Rbar3m 结构，包含分离良好的 Yb3+ 离子三角形层，没有可检测到的位点无序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 几何挫败三角晶格反铁磁体表现出磁序和量子自旋液体 (QSL) 行为之间的微妙竞争，基于 Yb 的铜铁矿家族 AYbX2 为探索这种物理现象提供了一个结构干净的平台。在这里，我们报告了使用直流磁化、交流磁化率、电子自旋共振 (ESR) 以及从室温到毫开尔文范围的比热测量对单晶 TlYbS2 进行的综合研究。单晶 X 射线衍射证实了三角 Rbar3m 结构，包含分离良好的 Yb3+ 离子三角形层，没有可检测到的位点无序。在零场处，在 530 mK 附近观察到弱热力学异常，这可能表明类似于 KYbSe2 中报道的弱有序态的开始。在 300 mK 以下，零场磁比热遵循 Cᵣₘ ₘpropto T1.⁸，接近于二次温度依赖性，这与姊妹化合物 TlYbSe2 报告的线性温度依赖性相反，后者是根据自旋子和热激发规范通量激发之间的相互作用进行描述的。磁化强度和 ESR 测量建立了明显的易平面磁各向异性，g_perp/g_parallel 约为 6.9。 530 mK 附近的异常对磁场表现出强烈的各向异性响应。对于 Hperp c，它在高达大约 2 T 时仍然可见，并持续向大约 2.5 T 以上的场致有序相演化，随后是一系列场致相，其中包括大约 5 到 8 T 之间的 1/3 磁化平台和接近 17 T 的完全极化。相比之下，对于 Hparallel c，异常减弱并在 3 T 附近受到抑制，这与最近报道的从有序状态到无约束状态的限制-解除限制转变一致。场诱导的 QSL。

articles.title: The Dry Ten Martini Problem at Criticality
articles.title_zh: 干十马提尼问题的关键
articles.abstract: arXiv:2112.06869v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We solve the dry ten martini problem (lean-verified this time) by showing that every labeled almost Mathieu gap is open for λ≠ 0 and every irrational frequency. In particular, we prove that the maximum logarithmic height of each labeled gap is non-decreasing in the coupling λ and extend an initial open seed gap for each gap label n from λin(0,λₙ) to all λ> 0. The non-decreasing property follows from restoring time-reversal symmetry to the almost Mathieu operator H by pairing it with its magnetic inverse barH. This allows us to express the logarithmic coupling derivative of the maximal gap height as the expectation value of a non-negative operator, yielding the required monotonicity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过证明每个标记的几乎 Mathieu 间隙对于 λ≠ 0 和每个无理频率都是开放的，来解决干十马提尼问题（这次经过精益验证）。特别是，我们证明每个标记间隙的最大对数高度在耦合 λ 中是不递减的，并将每个间隙标签 n 的初始开放种子间隙从 λin(0,λₙ) 扩展到所有 λ> 0。通过将时间反转对称性恢复到几乎 Mathieu 算子 H，通过将其与其磁逆 barH 配对，可以得出非递减性质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过证明每个标记的几乎 Mathieu 间隙对于 λ≠ 0 和每个无理频率都是开放的，来解决干十马提尼问题（这次经过精益验证）。特别是，我们证明每个标记间隙的最大对数高度在耦合 λ 中是不递减的，并将每个间隙标签 n 的初始开放种子间隙从 λin(0,λₙ) 扩展到所有 λ> 0。通过将时间反转对称性恢复到几乎 Mathieu 算子 H，通过将其与其磁逆 barH 配对，可以得出非递减性质。这使我们能够将最大间隙高度的对数耦合导数表示为非负算子的期望值，从而产生所需的单调性。

articles.title: Boltzmann generators for amorphous particle systems
articles.title_zh: 用于非晶粒子系统的玻尔兹曼发生器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.16607v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sampling configurations in thermodynamic equilibrium is a long-standing challenge in statistical physics. Boltzmann generators address this problem by employing generative models to propose independent configurations, which are then reweighted via importance sampling using exact likelihood evaluations. Recent Boltzmann Generators based on continuous normalizing flows and flow matching have achieved significant success for particle systems and biomolecules. However, these approaches have not been extended to amorphous materials (glasses), for which equilibrium sampling is notoriously slow. Because of their disordered structure, the invariances and geometrical constraints of amorphous materials differ from those of crystals and biomolecules, preventing the direct use of existing generative models. Here, we develop Boltzmann Generators tailored to amorphous materials by building the required equivariances directly into Riemannian stochastic interpolants. Our framework incorporates periodic boundary conditions and particle symmetries using equivariant graph neural networks. Numerical experiments demonstrate that enforcing physical symmetries significantly improves the accuracy of Boltzmann Generators, but also reveal an intrinsic limitation of the continuous-flow formulation: accumulated numerical errors during likelihood integration break time-reversibility, compromising exact thermodynamic reweighting. These results reveal a fundamental challenge for continuous-flow generative models in statistical mechanics and call for alternative approaches that preserve exact thermodynamic consistency.
articles.abstract_zh: 热力学平衡中的采样配置是统计物理学中长期存在的挑战。玻尔兹曼生成器通过使用生成模型提出独立配置来解决这个问题，然后使用精确的似然评估通过重要性采样重新加权。最近基于连续归一化流和流匹配的玻尔兹曼发生器在颗粒系统和生物分子方面取得了重大成功。然而，这些方法尚未扩展到非晶材料（玻璃），因为非晶材料的平衡采样速度非常慢。由于其无序结构，非晶材料的不变性和几何约束不同于晶体和生物分子，阻碍了直接使用现有的生成模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热力学平衡中的采样配置是统计物理学中长期存在的挑战。玻尔兹曼生成器通过使用生成模型提出独立配置来解决这个问题，然后使用精确的似然评估通过重要性采样重新加权。最近基于连续归一化流和流匹配的玻尔兹曼发生器在颗粒系统和生物分子方面取得了重大成功。然而，这些方法尚未扩展到非晶材料（玻璃），因为非晶材料的平衡采样速度非常慢。由于其无序结构，非晶材料的不变性和几何约束不同于晶体和生物分子，阻碍了直接使用现有的生成模型。在这里，我们通过将所需的等方差直接构建到黎曼随机插值中来开发适合非晶材料的玻尔兹曼发生器。我们的框架使用等变图神经网络结合了周期性边界条件和粒子对称性。数值实验表明，强制物理对称性显着提高了玻尔兹曼发生器的精度，但也揭示了连续流公式的内在局限性：似然积分过程中累积的数值误差破坏了时间可逆性，损害了精确的热力学重新加权。这些结果揭示了统计力学中连续流生成模型面临的根本挑战，并需要保持精确热力学一致性的替代方法。

articles.title: Implementation of non-local arbitrary two-qubit controlled gates via geometric quantum computation with Rydberg anti-blockade
articles.title_zh: 通过带有里德堡反封锁的几何量子计算实现非局部任意两个量子位控制门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.17656v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In the context of Rydberg anti-blockade, this paper proposes a new scheme for a high-fidelity controlled-unitary gate based on non-adiabatic holonomic quantum computation. Under specific detuning and interaction conditions, the scheme achieves a suitable evolution path for non-adiabatic holonomic quantum computation through reverse engineering of pulse parameters. This scheme can implement arbitrary two-qubit controlled gates with favorable robustness. We also evaluate the effects of spontaneous emission and laser intensity errors on the fidelity; numerical simulations show that the geometric gate scheme still exhibits excellent performance under these errors. Furthermore, we extend the scheme to non-local gates via entanglement transfer and quantum teleportation techniques, and demonstrate its application in the mutual conversion among four-qubit entangled states (GHZ, cluster, and W states). This finding indicates the potential applicability of our scheme to complex quantum information processing tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 在里德堡反封锁的背景下，本文提出了一种基于非绝热完整量子计算的高保真受控酉门新方案。在特定的失谐和相互作用条件下，该方案通过脉冲参数的逆向工程，实现了适合非绝热完整量子计算的演化路径。该方案可以实现任意两个量子位控制的门，具有良好的鲁棒性。我们还评估了自发发射和激光强度误差对保真度的影响；数值模拟表明，几何门方案在这些误差下仍然表现出优异的性能。此外，我们通过纠缠转移和量子隐形传态技术将该方案扩展到非局域门，并展示了其在四量子位纠缠态（GHZ、簇和W态）相互转换中的应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在里德堡反封锁的背景下，本文提出了一种基于非绝热完整量子计算的高保真受控酉门新方案。在特定的失谐和相互作用条件下，该方案通过脉冲参数的逆向工程，实现了适合非绝热完整量子计算的演化路径。该方案可以实现任意两个量子位控制的门，具有良好的鲁棒性。我们还评估了自发发射和激光强度误差对保真度的影响；数值模拟表明，几何门方案在这些误差下仍然表现出优异的性能。此外，我们通过纠缠转移和量子隐形传态技术将该方案扩展到非局域门，并展示了其在四量子位纠缠态（GHZ、簇和W态）相互转换中的应用。这一发现表明我们的方案对复杂的量子信息处理任务的潜在适用性。

articles.title: The bulk spectral gap is certifiable from above but uncomputable from below
articles.title_zh: 体光谱间隙可以从上方证明，但从下方无法计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.03836v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Determining spectral gaps in the thermodynamic limit is a central challenge in quantum many-body physics. When a fixed boundary condition is imposed, this problem is undecidable: no algorithm, even with unlimited resources, can decide for every Hamiltonian whether it is gapped. Yet the thermodynamic limit is meant to capture the intrinsic properties of very large systems, which should not depend on how their boundaries are chosen. Here, we therefore consider the bulk spectral gap problem, which concerns only the intrinsic excitations of the infinite system, independently of any boundary. We first give a general algorithm producing a hierarchy of certified upper bounds on the bulk gap, arbitrarily tight at the cost of more computation. Second, we prove that the spectral gap problem remains undecidable in the bulk: no algorithm can decide whether the bulk gap is positive, already for translationally invariant nearest-neighbour chains of fixed local dimension. The bulk spectral gap is thus certifiable from above but uncomputable from below. More precisely, the bulk-gaplessness promise problem is RE-complete, exactly as hard as the halting problem. The same construction also shows that deciding whether an explicitly given state is a ground state of the infinite system is undecidable. Finally, we apply the upper-bounding algorithm to the spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet to produce the first nontrivial certified upper bounds on its bulk gap.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定热力学极限中的光谱间隙是量子多体物理学的一个核心挑战。当施加固定边界条件时，这个问题是不可判定的：即使有无限的资源，也没有算法可以决定每个哈密顿量是否有间隙。然而，热力学极限旨在捕捉非常大系统的内在特性，这不应该取决于如何选择它们的边界。因此，在这里，我们考虑体光谱间隙问题，该问题仅涉及无限系统的固有激发，与任何边界无关。我们首先给出一个通用算法，产生一个关于体块间隙的经过认证的上限层次结构，以更多计算为代价任意紧。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确定热力学极限中的光谱间隙是量子多体物理学的一个核心挑战。当施加固定边界条件时，这个问题是不可判定的：即使有无限的资源，也没有算法可以决定每个哈密顿量是否有间隙。然而，热力学极限旨在捕捉非常大系统的内在特性，这不应该取决于如何选择它们的边界。因此，在这里，我们考虑体光谱间隙问题，该问题仅涉及无限系统的固有激发，与任何边界无关。我们首先给出一个通用算法，产生一个关于体块间隙的经过认证的上限层次结构，以更多计算为代价任意紧。其次，我们证明光谱间隙问题在整体上仍然是不可判定的：对于固定局部维度的平移不变最近邻链来说，没有算法可以确定整体间隙是否为正。因此，总体光谱间隙可以从上面证明，但从下面无法计算。更准确地说，批量无间隙承诺问题是重新完备的，与停止问题一样困难。相同的构造还表明，决定明确给定的状态是否是无限系统的基态是不可判定的。最后，我们将上限算法应用于自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体，以产生其体积间隙的第一个非平凡的认证上限。

articles.title: Quantum models with the Yang-Lee phase transition
articles.title_zh: 具有 Yang-Lee 相变的量子模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19732v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this article, we present four different 1+1D quantum models that realize the Yang-Lee (YL) phase transition under a deformation that preserves PT symmetry. These are the antiferromagnetic Ising spin chain in transverse and longitudinal magnetic fields, the massive Schwinger model, the Blume-Capel model, and the three-state quantum clock model. Using the state-operator correspondence, we identify the YL critical point, compute the scaling dimensions of the lowest operators in each model, and find perfect agreement with the exact results for the YL criticality in two dimensions. Using bosonization for the Schwinger model and the Polyakov-Hubbard transformation for the other models, we show that in all of these quantum models the YL critical point is described, as expected, by a massless bosonic field with an i φ³ interaction. In the quantum clock model, this critical field interacts with a massive bosonic field, and we identify the massless and massive states in the Hamiltonian spectrum. In addition, we numerically compute the two-point function of φ at the Yang-Lee critical point and show that it grows with distance, in agreement with theoretical expectations.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了四种不同的 1+1D 量子模型，这些模型在保持 PT 对称性的变形下实现了 Yang-Lee (YL) 相变。它们是横向和纵向磁场中的反铁磁伊辛自旋链、大规模施温格模型、布卢姆-卡佩尔模型和三态量子钟模型。使用状态算子对应关系，我们识别 YL 临界点，计算每个模型中最低算子的缩放维度，并找到与二维 YL 临界点的精确结果完全一致的结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们提出了四种不同的 1+1D 量子模型，这些模型在保持 PT 对称性的变形下实现了 Yang-Lee (YL) 相变。它们是横向和纵向磁场中的反铁磁伊辛自旋链、大规模施温格模型、布卢姆-卡佩尔模型和三态量子钟模型。使用状态算子对应关系，我们识别 YL 临界点，计算每个模型中最低算子的缩放维度，并找到与二维 YL 临界点的精确结果完全一致的结果。使用 Schwinger 模型的玻色化和其他模型的 Polyakov-Hubbard 变换，我们表明，在所有这些量子模型中，正如预期的那样，YL 临界点由具有 i φ3 相互作用的无质量玻色子场描述。在量子钟模型中，这个临界场与巨大的玻色子场相互作用，我们识别了哈密顿谱中的无质量和质量状态。此外，我们数值计算了在 Yang-Lee 临界点处的 φ 的两点函数，并表明它随着距离的增加而增长，与理论预期一致。

articles.title: Calculating strongly correlated ground states from the non-Markovian dissipative dynamics of Gaussian fermions
articles.title_zh: 从高斯费米子的非马尔可夫耗散动力学计算强相关基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06293v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a mapping between the ground state of interacting fermionic Hamiltonians and the non-equilibrium steady state of a purely dissipative open quantum system. Within the framework of third quantization, we map the Fermi-Hubbard Hamiltonian onto Lindblad jump operators acting on Majorana fermions. Remarkably, both hopping and interaction terms map onto jump operators that preserve the Gaussianity of Majorana fermions along individual quantum trajectories. As a result, the dynamics can be unravelled and each trajectory can be simulated efficiently using only two-point correlation functions, with a computational cost that scales polynomially with system size. We further show that finite particle number requires negative dissipative rates, leading to an intrinsically non-Markovian dynamics. The corresponding trajectory unravelling involves both positive and negative stochastic weights and exhibits a sign problem and large fluctuations, so that convergence requires an exponentially large number of trajectories. The overall computational cost remains exponential in system size despite the efficient Gaussian representation of individual trajectories, but is crucially dependent on the computational complexity of the non-Markovian unravelling, motivating further studies on the efficiency of such unravellings.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了相互作用的费米子哈密顿量的基态与纯耗散开放量子系统的非平衡稳态之间的映射。在第三量子化的框架内，我们将费米-哈伯德哈密顿量映射到作用于马约拉纳费米子的 Lindblad 跳跃算子。值得注意的是，跳跃和相互作用项都映射到跳跃算子上，这些算子保留了沿着各个量子轨迹的马约拉纳费米子的高斯性。因此，可以仅使用两点相关函数来阐明动力学，并且可以有效地模拟每个轨迹，并且计算成本与系统规模呈多项式缩放。我们进一步表明，有限的粒子数需要负耗散率，从而导致本质上的非马尔可夫动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了相互作用的费米子哈密顿量的基态与纯耗散开放量子系统的非平衡稳态之间的映射。在第三量子化的框架内，我们将费米-哈伯德哈密顿量映射到作用于马约拉纳费米子的 Lindblad 跳跃算子。值得注意的是，跳跃和相互作用项都映射到跳跃算子上，这些算子保留了沿着各个量子轨迹的马约拉纳费米子的高斯性。因此，可以仅使用两点相关函数来阐明动力学，并且可以有效地模拟每个轨迹，并且计算成本与系统规模呈多项式缩放。我们进一步表明，有限的粒子数需要负耗散率，从而导致本质上的非马尔可夫动力学。相应的轨迹解析涉及正随机权重和负随机权重，并且存在符号问题和大波动，因此收敛需要指数级数量的轨迹。尽管各个轨迹的高斯表示有效，但总体计算成本在系统规模上仍然呈指数级增长，但很大程度上取决于非马尔可夫分解的计算复杂性，这激发了对此类分解效率的进一步研究。

articles.title: Physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (PIKANs) for noise-robust reconstruction of boiling heat flux from infrared measurements
articles.title_zh: 基于物理的柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络 (PIKAN)，用于通过红外测量对沸腾热通量进行抗噪声重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20613v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recovering a noise-amplified inverse quantity from corrupted boundary data is a recurring problem in physics-informed learning for real-world applications. Specifically, small perturbations in the measured field are magnified through the spatial derivatives needed to reconstruct the target, and hence conventional discretization solvers turn them into large unphysical oscillations. We study this problem through the reconstruction of local time-resolved nucleate-boiling heat flux, which cannot be measured directly and must be inferred from infrared surface temperatures by solving an unsteady three-dimensional heat-conduction problem with sharp and rapidly evolving liquid-vapor interface gradients. We show that neither network architecture nor optimizer alone overcomes the spectral bias that smooths away these interface-scale features, and that the two must be addressed jointly. Our approach combines a Chebyshev physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold network (PIKAN) backbone, a quasi-second-order (SOAP) optimizer, and a temperature-annealed residual-based resampling scheme that concentrates collocation points at high-residual interface regions. Trained directly on experimental infrared measurements imposed as a boundary condition, the network resolves high-frequency bubble signatures and the high-flux distribution tail much better than a Fourier-feature PINN of equal size and training budget. In particular, it selectively filters measurement noise while preserving the physically meaningful high-frequency features, suppressing the spurious oscillations that contaminate finite-volume reconstructions and yielding more physically consistent heat-flux estimates from noisy experimental data.
articles.abstract_zh: 从损坏的边界数据中恢复噪声放大的反量是现实世界应用的物理知识学习中反复出现的问题。具体来说，测量场中的小扰动通过重建目标所需的空间导数被放大，因此传统的离散解算器将它们转化为大的非物理振荡。我们通过重建局部时间分辨的核沸腾热通量来研究这个问题，该热通量不能直接测量，必须通过解决具有急剧且快速变化的液-汽界面梯度的非稳态三维热传导问题来从红外表面温度推断。我们表明，单独的网络架构和优化器都无法克服平滑这些接口尺度特征的谱偏差，并且必须共同解决两者。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从损坏的边界数据中恢复噪声放大的反量是现实世界应用的物理知识学习中反复出现的问题。具体来说，测量场中的小扰动通过重建目标所需的空间导数被放大，因此传统的离散解算器将它们转化为大的非物理振荡。我们通过重建局部时间分辨的核沸腾热通量来研究这个问题，该热通量不能直接测量，必须通过解决具有急剧且快速变化的液-汽界面梯度的非稳态三维热传导问题来从红外表面温度推断。我们表明，单独的网络架构和优化器都无法克服平滑这些接口尺度特征的谱偏差，并且必须共同解决两者。我们的方法结合了切比雪夫物理信息的柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络 (PIKAN) 主干、准二阶 (SOAP) 优化器和基于温度退火的残差重采样方案，该方案将配置点集中在高残差界面区域。该网络直接根据作为边界条件施加的实验红外测量进行训练，可以比相同大小和训练预算的傅里叶特征 PINN 更好地解析高频气泡特征和高通量分布尾部。特别是，它选择性地过滤测量噪声，同时保留物理上有意义的高频特征，抑制污染有限体积重建的寄生振荡，并从噪声实验数据中产生物理上更一致的热通量估计。

articles.title: On the Assessment of Domain Decomposition Approaches in Extended Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the Shock-Dominated Burgers Equation
articles.title_zh: 扩展物理信息神经网络中激波主导的 Burgers 方程的域分解方法的评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20621v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free framework for solving partial differential equations but often struggle with sharp gradients and shock-dominated solutions. Extended Physics-Informed Neural Networks (XPINNs) address this challenge through domain decomposition; however, the effects of decomposition design, overlap, and local network capacity on solution accuracy remain insufficiently characterized. This work presents a systematic assessment of domain decomposition configurations for XPINNs applied to the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation (ν=0.01/π). We compare a standard PINN, a conventional XPINN, a shock-focused XPINN with increased network capacity in the shock-containing subdomain, and overlapping XPINNs with different overlap widths. All configurations are trained using a common protocol based on Adam, L-BFGS refinement, and ten Residual-based Adaptive Refinement (RAR) cycles. Performance is evaluated against a reference solution using global and shock-region relative L₂ and L_infty errors, maximum PDE residuals, and interface continuity errors. The results show that decomposition design strongly affects XPINN accuracy and shock resolution. Among the overlapping configurations, the smallest overlap provides the best accuracy, while larger overlaps degrade performance. The shock-focused XPINN achieves the lowest overall solution errors, indicating that increased local network capacity can provide greater benefit than increasing overlap alone. RAR produces the largest improvements during early refinement stages, followed by increasingly non-monotonic changes in accuracy. These findings highlight the importance of jointly considering decomposition, interface coupling, network capacity, and adaptive refinement for shock-dominated problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 提供了用于求解偏微分方程的无网格框架，但常常难以应对尖锐的梯度和冲击主导的解决方案。扩展物理信息神经网络 (XPINN) 通过域分解解决这一挑战；然而，分解设计、重叠和本地网络容量对解决方案精度的影响仍未得到充分表征。这项工作对应用于一维粘性 Burgers 方程 (ν=0.01/π) 的 XPINN 的域分解配置进行了系统评估。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 提供了用于求解偏微分方程的无网格框架，但常常难以应对尖锐的梯度和冲击主导的解决方案。扩展物理信息神经网络 (XPINN) 通过域分解解决这一挑战；然而，分解设计、重叠和本地网络容量对解决方案精度的影响仍未得到充分表征。这项工作对应用于一维粘性 Burgers 方程 (ν=0.01/π) 的 XPINN 的域分解配置进行了系统评估。我们比较了标准 PINN、传统 XPINN、在包含冲击的子域中具有增加的网络容量的以冲击为中心的 XPINN，以及具有不同重叠宽度的重叠 XPINN。所有配置均使用基于 Adam、L-BFGS 细化和十个基于残差的自适应细化 (RAR) 周期的通用协议进行训练。使用全局和冲击区域相对 L2 和 L_infty 误差、最大 PDE 残差和界面连续性误差，根据参考解来评估性能。结果表明，分解设计强烈影响 XPINN 精度和冲击分辨率。在重叠配置中，最小的重叠可提供最佳的精度，而较大的重叠会降低性能。以冲击为中心的 XPINN 实现了最低的整体解决方案错误，这表明增加本地网络容量比单独增加重叠可以提供更大的好处。 RAR 在早期细化阶段产生了最大的改进，随后精度的变化越来越不单调。这些发现强调了针对冲击主导问题联合考虑分解、接口耦合、网络容量和自适应细化的重要性。

articles.title: BBun: an unsteady vortex-ring panel method for interacting lifting bodies, box wings and propellers
articles.title_zh: BBun：一种用于相互作用升力体、箱翼和螺旋桨的非定常涡环面板方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This report documents BBun (Blunt Body unsteady), a low-order code for the unsteady potential flow around one or more interacting three-dimensional bodies. The bodies are represented by vortex rings (piecewise-constant doublets) with a Neumann boundary condition; free vortex sheets are shed from the trailing edges and, optionally, from the tips, and convected in time, with an implicit unsteady Kutta condition. The report describes the choices that make the discretization consistent and convergent (a single desingularized kernel per wake line, a bordered factorization of the singular Neumann problem, interior velocity conditions for the nearly singular mode of ring-shaped bodies, the detection of the separation lines from the grid connectivity) and the extensions to several bodies, box wings, symmetric configurations (image method), non-lifting bodies, rigidly rotating bodies (propellers), the unsteady Bernoulli equation, a wake-body collision treatment and a strip-wise integral boundary layer. The verification and validation are reported in full: potential flow around a sphere, sensitivity and grid convergence, the two-dimensional limit, an independent vortex-lattice method, the NACA 0015 wing of McAlister and Takahashi (loads and chordwise pressures), the NACA 0012 profile drag, the biplane of Knight and Noyes, Prandtl's best wing system, Wagner's function and blade-element momentum theory for a propeller. A complete aircraft with counter-rotating tractor propellers illustrates the use of the code.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报告记录了 BBun（钝体不稳定），这是一种低阶代码，用于描述一个或多个相互作用的三维物体周围的不稳定势流。这些物体由具有诺依曼边界条件的涡环（分段常数双峰）表示；自由涡流片从后缘和可选地从尖端脱落，并及时对流，具有隐含的不稳定库塔条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 该报告记录了 BBun（钝体不稳定），这是一种低阶代码，用于描述一个或多个相互作用的三维物体周围的不稳定势流。这些物体由具有诺依曼边界条件的涡环（分段常数双峰）表示；自由涡流片从后缘和可选地从尖端脱落，并及时对流，具有隐含的不稳定库塔条件。该报告描述了使离散化一致和收敛的选择（每个尾流线的单个去奇异化内核、奇异诺伊曼问题的边界分解、环形物体的近奇异模式的内部速度条件、网格连通性的分离线的检测）以及对多个物体、箱翼、对称配置（图像方法）、非升力物体、刚性旋转物体（螺旋桨）、非定常伯努利方程、尾迹物体碰撞处理和带状积分边界层。完整报告了验证和确认：围绕球体的势流、灵敏度和网格收敛、二维极限、独立涡晶格方法、McAlister 和 Takahashi 的 NACA 0015 机翼（载荷和弦向压力）、NACA 0012 轮廓阻力、Knight 和 Noyes 的双翼飞机、普朗特的最佳机翼系统、瓦格纳函数和螺旋桨的叶片单元动量理论。一架带有反向旋转牵引螺旋桨的完整飞机说明了该代码的用途。

articles.title: On magnetic-field consistency in the sideways force calculation of Phys. Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)
articles.title_zh: 物理学侧向力计算中的磁场一致性研究。等离子 27, 012508 (2020)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20644v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We examine the consistency of the equilibrium magnetic field B₀ used in the analytical calculation of the sideways wall force by A. A. Martynov and S. Yu. Medvedev [Phys. Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)] and the subsequent reformulation presented in [Phys. Plasmas 27, 054702 (2020)]. In these attempts, the current density j₀ = nabla × B₀ must vanish in the vacuum regions adjacent to the wall, making B₀ curl-free as a complement to the natural nabla · B₀ = 0. Since the cited works incorporate selected toroidal corrections without explicitly specifying the corresponding differential operators, we test B₀ adopted in these models against Maxwell's equations using both toroidal and quasi-cylindrical formulations. We show that the divergence-free requirement is violated in the toroidal interpretation, while the curl-free condition is not satisfied in the quasi-cylindrical limit. The reformulation likewise fails to define a self-consistent equilibrium field with toroidal effects because the accompanying field corrections required for consistency with Maxwell's equations are not specified. Since the sideways force calculations are built upon these inconsistent field prescriptions, their analytical derivations are consequently compromised. The resulting arguments therefore cannot serve as a valid basis for revising either the earlier results established by D. V. Mironov and V. D. Pustovitov [Phys. Plasmas 24, 092508 (2017)] or those obtained within the single-harmonic analysis [Phys. Plasmas 22, 052502 (2015)].
articles.abstract_zh: 我们检验了 A. A. Martynov 和 S. Yu 在侧壁力分析计算中使用的平衡磁场 B₀ 的一致性。梅德韦杰夫[物理学。 Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)] 以及 [Phys. Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)] 中提出的后续重新配方。等离子 27, 054702 (2020)]。在这些尝试中，电流密度 j₀ = nabla × B₀ 必须在邻近壁的真空区域中消失，使 B₀ 无卷曲，作为自然 nabla · B₀ = 0 的补充。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们检验了 A. A. Martynov 和 S. Yu 在侧壁力分析计算中使用的平衡磁场 B₀ 的一致性。梅德韦杰夫[物理学。 Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)] 以及 [Phys. Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)] 中提出的后续重新配方。等离子 27, 054702 (2020)]。在这些尝试中，电流密度 j₀ = nabla × B₀ 必须在邻近壁的真空区域中消失，使 B₀ 无卷曲，作为自然 nabla · B₀ = 0 的补充。由于引用的作品结合了选定的环形校正，而没有明确指定相应的微分算子，因此我们使用环形和准圆柱公式来测试这些模型中采用的 B₀ 与麦克斯韦方程组。我们表明，在环形解释中违反了无散度要求，而在准圆柱极限中不满足无旋度条件。重新表述同样无法定义具有环形效应的自洽平衡场，因为未指定与麦克斯韦方程组一致所需的伴随场校正。由于侧向力计算是建立在这些不一致的现场规定的基础上的，因此它们的分析推导会受到影响。因此，由此产生的论点不能作为修改 D. V. Mironov 和 V. D. Pustovitov [Phys. Plasmas 24, 092508 (2017)] 或在单谐波分析中获得的结果 [Phys. Plasmas 24, 092508 (2017)] 或在单谐波分析中获得的结果等离子体 22, 052502 (2015)]。

articles.title: Global-in-time Spectral Duhamel-Picard Method for Post-Exposure Bake Simulation and Physics-Informed Neural Operators for EUV Lithography
articles.title_zh: 用于 EUV 光刻曝光后烘烤模拟的全局实时光谱 Duhamel-Picard 方法和基于物理的神经算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20655v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a global-in-time spectral Duhamel-Picard method with polynomial expansions for post-exposure bake (PEB) simulation. The coupled acid-quencher reaction-diffusion equations are reformulated as nonlinear Volterra integral equations using the Duhamel principle. Full trajectories are represented by finite polynomial expansions, with temporal coefficient fields determined over the bake interval by Anderson-accelerated Picard iteration, thereby avoiding sequential time marching. In 3-D PEB simulations, we employ Chebyshev and Legendre temporal bases while evaluating the Duhamel integrals using the corresponding Gaussian quadrature rules. We demonstrate that the proposed method simulates a large domain of 1200×1200×100 voxels on the order of one minute. The representation is further incorporated into a physics-informed neural operator (PINO) with a mixed-transform variant of a factorized Fourier neural operator, which is trained without precomputed solution trajectories. Together, the integral formulation and its PINO extension enable accelerated, time-marching-free prediction of concentration fields at arbitrary times within the bake interval.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于曝光后烘烤 (PEB) 模拟的具有多项式展开的全局时间光谱 Duhamel-Picard 方法。使用 Duhamel 原理将耦合酸猝灭剂反应扩散方程重新表述为非线性 Volterra 积分方程。完整的轨迹由有限多项式展开表示，时间系数场由安德森加速皮卡德迭代在烘焙间隔内确定，从而避免顺序时间行进。在 3-D PEB 模拟中，我们采用切比雪夫和勒让德时间基，同时使用相应的高斯求积规则评估杜哈梅尔积分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种用于曝光后烘烤 (PEB) 模拟的具有多项式展开的全局时间光谱 Duhamel-Picard 方法。使用 Duhamel 原理将耦合酸猝灭剂反应扩散方程重新表述为非线性 Volterra 积分方程。完整的轨迹由有限多项式展开表示，时间系数场由安德森加速皮卡德迭代在烘焙间隔内确定，从而避免顺序时间行进。在 3-D PEB 模拟中，我们采用切比雪夫和勒让德时间基，同时使用相应的高斯求积规则评估杜哈梅尔积分。我们证明了所提出的方法可以在一分钟的时间内模拟 1200×1200×100 体素的大域。该表示进一步被合并到具有因式分解傅里叶神经算子的混合变换变体的物理信息神经算子（PINO）中，该算子在没有预先计算解轨迹的情况下进行训练。积分公式及其 Pino 扩展共同实现了烘烤间隔内任意时间的浓度场的加速、无时间步进预测。

articles.title: Building and calibrating a 3Di subgrid flood model for Hanoi, without a surveyed terrain model, drainage data, or rain gauges
articles.title_zh: 在没有测量地形模型、排水数据或雨量计的情况下，为河内构建和校准 3Di 次网格洪水模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Urban hydrodynamic flood models typically rely on a surveyed terrain model, an explicit pipe drainage network, and rain gauge measurements, none of which were available for the inundation following Typhoon Matmo in My Dinh and Tay Mo, Hanoi, on 7 October 2025. The present study addresses this issue by documenting the construction and calibration of a 32.8 km² 3Di subgrid model under severe data constraints, demonstrating how unmonitored catchments can be simulated using openly accessible sources. Specifically, a 1 m digital elevation model was systematically repaired for river and lake bathymetry, unsurveyed water bodies, road underpasses, and an excavation pit to re-establish essential overland flow paths. In addition, assigned infiltration rates across land-cover classes were utilized to stand in for the unrecorded subsurface sewer system, while half-hourly satellite precipitation from the IMERG Late product provided rainfall forcing for a closed two-dimensional domain. Model calibration was conducted against eight crowdsourced depth observations. The simulation results demonstrated that six observation points retained surface water and were closely aligned with the reported values within 2.2 cm. However, two peripheral locations along Tay Mo Road and Road 70 remained completely dry in the model. Because all eight points were utilized during parameter adjustment and no independent validation dataset was withheld, this correspondence reflects a calibration fit rather than an unconstrained predictive test.
articles.abstract_zh: 城市水动力洪水模型通常依赖于勘测地形模型、明确的排水管网和雨量计测量，而这些都无法用于 2025 年 10 月 7 日河内美亭和西莫台风 Matmo 后的洪水。本研究通过记录严格数据限制下 32.8 平方公里 3Di 子网格模型的构建和校准来解决这个问题，展示如何使用公开可访问的来源来模拟不受监控的流域。具体而言，系统修复了 1 m 数字高程模型，用于河流和湖泊测深、未测量的水体、道路地下通道和基坑，以重新建立重要的地表水流路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 城市水动力洪水模型通常依赖于勘测地形模型、明确的排水管网和雨量计测量，而这些都无法用于 2025 年 10 月 7 日河内美亭和西莫台风 Matmo 后的洪水。本研究通过记录严格数据限制下 32.8 平方公里 3Di 子网格模型的构建和校准来解决这个问题，展示如何使用公开可访问的来源来模拟不受监控的流域。具体而言，系统修复了 1 m 数字高程模型，用于河流和湖泊测深、未测量的水体、道路地下通道和基坑，以重新建立重要的地表水流路径。此外，利用指定的跨土地覆盖类别的渗透率来代替未记录的地下下水道系统，而来自 IMERG Late 产品的半小时卫星降水量为封闭的二维域提供了降雨强迫。针对八个众包深度观测进行了模型校准。模拟结果表明，6 个观测点保留了地表水，并且与报告值在 2.2 cm 范围内紧密一致。然而，模型中西莫路和 70 号公路沿线的两个外围地点仍然完全干燥。由于在参数调整过程中使用了所有八个点，并且没有保留独立的验证数据集，因此这种对应关系反映了校准拟合而不是无约束的预测测试。

articles.title: A Rydberg atom array coupled to a high-cooperativity optical cavity
articles.title_zh: 耦合到高协同光学腔的里德伯原子阵列
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrating Rydberg-state control of atom-atom interactions with cavity control of atom-light interactions enables the combination of local entangling operations with photon-mediated long-range coupling, measurement, and communication. Such integration is challenging because electric fields generated by charges on cavity optics and by cavity-stabilizing actuators may disturb Rydberg-state coherence. Here, we couple a Rydberg tweezer array to a high-cooperativity optical cavity, suppressing the electric fields produced by cavity length actuation so that the residual field variation of about 3~mV/cm rms does not limit Rydberg coherence. We demonstrate two capabilities that neither system provides alone. First, we use Purcell-enhanced fluorescence to read out atoms directly in the ground-Rydberg basis within 7.5~mus, well within the Rydberg-state lifetime, with ground- and Rydberg-state detection infidelities of 3% and 5%, respectively, and with low atom loss. Second, we use Rydberg-Rydberg interactions to control collective light-atom scattering into the cavity mode. Specifically, we drive blockaded Rabi oscillations between a state with two ground-state atoms, which scatter collectively with a superradiant or subradiant rate controlled by the atomic positions, and an entangled state with a single Rydberg excitation, which scatters like a single atom. These capabilities open routes toward networked Rydberg processors, mid-circuit measurements in analog quantum simulators, and many-body quantum optics with entangled emitters coupled collectively to light.
articles.abstract_zh: 将原子-原子相互作用的里德堡态控制与原子-光相互作用的腔控制相结合，能够将局部纠缠操作与光子介导的远程耦合、测量和通信相结合。这种集成具有挑战性，因为腔光学器件上的电荷和腔稳定执行器产生的电场可能会干扰里德堡态相干性。在这里，我们将里德伯镊子阵列耦合到高协同性光学腔，抑制腔长驱动产生的电场，使得约3~mV/cm rms的残余场变化不会限制里德伯相干性。我们展示了两个系统都单独提供的两种功能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将原子-原子相互作用的里德堡态控制与原子-光相互作用的腔控制相结合，能够将局部纠缠操作与光子介导的远程耦合、测量和通信相结合。这种集成具有挑战性，因为腔光学器件上的电荷和腔稳定执行器产生的电场可能会干扰里德堡态相干性。在这里，我们将里德伯镊子阵列耦合到高协同性光学腔，抑制腔长驱动产生的电场，使得约3~mV/cm rms的残余场变化不会限制里德伯相干性。我们展示了两个系统都单独提供的两种功能。首先，我们使用 Purcell 增强荧光在 7.5~mus 范围内直接读出基里德伯基中的原子，完全在里德伯态寿命内，基态和里德伯态检测不保真度分别为 3% 和 5%，并且原子损失低。其次，我们使用里德伯-里德伯相互作用来控制集体光原子散射到腔模式中。具体来说，我们在具有两个基态原子的状态和具有单个里德伯激发的纠缠态之间驱动封闭的拉比振荡，这两个基态原子以由原子位置控制的超辐射或次辐射速率共同散射，而纠缠态则像单个原子一样散射。这些功能为联网里德伯处理器、模拟量子模拟器中的中电路测量以及具有与光耦合的纠缠发射器的多体量子光学开辟了道路。

articles.title: Aluminum wide-range EOS sensitivity in Z-pinch dynamic-hohlraum liner-foam impact and outgoing radiation
articles.title_zh: Z 箍缩动态空腔衬垫泡沫冲击和传出辐射中铝的宽范围 EOS 灵敏度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a Z-pinch dynamic hohlraum, an aluminum liner collides with a central foam and converts kinetic energy into radiation, and the liner-foam response depends on the aluminum equation of state (EOS). We construct a wide-range aluminum equation-of-state table from density functional theory (DFT) simulations over solid-liquid-plasma regions, denoted DFT-eos. Mixed deterministic-stochastic finite-temperature DFT (mDFT) gives the electron thermal contribution; quantum molecular dynamics (QMD) with classical calibration gives the ion part. We perform one-dimensional cylindrical radiation magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) simulations at a peak current of 50 MA and rise times of 220-300 ns on a single-layer light foam load. Opacity and electrical conductivity are fixed; only the liner Al EOS is changed between DFT-eos and the quotidian EOS (QEOS). Impact time and peak liner kinetic energy change little between the two tables. Larger differences appear in flight-segment density, the contact state at impact, and the time history of outgoing radiation power at the outer interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 Z 箍缩动态空腔中，铝衬里与中心泡沫碰撞，将动能转化为辐射，衬里-泡沫响应取决于铝状态方程 (EOS)。我们根据固-液-等离子体区域的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 模拟构建了一个广泛的铝状态方程表，表示为 DFT-eos。混合确定性随机有限温度 DFT (mDFT) 给出了电子热贡献；量子分子动力学 (QMD) 与经典校准给出了离子部分。我们在单层轻质泡沫负载上以 50 MA 的峰值电流和 220-300 ns 的上升时间进行一维圆柱形辐射磁流体动力学 (MHD) 模拟。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 Z 箍缩动态空腔中，铝衬里与中心泡沫碰撞，将动能转化为辐射，衬里-泡沫响应取决于铝状态方程 (EOS)。我们根据固-液-等离子体区域的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 模拟构建了一个广泛的铝状态方程表，表示为 DFT-eos。混合确定性随机有限温度 DFT (mDFT) 给出了电子热贡献；量子分子动力学 (QMD) 与经典校准给出了离子部分。我们在单层轻质泡沫负载上以 50 MA 的峰值电流和 220-300 ns 的上升时间进行一维圆柱形辐射磁流体动力学 (MHD) 模拟。不透明度和电导率是固定的； DFT-eos 和日常 EOS (QEOS) 之间只有线性 Al EOS 发生了变化。冲击时间和峰值线性动能在两个表之间变化不大。较大的差异出现在飞行段密度、撞击时的接触状态以及外界面处输出辐射功率的时间历史上。

articles.title: Constrained Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory for Excited-State Dynamics with Nuclear Quantum Effects
articles.title_zh: 核量子效应激发态动力学的约束核电子轨道时变密度泛函理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21120v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nuclear quantum effects can strongly influence excited-state processes involving light nuclei, yet their inclusion in practical molecular dynamics remains challenging. We develop constrained nuclear-electronic orbital time-dependent density functional theory (CNEO-TDDFT), which incorporates quantum-nuclear delocalization into full-dimensional effective excited-state potential energy surfaces while retaining the formal structure and computational scaling of conventional TDDFT. Analytic gradients are also developed, enabling efficient on-the-fly excited-state dynamics. CNEO-TDDFT substantially improves excited-state vibrational frequencies involving hydrogen motion and reduces the root-mean-square deviation from experiment from 113 cm⁻¹ to 26 cm⁻¹. For excited-state proton transfer in 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline (HBQ), CNEO-TDDFT yields a characteristic transfer time of 14.0 fs, compared with 25.5 fs from conventional TDDFT, consistent with the experimentally inferred ultrafast timescale of 12±6 fs. These results establish CNEO-TDDFT as an accurate and efficient framework for excited-state dynamics with nuclear quantum effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 核量子效应可以强烈影响涉及轻核的激发态过程，但将其纳入实际分子动力学中仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了约束核电子轨道时间相关密度泛函理论（CNEO-TDDFT），该理论将量子核离域结合到全维有效激发态势能面中，同时保留了传统 TDDFT 的形式结构和计算尺度。还开发了解析梯度，实现高效的动态激发态动力学。 CNEO-TDDFT 显着提高了涉及氢运动的激发态振动频率，并将实验的均方根偏差从 113 cm -1 降低到 26 cm -1 。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 核量子效应可以强烈影响涉及轻核的激发态过程，但将其纳入实际分子动力学中仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了约束核电子轨道时间相关密度泛函理论（CNEO-TDDFT），该理论将量子核离域结合到全维有效激发态势能面中，同时保留了传统 TDDFT 的形式结构和计算尺度。还开发了解析梯度，实现高效的动态激发态动力学。 CNEO-TDDFT 显着提高了涉及氢运动的激发态振动频率，并将实验的均方根偏差从 113 cm -1 降低到 26 cm -1 。对于 10-羟基苯并[h]喹啉 (HBQ) 中的激发态质子转移，CNEO-TDDFT 产生的特征转移时间为 14.0 fs，而传统 TDDFT 为 25.5 fs，与实验推断的 12±6 fs 超快时间尺度一致。这些结果将 CNEO-TDDFT 确立为具有核量子效应的激发态动力学的准确且高效的框架。

articles.title: Energy Flow Shapes the Decomposition Dynamics of a Reactive Atmospheric Intermediate
articles.title_zh: 能量流塑造反应性大气中间体的分解动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21259v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The unimolecular dynamics of Criegee intermediates depend strongly on their internal energy, which can differ substantially between nascent atmospheric species and laboratory-prepared reactants. Here, the decomposition dynamics of it anti-CH₃CHOO are investigated using molecular dynamics simulations on a neural network-based potential energy surface under thermal and mode-selective vibrational excitation. Simulations were performed at internal energies representative of those released during ozonolysis (chemical/thermal preparation, TP) or following vibrational excitation (VibEx) along the CH-stretching mode with two or three quanta, as can be done in laboratory studies. These excitation conditions strongly affect reaction yields and kinetics, with VibEx promoting passage across the initial cyclization barrier. For TP, 35 kcal/mol of internal energy are required to form molecular products, whereas for VibEx, 27 kcal/mol are sufficient. Although TP and VibEx ensembles access largely the same fragmentation pathways with comparable relative yields, the absolute product yields, characteristic timescales, and kinetic behavior differ substantially. Methyldioxirane is found to be a kinetic trap along the pathway. The resulting molecular-level description of it anti-CH₃CHOO decomposition provides guidance for interpreting experiments and contributes to a broader understanding of energy-dependent Criegee-intermediate dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: Criegee中间体的单分子动力学很大程度上取决于它们的内能，新生大气物质和实验室制备的反应物之间的内能可能存在很大差异。在这里，在热和模式选择性振动激励下，使用基于神经网络的势能表面的分子动力学模拟研究了它的抗 CH₃CHOO 的分解动力学。模拟是在代表臭氧分解（化学/热制备，TP）期间或沿着具有两个或三个量子的 CH 拉伸模式的振动激发（VibEx）释放的内部能量进行的，正如可以在实验室研究中完成的那样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Criegee中间体的单分子动力学很大程度上取决于它们的内能，新生大气物质和实验室制备的反应物之间的内能可能存在很大差异。在这里，在热和模式选择性振动激励下，使用基于神经网络的势能表面的分子动力学模拟研究了它的抗 CH₃CHOO 的分解动力学。模拟是在代表臭氧分解（化学/热制备，TP）期间或沿着具有两个或三个量子的 CH 拉伸模式的振动激发（VibEx）释放的内部能量进行的，正如可以在实验室研究中完成的那样。这些激发条件强烈影响反应产率和动力学，VibEx 促进穿过初始环化势垒。对于TP，形成分子产物需要35 kcal/mol的内能，而对于VibEx，27 kcal/mol就足够了。尽管 TP 和 VibEx 系综获得的裂解途径基本相同且相对产量相当，但绝对产物产量、特征时间尺度和动力学行为却存在很大差异。发现甲基二环氧乙烷是该路径上的动力学陷阱。由此产生的抗 CH₃CHOO 分解的分子水平描述为解释实验提供了指导，并有助于更广泛地理解能量依赖的 Criegee-中间动力学。

articles.title: Machine Learning Surrogate Model for Accelerating InGaAs/GaAs Quantum Well Laser Design
articles.title_zh: 用于加速InGaAs/GaAs量子阱激光器设计的机器学习替代模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A machine-learning surrogate model based on a multi-layer perceptron neural network is used to predict six laser performance metrics for an indium gallium arsenide quantum well laser given epitaxial layer parameters as inputs. The surrogate model was trained on simulation data from a set of 4999 designs which were generated by varying epitaxial layer parameters and simulating each design with Harold to extract performance metrics.
