Electrical transport remains strongly localized, transitioning from small-polaron hopping at high temperatures to variable-range hopping at intermediate temperatures. These results position Sr2FeRuO6 as a representative 3d-4d hybrid system in which quenched disorder stabilizes spin inhomogeneity, while polaronic and hopping transport are also observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 对复杂过渡金属氧化物的全面了解是设计具有定制磁性和传输功能的下一代自旋电子材料的关键。我们研究了 3d-4d 杂化双钙钛矿 Sr2FeRuO6 中结构紊乱、受挫磁性和局域电荷传输之间的相互作用。该化合物采用单斜结构，具有显着的 B 位反位无序，从而驱动其非常规行为。磁性测量发现了一个远高于有序温度的鲁棒格里菲斯相，证明了无序矩阵内存在稳定的短程铁磁簇。电传输仍然强烈局域化，从高温下的小极化子跳跃过渡到中间温度下的可变范围跳跃。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对复杂过渡金属氧化物的全面了解是设计具有定制磁性和传输功能的下一代自旋电子材料的关键。我们研究了 3d-4d 杂化双钙钛矿 Sr2FeRuO6 中结构紊乱、受挫磁性和局域电荷传输之间的相互作用。该化合物采用单斜结构，具有显着的 B 位反位无序，从而驱动其非常规行为。磁性测量发现了一个远高于有序温度的鲁棒格里菲斯相，证明了无序矩阵内存在稳定的短程铁磁簇。电传输仍然强烈局域化，从高温下的小极化子跳跃过渡到中间温度下的可变范围跳跃。这些结果将 Sr2FeRuO6 定位为代表性的 3d-4d 杂化系统，其中猝灭无序稳定了自旋不均匀性，同时还观察到了极化和跳跃传输。

articles.title: Access Rate-Dependent Endurance Behavior of Ferroelectric Hafnium Zirconium Oxide Capacitors
articles.title_zh: 铁电铪锆氧化物电容器与接入速率相关的耐久性行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fluorite-structured ferroelectrics, such as hafnium zirconium oxide (Hf₁₋ₓZrₓO₂), are among the most promising materials for developing the next generation of low-power nonvolatile memories. Emulating realistic operating scenarios for ferroelectric memories requires performing access rate-dependent endurance tests. The access rate-dependent reduction of the switched polarization cannot be described as a mere superposition of fatigue and imprint effects, which are observed in conventional endurance and retention tests, respectively. The interplay between these degradation mechanisms and its correlation with the delay time in between the programming pulses remains unclear. Combining electrical testing through voltage pulses with ab initio and drift-diffusion simulations provides a comprehensive perspective on the microscopic origin of the access rate-dependent reduction of the switched polarization of ferroelectric capacitors based on product-relevant 5 nm thick Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂ films. The role of oxygen vacancy defects accumulating at the electrode-ferroelectric interface with delay time in reducing the fraction of switchable domains is elucidated considering electron transfer processes which change the defect charge state. Building upon this theoretical understanding, a physics-based model to extrapolate the long-term access rate-dependent endurance performance is developed and experimentally verified for temperatures up to 135degC and delay times up to 2 ms.
articles.abstract_zh: 萤石结构铁电体，例如氧化铪锆（Hf₁₋ₓZrₓO2），是开发下一代低功耗非易失性存储器最有前途的材料之一。模拟铁电存储器的实际操作场景需要执行与访问速率相关的耐久性测试。切换偏振的依赖于访问速率的减少不能被描述为疲劳和印记效应的单纯叠加，这分别在传统的耐久性和保持测试中观察到。这些退化机制之间的相互作用及其与编程脉冲之间的延迟时间的相关性仍不清楚。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 萤石结构铁电体，例如氧化铪锆（Hf₁₋ₓZrₓO2），是开发下一代低功耗非易失性存储器最有前途的材料之一。模拟铁电存储器的实际操作场景需要执行与访问速率相关的耐久性测试。切换偏振的依赖于访问速率的减少不能被描述为疲劳和印记效应的单纯叠加，这分别在传统的耐久性和保持测试中观察到。这些退化机制之间的相互作用及其与编程脉冲之间的延迟时间的相关性仍不清楚。将通过电压脉冲进行的电气测试与从头算和漂移扩散模拟相结合，可以全面了解基于产品相关的 5 nm 厚 Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O2 薄膜的铁电电容器开关极化与访问速率相关的减少的微观起源。考虑到改变缺陷电荷状态的电子转移过程，阐明了氧空位缺陷在电极-铁电界面处累积的延迟时间在减少可切换域分数中的作用。基于这一理论理解，我们开发了一个基于物理的模型来推断长期访问速率相关的耐久性能，并针对高达 135 摄氏度的温度和高达 2 毫秒的延迟时间进行了实验验证。

articles.title: A Topological-Geometrical Descriptor (TGD) for Scalable and Interpretable Modeling of Two-Dimensional Carbon Networks
articles.title_zh: 用于二维碳网络可扩展和可解释建模的拓扑几何描述符（TGD）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a compact Topological-Geometrical Descriptor (TGD) for planar two-dimensional carbon networks. Atomic coordinates are mapped to a periodic planar graph and represented through ring populations, topological-charge statistics, projected ring geometry, and dual-graph defect adjacency. The resulting modeling vector contains 19 physically interpretable features. We evaluate TGD on 120 published planar carbon allotropes using the DFT relative energy per atom with respect to graphene as the target. Repeated five-fold cross-validation with gradient boosting yields a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.0826 +/- 0.0138 eV/atom and R2 = 0.803 +/- 0.074. Under the same validation protocol, TGD gives a mean MAE of 0.0828 eV/atom, compared with 0.0929 eV/atom for a 203-feature Matminer representation. We further analyze 360 vacancy-defected graphene configurations spanning 12 vacancy concentrations from 2 to 24 percent. When entire vacancy concentrations are held out, TGD gives a pooled MAE of 0.269 eV/vacancy and R2 = 0.861, outperforming simple baselines based on vacancy concentration alone or non-hexagonal-ring fraction alone. Sensitivity tests show that the inferred edge sets are stable to moderate changes in the adaptive bond factor. Finally, the mean absolute topological charge is examined as a one-variable empirical surrogate for the allotrope dataset and is treated explicitly as dataset-specific rather than universal. These results show that TGD combines compact prediction with direct structural interpretation while making clear the present restriction to single-layer planar carbon networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们为平面二维碳网络引入了一种紧凑的拓扑几何描述符（TGD）。原子坐标被映射到周期性平面图，并通过环布居、拓扑电荷统计、投影环几何形状和双图缺陷邻接来表示。生成的建模向量包含 19 个物理上可解释的特征。我们使用相对于石墨烯的每个原子的 DFT 相对能量作为目标，对 120 种已发表的平面碳同素异形体进行 TGD 评估。使用梯度增强的重复五倍交叉验证产生的平均绝对误差 (MAE) 为 0.0826 +/- 0.0138 eV/原子，R2 = 0.803 +/- 0.074。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为平面二维碳网络引入了一种紧凑的拓扑几何描述符（TGD）。原子坐标被映射到周期性平面图，并通过环布居、拓扑电荷统计、投影环几何形状和双图缺陷邻接来表示。生成的建模向量包含 19 个物理上可解释的特征。我们使用相对于石墨烯的每个原子的 DFT 相对能量作为目标，对 120 种已发表的平面碳同素异形体进行 TGD 评估。使用梯度增强的重复五倍交叉验证产生的平均绝对误差 (MAE) 为 0.0826 +/- 0.0138 eV/原子，R2 = 0.803 +/- 0.074。在相同的验证协议下，TGD 给出的平均 MAE 为 0.0828 eV/atom，而 203 个特征的 Matminer 表示的平均 MAE 为 0.0929 eV/atom。我们进一步分析了 360 个空位缺陷石墨烯构型，涵盖 12 个空位浓度（从 2% 到 24%）。当保持整个空位浓度时，TGD 给出的合并 MAE 为 0.269 eV/空位，R2 = 0.861，优于仅基于空位浓度或仅基于非六角环分数的简单基线。敏感性测试表明，推断的边缘集对于自适应粘合因子的适度变化是稳定的。最后，平均绝对拓扑电荷被检查为同素异形体数据集的一变量经验替代，并被明确视为数据集特定的而不是通用的。这些结果表明，TGD 将紧凑预测与直接结构解释相结合，同时明确了目前对单层平面碳网络的限制。

articles.title: Bulk superconductivity in quintuple-layer square-planar nickelate La6Ni5O12
articles.title_zh: 五层方形平面镍盐La6Ni5O12的体超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20249v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nickelate superconductors, sharing a similar electronic environment with cuprate superconductors, offer a promising platform for unraveling the mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity. However, the realization of superconductivity in these systems has so far been restricted to thin films or bulk samples under high-pressure. This limits the applicability of various experimental probes to study the mechanism of superconductivity, and hinders the potential application of the nickelate superconductors. Exploring bulk superconductivity at ambient pressure is therefore essential to understand its origin and enable broader experimental research. Here, we report the realization of bulk superconductivity at ambient-pressure in quintuple-layer square-planar (SP) nickelate La6Ni5O12. The SP phase is obtained by performing topotactic reaction on the quintuple-layer Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) compound La6Ni5O16. Optimized reduction condition endows La6Ni5O12 with a superconducting state that exhibits onset transition temperature of ~ 18 K, as verified by both zero resistance and diamagnetic shielding effect. Pronounced hysteresis loops revealed by magnetization and torque magnetometry demonstrate the occurrence of vortex pinning. Specific heat measurements on a polycrystalline pellet of La6Ni5O12 reveal a clear superconducting transition at ~18 K and a superconducting volume fraction of ~ 25%, which strongly supports the presence of bulk superconductivity. Our results establish an unprecedented bulk sample platform for investigating superconductivity in nickelates at ambient pressure, which paves the way for further experimental studies into the superconducting mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 镍酸盐超导体与铜酸盐超导体具有相似的电子环境，为揭示高温超导机制提供了一个有前景的平台。然而，迄今为止，这些系统中超导性的实现仅限于高压下的薄膜或块状样品。这限制了各种实验探针研究超导机理的适用性，并阻碍了镍酸盐超导体的潜在应用。因此，探索环境压力下的体超导性对于了解其起源并实现更广泛的实验研究至关重要。在这里，我们报告了在五层方形平面（SP）镍酸盐 La6Ni5O12 中在环境压力下实现了体超导性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 镍酸盐超导体与铜酸盐超导体具有相似的电子环境，为揭示高温超导机制提供了一个有前景的平台。然而，迄今为止，这些系统中超导性的实现仅限于高压下的薄膜或块状样品。这限制了各种实验探针研究超导机理的适用性，并阻碍了镍酸盐超导体的潜在应用。因此，探索环境压力下的体超导性对于了解其起源并实现更广泛的实验研究至关重要。在这里，我们报告了在五层方形平面（SP）镍酸盐 La6Ni5O12 中在环境压力下实现了体超导性。 SP相是通过对五层Ruddlesden-Popper（RP）化合物La6Ni5O16进行拓扑反应得到的。优化的还原条件赋予 La6Ni5O12 超导态，其起始转变温度约为 18 K，零电阻和抗磁屏蔽效应均证实了这一点。磁化和扭矩磁力测量揭示的明显磁滞回线证明了涡旋钉扎的发生。对 La6Ni5O12 多晶颗粒的比热测量表明，在约 18 K 时发生明显的超导转变，超导体积分数约为 25%，这有力地支持了体超导的存在。我们的研究结果建立了一个前所未有的大样本平台，用于研究环境压力下镍酸盐的超导性，这为进一步研究超导机制铺平了道路。

articles.title: Transport regimes in tunnel ferromagnetic Josephson junctions
articles.title_zh: 隧道铁磁约瑟夫森结中的传输机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic study of the temperature-dependent transport properties of Nb- and Al-based superconductor--insulator--thin superconductor--ferromagnet--superconductor (SIsFS) Josephson junctions. By varying the superconducting material and the thickness of the intermediate superconducting layer, we identify three distinct transport regimes: a tunnel-dominated SIS-like regime, a temperature-driven crossover, and a complex weak-link regime. A unified Usadel-based description connects these regimes through the self-consistent pair potential of the intermediate s-layer. While for Al-based devices an SIS-like transport regime is observed, a self-consistent calculation of the s/F/S proximity electrode, combined with perturbative tunnel coupling to the outer electrode, accounts for Nb devices with different thickness of the superconducting interlayer. The calculation places the 10-nm-interlayer sample in a proximity-supported, strongly suppressed s state, close to the SInFS limit in which the interlayer is effectively driven normal (n). A reduced nonlinear long-junction description captures the same limiting physics. The evolution of I_cR_N(T) thereby provides a direct experimental signature of the three transport regimes. Beyond the fundamental interest, the results establish practical design guidelines: Nb junctions with sufficiently thick s interlayers are well suited for high-speed cryogenic memory elements and tunable superconducting parametric amplifiers, while Al junctions are natural candidates for coherent superconducting quantum circuits
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对铌基和铝基超导体-绝缘体-薄超导体-铁磁体-超导体（SIsFS）约瑟夫森结的温度依赖性输运特性进行了系统研究。通过改变超导材料和中间超导层的厚度，我们确定了三种不同的传输机制：隧道主导的 SIS 类机制、温度驱动的交叉机制和复杂的弱连接机制。基于 Usadel 的统一描述通过中间 s 层的自洽对势将这些状态连接起来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对铌基和铝基超导体-绝缘体-薄超导体-铁磁体-超导体（SIsFS）约瑟夫森结的温度依赖性输运特性进行了系统研究。通过改变超导材料和中间超导层的厚度，我们确定了三种不同的传输机制：隧道主导的 SIS 类机制、温度驱动的交叉机制和复杂的弱连接机制。基于 Usadel 的统一描述通过中间 s 层的自洽对势将这些状态连接起来。虽然对于基于 Al 的器件，观察到类似 SIS 的传输机制，但 s/F/S 邻近电极的自洽计算，结合与外部电极的微扰隧道耦合，解释了具有不同超导夹层厚度的 Nb 器件。计算将 10 nm 夹层样品置于邻近支撑、强抑制 s 状态，接近 SInFS 极限，其中夹层被有效驱动为法向 (n)。简化的非线性长结描述捕获了相同的限制物理现象。因此，I_cR_N(T) 的演化提供了三种传输机制的直接实验特征。除了基本利益之外，结果还建立了实用的设计指南：具有足够厚夹层的铌结非常适合高速低温存储元件和可调谐超导参量放大器，而铝结是相干超导量子电路的天然候选者

articles.title: Coherent and dissipative coupling of multiple photon-magnon hybrids in a chiral microwave resonator
articles.title_zh: 手性微波谐振器中多个光子-磁振子混合体的相干和耗散耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate control between level repulsion and level attraction of photon-magnon coupling spectra in a chiral microwave-photon resonator loaded with a 2 mm YIG sphere. By systematically varying the coupling mode volume via the YIG position and the dc-field orientation, we tune the ratio between coherent and dissipative coupling strengths, J/Γ, and thereby switch between level repulsion and level attraction in the hybrid spectra. Full-wave electromagnetic and magnetization-dynamics simulations reveal multiple photon-magnon hybrid modes with distinct spatial overlap factors, which quantitatively account for gap sizes and their angular dependence. Strong nonreciprocity appears near J/Γ approx 1, yielding 28.6 dB isolation ratio in agreement with a unified single-bath input-output model and full-wave simulations. Angular dependence of spectral characterization confirms a picture of the chirality-selection rule and our method of geometric tuning might be useful for considering reconfigurable on-chip isolators.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了在装有 2 mm YIG 球体的手性微波光子谐振器中光子-磁振子耦合光谱的能级排斥和能级吸引之间的控制。通过通过 YIG 位置和直流场方向系统地改变耦合模式体积，我们调整了相干耦合强度和耗散耦合强度之间的比率 J/Γ，从而在混合光谱中的能级排斥和能级吸引之间切换。全波电磁和磁化动力学模拟揭示了具有不同空间重叠因子的多种光子-磁振子混合模式，这些模式定量地解释了间隙尺寸及其角度依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了在装有 2 mm YIG 球体的手性微波光子谐振器中光子-磁振子耦合光谱的能级排斥和能级吸引之间的控制。通过通过 YIG 位置和直流场方向系统地改变耦合模式体积，我们调整了相干耦合强度和耗散耦合强度之间的比率 J/Γ，从而在混合光谱中的能级排斥和能级吸引之间切换。全波电磁和磁化动力学模拟揭示了具有不同空间重叠因子的多种光子-磁振子混合模式，这些模式定量地解释了间隙尺寸及其角度依赖性。在 J/Γ 约 1 附近出现强非互易性，产生 28.6 dB 隔离比，与统一的单浴输入输出模型和全波模拟一致。光谱表征的角度依赖性证实了手性选择规则的图景，并且我们的几何调谐方法可能有助于考虑可重新配置的片上隔离器。

articles.title: Designing Hamiltonians with Exactly Flat Higher-Vortexable Bands
articles.title_zh: 设计具有精确平坦的高涡能带的哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20380v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The zero modes of the Aharonov-Casher Hamiltonian form an exactly flat, vortexable Chern band in any nonuniform magnetic field, analogous to the lowest Landau level. We ask which local Hamiltonians host exactly flat higher-vortexable bands. For a scalar Hamiltonian, an exactly flat first-vortexable band requires a mass proportional to the local field; the Dirac analogue has the same structure. For periodic Bernal bilayer graphene with nonzero mean flux, the exact zero-mode pair is genuinely first-vortexable if and only if the interlayer hopping has nonzero mean; zero-mean hopping instead gives a decomposable pair. Multiorbital models yield exact higher-vortexable chains to arbitrary order, while remaining first order in momentum.
articles.abstract_zh: 阿哈罗诺夫-卡舍尔哈密顿量的零模在任何非均匀磁场中形成完全平坦的可涡旋陈氏带，类似于最低的朗道能级。我们询问哪些本地哈密顿主义者拥有完全平坦的高涡旋能带。对于标量哈密顿量，精确平坦的第一可涡带需要与局部场成比例的质量；狄拉克类似物具有相同的结构。对于具有非零平均通量的周期性伯纳尔双层石墨烯，当且仅当层间跳跃具有非零均值时，精确的零模对才是真正可第一涡旋的；相反，零均值跳跃给出了可分解的对。多轨道模型产生任意阶的精确高涡链，同时保持一阶动量。

articles.title: Influence of the Néel vector on the bulk electronic structure of MnTe measured from the (1 bar1 00) surface
articles.title_zh: 从 (1 bar1 00) 表面测量的 Néel 矢量对 MnTe 体电子结构的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism gives rise to momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization. Here, we use angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) to investigate bulk α-MnTe single crystals cleaved along the (1bar100) plane - an orientation that preserves the compensated magnetic symmetry at the surface and substantially reduces surface effects and k_z broadening. We resolve the three-dimensional bulk band structure with markedly enhanced spectral clarity. The d-wave band splitting, driven by the altermagnetic order and spin-orbit coupling in the Γ-K-M nodal plane, shows a perfect match to theoretical predictions. We further establish that the valence-band maximum occurs near the A point, identifying the corresponding hole pockets as the states governing the transport properties. Spatially resolved measurements reveal systematic variations of the band dispersion along Γ-K and A-L, associated with different pinning of the Néel vector at the surface. Our results establish a surface-sensitive route to resolving the bulk altermagnetic electronic structure of MnTe and provide direct spectroscopic evidence for Néel-vector-dependent band splitting.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁性会产生动量相关的自旋分裂，而无需净磁化。在这里，我们使用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 来研究沿 (1bar100) 平面劈裂的块体 α-MnTe 单晶，该平面保留了表面补偿磁对称性，并大大减少了表面效应和 k_z 展宽。我们解析了三维体能带结构，光谱清晰度显着增强。由 Γ-K-M 节面中的交变磁序和自旋轨道耦合驱动的 d 波段分裂与理论预测完美匹配。我们进一步确定价带最大值出现在 A 点附近，将相应的空穴袋识别为控制输运特性的状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁性会产生动量相关的自旋分裂，而无需净磁化。在这里，我们使用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 来研究沿 (1bar100) 平面劈裂的块体 α-MnTe 单晶，该平面保留了表面补偿磁对称性，并大大减少了表面效应和 k_z 展宽。我们解析了三维体能带结构，光谱清晰度显着增强。由 Γ-K-M 节面中的交变磁序和自旋轨道耦合驱动的 d 波段分裂与理论预测完美匹配。我们进一步确定价带最大值出现在 A 点附近，将相应的空穴袋识别为控制输运特性的状态。空间分辨测量揭示了沿 Γ-K 和 A-L 的能带色散的系统变化，与表面 Néel 矢量的不同钉扎相关。我们的结果建立了一种表面敏感途径来解析 MnTe 的体相变磁电子结构，并为依赖于尼尔矢量的能带分裂提供了直接的光谱证据。

articles.title: Large-Tiny Spin-Stripe SDW Order in La₃Ni₂O₇ via ¹³⁹La-NQR Spectroscopy: Reconsideration Based on the Am2m Structure
articles.title_zh: 通过 13⁹La-NQR 光谱获得 La₃Ni2O₇ 中的大-微小自旋条纹 SDW 有序：基于 Am2m 结构的重新考虑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The lower-symmetry Am2m structure was recently proposed as the intrinsic ambient-pressure phase of La₃Ni₂O₇ based on synchrotron x-ray diffraction, whereas earlier studies investigated its properties assuming the commonly accepted Amam structure. Here, we reexamine the crystal structure in La₃Ni₂O₇ and the spin configuration of spin-density-wave (SDW) state via ¹³⁹La nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR). The observation of two distinct La(2) sites in the NQR spectra is naturally accounted for by the Am2m structure without any special assumptions, whereas it cannot be reconciled within the Amam framework. Within the Am2m framework, we reanalyze the spin configuration of the SDW phase and identify it as a large-tiny spin-stripe structure, arising naturally from two inequivalent Ni sites with large and tiny magnetic moments. These results establish the itinerant nature of the SDW order at ambient pressure in La₃Ni₂O₇, providing a basis for understanding its relationship to the emergence of high-T_c superconductivity under high pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，基于同步加速器 X 射线衍射，提出了较低对称性的 Am2m 结构作为 La₃Ni2O₇ 的固有环境压力相，而早期的研究则假设普遍接受的 Amam 结构来研究其性质。在这里，我们通过 139La 核四极共振（NQR）重新研究了 La₃Ni2O₇ 的晶体结构和自旋密度波（SDW）态的自旋构型。 NQR 光谱中观察到的两个不同的 La(2) 位点自然由 Am2m 结构解释，无需任何特殊假设，但在 Amam 框架内无法协调。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，基于同步加速器 X 射线衍射，提出了较低对称性的 Am2m 结构作为 La₃Ni2O₇ 的固有环境压力相，而早期的研究则假设普遍接受的 Amam 结构来研究其性质。在这里，我们通过 139La 核四极共振（NQR）重新研究了 La₃Ni2O₇ 的晶体结构和自旋密度波（SDW）态的自旋构型。 NQR 光谱中观察到的两个不同的 La(2) 位点自然由 Am2m 结构解释，无需任何特殊假设，但在 Amam 框架内无法协调。在Am2m框架内，我们重新分析了SDW相的自旋构型，并将其识别为一种大而小的自旋条纹结构，自然产生于两个具有大和小磁矩的不等价的Ni位点。这些结果确立了La₃Ni2O₇中常压下SDW序的巡回性质，为理解其与高压下高温超导性的出现的关系提供了基础。

articles.title: Orbitronics in Zero-dimensional Graphene Nanoflakes via Electrode Coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过电极耦合实现零维石墨烯纳米片中的轨道电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that graphene nanoflakes realize a previously unexplored form of orbitronics in which orbital currents emerge in the absence of intrinsic angular momentum of the constituent atoms. Starting with a hexagonal graphene nanoflake, we demonstrate the presence of energy-degenerate eigenstates with opposite non-zero expectation values of the angular momentum. Placing electrodes in an appropriate configuration on the flake couples the reservoirs more strongly to one of the two opposite-angular-momentum states, yielding a chiral current that carries a net orbital angular momentum. The resulting circulating orbital currents generate magnetic fringe fields that are experimentally accessible with spin centers or superconducting quantum interference magnetometers, providing avenues for their experimental realization. Finally, our work establishes a new platform for exploring and studying orbitronics in zero-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们表明，石墨烯纳米片实现了一种以前未探索过的轨道电子学形式，其中轨道电流在组成原子不存在固有角动量的情况下出现。从六边形石墨烯纳米片开始，我们证明了具有相反的非零角动量期望值的能量简并本征态的存在。将电极以适当的配置放置在薄片上，可以使储层与两种相反角动量状态之一更强地耦合，从而产生携带净轨道角动量的手性电流。由此产生的循环轨道电流产生磁边缘场，可以通过自旋中心或超导量子干涉磁力计进行实验访问，为其实验实现提供途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，石墨烯纳米片实现了一种以前未探索过的轨道电子学形式，其中轨道电流在组成原子不存在固有角动量的情况下出现。从六边形石墨烯纳米片开始，我们证明了具有相反的非零角动量期望值的能量简并本征态的存在。将电极以适当的配置放置在薄片上，可以使储层与两种相反角动量状态之一更强地耦合，从而产生携带净轨道角动量的手性电流。由此产生的循环轨道电流产生磁边缘场，可以通过自旋中心或超导量子干涉磁力计进行实验访问，为其实验实现提供途径。最后，我们的工作为探索和研究零维系统中的轨道电子学建立了一个新的平台。

articles.title: Magnetic Susceptibility of Superconducting Films in the Meissner-London Regime
articles.title_zh: 迈斯纳-伦敦体系中超导薄膜的磁化率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20455v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extracting the London penetration depth, λ(T), from the measured magnetic susceptibility, χ(T), of a superconducting platelet in a perpendicular magnetic field requires knowing the function χ(λ) computed for the actual sample geometry. Thin films are increasingly important in quantum computing and superconducting electronics, most of which operate at ultra-low excitation fields in the vortex-free regime. Understanding their electromagnetic response in the Meissner--London (finite-λ, no vortices) state is therefore essential for extracting intrinsic properties such as the London penetration depth and superfluid phase stiffness. While numerous prior works have addressed different aspects of this problem, here we focus on providing an analytical semi-empirical representation of χ(λ) based on the 2D sheet-current model and establishing the limits of its applicability using two independent full 3D numerical solutions: finite-element modeling and a volume-current integral equation. As a result, we provide χ(λ) for a disc of radius a and thickness d in closed form, valid for all λ and for aspect ratios δequiv d/(2a)le0.05, and accurate to 0.1%. The two-dimensional sheet description with Pearl length Λ=2λ²/d is adequate for δ lesssim10⁻⁴ and λ gtrsim 4d. Thicker films require the full closed form, which includes the three-dimensional corrections. Using the same numerical analysis, we provide an empirical formula that maps rectangular samples---the geometry most commonly used in experiments---onto a disc with an ``effective radius'' for subsequent calculation of χ(λ), and formulate a complete calibration protocol for whole-sample susceptibility measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 从垂直磁场中测量的超导片的磁化率 χ(T) 中提取伦敦穿透深度 λ(T) 需要了解针对实际样品几何形状计算的函数 χ(λ)。薄膜在量子计算和超导电子学中变得越来越重要，其中大多数在无涡流状态下的超低激发场下运行。因此，了解它们在迈斯纳-伦敦（有限 λ，无涡流）状态下的电磁响应对于提取伦敦穿透深度和超流体相刚度等固有特性至关重要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从垂直磁场中测量的超导片的磁化率 χ(T) 中提取伦敦穿透深度 λ(T) 需要了解针对实际样品几何形状计算的函数 χ(λ)。薄膜在量子计算和超导电子学中变得越来越重要，其中大多数在无涡流状态下的超低激发场下运行。因此，了解它们在迈斯纳-伦敦（有限 λ，无涡流）状态下的电磁响应对于提取伦敦穿透深度和超流体相刚度等固有特性至关重要。虽然许多先前的工作已经解决了这个问题的不同方面，但在这里我们重点关注提供基于 2D 片电流模型的 χ(λ) 的分析半经验表示，并使用两个独立的全 3D 数值解（有限元建模和体积电流积分方程）确定其适用性的限制。因此，我们以封闭形式提供半径为 a、厚度为 d 的圆盘的 χ(λ)，对于所有 λ 和长宽比 δequiv d/(2a)le0.05 均有效，并且精确到 0.1%。珍珠长度 Λ=2λ²/d 的二维片描述足以满足 δ lesssim10⁻⁴ 和 λ gtrsim 4d。较厚的薄膜需要完全封闭的形式，其中包括三维校正。使用相同的数值分析，我们提供了一个经验公式，将矩形样本（实验中最常用的几何形状）映射到具有“有效半径”的圆盘上，以便随后计算 χ(λ)，并为全样本磁敏度测量制定完整的校准协议。

articles.title: Testing Replica Symmetry Breaking in the three-dimensional Edwards-Anderson model by using vanishing fields
articles.title_zh: 使用消失场测试三维 Edwards-Anderson 模型中的副本对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Replica Symmetry Breaking (RSB) theory for spin glasses, which is exact in infinite dimensions, provides detailed predictions for the behavior of these systems. One of these predictions is that vanishing magnetic fields induce chaotic behavior. Here, vanishing has a precise meaning: we refer to an externally applied magnetic field with intensity scaling as 1/sqrtN, where N is the number of spins in the system. RSB predicts that this chaotic behavior depends only on the probability density function of the overlap, P(q), as computed at zero field. We proceed to test the RSB prediction in the 3D Edwards-Anderson model, by first computing the P(q) numerically in the absence of a magnetic field. We then use this function as input to analytically compute the statistics of the states in the regime of a vanishing magnetic field, using a representation based on the Bolthausen-Sznitman coalescent process (which is exact for the mean-field Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model). This mixed numerical-analytical approach allows us to determine the prediction of RSB for the overlap distribution function measured in the presence of a small vanishing field, as well as the increase in chaoticity as the field strength grows. The above RSB predictions are quantitatively compared with the outcome of numerical simulations of the three-dimensional Edwards-Anderson in the presence of a small vanishing field, finding very good agreement. This agreement provides strong support for the idea that three-dimensional spin glass at zero magnetic field and low temperature is well described by RSB theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋玻璃的复制对称破缺（RSB）理论在无限维度上是精确的，为这些系统的行为提供了详细的预测。这些预测之一是消失的磁场会引发混沌行为。在这里，消失有一个精确的含义：我们指的是强度缩放为 1/sqrtN 的外部施加磁场，其中 N 是系统中的自旋数。 RSB 预测这种混沌行为仅取决于在零场计算的重叠概率密度函数 P(q)。我们首先在没有磁场的情况下数值计算 P(q)，从而继续测试 3D Edwards-Anderson 模型中的 RSB 预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋玻璃的复制对称破缺（RSB）理论在无限维度上是精确的，为这些系统的行为提供了详细的预测。这些预测之一是消失的磁场会引发混沌行为。在这里，消失有一个精确的含义：我们指的是强度缩放为 1/sqrtN 的外部施加磁场，其中 N 是系统中的自旋数。 RSB 预测这种混沌行为仅取决于在零场计算的重叠概率密度函数 P(q)。我们首先在没有磁场的情况下数值计算 P(q)，从而继续测试 3D Edwards-Anderson 模型中的 RSB 预测。然后，我们使用这个函数作为输入，使用基于 Bolthausen-Sznitman 聚结过程的表示（这对于平均场 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型来说是精确的）来分析计算消失磁场范围内状态的统计数据。这种混合数值分析方法使我们能够确定在存在小消失场的情况下测量的重叠分布函数的 RSB 预测，以及随着场强的增加而增加的混沌度。上述 RSB 预测与存在小消失场的三维 Edwards-Anderson 数值模拟的结果进行了定量比较，发现非常一致。该协议为RSB理论很好地描述了零磁场和低温下三维自旋玻璃的观点提供了有力的支持。

articles.title: Structural identification in general crystalline systems via Voronoi cell topology
articles.title_zh: 通过 Voronoi 单元拓扑结构识别一般晶体系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Widely used methods for identifying crystal structure in atomistic simulations are limited in practice to a handful of simple structures, leaving many important crystalline systems without automated classification techniques. Voronoi topology analysis offers a route to classifying arbitrary crystalline and defect environments, but realizing this potential first requires enumerating the Voronoi cell topologies that can arise under thermal perturbation of a structure of interest. We present an algorithm that deterministically enumerates all Voronoi cell topologies arising from generic infinitesimal perturbations of an arbitrary crystal structure, producing structural classifiers that extend automated identification to general crystalline systems. We demonstrate the approach on several structures of general interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 在原子模拟中广泛使用的晶体结构识别方法在实践中仅限于少数简单的结构，使得许多重要的晶体系统没有自动分类技术。 Voronoi 拓扑分析提供了一种对任意晶体和缺陷环境进行分类的途径，但要实现这一潜力，首先需要枚举在感兴趣结构的热扰动下可能出现的 Voronoi 单元拓扑。我们提出了一种算法，可以确定性地枚举由任意晶体结构的一般无穷小扰动产生的所有 Voronoi 单元拓扑，生成结构分类器，将自动识别扩展到一般晶体系统。我们在几种普遍感兴趣的结构上演示了该方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在原子模拟中广泛使用的晶体结构识别方法在实践中仅限于少数简单的结构，使得许多重要的晶体系统没有自动分类技术。 Voronoi 拓扑分析提供了一种对任意晶体和缺陷环境进行分类的途径，但要实现这一潜力，首先需要枚举在感兴趣结构的热扰动下可能出现的 Voronoi 单元拓扑。我们提出了一种算法，可以确定性地枚举由任意晶体结构的一般无穷小扰动产生的所有 Voronoi 单元拓扑，生成结构分类器，将自动识别扩展到一般晶体系统。我们在几种普遍感兴趣的结构上演示了该方法。

articles.title: Anyons at impurities: Fractional charge measurement and "wrong sign" binding
articles.title_zh: 杂质处的任意子：分数电荷测量和“错误符号”结合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20522v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent photoluminescence experiments in twisted MoTe₂ have reported signatures of anyons binding to trapped trions. The measured binding energies near the fractional Chern insulators at fillings of ν=-2/3 and -3/5 have a ratio close to the fractional-charge ratio 5/3, even though such scaling is not generally guaranteed for the expected short-range trion-anyon interaction. We model the trapped trion as a fixed impurity, and investigate anyon-impurity binding using a lowest-Landau-level model with exact diagonalization and Jain wavefunctions. Surprisingly, we find that the anyon-impurity binding energy ratio between ν=-2/3 and -3/5 is close to 5/3 for either short- or long-ranged impurity-electron interactions. However, the ratio departs strongly from the charge ratio at intermediate ranges or different Jain states. Remarkably, we also uncover "wrong-sign" binding, whereby both quasiholes and quasiparticles can bind to either sign of a short-range impurity potential by selecting orbital channels with favorable local density oscillations. Our findings show that localized excitons or trions can be used to probe the internal density profile of anyons.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近在扭曲 MoTe2 中进行的光致发光实验报告了任意子与捕获的三重子结合的特征。在 ν=-2/3 和 -3/5 填充时，在分数陈绝缘体附近测得的结合能具有接近分数电荷比 5/3 的比率，尽管对于预期的短程三重子-任意子相互作用通常不能保证这种缩放。我们将捕获的 Trion 建模为固定杂质，并使用具有精确对角化和 Jain 波函数的最低朗道能级模型研究任意子杂质结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近在扭曲 MoTe2 中进行的光致发光实验报告了任意子与捕获的三重子结合的特征。在 ν=-2/3 和 -3/5 填充时，在分数陈绝缘体附近测得的结合能具有接近分数电荷比 5/3 的比率，尽管对于预期的短程三重子-任意子相互作用通常不能保证这种缩放。我们将捕获的 Trion 建模为固定杂质，并使用具有精确对角化和 Jain 波函数的最低朗道能级模型研究任意子杂质结合。令人惊讶的是，我们发现对于短程或长程杂质-电子相互作用，ν=-2/3 和-3/5 之间的任意子-杂质结合能比接近 5/3。然而，该比率与中间范围或不同耆那教状态下的电荷比率有很大差异。值得注意的是，我们还发现了“错误符号”结合，即准空穴和准粒子都可以通过选择具有有利局部密度振荡的轨道通道来与短程杂质势的任一符号结合。我们的研究结果表明，局域激子或三重子可用于探测任意子的内部密度分布。

articles.title: Exchange Interactions and Magnon Spectra in bcc Fe(001) Thin Films: A Computational Study
articles.title_zh: bcc Fe(001) 薄膜中的交换相互作用和磁振子谱：计算研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20564v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We combined density functional theory with atomistic spin dynamics to understand how surfaces influence magnon dispersion. For this purpose, we investigate thin layers of body-centered cubic iron and compare them with the bulk material. We present how the broken symmetry affects exchange interactions and magnon behavior. Our results reveal enhanced magnetic moments and exchange interactions for surface atoms compared to bulk Fe. The increase in exchange interaction integrals is mostly visible for first- and second-nearest neighbors. We also find a significant spread in exchange values within each coordination shell. Magnon dispersion analysis shows, for the layered system, pronounced band blurring, a significant reduction of maximum frequencies relative to the previously reported bulk values, and the emergence of a low-frequency band outside the g{}-point. Our study shows that relying on bulk exchange parameters introduces errors in the magnon spectra of ultrathin systems, underscoring the need for a detailed, system-specific approach.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将密度泛函理论与原子自旋动力学相结合，以了解表面如何影响磁振子色散。为此，我们研究了体心立方铁的薄层并将其与块状材料进行比较。我们展示了对称性破缺如何影响交换相互作用和磁振子行为。我们的结果表明，与块状铁相比，表面原子的磁矩和交换相互作用增强。交换相互作用积分的增加对于第一和第二最近邻居来说最为明显。我们还发现每个协调壳内的交换价值存在显着差异。磁振子色散分析表明，对于分层系统，明显的频带模糊，相对于先前报告的体积值，最大频率显着降低，并且在 g{} 点之外出现了低频带。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将密度泛函理论与原子自旋动力学相结合，以了解表面如何影响磁振子色散。为此，我们研究了体心立方铁的薄层并将其与块状材料进行比较。我们展示了对称性破缺如何影响交换相互作用和磁振子行为。我们的结果表明，与块状铁相比，表面原子的磁矩和交换相互作用增强。交换相互作用积分的增加对于第一和第二最近邻居来说最为明显。我们还发现每个协调壳内的交换价值存在显着差异。磁振子色散分析表明，对于分层系统，明显的频带模糊，相对于先前报告的体积值，最大频率显着降低，并且在 g{} 点之外出现了低频带。我们的研究表明，依赖批量交换参数会在超薄系统的磁振子谱中引入误差，这强调了对详细的、针对系统的方法的需要。

articles.title: Droplets obstruct Onsager-type solutions of the Ising model in a magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中液滴阻碍伊辛模型的 Onsager 型解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20569v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Onsager solved the two-dimensional Ising model in zero field, but no solution is known in a magnetic field. We prove that in any dimension dge2, at every fixed dimensionless field outside a countable set, the free energy obeys no algebraic differential equation in the coupling, even locally. The obstruction arises from droplet geometry: the maximal droplet volume grows as the d/(d-1) power of its boundary size, while an integer band in the pressure coefficients protects the extremal contributions against cancellation. Our result excludes Onsager-type solutions and closed forms in elliptic, hypergeometric, or Painlevé functions of the coupling at these fields.
articles.abstract_zh: Onsager 在零场中求解了二维伊辛模型，但在磁场中尚无解。我们证明，在任何维度 dge2 中，在可数集之外的每个固定无量纲场，自由能在耦合中不服从代数微分方程，即使是局部的。障碍源于液滴几何形状：最大液滴体积随着其边界尺寸的 d/(d-1) 次方而增长，而压力系数中的整数带可保护极值贡献不被抵消。我们的结果排除了 Onsager 型解以及这些场耦合的椭圆、超几何或 Painlevé 函数的封闭形式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Onsager 在零场中求解了二维伊辛模型，但在磁场中尚无解。我们证明，在任何维度 dge2 中，在可数集之外的每个固定无量纲场，自由能在耦合中不服从代数微分方程，即使是局部的。障碍源于液滴几何形状：最大液滴体积随着其边界尺寸的 d/(d-1) 次方而增长，而压力系数中的整数带可保护极值贡献不被抵消。我们的结果排除了 Onsager 型解以及这些场耦合的椭圆、超几何或 Painlevé 函数的封闭形式。

articles.title: Nodal nematic superconductivity in moiré graphene
articles.title_zh: 莫尔石墨烯中的节点向列超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity can emerge in various forms in strongly correlated systems. Historically, the most extensively studied examples include nodal and triplet pairing, which were experimentally detected in cuprates and superfluid helium-3, respectively. Beyond these canonical cases, there are also nematic superconductors, in which the rotational symmetry of the lattice is broken in the superconducting state. While there are several examples of nematic superconductors whose pairing emerges inside a preexisting nematic normal state, experimental evidence for superconducting states that intrinsically break rotational symmetry on their own has been exceedingly scarce. Here, we report the experimental realization and identification of an intrinsic multi-component nodal nematic superconducting state in magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene (MATTG). By integrating tunneling spectroscopy with quantum transport measurements, we directly probe the symmetry of low-energy superconducting quasiparticles. Deep inside the superconducting state, we observe a pronounced two-fold anisotropy in the zero-bias tunneling conductance under an in-plane magnetic field, which is strongly suppressed together with superconductivity as the temperature or perpendicular magnetic field is increased. Remarkably, the major axis of anisotropy rotates by up to 90cⁱrc across the superconducting dome, indicating an intrinsic, field- and density-tunable symmetry of the low-energy excitations. These behaviors imply a nodal superconducting state in MATTG that spontaneously breaks the six-fold rotational symmetry of the moiré superlattice. Our results establish moiré graphene as a versatile platform for realizing and interrogating nodal nematic superconductivity, opening a new avenue for exploring unconventional symmetry-breaking superconducting states in two-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 在强相关系统中，非常规超导性可以以各种形式出现。历史上，最广泛研究的例子包括节点配对和三重态配对，它们分别在铜酸盐和超流氦 3 中通过实验检测到。除了这些典型情况之外，还存在向列超导体，其中晶格的旋转对称性在超导状态下被破坏。虽然有几个向列超导体的配对出现在预先存在的向列正常状态内的例子，但本质上打破旋转对称性的超导状态的实验证据却极其稀少。在这里，我们报告了魔角扭曲三层石墨烯（MATTG）中本征多组分节点向列超导态的实验实现和识别。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在强相关系统中，非常规超导性可以以各种形式出现。历史上，最广泛研究的例子包括节点配对和三重态配对，它们分别在铜酸盐和超流氦 3 中通过实验检测到。除了这些典型情况之外，还存在向列超导体，其中晶格的旋转对称性在超导状态下被破坏。虽然有几个向列超导体的配对出现在预先存在的向列正常状态内的例子，但本质上打破旋转对称性的超导状态的实验证据却极其稀少。在这里，我们报告了魔角扭曲三层石墨烯（MATTG）中本征多组分节点向列超导态的实验实现和识别。通过将隧道光谱与量子输运测量相结合，我们直接探测低能超导准粒子的对称性。在超导态深处，我们观察到面内磁场下零偏置隧道电导具有明显的两倍各向异性，随着温度或垂直磁场的增加，这种各向异性与超导性一起受到强烈抑制。值得注意的是，各向异性的主轴在超导穹顶上旋转了高达 90cⁱrc，这表明低能激发具有固有的、场和密度可调的对称性。这些行为意味着 MATTG 中的节点超导状态会自发打破莫尔超晶格的六重旋转对称性。我们的研究结果将莫尔石墨烯确立为实现和探究节点向列超导性的多功能平台，为探索二维材料中非常规对称破缺的超导态开辟了新途径。

articles.title: A Boson-informed neural network for Ground States of Many-Body Schrödinger equations
articles.title_zh: 用于多体薛定谔方程基态的玻色子神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18875v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a symmetry-preserving Boson-informed neural network (BINN) for the variational Monte Carlo computation of interacting-boson ground states in continuous space. The framework explicitly separates the two dominant physical scales of the system. At the microscopic interaction scale, a cell Jastrow factor absorbs the leading near-contact stiffness, while at the macroscopic scale, a potential-aware envelope encodes the external confinement, leaving the neural network to capture a smoother many-body residual. Across both two- and three-dimensional tests, the BINN approaches the Hartree and Gross-Pitaevskii limits with an empirical O(N⁻¹) finite-size trend in both energy and density. The energies agree with diffusion Monte Carlo to within 0.06% for the particle number tested up to 350 in the three-dimensional shrinking-range case. Applications are made under various trapping scenarios, justifying robust performance of BINN.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种保对称玻色子神经网络（BINN），用于连续空间中相互作用玻色子基态的变分蒙特卡罗计算。该框架明确区分了系统的两个主要物理尺度。在微观相互作用尺度上，细胞贾斯特罗因子吸收了主要的近接触刚度，而在宏观尺度上，电位感知包络对外部限制进行编码，使神经网络能够捕获更平滑的多体残差。在二维和三维测试中，BINN 在能量和密度方面均以经验 O(N⁻1) 有限尺寸趋势接近 Hartree 和 Gross-Pitaevskii 极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种保对称玻色子神经网络（BINN），用于连续空间中相互作用玻色子基态的变分蒙特卡罗计算。该框架明确区分了系统的两个主要物理尺度。在微观相互作用尺度上，细胞贾斯特罗因子吸收了主要的近接触刚度，而在宏观尺度上，电位感知包络对外部限制进行编码，使神经网络能够捕获更平滑的多体残差。在二维和三维测试中，BINN 在能量和密度方面均以经验 O(N⁻1) 有限尺寸趋势接近 Hartree 和 Gross-Pitaevskii 极限。在三维收缩范围情况下，对于测试的粒子数高达 350，能量与扩散蒙特卡罗一致，误差在 0.06% 以内。在各种捕获场景下进行的应用证明了 BINN 的稳健性能。

articles.title: Supercell-enabled inverse design of boundary-state dispersion for group-velocity control in pseudomagnetic phononic crystals
articles.title_zh: 用于赝磁声子晶体群速度控制的超晶胞边界态色散逆设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18908v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Topological boundary states offer a platform for guided-wave propagation within bulk bandgaps. Their propagation characteristics depend not only on the spectral extent of the states but also on their dispersion within the operating bandwidth. A nearly linear dispersion provides more uniform group velocity across frequency, whereas a reduced slope enables slow-wave propagation. Despite advances in inverse design of prescribed dispersion relations and topological dispersion tuning, application-oriented characteristics of boundary-state dispersion have rarely been direct inverse-design objectives. Here, we develop a supercell-enabled, surrogate-assisted framework for the inverse design of boundary-state dispersion in a phononic crystal with pseudomagnetic fields. Area-preserving anisotropic deformation shifts the local Dirac points, and independent variation of 21 rows within the supercell provides distributed control over the boundary-state branch. A constraint-preserving surrogate reconstructs the dispersion from an initial frequency and positive frequency increments, with first- and second-difference losses introduced to capture local slope and curvature. Coupled with a genetic algorithm, the framework targets two prescribed-bandwidth design tasks: highly linear dispersion and slow-wave dispersion. For the former, finite-element verification yields relative group-velocity variations of 0.142% to 1.183% over prescribed bandwidths of 4% to 6%. For slow-wave designs, mean group velocities of 190 to 385 m/s are obtained over bandwidths of 0.2% to 0.8% while satisfying a 5% group-velocity variation limit. These results establish boundary-state dispersion as a direct inverse-design target beyond conventional bandwidth optimization, opening a flexible route to group-velocity control through application-oriented dispersion engineering over prescribed relative bandwidths.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑边界态为体带隙内的导波传播提供了平台。它们的传播特性不仅取决于状态的光谱范围，还取决于它们在工作带宽内的色散。近乎线性的色散可在整个频率范围内提供更均匀的群速度，而减小的斜率可实现慢波传播。尽管规定色散关系和拓扑色散调整的逆向设计取得了进展，但边界态色散的面向应用的特性很少成为直接逆向设计的目标。在这里，我们开发了一种支持超级单元的、替代辅助的框架，用于具有赝磁场的声子晶体中边界态色散的逆设计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑边界态为体带隙内的导波传播提供了平台。它们的传播特性不仅取决于状态的光谱范围，还取决于它们在工作带宽内的色散。近乎线性的色散可在整个频率范围内提供更均匀的群速度，而减小的斜率可实现慢波传播。尽管规定色散关系和拓扑色散调整的逆向设计取得了进展，但边界态色散的面向应用的特性很少成为直接逆向设计的目标。在这里，我们开发了一种支持超级单元的、替代辅助的框架，用于具有赝磁场的声子晶体中边界态色散的逆设计。保持面积的各向异性变形会移动局部狄拉克点，并且超级单元内 21 行的独立变化提供了对边界状态分支的分布式控制。保留约束的代理从初始频率和正频率增量重建色散，并引入一阶和二阶差分损失来捕获局部斜率和曲率。与遗传算法相结合，该框架针对两个规定带宽设计任务：高度线性色散和慢波色散。对于前者，有限元验证在 4% 至 6% 的规定带宽上产生 0.142% 至 1.183% 的相对群速度变化。对于慢波设计，在 0.2% 至 0.8% 的带宽上获得 190 至 385 m/s 的平均群速度，同时满足 5% 的群速度变化限制。这些结果将边界态色散确立为超越传统带宽优化的直接逆向设计目标，通过在规定的相对带宽上面向应用的色散工程，为群速度控制开辟了一条灵活的途径。

articles.title: Invertible subalgebras for chiral semion topological order
articles.title_zh: 手征半子拓扑序的可逆子代数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18953v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chiral topological order is incompatible with strictly two-dimensional local commuting-projector Hamiltonians on finite-dimensional tensor-product Hilbert spaces. Invertible subalgebras (ISAs) provide an alternative framework. We construct an ISA supporting chiral semions, together with its anti-semion commutant, on a square lattice with one qubit per edge. We give explicit non-Pauli generators for both algebras and prove that together they generate all local operators on the Hilbert space. Starting from the Z₄ toric code, we condense the boson e²m² and identify the semion and anti-semion algebras. We then decompose each Z₄ qudit into two qubits and use a finite-depth circuit to disentangle one qubit per edge fixed by the condensation constraints. Pumping the semion ISA along the z direction defines an explicit three-dimensional non-Clifford quantum cellular automaton (QCA). We show that pumping eight times is equivalent to a translation followed by a finite-depth quantum circuit with ancillary qubits. We also give an explicit finite-depth circuit relating this construction to the semion QCA previously obtained from topological quantum field theory. A similar condensation construction yields a U(1)₄ ISA on a square lattice. Together with the semion and earlier odd-prime ISAs, finite stacking realizes every pointed Witt class of bosonic Abelian anyon theories. Finally, we extend both constructions to all spatial dimensions d=4k-2, with one qubit or Z₄ qudit on each (2k-1)-cell for the semion or U(1)₄ ISA, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性拓扑序与有限维张量积希尔伯特空间上的严格二维局部交换投影哈密顿量不兼容。可逆子代数 (ISA) 提供了另一种框架。我们在每边一个量子位的方格上构建了一个支持手性半子及其反半子交换子的 ISA。我们为这两个代数给出了显式的非保利生成器，并证明它们一起生成希尔伯特空间上的所有局部算子。从 Z₄ 环面码开始，我们压缩玻色子 e²m² 并识别半子代数和反半子代数。然后，我们将每个 Z₄ 量子位分解为两个量子位，并使用有限深度电路来解开由凝聚约束固定的每个边缘的一个量子位。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性拓扑序与有限维张量积希尔伯特空间上的严格二维局部交换投影哈密顿量不兼容。可逆子代数 (ISA) 提供了另一种框架。我们在每边一个量子位的方格上构建了一个支持手性半子及其反半子交换子的 ISA。我们为这两个代数给出了显式的非保利生成器，并证明它们一起生成希尔伯特空间上的所有局部算子。从 Z₄ 环面码开始，我们压缩玻色子 e²m² 并识别半子代数和反半子代数。然后，我们将每个 Z₄ 量子位分解为两个量子位，并使用有限深度电路来解开由凝聚约束固定的每个边缘的一个量子位。沿 z 方向泵浦半子 ISA 定义了显式三维非 Clifford 量子细胞自动机 (QCA)。我们证明，泵浦八次相当于平移，然后是带有辅助量子位的有限深度量子电路。我们还给出了一个明确的有限深度电路，将这种结构与先前从拓扑量子场论获得的半子 QCA 联系起来。类似的缩合结构在方形晶格上产生 U(1)₄ ISA。与半子和早期的奇素数 ISA 一起，有限堆叠实现了玻色阿贝尔任意子理论的每个尖维特类。最后，我们将这两种结构扩展到所有空间维度 d=4k-2，每个 (2k-1) 单元上分别有一个量子位或 Z₄ qudit 用于半子或 U(1)₄ ISA。

articles.title: Optimal Disorder Strength for Approximate Unitary k-Designs in Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: 自旋链中近似酉 k 设计的最佳无序强度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18954v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum simulators with disordered spin Hamiltonians offer a natural route to Haar-like unitary ensembles, but face a competition. Disorder enhances randomness, yet strong disorder suppresses dynamics and localizes the system in the computational basis. This suggests an optimal intermediate disorder strength for approximating a unitary k-design, which has so far been identified mainly empirically. Here, we develop a perturbative theory for the moment gap Δ⁽k⁾, the deviation of the k-th moment operator from its Haar value, for the full spectrum of the interacting XXZ chain in a fixed-magnetization sector. We find the non-monotonic asymptotic scalings ln Δ⁽k⁾sim -σ² at weak disorder and ln Δ⁽k⁾sim -1/σ at strong disorder, whose crossover sets an optimal disorder strength σ_csim Jₓy, where Jₓy is the energy scale of the non-random interaction. We further show that a multi-quench protocol further suppresses the gap exponentially in the number of quenches. Numerical simulations confirm both scalings and this exponential suppression, and we demonstrate the usefulness of the protocol for classical shadow tomography. This work suggests that strong disorder may block both thermalization and the formation of unitary designs through a common localization mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有无序自旋哈密顿量的量子模拟器提供了一条通往哈尔式酉系综的自然途径，但面临着竞争。无序性增强了随机性，但强烈的无序性会抑制动力学并使系统在计算基础上局域化。这表明近似单一 k 设计的最佳中间无序强度，迄今为止主要是凭经验确定的。在这里，我们针对固定磁化扇区中相互作用的 XXZ 链的全谱，开发了矩间隙 Δ⁽k⁾（第 k 矩算子与其 Haar 值的偏差）的微扰理论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有无序自旋哈密顿量的量子模拟器提供了一条通往哈尔式酉系综的自然途径，但面临着竞争。无序性增强了随机性，但强烈的无序性会抑制动力学并使系统在计算基础上局域化。这表明近似单一 k 设计的最佳中间无序强度，迄今为止主要是凭经验确定的。在这里，我们针对固定磁化扇区中相互作用的 XXZ 链的全谱，开发了矩间隙 Δ⁽k⁾（第 k 矩算子与其 Haar 值的偏差）的微扰理论。我们发现弱无序下的非单调渐近标度 ln Δ⁽k⁾sim -σ2 和强无序下的 ln Δ⁽k⁾sim -1/σ ，其交叉设置了最佳无序强度 σ_csim Jₓy，其中 Jₓy 是非随机相互作用的能量尺度。我们进一步表明，多重猝灭协议进一步以指数方式抑制猝灭次数的差距。数值模拟证实了缩放和这种指数抑制，并且我们证明了该协议对于经典阴影断层扫描的有用性。这项工作表明，强烈的无序性可能会通过共同的定位机制阻止热化和单一设计的形成。

articles.title: Programmable Polaron Models and Tomography in Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulators
articles.title_zh: 俘获离子量子模拟器中的可编程极化子模型和断层扫描
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18970v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Strong coupling between mobile charge carriers or excitons and lattice vibrations gives rise to polarons: quasiparticles formed by charge carriers dressed by a cloud of phonon excitations. Polaron formation determines transport properties of systems ranging from transition-metal oxides and organic semiconductors to light-harvesting complexes. In excitonic systems that admit a hard-core boson description, mapping the excitations to pseudospins provides a natural framework for studying polaron physics, including the nonperturbative regime in which hopping amplitudes, phonon energies, and coupling strengths are comparable. Here, we propose a trapped-ion blueprint for realizing spin-phonon Hamiltonians with programmable spatial coupling between excitation density and phonon displacements, encompassing local Holstein and long-range Fröhlich-type interactions. To access strongly dressed quasiparticles whose bare spectral weight is suppressed, we introduce displaced Green's functions implemented through spin-dependent phonon displacements. Their spectral response reveals the polaron band spectrum, including binding energies and phonon-excitation sidebands, while spatially resolved measurements probe the structure of the phonon dressing cloud, providing a route to polaron tomography. We further complement this spectroscopy with direct and ancilla-assisted measurements of spin-phonon correlations that track the coupled dynamics of the excitation and its environment. These approaches connect the emergent quasiparticle spectrum to the microscopic buildup of its dressing cloud, enabling controlled studies of how the spatial range of coupling shapes polaron formation and mobility.
articles.abstract_zh: 移动电荷载流子或激子与晶格振动之间的强耦合产生了极化子：由声子激发云装饰的电荷载流子形成的准粒子。极化子的形成决定了从过渡金属氧化物和有机半导体到光捕获复合物等系统的传输特性。在允许硬核玻色子描述的激子系统中，将激发映射到赝自旋为研究极化子物理提供了一个自然的框架，包括跳跃幅度、声子能量和耦合强度具有可比性的非微扰状态。在这里，我们提出了一个捕获离子蓝图，用于实现自旋声子哈密顿量，具有激发密度和声子位移之间的可编程空间耦合，包括局部荷斯坦和远程弗罗利希型相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 移动电荷载流子或激子与晶格振动之间的强耦合产生了极化子：由声子激发云装饰的电荷载流子形成的准粒子。极化子的形成决定了从过渡金属氧化物和有机半导体到光捕获复合物等系统的传输特性。在允许硬核玻色子描述的激子系统中，将激发映射到赝自旋为研究极化子物理提供了一个自然的框架，包括跳跃幅度、声子能量和耦合强度具有可比性的非微扰状态。在这里，我们提出了一个捕获离子蓝图，用于实现自旋声子哈密顿量，具有激发密度和声子位移之间的可编程空间耦合，包括局部荷斯坦和远程弗罗利希型相互作用。为了获得裸光谱权重被抑制的强装饰准粒子，我们引入了通过自旋相关声子位移实现的位移格林函数。它们的光谱响应揭示了极化子带谱，包括结合能和声子激发边带，而空间分辨测量则探测声子敷料云的结构，为极化子断层扫描提供了一条途径。我们通过自旋声子相关性的直接和辅助辅助测量进一步补充了这种光谱学，这些测量跟踪激发及其环境的耦合动力学。这些方法将出现的准粒子光谱与其梳妆云的微观积累联系起来，从而能够对耦合的空间范围如何影响极化子的形成和迁移率进行受控研究。

articles.title: Kinetic Equations and Turbulence in Large N Vector and SYK-like Models
articles.title_zh: 大 N 矢量和 SYK 类模型中的动力学方程和湍流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19130v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We apply large N expansion techniques to derive kinetic equations for strongly coupled, far-from-equilibrium field theories with O(N) symmetry. For large N vector models, the quasi-classical approximation holds. Incorporating arbitrary momentum-dependent interactions, we show the dynamics obey the standard kinetic equation, with the scattering amplitude given by the retarded propagator of the auxiliary Hubbard-Stratonovich field. This has broad applications to systems like spin wave and Langmuir ion-acoustic turbulence. For large N random coupling (SYK-like) models in d dimensions, leading-order melon diagrams induce order-one propagator renormalization and finite spectral width. The corresponding kinetic equation, unlike those for standard weakly interacting systems, does not have a local-in-time collision integral. We find evidence for a stationary, scale-invariant infrared solution, revealing a potentially novel strong turbulence scaling exponent.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们应用大 N 展开技术来导出具有 O(N) 对称性的强耦合、远离平衡场论的动力学方程。对于大 N 向量模型，准经典近似成立。结合任意动量相关的相互作用，我们表明动力学遵循标准动力学方程，散射幅度由辅助哈伯德-斯特拉托诺维奇场的延迟传播器给出。这对于自旋波和朗缪尔离子声湍流等系统有着广泛的应用。对于 d 维中的大 N 随机耦合（类 SYK）模型，前导瓜图会引发一阶传播器重整化和有限谱宽。与标准弱相互作用系统的动力学方程不同，相应的动力学方程没有局部时间碰撞积分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们应用大 N 展开技术来导出具有 O(N) 对称性的强耦合、远离平衡场论的动力学方程。对于大 N 向量模型，准经典近似成立。结合任意动量相关的相互作用，我们表明动力学遵循标准动力学方程，散射幅度由辅助哈伯德-斯特拉托诺维奇场的延迟传播器给出。这对于自旋波和朗缪尔离子声湍流等系统有着广泛的应用。对于 d 维中的大 N 随机耦合（类 SYK）模型，前导瓜图会引发一阶传播器重整化和有限谱宽。与标准弱相互作用系统的动力学方程不同，相应的动力学方程没有局部时间碰撞积分。我们找到了稳定的、尺度不变的红外解的证据，揭示了一种潜在的新颖的强湍流标度指数。

articles.title: Selective Control and Imaging of Higgs and Goldstone Modes with a Quantum Simulator
articles.title_zh: 使用量子模拟器对希格斯和戈德斯通模式进行选择性控制和成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19219v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We realize the mesoscopic Bose-Hubbard model at unit-filling on a two-dimensional array of transmon qubits and selectively excite collective modes associated with amplitude or phase fluctuations of the superfluid order parameter. We identify these modes respectively as the Higgs and Goldstone modes using complementary local observables, extracted from measuring the number of particles on each site. Modulation of the coupling between sites excites the Higgs mode, which we detect via the density of doubly occupied sites. In contrast, modulation of the local chemical potential with an appropriately chosen spatial profile excites the lowest-frequency Goldstone mode, which we detect via changes in the local density. The two modes have different symmetries and do not couple to one another. By varying the system geometry, we characterize the impact of finite system size on the evolution of both modes. In the thermodynamic limit, decay into a continuum of lower-energy excitations can obscure the Higgs response. In our mesoscopic system, however, the finite system size leads to spectral gaps and allows us to detect the Higgs mode as a coherent, long-lived excitation. Our work demonstrates how finite quantum simulators can isolate and probe physical phenomena that become difficult to resolve in the thermodynamic, large-scale limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在二维传输量子比特阵列上实现了单位填充的介观 Bose-Hubbard 模型，并选择性地激发与超流序参数的振幅或相位波动相关的集体模式。我们使用互补的局部可观测量分别将这些模式识别为希格斯模式和戈德斯通模式，这些可观测量是从测量每个站点上的粒子数量中提取的。位点之间耦合的调制会激发希格斯模式，我们通过双占据位点的密度来检测希格斯模式。相反，通过适当选择的空间分布来调制局部化学势会激发最低频率的戈德斯通模式，我们通过局部密度的变化来检测该模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在二维传输量子比特阵列上实现了单位填充的介观 Bose-Hubbard 模型，并选择性地激发与超流序参数的振幅或相位波动相关的集体模式。我们使用互补的局部可观测量分别将这些模式识别为希格斯模式和戈德斯通模式，这些可观测量是从测量每个站点上的粒子数量中提取的。位点之间耦合的调制会激发希格斯模式，我们通过双占据位点的密度来检测希格斯模式。相反，通过适当选择的空间分布来调制局部化学势会激发最低频率的戈德斯通模式，我们通过局部密度的变化来检测该模式。这两种模式具有不同的对称性并且不会相互耦合。通过改变系统几何形状，我们描述了有限系统尺寸对两种模式演化的影响。在热力学极限下，衰变成连续的低能激发可能会掩盖希格斯响应。然而，在我们的介观系统中，有限的系统尺寸会导致光谱间隙，并使我们能够将希格斯模式检测为相干、长寿命的激发。我们的工作展示了有限量子模拟器如何隔离和探测在热力学大规模极限下难以解决的物理现象。

articles.title: Beyond DFT electronic band structures via dual-space orbital learning
articles.title_zh: 通过双空间轨道学习超越 DFT 电子能带结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19919v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate electronic band structures are essential for predicting material properties, but high-fidelity calculations are computationally demanding. We introduce O-kRystal, a dual-space orbital-learning framework that uses a lower-cost Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) calculation as both an energy baseline and a source of structured orbital information. Combining PBE band energies with real- and reciprocal-space orbital matrices, O-kRystal predicts higher-level corrections for individual electronic states as a function of crystal momentum and spin. For states within 5 eV of the band-edge midpoint, it predicts Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof (HSE06) band energies with a mean absolute error of 0.171 ± 0.009 eV across nearly 6,000 three-dimensional materials spanning insulating, metallic, magnetic, and nonmagnetic systems. On a separate benchmark of six strongly correlated materials, it reduces the corresponding PBE band-energy MAE by 68.7% and resolves orbital-dependent changes in the relative placement of transition-metal d and ligand p states. Despite training only at high-symmetry points, it maintains comparable accuracy at unseen points along band paths and reconstructs HSE06 densities of states from dense Brillouin-zone predictions. Finally, training O-kRystal on G₀W₀ quasiparticle energies for two-dimensional materials demonstrates its applicability across levels of theory and the potential of orbital learning for higher-fidelity, momentum-resolved electronic-structure prediction beyond density functional theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确的电子能带结构对于预测材料特性至关重要，但高保真度计算的计算要求很高。我们引入了 O-kRystal，这是一种双空间轨道学习框架，它使用成本较低的 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) 计算作为能量基线和结构化轨道信息源。 O-kRystal 将 PBE 能带能量与实空间和倒易空间轨道矩阵相结合，预测单个电子态作为晶体动量和自旋函数的更高级别修正。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确的电子能带结构对于预测材料特性至关重要，但高保真度计算的计算要求很高。我们引入了 O-kRystal，这是一种双空间轨道学习框架，它使用成本较低的 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) 计算作为能量基线和结构化轨道信息源。 O-kRystal 将 PBE 能带能量与实空间和倒易空间轨道矩阵相结合，预测单个电子态作为晶体动量和自旋函数的更高级别修正。对于能带边缘中点 5 eV 以内的状态，它预测了跨绝缘、金属、磁性和非磁性系统的近 6,000 种三维材料的 Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof (HSE06) 能带能量，平均绝对误差为 0.171 ± 0.009 eV。在六种强相关材料的单独基准上，它将相应的 PBE 带能 MAE 降低了 68.7%，并解决了过渡金属 d 和配体 p 态相对位置的轨道依赖性变化。尽管仅在高对称点进行训练，但它在带路径上看不见的点上保持了相当的精度，并根据密集布里渊区预测重建了 HSE06 态密度。最后，在二维材料的 G₀W₀ 准粒子能量上训练 O-kRystal 证明了其跨理论层次的适用性，以及轨道学习在超越密度泛函理论的更高保真度、动量分辨电子结构预测方面的潜力。

articles.title: High-Harmonic Generation Probes Quantum Nuclear Fluctuations in Liquid Water
articles.title_zh: 高次谐波发生探测液态水中的量子核涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19967v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nuclear quantum effects are essential for an accurate description of the hydrogen-bonded structure of liquid water, yet their spectroscopic signatures can be subtle and difficult to measure. Moreover, probing these effects in solution on femtosecond timescales (or below) is an open challenge that is pivotal for optical control of hydrogen bonds and ultrafast spectroscopy of proton transfer. Here, we combine path-integral molecular dynamics with real-time time-dependent density-functional theory to explore high-harmonic generation (HHG) in liquid water from first principles, rigorously accounting for quantum nuclear delocalisation. Relative to classical-nuclei simulations, quantum sampling suppresses the harmonic yield around certain harmonics by up to an order of magnitude, inducing local structural minima. By analysing the ab initio simulations and reproducing the key effects with a simplified model Hamiltonian, we trace the physical origins of the interference minima to the broadening of valence-band states induced by hydrogen-bond fluctuations, a mechanism expected to generalise to other hydrogen-bonded structures. Our work shows that nuclear quantum effects are indispensable for capturing ultrafast electronic dynamics in liquids, and demonstrates the power of liquid HHG spectroscopy for attosecond probing of nuclear fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 核量子效应对于准确描述液态水的氢键结构至关重要，但它们的光谱特征可能很微妙且难以测量。此外，在飞秒时间尺度（或以下）内探测溶液中的这些效应是一个开放的挑战，对于氢键的光学控制和质子转移的超快光谱至关重要。在这里，我们将路径积分分子动力学与实时时间相关的密度泛函理论相结合，从第一原理探索液态水中的高次谐波产生（HHG），严格解释量子核离域。相对于经典核模拟，量子采样将某些谐波周围的谐波产量抑制高达一个数量级，从而引起局部结构最小值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 核量子效应对于准确描述液态水的氢键结构至关重要，但它们的光谱特征可能很微妙且难以测量。此外，在飞秒时间尺度（或以下）内探测溶液中的这些效应是一个开放的挑战，对于氢键的光学控制和质子转移的超快光谱至关重要。在这里，我们将路径积分分子动力学与实时时间相关的密度泛函理论相结合，从第一原理探索液态水中的高次谐波产生（HHG），严格解释量子核离域。相对于经典核模拟，量子采样将某些谐波周围的谐波产量抑制高达一个数量级，从而引起局部结构最小值。通过分析从头计算模拟并用简化模型哈密顿量重现关键效应，我们将干扰最小值的物理起源追溯到氢键涨落引起的价带态展宽，这种机制有望推广到其他氢键结构。我们的工作表明，核量子效应对于捕获液体中的超快电子动力学是不可或缺的，并展示了液体 HHG 光谱在阿秒探测核涨落方面的强大功能。

articles.title: Near-field contributions to cavity-mediated radiative heat transfer
articles.title_zh: 近场对空腔介导的辐射传热的贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20130v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Embedding materials in optical cavities has emerged as a powerful strategy for controlling their physical properties. In this context, increasing attention has been devoted to the thermal Purcell effect, which describes how the radiative heat transfer between a material and its photonic environ- ment can be modified by the electromagnetic boundary conditions imposed by the cavity. Here, we investigate near-field effects in cavity-mediated radiative heat transfer in planar cavities composed of realistic, dissipative gold mirrors, extending previous work that considered ideal mirrors. We iden- tify the conditions under which near-field effects lead to a substantial enhancement of heat transfer between the material and a photonic thermal bath relative to free space, owing to the strong modi- fication of the photonic local density of states by evanescent modes within the cavity. In particular, we find that radiative heat flow can be enhanced by several orders of magnitude in cavities ranging from nanometer to micrometer scales, depending on the absorber frequency and dipole orientation. These findings suggest that near-field effects may be relevant to polariton chemistry experiments and other systems operating within this cavity length-scale regime. Our results add to the idea that cavities can modify material properties not only by engineering vacuum fluctuations in the strong light-matter coupling regime, but also by controlling radiative dissipation and heat transfer.
articles.abstract_zh: 在光学腔中嵌入材料已成为控制其物理特性的强大策略。在这种背景下，人们越来越关注热珀塞尔效应，它描述了材料与其光子环境之间的辐射传热如何通过腔体施加的电磁边界条件来改变。在这里，我们研究了由真实的耗散金镜组成的平面腔中腔介导的辐射传热的近场效应，扩展了之前考虑理想镜子的工作。我们确定了近场效应导致材料和光子热浴之间相对于自由空间的传热显着增强的条件，这是由于腔内的倏逝模式对光子局域密度的强烈改变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在光学腔中嵌入材料已成为控制其物理特性的强大策略。在这种背景下，人们越来越关注热珀塞尔效应，它描述了材料与其光子环境之间的辐射传热如何通过腔体施加的电磁边界条件来改变。在这里，我们研究了由真实的耗散金镜组成的平面腔中腔介导的辐射传热的近场效应，扩展了之前考虑理想镜子的工作。我们确定了近场效应导致材料和光子热浴之间相对于自由空间的传热显着增强的条件，这是由于腔内的倏逝模式对光子局域密度的强烈改变。特别是，我们发现在从纳米到微米尺度的空腔中，辐射热流可以增强几个数量级，具体取决于吸收器频率和偶极子方向。这些发现表明，近场效应可能与极化子化学实验和在该腔长度尺度范围内运行的其他系统有关。我们的结果增强了这样的想法：空腔不仅可以通过在强光-物质耦合状态下设计真空波动，还可以通过控制辐射耗散和传热来改变材料特性。

articles.title: Magneto-optical signatures of plateau states in the kagome spin-ice HoAgGe
articles.title_zh: Kagome 自旋冰 HoAgGe 中高原状态的磁光特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.10274v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Coupling of itinerant electrons to non-collinear spin structures in frustrated rare-earth magnets leads to unusual transport properties. While these complex magnetic orders are expected to modify the electronic structure, underlying microscopic mechanisms have been rarely identified. Using magnetoreflectance spectroscopy and ab initio calculations, we reveal reconstructions of the electronic structure across the magnetization plateaus of the kagome spin-ice HoAgGe. We find an unusual optical anisotropy: a larger conductivity perpendicular to the kagome planes originating from the hybridization of Ho 4f flat bands with conduction electrons. Moreover, these flat bands are also responsible for the pronounced magnetoreflectance observed at the metamagnetic transitions. Most importantly, the magnetoreflectance behaves completely differently for excitations near the Fermi level and higher-energy interband transitions. The former, expected to sensitively probe variations in band topology near the Fermi level, shows abrupt non-monotonous changes between the magnetic states, while the interband excitations mimic the field dependence of the magnetization. These observations imply that in HoAgGe, the unusual magnetotransport likely reflects variation of band topology between plateau states. More generally, our study shows that heavy-electron bands near the Fermi level offer an efficient way to control the band structure and thereby the transport and optical properties of non-collinear magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 受挫稀土磁体中流动电子与非共线自旋结构的耦合导致了不寻常的传输特性。虽然这些复杂的磁序有望改变电子结构，但很少确定潜在的微观机制。利用磁反射光谱和从头计算，我们揭示了 Kagome 自旋冰 HoAgGe 磁化平台上电子结构的重建。我们发现了一种不寻常的光学各向异性：垂直于 Kagome 平面的较大电导率源自 Ho 4f 平带与传导电子的杂化。此外，这些平带也是造成在变磁转变处观察到的明显磁反射的原因。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受挫稀土磁体中流动电子与非共线自旋结构的耦合导致了不寻常的传输特性。虽然这些复杂的磁序有望改变电子结构，但很少确定潜在的微观机制。利用磁反射光谱和从头计算，我们揭示了 Kagome 自旋冰 HoAgGe 磁化平台上电子结构的重建。我们发现了一种不寻常的光学各向异性：垂直于 Kagome 平面的较大电导率源自 Ho 4f 平带与传导电子的杂化。此外，这些平带也是造成在变磁转变处观察到的明显磁反射的原因。最重要的是，对于费米能级附近的激发和更高能量的带间跃迁，磁反射的行为完全不同。前者有望灵敏地探测费米能级附近能带拓扑的变化，显示出磁态之间的突然非单调变化，而带间激励则模拟磁化强度的场依赖性。这些观察结果表明，在 HoAgGe 中，不寻常的磁输运可能反映了平台态之间能带拓扑的变化。更一般地说，我们的研究表明，费米能级附近的重电子能带提供了一种有效的方法来控制能带结构，从而控制非共线磁体的输运和光学特性。

articles.title: Statistical Description of Fermi System over a Surface in a Uniform External Field
articles.title_zh: 均匀外场表面费米系统的统计描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.12608v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A statistical approach to the description of the thermodynamic properties of the Fermi particle system occupying a half-space over a plane of finite size in a uniform external field is proposed. The number of particles per unit area is assumed to be arbitrary, in particular, small. General formulas are obtained for entropy, energy, thermodynamic potential, heat capacities under various conditions and the distribution of the particle number density over the surface. In the continuum limit of a large surface area, the temperature dependences of heat capacities and density distribution are calculated. The cases of gravitational and electric fields are considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 提出了一种统计方法来描述均匀外场中有限尺寸平面上的半空间费米粒子系统的热力学性质。假设每单位面积的颗粒数量是任意的，特别是很小的。获得了各种条件下的熵、能量、热力学势、热容以及表面上粒子数密度分布的通用公式。在大表面积的连续极限中，计算热容量和密度分布的温度依赖性。考虑重力场和电场的情况。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 提出了一种统计方法来描述均匀外场中有限尺寸平面上的半空间费米粒子系统的热力学性质。假设每单位面积的颗粒数量是任意的，特别是很小的。获得了各种条件下的熵、能量、热力学势、热容以及表面上粒子数密度分布的通用公式。在大表面积的连续极限中，计算热容量和密度分布的温度依赖性。考虑重力场和电场的情况。

articles.title: Zigzag Graphene Nanoribbons as a Majorana Platform
articles.title_zh: 作为Majorana平台的Zigzag石墨烯纳米带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.14999v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graphene nanoribbons support a variety of electronic phases that can be tuned via external stimuli. In particular, zigzag graphene nanoribbons exhibit an antiferromagnetic insulating ground state which can transition to a half-metallic phase under a transverse electric field or when embedded in hexagonal boron nitride. Here, we develop a simple model of a heterostructure composed of a half-metallic zigzag graphene nanoribbon coupled with an Ising superconductor. We demonstrate that an Ising superconductor's s-wave spin-singlet pairing gap component can induce a spin-triplet, odd-parity pairing gap in the half-metallic phase of the nanoribbon via proximity coupling. The resulting superconducting phase is topologically nontrivial, with gate-tunable transitions that enable the emergence of Majorana zero modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 石墨烯纳米带支持多种可以通过外部刺激进行调节的电子相。特别是，之字形石墨烯纳米带表现出反铁磁绝缘基态，在横向电场下或嵌入六方氮化硼中时可以转变为半金属相。在这里，我们开发了一个由半金属锯齿形石墨烯纳米带与伊辛超导体耦合组成的异质结构的简单模型。我们证明，伊辛超导体的 s 波自旋单重态配对间隙分量可以通过邻近耦合在纳米带的半金属相中诱导自旋三重态、奇宇称配对间隙。由此产生的超导相在拓扑上并不平凡，其栅极可调跃迁使得马约拉纳零模式的出现成为可能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 石墨烯纳米带支持多种可以通过外部刺激进行调节的电子相。特别是，之字形石墨烯纳米带表现出反铁磁绝缘基态，在横向电场下或嵌入六方氮化硼中时可以转变为半金属相。在这里，我们开发了一个由半金属锯齿形石墨烯纳米带与伊辛超导体耦合组成的异质结构的简单模型。我们证明，伊辛超导体的 s 波自旋单重态配对间隙分量可以通过邻近耦合在纳米带的半金属相中诱导自旋三重态、奇宇称配对间隙。由此产生的超导相在拓扑上并不平凡，其栅极可调跃迁使得马约拉纳零模式的出现成为可能。

articles.title: Ultrasmall (3,0) carbon nanotube: a superconducting unit with strong electron-phonon coupling
articles.title_zh: 超小型（3,0）碳纳米管：具有强电子声子耦合的超导单元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.03764v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Based on density-functional first-principles calculations, we study the electronic structures, lattice dynamics, and electron-phonon coupling (EPC) properties of the ultrasmall one-dimensional (3,0) carbon nanotube (CNT). Our studies reveal that the (3,0) CNT hosts characteristic collective phonon modes, in which the corresponding atomic vibrations can significantly modulate the electronic self-consistent potential and induce strong EPC. Our results further show that the (3,0) CNT exhibits robust phonon-mediated superconductivity under ambient pressure, with a superconducting transition temperature reaching sim 33 K (μ^* = 0.10). We also find that although hole doping enhances the density of states (DOS) near the Fermi level, it simultaneously hardens the strongly coupled phonon modes and suppresses the total EPC. This result indicates that phonons play a more crucial role in the superconductivity of ultrasmall CNTs rather than the DOS alone. Therefore, we suggest that the ultrasmall (3,0) CNT can serve as a superconducting unit hosting phonon modes with strong EPC, and propose a strategy for discovering new phonon-mediated superconductors by identifying superconducting units.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于密度泛函第一性原理计算，我们研究了超小一维（ 3,0 ）碳纳米管（ CNT ）的电子结构、晶格动力学和电子-声子耦合（ EPC ）特性。我们的研究表明， （ 3,0 ） CNT主机具有特征的集体声子模式，其中相应的原子振动可以显着调节电子自洽电位并诱导强EPC。我们的结果进一步表明， （ 3,0 ） CNT在环境压力下表现出强大的声子介导超导性，超导转变温度达到33 K （ μ ^ * = 0.10 ）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于密度泛函第一性原理计算，我们研究了超小一维（ 3,0 ）碳纳米管（ CNT ）的电子结构、晶格动力学和电子-声子耦合（ EPC ）特性。我们的研究表明， （ 3,0 ） CNT主机具有特征的集体声子模式，其中相应的原子振动可以显着调节电子自洽电位并诱导强EPC。我们的结果进一步表明， （ 3,0 ） CNT在环境压力下表现出强大的声子介导超导性，超导转变温度达到33 K （ μ ^ * = 0.10 ）。我们还发现，尽管空穴掺杂增强了费米能级附近的状态密度（ DOS ） ，但它同时强化了强耦合声子模态并抑制了总EPC。这一结果表明，声子在超小型碳纳米管的超导性中起着更关键的作用，而不仅仅是DOS。因此，我们建议超小（ 3,0 ） CNT可以作为具有强EPC的声子模式的超导单元，并提出通过识别超导单元来发现新的声子介导的超导体的策略。

articles.title: Local Geometric and Transport Properties of Networks that are Generated from Hyperuniform Point Patterns
articles.title_zh: 从超均匀点模式生成的网络的局部几何和传输属性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.21082v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hyperuniformity, which is a type of order that is characterized by the suppression of long-range density fluctuations in comparison to the fluctuations in standard disordered systems, has emerged as a powerful concept in many natural and engineered phenomena. In this paper, we harness hyperuniform point patterns to generate disordered, spatially-embedded networks that are distinct from both perfectly ordered lattices and uniformly random spatial networks. We refer to this class of disordered networks as emph{hyperuniform-point-pattern-induced (HuPPI) networks}, and we compare them to counterpart emph{Poisson-point-pattern-induced (PoPPI) networks} and networks that we generate from random-sequential-adsorption (RSA) packings (which have local order but are not hyperuniform). We examine HuPPI, PoPPI, and RSA networks that we generate using Gabriel, Delaunay, Delaunay-centroidal, and Voronoi network-generation methods. We show that HuPPI networks have smaller mean normalized total effective resistances (TERs) than PoPPI networks in Gabriel, Delaunay-centroidal, and Voronoi networks and have shorter mean random-walk mixing times than PoPPI networks in Gabriel, Delaunay, and Delaunay-centroidal networks. For all four network-generation methods and for both HuPPI and PoPPI networks, we find that the Ollivier--Ricci curvature (ORC) of an edge is negatively correlated with its TER edge contribution (i.e., the increase in TER that results from removing that edge). Collectively, our results (1) illustrate how the local network geometry that ORC measures is related to transport and network connectivity and (2) demonstrate that the network-generation method provides an additional design lever for spatial networks beyond the choice of their underlying point pattern. [This abstract is abridged significantly from the full abstract.]
articles.abstract_zh: 超均匀性是一种秩序，其特征是与标准无序系统的波动相比，抑制长程密度波动，它已成为许多自然和工程现象中的一个强大概念。在本文中，我们利用超均匀点模式来生成无序的空间嵌入网络，该网络不同于完美有序的晶格和均匀随机的空间网络。我们将这类无序网络称为 emph超均匀点模式诱导 (HuPPI) 网络，并将它们与对应的 emph泊松点模式诱导 (PoPPI) 网络以及我们从随机顺序吸附 (RSA) 堆积（具有局部有序但不是超均匀）生成的网络进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超均匀性是一种秩序，其特征是与标准无序系统的波动相比，抑制长程密度波动，它已成为许多自然和工程现象中的一个强大概念。在本文中，我们利用超均匀点模式来生成无序的空间嵌入网络，该网络不同于完美有序的晶格和均匀随机的空间网络。我们将这类无序网络称为 emph超均匀点模式诱导 (HuPPI) 网络，并将它们与对应的 emph泊松点模式诱导 (PoPPI) 网络以及我们从随机顺序吸附 (RSA) 堆积（具有局部有序但不是超均匀）生成的网络进行比较。我们检查使用 Gabriel、Delaunay、Delaunay 质心和 Voronoi 网络生成方法生成的 HuPPI、PoPPI 和 RSA 网络。我们表明，HuPPI 网络比 Gabriel、Delaunay 质心和 Voronoi 网络中的 PoPPI 网络具有更小的平均归一化总有效电阻（TER），并且比 Gabriel、Delaunay 和 Delaunay 质心网络中的 PoPPI 网络具有更短的平均随机游走混合时间。对于所有四种网络生成方法以及 HuPPI 和 PoPPI 网络，我们发现边缘的奥利维耶-里奇曲率 (ORC) 与其 TER 边缘贡献负相关（即，由于删除该边缘而导致 TER 的增加）。总的来说，我们的结果（1）说明了 ORC 测量的本地网络几何形状如何与传输和网络连接相关；（2）证明网络生成方法为空间网络提供了超出其基础点模式选择的额外设计杠杆。 [本摘要对完整摘要进行了大幅删节。]

articles.title: Magnetic Structures Database from Symmetry-aided High-Throughput Calculations
articles.title_zh: 来自对称辅助高通量计算的磁性结构数据库
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.01617v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic structures-the spatial arrangement of magnetic moments-underpin the diverse functionalities of magnetic materials, yet they have been experimentally determined for only a small fraction of known compounds. Conventional first-principles prediction requires candidate magnetic configurations as input, but the number of possible configurations is in principle infinite. Although the classic Landau-theory based symmetry analysis is widely used to classify magnetic ordering, their direct application to generate input magnetic configurations remains a major challenge due to unavoidable residual degrees of freedom. Here we turn this classification language into a practical predictive framework by resolving these freedoms through a two-step symmetry-aided strategy: an irrep-compatible maximal-magnetic-subgroup selection, followed by the physically motivated high-symmetry-direction construction. This highly efficient scheme is justified within the newly developed oriented spin space group framework. Benchmarked against 1,043 Landau-compatible experimental structures in MAGNDATA, our candidate sets reproduce 90% of the experimentally reported magnetic structures in the four high-symmetry crystal systems with only ~51 candidates per material on average, and subsequent first-principles calculations with material-specific Hubbard U parameters recover the experimental ground state with 83% accuracy. Applying the validated workflow to 19,808 transition-metal compounds, we construct a database of more than 5,000 magnetic materials-nearly twice the size of the experimental MAGNDATA. The database reveals statistical regularities accessible only at scale, including the occurrence rate of magnetism, the prevalence of competing magnetic states, and enables the identification of hundreds of magnetic topological materials, altermagnets, and other emerging magnetic phases and functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性结构（磁矩的空间排列）支撑着磁性材料的多种功能，但它们仅针对一小部分已知化合物进行了实验确定。传统的第一原理预测需要候选磁配置作为输入，但可能配置的数量原则上是无限的。尽管经典的基于朗道理论的对称性分析被广泛用于磁有序分类，但由于不可避免的残余自由度，它们在生成输入磁配置方面的直接应用仍然是一个主要挑战。在这里，我们通过两步对称辅助策略来解决这些自由度，从而将这种分类语言转化为实用的预测框架：不兼容的最大磁子群选择，然后是物理动机的高对称方向构造。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性结构（磁矩的空间排列）支撑着磁性材料的多种功能，但它们仅针对一小部分已知化合物进行了实验确定。传统的第一原理预测需要候选磁配置作为输入，但可能配置的数量原则上是无限的。尽管经典的基于朗道理论的对称性分析被广泛用于磁有序分类，但由于不可避免的残余自由度，它们在生成输入磁配置方面的直接应用仍然是一个主要挑战。在这里，我们通过两步对称辅助策略来解决这些自由度，从而将这种分类语言转化为实用的预测框架：不兼容的最大磁子群选择，然后是物理动机的高对称方向构造。这种高效的方案在新开发的面向自旋空间群框架中是合理的。以MAGNDATA中的1043个Landau兼容实验结构为基准，我们的候选集在四个高对称晶体系统中重现了90%的实验报告磁性结构，平均每种材料只有约51个候选，随后使用材料特定的哈伯德U参数进行的第一原理计算以83%的准确度恢复实验基态。将经过验证的工作流程应用于19,808种过渡金属化合物，我们构建了一个包含5,000多种磁性材料的数据库-几乎是实验MAGNDATA大小的两倍。该数据库揭示了只有大规模才能获得的统计规律，包括磁性的发生率、相互竞争的磁态的普遍性，并使数百种磁性拓扑材料、变磁体和其他新兴磁相和功能的识别成为可能。

articles.title: Training overdamped dynamics
articles.title_zh: 训练过阻尼动态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.19122v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In regimes where inertia is negligible, the temporal evolution is governed by overdamped dynamics. This limit is particularly relevant in soft-matter contexts, such as polymers, colloidal suspensions, and processes occurring at the cellular scale. Being able to manipulate the dynamics of such many-particle systems would enable control over rate-dependent elastic responses, time-dependent material properties, relaxation processes, and perhaps the hydrodynamics of suspensions. In this work, we develop a framework for manipulating overdamped dynamics through local, physically motivated update rules. Our approach is inspired by ideas from physical learning and directed aging, in which microscopic parameters adapt autonomously to endow a material with a desired function. Using the Rayleighian formulation, whose minimization reproduces the overdamped equations of motion, we derive approximate directed-aging and equilibrium-propagation rules tailored to dissipative systems. To demonstrate these ideas, we study a disordered Maxwell material that behaves elastically at short times but flows at long times. By locally modifying the viscous damping, we show that one can tune the viscous Poisson's ratio and shape local mechanical responses. These results illustrate how materials can be trained to exhibit targeted rate-dependent elastic and viscous behaviors.
articles.abstract_zh: 在惯性可以忽略不计的情况下，时间演化受过阻尼动力学支配。该限制在软物质环境中尤其相关，例如聚合物、胶体悬浮液和在细胞尺度上发生的过程。能够操纵这种许多粒子系统的动力学将能够控制速率相关的弹性响应、时间相关的材料特性、弛豫过程，也许还有悬浮液的流体动力学。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个框架，用于通过本地、物理动机的更新规则来操纵过阻尼动态。我们的方法受到物理学习和定向老化的启发，其中微观参数自主适应以赋予材料所需的功能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在惯性可以忽略不计的情况下，时间演化受过阻尼动力学支配。该限制在软物质环境中尤其相关，例如聚合物、胶体悬浮液和在细胞尺度上发生的过程。能够操纵这种许多粒子系统的动力学将能够控制速率相关的弹性响应、时间相关的材料特性、弛豫过程，也许还有悬浮液的流体动力学。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个框架，用于通过本地、物理动机的更新规则来操纵过阻尼动态。我们的方法受到物理学习和定向老化的启发，其中微观参数自主适应以赋予材料所需的功能。使用瑞利公式，其最小化再现了过阻尼的运动方程，我们推导出适合耗散系统的近似定向老化和平衡传播规则。为了证明这些想法，我们研究了一种无序的麦克斯韦材料，它在短时间内具有弹性，但在长时间内流动。通过局部修改粘性阻尼，我们表明可以调节粘性泊松比并形成局部机械响应。这些结果说明了如何训练材料以表现出目标速率相关的弹性和粘性行为。

articles.title: The Phase Transitions in a p spin Glass Model: A Numerical Study
articles.title_zh: 自旋玻璃模型中的相变：一项数值研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15433v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the balanced M=4, p=4 spin-glass model for a one-dimensional long-range proxy for the finite dimensional short-range p-spin glass model to examine the nature of the glass transition beyond mean-field theory. We perform large-scale Monte Carlo equilibrated simulations for both fully connected and power-law diluted versions of the model. The critical temperatures extracted from the finite-size scaling (FSS) analysis of spin-glass susceptibility are in good agreement with theoretical predictions for σ = 0, 0.25, and 0.55. For these values of the long-range exponent σ (which is the power of the decrease of the interactions between the spins with their separation), one might have expected that mean-field theory would provide a good description of the system. However, the spin-overlap distribution and the value of the λ-parameter do not provide numerical evidence for a one-step replica symmetry breaking (1RSB) phase transition. Instead, our results indicate a direct transition from the paramagnetic state to a full replica symmetry broken phase, with a renormalized value of λequiv ω₂/ω₁ < 1 suggesting a continuous FRSB transition, despite this ratio being equal to 2 at mean-field level. A value of λ > 1 is required for the discontinuous 1RSB transition. We argue that strong finite-size effects and closely spaced transition temperatures remove the expected 1RSB transition for the system sizes which we can study. For values of the exponent σ = 0.85, which roughly corresponds to a three dimensional system, we find that the renormalized value of λ is again less than 1, with no signs of either the 1RSB transition or the continuous FRSB transition, suggesting that the Kauzmann temperature T_K in three dimensions might be zero and the complete absence of phase transitions in structural glasses.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究有限维短程p自旋玻璃模型的一维远程代理的平衡M = 4, p = 4自旋玻璃模型，以研究超越平均场理论的玻璃转变的性质。我们对模型的全连接和幂律稀释版本进行了大规模的蒙特卡罗平衡模拟。从自旋玻璃敏感性的有限尺寸缩放（ FSS ）分析中提取的临界温度与σ = 0,0.25和0.55的理论预测非常吻合。对于远程指数σ的这些值（这是自旋与其分离之间相互作用减少的幂） ，人们可能会期望平均场理论将为系统提供良好的描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究有限维短程p自旋玻璃模型的一维远程代理的平衡M = 4, p = 4自旋玻璃模型，以研究超越平均场理论的玻璃转变的性质。我们对模型的全连接和幂律稀释版本进行了大规模的蒙特卡罗平衡模拟。从自旋玻璃敏感性的有限尺寸缩放（ FSS ）分析中提取的临界温度与σ = 0,0.25和0.55的理论预测非常吻合。对于远程指数σ的这些值（这是自旋与其分离之间相互作用减少的幂） ，人们可能会期望平均场理论将为系统提供良好的描述。然而，自旋重叠分布和λ参数的值并不能为一步复制对称断裂（ 1RSB ）相变提供数值证据。相反，我们的结果表明从顺磁状态到完全复制对称断裂相的直接转变，不连续的1RSB转变需要重整值λequiv ω ₂/ω恤1。我们认为，强大的有限尺寸效应和紧密间隔的过渡温度消除了我们可以研究的系统尺寸的预期1RSB过渡。对于大致对应于三维系统的指数σ = 0.85的值，我们发现λ的重整值再次小于1 ，没有1RSB跃迁或连续FRSB跃迁的迹象，这表明三维中的Kauzmann温度T_K可能为零，并且结构玻璃中完全没有相变。

articles.title: Dynamics of spinor Bose-Einstein condensates close to spin-spatial resonances
articles.title_zh: 玻色-爱因斯坦旋量凝聚的动力学接近自旋空间共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.16732v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a coupled-channel framework to describe the dynamics of spinor Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs), with particular emphasis on the behavior near resonances between spin dynamics and spatial excitations. Taking advantage of the disparity between the spin-dependent and spin-independent scattering lengths in typical spinor BECs, the Bogoliubov modes of the spin-independent part of the full system Hamiltonian provide an efficient set of basis functions for describing the system dynamics in a coupled-channel framework. For quadratic Zeeman shifts far from any resonance, the system can be described by a single spatial wavefunction during the spin dynamics, i.e., the so-called single-mode approximation holds. By tuning the quadratic Zeeman shift, we find resonant excitations of the Bogoliubov modes, which can be classified into two categories: those with particle-hole correlations and those without particle-hole correlations. We show that the beyond-quadratic-order terms that are neglected in standard Bogoliubov theories become increasingly important for capturing the long-time dynamics of the system near resonances. The coupled-channel framework is benchmarked against results from 1D Gross-Pitaevskii equation simulations. The framework developed in this work not only provides a numerically efficient tool for describing spinor BEC dynamics governed by different length scales, but also provides a clean physical interpretation of resonance phenomena in spinor BECs. Applications of this approach to other systems and extensions to the beyond-mean-field regime are also discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个耦合通道框架来描述自旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态（ BEC ）的动力学，特别强调自旋动力学和空间激发之间接近共振的行为。利用典型旋量BEC中自旋相关和自旋无关散射长度之间的差异，全系统自旋无关部分的Bogoliubov模式Hamiltonian为描述耦合通道框架中的系统动力学提供了一组有效的基函数。对于二次塞曼偏移远离任何共振，系统可以通过自旋动力学期间的单个空间波函数来描述，即所谓的单模逼近保持。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一个耦合通道框架来描述自旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态（ BEC ）的动力学，特别强调自旋动力学和空间激发之间接近共振的行为。利用典型旋量BEC中自旋相关和自旋无关散射长度之间的差异，全系统自旋无关部分的Bogoliubov模式Hamiltonian为描述耦合通道框架中的系统动力学提供了一组有效的基函数。对于二次塞曼偏移远离任何共振，系统可以通过自旋动力学期间的单个空间波函数来描述，即所谓的单模逼近保持。通过调整二次Zeeman位移，我们发现Bogoliubov模式的共振激发，可以分为两类：具有粒子孔相关性和没有粒子孔相关性的共振激发。我们表明，标准Bogoliubov理论中忽略的超二次项对于捕获系统接近共振的长期动态变得越来越重要。耦合通道框架以一维Gross-Pitaevskii方程模拟的结果为基准。本工作中开发的框架不仅为描述由不同长度尺度支配的旋量体BEC动力学提供了数值有效的工具，而且还为旋量体BEC中的共振现象提供了干净的物理解释。还讨论了这种方法在其他系统上的应用以及对超均值场机制的扩展。

articles.title: Fluctuation-driven multi-step charge density wave melting in monolayer TiSe₂
articles.title_zh: 单层TiSe ₂中波动驱动的多步电荷密度波熔化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.20355v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The exact microscopic origin, symmetry, and thermal melting mechanism of the charge density wave (CDW) phase in TiSe₂ remain intensely debated, particularly regarding chiral structural order and multi-step phase transitions. Using large-scale molecular dynamics driven by an accurate machine-learning interatomic potential, we resolve the finite-temperature structural dynamics of the monolayer TiSe₂. We demonstrate that CDW melting deviates from conventional mean-field second-order behavior, undergoing a two-step process characterized by an extended fluctuation region (200-250 K) with proliferating domain walls, phase decoherence, component-selective melting, and an overdamped soft optical phonon. Furthermore, anisotropic long-wavelength thermal fluctuations spontaneously stabilize an asymmetric 3Q CDW order with P1 symmetry. These findings provide a unified microscopic framework for fluctuation-driven transitions in 2D quantum materials, demonstrating that the complex CDW physics of TiSe₂ is captured entirely via non-perturbative electron-phonon and phonon-phonon interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: TiSe ₂中电荷密度波（ CDW ）相的确切微观起源、对称性和热熔融机制仍然存在激烈争论，特别是关于手性结构顺序和多步相变。利用由精确的机器学习原子间势驱动的大规模分子动力学，我们解决了单层TiSe ₂的有限温度结构动力学。我们证明， CDW熔化偏离了传统的均值场二阶行为，经历了两步过程，其特征是具有增殖畴壁的扩展波动区（ 200-250 K ）、相位退相干、组分选择性熔化和过阻尼的软光学声子。此外，各向异性长波长热波动自发稳定具有P1对称性的不对称3Q CDW级。
articles.abstract_zh_full: TiSe ₂中电荷密度波（ CDW ）相的确切微观起源、对称性和热熔融机制仍然存在激烈争论，特别是关于手性结构顺序和多步相变。利用由精确的机器学习原子间势驱动的大规模分子动力学，我们解决了单层TiSe ₂的有限温度结构动力学。我们证明， CDW熔化偏离了传统的均值场二阶行为，经历了两步过程，其特征是具有增殖畴壁的扩展波动区（ 200-250 K ）、相位退相干、组分选择性熔化和过阻尼的软光学声子。此外，各向异性长波长热波动自发稳定具有P1对称性的不对称3Q CDW级。这些发现为2D量子材料中的波动驱动跃迁提供了一个统一的微观框架，表明TiSe ₂的复杂CDW物理完全通过非扰动电子-声子和声子-声子相互作用捕获。

articles.title: Propelling catalytic structures using active biomolecular condensates
articles.title_zh: 使用活性生物分子冷凝物推进催化结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.27965v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Living systems routinely consume energy to achieve motility, often using intricate biomolecular machinery.
