Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. Notably, in the extreme quantum limit at cryogenic temperatures, the magnetoresistance undergoes a dramatic reversal from negative to positive. This reversal points to a potential field-induced phase transition into a collective electronic state driven by enhanced electron-electron interactions. Our findings provide valuable insights into the unconventional chiral transport and emergent correlated quantum states under extreme magnetic fields.

articles.title: Role of composition-tuned disorder on magnetic exchange interactions in NiRuMnGa
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the experimental investigation of the quaternary Heusler alloy NiRuMnGa, complemented by first-principles calculations. The energetically favorable crystal structure was identified from first-principles calculations and subsequently used as the structural model for refinement of the powder X-ray diffraction data. The refinement shows good agreement with the experimental pattern and reveals substantial B2-type disorder involving Ni/Ru and Mn/Ga site intermixing. The dc magnetic response exhibits pronounced ZFC--FC irreversibility near sim 48 K, with the irreversibility temperature shifting toward lower temperatures under increasing magnetic field, indicating a field-sensitive glassy state. The isothermal magnetization remains unsaturated up to 7 T, reaching only sim 0.4,μB/f.u., accompanied by pronounced hysteresis, suggesting competing exchange interactions and frustrated magnetic moments. AC susceptibility, together with magnetic relaxation and memory measurements, confirms slow spin dynamics characteristic of a cluster glass state. The lack of a discernible heat-capacity anomaly near the irreversibility temperature further supports the absence of conventional long-range magnetic order. Collectively, these results demonstrate that competition between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic interactions in NiRuMnGa leads to magnetic frustration and stabilizes a cluster glass state.

articles.title: Assessing quantitative phase reliability in electron ptychography using a twisted trilayer WS2 thickness staircase
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The phase of an electron wave is sensitive to the local electrostatic environment and can therefore provide information about atomic-scale structural variations. In electron ptychography, however, specimen thickness, multiple scattering and projected atomic overlap can complicate the quantitative interpretation of the reconstructed phase. Here, we use a twisted trilayer WS2 thickness staircase containing monolayer, bilayer and trilayer regions as an internal reference, with all regions measured under identical experimental conditions. The mean W-column phase increases by approximately 13.2% from the monolayer to the bilayer region, compared with only 4.7% from the bilayer to the trilayer region, revealing a nonlinear thickness dependence. W-S overlap has little effect on the W-column phase, whereas short-range projected W-W overlap increases it by approximately 8-9%. These results provide a benchmark for evaluating quantitative phase measurement in multilayer WS2 and for assessing phase-based mapping of local electrostatic potential, charge-density and three-dimensional atomic-scale polarization.

articles.title: Electron- and hole-doped superconductivity in two-dimensional electride ZrX₂ (X = Cl, Br, I)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) superconducting systems have recently emerged as a frontier in condensed matter physics, driven by their unique physical properties and potential applications. Using first-principles calculations, we show that monolayer ZrX₂ (X = Cl, Br, I), which is a family of 2D semiconducting electrides, hosts phonon-mediated superconductivity under both electron and hole dopings. Electron doping in ZrX₂ can achieve high superconducting transition temperatures at very low concentrations, with ZrBr₂ reaching T_c = 30.0 K at 0.01 e/f.u., followed by ZrCl₂ (22.5 K at 0.05 e/f.u.) and ZrI₂ (18.1 K at 0.01 e/f.u.), for which the high T_c originates from the flat conduction band minimum, with Van Hove singularities nearby enhancing the density of states. In contrast, hole doping requires higher concentrations (0.2--0.25 h/f.u.) to activate superconductivity, yielding T_c sim 2 K, and approaches a magnetic instability at elevated doping levels. By comparing with InSe and LaBr₂, we identify the spatial location and orbital character of excess electrons as key factors determining the strength of hole-doped superconductivity and the nature of competing orders. These findings establish monolayer ZrX₂ as a platform for bipolar superconductivity in a 2D electride and provide insights into flat-band engineering for high-T_c superconductors.

articles.title: Orbital transfer reveals material-selective structure in Rydberg excitons
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rydberg excitons in atomically thin semiconductors offer a sensitive view of dielectric screening and electronic structure. As their spectra become increasingly well resolved, a central question is how much material information an effective Hamiltonian can predict beyond the states used to determine it. Using the 1s, 2p and 2s levels to determine a scalar Rytova-Keldysh Hamiltonian, we test its transfer to the excluded 3p state. The transfer deviations have opposite signs: the observed 3p lies 7.38 meV below the prediction in MoSe2 and 5.58 meV above it in WS2; the opposite signs persist across the complete reported +/-2-sigma peak-error boxes. In a separate high-field-calibrated benchmark, RK removes 66.8% of the orbital error of a pure two-dimensional Coulomb reference, making the remaining state-selective deviations particularly informative. After separating gap and common-scale contributions, the residuals reveal distinct material-dependent orbital patterns and constrain simple multichannel descriptions. For WS2, the measured 2p/3p curvatures yield a parameter-fixed prediction, Q4p=+4.08 meV, for a future same-platform measurement. Together these results show how a well-performing spectral model can be tested for transferable physical information, with the next unmeasured state providing an independent experimental check.

articles.title: X-ray absorption spectroscopic studies of oxygen-deficient double perovskite oxide NdBaCo₂O₅₊δ (δ sim 0.65)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The degree of oxygen vacancy in A-site-doped layered double perovskite oxides can lead to anion vacancy ordering, which subsequently results in distinct superstructures. We have studied oxygen deficient double perovskite oxide, NdBaCo2O₅₊δ (δ sim 0.65), utilising X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy complemented by multiple scattering and first-principles calculations based on density functional theory (DFT+U). The present results establish a direct correlation between oxygen-vacancy distribution, magnetic inhomogeneity, and charge transport in layered cobaltates. Our investigations on the Co K, Ba, and Nd LIII edges suggest that the near-edge spectra, based on the number and shape of the spectral features, indicate the value of δ for the compound under study lies closer to 0.75. The analysis of the Ba LIII edge spectrum confirms the +2 oxidation state for Ba ions. The Co K-edge near-edge spectra suggest the possibility of oxygen vacancies arising at the basal sites in addition to the apical sites. This is counterintuitive to the common understanding that oxygen vacancies usually occur at the apical sites, i.e., in the lanthanide (Nd) layer in these compounds. Such a distribution of oxygen vacancies naturally explains the Griffith phase and the conduction mechanism of variable range hopping observed in the compound. The vacancy distribution, when at the optimum level, can also bring about easier oxygen ion mobility and a more sensitive and faster oxygen sensor. We believe that our results will help in tailoring oxygen-ion mobility and enhancing oxygen-sensing performance.

articles.title: Insights on the volume variation of LiCoxMn2-xO4 electrode upon cycling: a correlative operando XRD and XAS study
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding volume changes in high-voltage spinel cathodes is essential for mitigating mechanical degradation and improving cycling stability. However, linking these changes to cation-specific redox processes remains challenging. Here, we combine operando X-ray diffraction (XRD) and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) to investigate the LiCoxMn2-xO4 spinel system, which exhibits a cubic structure and isotropic lattice response, in order to correlate the evolution of the local and long-range structure. Five compositions (x = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1.0) were synthesized and electrochemically characterized, with x = 0, 0.5, and 1.0 examined in detail under identical cycling conditions. XAS at the Mn and Co K-edges reveals distinct Mn4+/Mn3+ and Co4+/Co3+ redox processes, with Mn redox activity dominating below 4.7 V and Co redox triggered at higher potentials. Chemometric tools for XAS data analysis further resolve the evolution of local structure during cycling. Both XRD and XAS capture consistent trends in volume evolution, despite probing different structural length scales. Increasing Co content progressively decreases the overall volume change, from 5.0 % to 1.6 % by XAS and from 5.8 % to 2.1 % by XRD. These results demonstrate that Co substitution suppresses electrochemically induced structural strain and establish a direct link between cation-specific redox activity and volumetric evolution. The correlative operando XRD/XAS approach provides a framework to investigate newly designed low-strain, high-energy cathodes with improved cycling stability.

articles.title: Equal-Spin local and nonlocal Andreev reflection in altermagnet/superconductor/altermagnet junction
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13193v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated the equal-spin Andreev reflection phenomenon in an altermagnet/super-conductor/altermagnet (AM/SC/AM) junction, focusing on the roles of the crystal orientation angle and the Néel vector. The crystal orientation angle in the AM effectively determines the spin-dependent transport channels for both electrons and holes, leading to orientation-dependent local and crossed Andreev reflection in the AM/SC/AM junction. We studied how and under what conditions this equal-spin Andreev reflection occurs. Rotating the Néel vector in the AM substantially increases spin-flip channels for both electrons and holes, giving rise to equal-spin Andreev reflection. When the Néel vector θ=π/2, the spin-dependent transmission channels for crystal orientations α=0 and α=π/2 are completely the same, the Andreev reflection coefficients remain different, reflecting the distinct roles of the Néel vector in spin space and the crystal orientation in real space. By tuning the crystal orientation angle and the Néel vector, orientation-dependent conventional and equal-spin Andreev reflection can be realized. This study reveals that Néel vector rotation is the direct cause of equal-spin Andreev reflection in AM/SC/AM junctions and provides a viable pathway for realizing spin-dependent superconducting transport phenomena in AM heterojunctions.

articles.title: Atomic Edge Resonators Flatten Phonon Bands in Biphenylene Nanoribbons
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that H--F edge complexes in biphenylene nanoribbons act as intrinsic atomic resonators, flattening low-frequency phonon branches. With increasing wave vector, flexural and twisting vibrations concentrate at the edges while motion of the carbon backbone is suppressed. Displacement profiles and edge-mass tuning identify a local-resonance mechanism, an atomic counterpart of a tuned mass damper. Combining machine-learned interatomic potentials, frozen-phonon calculations, and density-functional tight binding, we find that weakly dispersive modes contribute substantially to thermal band-gap narrowing. Zero-point motion shifts the calculated gap closure toward the experimentally observed ribbon widths. A hexagonal boron nitride substrate preserves the principal spectral features while reducing thermal renormalization. These results establish edge chemistry as a route to nearly flat phonon bands and connect a local atomic resonance to the electronic response of an entire nanoribbon.

articles.title: VN-GraphGG: von Neumann--Mullins--based graph grain growth simulation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient simulations of grain growth are essential for investigating the process-structure-property relationships in polycrystalline materials. We introduce a two-dimensional von Neumann-Mullins-based graph grain growth simulation (VN-GraphGG), which couples the grain-scale kinetics with microstructure reconstruction. The polycrystalline microstructure is represented as a graph with grain and junction nodes. The grain-area evolution on the grain graph is governed by the von Neumann--Mullins (VN) law, while a graph neural network is trained to reconstruct the microstructure from the graph. This separation allows kinetic coefficients to be varied without retraining the neural reconstruction model. Topological changes during grain growth such as disappearance of grains and changes in neighbor relations are handled straightforwardly through reconstruction and postprocessing. Simulations demonstrate accurate predictions of VN kinetics and coarsening statistics, and significant speedup over the phase-field simulations. The proposed method provides a foundation for efficient grain growth simulation based on grain-scale kinetics, opening the way to incorporate a broader range of physical mechanisms. An application example is presented for abnormal grain growth, in which kinetic heterogeneity significantly influences the grain microstructure evolution.

articles.title: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. These predictions accurately reproduce edge morphology, linewidth variations, and defect probabilities observed in fabricated samples, enabling statistical analysis of milling performance and the identification of dominant structural and process parameter-dependent deformation modes. The work establishes a probabilistic modelling framework for fabrication variability analysis and fabrication-aware design optimization.

articles.title: Magnetic-field-induced detwinning of orientational domains in altermagnet α-MnTe: A single-crystal neutron diffraction study
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, which makes them promising for future spintronic and magnonic applications, but their macroscopic responses can be strongly reduced by domain averaging. In hexagonal α-MnTe, three symmetry-related in-plane Néel-vector orientations and their time-reversal counterparts form six magnetic domain states, complicating both magnetic structure determination and measurements of the chiral magnon response. Using single-crystal neutron diffraction, we show that an in-plane field applied along the [-1,1,0] direction produces a common magnetic domain orientation that saturates near μ₀H=2 T. A constrained refinement of 61 nuclear and magnetic reflections collected at 2 K and 2 T yields Mparallel[1,1,0], an ordered moment of 4.62(8)~μ_B per Mn, and an orientational domain population at r_A:r_B:r_C=0.97:0.03(5):0 that is compatible with a nearly complete alignment of orientational domains. Furthermore, an abnormal behaviour in the temperature dependence of the selected reflections is observed in 60-88 K, its microscopic origin is discussed within the context of possible intrinsic piezomagnetic or magnetoelastic effects. Because unpolarized diffraction neither distinguishes domain repopulation from continuous Néel-vector rotation nor resolves time-reversal antiphase domains, the field-prepared state is a near-single-orientation state rather than a truly single-domain state. This non-contact domain control provides a practical complement to strain and field-cooling approaches for preparing well-defined magnetic states in bulk α-MnTe.

articles.title: The effects of non-stoichiometric lattice structure and secondary phase α-Fe2O3 on modifying the magnetic, electrical, and magneto-electric properties of Eu doped BaFe12O19 hexaferrite
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Ba-atoms in BaFe12O19 were substituted by Eu-atoms to prepare the material of composition Ba1-xEuyFe12O19. The Eu atoms occupied at the sites of Fe atoms. The atomic ratio of Eu/Ba were varied from 0 to 0.33 to control the secondary phase (hematite) and M-type hexaferrite. Raman spectra provided complimentary support for a systematic increase of the hematite phase on increasing the Eu/Ba ratio. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy informed the presence of oxygen deficiency and surface defects, and charge state of Ba and Fe/Eu ions close to +2 and +3, respectively. The material showed direct optical transitions with band gap in the range of 2.25-3.09 eV. The increase of Eu/Ba ratio systematically increased the saturation magnetization from 84.44 emu g-1 to 57.68 emu g-1 at 3 K and 67.09 emu g-1 to 43.42 emu g-1 at 300 K, along with remarkable enhancement of the coercivity (914- 3656 Oe at 3 K and 1996-4862 Oe at 300 K). Electrical conductivity increased from 10-11-10-10 Sm-1 at 30 K to 10-5 -10-4 Sm-1 at 300 K. The electrical conductivity analysis reveals the Efros-Shklovsky-type variable-range hopping mechanism at the low-temperature region, whereas the Mott variable range hopping mechanism is applicable near to room temperature. The analysis of current-voltage characteristics provided electrode to sample interfacial barrier height of 0.27-0.74 eV. The material exhibited novel magneto-electronic properties (bi-stable electronic switching and its transformation in the temperature scale, magnetoresistance and magnetoelectric coupling) which are highly useful for spintronic devices. This work demonstrates that controlled Eu/Ba atomic ratio in the stoichiometric and non-stoichiometric lattice structure could be an effective strategy to widely tune the magnetic, optical and magneto-electronic properties in M-type Ba hexaferrite material.

articles.title: Giant geometric nonlinear transport in inhomogeneously strained Bi₂Se₃ single crystalline slabs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrical transport in non-centrosymmetric materials exhibits a nonlinear conductivity tensor component that generates second-harmonic voltages in response to applied electric fields. Harnessing this effect is essential for developing zero-threshold electromagnetic energy harvesters and broadband frequency upconverters, both of which require maximizing the nonlinear responsivity. Here, we demonstrate that inhomogeneously strained macroscopic slabs of the topological insulator Bi₂Se₃ achieve a record-high nonlinear responsivity of 10⁴,μm/V: a six orders of magnitude boost compared to its thin-film counterparts. We attribute this giant enhancement to a classical geometric nonlinear transport effect, which is driven by complex strain gradients within the bulk material. Notably, a similar geometric mechanism known as geometric nonlinear Hall was previously observed only in microscale-patterned structures. Our findings establish macroscopic strain engineering as a powerful route to enhance nonlinear transport, with immediate relevance to a broad class of layered systems, including transition metal dichalcogenides and moiré heterostructures.

articles.title: Altermagnetic Control of Charge-4e Superconductivity
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13584v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present, to our knowledge, the first theoretical realization of an independent charge-4e phase in a two-dimensional classical array of conventional superconductors coupled through altermagnetic junctions. Tuning the altermagnetic splitting suppresses the leading single-pair tunneling harmonic while retaining strong double-pair coupling, producing a finite charge-4e region between staggered and uniform charge-2e states. Using the complete temperature-dependent microscopic Josephson spectrum, we find short-range ordinary pair correlations alongside algebraic coherence of pairs of Cooper pairs. Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless scaling and a half-flux response further identify the charge-4e phase. Our results establish altermagnetism as a microscopic means to select between ordinary and composite superconducting coherence.

articles.title: Ferroelectric Domain-Wall Motion, Stability, and Frequency Responses under Different Screening-Charge Conservation Laws
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13619v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analyze ferroelectric domain wall motion, shape, and internal structure arising from coupling between polarization and screening charge. Universal cases are organized by electrical boundary conditions, charge conservation and dynamics, and polarization free energy. We consider exposed surfaces, interfaces beneath a dielectric layer and top electrode, and interfaces with a blocking mixed ionic-electronic conductor. Screening occurs through local exchange, exchange with lateral transport, or strictly conserved redistribution. Analytical derivations and finite-depth calculations establish screening drag, velocity branches, and conditions for spatial instability. For an isolated wall joining differently compensated domains, strict surface conservation and zero far-field current exclude steady translation of the screening profile, while allowing transient displacement, finite-sample arrest, and charge-balanced structural changes. Conservation also constrains long-distance transport around a moving junction in an adjoining conductor. Large-field simulations in the top-electrode geometry reveal nonlinear corrugation, transfer toward longer wavelengths, and coupled polarization rotation. First-order polarization energetics allow two interphase fronts enclosing a paraelectric core; multiaxial polarization permits wall rotation and competing intermediate ferroelectric domains. A driven structural-screening reduction supports stable periodic behavior. Reduced-variable diagrams summarize motion and structural regimes, while BaTiO3 and BiFeO3 examples connect them to material thermodynamics. Small-signal analysis distinguishes displacement, polarization, and electrostatic response functions. These results provide a framework for wall dynamics and structural transitions under different driving and screening conditions.

articles.title: Dislocation mediated twin boundary faceting in β-Sn
articles.title_zh: β-Sn 中位错介导的孪晶边界刻面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs), including twin boundaries (TBs), play a critical role in plastic deformation by interacting with dislocations. The deformation and strengthening mechanisms in β-Sn are of significant interest because Sn-based alloys are widely used as solder materials. Recent experiments have shown deformation-induced faceting in β-Sn arising from twin-dislocation interactions. Using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations informed by a recently developed machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP), we demonstrate a langle crangle dislocation-absorption mediated faceting reaction along (301) TBs in β-Sn in which facet length grows with the number of absorbed dislocations. We show that the predicted facet length is consistent with isotropic elasticity theory only when the disclination character of the asymmetric twin facet is taken into account. We discuss analogies to faceting reactions in other low symmetry metals and hypothesize that the ubiquity of (301) twins in β-Sn stems from their ability to grow rapidly through a forest of dislocation obstacles.
articles.abstract_zh: 晶界 (GB)，包括孪晶界 (TB)，通过与位错相互作用在塑性变形中发挥着关键作用。由于锡基合金广泛用作焊料材料，β-Sn 的变形和强化机制引起了人们的极大兴趣。最近的实验表明，β-Sn 中的变形引起的刻面是由孪生位错相互作用引起的。利用最近开发的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）提供的分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们证明了沿着β-Sn中的（301）TB的langle cangle位错吸收介导的刻面反应，其中刻面长度随着吸收位错的数量而增长。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶界 (GB)，包括孪晶界 (TB)，通过与位错相互作用在塑性变形中发挥着关键作用。由于锡基合金广泛用作焊料材料，β-Sn 的变形和强化机制引起了人们的极大兴趣。最近的实验表明，β-Sn 中的变形引起的刻面是由孪生位错相互作用引起的。利用最近开发的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）提供的分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们证明了沿着β-Sn中的（301）TB的langle cangle位错吸收介导的刻面反应，其中刻面长度随着吸收位错的数量而增长。我们表明，仅当考虑非对称孪生面的向错特性时，预测的面长度才符合各向同性弹性理论。我们讨论了与其他低对称性金属中的刻面反应的类比，并假设 β-Sn 中普遍存在的 (301) 孪晶源于它们能够穿过位错障碍森林快速生长的能力。

articles.title: Scalene Yang-Baxter triples realize all nearest-neighbour Hamiltonians with global additive symmetries
articles.title_zh: Scalene Yang-Baxter 三元组实现了具有全局加性对称性的所有最近邻哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish that bond Hamiltonian densities, up to local difference terms whose sum vanishes under periodic boundary conditions, lying in the commutant of bond operators, wⱼ± wⱼ₊₁, is a necessary and sufficient condition for a one-dimensional nearest-neighbour Hamiltonian to conserve a uniform or staggered sum of the one-site operators wⱼ. Starting from these local commutants, we show that every such Hamiltonian and its conserved charge can be obtained from monodromy matrices constructed using regular and non-regular members of scalene Yang-Baxter triples. The results hold on periodic chains of length L≥3, with even length required in the staggered case. The results do not require translation invariance, and hence the interaction on each bond can be chosen independently from the full corresponding commutant. Our representation-independent construction applies in arbitrary finite local dimension and exhausts the Hamiltonians with either prescribed additive symmetry, without requiring ordinary Yang-Baxter integrability. We illustrate the construction with spin-tfrac12 and spin-1 systems and discuss its relation to the double-commutant theorem. Classifying the one-site generators w and their associated bond commutants provides a route to classifying such Hamiltonians with additive conserved charges.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们建立了键哈密顿密度，直到其和在周期性边界条件下消失的局部差分项，位于键算子的交换子 wⱼ± wⱼ₊₁ 中，是一维最近邻哈密顿量守恒单点算子 wⱼ 的均匀或交错和的充分必要条件。从这些局部交换子开始，我们证明了每个这样的哈密顿量及其守恒电荷都可以从使用不等边斜角杨-巴克斯特三元组的规则和非常规成员构造的单向矩阵中获得。结果适用于长度 L≥3 的周期链，并且交错情况下要求长度均匀。结果不需要平移不变性，因此每个键上的相互作用可以独立于完全相应的交换子进行选择。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了键哈密顿密度，直到其和在周期性边界条件下消失的局部差分项，位于键算子的交换子 wⱼ± wⱼ₊₁ 中，是一维最近邻哈密顿量守恒单点算子 wⱼ 的均匀或交错和的充分必要条件。从这些局部交换子开始，我们证明了每个这样的哈密顿量及其守恒电荷都可以从使用不等边斜角杨-巴克斯特三元组的规则和非常规成员构造的单向矩阵中获得。结果适用于长度 L≥3 的周期链，并且交错情况下要求长度均匀。结果不需要平移不变性，因此每个键上的相互作用可以独立于完全相应的交换子进行选择。我们的与表示无关的构造适用于任意有限局部维度，并用任一规定的加性对称性耗尽哈密顿量，而不需要普通的杨-巴克斯特可积性。我们用 spin-tfrac12 和 spin-1 系统说明了构造，并讨论了它与双交换定理的关系。对单点生成元 w 及其相关的键交换子进行分类提供了一种对具有加性守恒电荷的哈密顿量进行分类的途径。

articles.title: Improved screening of doped ZrO₂ catalysts for CO₂ hydrogenation from graph-based machine learning
articles.title_zh: 通过基于图形的机器学习改进用于 CO2 加氢的掺杂 ZrO2 催化剂的筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dopants can tune the activity of zirconia-based CO₂ hydrogenation catalysts through changes in adsorbate and transition-state (TS) energetics. Computing these quantities with density functional theory (DFT) becomes expensive when several dopants, reaction intermediates, and TSs must be screened. Here, we further develop the graph-based machine learning method Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman Gaussian Process Regression (WWL-GPR): we introduce additional electronic-structure and local-environment features relevant for oxide surfaces and use the resulting model to predict adsorption and TS energies on ZrO₂(101) surfaces doped with Al³⁺, Cd²⁺, Ga³⁺, In³⁺, and Zn²⁺. Adsorbate-surface structures are represented as attributed graphs that combine bonds connectivity and features. We benchmark WWL-GPR against thermodynamic scaling relations (TSR) for reaction intermediates and Bronsted-Evans-Polanyi relations (BEP) for TSs, and then propagate the predicted energies to microkinetic CH₃OH-yield estimates. WWL-GPR consistently improves the prediction of reaction intermediate energetics relative to linear scaling approaches and provides TS estimates that are competitive with BEP-based models. These improvements become especially relevant when the predicted energetics are propagated through the reaction network. Microkinetic calculations show that WWL-GPR-derived energies give CH₃OH yields closer to DFT-derived yields than the linear-relation workflow. Degree-of-rate-control analysis links the activity errors to dopant-dependent rate-controlling steps, including HCOO* formation, H₂COOH* dissociation, and H₃CO* formation. These results support WWL-GPR as a data-efficient surrogate for connecting atomistic energetics with catalyst-screening observables on doped oxide surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 掺杂剂可以通过吸附质和过渡态 (TS) 能量的变化来调节氧化锆基 CO2 加氢催化剂的活性。当必须筛选多种掺杂剂、反应中间体和 TS 时，使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算这些量变得昂贵。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 掺杂剂可以通过吸附质和过渡态 (TS) 能量的变化来调节氧化锆基 CO2 加氢催化剂的活性。当必须筛选多种掺杂剂、反应中间体和 TS 时，使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算这些量变得昂贵。在这里，我们进一步开发了基于图的机器学习方法 Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman 高斯过程回归 (WWL-GPR)：我们引入了与氧化物表面相关的附加电子结构和局部环境特征，并使用所得模型来预测掺杂 Al3⁺、Cd2⁺、Ga3⁺、In3⁺ 和 Zn2⁺ 的 ZrO2(101) 表面上的吸附和 TS 能量。吸附物表面结构表示为结合了键连接性和特征的属性图。我们将 WWL-GPR 与反应中间体的热力学标度关系 (TSR) 和 TS 的布朗斯台德-埃文斯-波兰尼关系 (BEP) 进行基准测试，然后将预测的能量传播到微动力学 CH₃OH 产率估计。相对于线性标度方法，WWL-GPR 持续改进了反应中间体能量学的预测，并提供了与基于 BEP 的模型相媲美的 TS 估计。当预测的能量通过反应网络传播时，这些改进变得尤其重要。微动力学计算表明，与线性关系工作流程相比，WWL-GPR 衍生的能量使 CH₃OH 产率更接近 DFT 衍生的产率。速率控制程度分析将活度误差与掺杂剂相关的速率控制步骤联系起来，包括 HCOO* 形成、H2COOH* 解离和 H₃CO* 形成。这些结果支持 WWL-GPR 作为一种数据高效的替代品，用于将原子能量学与掺杂氧化物表面上的催化剂筛选可观测值联系起来。

articles.title: Potential energy release rate for solids with bounded domains during evolutions involving changes to boundaries and boundary data
articles.title_zh: 涉及边界和边界数据变化的演化过程中具有有界域的固体的势能释放率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13874v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the rate of change of equilibrium potential energy for nonlinear elastic solids undergoing evolutions that may involve changes in body geometry, material properties, applied tractions, and prescribed displacements. We represent such an evolution by a one-parameter family of variational problems and identify a class of these families for which the potential-energy release rate is well defined. Particular attention is given to the formulation of the potential energy at each evolution state: each constituent variational problem must yield the appropriate equilibrium state, while its equilibrium value must also correctly represent the physical change in potential energy between states. Within this framework, we derive a closed-form expression for the potential-energy release rate for solids with bounded domains, allowing for spatially nonuniform material evolution, sharp material interfaces, and evolving boundary geometry and prescribed boundary data. The expression is determined entirely by the equilibrium solution at the state under consideration and by the quantities prescribing the local evolution, so neighboring equilibrium problems need not be solved. Finally, we apply the result to the extension of a notch in a two-dimensional elastic body and show that the resulting potential-energy release rate reduces to the classical J-integral.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究非线性弹性固体在演化过程中平衡势能的变化率，这些演化可能涉及物体几何形状、材料特性、施加的牵引力和规定位移的变化。我们用单参数变分问题族来表示这种演化，并确定了这些族中的一类，其势能释放率被明确定义。特别注意每个演化状态下势能的公式：每个组成变分问题必须产生适当的平衡状态，而其平衡值也必须正确表示状态之间势能的物理变化。在此框架内，我们推导出具有有界域的固体势能释放率的封闭式表达式，允许空间上不均匀的材料演化、尖锐的材料界面以及不断演化的边界几何形状和规定的边界数据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究非线性弹性固体在演化过程中平衡势能的变化率，这些演化可能涉及物体几何形状、材料特性、施加的牵引力和规定位移的变化。我们用单参数变分问题族来表示这种演化，并确定了这些族中的一类，其势能释放率被明确定义。特别注意每个演化状态下势能的公式：每个组成变分问题必须产生适当的平衡状态，而其平衡值也必须正确表示状态之间势能的物理变化。在此框架内，我们推导出具有有界域的固体势能释放率的封闭式表达式，允许空间上不均匀的材料演化、尖锐的材料界面以及不断演化的边界几何形状和规定的边界数据。该表达式完全由所考虑状态的平衡解和规定局部演化的量决定，因此不需要求解邻近的平衡问题。最后，我们将结果应用于二维弹性体中缺口的延伸，并表明所得的势能释放率降低到经典的 J 积分。

articles.title: Quantum limit to transparency
articles.title_zh: 透明度的量子极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12560v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We argue that no material can be made completely transparent to light as long as it has a nontrivial index of refraction. The quantum decay of photons into phonons is an ineliminable source of attenuation. This survives even once all other excitations have been gapped away, impurities have been removed, and the temperature has been set to zero. Restricting for simplicity to the case of a superfluid, we determine via effective field theory methods the corresponding low-frequency contribution to the imaginary part of the index of refraction. This scales as ω⁴ and induces a nonanalyticity of the real part for ω → 0. We also extend our result to large coherent electromagnetic fields, such as those of a laser, showing that the effect can receive strong nonlinear enhancements. Our result is a genuine quantum lower bound to the transparency of a medium.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们认为，只要具有不平凡的折射率，就不可能使任何材料对光完全透明。光子到声子的量子衰变是不可消除的衰减源。即使所有其他激发都被消除、杂质被去除并且温度被设置为零，这种情况仍然存在。为了简单起见，仅限于超流体的情况，我们通过有效场论方法确定对折射率虚部的相应低频贡献。这个比例为 ω⁴ 并导致 ω → 0 实部的非解析性。我们还将我们的结果扩展到大的相干电磁场，例如激光场，表明该效应可以获得强烈的非线性增强。我们的结果是介质透明度的真正量子下界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们认为，只要具有不平凡的折射率，就不可能使任何材料对光完全透明。光子到声子的量子衰变是不可消除的衰减源。即使所有其他激发都被消除、杂质被去除并且温度被设置为零，这种情况仍然存在。为了简单起见，仅限于超流体的情况，我们通过有效场论方法确定对折射率虚部的相应低频贡献。这个比例为 ω⁴ 并导致 ω → 0 实部的非解析性。我们还将我们的结果扩展到大的相干电磁场，例如激光场，表明该效应可以获得强烈的非线性增强。我们的结果是介质透明度的真正量子下界。

articles.title: An all-transistor physical-learning transformer can be trained to perform in-context learning
articles.title_zh: 可以训练全晶体管物理学习变压器来执行上下文学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12571v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. We show that in simulations this circuit can be trained to perform a simple in-context learning task, despite using realistic reverse components which transmit only an approximate gradient. For this training to succeed we need cross-entropy loss (not mean squared error). We generate nudges appropriate for this loss using a novel floating circuit element, based on the same MOSFET sub-circuit used for softmax. We train the resistors in this circuit using the Lion optimiser, which can be implemented using one capacitor per parameter to store local memory of past gradient estimates.
articles.abstract_zh: 大多数通过平衡传播或耦合学习训练的系统与多层感知器属于同一类：虽然它们可能是通用函数逼近器，但它们很难学习对于变换器来说很容易的关联任务。平衡传播依赖于输入和输出之间通过物理系统的双向信息流。反向流被更复杂的非线性系统打破，例如那些执行表达点积注意力所需的乘法的系统。在这里，我们通过为此目的将额外的电路元件引入双或二元电路来明确地恢复这种双向流。然后，我们利用这些想法构建了一个利用亚阈值 MOSFET 器件的指数电流定律的注意力机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大多数通过平衡传播或耦合学习训练的系统与多层感知器属于同一类：虽然它们可能是通用函数逼近器，但它们很难学习对于变换器来说很容易的关联任务。平衡传播依赖于输入和输出之间通过物理系统的双向信息流。反向流被更复杂的非线性系统打破，例如那些执行表达点积注意力所需的乘法的系统。在这里，我们通过为此目的将额外的电路元件引入双或二元电路来明确地恢复这种双向流。然后，我们利用这些想法构建了一个利用亚阈值 MOSFET 器件的指数电流定律的注意力机制。我们表明，在模拟中，尽管使用仅传输近似梯度的真实反向组件，但可以训练该电路来执行简单的上下文学习任务。为了使训练成功，我们需要交叉熵损失（不是均方误差）。我们使用一种新颖的浮动电路元件生成适合这种损失的微调，该元件基于用于 softmax 的相同 MOSFET 子电路。我们使用 Lion 优化器训练该电路中的电阻器，可以使用每个参数一个电容器来存储过去梯度估计的本地存储器来实现。

articles.title: Predictive Synthesis of MOFs and COFs
articles.title_zh: MOF 和 COF 的预测合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12739v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predictive synthesis concerns the prospective modeling of how a targeted structure can be realized. The synthesis of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) and covalent organic frameworks (COFs) intrinsically involves a multidimensional space of interdependent variables, posing a challenge for bench chemists to parameterize and predict. In this Perspective, we discuss the evolution from chemical-intuition-driven experimentation toward the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in the laboratory. By virtue of prior knowledge, uncertainty, and experimental failure in determining what should be attempted next, we envision predictive synthesis progressing from static recipe recommendation toward real-time control and transferable principles of framework formation. In this context, the significance lies in transforming trial-and-error practice into a means of measurable chemical reasoning, thereby accelerating crystalline materials discovery and advancing synthetic chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测综合涉及如何实现目标结构的前瞻性建模。金属有机框架（MOF）和共价有机框架（COF）的合成本质上涉及相互依赖变量的多维空间，这对实验室化学家的参数化和预测提出了挑战。在本视角中，我们讨论了从化学直觉驱动的实验到实验室中人工智能 (AI) 和机器学习 (ML) 集成的演变。凭借先验知识、不确定性和确定下一步应该尝试什么的实验失败，我们设想预测综合从静态配方推荐发展到实时控制和框架形成的可转移原则。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测综合涉及如何实现目标结构的前瞻性建模。金属有机框架（MOF）和共价有机框架（COF）的合成本质上涉及相互依赖变量的多维空间，这对实验室化学家的参数化和预测提出了挑战。在本视角中，我们讨论了从化学直觉驱动的实验到实验室中人工智能 (AI) 和机器学习 (ML) 集成的演变。凭借先验知识、不确定性和确定下一步应该尝试什么的实验失败，我们设想预测综合从静态配方推荐发展到实时控制和框架形成的可转移原则。在此背景下，其意义在于将试错实践转变为可测量的化学推理手段，从而加速晶体材料的发现并推进合成化学。

articles.title: Analog quantum simulation of Shastry-Sutherland Ising materials
articles.title_zh: Shastry-Sutherland Ising 材料的模拟量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12800v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Frustrated magnets host rich emergent behavior because competing interactions generate dense manifolds of low-energy states. The Ising Shastry-Sutherland model is a paradigmatic setting, motivated experimentally by Ising-like rare-earth tetraborides such as TmB₄ and ErB₄, whose field-induced magnetization plateaus have motivated extensive microscopic modeling. Yet how tunable quantum fluctuations reorganize this material-motivated phase diagram remains largely unexplored. Here, we realize a transverse- and longitudinal-field Ising model on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice using a programmable Rydberg-atom array. We map its quantum phase diagram using density matrix renormalization group calculations and probe corresponding signatures experimentally in arrays containing more than 110 atoms. Beyond the established classical phases, the calculations identify two regimes absent in the classical limit and stabilized at finite transverse field: a 2/5 filling plateau whose finite stability region emerges from a classically degenerate phase boundary and a symmetry-preserving quantum-dimer regime replacing classically selected collinear order. Experiments on finite open arrays reveal signatures consistent with these regimes across three boundary-pinning conditions, with the resulting response maps agreeing qualitatively with the calculated phase diagram. Our results establish programmable Rydberg-atom arrays as tools for exploring frustrated, material-motivated Hamiltonians and motivate searches for new, quantum-driven magnetization plateaus and quantum-dimer behavior in ErB₄ under a transverse field or in strain-tuned TmB₄.
articles.abstract_zh: 受挫的磁体具有丰富的涌现行为，因为竞争相互作用会产生密集的低能态流形。 Ising Shastry-Sutherland 模型是一个范例设置，由 TmB₄ 和 ErB₄ 等类似 Ising 的稀土四硼化物实验激发，其场致磁化平台激发了广泛的微观建模。然而，可调谐量子涨落如何重组这种材料驱动的相图在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们使用可编程里德堡原子阵列在 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上实现了横向和纵向场伊辛模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受挫的磁体具有丰富的涌现行为，因为竞争相互作用会产生密集的低能态流形。 Ising Shastry-Sutherland 模型是一个范例设置，由 TmB₄ 和 ErB₄ 等类似 Ising 的稀土四硼化物实验激发，其场致磁化平台激发了广泛的微观建模。然而，可调谐量子涨落如何重组这种材料驱动的相图在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们使用可编程里德堡原子阵列在 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上实现了横向和纵向场伊辛模型。我们使用密度矩阵重正化群计算绘制其量子相图，并在包含超过 110 个原子的阵列中通过实验探测相应的特征。除了已建立的经典相之外，计算还确定了经典极限中不存在且在有限横向场下稳定的两种状态：2/5 填充平台，其有限稳定区域从经典简并相边界中出现，以及对称性保持的量子二聚体状态取代了经典选择的共线顺序。有限开放阵列的实验揭示了在三个边界钉扎条件下与这些状态一致的特征，所得的响应图与计算的相图定性地一致。我们的结果建立了可编程里德堡原子阵列作为探索受挫的、材料驱动的哈密顿量的工具，并激发了对横向场或应变调谐 TmB₄ 下 ErB₄ 中新的量子驱动磁化平台和量子二聚体行为的搜索。

articles.title: Alter-excitons in Altermagnets: Symmetry, Splitting and Dispersion
articles.title_zh: 交变磁体中的交变激子：对称性、分裂和色散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12900v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetism provides a fertile platform for discovering emergent quantum phenomena governed by symmetry. Recent developments of spin-space-group (SSG) theory have revealed altermagnets as a distinct class of nonrelativistic collinear magnets with unconventional spin-dependent electronic structures. Here, we demonstrate that altermagnetic symmetry imposes fundamentally different constraints on electronic and excitonic excitations. Although the quasiparticle and two-body Hamiltonians possess identical SSG symmetries, we find that symmetry-protected degeneracies present in the electronic band structure can be intrinsically lifted in the exciton spectrum at specific momenta. This splitting arises solely from the many-body nature of excitons and does not require spin-orbit coupling or noncollinear magnetic order. Combining symmetry analysis with many-body perturbation theory, we predict a novel class of spin-split excitonic quasiparticles, termed alter-excitons, and reveal their characteristic dispersions in altermagnetic systems. Our results establish excitons as a sensitive probe of hidden spin-space symmetries and uncover a new route toward symmetry-engineered many-body phenomena in collinear magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性为发现受对称性支配的新兴量子现象提供了丰富的平台。自旋空间群（SSG）理论的最新发展揭示了交替磁体是一类独特的非相对论共线磁体，具有非常规的自旋相关电子结构。在这里，我们证明交变磁对称性对电子和激子激发施加了根本不同的约束。尽管准粒子和二体哈密顿量具有相同的 SSG 对称性，但我们发现电子能带结构中存在的对称保护简并性可以在特定动量的激子谱中本质上被提升。这种分裂仅由激子的多体性质引起，不需要自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性为发现受对称性支配的新兴量子现象提供了丰富的平台。自旋空间群（SSG）理论的最新发展揭示了交替磁体是一类独特的非相对论共线磁体，具有非常规的自旋相关电子结构。在这里，我们证明交变磁对称性对电子和激子激发施加了根本不同的约束。尽管准粒子和二体哈密顿量具有相同的 SSG 对称性，但我们发现电子能带结构中存在的对称保护简并性可以在特定动量的激子谱中本质上被提升。这种分裂仅由激子的多体性质引起，不需要自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序。将对称分析与多体微扰理论相结合，我们预测了一类新型的自旋分裂激子准粒子，称为交变激子，并揭示了它们在交变磁系统中的特征色散。我们的研究结果将激子确立为隐藏自旋空间对称性的敏感探针，并揭示了共线磁体中对称工程多体现象的新途径。

articles.title: Zak Phase Quantization without Global Symmetry through Destructive Interference
articles.title_zh: 通过相消干涉实现无全局对称性的 Zak 相位量化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13250v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Zak phase provides a fundamental geometric characterization of one-dimensional band structures and, when quantized by symmetry, serves as a bulk indicator of polarization and boundary phenomena. Conventionally, its exact quantization is tied to a global symmetry of the Bloch Hamiltonian, such as inversion or reflection symmetry. Here, we demonstrate a distinct mechanism by which the Zak phase remains exactly quantized even when the corresponding protecting symmetry is explicitly broken at the level of the full Hamiltonian. The mechanism is based on local support symmetry and destructive interference: symmetry-breaking degrees of freedom are coupled to a topological parent system in such a way that the relevant Bloch states cannot leak into them. The preserved states therefore retain their parent wave functions and inherit their quantized Zak phase exactly, despite the absence of the protecting global symmetry. We establish this mechanism for general one-dimensional insulators and demonstrate it in an inversion-broken minimal model and a reflection-broken armchair nanoribbon, where a quantized π Zak phase and associated boundary-localized states persist. We further show that perturbations violating the exact destructive-interference condition continuously dequantize the Zak phase, while a finite regime with a near-π Zak phase and boundary response can survive. Our results establish wave-function support, rather than global symmetry alone, as a mechanism for protecting quantized quantum geometry in one-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: Zak 相提供了一维能带结构的基本几何特征，并且当通过对称性量化时，可用作偏振和边界现象的体指示剂。传统上，其精确量化与布洛赫哈密顿量的全局对称性相关，例如反演或反射对称性。在这里，我们证明了一种独特的机制，即使相应的保护对称性在完整哈密顿量的水平上被明确破缺，Zak 相位也能保持精确的量子化。该机制基于局部支持对称性和破坏性干涉：对称破缺自由度以相关布洛赫态无法泄漏到其中的方式耦合到拓扑父系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Zak 相提供了一维能带结构的基本几何特征，并且当通过对称性量化时，可用作偏振和边界现象的体指示剂。传统上，其精确量化与布洛赫哈密顿量的全局对称性相关，例如反演或反射对称性。在这里，我们证明了一种独特的机制，即使相应的保护对称性在完整哈密顿量的水平上被明确破缺，Zak 相位也能保持精确的量子化。该机制基于局部支持对称性和破坏性干涉：对称破缺自由度以相关布洛赫态无法泄漏到其中的方式耦合到拓扑父系统。因此，尽管缺乏保护全局对称性，保留的态仍保留其父波函数并准确继承其量化的 Zak 相位。我们为一般一维绝缘体建立了这种机制，并在反演破坏最小模型和反射破坏扶手椅纳米带中进行了演示，其中量子化 π Zak 相位和相关的边界局域态持续存在。我们进一步表明，违反精确破坏性干扰条件的扰动会不断使 Zak 相位去量化，而具有近 π Zak 相位和边界响应的有限状态可以保留。我们的结果建立了波函数支持，而不仅仅是全局对称性，作为保护一维系统中量子几何的机制。

articles.title: Aubry-André transition in photonic time quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 光子时间准晶体中的奥布里-安德烈跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13538v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In one dimension, Anderson localization by a disordered potential sets in at any strength, whereas localization by a quasiperiodic potential in the Aubry-André model occurs through a transition at a critical strength. Disordered photonic time crystals exhibit a temporal counterpart of this Anderson localization, in which light, instead of decaying in space, stops propagating and grows in time. Whether a counterpart of the Aubry-André transition exists in photonic time quasicrystals remains an open question. Here we show that it does, and that the transition occurs at mobility edges in momentum rather than in energy. These edges arise even under impulsive modulation, where the field obeys the self-dual almost-Mathieu equation exactly, and for general analytic modulations Avila's global theory reveals the condition under which they form. The Aubry-André transition thus extends from spatial lattices to the time domain, where it sorts light by wave number into components that propagate and components that stop and grow.
articles.abstract_zh: 在一个维度中，安德森定位通过无序势在任何强度处开始，而奥布里-安德烈模型中准周期势的定位通过临界强度的转变发生。无序的光子时间晶体表现出安德森局域化的时间对应物，其中光不是在空间中衰减，而是停止传播并在时间中增长。光子时间准晶体中是否存在奥布里-安德烈跃迁的对应物仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们证明确实如此，并且转变发生在动量而不是能量的迁移边缘。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在一个维度中，安德森定位通过无序势在任何强度处开始，而奥布里-安德烈模型中准周期势的定位通过临界强度的转变发生。无序的光子时间晶体表现出安德森局域化的时间对应物，其中光不是在空间中衰减，而是停止传播并在时间中增长。光子时间准晶体中是否存在奥布里-安德烈跃迁的对应物仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们证明确实如此，并且转变发生在动量而不是能量的迁移边缘。即使在脉冲调制下，这些边缘也会出现，其中场严格遵守自对偶马蒂厄方程，并且对于一般解析调制，阿维拉的全局理论揭示了它们形成的条件。因此，奥布里-安德烈跃迁从空间晶格延伸到时域，在时域中，它按波数将光分类为传播的分量和停止并生长的分量。

articles.title: Anomaly induced transport in holographic superconductors
articles.title_zh: 全息超导体中的异常诱导输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13727v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the anomaly-induced transport properties of a holographic superconductor exhibiting spontaneous symmetry breaking. The holographic model incorporates vector and axial gauge fields, an additional non-anomalous U(1) symmetry, and a charged scalar field that drives the phase transition. Working in the probe limit, we numerically construct the superconducting background under two alternative scalar field quantizations, corresponding to operators with scaling dimensions Δ=1 and Δ=3 (denoted as the O₁ and O₂ theories, respectively). Using Kubo formulae, we compute the chiral magnetic conductivities and examine their response to the scalar condensate. Our findings demonstrate that spontaneous symmetry breaking allows anomaly-induced transport to extend beyond anomalous currents, significantly impacting the non-anomalous sector as well. Remarkably, this effect appears in both theories, indicating that the influence on the non-anomalous sector is independent of the chosen quantization. The comparison of our numerical results with the analytical limits for Oᵢ → 0 and Oᵢ → infty (i=1,2) reveals consistent behavior across both theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了表现出自发对称破缺的全息超导体的异常诱导输运特性。全息模型包含矢量和轴向规范场、附加的非反常 U(1) 对称性以及驱动相变的带电标量场。在探测极限下，我们在两个替代标量场量子化下以数值方式构造超导背景，对应于缩放维数 Δ=1 和 Δ=3 的算子（分别表示为 O₁ 和 O2 理论）。使用 Kubo 公式，我们计算手性磁导率并检查它们对标量凝聚的响应。我们的研究结果表明，自发对称性破缺使得异常引起的传输能够扩展到异常电流之外，从而对非异常区域产生重大影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了表现出自发对称破缺的全息超导体的异常诱导输运特性。全息模型包含矢量和轴向规范场、附加的非反常 U(1) 对称性以及驱动相变的带电标量场。在探测极限下，我们在两个替代标量场量子化下以数值方式构造超导背景，对应于缩放维数 Δ=1 和 Δ=3 的算子（分别表示为 O₁ 和 O2 理论）。使用 Kubo 公式，我们计算手性磁导率并检查它们对标量凝聚的响应。我们的研究结果表明，自发对称性破缺使得异常引起的传输能够扩展到异常电流之外，从而对非异常区域产生重大影响。值得注意的是，这种效应出现在两种理论中，表明对非异常部分的影响与所选的量化无关。我们的数值结果与 Oᵢ → 0 和 Oᵢ → infty (i=1,2) 的分析极限的比较揭示了两种理论的一致行为。

articles.title: Utilizing Neural Networks for Solving Functional Renormalization Group Flow Equations
articles.title_zh: 利用神经网络求解函数重整化群流方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13754v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A novel physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) based approach for solving functional renormalization group flow equations is presented. We investigate the finite temperature phase transition in O(N) models without relying on the large-N approximation, which was used in earlier attempts with similar methods. We argue that these previous solutions cannot easily be generalized for more complex symmetries, and hence our approach can provide new insight. Our technique relies on a series of ansätze that combines the small- and large-field approximation schemes with a neural network, leading to a highly accurate approximation over the entire field range. We compare the PINNs approach with traditional grid-based Runge-Kutta results and show that the network can successfully learn the temperature, field, and scale dependencies of the effective potential in the local potential approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的新颖方法来求解函数重整化群流方程。我们研究了 O(N) 模型中的有限温度相变，而不依赖于大 N 近似，该近似在早期尝试中使用过类似的方法。我们认为，这些先前的解决方案不能轻易地推广到更复杂的对称性，因此我们的方法可以提供新的见解。我们的技术依赖于一系列将小场和大场近似方案与神经网络相结合的 ansätze，从而在整个场范围内实现高度准确的近似。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的新颖方法来求解函数重整化群流方程。我们研究了 O(N) 模型中的有限温度相变，而不依赖于大 N 近似，该近似在早期尝试中使用过类似的方法。我们认为，这些先前的解决方案不能轻易地推广到更复杂的对称性，因此我们的方法可以提供新的见解。我们的技术依赖于一系列将小场和大场近似方案与神经网络相结合的 ansätze，从而在整个场范围内实现高度准确的近似。我们将 PINNs 方法与传统的基于网格的 Runge-Kutta 结果进行比较，并表明网络可以成功学习局部势近似中有效势的温度、场和尺度依赖性。

articles.title: Modular Properties of Generalised Gibbs Ensembles: The Deformed KdV Hierarchy
articles.title_zh: 广义吉布斯系综的模属性：变形的 KdV 层次结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13875v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct a set of conserved charges which are deformations of quantum KdV charges. They are associated with the modular transformation of a GGE with the spin-σ KdV charge inserted with chemical potential α_σ. The charges are formal power series in the chemical potential, with coefficients given by local integrals of motion. We define local recursion relations and equivalent flow equations, prove commutativity to all orders, and establish uniqueness of the currents modulo total derivatives for a fixed generating series. We show that the eigenvalues of these deformed charges can be obtained from the thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz in two models. In the c=1/2 free fermion theory, the deformed charges reduce to explicit linear combinations of undeformed KdV charges, and their ground-state eigenvalues agree with the TBA expansion to all orders. In the Lee-Yang model, we find numerical agreement through cubic order in the spin-5 deformation for the first few charges evaluated on low-lying states.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一组守恒电荷，它们是量子 KdV 电荷的变形。它们与插入化学势 α_σ 的自旋 σ KdV 电荷的 GGE 的模变换相关。电荷是化学势的形式幂级数，其系数由局部运动积分给出。我们定义局部递归关系和等效流动方程，证明所有阶的交换性，并建立固定生成级数的电流模全导数的唯一性。我们证明这些变形电荷的特征值可以从两个模型中的热力学 Bethe Ansatz 获得。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了一组守恒电荷，它们是量子 KdV 电荷的变形。它们与插入化学势 α_σ 的自旋 σ KdV 电荷的 GGE 的模变换相关。电荷是化学势的形式幂级数，其系数由局部运动积分给出。我们定义局部递归关系和等效流动方程，证明所有阶的交换性，并建立固定生成级数的电流模全导数的唯一性。我们证明这些变形电荷的特征值可以从两个模型中的热力学 Bethe Ansatz 获得。在c=1/2自由费米子理论中，变形电荷简化为未变形KdV电荷的显式线性组合，并且它们的基态特征值与所有阶的TBA展开一致。在 Lee-Yang 模型中，我们发现在低位态评估的前几个电荷的自旋 5 变形中通过立方阶的数值一致。

articles.title: Domain-wall circulation gating and pinning via compositional engineering of cylindrical nanowires
articles.title_zh: 通过圆柱形纳米线的组合工程实现畴壁循环选通和钉扎
articles.abstract: arXiv:2405.00652v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spintronic devices based on cylindrical magnetic nanowires have been proposed as a route toward three-dimensional information storage and processing by harnessing the controlled motion of domain walls (DWs). In this geometry, the Bloch-point wall (BPW) is the characteristic DW type. It features a curling of magnetization around a Bloch Point singularity, a topology that has been predicted to enable propagation at high speed without undergoing a Walker breakdown. We demonstrate that compositional modulations of larger magnetization, which host spontaneous curling states while the rest of the wire remains axial, fulfil a dual role: they act as deterministic pinning sites and as active gates for BPW circulation. Combining magnetic transmission X-ray microscopy and micromagnetic simulations, we reveal that DW-modulation interactions are the result of a superposition of long-range magnetostatic repulsion and short-range, circulation-dependent exchange contributions: parallel circulation produces an attractive well, while opposite circulation generates a repulsive barrier. This results in DW pinning at or near a compositional modulation. A DW's internal circulation can be inverted upon traversing a modulation, enabling on-demand switching of its circulation state. This dual mechanism demonstrates that both DW position and circulation can be tuned in a controlled manner, with potential implications for multistate spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于圆柱形磁性纳米线的自旋电子器件已被提出作为通过利用磁畴壁（DW）的受控运动来实现三维信息存储和处理的途径。在此几何结构中，布洛赫点墙 (BPW) 是典型的 DW 类型。它具有围绕布洛赫点奇点的磁化卷曲，这种拓扑结构预计可以实现高速传播而不会发生沃克击穿。我们证明，较大磁化强度的成分调制（其具有自发卷曲状态，而线的其余部分保持轴向）具有双重作用：它们充当确定性钉扎位点和 BPW 循环的主动门。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于圆柱形磁性纳米线的自旋电子器件已被提出作为通过利用磁畴壁（DW）的受控运动来实现三维信息存储和处理的途径。在此几何结构中，布洛赫点墙 (BPW) 是典型的 DW 类型。它具有围绕布洛赫点奇点的磁化卷曲，这种拓扑结构预计可以实现高速传播而不会发生沃克击穿。我们证明，较大磁化强度的成分调制（其具有自发卷曲状态，而线的其余部分保持轴向）具有双重作用：它们充当确定性钉扎位点和 BPW 循环的主动门。结合磁透射 X 射线显微镜和微磁模拟，我们揭示了 DW 调制相互作用是长程静磁斥力和短程、依赖环流的交换贡献叠加的结果：平行环流产生吸引势垒，而反向环流产生排斥势垒。这导致 DW 固定在或接近合成调制。 DW 的内部循环可以在遍历调制时反转，从而实现其循环状态的按需切换。这种双重机制表明，DW 位置和循环都可以以受控方式进行调整，这对多态自旋电子器件具有潜在影响。

articles.title: Electric-Field Driven Nuclear Dynamics of Liquids and Solids from a Multi-Valued Machine-Learned Dipolar Model
articles.title_zh: 来自多值机器学习偶极模型的电场驱动液体和固体核动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.02413v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The driving of vibrational motion by external electric fields is a topic of continued interest, due to the possibility of assessing new or metastable material phases with desirable properties. Here, we combine ab initio molecular dynamics within the electric-dipole approximation with machine-learning neural networks (NNs) to develop a general, efficient and accurate method to perform electric-field-driven nuclear dynamics for molecules, solids, and liquids. We train equivariant and autodifferentiable NNs for the interatomic potential and the dipole, modifying the model infrastructure to account for the multi-valued nature of the latter in periodic systems. We showcase the method by addressing property modifications induced by electric field interactions in a polar liquid and a polar solid from nanosecond-long molecular dynamics simulations with quantum-mechanical accuracy. For liquid water, we present a calculation of the dielectric function in the GHz to THz range and the electrofreezing transition, showing that nuclear quantum effects enhance this phenomenon. For the ferroelectric perovskite LiNbO₃, we simulate the ferroelectric to paraelectric phase transition and the non-equilibrium dynamics of driven phonon modes related to the polarization switching mechanisms, showing that a full polarization switch is not achieved in the simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于可以评估具有所需特性的新的或亚稳态的材料相，因此外部电场驱动振动运动是人们持续关注的话题。在这里，我们将电偶极近似中的从头算分子动力学与机器学习神经网络 (NN) 相结合，开发出一种通用、高效且准确的方法来对分子、固体和液体执行电场驱动的核动力学。我们针对原子间势和偶极子训练等变和自微神经网络，修改模型基础设施以考虑后者在周期系统中的多值性质。我们通过具有量子力学精度的纳秒长分子动力学模拟来解决极性液体和极性固体中电场相互作用引起的性质变化，从而展示了该方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于可以评估具有所需特性的新的或亚稳态的材料相，因此外部电场驱动振动运动是人们持续关注的话题。在这里，我们将电偶极近似中的从头算分子动力学与机器学习神经网络 (NN) 相结合，开发出一种通用、高效且准确的方法来对分子、固体和液体执行电场驱动的核动力学。我们针对原子间势和偶极子训练等变和自微神经网络，修改模型基础设施以考虑后者在周期系统中的多值性质。我们通过具有量子力学精度的纳秒长分子动力学模拟来解决极性液体和极性固体中电场相互作用引起的性质变化，从而展示了该方法。对于液态水，我们对 GHz 至 THz 范围内的介电函数和电冻结转变进行了计算，表明核量子效应增强了这种现象。对于铁电钙钛矿LiNbO₃，我们模拟了铁电到顺电的相变以及与偏振切换机制相关的驱动声子模式的非平衡动力学，表明在模拟中没有实现完全的偏振切换。

articles.title: Emergence of the electronic states driven by quantum charge fluctuations in electron doped cuprate superconductors
articles.title_zh: 电子掺杂铜酸盐超导体中量子电荷涨落驱动的电子态的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.12639v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The origin of electron-boson interactions is central to understanding high-T_c superconductivity in cuprates. While phonons and magnetic fluctuations are widely considered as candidates for mediating electron pairing, the role of charge fluctuations, one of the fundamental electronic degrees of freedom, remains unclear. Here, we investigate the electronic structure of the electron-doped cuprate using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and angle-resolved and resonant inverse photoemission spectroscopies, which reveal the electronic structure in the occupied and unoccupied states, respectively. From these spectroscopic experiments, we find emergent spectral features on both occupied and unoccupied states that are consistent with excitations driven by quantum charge fluctuations. The results obtained in this study offer direct experimental insight into charge fluctuations in cuprates, thereby paving the way towards clarifying the electronic structure of cuprates to understand the mechanism of high-T_c superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子-玻色子相互作用的起源对于理解铜酸盐的高温超导性至关重要。虽然声子和磁涨落被广泛认为是介导电子配对的候选者，但电荷涨落（基本电子自由度之一）的作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用角分辨光电子能谱以及角分辨和共振逆光电子能谱研究了电子掺杂铜酸盐的电子结构，分别揭示了占据态和未占据态的电子结构。从这些光谱实验中，我们发现占据态和未占据态上出现的光谱特征与量子电荷波动驱动的激发一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子-玻色子相互作用的起源对于理解铜酸盐的高温超导性至关重要。虽然声子和磁涨落被广泛认为是介导电子配对的候选者，但电荷涨落（基本电子自由度之一）的作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用角分辨光电子能谱以及角分辨和共振逆光电子能谱研究了电子掺杂铜酸盐的电子结构，分别揭示了占据态和未占据态的电子结构。从这些光谱实验中，我们发现占据态和未占据态上出现的光谱特征与量子电荷波动驱动的激发一致。本研究获得的结果为铜酸盐中的电荷波动提供了直接的实验见解，从而为阐明铜酸盐的电子结构以了解高温超导机制铺平了道路。

articles.title: Specific-heat anomaly in frustrated magnets with vacancy defects
articles.title_zh: 具有空位缺陷的受挫磁体的比热异常
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.17392v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by frustrated magnets and spin-liquid-candidate materials, we study the thermodynamics of a 2D geometrically frustrated magnet with vacancy defects. The presence of vacancies imposes significant constraints on the bulk spins, which freeze some of the degrees of freedom in the system at low temperatures. With increasing temperature, these constraints get relaxed, resulting in an increase in the system's entropy. This leads to the emergence of a peak in the heat capacity C(T) of the magnet at a temperature T_imp determined by the concentration of the vacancy defects. The entropy associated with this peak comes from the lowest-energy degrees of freedom in the material. To illustrate the emergence of such an anomaly, we compute analytically the heat capacity of the antiferromagnetic (AFM) Ising model on the triangular lattice with vacancy defects. The presence of the vacancy leads to a peak in C(T) at the temperature T_imp=-4J/ln n_imp, where J is the AFM coupling between the spins and n_imp is the fraction of the missing sites.
articles.abstract_zh: 在受挫磁体和自旋液体候选材料的推动下，我们研究了具有空位缺陷的二维几何受挫磁体的热力学。空位的存在对整体自旋施加了显着的限制，从而在低温下冻结了系统中的一些自由度。随着温度的升高，这些约束得到放松，导致系统的熵增加。这导致磁体的热容量C(T)在由空位缺陷的浓度确定的温度T_imp处出现峰值。与该峰值相关的熵来自材料中最低能量的自由度。为了说明这种异常现象的出现，我们分析计算了具有空位缺陷的三角形晶格上的反铁磁 (AFM) 伊辛模型的热容。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在受挫磁体和自旋液体候选材料的推动下，我们研究了具有空位缺陷的二维几何受挫磁体的热力学。空位的存在对整体自旋施加了显着的限制，从而在低温下冻结了系统中的一些自由度。随着温度的升高，这些约束得到放松，导致系统的熵增加。这导致磁体的热容量C(T)在由空位缺陷的浓度确定的温度T_imp处出现峰值。与该峰值相关的熵来自材料中最低能量的自由度。为了说明这种异常现象的出现，我们分析计算了具有空位缺陷的三角形晶格上的反铁磁 (AFM) 伊辛模型的热容。空位的存在导致 C(T) 在温度 T_imp=-4J/ln n_imp 处出现峰值，其中 J 是自旋之间的 AFM 耦合，n_imp 是缺失位点的分数。

articles.title: Anomalies of global symmetries on the lattice
articles.title_zh: 晶格上的全局对称性异常
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.21209v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: 't Hooft anomalies of global symmetries play a fundamental role in quantum many-body systems and quantum field theory (QFT). In this paper, we make a systematic analysis of lattice anomalies - the analog of 't Hooft anomalies in lattice systems - for which we give a precise definition. Crucially, a lattice anomaly is not a feature of a specific Hamiltonian, but rather is a topological invariant of the symmetry action. The controlled setting of lattice systems allows for a systematic and rigorous treatment of lattice anomalies, shorn of the technical challenges of QFT. We find that lattice anomalies reproduce the expected properties of QFT anomalies in many ways, but also have crucial differences. In particular, lattice anomalies and QFT anomalies are not, contrary to a common expectation, in one-to-one correspondence, and there can be nontrivial anomalies on the lattice that are infrared (IR) trivial: They admit symmetric trivial gapped ground states, and map to trivial QFT anomalies at low energies. Nevertheless, we show that lattice anomalies (including IR-trivial ones) have a number of interesting consequences in their own right, including connections to commuting projector models, phases of many-body localized (MBL) systems, and quantum cellular automata (QCA). We make substantial progress on the classification of lattice anomalies and develop several theoretical tools to characterize their consequences on symmetric Hamiltonians. Our work places symmetries of quantum many-body lattice systems into a unified theoretical framework and may also suggest new perspectives on symmetries in QFT.
articles.abstract_zh: 全局对称性的特霍夫特异常在量子多体系统和量子场论（QFT）中发挥着重要作用。在本文中，我们对晶格异常（类似于晶格系统中的特霍夫特异常）进行了系统分析，并给出了精确的定义。至关重要的是，晶格异常不是特定哈密顿量的特征，而是对称作用的拓扑不变量。晶格系统的受控设置可以对晶格异常进行系统且严格的处理，从而克服了 QFT 的技术挑战。我们发现晶格异常在很多方面再现了 QFT 异常的预期特性，但也存在重大差异。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全局对称性的特霍夫特异常在量子多体系统和量子场论（QFT）中发挥着重要作用。在本文中，我们对晶格异常（类似于晶格系统中的特霍夫特异常）进行了系统分析，并给出了精确的定义。至关重要的是，晶格异常不是特定哈密顿量的特征，而是对称作用的拓扑不变量。晶格系统的受控设置可以对晶格异常进行系统且严格的处理，从而克服了 QFT 的技术挑战。我们发现晶格异常在很多方面再现了 QFT 异常的预期特性，但也存在重大差异。特别是，与通常的预期相反，晶格异常和 QFT 异常并不是一一对应的，并且晶格上可能存在红外 (IR) 平凡的非平凡异常：它们承认对称平凡带隙基态，并映射到低能量下平凡 QFT 异常。尽管如此，我们表明晶格异常（包括红外微不足道的晶格异常）本身会产生许多有趣的后果，包括与通勤投影仪模型、多体局域（MBL）系统的阶段和量子细胞自动机（QCA）的联系。我们在晶格异常的分类方面取得了实质性进展，并开发了几种理论工具来表征它们对对称哈密顿量的影响。我们的工作将量子多体晶格系统的对称性置于统一的理论框架中，也可能为 QFT 中的对称性提出新的视角。

articles.title: Quantum Theory of Exciton Magnetic Moment: Interaction and Topological Effects
articles.title_zh: 激子磁矩的量子理论：相互作用和拓扑效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.07284v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Combining magnetometry with optical spectroscopy has uncovered novel quantum phenomena and is emerging as a powerful probe of quantum materials. However, the theory of the magnetic response of excitons, correlated electron-hole pairs in insulators, remains incomplete due to insufficient treatment of electron-hole interactions and quantum geometric effects. In biased bilayer graphene, for instance, theoretical predictions of valley g-factors for p-excitons deviate from experiment by nearly an order of magnitude. Here, we develop a quantum theory of the exciton orbital magnetic moment, based on first-order perturbation theory within the GW plus Bethe-Salpeter Equation approach and a rigorous treatment of the position operator in the response of exciton states to a magnetic field. Our formalism reveals three distinct contributions that go beyond the heuristic approaches used in the literature: a Berry-phase-corrected single-particle electron and hole moment difference, a term from envelope-function winding linked to electron-hole relative motion, and a center-of-mass correction from exciton band quantum geometry, with the latter two being completely new effects not considered in previous studies. Our ab initio calculations yield results in excellent agreement with experiment, establishing the importance of interaction and quantum geometric effects in the magnetic response of excitons.
articles.abstract_zh: 将磁力测量与光学光谱相结合发现了新颖的量子现象，并正在成为量子材料的强大探针。然而，由于对电子-空穴相互作用和量子几何效应的处理不充分，激子的磁响应理论（绝缘体中相关的电子-空穴对）仍然不完整。例如，在偏置双层石墨烯中，p 激子谷 g 因子的理论预测与实验偏差近一个数量级。在这里，我们基于 GW 内的一阶微扰理论加上 Bethe-Salpeter 方程方法以及激子态对磁场响应中的位置算符的严格处理，开发了激子轨道磁矩的量子理论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将磁力测量与光学光谱相结合发现了新颖的量子现象，并正在成为量子材料的强大探针。然而，由于对电子-空穴相互作用和量子几何效应的处理不充分，激子的磁响应理论（绝缘体中相关的电子-空穴对）仍然不完整。例如，在偏置双层石墨烯中，p 激子谷 g 因子的理论预测与实验偏差近一个数量级。在这里，我们基于 GW 内的一阶微扰理论加上 Bethe-Salpeter 方程方法以及激子态对磁场响应中的位置算符的严格处理，开发了激子轨道磁矩的量子理论。我们的形式主义揭示了超越文献中使用的启发式方法的三个独特贡献：贝里相位校正的单粒子电子和空穴矩差、与电子-空穴相对运动相关的包络函数缠绕的术语，以及激子带量子几何的质心校正，后两者是以前的研究中未考虑的全新效应。我们的从头计算得到的结果与实验非常吻合，确立了相互作用和量子几何效应在激子磁响应中的重要性。

articles.title: Deterministic domain selection of antiferromagnets via magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 通过磁场确定反铁磁体的域选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.06646v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFMs) hold promise for applications in digital logic. However, switching AFM domains is challenging, as magnetic fields do not couple to the bulk antiferromagnetic order parameter. Here we show that magnetic-field-driven switching of AFM domains can in many cases be enabled by a generic reduction of magnetic exchange at surfaces. We use statistical mechanics and Monte Carlo simulations to demonstrate that an inequivalence in magnetic exchange between top and bottom surface moments, combined with the enhanced magnetic susceptibility of surface spins, can enable deterministic selection of antiferromagnetic domains depending on the magnetic-field ramping direction. We further show that this mechanism provides a natural interpretation for experimental observations of hysteresis in magneto-optical response of the van der Waals AFM MnBi₂Te₄. Our findings highlight the critical role of surface spins in responses of antiferromagnets to magnetic fields. Furthermore, our results suggest that antiferromagnetic domain selection via purely magnetic means may be a more common and experimentally accessible phenomenon than previously assumed.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁体 (AFM) 有望在数字逻辑中得到应用。然而，切换 AFM 域具有挑战性，因为磁场不耦合到体反铁磁有序参数。在这里，我们表明，在许多情况下，磁场驱动的 AFM 域切换可以通过表面磁交换的一般减少来实现。我们使用统计力学和蒙特卡罗模拟来证明，顶部和底部表面矩之间磁交换的不等价性，再加上表面自旋增强的磁化率，可以根据磁场斜坡方向确定性地选择反铁磁域。我们进一步表明，这种机制为范德华原子力显微镜 MnBi2Te4 磁光响应中磁滞的实验观察提供了自然的解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体 (AFM) 有望在数字逻辑中得到应用。然而，切换 AFM 域具有挑战性，因为磁场不耦合到体反铁磁有序参数。在这里，我们表明，在许多情况下，磁场驱动的 AFM 域切换可以通过表面磁交换的一般减少来实现。我们使用统计力学和蒙特卡罗模拟来证明，顶部和底部表面矩之间磁交换的不等价性，再加上表面自旋增强的磁化率，可以根据磁场斜坡方向确定性地选择反铁磁域。我们进一步表明，这种机制为范德华原子力显微镜 MnBi2Te4 磁光响应中磁滞的实验观察提供了自然的解释。我们的研究结果强调了表面自旋在反铁磁体对磁场的响应中的关键作用。此外，我们的结果表明，通过纯磁性手段进行的反铁磁畴选择可能是比之前假设的更常见且实验上容易实现的现象。

articles.title: A Generalizable Machine Learning Framework for Half-Heusler Thermoelectrics
articles.title_zh: Half-Heusler 热电的通用机器学习框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.01149v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful approach for accelerating the discovery of thermoelectric (TE) materials, yet many models suffer from limited generalizability. Here we present a robust ML framework for predicting the thermoelectric figure of merit (zT) in half-Heusler (hH) compounds, emphasizing prediction of previously unseen compositions. A principal component analysis (PCA)-based train/test splitting strategy is introduced to generate representative partitions of chemical space. Bayesian hyperparameter optimization is combined with correlation-based k-best feature selection for Random Forest, XGBoost, and Neural Network models, together with the interpretable SISSO symbolic-regression method. Relative to the full set of 118 input features, the optimized feature subsets reduce the test RMSE by 16-27%. SHAP and SISSO analyses identify temperature, A-site dopant concentration, and A-site heat of vaporization as the most important descriptors of zT. The framework is validated through prediction of previously unexplored compositions, recovery of literature-reported optimal zT values for established hH systems, and first-principles calculations for the new compounds CeCoBi and CeIrBi, which exhibit favorable electronic transport properties. The framework is further applied to high-throughput screening of the doped hH chemical space, covering about 2.46 million elemental substitution combinations across 631 thermodynamically screened parent matrices under stability constraints. This screening yields a concise set of promising candidates for future study. Overall, the work establishes a generalizable workflow for reliable data-driven thermoelectric materials discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习 (ML) 已成为加速热电 (TE) 材料发现的强大方法，但许多模型的通用性有限。在这里，我们提出了一个强大的机器学习框架，用于预测 half-Heusler (hH) 化合物的热电品质因数 (zT)，强调预测以前未见过的成分。引入基于主成分分析（PCA）的训练/测试分割策略来生成化学空间的代表性分区。贝叶斯超参数优化与随机森林、XGBoost 和神经网络模型的基于相关性的 k 最佳特征选择以及可解释的 SISSO 符号回归方法相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习 (ML) 已成为加速热电 (TE) 材料发现的强大方法，但许多模型的通用性有限。在这里，我们提出了一个强大的机器学习框架，用于预测 half-Heusler (hH) 化合物的热电品质因数 (zT)，强调预测以前未见过的成分。引入基于主成分分析（PCA）的训练/测试分割策略来生成化学空间的代表性分区。贝叶斯超参数优化与随机森林、XGBoost 和神经网络模型的基于相关性的 k 最佳特征选择以及可解释的 SISSO 符号回归方法相结合。相对于全套 118 个输入特征，优化后的特征子集将测试 RMSE 降低了 16-27%。 SHAP 和 SISSO 分析将温度、A 位掺杂剂浓度和 A 位汽化热确定为 zT 最重要的描述符。该框架通过预测先前未探索的成分、恢复文献报道的已建立 hH 系统的最佳 zT 值以及新化合物 CeCoBi 和 CeIrBi 的第一原理计算来验证，这些化合物表现出良好的电子传输特性。该框架进一步应用于掺杂 hH 化学空间的高通量筛选，覆盖了稳定性约束下的 631 个热力学筛选母体中约 246 万个元素取代组合。这种筛选产生了一组简明的有前途的候选者供未来研究。总体而言，这项工作为可靠的数据驱动热电材料发现建立了一个通用的工作流程。

articles.title: Anomalous Edge Contrast in Magnetic Force Imaging of 2D Topological Insulators
articles.title_zh: 二维拓扑绝缘体磁力成像中的反常边缘对比度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.18281v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic force imaging (MFM) of 2D topological insulators, such as crystalline plates of Bi2Te3 and Bi2Se3, reveals anomalously large contrast around the plate edges even under ambient imaging conditions. And while there are several known contrast mechanisms in MFM, these cannot easily explain the magnitude of contrast observe for such systems. In this work we use multi-parameter magnetic force phase imaging together with a simple analytical model to suggest that the observed magnetic edge-features can be associated with two sources: a pseudo-Faraday effect in the conductive edge channels of the topological system and magnetic scattering in those channels caused by the proximal, localized field of the tip. These results suggest novel MFM contrast mechanisms unique to topological systems and point to the utility of multi-parameter MFM techniques in studies of topological-material-based circuit elements.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维拓扑绝缘体（例如 Bi2Te3 和 Bi2Se3 晶体板）的磁力成像 (MFM) 即使在环境成像条件下也能显示板边缘周围异常大的对比度。虽然 MFM 中有几种已知的对比机制，但这些机制无法轻松解释此类系统的对比观察量。在这项工作中，我们使用多参数磁力相位成像和一个简单的分析模型来表明观察到的磁边缘特征可以与两个来源相关：拓扑系统的导电边缘通道中的伪法拉第效应以及由尖端的近端局部场引起的这些通道中的磁散射。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维拓扑绝缘体（例如 Bi2Te3 和 Bi2Se3 晶体板）的磁力成像 (MFM) 即使在环境成像条件下也能显示板边缘周围异常大的对比度。虽然 MFM 中有几种已知的对比机制，但这些机制无法轻松解释此类系统的对比观察量。在这项工作中，我们使用多参数磁力相位成像和一个简单的分析模型来表明观察到的磁边缘特征可以与两个来源相关：拓扑系统的导电边缘通道中的伪法拉第效应以及由尖端的近端局部场引起的这些通道中的磁散射。这些结果表明了拓扑系统特有的新型 MFM 对比机制，并指出了多参数 MFM 技术在基于拓扑材料的电路元件研究中的实用性。

articles.title: Finite-momentum superconductivity with singlet-triplet mixing in an altermagnetic metal: A pairing instability analysis
articles.title_zh: 互磁金属中单重态-三重态混合的有限动量超导：配对不稳定性分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.12897v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyze the pairing instability of an altermagnetic metal on a square lattice driven by an attractive nearest-neighbor interaction. This interaction enables multiple pairing channels, including even-parity extended s-wave and d-wave states, as well as two odd-parity p-wave channels. We verify that altermagnetic spin-splitting in the single-particle dispersion gives rise to finite-momentum pairing between electrons with unlike spins, in agreement with earlier predictions. Quite unexpectedly, this pairing typically emerges across multiple channels with mixed parity. Consequently, the resulting finite-momentum Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) superconducting phase is expected to exhibit a multi-component order parameter featuring singlet-triplet mixing. We examine several forms of altermagnetism, specifically dₓy-wave and dₓ²-y²-wave altermagnetic couplings, and present the corresponding phase diagrams. Additionally, we study triplet pairing between electrons with identical spins and find that it always occurs at zero center-of-mass momentum. Although it is unfavorable in the regime of weak altermagnetic coupling and low electron filling, it can dominate the phase diagram when the altermagnetic coupling is sufficiently strong. The influence of on-site attractive interactions on mixed-parity pairing is also explored.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们分析了由吸引的最近邻相互作用驱动的方晶格上交磁金属的配对不稳定性。这种相互作用实现了多个配对通道，包括偶奇偶校验扩展 s 波和 d 波状态，以及两个奇奇偶校验 p 波通道。我们验证了单粒子分散体中的交变磁自旋分裂会在具有不同自旋的电子之间产生有限动量配对，这与早期的预测一致。出乎意料的是，这种配对通常出现在具有混合奇偶校验的多个渠道中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们分析了由吸引的最近邻相互作用驱动的方晶格上交磁金属的配对不稳定性。这种相互作用实现了多个配对通道，包括偶奇偶校验扩展 s 波和 d 波状态，以及两个奇奇偶校验 p 波通道。我们验证了单粒子分散体中的交变磁自旋分裂会在具有不同自旋的电子之间产生有限动量配对，这与早期的预测一致。出乎意料的是，这种配对通常出现在具有混合奇偶校验的多个渠道中。因此，由此产生的有限动量 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) 超导相预计将表现出具有单重态-三重态混合特征的多分量有序参数。我们研究了几种形式的交变磁力，特别是 dₓy 波和 dₓ²-y² 波交变磁耦合，并给出了相应的相图。此外，我们研究了具有相同自旋的电子之间的三重态配对，发现它总是发生在质心动量为零的情况下。尽管它在弱交磁耦合和低电子填充的情况下是不利的，但当交磁耦合足够强时，它可以主导相图。还探讨了现场吸引相互作用对混合奇偶配对的影响。

articles.title: Topologically quantized macroscopic attractor states in hydrated DNA
articles.title_zh: 水合 DNA 中的拓扑量子化宏观吸引子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26847v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Driven dissipative systems at ambient conditions typically exhibit continuous responses shaped by fluctuations and relaxation, with discrete macroscopic states arising only under specific dynamical constraints. Here, we report the emergence of discrete attractor states in a quasi-two-dimensional hydrated DNA sample under magnetic excitation. The transverse polarization voltage Vₓy displays telegraph switching between well-defined levels, indicating stochastic transitions between metastable macroscopic states. Statistical analysis of the voltage time series reveals bimodal distributions and strong Bayesian model selection in favor of multiple coexisting states. A phenomenological phase-field framework describes the observed metastability and switching in terms of a proposed collective U(1) polarization phase. Within this interpretation, phase-slip dynamics and integer-labeled winding sectors provide a possible organizing principle for the discrete macroscopic response. The results suggest that macroscopic quantization can emerge in a classical system at ambient conditions as a consequence of dissipative dynamics constrained by phase topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 环境条件下的驱动耗散系统通常表现出由波动和松弛形成的连续响应，只有在特定的动态约束下才会出现离散的宏观状态。在这里，我们报告了在磁激励下准二维水合 DNA 样品中离散吸引子态的出现。横向极化电压 Vₓy 显示明确定义的电平之间的电报切换，表明亚稳态宏观状态之间的随机转变。电压时间序列的统计分析揭示了双峰分布和有利于多种共存状态的强贝叶斯模型选择。现象学相场框架描述了所观察到的亚稳定性和根据所提出的集体 U(1) 极化相位的切换。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 环境条件下的驱动耗散系统通常表现出由波动和松弛形成的连续响应，只有在特定的动态约束下才会出现离散的宏观状态。在这里，我们报告了在磁激励下准二维水合 DNA 样品中离散吸引子态的出现。横向极化电压 Vₓy 显示明确定义的电平之间的电报切换，表明亚稳态宏观状态之间的随机转变。电压时间序列的统计分析揭示了双峰分布和有利于多种共存状态的强贝叶斯模型选择。现象学相场框架描述了所观察到的亚稳定性和根据所提出的集体 U(1) 极化相位的切换。在这种解释中，相滑动力学和整数标记的绕组扇区为离散宏观响应提供了可能的组织原则。结果表明，由于相拓扑约束的耗散动力学，宏观量子化可以在环境条件下出现在经典系统中。

articles.title: Complex surface patterning in homo- and heteroepitaxial contexts: (simultaneous) step bunching and step meandering
articles.title_zh: 同质和异质外延环境中的复杂表面图案：（同时）阶梯聚束和阶梯曲折
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.13821v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We confront a meso-scale continuum model, archetypical for the heteroepitaxial context, with an atomistic Vicinal Cellular Automaton (VicCA), built as a homoepitaxial counterpart, to show that in (2+1)D complex surface instabilities are fundamental growth phenomena rather than context-specific artifacts. Our approach is to first construct a Ginzburg-Landau-type model, designed to extend the previously (1+1)D Tersoff-type models to (2+1)D. We complement the continuum approach with a discrete one - the VicCA, in which we use a novel version of the potential landscape for the diffusing particles - a double-well potential located at each step edge. Importantly, this framework also captures both step bunching and step meandering. While these behaviors are rarely treated together in earlier approaches, they naturally coexist in real materials. Thus we establish a cross-context correspondence at the level of obtained morphologies and morphology diagrams and, additionally, a multiscale perspective on the governing parameters, bridging the gap between the mesoscale and atomistic modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们面对一个介观尺度的连续体模型，它是异质外延环境的原型，具有原子邻位细胞自动机（VicCA），作为同质外延的对应物，以表明在（2+1）D复杂表面不稳定性是基本的生长现象，而不是特定于环境的伪影。我们的方法是首先构建一个 Ginzburg-Landau 型模型，旨在将之前的 (1+1)D Tersoff 型模型扩展到 (2+1)D。我们用离散方法 - VicCA 来补充连续体方法，其中我们使用扩散粒子势能景观的新版本 - 位于每个台阶边缘的双阱势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们面对一个介观尺度的连续体模型，它是异质外延环境的原型，具有原子邻位细胞自动机（VicCA），作为同质外延的对应物，以表明在（2+1）D复杂表面不稳定性是基本的生长现象，而不是特定于环境的伪影。我们的方法是首先构建一个 Ginzburg-Landau 型模型，旨在将之前的 (1+1)D Tersoff 型模型扩展到 (2+1)D。我们用离散方法 - VicCA 来补充连续体方法，其中我们使用扩散粒子势能景观的新版本 - 位于每个台阶边缘的双阱势。重要的是，该框架还捕获了步骤聚束和步骤蜿蜒。虽然这些行为在早期方法中很少一起处理，但它们自然地共存于真实材料中。因此，我们在获得的形态和形态图的水平上建立了跨上下文对应关系，此外，还建立了控制参数的多尺度视角，弥合了介观模型和原子模型之间的差距。

articles.title: Engineering superconductivity on the surface of Weyl semimetals
articles.title_zh: 外尔半金属表面的工程超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.26859v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ten years after the experimental discovery of Weyl semimetals, theoretical and experimental work has pointed to the possibility of realizing surface-only superconductivity at relatively high temperatures in these materials. A consensus is developing that this unusual form of superconductivity is supported by surface electronic states unique to Weyl semimetals, known as Fermi arcs. In this work, we show that the topological protection of these exotic states can be exploited to engineer high critical temperatures. Motivated by reports of van Hove singularities on the surface of PtBi₂-the first Weyl semimetal in which surface superconductivity was unequivocally linked to its Fermi arcs-we demonstrate how such singularities can be engineered through the deposition of a suitable additional layer. We find that the critical temperature becomes extremely sensitive to the exact value of the chemical potential, and values as large as 20 times the bulk T_c can be achieved. More generally, our results demonstrate how topological protection can be exploited to manipulate surface electronic states, thereby opening experimentally accessible routes toward engineering high-temperature two-dimensional superconductivity and other exotic phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 在实验发现外尔半金属十年后，理论和实验工作指出了在这些材料中在相对较高的温度下实现仅表面超导的可能性。人们正在形成共识，即这种不寻常的超导形式是由韦尔半金属特有的表面电子态（称为费米弧）支持的。在这项工作中，我们表明可以利用这些奇异态的拓扑保护来设计高临界温度。 PtBi2 是第一种表面超导性与其费米弧明确相关的外尔半金属，受 PtBi2 表面范霍夫奇点报道的启发，我们演示了如何通过沉积合适的附加层来设计此类奇点。
